# Profile-guided optimization (clang and clang-cl), after Jetsku's U59 build. Use a separate build
# directory for each step:
# 1. KYTY_PGO_GENERATE=ON builds an instrumented emulator. Run it with KYTY_PGO_FILE=<x.profraw>:
#    it writes its counters every KYTY_PGO_DUMP_SECONDS (default 20) to that file (main.cpp), so a
#    run stopped with TerminateProcess keeps its last complete dump.
# 2. llvm-profdata merge -o <x.profdata> <dumps>, with the llvm-profdata of the compiler's version.
# 3. KYTY_PGO_USE=<x.profdata> builds the optimized emulator.
# Only Kyty's own targets (declared below) get the flags: third-party code a training run does not
# exercise (the SPIR-V optimizer, ...) keeps its normal optimization instead of being treated as
# cold. They are compile options, not CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS.
option(KYTY_PGO_GENERATE "Instrumented build for profile-guided optimization (clang)" OFF)
set(KYTY_PGO_USE "" CACHE FILEPATH "llvm-profdata output to optimize with (clang; empty: none)")
set(KYTY_PGO_RUNTIME "" CACHE FILEPATH "clang_rt.profile-x86_64.lib (clang-cl; empty: search)")
# KYTY_PGO: the profile kept in the repository, pgo/title.profdata (the title Performance and Fidelity,
# recorded with LLVM 22.1.8; an older compiler cannot read it). KYTY_PGO_USE, when set, wins.
option(KYTY_PGO "Optimize with pgo/title.profdata (clang)" OFF)
if(KYTY_PGO AND NOT KYTY_PGO_USE AND NOT KYTY_PGO_GENERATE)
	set(KYTY_PGO_USE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/pgo/title.profdata")
endif()
if(KYTY_PGO_GENERATE OR KYTY_PGO_USE)
	if(NOT CLANG)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "KYTY_PGO_GENERATE/KYTY_PGO_USE need clang or clang-cl")
	endif()
	if(KYTY_PGO_GENERATE AND KYTY_PGO_USE)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "KYTY_PGO_GENERATE and KYTY_PGO_USE are separate builds")
	endif()
endif()
if(KYTY_PGO_GENERATE)
	add_compile_options(-fprofile-instr-generate)
	add_compile_definitions(KYTY_PGO_GENERATE=1)
	if(KYTY_CLANG_CL)
		# lld-link is called directly, so the profile runtime has to be named. Some clang-cl
		# distributions do not ship it; the one of Visual Studio's LLVM of the same major version
		# works too (KYTY_PGO_RUNTIME).
		set(kyty_profile_runtime "${KYTY_PGO_RUNTIME}")
		if(NOT kyty_profile_runtime)
			cmake_path(GET CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER PARENT_PATH kyty_llvm_bin)
			file(GLOB kyty_profile_runtime "${kyty_llvm_bin}/../lib/clang/*/lib/windows/clang_rt.profile-x86_64.lib")
		endif()
		if(NOT kyty_profile_runtime)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "KYTY_PGO_GENERATE: clang_rt.profile-x86_64.lib not found next to ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}; set KYTY_PGO_RUNTIME")
		endif()
		list(GET kyty_profile_runtime 0 kyty_profile_runtime)
		link_libraries("${kyty_profile_runtime}")
		# clang 19 also asks for the runtime by its new name (clang_rt.profile.lib), which the
		# older-layout runtimes do not have; the one named above provides the same symbols.
		add_link_options("/NODEFAULTLIB:clang_rt.profile.lib")
	else()
		add_link_options(-fprofile-instr-generate)
	endif()
	message(STATUS "PGO: instrumented build (run with KYTY_PGO_FILE=<file.profraw>)")
elseif(KYTY_PGO_USE)
	if(NOT EXISTS "${KYTY_PGO_USE}")
		# A missing profile never fails the build: it is built without one.
		message(WARNING "KYTY_PGO_USE: ${KYTY_PGO_USE} does not exist, building without a profile")
	else()
		# No warnings for sources without profile data (launcher, tests) or per function; a
		# function that changed since the profile was recorded is optimized without it.
		add_compile_options("-fprofile-instr-use=${KYTY_PGO_USE}" -Wno-profile-instr-unprofiled
		                    -Wno-profile-instr-out-of-date -Wno-backend-plugin)
		message(STATUS "PGO: optimizing with ${KYTY_PGO_USE}")
	endif()
endif()

# Code generation for the machine class this runs on, both off by default (a release must run on
# any x86-64 CPU and a clean build with ThinLTO takes about as long again):
# - KYTY_NATIVE_V3: x86-64-v3 (AVX2, BMI1/2, FMA, LZCNT, MOVBE: Intel since Haswell 2013, AMD since
#   Excavator/Zen). The emulator does not start on older CPUs.
# - KYTY_THINLTO: ThinLTO across translation units (clang and clang-cl, with lld).
option(KYTY_NATIVE_V3 "Compile for x86-64-v3 (AVX2/BMI2/FMA CPUs; clang)" OFF)
option(KYTY_THINLTO "Optimize across translation units with ThinLTO (clang with lld)" OFF)
if(KYTY_NATIVE_V3)
	if(NOT CLANG)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "KYTY_NATIVE_V3 needs clang or clang-cl")
	endif()
	if(KYTY_CLANG_CL)
		add_compile_options("/clang:-march=x86-64-v3")
	else()
		add_compile_options(-march=x86-64-v3)
	endif()
	message(STATUS "Code generation: x86-64-v3 (AVX2)")
endif()
if(KYTY_THINLTO)
	if(NOT CLANG)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "KYTY_THINLTO needs clang or clang-cl")
	endif()
	add_compile_options(-flto=thin)
	message(STATUS "Code generation: ThinLTO")
endif()

)
list(APPEND kyty_emulator_src "${indirect_thread_shader_header}")

# The buffer cache's batched uploads (see BufferCache::FlushUploadBatch()).

	OUTPUT "${buffer_scatter_shader_header}"
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${gpu_tiler_generated_dir}"
	COMMAND "${KYTY_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR}" -V --target-env vulkan1.3 -Os
	        -o "${buffer_scatter_shader_spv}" "${buffer_scatter_shader_source}"
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DINPUT=${buffer_scatter_shader_spv} -DOUTPUT=${buffer_scatter_shader_header}
	        -DSYMBOL=BUFFER_SCATTER_SPV -P "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/embed_spirv.cmake"
	DEPENDS "${buffer_scatter_shader_source}"
	VERBATIM
)
list(APPEND kyty_emulator_src "${buffer_scatter_shader_header}")

# Native ray tracing: walks of the guest BVHs (see nativeRayTracing.h).
foreach(shader_name IN ITEMS rt_tlas_walk rt_blas_walk hle_tlas hle_blas_refit)
	set(shader_source "${gpu_tiler_shader_dir}/${shader_name}.comp")
	set(shader_spv "${gpu_tiler_generated_dir}/${shader_name}.spv")
	set(shader_header "${gpu_tiler_generated_dir}/${shader_name}_spv.h")
	string(TOUPPER "${shader_name}_SPV" shader_symbol)
	add_custom_command(
		OUTPUT "${shader_header}"
		COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${gpu_tiler_generated_dir}"
		COMMAND "${KYTY_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR}" -V --target-env vulkan1.3 -Os
		        -DCACHING_PAGEBITS=14 "-I${gpu_tiler_shader_dir}"
		        -o "${shader_spv}" "${shader_source}"
		COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DINPUT=${shader_spv} -DOUTPUT=${shader_header}
		        -DSYMBOL=${shader_symbol} -P "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/embed_spirv.cmake"
		DEPENDS "${shader_source}" "${gpu_tiler_shader_dir}/rt_common.inc"
		VERBATIM
	)
	list(APPEND kyty_emulator_src "${shader_header}")
endforeach()
list(APPEND kyty_emulator_src ${gpu_tiler_shader_headers})

set(gpu_blit_generated_dir "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/gpu_blit_shaders")
function(add_gpu_blit_shader shader_name shader_file)
	set(shader_source "${gpu_tiler_shader_dir}/${shader_file}")
	set(shader_spv "${gpu_blit_generated_dir}/${shader_name}.spv")
	set(shader_header "${gpu_blit_generated_dir}/${shader_name}_spv.h")
	string(TOUPPER "${shader_name}_SPV" shader_symbol)
	add_custom_command(
		OUTPUT "${shader_header}"
		COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${gpu_blit_generated_dir}"
		COMMAND "${KYTY_GLSLANG_VALIDATOR}" -V --target-env vulkan1.3 -Os ${ARGN}
		        "-I${gpu_tiler_shader_dir}" -o "${shader_spv}" "${shader_source}"
		COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DINPUT=${shader_spv} -DOUTPUT=${shader_header}
		        -DSYMBOL=${shader_symbol} -P "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/embed_spirv.cmake"
		DEPENDS "${shader_source}" "${gpu_tiler_shader_dir}/gpu_video_out_hdr10_to_sdr.inc"
		VERBATIM
	)
	set(gpu_blit_shader_headers ${gpu_blit_shader_headers} "${shader_header}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(add_kyty_full_emulator_test target source)
	add_executable(${target} EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${source} ${kyty_emulator_src})
	target_link_libraries(${target} ${kyty_emulator_link_libraries})
	target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE ${inc_headers})
	if (WIN32)
		target_link_libraries(${target} iphlpapi dxgi)
	endif()
	if (KYTY_CLANG_CL)
		target_link_libraries(${target} onecore)
		add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${KYTY_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/winpthread/bin/libwinpthread-1.dll" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>/libwinpthread-1.dll)
	endif()
	# The macOS x86_64 guest address space needs its .zerofill segments anchored
	# by linker flags, or the kernel kills the binary on load (posix_spawn EIO).
	configure_macos_guest_address_space(${target})
endfunction()

function(configure_macos_guest_address_space target)
	if(APPLE AND (CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL "x86_64" OR
			(NOT CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64)$")))
		target_sources(${target} PRIVATE "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/kernel/macosGuestAddressSpace.cpp")
		target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE KYTY_LINKED_GUEST_ADDRESS_SPACE=1)
		target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE
			-Wl,-ld_classic,-no_pie,-no_fixup_chains,-no_huge,-pagezero_size,0x40000,-segaddr,SYSTEM_MANAGED,0x40000,-segaddr,SYSTEM_RESERVED,0x7ffffc000,-segaddr,USER_AREA,0x7000000000,-image_base,0x700000000000)
	endif()
endfunction()

# Common::SoftExitScope turns a fatal error of the current thread into a C++ exception: its
# thrower and the renderer code that catches it need exceptions where they are off by default.
if(NOT KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	target_compile_options(common PRIVATE -fexceptions)
	set_source_files_properties(
		"${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/descriptors.cpp"
		"${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineCache.cpp"
		PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS -fexceptions)
endif()

# These tests use exceptions.
if(NOT KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	foreach(kyty_exception_test scalar_provenance_tests resource_tracking_tests
			virtual_memory_allocation_tests)
		target_compile_options(${kyty_exception_test} PRIVATE -fexceptions)
	endforeach()
endif()

# Test Darwin signal-context restoration for SSE4a instructions.
if(APPLE AND (CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL "x86_64" OR
		(NOT CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64)$")))
	add_executable(macos_sse4a_tests EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
		"${KYTY_TESTS_DIR}/macosSse4aTests.cpp"
		"${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/loader/x64InstructionEmulator.cpp"
		"${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/loader/guestInstructionPatcher.cpp"
	)
	target_link_libraries(macos_sse4a_tests common fmt::fmt Zydis::Zydis xbyak::xbyak)
	target_include_directories(macos_sse4a_tests PRIVATE ${inc_headers})
	if(BUILD_TESTING)
		add_test(NAME macos_sse4a COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:macos_sse4a_tests>)
		set_tests_properties(macos_sse4a PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
		add_dependencies(kyty_tests macos_sse4a_tests)
	endif()
endif()

add_executable(kyty_emulator "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp" ${kyty_emulator_src})
configure_macos_guest_address_space(kyty_emulator)

# Hybrid step 0: the GPU libraries as a DLL resolved by NID from the AnyPS5 executable.
if (WIN32)
	add_library(kyty_gpu SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/hybrid/kytyGpu.cpp" ${kyty_emulator_src})
	target_link_libraries(kyty_gpu ${kyty_emulator_link_libraries} opengl32 iphlpapi setupapi ws2_32 dxgi ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
	if (KYTY_CLANG_CL)
		target_link_libraries(kyty_gpu onecore)
	endif()
	target_include_directories(kyty_gpu PRIVATE ${inc_headers})
endif()

set(KYTY_TROPHY_UNLOCK_SOUND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/sounds/trophy-unlock.wav")
add_custom_target(kyty_trophy_sound
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/assets/sounds"
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${KYTY_TROPHY_UNLOCK_SOUND}"
		"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/assets/sounds/trophy-unlock.wav"
	VERBATIM)
add_dependencies(kyty_emulator kyty_trophy_sound)
install(FILES "${KYTY_TROPHY_UNLOCK_SOUND}" DESTINATION assets/sounds)

	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/cursors"
		"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/assets/cursors"
	VERBATIM)

# Per-title pipeline manifests (<TITLE_ID>_<APP_VER>.kpm), read at boot.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/pipelines")
	add_custom_target(kyty_pipeline_manifests
		COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
			"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/pipelines"
			"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/assets/pipelines"
		VERBATIM)
	add_dependencies(kyty_emulator kyty_pipeline_manifests)
	install(DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/pipelines" DESTINATION assets)
endif()

set(KYTY_NOTO_SANS_FONTS
	"${KYTY_NOTO_SANS_DIR}/NotoSans-Regular.ttf"
	"${KYTY_NOTO_SANS_DIR}/NotoSans-Bold.ttf"

	"${KYTY_NOTO_SANS_DIR}/NotoSans-BoldItalic.ttf")

	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/assets/fonts"
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different ${KYTY_NOTO_SANS_FONTS}
		"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/assets/fonts"
	VERBATIM)

	target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator iphlpapi)
	target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator setupapi)
	target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator ws2_32)
	target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator dxgi)
endif()
if (KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator onecore)
endif()
if (CLANG AND NOT KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator pthread)
endif()
# dlopen/dlsym/dladdr for RenderDoc.
target_link_libraries(kyty_emulator ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_include_directories(kyty_emulator PRIVATE ${inc_headers})

clang_tidy_check(kyty_emulator "" "${check_headers}" "${inc_headers}")

include_what_you_use(kyty_emulator "${inc_headers}")

set(KYTY_EMULATOR_MAP_NAME "kyty_emulator_${KYTY_COMPILER_ID}_${KYTY_LINKER_ID}.map")

set(KYTY_EMULATOR_MAP_LINK_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${KYTY_EMULATOR_MAP_NAME}")
set(KYTY_EMULATOR_PDB_LINK_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/kyty_emulator.pdb")

if(KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	target_link_options(kyty_emulator PRIVATE
		"/DYNAMICBASE:NO"
		"/DEBUG:FULL"
		"/PDB:${KYTY_EMULATOR_PDB_LINK_PATH}"
		"/lldmap:${KYTY_EMULATOR_MAP_LINK_PATH}"
	)
	add_custom_command(TARGET kyty_emulator POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${KYTY_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/winpthread/bin/libwinpthread-1.dll" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kyty_emulator>/libwinpthread-1.dll)
elseif(WIN32 OR LINUX)
	set_target_properties(kyty_emulator PROPERTIES LINK_FLAGS "${KYTY_LD_OPTIONS}")
	# LINK_FLAGS is a space-delimited string: a -Map path containing spaces would
	# be split into bogus arguments, so pass it as a discrete link option instead.
	target_link_options(kyty_emulator PRIVATE "-Wl,-Map=${KYTY_EMULATOR_MAP_LINK_PATH}")
endif()

if(LINUX)
    target_link_options(kyty_emulator PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Wl,--strip-all>
    )
endif()

if(APPLE)
	# The emulator writes x86-64 trampolines/PLT stubs into memory and executes them, and
	# runs guest code under Rosetta. That requires the JIT / unsigned-executable-memory
	# entitlements, so re-sign the binary after every link (an unsigned/relinked binary
	# reverts to the hardened defaults and aborts when it first executes written code).
	add_custom_command(TARGET kyty_emulator POST_BUILD
		COMMAND codesign -s - --force --options runtime
			--entitlements "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/macos_jit.entitlements"
			$<TARGET_FILE:kyty_emulator>
		COMMENT "Codesign kyty_emulator with JIT entitlements (macOS)")
endif()

install(TARGETS kyty_emulator DESTINATION .)
if(KYTY_BUILD_LAUNCHER)
	add_subdirectory("${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/launcher" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/launcher")

	if(LINUX)
		target_link_options(launcher PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Wl,--strip-all>)
		target_link_options(kyty_updater PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Wl,--strip-all>)
	endif()
endif()
if(KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	install(FILES "${KYTY_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/winpthread/bin/libwinpthread-1.dll" DESTINATION .)
endif()

`README.md`:

```md
# kyty-gpu-hybrid

A fork of KytyPS5 by [TheCruZ](https://github.com/TheCruZ), itself based on the original
[Kyty](https://github.com/InoriRus/Kyty) emulator by InoriRus.

This fork builds Kyty's GPU (the guest command processor, the shader recompiler and the Vulkan
renderer) so that another PS5 compatibility layer can load it as a DLL and use it as its graphics
backend. The rest of Kyty is kept so the fork can still be built and tested on its own.

Branches:
- `hibrido`: the GPU DLL build and the fixes it needs.
- `kyty-puro`: the AMD fixes only, on top of KytyPS5, without the DLL changes.

## License

GPL-2.0, as KytyPS5 (see `LICENSE`). The original Kyty code is MIT (see `LICENSES/Kyty-MIT.txt`).

## Credits

- InoriRus, for Kyty.
- TheCruZ and the KytyPS5 contributors, for the fork this one starts from.

Test suite: 37/79 pass on Windows/clang-cl; the failures predate this fork's changes.

No game files, keys or firmware are part of this repository.

```

`docs/notification-localization.md`:

```md
# Notification localization

Trophy notification subtitles use the configured console language. Trophy names still come
from the game's metadata. The launcher trophy dialogs are unchanged.

Edit `assets/localization/<locale>.json`, using flat UTF-8 string values:

```json
{
  "trophy.toast.earned": "Trophy earned!"
}
```

CMake converts the catalogs into C++ byte arrays in the build directory. The emulator parses
the embedded catalogs once and falls back to `en-US.json` for missing translations. No language
files or translation service are needed at runtime. Rebuild after editing a catalog.

For local testing, rebuild `kyty_emulator`, choose a game's Console Language in the launcher,
and unlock a trophy with notifications enabled. Installed system fonts provide non-Latin
glyphs; the selected language needs an appropriate font on the host.

```

`src/common/CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
file(GLOB common_src CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
	"*.cpp"
	"logging/*.cpp"
	"platform/*.cpp"
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE common_headers CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "*.h")

if(KYTY_CLANG_CL)
	set_source_files_properties(${common_src} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-pragma-pack")
endif()

add_library(common STATIC ${common_src} ${common_headers})

set(localization_dir "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/localization")
file(GLOB localization_catalogs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${localization_dir}/*.json")
set(localization_data "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/localizationData.h")
add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT "${localization_data}"
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} "-DINPUTS=${localization_catalogs}" "-DOUTPUT=${localization_data}"
		-P "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/embed_localization.cmake"
	DEPENDS ${localization_catalogs} "${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}/embed_localization.cmake"
	COMMENT "Embed notification localization catalogs"
	VERBATIM
)
target_sources(common PRIVATE "${localization_data}")

target_include_directories(common
	PUBLIC ${KYTY_SOURCE_DIR}
	PRIVATE
		${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
		${KYTY_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/cpuinfo/include
)

target_link_libraries(common
	PUBLIC
		fmt::fmt
		Tracy::TracyClient
	PRIVATE
		cpuinfo
		kyty_git_version
		spdlog::spdlog
		ZArchive::zarchive
		nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
)
if(APPLE)
	# hostStats.cpp reads GPU utilization from the IOAccelerator registry entries.
	target_link_libraries(common PRIVATE "-framework CoreFoundation" "-framework IOKit")
endif()

get_property(inc_headers TARGET common PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
set(check_headers ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

clang_tidy_check(common "" "${check_headers}" "${inc_headers}")
include_what_you_use(common "${inc_headers}")

`src/common/additionalContent.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common/additionalContent.h"

#include "common/stringUtils.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
#include <regex>
#include <system_error>

namespace Common {

namespace {

std::string GetString(const nlohmann::json& object, const std::string& key) {
	const auto it = object.find(key);
	return it != object.end() && it->is_string() ? it->get<std::string>() : std::string {};
}

std::string GetTitle(const nlohmann::json& param) {
	const auto localized = param.find("localizedParameters");
	if (localized != param.end() && localized->is_object()) {
		const auto preferred = localized->find(GetString(*localized, "defaultLanguage"));
		if (preferred != localized->end()) {
			if (auto title = GetString(*preferred, "titleName"); !title.empty()) {
				return title;
			}
		}
		for (const auto& language: *localized) {
			if (auto title = GetString(language, "titleName"); !title.empty()) {
				return title;
			}
		}
	}
	return GetString(param, "titleName");
}

} // namespace

std::vector<AddContentEntry> FindAddContent(const std::filesystem::path& dir,
                                            const std::string&           title_id) {
	if (dir.empty() || title_id.empty()) {
		return {};
	}

	std::error_code ec;
	const auto      root = std::filesystem::absolute(dir, ec);
	if (ec) {
		return {};
	}

	// Scan directories separately so an unreadable child does not discard its siblings.
	std::vector<std::filesystem::path> pending {root};
	std::vector<std::filesystem::path> params;
	while (!pending.empty()) {
		const auto current = std::move(pending.back());
		pending.pop_back();
		std::filesystem::directory_iterator it(
		    current, std::filesystem::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec);
		const std::filesystem::directory_iterator end;
		for (; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) {
			std::error_code entry_ec;
			if (it->is_directory(entry_ec) && !it->is_symlink(entry_ec) && !entry_ec) {
				pending.push_back(it->path());
			} else if (it->is_regular_file(entry_ec) && !entry_ec &&
			           EqualNoCase(PathToString(it->path().filename()), "param.json") &&
			           EqualNoCase(PathToString(it->path().parent_path().filename()), "sce_sys")) {
				params.push_back(it->path());
			}
		}
	}
	std::sort(params.begin(), params.end());

	static const std::regex content_id_pattern(
	    "^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{4}[0-9]{5}_[0-9]{2}-[A-Z0-9]{16}$");
	std::map<std::string, AddContentEntry> by_label;
	for (const auto& file: params) {
		const auto size = std::filesystem::file_size(file, ec);
		if (ec || size > 1024 * 1024) {
			continue;
		}
		std::ifstream stream(file, std::ios::binary);
		if (!stream) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto param = nlohmann::json::parse(stream, nullptr, false);
		// applicationCategoryType is required for applications, not additional content.
		if (!param.is_object() || param.contains("applicationCategoryType")) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto content_id = GetString(param, "contentId");
		if (!std::regex_match(content_id, content_id_pattern) ||
		    content_id.compare(7, 9, title_id) != 0) {
			continue;
		}

		const auto mount_dir = file.parent_path().parent_path();
		const auto label     = content_id.substr(20);
		by_label.try_emplace(label,
		                     AddContentEntry {content_id, label, mount_dir, GetTitle(param)});
	}

	std::vector<AddContentEntry> entries;
	entries.reserve(by_label.size());
	for (auto& [label, entry]: by_label) {
		entries.push_back(std::move(entry));
	}
	return entries;
}

std::optional<AddContentEntry> ParseAddContent(std::string_view value) {
	static const std::regex label_pattern("^[A-Z0-9]{16}$");
	const auto              eq    = value.find('=');
	const auto              label = value.substr(0, eq);
	if (!std::regex_match(label.begin(), label.end(), label_pattern)) {
		return std::nullopt;
	}

	AddContentEntry entry {{}, std::string(label), {}, {}};
	if (eq != std::string_view::npos) {
		entry.mount_dir = PathFromUtf8(FixFilenameSlash(value.substr(eq + 1)));
		std::error_code ec;
		if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(entry.mount_dir, ec)) {
			return std::nullopt;
		}
	}
	return entry;
}

} // namespace Common

// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2014 Jannik Vogel <email@jannikvogel.de>
// SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <type_traits>

namespace Common {

template <typename T>
[[nodiscard]] constexpr T AlignUp(T value, std::size_t size) {
	static_assert(std::is_unsigned_v<T>, "T must be an unsigned value.");
	auto mod{static_cast<T>(value % size)};
	value -= mod;
	return static_cast<T>(mod == T{0} ? value : value + size);
}

template <typename T>
[[nodiscard]] constexpr T AlignDown(T value, std::size_t size) {
	static_assert(std::is_unsigned_v<T>, "T must be an unsigned value.");
	return static_cast<T>(value - value % size);
}

} // namespace Common

```cpp
#include "common/archive.h"

#include "common/stringUtils.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <zarchive/zarchivereader.h>

// POSIX hosts and MinGW's pthread-backed libstdc++ have cancellable condition waits.
// MSVC/ClangCL and MinGW's native Win32 threading backend do not use pthread waits.
#if !defined(_WIN32) || defined(_GLIBCXX_GCC_GTHR_POSIX_H)
#include <pthread.h>
#define KYTY_ARCHIVE_PTHREAD_CANCELLATION
#endif

namespace Common {

// Backends expose immutable metadata and offset-based reads. Cursor management, path routing,
// reader lifetime and the host-stack worker are shared by every archive format.
class ArchiveReader {
public:
	struct Entry {
		uint64_t id;
		uint64_t size;
		bool     is_file;
	};

	virtual ~ArchiveReader()                                                       = default;
	virtual std::optional<Entry>        Find(std::string_view member)              = 0;
	virtual std::vector<File::DirEntry> List(std::string_view member)              = 0;
	virtual uint64_t Read(uint64_t id, uint64_t offset, uint32_t size, void* data) = 0;
};

namespace {

class ZArchiveReaderBackend final: public ArchiveReader {
public:
	explicit ZArchiveReaderBackend(std::unique_ptr<ZArchiveReader> reader)
	    : m_reader(std::move(reader)) {}

	std::optional<Entry> Find(std::string_view member) override {
		const auto node = m_reader->LookUp(member);
		if (node == ZARCHIVE_INVALID_NODE) {
			return {};
		}
		return Entry {node, m_reader->GetFileSize(node), m_reader->IsFile(node)};
	}

	std::vector<File::DirEntry> List(std::string_view member) override {
		const auto node = m_reader->LookUp(member);
		if (!m_reader->IsDirectory(node)) {
			return {};
		}
		const auto count = m_reader->GetDirEntryCount(node);
		if (count > (1u << 20u)) {
			return {};
		}
		std::vector<File::DirEntry> result;
		result.reserve(count);
		for (uint32_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
			ZArchiveReader::DirEntry entry {};
			if (m_reader->GetDirEntry(node, index, entry)) {
				result.push_back({std::string(entry.name), entry.isFile});
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	uint64_t Read(uint64_t id, uint64_t offset, uint32_t size, void* data) override {
		// ZArchiveReader already serializes access to its stream and decompression cache.
		return m_reader->ReadFromFile(static_cast<ZArchiveNodeHandle>(id), offset, size, data);
	}

private:
	std::unique_ptr<ZArchiveReader> m_reader;
};

std::shared_ptr<ArchiveReader> OpenZArchive(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	auto reader = std::unique_ptr<ZArchiveReader>(ZArchiveReader::OpenFromFile(path));
	return reader ? std::make_shared<ZArchiveReaderBackend>(std::move(reader)) : nullptr;
}

struct ArchiveFormat {
	std::string_view extension;
	std::shared_ptr<ArchiveReader> (*open)(const std::filesystem::path&);
};

constexpr ArchiveFormat Formats[] = {{".zar", OpenZArchive}};
using NativeView                  = std::basic_string_view<std::filesystem::path::value_type>;

const ArchiveFormat* FindFormat(NativeView path) {
	for (const auto& format: Formats) {
		if (path.size() < format.extension.size()) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto extension = path.substr(path.size() - format.extension.size());
		if (std::equal(
		        extension.begin(), extension.end(), format.extension.begin(),
		        [](auto a, char b) { return (a >= 'A' && a <= 'Z' ? a + ('a' - 'A') : a) == b; })) {
			return &format;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

size_t FindMarker(NativeView path) {
	// Native files use this check on every operation. The usual path has no marker and allocates
	// nothing.
	for (auto marker = path.find('!'); marker != NativeView::npos;
	     marker      = path.find('!', marker + 1)) {
		if ((marker + 1 == path.size() || path[marker + 1] == '/' || path[marker + 1] == '\\') &&
		    FindFormat(path.substr(0, marker)) != nullptr) {
			return marker;
		}
	}
	return NativeView::npos;
}

struct ParsedPath {
	std::filesystem::path archive;
	std::string           member;
};

std::optional<ParsedPath> ParsePath(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	const auto& native = path.native();
	const auto  marker = FindMarker(native);
	if (marker == NativeView::npos) {
		return {};
	}
	ParsedPath parsed {.archive = std::filesystem::path(native.substr(0, marker))};
	auto       member = PathToGenericString(std::filesystem::path(native.substr(marker + 1)));
	std::replace(member.begin(), member.end(), '\\', '/');
	std::string_view remaining = member;
	while (!remaining.empty()) {
		const auto separator = remaining.find('/');
		const auto component = remaining.substr(0, separator);
		remaining.remove_prefix(separator == std::string_view::npos ? remaining.size() : separator + 1);
		if (component.empty() || component == ".") {
			continue;
		}
		if (component == "..") {
			if (parsed.member.empty()) {
				return {};
			}
			const auto separator = parsed.member.rfind('/');
			parsed.member.resize(separator == std::string::npos ? 0 : separator);
		} else {
			if (!parsed.member.empty()) {
				parsed.member += '/';
			}
			parsed.member += component;
		}
	}
	return parsed;
}

std::mutex                                                              g_readers_mutex;
std::unordered_map<std::filesystem::path, std::weak_ptr<ArchiveReader>> g_readers;

// Guest stacks can be only 64 KiB. Decompress on an ordinary host stack, then copy into guest
// memory on the caller so GPU-tracked writes use its fault handler. A single worker bounds host
// threads and avoids duplicating the archive's own block cache. Requests live on waiting callers.
class ArchiveIoThread {
public:
	static ArchiveIoThread& Instance() {
		// Guest exit can run static destructors while other guest threads are still reading.
		// Keep the worker alive until process termination, as with the guest threads themselves.
		static auto* instance = new ArchiveIoThread;
		return *instance;
	}

	uint64_t Read(ArchiveReader& reader, uint64_t id, uint64_t offset, uint32_t size, void* data) {
		Request          request {reader, id, offset, size, data};
		std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
		if (m_last != nullptr) {
			m_last->next = &request;
		} else {
			m_first = &request;
		}
		m_last = &request;
		m_wake.notify_one();
		request.ready.wait(lock, [&] { return request.done; });
		return request.result;
	}

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(ArchiveIoThread);

private:
	struct Request {
		ArchiveReader&          reader;
		uint64_t                id;
		uint64_t                offset;
		uint32_t                size;
		void*                   data;
		Request*                next   = nullptr;
		uint64_t                result = 0;
		bool                    done   = false;
		std::condition_variable ready {};
	};

	ArchiveIoThread() {
		std::thread([this] { Loop(); }).detach();
	}

	void Loop() {
		for (;;) {
			Request* request;
			{
				std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
				m_wake.wait(lock, [this] { return m_first != nullptr; });
				request = m_first;
				m_first = request->next;
				if (m_first == nullptr) {
					m_last = nullptr;
				}
			}
			const auto result =
			    request->reader.Read(request->id, request->offset, request->size, request->data);
			{
				std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
				request->result = result;
				request->done   = true;
				// Notify before releasing the mutex: the waiting caller owns the condition
				// variable.
				request->ready.notify_one();
			}
		}
	}

	std::mutex              m_mutex;
	std::condition_variable m_wake;
	Request*                m_first = nullptr;
	Request*                m_last  = nullptr;
};

} // namespace

struct ArchiveFile::Private {
	std::shared_ptr<ArchiveReader> reader;
	ArchiveReader::Entry           entry;
	uint64_t                       position = 0;
};

ArchiveFile::ArchiveFile(std::unique_ptr<Private> p): m_p(std::move(p)) {}
ArchiveFile::~ArchiveFile() = default;

uint64_t ArchiveFile::Size() const {
	return m_p->entry.size;
}
uint64_t ArchiveFile::Tell() const {
	return m_p->position;
}
bool ArchiveFile::Seek(uint64_t offset) {
	m_p->position = offset;
	return true;
}

void ArchiveFile::Read(void* data, uint32_t size, uint32_t* bytes_read) {
#if defined(KYTY_ARCHIVE_PTHREAD_CANCELLATION)
	// A pending cancellation must not destroy the waiting request or its TLS buffer while the
	// worker still uses them. Restore the caller's state only after the copy is complete.
	int cancellation_state = PTHREAD_CANCEL_ENABLE;
	pthread_setcancelstate(PTHREAD_CANCEL_DISABLE, &cancellation_state);
#endif
	constexpr uint32_t                chunk_size = 1u << 20u;
	thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> chunk;
	uint32_t                          read = 0;
	if (data != nullptr && size != 0 && m_p->position < Size()) {
		const auto requested =
		    static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(size, Size() - m_p->position));
		if (chunk.size() < std::min(chunk_size, requested)) {
			chunk.resize(std::min(chunk_size, requested));
		}
		while (read < requested) {
			const auto step = std::min(chunk_size, requested - read);
			const auto got  = ArchiveIoThread::Instance().Read(*m_p->reader, m_p->entry.id,
			                                                   m_p->position, step, chunk.data());
			if (got == 0 || got > step) {
				break;
			}
			std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(data) + read, chunk.data(), got);
			read += static_cast<uint32_t>(got);
			m_p->position += got;
			if (got < step) {
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	if (bytes_read != nullptr) {
		*bytes_read = read;
	}
#if defined(KYTY_ARCHIVE_PTHREAD_CANCELLATION)
	pthread_setcancelstate(cancellation_state, nullptr);
#endif
}

std::filesystem::path MakeArchivePath(const std::filesystem::path& archive,
                                      const std::filesystem::path& member) {
	auto root = archive;
	root += "!";
	return member.empty() ? root : root / member.relative_path();
}

bool IsSupportedArchive(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	return FindFormat(path.native()) != nullptr;
}

bool IsArchivePath(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	return FindMarker(path.native()) != NativeView::npos;
}

std::filesystem::path GetArchiveHostPath(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	const auto marker = FindMarker(path.native());
	return marker == NativeView::npos ? std::filesystem::path {}
	                                  : std::filesystem::path(path.native().substr(0, marker));
}

std::shared_ptr<ArchiveReader> OpenArchive(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	const auto  archive = IsArchivePath(path) ? GetArchiveHostPath(path) : path;
	const auto* format  = FindFormat(archive.native());
	if (format == nullptr) {
		return {};
	}
	std::error_code error;
	auto            key = std::filesystem::absolute(archive, error);
	if (error) {
		return {};
	}
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(g_readers_mutex);
		if (auto it = g_readers.find(key); it != g_readers.end()) {
			if (auto reader = it->second.lock()) {
				return reader;
			}
		}
	}
	// Do not hold the cache mutex while opening an unrelated archive from disk.
	auto reader = format->open(archive);
	if (reader == nullptr) {
		return {};
	}
	std::lock_guard lock(g_readers_mutex);
	std::erase_if(g_readers, [](const auto& entry) { return entry.second.expired(); });
	auto& cached = g_readers[key];
	if (auto existing = cached.lock()) {
		return existing;
	}
	cached = reader;
	return reader;
}

std::optional<File::Info> GetArchiveInfo(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	const auto parsed = ParsePath(path);
	if (parsed) {
		if (auto reader = OpenArchive(parsed->archive)) {
			if (auto entry = reader->Find(parsed->member)) {
				return File::Info {entry->is_file, entry->size};
			}
		}
	}
	return {};
}

std::vector<File::DirEntry> GetArchiveDirEntries(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	const auto parsed = ParsePath(path);
	if (parsed) {
		if (auto reader = OpenArchive(parsed->archive)) {
			return reader->List(parsed->member);
		}
	}
	return {};
}

std::unique_ptr<ArchiveFile> OpenArchiveFile(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	auto parsed = ParsePath(path);
	if (!parsed) {
		return {};
	}
	auto       reader = OpenArchive(parsed->archive);
	const auto entry  = reader ? reader->Find(parsed->member) : std::nullopt;
	if (!entry || !entry->is_file) {
		return {};
	}
	auto p     = std::make_unique<ArchiveFile::Private>();
	p->reader  = std::move(reader);
	p->entry   = *entry;
	return std::unique_ptr<ArchiveFile>(new ArchiveFile(std::move(p)));
}

} // namespace Common

`src/common/archivePack.cpp`:

```cpp
// Kept out of archive.cpp so the statically linked emulator does not pull in the writer and the
// zstd compressor.
#include "common/archive.h"

#include "common/stringUtils.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <zarchive/zarchivewriter.h>

namespace Common {

bool PackArchive(const std::filesystem::path& directory, const std::filesystem::path& archive,
                 const std::function<bool(uint64_t done, uint64_t total)>& progress) {
	namespace fs = std::filesystem;
	struct Output {
		File file;
		bool ok = true;
	} output;
	// Create the archive before walking, so a re-run started while a cancelled pack is still
	// walking sees it exists instead of losing its archive to that pack's cleanup.
	if (!output.file.Create(archive)) {
		return false;
	}
	struct Entry {
		fs::path path;
		uint64_t size;
		bool     is_file;
	};
	std::vector<Entry> entries;
	uint64_t           total = 0;
	std::error_code    error;
	// Follow directory links, as the emulator does when it runs the folder.
	fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(directory, fs::directory_options::follow_directory_symlink,
	                                    error);
	for (; !error && it != fs::end(it); it.increment(error)) {
		const bool is_file = !it->is_directory(error);
		const auto size    = is_file && !error ? it->file_size(error) : 0;
		if (error) {
			break;
		}
		entries.push_back({it->path(), size, is_file});
		total += size;
	}
	output.ok = !error;
	ZArchiveWriter writer(
	    [](int32_t, void*) {},
	    [](const void* data, size_t size, void* opaque) {
		    auto&    out     = *static_cast<Output*>(opaque);
		    uint32_t written = 0;
		    out.file.Write(data, static_cast<uint32_t>(size), &written);
		    out.ok = out.ok && written == size;
	    },
	    &output);
	std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(1u << 20u);
	uint64_t             done = 0;
	for (size_t index = 0; output.ok && index < entries.size(); index++) {
		const auto& entry = entries[index];
		const auto  name  = PathToGenericString(entry.path.lexically_relative(directory));
		File        input;
		output.ok = entry.is_file ? writer.StartNewFile(name.c_str()) &&
		                                input.Open(entry.path, File::Mode::Read)
		                          : writer.MakeDir(name.c_str());
		for (uint64_t left = entry.size; output.ok && left != 0;) {
			uint32_t read = 0;
			input.Read(buffer.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(left, buffer.size())),
			           &read);
			writer.AppendData(buffer.data(), read);
			done += read;
			left -= read;
			output.ok = output.ok && read != 0 && progress(done, total);
		}
	}
	if (output.ok) {
		writer.Finalize();
	}
	output.ok = output.ok && output.file.Flush();
	output.file.Close();
	if (!output.ok) {
		File::DeleteFile(archive);
	}
	return output.ok;
}

} // namespace Common

`src/common/assert.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common/assert.h"

#include "common/subsystems.h"
#include "kytyGitVersion.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

namespace Common {

static thread_local bool t_soft_exit = false;

SoftExitScope::SoftExitScope(): m_previous(t_soft_exit) {
	t_soft_exit = true;
}

SoftExitScope::~SoftExitScope() {
	t_soft_exit = m_previous;
}

// Throws instead of reporting while the thread has a SoftExitScope.
static void ThrowIfSoft([[maybe_unused]] const std::string& text) {
#if defined(__cpp_exceptions)
	if (t_soft_exit) {
		throw SoftExitError(text);
	}
#endif
}

void (*g_fatal_report_hook)() = nullptr;

[[noreturn]] static void DbgReport(const char* title, std::string_view text, const char* file,
                                   int line) {
	if (auto* hook = std::exchange(g_fatal_report_hook, nullptr)) {
		hook();
	}
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("--- Build ---\n{}\n{}\n{} in {}:{}\n", KYTY_BUILD_LABEL,
	                                      title, text, file, line));
	Subsystems::EmergencyShutdownActive();
	std::fflush(nullptr);
	std::_Exit(321);
}

void DbgExitIfHandler(const char* expr, const char* file, int line) {
	ThrowIfSoft(fmt::format("condition ({}) is true at {}:{}", expr, file, line));
	DbgReport("--- Fatal Error ---", fmt::format("Error: condition ({}) is true", expr), file,
	          line);
}

void DbgNotImplementedHandler(const char* expr, const char* file, int line) {
	ThrowIfSoft(fmt::format("not implemented ({}) at {}:{}", expr, file, line));
	DbgReport("--- Fatal Error ---", fmt::format("Not implemented ({})", expr), file, line);
}

void DbgExitHandler(const char* file, int line, std::string_view text) {
	ThrowIfSoft(fmt::format("{} at {}:{}", text, file, line));
	DbgReport("--- Error ---", text, file, line);
}

} // namespace Common

`src/common/assert.h`:

```h
#ifndef KYTY_COMMON_ASSERT_H_
#define KYTY_COMMON_ASSERT_H_

#include "common/common.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"

#include <stdexcept>
#include <string_view>

namespace Common {

// While a SoftExitScope is alive on a thread, the fatal errors that thread reaches (EXIT,
// EXIT_IF, EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED) throw a SoftExitError instead of ending the process, for the
// caller to catch: work that is not the guest's own, such as compiling a record that came from a
// file, can then drop what it cannot handle. Needs a build with exceptions; without them the
// scope changes nothing.
class SoftExitError: public std::runtime_error {
public:
	using std::runtime_error::runtime_error;
};

class SoftExitScope {
public:
	SoftExitScope();
	~SoftExitScope();
	SoftExitScope(const SoftExitScope&)            = delete;
	SoftExitScope& operator=(const SoftExitScope&) = delete;

private:
	bool m_previous;
};

// Called once before a fatal error is reported (GPU hang breadcrumbs).
extern void (*g_fatal_report_hook)();
[[noreturn]] void DbgExitHandler(char const* file, int line, std::string_view text);
[[noreturn]] void DbgExitIfHandler(char const* expr, char const* file, int line);
[[noreturn]] void DbgNotImplementedHandler(char const* expr, char const* file, int line);

} // namespace Common

#ifndef KYTY_FINAL
#define EXIT_IF(x) ((x) ? Common::DbgExitIfHandler(#x, __FILE__, __LINE__) : (void)0)
#else
#define EXIT_IF(x) ((void)(false && (x)))
#endif
#define EXIT(...) Common::DbgExitHandler(__FILE__, __LINE__, ::fmt::sprintf(__VA_ARGS__))
#define EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(x)                                                                    \
	((x) ? Common::DbgNotImplementedHandler(#x, __FILE__, __LINE__) : (void)0)

#endif /* KYTY_COMMON_ASSERT_H_ */

```

`src/common/bitArray.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_COMMON_BITARRAY_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_COMMON_BITARRAY_H_

#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iterator>
#include <utility>

namespace Common {

template <size_t N>
class BitArray final {
	static_assert(N != 0, "BitArray size must be nonzero");
	static_assert(N % 64 == 0, "BitArray size must be a multiple of 64 bits");

	static constexpr size_t BITS_PER_WORD = 64;
	static constexpr size_t WORD_COUNT    = N / BITS_PER_WORD;

public:
	using Range = std::pair<size_t, size_t>;

	class Iterator final {
	public:
		using iterator_category = std::forward_iterator_tag;
		using value_type        = Range;
		using difference_type   = std::ptrdiff_t;
		using pointer           = const Range*;
		using reference         = const Range&;

		Iterator(const BitArray& bits, size_t start)
		    : m_bits(bits), m_range(bits.FirstRangeFrom(start)) {}

		Iterator& operator++() {
			m_range = m_bits.FirstRangeFrom(m_range.second);
			return *this;
		}

		[[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const Iterator& other) const {
			return &m_bits == &other.m_bits && m_range == other.m_range;
		}

		[[nodiscard]] bool operator!=(const Iterator& other) const { return !(*this == other); }

		[[nodiscard]] reference operator*() const { return m_range; }
		[[nodiscard]] pointer   operator->() const { return &m_range; }

	private:
		const BitArray& m_bits;
		Range           m_range;
	};

	using const_iterator = Iterator;

	constexpr BitArray() = default;

	constexpr BitArray(const BitArray& other, size_t start, size_t end) {
		if (start >= end || end > N) {
			return;
		}

		const auto first_word = start / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto last_word  = (end - 1) / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_bit  = start % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto end_bit    = (end - 1) % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_mask = ~uint64_t {0} << start_bit;
		const auto end_mask =
		    end_bit == BITS_PER_WORD - 1 ? ~uint64_t {0} : (uint64_t {1} << (end_bit + 1)) - 1;

		if (first_word == last_word) {
			m_data[first_word] = other.m_data[first_word] & start_mask & end_mask;
			return;
		}

		m_data[first_word] = other.m_data[first_word] & start_mask;
		for (auto word = first_word + 1; word < last_word; word++) {
			m_data[word] = other.m_data[word];
		}
		m_data[last_word] = other.m_data[last_word] & end_mask;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool Get(size_t index) const {
		return (m_data[index / BITS_PER_WORD] & (uint64_t {1} << (index % BITS_PER_WORD))) != 0;
	}

	constexpr void Set(size_t index) {
		m_data[index / BITS_PER_WORD] |= uint64_t {1} << (index % BITS_PER_WORD);
	}

	constexpr void Unset(size_t index) {
		m_data[index / BITS_PER_WORD] &= ~(uint64_t {1} << (index % BITS_PER_WORD));
	}

	constexpr void SetRange(size_t start, size_t end) {
		if (start >= end || end > N) {
			return;
		}

		const auto first_word = start / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto last_word  = (end - 1) / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_bit  = start % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto end_bit    = (end - 1) % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_mask = ~uint64_t {0} << start_bit;
		const auto end_mask =
		    end_bit == BITS_PER_WORD - 1 ? ~uint64_t {0} : (uint64_t {1} << (end_bit + 1)) - 1;

		if (first_word == last_word) {
			m_data[first_word] |= start_mask & end_mask;
			return;
		}

		m_data[first_word] |= start_mask;
		for (auto word = first_word + 1; word < last_word; word++) {
			m_data[word] = ~uint64_t {0};
		}
		m_data[last_word] |= end_mask;
	}

	constexpr void UnsetRange(size_t start, size_t end) {
		if (start >= end || end > N) {
			return;
		}

		const auto first_word = start / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto last_word  = (end - 1) / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_bit  = start % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto end_bit    = (end - 1) % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_mask = (uint64_t {1} << start_bit) - 1;
		const auto end_mask =
		    end_bit == BITS_PER_WORD - 1 ? uint64_t {0} : ~((uint64_t {1} << (end_bit + 1)) - 1);

		if (first_word == last_word) {
			m_data[first_word] &= start_mask | end_mask;
			return;
		}

		m_data[first_word] &= start_mask;
		for (auto word = first_word + 1; word < last_word; word++) {
			m_data[word] = 0;
		}
		m_data[last_word] &= end_mask;
	}

	constexpr void Clear() { m_data.fill(0); }
	constexpr void Fill() { m_data.fill(~uint64_t {0}); }

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool None() const {
		uint64_t combined = 0;
		for (const auto word: m_data) {
			combined |= word;
		}
		return combined == 0;
	}

	// Whether a bit in [start, end) is set, without building a masked copy.
	[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool AnyInRange(size_t start, size_t end) const {
		if (start >= end || end > N) {
			return false;
		}
		const auto first_word = start / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto last_word  = (end - 1) / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto start_mask = ~uint64_t {0} << (start % BITS_PER_WORD);
		const auto end_bit    = (end - 1) % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto end_mask =
		    end_bit == BITS_PER_WORD - 1 ? ~uint64_t {0} : (uint64_t {1} << (end_bit + 1)) - 1;
		if (first_word == last_word) {
			return (m_data[first_word] & start_mask & end_mask) != 0;
		}
		if ((m_data[first_word] & start_mask) != 0 || (m_data[last_word] & end_mask) != 0) {
			return true;
		}
		for (auto word = first_word + 1; word < last_word; word++) {
			if (m_data[word] != 0) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr Range FirstRangeFrom(size_t start) const {
		if (start >= N) {
			return {N, N};
		}

		auto word_index = start / BITS_PER_WORD;
		auto word       = m_data[word_index] & (~uint64_t {0} << (start % BITS_PER_WORD));
		while (word == 0) {
			word_index++;
			if (word_index == WORD_COUNT) {
				return {N, N};
			}
			word = m_data[word_index];
		}

		const auto first     = word_index * BITS_PER_WORD + std::countr_zero(word);
		const auto first_bit = first % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto first_ones =
		    static_cast<size_t>(std::countr_one(m_data[word_index] >> first_bit));
		if (first_bit + first_ones < BITS_PER_WORD) {
			return {first, first + first_ones};
		}

		for (word_index++; word_index < WORD_COUNT; word_index++) {
			word = m_data[word_index];
			if (word != ~uint64_t {0}) {
				return {first, word_index * BITS_PER_WORD + std::countr_one(word)};
			}
		}
		return {first, N};
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr Range FirstRange() const { return FirstRangeFrom(0); }

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr Range LastRangeFrom(size_t end) const {
		if (end == 0) {
			return {0, 0};
		}
		if (end > N) {
			end = N;
		}

		auto       word_index = (end - 1) / BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto end_bit    = (end - 1) % BITS_PER_WORD;
		const auto end_mask =
		    end_bit == BITS_PER_WORD - 1 ? ~uint64_t {0} : (uint64_t {1} << (end_bit + 1)) - 1;
		auto word = m_data[word_index] & end_mask;
		while (word == 0) {
			if (word_index == 0) {
				return {0, 0};
			}
			word = m_data[--word_index];
		}

		const auto empty_bits = static_cast<size_t>(std::countl_zero(word));
		const auto ones       = static_cast<size_t>(std::countl_one(word << empty_bits));
		const auto last       = (word_index + 1) * BITS_PER_WORD - empty_bits;
		if (empty_bits + ones < BITS_PER_WORD) {
			return {last - ones, last};
		}

		while (word_index != 0) {
			word = m_data[--word_index];
			if (word != ~uint64_t {0}) {
				return {(word_index + 1) * BITS_PER_WORD - std::countl_one(word), last};
			}
		}
		return {0, last};
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr Range LastRange() const { return LastRangeFrom(N); }

	[[nodiscard]] const_iterator begin() const { return Iterator(*this, 0); }
	[[nodiscard]] const_iterator end() const { return Iterator(*this, N); }

	constexpr BitArray& operator^=(const BitArray& other) {
		for (size_t word = 0; word < WORD_COUNT; word++) {
			m_data[word] ^= other.m_data[word];
		}
		return *this;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr BitArray operator^(const BitArray& other) const {
		auto result = *this;
		result ^= other;
		return result;
	}

	constexpr BitArray& operator|=(const BitArray& other) {
		for (size_t word = 0; word < WORD_COUNT; word++) {
			m_data[word] |= other.m_data[word];
		}
		return *this;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr BitArray operator~() const {
		auto result = *this;
		for (auto& word: result.m_data) {
			word = ~word;
		}
		return result;
	}

private:
	std::array<uint64_t, WORD_COUNT> m_data {};
};

} // namespace Common

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_COMMON_BITARRAY_H_

`src/common/debugCounters.h`:

```h
#ifndef KYTY_COMMON_DEBUG_COUNTERS_H_
#define KYTY_COMMON_DEBUG_COUNTERS_H_

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <x86intrin.h>

namespace Common::DebugCounters {

static_assert(std::atomic<uint64_t>::is_always_lock_free && std::atomic<bool>::is_always_lock_free);

// Collect events only while the panel is visible. Relaxed, lock-free atomics keep updates
// cheap and safe in signal handlers. Rates come from comparing two snapshots.
enum class Counter {
	// GPU work.
	Draws,
	DrawInstances,
	IndirectDraws,
	Dispatches,
	QueueSubmits,
	GpuWaits, // CPU blocked on a GPU timeline semaphore.
	GpuWaitNs,
	GpuFaults, // Guest writes to GPU-tracked memory.
	ShadersCompiled,
	ShaderCompileNs,
	PipelinesCreated,
	PipelineCreateNs,
	// Caches.
	TextureUploadBytes,
	TextureDownloadBytes,
	TextureEvictions,
	ColorMetadataReadbacks, // CPU blocked reading back GPU-written DCC/CMASK metadata.
	ColorMetadataReadbackNs,
	ColorMetadataChecks, // GPU clear-key checks of DCC/CMASK metadata.
	BufferUploadBytes,
	BufferDownloadBytes,
	BufferEvictions,
	// Presentation.
	FlipsRequested,
	FlipsRejected, // Guest flip queue was full.
	LateVblanks,   // The present thread fell behind the vblank rate.
	SwapchainRecreations,
	DroppedPresents,
	// Emulator.
	EmulatedInstructions, // Host CPU lacked an instruction the guest used.
	UnresolvedImportCalls,
	GuestFileReadBytes,
	GuestFileWriteBytes,
	AudioUnderruns,
	// Overlapping host elapsed timings, including waits.
	GpuThreadBusyNs,
	PresentNs, // Includes image acquire and overlay preparation.
	PresentAcquireNs,
	OverlayNs,
	// KYTY_STAGE_TIMES=1: TSC ticks each GPU stage spends working (not waiting for its input) and
	// blocked pushing to the next stage; the [kyty-frames] line converts them to ms.
	StageCpPushTicks,
	StageResolveTicks,
	StageResolvePushTicks,
	StageResolveVsTicks, // Parts of StageResolveTicks: preparing the vertex and the pixel program.
	StageResolvePsTicks,
	StageExecuteTicks,
	StageExecuteFlipWaitTicks, // Part of StageExecuteTicks: the guest's wait for a pending flip of a buffer.
	StageRecordTicks,
	StageDrawPipelineSwitches, // Draws that bind another graphics pipeline than the draw before.
	StageDrawTargetsReused,    // Draws that kept the render targets of the draw before.
	Count
};

enum class Peak { ShaderCompileNs, PipelineCreateNs, Count };

namespace Detail {
inline std::atomic<bool>     g_enabled {false};
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> g_counters[static_cast<int>(Counter::Count)] {};
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> g_peaks[static_cast<int>(Peak::Count)] {};
} // namespace Detail

[[nodiscard]] inline bool Enabled() noexcept {
	return Detail::g_enabled.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

inline void SetEnabled(bool enabled) noexcept {
	Detail::g_enabled.store(enabled, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

inline void Add(Counter counter, uint64_t value = 1) noexcept {
	if (!Enabled()) {
		return;
	}
	Detail::g_counters[static_cast<int>(counter)].fetch_add(value, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

class ScopedTimer final {
public:
	explicit ScopedTimer(Counter duration): ScopedTimer(Counter::Count, duration) {}
	ScopedTimer(Counter count, Counter duration, Peak peak = Peak::Count)
	    : m_count(count), m_duration(duration), m_peak(peak),
	      m_start(Enabled() ? std::chrono::steady_clock::now()
	                        : std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point {}) {}
	~ScopedTimer() {
		if (m_start == std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point {} || !Enabled()) {
			return;
		}
		const auto elapsed =
		    static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
		                              std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - m_start)
		                              .count());
		if (m_count != Counter::Count) {
			Add(m_count);
		}
		Add(m_duration, elapsed);
		if (m_peak != Peak::Count) {
			auto& peak     = Detail::g_peaks[static_cast<int>(m_peak)];
			auto  previous = peak.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
			while (previous < elapsed &&
			       !peak.compare_exchange_weak(previous, elapsed, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
			}
		}
	}
	ScopedTimer(const ScopedTimer&)            = delete;
	ScopedTimer& operator=(const ScopedTimer&) = delete;

private:
	Counter                               m_count;
	Counter                               m_duration;
	Peak                                  m_peak;
	std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point m_start;
};

[[nodiscard]] inline bool StageTimesEnabled() noexcept {
	static const bool enabled = [] {
		const char* value = std::getenv("KYTY_STAGE_TIMES");
		return value != nullptr && value[0] == '1';
	}();
	return enabled;
}

// Cheaper than ScopedTimer (a TSC read each side): one runs per draw on each GPU stage.
class StageTimer final {
public:
	explicit StageTimer(Counter ticks)
	    : m_ticks(ticks), m_start(StageTimesEnabled() && Enabled() ? __rdtsc() : 0) {}
	~StageTimer() {
		if (m_start != 0) {
			Add(m_ticks, __rdtsc() - m_start);
		}
	}
	StageTimer(const StageTimer&)            = delete;
	StageTimer& operator=(const StageTimer&) = delete;

private:
	Counter  m_ticks;
	uint64_t m_start;
};

[[nodiscard]] inline uint64_t Get(Counter counter) noexcept {
	return Detail::g_counters[static_cast<int>(counter)].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

[[nodiscard]] inline uint64_t Get(Peak peak) noexcept {
	return Detail::g_peaks[static_cast<int>(peak)].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

} // namespace Common::DebugCounters

#endif /* KYTY_COMMON_DEBUG_COUNTERS_H_ */

```

#include "common/emulatorConfig.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/debugCounters.h"
#include "common/threads.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string_view>

namespace Config {

static std::unique_ptr<ConfigOptions> g_config;

void Initialize() {
	EXIT_IF(g_config != nullptr);

	g_config = std::make_unique<ConfigOptions>();
}

void Shutdown() {
	Common::DebugCounters::SetEnabled(false);
	g_config.reset();
}

void Load(const ConfigOptions& cfg) {
	EXIT_IF(g_config == nullptr);
	EXIT_IF(cfg.user_name.empty() || cfg.user_name.size() > MAX_USER_NAME_LENGTH);
	EXIT_IF(!IsConfiguredUserIdValid(cfg.user_id));
	EXIT_IF(cfg.controller_speaker_volume > 100 || cfg.controller_vibration_intensity > 100);
	EXIT_IF(cfg.keyboard_player > static_cast<uint32_t>(MAX_PLAYERS));

	*g_config = cfg;
	Common::DebugCounters::SetEnabled(cfg.perf_overlay_enabled);
}

uint32_t GetScreenWidth() {
	return g_config->screen_width;
}

uint32_t GetScreenHeight() {
	return g_config->screen_height;
}

	return g_config->user_name;
}

	return g_config->user_id;
}

	return g_config->audio_input_device;

	return g_config->controller_vibration_intensity;

	return g_config->user_id + player * PLAYER_USER_ID_STEP;
}

int GetPlayerFromUserId(int32_t user_id) {
	for (int player = 0; player < MAX_PLAYERS; player++) {
		if (user_id == GetPlayerUserId(player)) {
			return player;
		}
	}
	return -1;
}

bool IsGuestUserId(int32_t user_id) {
	return GetPlayerFromUserId(user_id) > 0;
}

uint32_t ParseGpuPipelineStages(const char* value) {
	char*      end    = nullptr;
	const auto parsed = std::strtoul(value, &end, 0);
	if (end == value || *end != '\0') {
		EXIT("invalid GPU pipeline stages: %s\n", value);
	}
	return parsed == 1 ? GPU_PIPELINE_ALL : static_cast<uint32_t>(parsed) & GPU_PIPELINE_ALL;
}

void ConfigureGpuStageThread(GpuStageThread stage) {
	// Five physical cores of the first CCD of a Ryzen 9 5900X (SMT siblings are adjacent), away
	// from core 0: the stages share its L3.
	static const std::array<int, 5> cpus = [] {
		std::array<int, 5> result {4, 6, 8, 10, 2};
		const char*        value = std::getenv("KYTY_GPU_THREAD_CPUS");
		if (value == nullptr) {
			return result;
		}
		if (std::string_view(value) == "off") {
			return std::array<int, 5> {-1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
		}
		// Stages without a listed CPU keep their default.
		for (auto& cpu: result) {
			if (*value == '\0') {
				break;
			}
			char* end = nullptr;
			cpu       = static_cast<int>(std::strtol(value, &end, 10));
			if (end == value) {
				EXIT("invalid KYTY_GPU_THREAD_CPUS: %s\n", std::getenv("KYTY_GPU_THREAD_CPUS"));
			}
			value = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : end;
		}
		return result;
	}();
	static const bool high_priority = [] {
		const char* value = std::getenv("KYTY_GPU_THREAD_PRIORITY");
		return value == nullptr || std::string_view(value) != "0";
	}();
	if (high_priority) {
		Common::Thread::RaiseCurrentPriority();
	}
	// Guest threads that spin while they wait for work (Demon's Souls keeps ~12 job workers at
	// ~95% of a core each) otherwise run on the SMT siblings of the pinned stages and slow them
	// down: give the stages whole physical cores.
	static std::once_flag reserved;
	std::call_once(reserved, [] { Common::Thread::ReserveCores(cpus); });
	Common::Thread::PinCurrent(cpus[static_cast<uint32_t>(stage)]);
}

uint32_t GpuPipelineStages() {
	if (const char* value = std::getenv("KYTY_GPU_PIPELINE"); value != nullptr) {
		return ParseGpuPipelineStages(value);
	}
	// Tools and tests that do not load a configuration run the GPU inline.
	return g_config != nullptr ? g_config->gpu_pipeline_stages : 0;
}

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
bool RedZoneProtectionEnabled() {
	return g_config->red_zone_protection_enabled;
}
#endif

const Keymap& GetKeymap() {
	return g_config->keymap;
}

const std::vector<std::string>& GetGuestArguments() {
	return g_config->guest_arguments;
}

// Stages of the emulated GPU that run on threads of their own; see GpuPipelineStages().
enum GpuPipelineStage : uint32_t {
	GPU_PIPELINE_RECORDING = 1u << 0u, // Vulkan command recording and submission.
	// The command processor runs ahead of the execution of the operations it produces.
	GPU_PIPELINE_COMMAND_PROCESSOR = 1u << 1u,
	// Shader programs and resource tables of draws are resolved ahead of their execution
	// (requires the command processor stage).
	GPU_PIPELINE_RESOLVE = 1u << 2u,
	GPU_PIPELINE_ALL =
	    GPU_PIPELINE_RECORDING | GPU_PIPELINE_COMMAND_PROCESSOR | GPU_PIPELINE_RESOLVE,
};

#include "common/file.h"

#include "common/archive.h"
#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/common.h"
#include "common/platform/sysFileIO.h"
#include "common/platform/sysTimer.h"
#include "common/stringUtils.h"

#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

// IWYU pragma: no_include <fileapi.h>
// IWYU pragma: no_include <windows.h>

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
#ifdef CreateDirectory
#undef CreateDirectory
#endif
#ifdef DeleteFile
#undef DeleteFile
#endif
#endif

namespace Common {

struct File::FilePrivate {
	sys_file_t*                  f;
	std::unique_ptr<ArchiveFile> archive;
};

File::File(): m_p(std::make_unique<FilePrivate>()) {
	m_p->f = nullptr;
}

File::~File() {
	Close();
}

File::File(const std::filesystem::path& name): m_p(std::make_unique<FilePrivate>()) {
	m_p->f = nullptr;

	Create(name);
}

File::File(const std::filesystem::path& name, Mode mode): m_p(std::make_unique<FilePrivate>()) {
	m_p->f = nullptr;

	Open(name, mode);
}

bool File::IsInvalid() const {
	return m_p->f == nullptr && m_p->archive == nullptr;
}

bool File::Create(const std::filesystem::path& name) {
	EXIT_IF(!IsInvalid());

	if (IsArchivePath(name)) {
		return false;
	}

	m_file_name = name;

	m_p->f = SysFileCreate(name);
	return m_p->f != nullptr;
}

bool File::Open(const std::filesystem::path& name, Mode mode) {
	EXIT_IF(!IsInvalid());

	m_file_name = name;
	if (IsArchivePath(name)) {
		if (mode != Mode::Read) {
			return false;
		}
		m_p->archive = OpenArchiveFile(name);
		return m_p->archive != nullptr;
	}

	switch (mode) {
		case Mode::Read: m_p->f = SysFileOpenR(name); break;
		case Mode::Write: m_p->f = SysFileOpenW(name); break;
		case Mode::ReadWrite: m_p->f = SysFileOpenRw(name); break;
	}
	return m_p->f != nullptr;
}

void File::Close() {
	m_p->archive.reset();
	if (m_p->f != nullptr) {
		SysFileClose(m_p->f);
		m_p->f = nullptr;
	}
}

uint64_t File::Size() const {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return m_p->archive->Size();
	}

	if (m_p->f == nullptr) {
		return 0;
	}

	return SysFileSize(*m_p->f);
}

uint64_t File::Remaining() const {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	const auto size     = Size();
	const auto position = Tell();
	return position < size ? size - position : 0;
}

uint64_t File::Size(const std::filesystem::path& name) {
	const auto info = GetInfo(name);
	return info ? info->size : 0;
}

std::optional<File::Info> File::GetInfo(const std::filesystem::path& name) {
	if (IsArchivePath(name)) {
		return GetArchiveInfo(name);
	}
	Info info {};
	return SysFileGetInfo(name, &info.is_file, &info.size) ? std::optional(info) : std::nullopt;
}

static std::optional<File::Times> QueryTimes(auto& target) {
	SysFileTimeStruct access {};
	SysFileTimeStruct write {};
	SysFileGetLastAccessAndWriteTimeUtc(target, access, write);
	if (access.is_invalid || write.is_invalid) {
		return std::nullopt;
	}
	return File::Times {SysFileTimeToNs(access), SysFileTimeToNs(write)};
}

std::optional<File::Times> File::GetTimes(const std::filesystem::path& name) {
	if (IsArchivePath(name)) {
		return GetTimes(GetArchiveHostPath(name));
	}
	return QueryTimes(name);
}

std::optional<File::Times> File::GetTimes() const {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return GetTimes(m_file_name);
	}
	return QueryTimes(*m_p->f);
}

bool File::Seek(uint64_t offset) {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return m_p->archive->Seek(offset);
	}

	return SysFileSeek(*m_p->f, offset);
}

bool File::Truncate(uint64_t size) {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return false;
	}

	return SysFileTruncate(*m_p->f, size);
}

bool File::Unlink() {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return false;
	}

	return SysFileUnlink(*m_p->f, m_file_name);
}

uint64_t File::Tell() const {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return m_p->archive->Tell();
	}

	return SysFileTell(*m_p->f);
}

void File::Read(void* data, uint32_t size, uint32_t* bytes_read) {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		m_p->archive->Read(data, size, bytes_read);
		return;
	}

	if (m_p->f != nullptr) {
		SysFileRead(data, size, *m_p->f, bytes_read);
	}
}

void File::Write(const void* data, uint32_t size, uint32_t* bytes_written) {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		if (bytes_written != nullptr) {
			*bytes_written = 0;
		}
		return;
	}

	SysFileWrite(data, size, *m_p->f, bytes_written);
}

static std::string FileVformat(const char* format, va_list args) {
	va_list copy {};
	va_copy(copy, args);
	const int size = std::vsnprintf(nullptr, 0, format, copy);
	va_end(copy);

	if (size <= 0) {
		return {};
	}

	std::vector<char> buffer(static_cast<size_t>(size) + 1u);
	va_list           copy2 {};
	va_copy(copy2, args);
	std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format, copy2);
	va_end(copy2);

	return {buffer.data(), static_cast<size_t>(size)};
}

void File::Printf(const char* format, ...) {
	va_list args {};
	va_start(args, format);

	auto s = FileVformat(format, args);

	va_end(args);

	s = Common::ReplaceStr(s, "\n", "\r\n");
	Write(s.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(s.size()));
}

static std::filesystem::path WithoutTrailingSeparator(
	const std::filesystem::path& path) {
		if (!path.empty() && !path.has_filename() &&
			path != path.root_path()) {
			return path.parent_path();
		}

		return path;
}


bool File::IsDirectoryExisting(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	const auto info = GetInfo(path);
	return info && !info->is_file;
}

bool File::IsFileExisting(const std::filesystem::path& name) {
	const auto info = GetInfo(name);
	return info && info->is_file;
}

bool File::CreateDirectory(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	if (IsArchivePath(path)) {
		return false;
	}
    return SysFileCreateDirectory(
        WithoutTrailingSeparator(path));
}

bool File::DeleteDirectory(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	if (IsArchivePath(path)) {
		return false;
	}
    return SysFileDeleteDirectory(
        WithoutTrailingSeparator(path));
}

bool File::CreateDirectories(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	if (IsArchivePath(path)) {
		return false;
	}
    const auto normalized_path =
        WithoutTrailingSeparator(path);

    auto current_path = normalized_path.root_path();

    for (const auto& component:
         normalized_path.relative_path()) {
        current_path /= component;

        if (IsDirectoryExisting(current_path)) {
            continue;
        }

        if (!CreateDirectory(current_path)) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

bool File::DeleteFile(
    const std::filesystem::path& name) // @suppress("Member declaration not found")
{
	if (IsArchivePath(name)) {
		return false;
	}
	return SysFileDeleteFile(name);
}

bool File::Flush() {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());

	if (m_p->archive != nullptr) {
		return true;
	}

	return SysFileFlush(*m_p->f);
}

std::vector<std::byte> File::ReadWholeBuffer() {
	EXIT_IF(IsInvalid());
	EXIT_IF(Tell() != 0);

	uint64_t s = Size();

	EXIT_IF((s >> 32u) != 0);

	const auto            read_size = static_cast<uint32_t>(s);
	std::vector<std::byte> buf(read_size);

	Read(buf.data(), read_size);

	return buf;
}

std::vector<File::DirEntry> File::GetDirEntries(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	if (IsArchivePath(path)) {
		return GetArchiveDirEntries(path);
	}
	std::vector<sys_dir_entry_t> files;

	SysFileGetDents(path, files);

	std::vector<File::DirEntry> ret;
	ret.reserve(files.size());

	for (auto& f: files) {
		ret.emplace_back(std::move(f.name), f.is_file);
	}

	return ret;
}

bool File::RenameFile(const std::filesystem::path& src,
                      const std::filesystem::path& dst) // @suppress("Member declaration not found")
{
	if (IsArchivePath(src) || IsArchivePath(dst)) {
		return false;
	}
	if (IsFileExisting(dst)) {
		DeleteFile(dst); // @suppress("Invalid arguments")
	}

	return SysFileRenameFile(src, dst);
}

} // namespace Common

```h
#ifndef KYTY_COMMON_FILE_H_
#define KYTY_COMMON_FILE_H_

#include "common/common.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
#ifdef CreateDirectory
#undef CreateDirectory
#endif
#ifdef DeleteFile
#undef DeleteFile
#endif
#endif

namespace Common {

// SUBSYSTEM_DEFINE(File);

class File {
public:
	enum class Mode { Read, Write, ReadWrite };

	struct DirEntry {
		std::string name;
		bool        is_file;
	};
	struct Info {
		bool     is_file;
		uint64_t size;
	};
	// Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.
	struct Times {
		int64_t access_ns;
		int64_t write_ns;
	};

`src/common/hackNotice.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common/hackNotice.h"

// The unit tests that compile the walkers do not link the logging library: they print to stdout.
#ifdef KYTY_HACK_NOTICE_STDOUT
#include <cstdio>
#define HACK_LOG(...) std::printf(__VA_ARGS__)
#else
#include "common/logging/log.h"
// WriteToConsoleAndLog reaches stdout and emulator.log whatever the log direction (LOGF is silent
// unless the printf log is enabled).
#define HACK_LOG(...) ::Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(::fmt::sprintf(__VA_ARGS__))
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

namespace Common::HackNotice {
namespace {

constexpr size_t   TABLE_SIZE    = 512;
constexpr size_t   PROBE_LIMIT   = 24;
constexpr int64_t  SUMMARY_NS    = 10'000'000'000;
constexpr size_t   SUMMARY_LINES = 6;

struct Entry {
	std::atomic<uint64_t> key {0};
	std::atomic<bool>     ready {false};
	std::atomic<uint64_t> count {0};
	std::atomic<uint64_t> reported {0};
	// Written once by the thread that claimed the entry, before `ready`.
	const char*           hack        = nullptr;
	const char*           site        = nullptr;
	uint64_t              shader_hash = 0;
	uint64_t              where       = 0;
};

std::array<Entry, TABLE_SIZE> g_table;
std::atomic<uint64_t>         g_overflow {0};
std::atomic<int64_t>          g_next_summary_ns {0};
std::atomic<uint64_t>         g_calls {0};

uint64_t Mix(uint64_t x) {
	x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
	x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
	x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
	return x ^ (x >> 31);
}

int64_t NowNs() {
	return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
	           std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
	    .count();
}

std::string Shader(uint64_t shader_hash) {
	char text[32];
	if (shader_hash == 0) return "unknown";
	std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "0x%016llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(shader_hash));
	return text;
}

void Summarize() {
	struct Line {
		const Entry* entry;
		uint64_t     delta;
		uint64_t     total;
	};
	std::array<Line, TABLE_SIZE> lines {};
	size_t                       line_count = 0;
	uint64_t                     period     = 0;
	for (auto& entry: g_table) {
		if (!entry.ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) continue;
		const auto total = entry.count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
		const auto delta = total - entry.reported.exchange(total, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		if (delta == 0) continue;
		period += delta;
		lines[line_count++] = {&entry, delta, total};
	}
	const auto overflow = g_overflow.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
	period += overflow;
	if (period == 0) return;
	const auto shown = std::min(line_count, SUMMARY_LINES);
	std::partial_sort(lines.begin(), lines.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(shown),
	                  lines.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(line_count),
	                  [](const Line& a, const Line& b) { return a.delta > b.delta; });
	HACK_LOG("[HACK] summary of the last 10 s: %llu applications in %zu sources\n",
	     static_cast<unsigned long long>(period), line_count + (overflow != 0 ? 1u : 0u));
	for (size_t i = 0; i < shown; ++i) {
		const auto& line = lines[i];
		HACK_LOG("[HACK]   %s at %s shader=%s where=0x%llx: +%llu (total %llu)\n", line.entry->hack,
		     line.entry->site, Shader(line.entry->shader_hash).c_str(),
		     static_cast<unsigned long long>(line.entry->where),
		     static_cast<unsigned long long>(line.delta),
		     static_cast<unsigned long long>(line.total));
	}
	if (line_count > shown) {
		HACK_LOG("[HACK]   (+%zu more sources)\n", line_count - shown);
	}
}

} // namespace

void Report(const char* hack, const char* site, uint64_t shader_hash, uint64_t where,
            std::string_view detail) {
	if (shader_hash == 0) shader_hash = CurrentShaderSlot();
	auto key = Mix(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(hack));
	key      = Mix(key ^ reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(site));
	key      = Mix(key ^ shader_hash);
	key      = Mix(key ^ where);
	if (key == 0) key = 1;

	Entry* found = nullptr;
	bool   first = false;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < PROBE_LIMIT; ++i) {
		auto&    entry    = g_table[(key + i) % TABLE_SIZE];
		uint64_t expected = entry.key.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
		if (expected == 0 && entry.key.compare_exchange_strong(expected, key,
		                                                       std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
			entry.hack        = hack;
			entry.site        = site;
			entry.shader_hash = shader_hash;
			entry.where       = where;
			entry.ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
			found = &entry;
			first = true;
			break;
		}
		if (expected == key) {
			found = &entry;
			break;
		}
	}
	if (found == nullptr) {
		g_overflow.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
	} else {
		found->count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		if (first) {
			// The line below counts as reported; later applications go to the summaries.
			found->reported.store(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
			const std::string suffix = detail.empty() ? std::string() : ", " + std::string(detail);
			HACK_LOG("[HACK] %s: first at %s, shader=%s, where=0x%llx%s\n", hack, site,
			     Shader(shader_hash).c_str(), static_cast<unsigned long long>(where),
			     suffix.c_str());
		}
	}

	// The first report arms the summary timer; any thread that sees it expire prints the summary.
	// Reading the clock on every report would be the main cost of a busy key, so after the first
	// few reports it is read once in 16.
	const auto calls = g_calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
	if (calls >= 64 && (calls & 15u) != 0) return;
	const auto now      = NowNs();
	auto       deadline = g_next_summary_ns.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
	if (deadline == 0) {
		g_next_summary_ns.compare_exchange_strong(deadline, now + SUMMARY_NS,
		                                          std::memory_order_relaxed);
	} else if (now >= deadline &&
	           g_next_summary_ns.compare_exchange_strong(deadline, now + SUMMARY_NS,
	                                                     std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
		Summarize();
	}
}

} // namespace Common::HackNotice

`src/common/hackNotice.h`:

```h
#ifndef KYTY_COMMON_HACK_NOTICE_H_
#define KYTY_COMMON_HACK_NOTICE_H_

#include <cstdint>
#include <string_view>

// Visible notices for the workarounds ("hacks") that change what a game computes. They go to the
// normal log (stdout / emulator.log) with the fixed prefix "[HACK]", without any environment
// variable, so a session shows whether a hack was applied. Report() is safe for hot paths: it takes
// no locks, only atomics. The first report of each distinct (hack, site, shader, where) key prints a
// line; afterwards the keys that kept firing are summarised every 10 seconds with their totals.
namespace Common::HackNotice {

// `hack` and `site` must be string literals (they are compared by address). `shader_hash` 0 means
// "the shader of the enclosing ScopedShader, if any". `where` is part of the key (an address, an
// offset or a limit). `detail` is only used for the first line of a key.
void Report(const char* hack, const char* site, uint64_t shader_hash, uint64_t where,
            std::string_view detail = {});

inline uint64_t& CurrentShaderSlot() {
	static thread_local uint64_t shader_hash = 0;
	return shader_hash;
}

// Names the shader whose resources the calling thread is reading, for the notices of readers that
// do not know it (memory callbacks).
class ScopedShader {
public:
	explicit ScopedShader(uint64_t shader_hash): m_previous(CurrentShaderSlot()) {
		CurrentShaderSlot() = shader_hash;
	}
	~ScopedShader() { CurrentShaderSlot() = m_previous; }
	ScopedShader(const ScopedShader&)            = delete;
	ScopedShader& operator=(const ScopedShader&) = delete;

private:
	uint64_t m_previous;
};

} // namespace Common::HackNotice

#endif /* KYTY_COMMON_HACK_NOTICE_H_ */
