		    handler(*this, packet_header & ~1u, packet + 1, remaining_dw, total_dw) + 1;
		EXIT_IF(packet_dw > remaining_dw);
		if (execution.m_suspended) {
			return;
		}
		cursor.offset_dw += packet_dw;
		execution.m_made_progress = true;
		if (!execution.m_next_buffer.empty()) {
			// Chains and taken branches reuse the fetcher; only calls retain a return cursor.
			if (execution.m_chain) {
				cursor = {execution.m_next_buffer};
			} else {
				execution.m_buffer_stack.push_back({execution.m_next_buffer});
			}
			execution.m_next_buffer = {};
		}
		if (execution.m_yield) {
			return;
		}
	}
}

void CommandProcessor::SetIndexType(uint32_t index_type_and_size) {
	m_index_type_and_size = index_type_and_size & 0x3u;
}

void CommandProcessor::SetIndexBaseAddress(uint64_t index_base_addr) {
	m_index_base_addr = index_base_addr;
}

void CommandProcessor::SetIndexBufferSize(uint32_t index_buffer_size) {
	m_index_buffer_size = index_buffer_size;
}

void CommandProcessor::SetDrawIndirectArgsBaseAddress(uint64_t draw_indirect_args_base_addr) {
	m_draw_indirect_args_base_addr = draw_indirect_args_base_addr;
}

void CommandProcessor::SetDispatchIndirectArgsBaseAddress(
    uint64_t dispatch_indirect_args_base_addr) {
	m_dispatch_indirect_args_base_addr = dispatch_indirect_args_base_addr;
}

void CommandProcessor::SetNumInstances(uint32_t num_instances) {
	if (num_instances == 0) {
		num_instances = 1;
	}

	m_num_instances.value = num_instances;
	m_num_instances.sequence++;
}

uint32_t CommandProcessor::ResolveNumInstances(const GpuOperation& operation) {
	// An indirect draw executed after the last NUM_INSTANCES packet of the operation's stream
	// position set the persistent count.
	if (m_has_indirect_instances &&
	    m_indirect_instances_sequence == operation.num_instances.sequence) {
		const auto& gpu = m_gpu_indirect_instances;
		if (gpu.address != 0) {
			// The GPU read the records: read the last draw's instance count when a later draw
			// inherits it (the second dword of both record layouts), waiting for the GPU work that
			// wrote it.
			uint32_t count = gpu.count;
			if (gpu.count_address != 0) {
				const uint32_t written =
				    *reinterpret_cast<const volatile uint32_t*>(gpu.count_address);
				count = std::min(written, count);
			}
			m_indirect_instances =
			    count != 0 ? *reinterpret_cast<const volatile uint32_t*>(
			                     gpu.address + uint64_t {count - 1} * gpu.stride +
			                     offsetof(vk::DrawIndirectCommand, instanceCount))
			               : m_indirect_instances;
			m_gpu_indirect_instances = {};
		}
		return m_indirect_instances;
	}
	return operation.num_instances.value;
}

void CommandProcessor::SetPredication(uint32_t condition, uint32_t op, uint32_t wait_op,
                                      const volatile void* address) {
	uint64_t value = 0;

	switch (op) {
		case 0x00:
			m_predicate_skip = false;
			return;
		case 0x01: {
			EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(address == nullptr);
			// One begin/end pair per DB; bit 63 marks each counter ready.
			constexpr uint64_t      ready_bit = 1ull << 63u;
			std::array<uint64_t, 32> results {};
			ReadDecisionMemory(address, results.data(), sizeof(results));
			for (uint32_t db = 0; db < 16u; db++) {
				const auto begin = results[db * 2u];
				const auto end   = results[db * 2u + 1u];
				if ((begin & end & ready_bit) == 0) {
					if (wait_op == 0) {
						// Host query results reach guest memory from the execution thread once
						// the GPU finished them: make sure it does and they are published.
						if (!m_occlusion_wait_requested) {
							m_occlusion_wait_requested = true;
							EmitCallback([this] {
								auto& queries = m_renderer.GetOcclusionQueries();
								if (queries.HasPendingDumps()) {
									GetScheduler().Finish();
									queries.PublishCompleted(true);
								}
							});
						}
						SuspendPm4();
					} else {
						m_predicate_skip = false;
					}
					return;
				}
				value += end - begin;
			}
			m_occlusion_wait_requested = false;
		} break;
		case 0x03:
			// The wait selector applies only to Z-pass query readiness.
			EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(address == nullptr);
			value = ReadDecisionValue<uint64_t>(address);
			break;
		default: EXIT("unknown predication op: 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", op);
	}
	switch (condition) {
		case 0x00: m_predicate_skip = (value != 0); break;
		case 0x01: m_predicate_skip = (value == 0); break;
		default: EXIT("unknown predication condition: 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", condition);
	}
}

void CommandProcessor::DrawIndex(DrawIndexArgs args) {
	args.index_type_and_size = m_index_type_and_size;
	auto operation       = MakeOperation(GpuOperationKind::DrawIndex);
	operation.draw_index = args;
	Emit(std::move(operation));
}

void CommandProcessor::ExecuteDrawIndex(const GpuOperation& operation, DrawIndexArgs args) {
	NoteRecordedWork();
	if (args.instance_count == 0) {
		args.instance_count = ResolveNumInstances(operation);
	}
	m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().DrawIndex(CurrentBuffer(), args);
}

const void* CommandProcessor::IndexAddress(uint64_t base, uint32_t type_and_size,
                                           uint32_t first_index) {
	uint64_t index_size = 0;
	switch (type_and_size) {
		case 0: index_size = 2; break;
		case 1: index_size = 4; break;
		case 2: index_size = 1; break;
		default: EXIT("unknown index_type_and_size: %u\n", type_and_size);
	}
	return reinterpret_cast<const void*>(base + first_index * index_size);
}

const void* CommandProcessor::IndexAddress(uint32_t first_index) const {
	return IndexAddress(m_index_base_addr, m_index_type_and_size, first_index);
}

void CommandProcessor::DrawIndexOffset(uint32_t index_offset, uint32_t index_count) {
	DrawIndex({.index_count = index_count, .index_addr = IndexAddress(index_offset)});
}

// Writes the GS user-data slots the packet patches; false when the shaders cannot read the
// offsets from GPU records: a first-index or subdraw-index destination, or another stage's
// user data.
static bool IndirectDrawOffsets(IndirectDrawRegisters registers, ShaderIndirectOffsets& offsets) {
	if (registers.index_offset != Pm4::SH_NOP || registers.draw_index != Pm4::SH_NOP) {
		return false;
	}
	for (const auto [location, slot]: {std::pair {registers.vertex_offset, &offsets.vertex},
	                                   std::pair {registers.instance_offset, &offsets.instance}}) {
		if (location == Pm4::SH_NOP) {
			continue;
		}
		const uint32_t index = location - Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_GS_0;
		if (index >= HW::UserSgprInfo::SGPRS_MAX) {
			return false;
		}
		*slot = static_cast<uint8_t>(index);
	}
	return true;
}

void CommandProcessor::DrawIndirect(uint32_t data_offset, IndirectDrawRegisters registers,
                                    uint32_t draw_initiator, bool indexed) {
	const auto args_size =
	    indexed ? sizeof(vk::DrawIndexedIndirectCommand) : sizeof(vk::DrawIndirectCommand);
	DrawIndirectMulti(data_offset, 1, nullptr, args_size, registers, draw_initiator, indexed);
}

void CommandProcessor::DrawIndirectMulti(uint32_t data_offset, uint32_t max_count_or_count,
                                         const volatile uint32_t* count_addr,
                                         uint32_t stride_in_bytes, IndirectDrawRegisters registers,
                                         uint32_t draw_initiator, bool indexed) {
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED((draw_initiator & ~0x20u) != (indexed ? 0u : 2u));
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(m_draw_indirect_args_base_addr == 0);
	// The guest records match Vulkan's indirect commands byte for byte.
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED((stride_in_bytes & 3u) != 0 ||
	                     stride_in_bytes < (indexed ? sizeof(vk::DrawIndexedIndirectCommand)
	                                                : sizeof(vk::DrawIndirectCommand)));

	auto operation          = MakeOperation(GpuOperationKind::DrawIndirect);
	operation.draw_indirect = {.args_base         = m_draw_indirect_args_base_addr,
	                           .data_offset       = data_offset,
	                           .max_count         = max_count_or_count,
	                           .count_addr        = count_addr,
	                           .stride            = stride_in_bytes,
	                           .draw_initiator    = draw_initiator,
	                           .index_type        = m_index_type_and_size,
	                           .index_buffer_size = m_index_buffer_size,
	                           .index_base        = m_index_base_addr,
	                           .indexed           = indexed,
	                           .multi             = true,
	                           .registers         = registers};
	Emit(std::move(operation));
}

static bool PatchUserSgpr(HW::Shader& shaders, uint32_t location, uint32_t value) {
	const auto in  = [location](uint32_t base) { return location >= base && location < base + 32u; };
	const auto set = [value](const HW::UserSgprInfo& sgprs, uint32_t id, auto&& setter) {
		if (sgprs.value[id] == value) {
			return false;
		}
		setter(id, value);
		return true;
	};
	if (in(Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_GS_0)) {
		return set(shaders.GetVs().gs_user_sgpr, location - Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_GS_0,
		           [&](uint32_t id, uint32_t v) { shaders.SetGsUserSgpr(id, v); });
	}
	if (in(Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_HS_0)) {
		return set(shaders.GetVs().hs_user_sgpr, location - Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_HS_0,
		           [&](uint32_t id, uint32_t v) { shaders.SetHsUserSgpr(id, v); });
	}
	if (in(Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_PS_0)) {
		return set(shaders.GetPs().ps_user_sgpr, location - Pm4::SPI_SHADER_USER_DATA_PS_0,
		           [&](uint32_t id, uint32_t v) { shaders.SetPsUserSgpr(id, v); });
	}
	EXIT("unsupported indirect draw offset register 0x%" PRIx32 "\n", location);
	return false;
}

// Writes the offsets of one draw of an indirect packet to the user SGPRs the packet names, as
// the CP does before the draw. Without a pipeline the registers are the live ones. A pipelined
// operation carries a register snapshot shared with other operations: a copy is patched and
// bound for this draw, and the ahead resolution (made from the unpatched registers) is dropped
// when a value changed. Returns whether the packet names any register.
bool CommandProcessor::PatchIndirectDrawOffsets(const GpuOperation& operation,
                                                uint32_t vertex_offset, uint32_t instance_offset,
                                                uint32_t first_index, uint32_t draw_index) {
	const auto& registers = operation.draw_indirect.registers;
	if (registers.vertex_offset == Pm4::SH_NOP && registers.instance_offset == Pm4::SH_NOP &&
	    registers.index_offset == Pm4::SH_NOP && registers.draw_index == Pm4::SH_NOP) {
		return false;
	}
	const std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> writes[] = {{registers.vertex_offset, vertex_offset},
	                                                {registers.instance_offset, instance_offset},
	                                                {registers.index_offset, first_index},
	                                                {registers.draw_index, draw_index}};
	if (m_pipeline == nullptr) {
		for (const auto& [location, value]: writes) {
			if (location == Pm4::SH_NOP) {
				continue;
			}
			EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(location >= Pm4::SH_NUM ||
			                     g_hw_sh_indirect_func[location] == nullptr);
			g_hw_sh_indirect_func[location](*this, location, value);
		}
		return true;
	}
	if (m_indirect_shaders == nullptr) {
		m_indirect_shaders = std::make_unique<HW::Shader>();
	}
	*m_indirect_shaders = *operation.state.shaders;
	bool changed        = false;
	for (const auto& [location, value]: writes) {
		if (location != Pm4::SH_NOP) {
			changed |= PatchUserSgpr(*m_indirect_shaders, location, value);
		}
	}
	if (changed) {
		m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().UseResolvedDraw(nullptr);
	}
	GetScheduler().Begin(*operation.state.context, *operation.state.user_config,
	                     *m_indirect_shaders);
	return true;
}

// The arguments are read when the draw executes: earlier GPU work may produce them.
void CommandProcessor::ExecuteDrawIndirect(const GpuOperation& operation) {
	const auto& indirect = operation.draw_indirect;
	if (indirect.max_count == 0) {
		return;
	}
	const auto  args_addr = indirect.args_base + indirect.data_offset;
	const auto& registers = indirect.registers;
	// The GPU reads the records if the shaders allow; the VS prolog removes Vulkan's bases
	// from the index VGPRs and copies them only to the user SGPRs the packet patches. GPU work
	// (culling shaders) writes the records and the draw count: the host GPU reads the count too
	// (vkCmdDraw*IndirectCount), since reading it here would wait for all the GPU work recorded
	// so far. Like any GPU-read record, the count path draws with indirect_draw shaders.
	const auto count_address = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(indirect.count_addr);
	DrawIndirectArgs records {args_addr, indirect.max_count, indirect.stride};
	records.count_address = count_address;
	if ((count_address == 0 || (m_renderer.GetGraphics().indirect_draws_enabled &&
	                            (count_address & 3u) == 0)) &&
	    IndirectDrawOffsets(registers, records.offsets) &&
	    (!indirect.indexed || indirect.index_buffer_size != 0)) {
		// NUM_INSTANCES keeps the last draw's instance count.
		m_gpu_indirect_instances      = records;
		m_indirect_instances_sequence = operation.num_instances.sequence;
		m_has_indirect_instances      = true;
		NoteRecordedWork();
		auto& executor = m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor();
		if (indirect.indexed
		        ? executor.DrawIndex(CurrentBuffer(),
		                             {.index_count         = indirect.index_buffer_size,
		                              .index_addr          = IndexAddress(indirect.index_base,
		                                                                  indirect.index_type, 0),
		                              .index_type_and_size = indirect.index_type,
		                              .indirect            = records})
		        : executor.DrawAuto(CurrentBuffer(), {.indirect = records})) {
			Common::DebugCounters::Add(Common::DebugCounters::Counter::IndirectDraws,
			                           indirect.max_count);
			return;
		}
	}

	uint32_t draw_count = indirect.max_count;
	if (indirect.count_addr != nullptr) {
		draw_count = *indirect.count_addr;
		if (draw_count > indirect.max_count) {
			draw_count = indirect.max_count;
		}
	}
	m_gpu_indirect_instances = {};
	if (draw_count == 0) {
		return;
	}
	Common::DebugCounters::Add(Common::DebugCounters::Counter::IndirectDraws, draw_count);

	const uint32_t max_indices = indirect.index_buffer_size != 0 ? indirect.index_buffer_size : UINT32_MAX;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < draw_count; i++) {
		const auto* record_addr = reinterpret_cast<const void*>(
		    args_addr + static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * indirect.stride);

		if (!indirect.indexed) {
			vk::DrawIndirectCommand args {};
			std::memcpy(&args, record_addr, sizeof(args));
			m_indirect_instances          = args.instanceCount;
			m_indirect_instances_sequence = operation.num_instances.sequence;
			m_has_indirect_instances      = true;
			PatchIndirectDrawOffsets(operation, args.firstVertex, args.firstInstance, 0, i);
			ExecuteDrawAuto(operation, {.vertex_count   = args.vertexCount,
			                            .instance_count = args.instanceCount,
			                            .first_vertex   = args.firstVertex,
			                            .first_instance = args.firstInstance,
			                            .offset_source  = DrawOffsetSource::IndirectArgs});
			continue;
		}

		vk::DrawIndexedIndirectCommand args {};
		std::memcpy(&args, record_addr, sizeof(args));
		PatchIndirectDrawOffsets(operation, static_cast<uint32_t>(args.vertexOffset),
		                         args.firstInstance, args.firstIndex, i);

		const auto*    index_addr = IndexAddress(indirect.index_base, indirect.index_type, args.firstIndex);
		const uint32_t index_count = std::min(args.indexCount, max_indices);
		m_indirect_instances          = args.instanceCount;
		m_indirect_instances_sequence = operation.num_instances.sequence;
		m_has_indirect_instances      = true;
		ExecuteDrawIndex(operation, {.index_count         = index_count,
		                             .index_addr          = index_addr,
		                             .instance_count      = args.instanceCount,
		                             .index_type_and_size = indirect.index_type,
		                             .base_vertex    = args.vertexOffset,
		                             .first_instance = args.firstInstance,
		                             .offset_source  = DrawOffsetSource::IndirectArgs});
	}
}

Psr::Shader CommandProcessor::ComputePsrShader(uint64_t data_addr) {
	// The library's shaders live in the game's executable: their addresses never change.
	auto [it, inserted] = m_cs_psr_shaders.try_emplace(data_addr, Psr::Shader::None);
	if (inserted) {
		it->second = Psr::IdentifyShader(data_addr);
	}
	return it->second;
}

// Reads guest memory on the execution thread without waiting for the GPU when the GPU wrote
// other bytes of its pages.
static void ReadGuestAroundGpuWrites(uint64_t vaddr, void* data, uint64_t size) {
	if (!Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadAroundGpuWrites(vaddr, data, size)) {
		std::memcpy(data, reinterpret_cast<const void*>(vaddr), size);
	}
}

// Games using sce::Psr (the title) refit the BLASes of their animated geometry every frame with
// Psr_Gpu_BottomLevelBvh_FanRefit, four Psr shaders dispatched once per BLAS (one of them once per
// geometry): psr_qbvh_fan_refit_copy_dispatch_args (the indirect arguments of the next one, from
// the BLAS header), psr_qbvh_fan_refit_async (the vertices of a geometry's triangle nodes, from
// its vertex buffer and object matrix), psr_qbvh_fan_refit_recover_aabbs (the arguments of the
// last one) and psr_qbvh_refit_bottom_level (the boxes, bottom up). With native ray tracing they
// are replaced by NativeRayTracing::RecordHleRefit(): the dispatches are dropped; each BLAS
// (s[0:1] of the first shader) and each geometry (the geometry table V# at s[0:3], BLAS at s[4:5]
// and geometry index s8 of the second one, user data of generation Base460) are kept and, with
// the last box pass, one host command refits every BLAS (with the vertices other work wrote
// meanwhile). True when the dispatch is dropped.
bool CommandProcessor::HleBlasDispatch(uint64_t data_addr) {
	if (data_addr == 0 || !m_renderer.GetNativeRayTracing().Enabled()) {
		return false;
	}
	using Psr::Shader;
	const auto shader       = ComputePsrShader(data_addr);
	const bool refit_shader = shader == Shader::QbvhFanRefitCopyDispatchArgs ||
	                          shader == Shader::QbvhFanRefitAsync ||
	                          shader == Shader::QbvhFanRefitRecoverAabbs ||
	                          shader == Shader::QbvhRefitBottomLevel;
	// Other shaders run meanwhile.
	if (!refit_shader) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!m_hle_refit_window) {
		if (shader != Shader::QbvhFanRefitCopyDispatchArgs) {
			return false;
		}
		m_hle_refit_window = true;
		m_hle_refit_blases.clear();
		m_hle_refit_geometries.clear();
		m_hle_refit_finished = 0;
	}
	const auto& user = GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_user_sgpr.value;
	if (shader == Shader::QbvhFanRefitCopyDispatchArgs) {
		m_hle_refit_blases.push_back((uint64_t {user[0]} | (uint64_t {user[1]} << 32u)) &
		                             0xffffffffffffull);
	} else if (shader == Shader::QbvhFanRefitAsync) {
		m_hle_refit_geometries.push_back(
		    {.blas     = uint64_t {user[4]} | (uint64_t {user[5] & 0xffffu} << 32u),
		     .table    = uint64_t {user[0]} | (uint64_t {user[1] & 0xffffu} << 32u),
		     .geometry = user[8]});
	} else if (shader == Shader::QbvhRefitBottomLevel &&
	           ++m_hle_refit_finished == m_hle_refit_blases.size()) {
		m_hle_refit_window = false;
		EmitHleRefit();
	}
	return true;
}

void CommandProcessor::EmitHleRefit() {
	EmitHostCommand([this, blases = m_hle_refit_blases, refs = m_hle_refit_geometries] {
		auto&                                          context = m_renderer;
		auto&                                          cache   = context.GetBufferCache();
		std::vector<NativeRayTracing::HleRefitGeometry> geometries;
		geometries.reserve(refs.size());
		uint64_t last_vertices = 0;
		for (const auto& ref: refs) {
			if (ref.blas == 0 || ref.table == 0) {
				continue;
			}
			// The geometry entry (120 bytes, written by the game's CPU): the vertex buffer V# at
			// +8 and the object matrix at +56.
			std::array<uint32_t, 30> entry {};
			ReadGuestAroundGpuWrites(ref.table + uint64_t {ref.geometry} * 120u, entry.data(),
			                         sizeof(entry));
			NativeRayTracing::HleRefitGeometry geometry {.blas = ref.blas, .geometry = ref.geometry};
			std::memcpy(geometry.vsharp.data(), &entry[2], sizeof(geometry.vsharp));
			std::memcpy(geometry.matrix.data(), &entry[14], sizeof(geometry.matrix));
			ShaderBufferResource vsharp;
			std::memcpy(vsharp.fields, geometry.vsharp.data(), sizeof(vsharp.fields));
			// The vertex buffer reaches the GPU (once per buffer in a row).
			if (vsharp.Base48() != 0 && vsharp.Base48() != last_vertices && vsharp.GetSize() != 0) {
				last_vertices = vsharp.Base48();
				(void)cache.ObtainBuffer(vsharp.Base48(), vsharp.GetSize(), false);
			}
			geometries.push_back(geometry);
		}
		// The refit writes the nodes; the header (first 256 bytes) stays.
		for (const auto blas: blases) {
			uint32_t size = 0;
			ReadGuestAroundGpuWrites(blas + 16, &size, sizeof(size));
			if (blas != 0 && size > 256u) {
				(void)cache.ObtainBuffer(blas + 256u, size - 256u, true);
			}
		}
		// The inputs reached the GPU above (or are GPU written).
		context.PrepareBda(true, false);
		auto& command = context.GetCommandScheduler().Current();
		command.EndRendering();
		context.GetNativeRayTracing().RecordHleRefit(command.Handle(), blases, geometries);
	});
}

// Games using sce::Psr (the title builds the four TLASes of its ray tracing passes every frame) build
// TLASes in the kBase format with Psr_Gpu_TopLevelBvh_Build: 18 Psr shaders, each dispatched
// once per TLAS (psr_morton_rotate_tree_top more often), several of which wait for the GPU. With
// native ray tracing, the stage is replaced by NativeRayTracing::RecordHleTlas(): its dispatches
// are dropped; the instance list of each build (the V# at s[6:9] and the count at s8 of
// psr_morton_compute_bounding_box_for_instances, written by the game's CPU) is kept with the TLAS
// address (s[0:1] of psr_collapse_to_qbvh_simple_top, the stage's last shader), user data of
// generation Base460, and there one host command builds every TLAS. True when the dispatch is
// dropped.
bool CommandProcessor::HleTlasDispatch(uint64_t data_addr) {
	if (data_addr == 0 || !m_renderer.GetNativeRayTracing().Enabled()) {
		return false;
	}
	using Psr::Shader;
	const auto shader = ComputePsrShader(data_addr);
	// Some of the stage's shaders (sorts, scans) also serve other builds: only the dispatches
	// from the stage's first list (used only there) to the end of its last build are the TLAS
	// builds. Other shaders run meanwhile (the stage reads nothing they write).
	if (!Psr::IsTopLevelBuildShader(shader)) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!m_hle_tlas_window) {
		if (shader != Shader::MortonComputeBoundingBoxForInstances) {
			return false;
		}
		m_hle_tlas_window = true;
		m_hle_tlas_builds.clear();
		m_hle_tlas_finished = 0;
	}
	const auto& user = GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_user_sgpr.value;
	if (shader == Shader::MortonComputeBoundingBoxForInstances) {
		m_hle_tlas_builds.push_back({.input  = uint64_t {user[6]} | (uint64_t {user[7] & 0xffffu} << 32u),
		                             .stride = (user[7] >> 16u) & 0x3fffu,
		                             .count  = user[8]});
	}
	if (shader != Shader::CollapseToQbvhSimpleTop) {
		return true;
	}
	if (m_hle_tlas_finished < m_hle_tlas_builds.size()) {
		// Addresses have 48 bits.
		m_hle_tlas_builds[m_hle_tlas_finished].header =
		    (uint64_t {user[0]} | (uint64_t {user[1]} << 32u)) & 0xffffffffffffull;
	}
	if (++m_hle_tlas_finished < m_hle_tlas_builds.size()) {
		return true;
	}
	m_hle_tlas_window = false;
	EmitHostCommand([this, builds = m_hle_tlas_builds] {
		auto& context = m_renderer;
		auto& cache   = context.GetBufferCache();
		for (const auto& build: builds) {
			// An empty list still makes an empty TLAS.
			if (build.header == 0 || (build.count != 0 && (build.input == 0 || build.stride < 96))) {
				// [HACK] No build for a list the native build cannot read: the guest's own build was
				// dropped, so the TLAS keeps what it held.
				Common::HackNotice::Report(
				    "native TLAS build skipped for an instance list it cannot read",
				    "CommandProcessor::HleTlasDispatch", 0, build.stride,
				    fmt::format("{} instances of {} bytes at 0x{:x}, TLAS at 0x{:x}", build.count,
				                build.stride, build.input, build.header));
				continue;
			}
			// The list the CPU wrote reaches the GPU. The header depends only on the instance
			// count: it is written here too, so CPU reads of it need no readback; the rest of the
			// TLAS becomes GPU written.
			if (build.count != 0) {
				(void)cache.ObtainBuffer(build.input, uint64_t {build.stride} * build.count, false);
			}
			std::array<uint32_t, 32> header {};
			const auto size = NativeRayTracing::HleTlasHeader(build.count, header);
			Libs::LibKernel::Memory::WriteBacking(build.header, header.data(), sizeof(header));
			(void)cache.ObtainBuffer(build.header + 256u, size - 256u, true);
		}
		// The builds store through device addresses; their inputs reached the GPU above (or are
		// GPU written).
		context.PrepareBda(true, false);
		auto& command = context.GetCommandScheduler().Current();
		command.EndRendering();
		for (const auto& build: builds) {
			if (build.header != 0 && (build.count == 0 || (build.input != 0 && build.stride >= 96))) {
				context.GetNativeRayTracing().RecordHleTlas(command.Handle(), build.input,
				                                            build.count, build.stride,
				                                            build.header);
			}
		}
	});
	return true;
}

// Games using sce::Psr build the BLASes of their triangle geometry with
// Psr_Gpu_BottomLevelBvh_Build, one BLAS after another, each from a geometry table the game's CPU
// writes (120-byte srt_geometry_config entries: +0 kind, 1 = triangles; +4 flags, bit 0 opaque;
// +8 vertex buffer V#; +24 index buffer V#, whose record count, +32, is the triangle count; +56
// object matrix). With native ray tracing the builds still run (shaders read the guest BVH), and
// the command processor tells NativeRayTracing about each one as it ends, so the host BLAS follows
// it in the same frame instead of waiting for a walk to find it: psr_morton_compute_bounding_box_
// for_vertices runs once per geometry (the table V# at s[0:3], its record count the geometry count,
// the build's scratch memory at s[4:5] and the geometry index s9), and so does
// psr_morton_compute_code_for_mesh_* (geometry index s7) in builds that do not split triangles;
// psr_collapse_to_qbvh_simple_bottom(_with_refit) writes the BLAS (its address at s[0:1], the same scratch memory at s[2:3], its
// primitive count at s14), user data of generation Base460. The game builds BLASes in batches
// (each pass for every BLAS of the batch, then the next pass), so the builds in progress are told
// apart by their scratch memory. A build whose geometries are not all triangle geometries seen by
// those passes, or that has fewer primitives than triangles, is left to the walks. Split
// triangles (more primitives than triangles: the same triangle in several leaves) keep the layout
// (see rt_blas_walk.comp).
//
// It also streams in compressed BLASes and decompresses them on the GPU: psr_morton_capture_memory
// (the BLAS memory at s[0:1], its size at s2), psr_decompress_header_base, then the other passes and
// psr_decompress_compute_fan_node_* (the BLAS at s6 with its high bits at s1). Their triangle
// counts are only on the GPU: NativeRayTracing sizes their slots from the memory.
void CommandProcessor::PsrBlasDispatch(uint64_t data_addr) {
	if (data_addr == 0 || !m_renderer.GetNativeRayTracing().Enabled()) {
		return;
	}
	using Psr::Shader;
	const auto shader = ComputePsrShader(data_addr);
	if (shader != Shader::MortonComputeBoundingBoxForVertices && shader != Shader::MortonComputeCodeForMesh &&
	    shader != Shader::CollapseToQbvhSimpleBottom && shader != Shader::MortonCaptureMemory &&
	    shader != Shader::DecompressHeaderBase && shader != Shader::DecompressComputeFanNode) {
		return;
	}
	const auto& user = GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_user_sgpr.value;
	// Addresses have 48 bits.
	const auto address = [&](uint32_t sgpr) {
		return uint64_t {user[sgpr]} | (uint64_t {user[sgpr + 1] & 0xffffu} << 32u);
	};
	if (shader == Shader::MortonCaptureMemory) {
		if (m_psr_captured.size() >= 4096) {
			m_psr_captured.clear();
		}
		m_psr_captured[address(0)] = user[2];
		return;
	}
	if (shader == Shader::DecompressHeaderBase || shader == Shader::DecompressComputeFanNode) {
		const auto blas = uint64_t {user[6]} | (uint64_t {user[1] & 0xffffu} << 32u);
		const auto it   = m_psr_captured.find(blas);
		if (it == m_psr_captured.end()) {
			return;
		}
		if (shader == Shader::DecompressComputeFanNode) {
			m_psr_decompressed      = blas;
			m_psr_decompressed_size = it->second;
		}
		return;
	}
	constexpr uint32_t GeometryStride = 120;
	constexpr uint32_t MaxGeometries  = 1024;
	// Builds whose last pass never came (a batch the game gave up) do not pile up.
	constexpr size_t MaxBuilds = 4096;
	if (shader == Shader::MortonComputeBoundingBoxForVertices || shader == Shader::MortonComputeCodeForMesh) {
		const auto table    = address(0);
		const auto count    = user[2];
		const auto geometry = user[shader == Shader::MortonComputeCodeForMesh ? 7 : 9];
		if (m_psr_blas_builds.size() >= MaxBuilds) {
			m_psr_blas_builds.clear();
		}
		auto& state = m_psr_blas_builds[address(4)];
		if (table != state.table || count != state.seen.size()) {
			state.table = count != 0 && count <= MaxGeometries ? table : 0;
			state.seen.assign(state.table != 0 ? count : 0, 0);
		}
		if (geometry < state.seen.size()) {
			state.seen[geometry] = 1;
		}
		return;
	}
	const auto blas       = address(0);
	const auto primitives = user[14];
	const auto it         = m_psr_blas_builds.find(address(2));
	if (it == m_psr_blas_builds.end()) {
		return;
	}
	const auto table = it->second.table;
	const auto seen  = std::move(it->second.seen);
	m_psr_blas_builds.erase(it);
	if (blas == 0 || table == 0 || std::ranges::find(seen, 0) != seen.end()) {
		return;
	}
	NativeRayTracing::GuestBlasBuild build {.blas_va = blas};
	std::vector<uint32_t>            entries(seen.size() * GeometryStride / 4);
	ReadGuestAroundGpuWrites(table, entries.data(), entries.size() * 4);
	uint64_t triangles = 0;
	for (size_t g = 0; g < seen.size(); g++) {
		const auto* entry = &entries[g * GeometryStride / 4];
		if (entry[0] != 1) {
			return;
		}
		build.geometries.emplace_back(entry[8], (entry[1] & 1u) != 0);
		triangles += entry[8];
	}
	if (triangles == 0 || primitives < triangles) {
		return;
	}
	m_psr_blas_built = std::move(build);
}

void CommandProcessor::EmitPsrBlasBuilt() {
	if (m_psr_decompressed != 0) {
		EmitHostCommand([this, blas = m_psr_decompressed, size = m_psr_decompressed_size] {
			m_renderer.GetNativeRayTracing().NoteGuestBlasDecompressed(blas, size);
		});
		m_psr_decompressed = 0;
	}
	if (m_psr_blas_built.blas_va == 0) {
		return;
	}
	EmitHostCommand([this, build = std::move(m_psr_blas_built)] {
		m_renderer.GetNativeRayTracing().NoteGuestBlasBuilds(std::span(&build, 1));
	});
	m_psr_blas_built = {};
}

void CommandProcessor::DispatchDirect(uint32_t thread_group_x, uint32_t thread_group_y,
                                      uint32_t thread_group_z, uint32_t mode) {
	PsrBlasDispatch(GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_regs.data_addr);
	if (HleTlasDispatch(GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_regs.data_addr) ||
	    HleBlasDispatch(GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_regs.data_addr)) {
		return;
	}
	GetShCtx().SetCsWaveSize(Pm4::ComputeWaveSize(mode));
	auto operation     = MakeOperation(GpuOperationKind::DispatchDirect);
	operation.dispatch = {.thread_group_x = thread_group_x,
	                      .thread_group_y = thread_group_y,
	                      .thread_group_z = thread_group_z,
	                      .mode           = mode};
	Emit(std::move(operation));
	EmitPsrBlasBuilt();
}

void CommandProcessor::ExecuteDispatchDirect(const GpuOperation& operation, uint32_t thread_group_x,
                                             uint32_t thread_group_y, uint32_t thread_group_z,
                                             uint32_t mode) {
	NoteRecordedWork();

	m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().DispatchDirect(CurrentBuffer(), thread_group_x,
	                                              thread_group_y, thread_group_z, mode,
	                                              IsAsyncComputeQueue());
}

void CommandProcessor::ProcessPssr(const Pssr::Request& request) {
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(IsAsyncComputeQueue());
	m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().ProcessPssr(CurrentBuffer(), request);
}

void CommandProcessor::DispatchIndirect(uint64_t args_addr, uint32_t mode) {
	PsrBlasDispatch(GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_regs.data_addr);
	if (HleTlasDispatch(GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_regs.data_addr) ||
	    HleBlasDispatch(GetShCtx().GetCs().cs_regs.data_addr)) {
		return;
	}
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(args_addr == 0 || (args_addr & 3u) != 0);
	GetShCtx().SetCsWaveSize(Pm4::ComputeWaveSize(mode));
	auto operation     = MakeOperation(GpuOperationKind::DispatchIndirect);
	operation.dispatch = {.mode = mode, .args_addr = args_addr};
	Emit(std::move(operation));
	EmitPsrBlasBuilt();
}

void CommandProcessor::ExecuteDispatchIndirect(const GpuOperation& operation) {
	const auto& dispatch = operation.dispatch;
	NoteRecordedWork();
	if ((dispatch.mode & Pm4::COMPUTE_DISPATCH_INITIATOR_USE_THREAD_DIMENSIONS) != 0) {
		// Earlier GPU work writes the thread counts: reading them here would wait for it.
		m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().DispatchIndirectThreads(CurrentBuffer(), dispatch.args_addr,
		                                                       dispatch.mode,
		                                                       IsAsyncComputeQueue());
		return;
	}
	m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().DispatchIndirect(CurrentBuffer(),
	                                                dispatch.args_addr, dispatch.mode,
	                                                IsAsyncComputeQueue());
}

void CommandProcessor::DrawIndexAuto(DrawAutoArgs args) {
	auto operation      = MakeOperation(GpuOperationKind::DrawAuto);
	operation.draw_auto = args;
	Emit(std::move(operation));
}

void CommandProcessor::ExecuteDrawAuto(const GpuOperation& operation, DrawAutoArgs args) {
	NoteRecordedWork();
	if (args.instance_count == 0) {
		args.instance_count = ResolveNumInstances(operation);
	}
	m_renderer.GetRenderExecutor().DrawAuto(CurrentBuffer(), args);
}

void CommandProcessor::WaitFlipDone(uint32_t video_out_handle, uint32_t display_buffer_index) {
	// Flips before this packet that the execution thread has not run yet can still make the
	// buffer busy, so the execution thread waits, in operation order, until no flip of the buffer
	// is pending (upstream's wait, without the displayed-buffer condition it reverted).
	EmitCallback([this, video_out_handle, display_buffer_index] {
		GetScheduler().Flush();
		Common::DebugCounters::StageTimer wait(Common::DebugCounters::Counter::StageExecuteFlipWaitTicks);
		m_renderer.GetVideoOut().WaitFlipDone(static_cast<int>(video_out_handle),
		                                      static_cast<int>(display_buffer_index));
	});
}

void CommandProcessor::ReleaseMem(uint32_t data_sel, uint32_t interrupt_selector, void* address,
                                  uint64_t data, uint32_t interrupt_context_id) {
	if (graphics_debug_dump_enabled()) {
		LOGF("CommandProcessor::ReleaseMem()\n"
		     "\t data_sel           = %" PRIu32 "\n"
		     "\t interrupt_selector = %" PRIu32 "\n"
		     "\t address            = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n"
		     "\t data               = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n"
		     "\t interrupt_context  = 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
		     data_sel, interrupt_selector, reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(address), data,
		     interrupt_context_id);
	}

	// QueuedInterrupt: kNone, kOnly, kAfterWriteConfirm, kDataAfterWriteConfirm, kSendIntCtx.
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(interrupt_selector > 4);
	const bool interrupt = (interrupt_selector != 0 && interrupt_selector != 3);
	// kSendIntCtx has no label, and kOnly writes none on graphics queues.
	if (address == nullptr || interrupt_selector == 4 ||
	    (interrupt_selector == 1 && !IsAsyncComputeQueue())) {
		data_sel = 0;
	}
	if (data_sel == 0 && !interrupt) {
		return;
	}

	const auto sequence = EmitCallback([=, this] {
		ExecuteReleaseMem(data_sel, interrupt, address, data, interrupt_context_id);
	});
	// What ExecuteReleaseMem() writes: the value, or the clock and GDS dwords, known only then.
	const auto destination = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(address);
	switch (data_sel) {
		case 1: {
			const auto value = static_cast<uint32_t>(data);
			NoteGuestWrite(sequence, destination, sizeof(value), &value);
			break;
		}
		case 2: NoteGuestWrite(sequence, destination, sizeof(data), &data); break;
		case 3: NoteGuestWrite(sequence, destination, sizeof(data)); break;
		case 5:
			NoteGuestWrite(sequence, destination,
			               uint64_t {static_cast<uint32_t>(data) >> 16u} * sizeof(uint32_t));
			break;
		default: break;
	}
}

void CommandProcessor::ExecuteReleaseMem(uint32_t data_sel, bool interrupt, void* address,
                                         uint64_t data, uint32_t interrupt_context_id) {
	(void)CurrentBuffer().Handle();

	// A label beside GPU-written bytes goes to the backing store, so they are not downloaded.
	// Other labels go through the guest mapping: its fault keeps a clean cached copy current and
	// downloads GPU-written bytes under the label before the store.
	const auto write_label = [this, address](const void* value, uint64_t size) {
		const auto vaddr   = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(address);
		auto&      buffers = m_renderer.GetBufferCache();
		if (!GuestRange {vaddr, size}.Valid() || !buffers.IsRegionGpuModified(vaddr, size) ||
		    buffers.HasGpuDirtyBytes(vaddr, size) ||
		    !LibKernel::Memory::TryWriteBacking(vaddr, value, size)) {
			m_renderer.PrepareGpuWrite(address, size);
			std::memcpy(address, value, size);
		}
	};
	// Occlusion counters reach guest memory in a priority completion once the GPU got past
	// their dump. A label released after a dump tells the guest that the counters are there: the title
	// San Andreas DE writes one into every query object after its end dump and reads the query
	// once it is set. On the console the label lands after the counters, so it goes behind them
	// through the same completions instead of being written now. Labels keep their order: while
	// a deferred label is not written yet, later ones follow it through the completions too.
	// EOP interrupts always go through the priority completions, so they stay in order as well.
	if (data_sel != 0 && (m_renderer.GetOcclusionQueries().HasPendingDumps() ||
	                      m_deferred_labels.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0)) {
		const auto     vaddr = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(address);
		const uint64_t size  = data_sel == 1 ? sizeof(uint32_t) : sizeof(uint64_t);
		if (data_sel <= 3 && GuestRange {vaddr, size}.Valid() &&
		    !m_renderer.GetBufferCache().IsRegionGpuModified(vaddr, size)) {
			m_renderer.PrepareGpuWrite(address, size);
			m_deferred_labels.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
			GetScheduler().DeferPriorityOperation(
			    [this, address, data, data_sel] {
				    // Later GPU work may own the page again by now (ASTRO BOT, Sky Garden).
				    if (data_sel == 1) {
					    const auto value = static_cast<uint32_t>(data);
					    m_renderer.WriteFromCompletion(address, &value, sizeof(value));
				    } else {
					    const uint64_t value = data_sel == 3 ? Sync::ReadReferenceClock() : data;
					    m_renderer.WriteFromCompletion(address, &value, sizeof(value));
				    }
				    m_deferred_labels.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_release);
			    },
			    vaddr, size);
			if (interrupt) {
				DeferEopInterrupt(interrupt_context_id);
			}
			return;
		}
		// A label that cannot be deferred (GPU-written memory, GDS) behind deferred ones waits
		// until the GPU and the completions queued before it, those labels included, have run.
		if (m_deferred_labels.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0) {
			auto&      scheduler = GetScheduler();
			const auto tick      = scheduler.CurrentTick();
			scheduler.Wait(tick);
			scheduler.WaitPriorityOperations(tick);
		}
	}
	// EndOfPipeData: kNone, kImmediate32b, kImmediate64b, kRefClk; 5 reads GDS.
	switch (data_sel) {
		case 0: break;
		case 1: {
			const auto value = static_cast<uint32_t>(data);
			write_label(&value, sizeof(value));
			break;
		}
		case 3: data = Sync::ReadReferenceClock(); [[fallthrough]];
		case 2: write_label(&data, sizeof(data)); break;
		case 5: {
			GetScheduler().Finish();
			const auto gds = static_cast<uint32_t>(data);
			Sync::ReadGds(*m_renderer.GetBufferCache().GetGdsBuffer(),
			              static_cast<uint32_t*>(address), gds & 0xffffu, gds >> 16u);
			break;
		}
		default: EXIT("unknown release_mem data selector: %" PRIu32 "\n", data_sel);
	}

	// GuestGpu::Process's end-of-slice flush submits the work this interrupt waits on.
	if (interrupt) {
		DeferEopInterrupt(interrupt_context_id);
	}
}

void CommandProcessor::DeferEopInterrupt(uint32_t interrupt_context_id) {
	(void)CurrentBuffer().Handle();
	GetScheduler().DeferHostOperation(
	    [&renderer = m_renderer, event_id = m_interrupt_event_id, interrupt_context_id] {
		    renderer.TriggerInterrupt(event_id, interrupt_context_id);
	    },
	    true);
}

void CommandProcessor::TriggerEvent(uint32_t event_type, uint32_t event_index,
                                    uint64_t event_address) {
	if (graphics_debug_dump_enabled()) {
		LOGF("CommandProcessor::TriggerEvent()\n"
		     "\t event_type  = 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n"
		     "\t event_index = 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n"
		     "\t address     = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
		     event_type, event_index, event_address);
	}

	const auto sequence = EmitCallback([this, event_type, event_index, event_address] {
		ExecuteTriggerEvent(event_type, event_index, event_address);
	});
	if (event_type == 0x00000039) {
		// Occlusion counter pairs of 16 DBs.
		NoteGuestWrite(sequence, event_address, 16u * 2u * sizeof(uint64_t));
	}
}

void CommandProcessor::ExecuteTriggerEvent(uint32_t event_type, uint32_t event_index,
                                           uint64_t event_address) {
	const auto valid_cache_event_index = event_index == 0x00000000 || event_index == 0x00000007;
	// Partial flushes and cache writebacks only order GPU work, which the renderer's resource
	// barriers already order.
	switch (event_type) {
		// CsPartialFlush, GsPartialFlush, PsPartialFlush.
		case 0x00000007:
		case 0x0000000f:
		case 0x00000010: break;
		// CbDbDataWritebackInvalidate, CbDataWritebackInvalidate, DbDataWritebackInvalidate,
		// DbMetadataWritebackInvalidate, CbMetadataWritebackInvalidate.
		case 0x00000016:
		case 0x00000031:
		case 0x0000002a:
		case 0x0000002c:
		case 0x0000002e:
			if (!valid_cache_event_index) {
				EXIT("unknown event type: 0x%08" PRIx32 ", 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", event_type,
				     event_index);
			}
			break;
		case 0x0000000d:
		case 0x0000000e:
		case 0x00000012:
		case 0x00000017:
		case 0x00000018:
		case 0x00000019:
		case 0x0000001a:
		case 0x0000001b:
		case 0x00000038:
		case 0x0000003a:
			LOGF("\t temporary: ignoring unsupported event_write type 0x%08" PRIx32
			     ", index 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
			     event_type, event_index);
			break;
		case 0x00000039: {
			if (event_index != 0x00000001 || event_address == 0 || (event_address & 0x7u) != 0) {
				EXIT("invalid occlusion-counter dump: index=0x%08" PRIx32 ", address=0x%016" PRIx64
				     "\n",
				     event_index, event_address);
			}
			auto& queries = m_renderer.GetOcclusionQueries();
			if (queries.Enabled()) {
				queries.Dump(GetScheduler(), event_address);
				break;
			}
			static std::once_flag warning_once;
			std::call_once(warning_once, [] {
				std::printf("Warning: game uses occlusion queries, which are treated as always "
				            "visible without --occlusion-queries; GPU usage may be higher and FPS "
				            "may be lower.\n");
			});

			// Without host occlusion queries, publish an always-visible result. The PS5 layout
			// contains one interleaved begin/end pair per DB, and bit 63 marks a result ready.
			constexpr uint64_t ready_bit    = 1ull << 63u;
			constexpr uint64_t counter_mask = ready_bit - 1u;
			auto*              results      = reinterpret_cast<volatile uint64_t*>(event_address);
			const auto         value        = ready_bit | m_synthetic_occlusion_counter;
			for (uint32_t db = 0; db < 16u; db++) {
				results[db * 2u] = value;
			}
			m_synthetic_occlusion_counter = (m_synthetic_occlusion_counter + 1u) & counter_mask;
			break;
		}
		default:
			EXIT("unknown event type: 0x%08" PRIx32 ", 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n", event_type, event_index);
	}
}

void CommandProcessor::WriteLodStats(void* dst, uint32_t size, uint32_t control) {
	// The report reaches guest memory when the GPU completes it (LodStatsCounter::Report).
	EmitCallback([this, dst, size, control] {
		m_renderer.GetLodStats().Report(reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(dst), size, control);
	});
}

void CommandProcessor::Flip(int handle, int index, int flip_mode, int64_t flip_arg) {
	if (graphics_debug_dump_enabled()) {
		LOGF("CommandProcessor::Flip()\n");
	}

	EmitCallback([this, handle, index, flip_mode, flip_arg] {
		auto& command = CurrentBuffer();
		m_renderer.GetOcclusionQueries().OnFrame();
		auto  request = Sync::PrepareVideoOutFlip(command, handle, index, flip_mode, flip_arg);
		GetScheduler().DeferHostOperation(
		    [&renderer = m_renderer, request] { renderer.GetVideoOut().CompleteFlip(request); },
		    true);
		GetScheduler().Flush();
	});
}

void CommandProcessor::PrepareCpuFlip(uint64_t request_id) {
	if (g_current_processor != nullptr) {
		EXIT("invalid graphics-thread CPU flip preparation\n");
	}
	EmitCallback([this, request_id] {
		struct ProcessorScope {
			explicit ProcessorScope(CommandProcessor& processor) {
				g_current_processor = &processor;
			}
			~ProcessorScope() { g_current_processor = nullptr; }
		};
		ProcessorScope processor_scope(*this);

		m_renderer.GetVideoOut().PrepareFlip(request_id, CurrentBuffer());
		GetScheduler().DeferHostOperation(
		    [this, request_id] { m_renderer.GetVideoOut().CompleteFlip(request_id); }, true);
		GetScheduler().Flush();
	});
}

void GuestGpu::RunUrgentCommandsWhileWaiting() {
	if (g_executing_gpu != nullptr) {
		g_executing_gpu->RunUrgentCommands();
	}
}

bool GuestGpu::IsGpuThread() noexcept {
	return g_gpu_thread;
}

namespace Libs::Graphics {

class RenderContext;

class GuestGpu final {
public:
	explicit GuestGpu(RenderContext& renderer);
	~GuestGpu();
	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(GuestGpu);

	// The hybrid's frame capture: the register state of every command processor (context, user
	// config, shader) as words, taken with the GPU idle and put back by the replay before its first frame.
	void CaptureRegisters(std::vector<uint64_t>& words);
	bool RestoreRegisters(const uint64_t* words, const uint64_t* end);

	void               Shutdown();
	[[nodiscard]] bool IsStopping();
	void               SendCommand(Common::UniqueFunction<void>&& command);
	void               SendCommandSync(Common::UniqueFunction<void>&& command);
	// Runs a host command on the execution thread before the operations queued so far, and
	// waits for it. Only for work that no queued operation depends on (memory the guest unmaps
	// after the operations that used it executed).
	void SendUrgentCommandSync(Common::UniqueFunction<void>&& command);

	// Submitted command memory is borrowed and must remain valid until GPU execution completes.
	void Submit(std::span<const uint32_t> commands);
	void SubmitCompute(uint32_t queue, std::span<const uint32_t> commands);
	void SubmitFlipPreparation(uint64_t request_id);
	// Insert an ordered graphics drain; only a previous suspend point can block the caller.
	void SuspendPoint();
	// Wait for guest command processing, including all compute queues (not native GPU completion).
	void              WaitForIdle();
	// WaitForIdle() bounded by `millis`: false when the GPU still has work (it may wait on memory the caller writes later).
	bool              WaitForIdleFor(uint32_t millis);
	// What keeps the GPU busy, one line per queue with work: queued submissions, whether the front one is
	// blocked, and the guest memory it waits on with its current first 8 bytes (diagnostics, racy).
	std::string       DescribeBusy();
	// WaitForIdleFor() for the graphics queue only: no gfx submission queued or being processed and no
	// pending command; compute queues may keep running.
	bool              WaitForGfxIdleFor(uint32_t millis);
	// The queues with queued submissions (0 = gfx, then compute).
	std::vector<uint32_t> BusyQueues();
	// Quiet: nothing being processed or executed, and every queued submission blocked (on a wait or a
	// rewind), so the GPU does not change memory. `blocked` gets the number of queued submissions.
	bool              WaitForQuietFor(uint32_t millis, uint32_t* blocked);
	// The queued command submissions (queue, buffer, execution cursor) as words, and their requeueing in
	// the replay, so a submission blocked at the capture resumes when the replay writes what it waits on.
	void              CaptureBlocked(std::vector<uint64_t>& words);
	bool              RestoreBlocked(const uint64_t* words, const uint64_t* end);
	// Queues a rewind whose bit is clear, checks it waits, sets the bit and checks it finishes.
	bool              SelfTestRewind();
	[[nodiscard]] int GetFrameNum() const;

	// The thread that owns the renderer: the execution thread of a pipelined GPU.
	[[nodiscard]] static bool IsGpuThread() noexcept;
	// Execution thread, while it waits for another thread: runs the urgent commands queued so
	// far, which that thread may be waiting for (a read of guest memory the GPU owns).
	static void RunUrgentCommandsWhileWaiting();

	// A pipelined GPU parses command buffers on its command processor thread and executes the
	// operations they produce, in order, on its execution thread.
	[[nodiscard]] bool Pipelined() const noexcept { return m_pipelined; }
	// Command processor thread.
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t NextSequence() const noexcept { return m_emitted + 1; }
	// Returns the sequence of the operation.
	uint64_t               EmitOperation(GpuOperation&& operation);
	// The guest memory an emitted operation writes, and the value it writes when that is known
	// when the operation is emitted (`value` null otherwise, or larger than 8 bytes).
	void NoteGuestWrite(uint64_t sequence, uint64_t address, uint64_t size, const void* value);
	// Reads guest memory the command processor decides on as a serial GPU would at this point
	// of the stream: from the value of a pending write when it is known, otherwise from memory
	// once the operations that write it executed.
	void ReadDecisionMemory(const volatile void* address, void* value, size_t size);
	void                   WaitForExecution(uint64_t sequence) { m_executed.WaitFor(sequence); }
	// Waits until every operation emitted so far executed.
	void WaitForExecution() { m_executed.WaitFor(m_emitted); }
	// Command processor thread: the queue being processed waits on this guest memory.
	void NoteBlockedWait(uint64_t address, uint64_t size);
	// Command processor thread: whether another queue waits on guest memory in the range.
	[[nodiscard]] bool OtherQueueWaitsOn(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) const;
	[[nodiscard]] const GpuRegisterState& NeutralState() const noexcept { return m_neutral_state; }

private:
	static constexpr uint32_t ComputePipeCount     = 7;
	static constexpr uint32_t QueuesPerComputePipe = 8;
	static constexpr uint32_t ComputeQueueCount    = ComputePipeCount * QueuesPerComputePipe;
	static constexpr uint32_t ComputeQueueBase     = 0x20;
	static constexpr uint32_t QueueCount           = 1 + ComputeQueueCount;

	enum class SubmissionType { Commands, FlipPreparation, SuspendPoint };

	struct Submission {
		SubmissionType            type     = SubmissionType::Commands;
		uint32_t                  queue_id = 0;
		std::span<const uint32_t> commands;
		Pm4Execution              execution;
		bool                      blocked         = false;
		bool                      yielded         = false;
		uint64_t                  flip_request_id = 0;
	};

	void              Enqueue(Submission submission);
	void              ProcessCommands();
	void              ExecutionThread();
	void              ResolveThread();
	void              StopExecution();
	// Command processor thread of a pipelined GPU: runs a command on the execution thread and
	// waits for it.
	void              ExecuteSync(Common::UniqueFunction<void>&& command);
	bool              Process(Submission& submission);
	static void       ThreadRun(void* data);
	CommandProcessor& GetProcessor(uint32_t queue_id);

	RenderContext&                                 m_renderer;
	Common::Mutex                                  m_queue_mutex;
	std::mutex                                     m_shutdown_mutex;
	Common::CondVar                                m_work_available;
	Common::CondVar                                m_idle;
	std::array<std::deque<Submission>, QueueCount> m_queues;
	std::deque<Common::UniqueFunction<void>>       m_commands;
	std::atomic_uint32_t                           m_pending_commands {0};
	uint32_t                                       m_next_queue        = 0;
	uint32_t                                       m_submission_count  = 0;
	bool                                           m_processing        = false;
	bool                                           m_accepting         = true;
	bool                                           m_stopping          = false;
	bool                                           m_shutdown_complete = false;
	// Completion callbacks can outlive GuestGpu during renderer shutdown.
	std::shared_ptr<std::binary_semaphore> m_suspend_point_ready =
	    std::make_shared<std::binary_semaphore>(1);

	std::unique_ptr<CommandProcessor>                                m_gfx_cp;
	std::array<std::unique_ptr<CommandProcessor>, ComputeQueueCount> m_compute_cp;

	uint64_t        m_submit_id = 0;
	std::atomic_int m_done_num  = 0;

	// Command processor thread: the guest memory the blocked front submission of each queue
	// waits on (empty when it does not wait on memory).
	struct WaitRange {
		uint64_t begin = 0;
		uint64_t end   = 0;
	};
	std::array<WaitRange, QueueCount> m_wait_ranges {};
	uint32_t                          m_waiting_queues = 0;
	uint32_t                          m_current_queue  = 0;

	// Pipelined execution. m_emitted is only used by the command processor thread.
	struct GuestWrite {
		uint64_t sequence = 0;
		uint64_t address  = 0;
		uint64_t size     = 0;
		bool     known    = false;
		uint8_t  value[8] = {};
	};

	const bool                      m_pipelined;
	// With a resolve stage, the command processor queues operations for the resolve thread,
	// which forwards them to the execution thread.
	const bool                      m_resolving;
	Common::SpscQueue<GpuOperation> m_operations;
	Common::SpscQueue<GpuOperation> m_resolved;
	Common::ProgressCounter         m_executed;
	uint64_t                        m_emitted = 0;
	// Command processor thread: a ring of the writes of operations that may not have executed
	// yet, oldest first. It holds more writes than operations can be queued.
	static constexpr size_t PendingWriteCapacity = 16384;
	std::unique_ptr<GuestWrite[]> m_pending_writes;
	size_t                        m_pending_first = 0;
	size_t                        m_pending_count = 0;
	void                          ForgetExecutedWrites();
	// Commands that run before the next operation the execution thread takes.
	void                                      RunUrgentCommands();
	std::mutex                                m_urgent_mutex;
	std::vector<Common::UniqueFunction<void>> m_urgent_commands;
	std::atomic_uint32_t                      m_urgent_pending {0};
	// Game and host threads bump it when they queue work, under m_queue_mutex; the command
	// processor thread spins on it before it sleeps.
	std::atomic_uint64_t m_work_epoch {0};
	HW::Context                     m_neutral_context;
	HW::UserConfig                  m_neutral_user_config;
	HW::Shader                      m_neutral_shaders;
	GpuRegisterState                m_neutral_state;
	std::jthread                    m_executor;
	std::jthread                    m_resolver;

	std::jthread m_thread;

	friend class CommandProcessor;
};
} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif /* EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_GRAPHICSRUN_H_ */

struct DepthZInfo {
	Prospero::DepthFormat                       format      = Prospero::DepthFormat::kInvalid;
	uint32_t                                    num_samples = 0;
	Prospero::TextureCompatiblePlaneCompression texture_compatibility =
	    Prospero::TextureCompatiblePlaneCompression::kDisable;
	Prospero::ZCompareBase z_compare_base     = Prospero::ZCompareBase::kZMax;
	bool                   htile_acceleration = false;
	bool                   expclear_enabled   = false;
	bool                   partially_resident = false;
	uint8_t                max_mip_level      = 0;

	[[nodiscard]] static DepthZInfo Decode(uint32_t value) {
		DepthZInfo info;
		info.format                = static_cast<Prospero::DepthFormat>(value & 0x3u);
		info.num_samples           = (value >> 2u) & 0x3u;
		info.texture_compatibility = static_cast<Prospero::TextureCompatiblePlaneCompression>(
		    value & static_cast<uint32_t>(Prospero::TextureCompatiblePlaneCompression::kBitMask));
		info.partially_resident = (value & 0x00001000u) != 0;
		info.max_mip_level      = static_cast<uint8_t>((value >> 16u) & 0x0fu);
		info.expclear_enabled   = (value & 0x08000000u) != 0;
		info.htile_acceleration = (value & 0x20000000u) != 0;
		info.z_compare_base     = static_cast<Prospero::ZCompareBase>(
		    value & static_cast<uint32_t>(Prospero::ZCompareBase::kBitMask));
		return info;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] bool HasValidTextureCompatibility() const {
		switch (texture_compatibility) {
			case Prospero::TextureCompatiblePlaneCompression::kDisable:
			case Prospero::TextureCompatiblePlaneCompression::kEnable: return true;
			default: return false;
		}
	}
};

struct DepthStencilInfo {

	    Prospero::TextureCompatibleStencil::kDisable;

	bool htile_stencil_disabled = true;
	bool partially_resident     = false;

	[[nodiscard]] static DepthStencilInfo Decode(uint32_t value) {
		DepthStencilInfo info;
		info.format                = static_cast<Prospero::StencilFormat>(value & 0x1u);
		info.texture_compatibility = static_cast<Prospero::TextureCompatibleStencil>(
		    value & static_cast<uint32_t>(Prospero::TextureCompatibleStencil::kBitMask));
		info.partially_resident     = (value & 0x00001000u) != 0;
		info.expclear_enabled       = (value & 0x08000000u) != 0;
		info.htile_stencil_disabled = (value & 0x20000000u) != 0;
		return info;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] bool HasValidTextureCompatibility() const {
		switch (texture_compatibility) {
			case Prospero::TextureCompatibleStencil::kDisable:
			case Prospero::TextureCompatibleStencil::kEnable: return true;
