		c.buildAccelerationStructuresKHR(count, infos.data(), range_pointers.data());
	});
	MemoryBarrier(command, AsBuildStage, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eAccelerationStructureWriteKHR,
	              AsBuildStage | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader |
	                  vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eAccelerationStructureReadKHR | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eAccelerationStructureWriteKHR |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite);
	// Built: the TLAS walk may reference them.
	constexpr uint32_t built = 1;
	for (const auto index: slots) {
		UpdateBuffer(command, m_slots->Handle(), uint64_t {index} * SlotStride + offsetof(SlotInfo, state),
		             &built, sizeof(built));
		m_slot_list[index]->built       = true;
		m_slot_list[index]->built_frame = m_frame;
	}
	readback.build_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(slots.size());
	readback.build_slots = std::move(slots);
}

void NativeRayTracing::Prepare(const CommandRecorder& command, uint64_t user_pointer,
                               const TlasSource& source, const vk::DescriptorBufferInfo& flattened_srt,
                               uint64_t frame) {
	if (!m_enabled) {
		return;
	}
	auto& readback = m_readbacks[m_readback_index];
	if (readback.tick != 0) {
		// The ring is full: the oldest readback must complete first (rare).
		m_scheduler.Wait(readback.tick);
		m_scheduler.PopPendingOperations();
	}
	readback.build_count = 0;
	readback.build_slots.clear();
	const auto source_key = source.user_sgpr << 16u | source.header_offset;
	readback.source_key   = source_key;
	readback.frame        = frame;
	uint32_t              tlas_count = 0;
	std::vector<uint32_t> retry;
	// Slots released this preparation (index and table entry), and slots that got new memory
	// (their infos must not point at the old structure any more).
	std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> evicted;
	std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, SlotInfo>> reallocated;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                      moved;
	std::vector<std::tuple<uint32_t, uint64_t, uint32_t>> host_writes;
	{
		Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);
		m_frame = frame;
		DestroyRetired();
		for (const auto index: m_give_up) {
			if (index < m_slot_list.size() && m_slot_list[index] != nullptr && !m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
				evicted.push_back({index, m_slot_list[index]->table_index});
				EvictSlot(index);
			}
		}
		m_give_up.clear();
		moved.insert(moved.end(), m_moved_slots.begin(), m_moved_slots.end());
		m_moved_slots.clear();
		for (const auto& pending: m_new_slots) {
			if (!CreateSlot(pending)) {
				// No free slot: reported again later (a few times).
				ReportAgain(pending.blas_va, pending.root, pending.table_index);
			}
		}
		m_new_slots.clear();
		for (const auto& [index, opaque, alpha]: m_grow) {
			if (m_slot_list[index] == nullptr || m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
				continue;
			}
			auto& slot = *m_slot_list[index];
			// An implausible or too large count (see ComputeSlotSizes) keeps the slot as it is:
			// its builds drop the triangles that do not fit.
			SlotSizes sizes;
			if (!ComputeSlotSizes(opaque, alpha, sizes)) {
				continue;
			}
			// The recorded work may still use the old structure: it is destroyed later.
			RetireResources(slot, UINT32_MAX);
			AllocateSlot(slot, sizes);
			slot.leaf_count  = 0;
			slot.needs_build = true;
			m_build_queue.push_back(index);
			moved.push_back(index);
		}
		m_grow.clear();
		if (m_prepare_id - m_last_scan_prepare >= EvictScanPrepares) {
			m_last_scan_prepare = m_prepare_id;
			std::vector<uint32_t> indices;
			EvictUnused(indices);
			for (const auto index: indices) {
				evicted.push_back({index, m_slot_list[index]->table_index});
			}
			Defragment(moved);
		}
		for (const auto index: moved) {
			const auto& slot = *m_slot_list[index];
			if (slot.evicted) {
				// Released by the scan above after it got new memory.
				continue;
			}
			reallocated.push_back({index, SlotInfo {.as_address  = slot.as_address,
			                                        .entry_table = slot.entries.address,
			                                        .capacity0   = slot.capacity0,
			                                        .capacity1   = slot.capacity1,
			                                        .blas_va     = slot.blas_va,
			                                        .root        = slot.root}});
		}
		std::erase_if(m_late_retries, [&](const std::pair<uint64_t, uint32_t>& late) {
			if (late.first > m_prepare_id) {
				return false;
			}
			m_retry.push_back(late.second);
			return true;
		});
		retry.swap(m_retry);
		host_writes.swap(m_host_table_writes);
		// Slots the guest changed lately are rebuilt before each use: the verification finds a
		// change only after the TLAS of that preparation was built.
		std::erase_if(m_dynamic, [&](uint32_t index) {
			auto* released = m_slot_list[index].get();
			if (released == nullptr || released->evicted) {
				return true;
			}
			auto& slot = *released;
			if (slot.dynamic_until <= m_prepare_id) {
				slot.dynamic_until = 0;
				// No longer changing: built once more for tracing.
				if (slot.fast_built && !slot.needs_build) {
					slot.needs_build = true;
					m_build_queue.push_back(index);
				}
				return true;
			}
			// Before every preparation, not once a frame: the guest may change it between the ray
			// tracing passes of a frame.
			if (!slot.needs_build) {
				slot.needs_build = true;
				m_build_queue.push_back(index);
			}
			return false;
		});
		const auto last = m_last_instance_counts[source_key];
		tlas_count      = std::min(m_tlas_capacity, std::max(1024u, (last + last / 4 + 255u) &
		                                                           ~255u));
	}
	m_prepare_id++;

	// Earlier guest work wrote the BVHs; earlier ray queries read the TLAS this rebuilds.
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eAllCommands,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryWrite | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryRead,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer |
	                  AsBuildStage,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eAccelerationStructureWriteKHR);
	if (!m_cleared) {
		// The buffers start clear (empty table, invalid contexts).
		m_cleared = true;
		for (const auto* buffer: {m_table.get(), m_slots.get(), m_context.get()}) {
			command.fillBuffer(buffer->Handle(), 0, buffer->Size(), 0);
		}
		// Patched shaders find the context through the BDA page table.
		UpdateBuffer(command, m_buffer_cache.GetBdaPageTableBuffer()->Handle(),
		             BufferCache::NATIVE_RT_CONTEXT_PAGE * sizeof(uint64_t), &m_context_address,
		             sizeof(m_context_address));
	}
	// Table entries to forget become tombstones: the probe chains through them stay intact and
	// the walk reports the BLAS again (or reuses the entry for another key).
	const auto forget = [&](uint32_t table_index) {
		const std::array<uint64_t, 2> tombstone {TableTombstone, 0};
		UpdateBuffer(command, m_table->Handle(), uint64_t {table_index} * TableStride, tombstone.data(),
		             sizeof(tombstone));
	};
	for (const auto index: retry) {
		forget(index);
	}
	// Released slots: no table entry finds them and no TLAS may reference them (state 0).
	for (const auto& [index, table_index]: evicted) {
		constexpr SlotInfo cleared {};
		UpdateBuffer(command, m_slots->Handle(), uint64_t {index} * SlotStride, &cleared, sizeof(cleared));
		if (table_index != UINT32_MAX) {
			forget(table_index);
		}
	}
	// The host table, after the evictions released their entries.
	for (const auto& [index, key, encoded]: host_writes) {
		const std::array<uint32_t, 4> entry {static_cast<uint32_t>(key), static_cast<uint32_t>(key >> 32u),
		                                     encoded, 0};
		UpdateBuffer(command, m_table->Handle(), uint64_t {TableEntries + index} * TableStride, entry.data(),
		             sizeof(entry));
	}
	for (const auto& [index, info]: reallocated) {
		UpdateBuffer(command, m_slots->Handle(), uint64_t {index} * SlotStride, &info, sizeof(info));
	}
	command.fillBuffer(m_state->Handle(), 0, StateSize, 0);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite);
	// The header address as the guest's own load reads it, from the flattened SRT (its user data,
	// read on the CPU, with the dwords the GPU wrote copied in), into the state the walk starts
	// from. Through the BDA page table the walk would read a cache buffer over that memory,
	// synchronized only when something binds it, or no buffer at all (zero, Astro Bot).
	const auto in_srt = [&](uint32_t slot) {
		return slot != ShaderRecompiler::IR::ShaderInfo::NoRayQuerySlot &&
		       (uint64_t {slot} + 1) * sizeof(uint32_t) <= flattened_srt.range;
	};
	const bool header_in_state = flattened_srt.buffer && in_srt(source.header_slots[0]) &&
	                             in_srt(source.header_slots[1]);
	if (header_in_state) {
		const std::array<vk::BufferCopy, 2> words {{
		    {flattened_srt.offset + uint64_t {source.header_slots[0]} * sizeof(uint32_t),
		     offsetof(RtState, header_va), sizeof(uint32_t)},
		    {flattened_srt.offset + uint64_t {source.header_slots[1]} * sizeof(uint32_t),
		     offsetof(RtState, header_va) + sizeof(uint32_t), sizeof(uint32_t)},
		}};
		command.copyBuffer(flattened_srt.buffer, m_state->Handle(), static_cast<uint32_t>(words.size()),
		                   words.data());
		MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite,
		              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer,
		              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite |
		                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite);
	}

	auto* page_table = m_buffer_cache.GetBdaPageTableBuffer();
	const vk::DescriptorBufferInfo page_info {page_table->Handle(), 0, page_table->Size()};
	vk::WriteDescriptorSet write {};
	write.dstBinding      = 0;
	write.descriptorCount = 1;
	write.descriptorType  = vk::DescriptorType::eStorageBuffer;
	write.pBufferInfo     = &page_info;
	command.pushDescriptorSetKHR(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_blas_layout, 0, 1, &write);

	RecordBuilds(command);

	command.fillBuffer(m_instances->Handle(), 0, uint64_t {tlas_count} * InstanceStride, 0);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite);
	command.pushDescriptorSetKHR(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_tlas_layout, 0, 1, &write);

	const TlasPush tlas_push {
	    .user_ptr_va       = user_pointer,
	    .state             = m_state->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .queue             = m_queue->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .instance_nodes    = m_instance_nodes->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .instances         = m_instances->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .table             = m_table->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .slots             = m_slots->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .missing           = m_missing->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .context           = m_context_address,
	    .tlas_address      = m_tlas_address,
	    .verify_list       = m_verify_list->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	    .header_offset     = header_in_state ? HeaderInState : source.header_offset,
	    .root              = source.root,
	    .instance_capacity = tlas_count,
	    .table_mask        = TableEntries - 1,
	    .prepare_id        = m_prepare_id,
	    .verify            = 1u,
	    // The facing of each instance follows the game's triangle test (the layout's flip bit: the title
	    // V 01.011's accepts, with flags bit 3 clear, the triangles whose test sign is set, the
	    // host's back faces; not flipping them culled the wrong face of every instance without both
	    // faces, and single sided geometry such as peds, roofs and walls cast no shadow).
	    .layout            = source.layout,
	};
	command.bindPipeline(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_tlas_pipeline);
	command.pushConstants(m_tlas_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(tlas_push),
	                      &tlas_push);
	command.dispatch(1, 1, 1);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eDrawIndirect |
	                  AsBuildStage,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eIndirectCommandRead);

	// Counts the leaves of the BLASes the walk found missing, and checks the built ones it uses.
	command.bindPipeline(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_blas_pipeline);
	command.pushDescriptorSetKHR(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_blas_layout, 0, 1, &write);
	BlasPush blas_push {m_missing->BufferDeviceAddress(), m_pool->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	                    m_slots->BufferDeviceAddress(),   m_state->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	                    m_changed->BufferDeviceAddress(), ModeCount,
	                    PoolCapacity,                     0,
	                    ChangedCapacity,                  m_prepare_id};
	command.pushConstants(m_blas_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(blas_push),
	                      &blas_push);
	command.dispatchIndirect(m_state->Handle(), StateDispatch);
	blas_push.jobs = m_verify_list->BufferDeviceAddress();
	blas_push.mode = ModeVerify;
	command.pushConstants(m_blas_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(blas_push),
	                      &blas_push);
	command.dispatchIndirect(m_state->Handle(), StateVerify);

	// The TLAS over the walk's instances (inactive ones have a null BLAS).
	{
		const auto handle    = m_tlas;
		const auto instances = m_instances->BufferDeviceAddress();
		const auto scratch   = m_build_scratch->BufferDeviceAddress();
		command.Custom([handle, instances, scratch, tlas_count](vk::CommandBuffer c) {
			vk::AccelerationStructureGeometryKHR geometry {};
			geometry.geometryType = vk::GeometryTypeKHR::eInstances;
			geometry.geometry.instances.sType =
			    vk::StructureType::eAccelerationStructureGeometryInstancesDataKHR;
			geometry.geometry.instances.arrayOfPointers    = VK_FALSE;
			geometry.geometry.instances.data.deviceAddress = instances;
			vk::AccelerationStructureBuildGeometryInfoKHR info {};
			info.type                      = vk::AccelerationStructureTypeKHR::eTopLevel;
			info.flags                     = vk::BuildAccelerationStructureFlagBitsKHR::ePreferFastBuild;
			info.mode                      = vk::BuildAccelerationStructureModeKHR::eBuild;
			info.dstAccelerationStructure  = handle;
			info.geometryCount             = 1;
			info.pGeometries               = &geometry;
			info.scratchData.deviceAddress = scratch;
			vk::AccelerationStructureBuildRangeInfoKHR range {};
			range.primitiveCount      = tlas_count;
			const auto* range_pointer = &range;
			c.buildAccelerationStructuresKHR(1, &info, &range_pointer);
		});
	}
	MemoryBarrier(command, AsBuildStage | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eAccelerationStructureWriteKHR | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eAccelerationStructureReadKHR | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferRead);

	// Reads back the state, the counted missing BLASes, the build results and the changed slots.
	const std::array<vk::BufferCopy, 5> regions {{
	    {0, 0, StateSize},
	    {0, ReadbackMissing, uint64_t {MissingCapacity} * MissingStride},
	    {0, ReadbackJobs, uint64_t {MaxJobs} * JobStride},
	    {0, ReadbackChanged, uint64_t {ChangedCapacity} * 4},
	    {0, ReadbackUsed, uint64_t {SlotCapacity} * 4},
	}};
	command.copyBuffer(m_state->Handle(), readback.buffer->Handle(), 1, &regions[0]);
	command.copyBuffer(m_missing->Handle(), readback.buffer->Handle(), 1, &regions[1]);
	command.copyBuffer(m_jobs->Handle(), readback.buffer->Handle(), 1, &regions[2]);
	command.copyBuffer(m_changed->Handle(), readback.buffer->Handle(), 1, &regions[3]);
	command.copyBuffer(m_verify_list->Handle(), readback.buffer->Handle(), 1, &regions[4]);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eAllCommands,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryWrite);
	readback.tick = m_scheduler.CurrentTick();
	m_scheduler.DeferHostOperation([this, &readback] { ProcessReadback(readback); });
	m_readback_index = (m_readback_index + 1) % m_readbacks.size();
}

void NativeRayTracing::ProcessReadback(Readback& readback) {
	readback.buffer->Invalidate(0, ReadbackSize);
	const auto* bytes = readback.buffer->Mapped().data();
	RtState     state {};
	std::memcpy(&state, bytes, sizeof(state));
	const auto               missing_count = std::min(state.missing_count, MissingCapacity);
	std::vector<PendingSlot> pending;
	std::vector<uint32_t>    retry;
	Common::LockGuard        lock(m_mutex);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < missing_count; i++) {
		MissingEntry entry {};
		std::memcpy(&entry, bytes + ReadbackMissing + uint64_t {i} * MissingStride, sizeof(entry));
		if (entry.flags != 0 || entry.leaf_count == 0) {
			// Not countable now (memory not written yet, a too large BLAS): forget the entry so
			// the walk reports it again, a few times.
			ReportAgain(entry.blas_va, entry.root, entry.table_index);
			continue;
		}
		m_new_slots.push_back({entry.blas_va, entry.root, entry.table_index, entry.leaf_count,
		                       entry.opaque_count, entry.alpha_count});
	}
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < readback.build_count && i < readback.build_slots.size(); i++) {
		Job job {};
		std::memcpy(&job, bytes + ReadbackJobs + uint64_t {i} * JobStride, sizeof(job));
		if ((job.result & 1u) == 0 && ((job.result >> 1u) & 5u) != 0) {
			// The walk found no room: in the pool (other jobs of the preparation took it) or in
			// its queue (the BLAS has more nodes than when it was counted). The slot misses
			// triangles: built again, after a queue overflow with a queue of the size the BLAS
			// header allows.
			const auto index = readback.build_slots[i];
			if (m_slot_list[index] != nullptr && !m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
				auto& slot = *m_slot_list[index];
				if (((job.result >> 1u) & 1u) != 0) {
					slot.leaf_count = 0;
				}
				if (!slot.needs_build) {
					slot.needs_build = true;
					m_build_queue.push_back(index);
				}
			}
		}
		if ((job.result & (JobLayoutMismatch | JobLayoutStale)) != 0) {
			// The guest BLAS is not (or no longer) laid out as its build said: given up, the walks
			// find what the memory holds. A later build there is laid out again.
			const auto index = readback.build_slots[i];
			if (m_slot_list[index] != nullptr && !m_slot_list[index]->evicted &&
			    !m_slot_list[index]->layout.empty()) {
				m_give_up.push_back(index);
			}
			continue;
		}
		if (job.leaves != 0 && (job.result & 0xfu) == 0) {
			// A complete walk: the next one takes a queue of about as many nodes (a slot that
			// grew or overflowed its queue walked with the largest one).
			const auto index = readback.build_slots[i];
			if (m_slot_list[index] != nullptr && !m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
				m_slot_list[index]->leaf_count = job.leaves;
			}
		}
		if ((job.result & 0xfu) == 0 && job.layout == 0) {
			// A complete walk of a slot with far more room than the BLAS has (a decompressed BLAS
			// sized from its memory): it gets its exact size, like a grown slot.
			const auto index = readback.build_slots[i];
			if (m_slot_list[index] != nullptr && !m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
				const auto& slot = *m_slot_list[index];
				if (slot.capacity0 > job.capacity0 * 2 + 1024 || slot.capacity1 > job.capacity1 * 2 + 1024) {
					m_grow.push_back({index, job.capacity0, job.capacity1});
				}
			}
		}
		if ((job.result & 1u) != 0) {
			// More triangles than the slot holds (the guest rebuilt the BLAS bigger): the job
			// came back with the counts. A slot released since needs nothing.
			const auto index = readback.build_slots[i];
			if (m_slot_list[index] != nullptr && !m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
				m_grow.push_back({index, job.capacity0, job.capacity1});
			}
		}
	}
	const auto changed = std::min(state.changed_count, ChangedCapacity);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < changed; i++) {
		uint32_t index = 0;
		std::memcpy(&index, bytes + ReadbackChanged + uint64_t {i} * 4, sizeof(index));
		if (index >= m_slot_list.size() || m_slot_list[index] == nullptr ||
		    m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
			continue;
		}
		auto& slot = *m_slot_list[index];
		if (slot.dynamic_until == 0) {
			m_dynamic.push_back(index);
		}
		slot.dynamic_until = m_prepare_id + DynamicPrepares;
		if (!slot.needs_build) {
			slot.needs_build = true;
			m_build_queue.push_back(index);
		}
	}
	// The slots the TLAS referenced were used in the preparation's frame.
	const auto used = std::min(state.verify_count, SlotCapacity);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < used; i++) {
		uint32_t index = 0;
		std::memcpy(&index, bytes + ReadbackUsed + uint64_t {i} * 4, sizeof(index));
		if (index < m_slot_list.size() && m_slot_list[index] != nullptr &&
		    !m_slot_list[index]->evicted) {
			auto& slot          = *m_slot_list[index];
			slot.last_use_frame = std::max(slot.last_use_frame, readback.frame);
		}
	}
	m_last_instance_counts[readback.source_key] = state.instance_count;
	if (state.leaf_box_dropped != 0) {
		// [HACK] See rt_blas_walk.comp. Not the shader of the draw that runs this completion.
		Common::HackNotice::ScopedShader no_shader(0);
		Common::HackNotice::Report("native RT drops refit BLAS triangles outside their leaf box",
		                           "rt_blas_walk EmitLeaf", 0, 0,
		                           fmt::format("{} triangles in one preparation", state.leaf_box_dropped));
	}
	readback.tick = 0;
}

uint32_t NativeRayTracing::HleTlasHeader(uint32_t count, std::array<uint32_t, 32>& header) noexcept {
	if (count > HleTlasMaxInstances) {
		// [HACK] One workgroup builds the TLAS (hle_tlas.comp): the instances past the limit are
		// left out of it.
		Common::HackNotice::Report("native TLAS build keeps only its first 4096 instances",
		                           "NativeRayTracing::HleTlasHeader", 0, HleTlasMaxInstances,
		                           fmt::format("{} instances", count));
	}
	count          = std::min(count, HleTlasMaxInstances);
	uint32_t nodes = 0;
	for (uint32_t n = std::max((count + 3u) / 4u, 1u);; n = (n + 3u) / 4u) {
		nodes += n;
		if (n == 1u) {
			break;
		}
	}
	const uint32_t instance_offset = 256u + nodes * 128u;
	header                         = {};
	header[0]                      = 0x5f525350u; // "PSR_BVHL"
	header[1]                      = 0x4c485642u;
	header[2]                      = 0x5d1cba8cu;
	header[4]                      = instance_offset + count * 128u;
	header[6]                      = 0x00020024u;
	header[12]                     = instance_offset;
	header[22]                     = count + 4u;
	header[28]                     = count;
	return header[4];
}

void NativeRayTracing::RecordHleTlas(const CommandRecorder& command, uint64_t input_va,
                                     uint32_t count, uint32_t stride, uint64_t header_va) {
	if (!m_enabled || header_va == 0 || (count != 0 && input_va == 0)) {
		return;
	}
	// The game's CPU wrote the list; earlier GPU work wrote the BLASes the build reads and read
	// the TLAS it replaces.
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eAllCommands,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryWrite | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryRead,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite);
	auto* page_table = m_buffer_cache.GetBdaPageTableBuffer();
	const vk::DescriptorBufferInfo page_info {page_table->Handle(), 0, page_table->Size()};
	vk::WriteDescriptorSet write {};
	write.dstBinding      = 0;
	write.descriptorCount = 1;
	write.descriptorType  = vk::DescriptorType::eStorageBuffer;
	write.pBufferInfo     = &page_info;
	command.bindPipeline(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_hle_tlas_pipeline);
	command.pushDescriptorSetKHR(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_hle_tlas_layout, 0, 1, &write);
	const HleTlasPush push {input_va, header_va, m_hle_tlas_scratch->BufferDeviceAddress(), count,
	                        stride};
	command.pushConstants(m_hle_tlas_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(push), &push);
	command.dispatch(1, 1, 1);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eAllCommands,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryWrite);
}

void NativeRayTracing::NoteGuestBlasBuilds(std::span<const GuestBlasBuild> builds) {
	if (!m_enabled) {
		return;
	}
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);
	for (const auto& build: builds) {
		if (build.blas_va == 0 || build.geometries.empty()) {
			continue;
		}
		// Each geometry's triangles follow those of the earlier geometries of its opacity.
		std::vector<std::array<uint32_t, 4>> layout;
		std::array<uint64_t, 2>              totals {};
		for (const auto& [triangles, opaque]: build.geometries) {
			auto& total = totals[opaque ? 0 : 1];
			layout.push_back({static_cast<uint32_t>(total), triangles, opaque ? 1u : 0u, 0u});
			total += triangles;
		}
		if (totals[0] + totals[1] == 0 || totals[0] + totals[1] > MaxSlotTriangles) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto capacity0 = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::max<uint64_t>(totals[0], 1));
		const auto capacity1 = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::max<uint64_t>(totals[1], 1));
		// A BLAS with a slot already (built before, or found by a walk): laid out again.
		uint32_t index = UINT32_MAX;
		if (const auto it = m_slots_by_blas.find(build.blas_va); it != m_slots_by_blas.end()) {
			for (const auto candidate: it->second) {
				if (m_slot_list[candidate]->root == GuestBlasRoot) {
					index = candidate;
				}
			}
		}
		if (index != UINT32_MAX) {
			auto& slot = *m_slot_list[index];
			if (slot.capacity0 != capacity0 || slot.capacity1 != capacity1) {
				SlotSizes sizes;
				if (!ComputeSlotSizes(capacity0, capacity1, sizes, true)) {
					continue;
				}
				// The recorded work may still use the old structure: it is destroyed later.
				RetireResources(slot, UINT32_MAX);
				AllocateSlot(slot, sizes);
				m_moved_slots.push_back(index);
			}
			slot.layout = std::move(layout);
			// Leaves hold one triangle or more: the walk's queue is sized for as many (a walk
			// that needs more reports it, see RecordBuilds()).
			slot.leaf_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(totals[0] + totals[1]);
			if (!slot.needs_build) {
				slot.needs_build = true;
				m_build_queue.push_back(index);
			}
			continue;
		}
		SlotSizes sizes;
		if (!ComputeSlotSizes(capacity0, capacity1, sizes, true)) {
			continue;
		}
		if (const auto created = CreateHostSlot(build.blas_va, sizes); created != UINT32_MAX) {
			auto& slot      = *m_slot_list[created];
			slot.layout     = std::move(layout);
			slot.leaf_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(totals[0] + totals[1]);
		}
	}
}

uint32_t NativeRayTracing::FindHostSlotIndex(uint64_t blas_va) const {
	if (const auto it = m_slots_by_blas.find(blas_va); it != m_slots_by_blas.end()) {
		for (const auto candidate: it->second) {
			if (m_slot_list[candidate]->root == GuestBlasRoot) {
				return candidate;
			}
		}
	}
	return UINT32_MAX;
}

uint32_t NativeRayTracing::CreateHostSlot(uint64_t blas_va, const SlotSizes& sizes) {
	// A host table entry: the first free (or released) one of the key's probe chain.
	const uint64_t key  = blas_va ^ (uint64_t {GuestBlasRoot} << 48u);
	const uint32_t hash = TableHash(key);
	uint32_t       host = UINT32_MAX;
	for (uint32_t probe = 0; probe < HostTableProbes; probe++) {
		const uint32_t candidate = (hash + probe) & (HostTableEntries - 1);
		if (m_host_keys[candidate] == 0 || m_host_keys[candidate] == TableTombstone) {
			host = candidate;
			break;
		}
	}
	if (host == UINT32_MAX) {
		return UINT32_MAX;
	}
	uint32_t index = UINT32_MAX;
	if (!m_free_slots.empty()) {
		index = m_free_slots.back();
		m_free_slots.pop_back();
	} else if (m_slot_list.size() < SlotCapacity) {
		index = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_slot_list.size());
		m_slot_list.emplace_back();
	} else {
		return UINT32_MAX;
	}
	auto slot              = std::make_unique<Slot>();
	slot->blas_va          = blas_va;
	slot->root             = GuestBlasRoot;
	slot->table_index      = UINT32_MAX;
	slot->host_table_index = host;
	slot->last_use_frame   = m_frame;
	AllocateSlot(*slot, sizes);
	slot->needs_build = true;
	m_slots_by_blas[blas_va].push_back(index);
	m_build_queue.push_back(index);
	m_slot_list[index] = std::move(slot);
	m_host_keys[host]  = key;
	m_host_table_writes.emplace_back(host, key, index + 1);
	return index;
}

void NativeRayTracing::NoteGuestBlasDecompressed(uint64_t blas_va, uint64_t memory_size) {
	if (!m_enabled || blas_va == 0) {
		return;
	}
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);
	if (const auto index = FindHostSlotIndex(blas_va); index != UINT32_MAX) {
		// The memory holds another BLAS now: no layout and no refits of the old one; the walk
		// builds it again (and grows the slot if needed).
		auto& slot     = *m_slot_list[index];
		slot.layout.clear();
		slot.refit_seq = 0;
		if (!slot.needs_build) {
			slot.needs_build = true;
			m_build_queue.push_back(index);
		}
		return;
	}
	// Its triangle counts are not known before the decompression ran on the GPU: the slot takes
	// as many triangles of each opacity as the BLAS memory can hold (a triangle takes more than
	// DecompressBytesPerTriangle bytes of it), and its first build gives it its exact size.
	const auto bound = static_cast<uint32_t>(
	    std::clamp<uint64_t>(memory_size / DecompressBytesPerTriangle, 1, MaxSlotTriangles / 2));
	SlotSizes sizes;
	if (memory_size == 0 || !ComputeSlotSizes(bound, bound, sizes, true)) {
		return;
	}
	if (const auto created = CreateHostSlot(blas_va, sizes); created != UINT32_MAX) {
		m_slot_list[created]->leaf_count = bound;
	}
}

void NativeRayTracing::RecordHleRefit(const CommandRecorder& command, std::span<const uint64_t> blases,
                                      std::span<const HleRefitGeometry> geometries) {
	if (!m_enabled || blases.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	const uint64_t geometry_bytes = uint64_t {HleRefitGeometryStride} * geometries.size();
	const uint64_t blas_offset    = (geometry_bytes + 255u) & ~uint64_t {255};
	const uint64_t blas_bytes     = uint64_t {HleRefitBlasStride} * blases.size();
	if (blas_offset + blas_bytes > HleRefitJobsSize) {
		// [HACK] The game's refit dispatches were dropped: these BLASes keep their last shape.
		Common::HackNotice::Report("native BLAS refit skipped: its jobs exceed the job buffer",
		                           "NativeRayTracing::RecordHleRefit", 0, HleRefitJobsSize,
		                           fmt::format("{} BLASes, {} geometries, {} bytes", blases.size(),
		                                       geometries.size(), blas_offset + blas_bytes));
		return;
	}
	static_assert(sizeof(HleRefitGeometry) == HleRefitGeometryStride);
	// Earlier work read the jobs of the last refit and wrote what this one reads.
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eAllCommands,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryWrite | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryRead,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer | vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead |
	                  vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite);
	const auto upload = [&](uint64_t offset, const uint8_t* data, uint64_t size) {
		for (uint64_t done = 0; done < size;) {
			const auto chunk = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(size - done, 65536));
			UpdateBuffer(command, m_hle_jobs->Handle(), offset + done, data + done, chunk);
			done += chunk;
		}
	};
	if (geometry_bytes != 0) {
		upload(0, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(geometries.data()), geometry_bytes);
	}
	std::vector<uint64_t> blas_jobs(blases.size() * 2);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < blases.size(); i++) {
		blas_jobs[i * 2] = blases[i];
	}
	{
		Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);
		m_refit_seq++;
		for (const auto blas: blases) {
			if (const auto it = m_slots_by_blas.find(blas); it != m_slots_by_blas.end()) {
				for (const auto index: it->second) {
					// Built again (gathered) at the next preparation, so the frame that refit it
					// traces the new shape.
					auto& slot     = *m_slot_list[index];
					slot.refit_seq = m_refit_seq;
					if (slot.built && !slot.needs_build) {
						slot.needs_build = true;
						m_build_queue.push_back(index);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	upload(blas_offset, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(blas_jobs.data()), blas_bytes);
	command.fillBuffer(m_hle_state->Handle(), 0, HleRefitStateSize, 0);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite);
	auto* page_table = m_buffer_cache.GetBdaPageTableBuffer();
	const vk::DescriptorBufferInfo page_info {page_table->Handle(), 0, page_table->Size()};
	vk::WriteDescriptorSet write {};
	write.dstBinding      = 0;
	write.descriptorCount = 1;
	write.descriptorType  = vk::DescriptorType::eStorageBuffer;
	write.pBufferInfo     = &page_info;
	command.bindPipeline(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_hle_refit_pipeline);
	command.pushDescriptorSetKHR(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_hle_refit_layout, 0, 1, &write);
	const auto jobs = m_hle_jobs->BufferDeviceAddress();
	HleRefitPush push {jobs,
	                   m_hle_pool->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	                   m_hle_state->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	                   0,
	                   static_cast<uint32_t>(geometries.size()),
	                   HleRefitPoolCapacity,
	                   0};
	if (!geometries.empty()) {
		command.pushConstants(m_hle_refit_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(push), &push);
		command.dispatch(static_cast<uint32_t>(geometries.size()), 1, 1);
		// The boxes enclose the new vertices.
		MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite,
		              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader,
		              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite);
	}
	push.jobs      = jobs + blas_offset;
	push.mode      = 1;
	push.job_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(blases.size());
	command.pushConstants(m_hle_refit_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(push), &push);
	command.dispatch(static_cast<uint32_t>(blases.size()), 1, 1);
	MemoryBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eComputeShader, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite,
	              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eAllCommands,
	              vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits2::eMemoryWrite);
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/nativeRayTracing.h`:

#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_NATIVERAYTRACING_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_NATIVERAYTRACING_H_

#include "common/abi.h"
#include "common/common.h"
#include "common/threads.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/streamBuffer.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <span>
#include <tuple>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

namespace ShaderRecompiler::IR {
struct ShaderInfo;
} // namespace ShaderRecompiler::IR

class BufferCache;
class CommandRecorder;
class CommandScheduler;
struct GraphicContext;

// Host acceleration structures for guest ray tracing (VK_KHR_acceleration_structure).
//
// The title builds AMD BVHs with its own compute shaders and traverses them in software with
// IMAGE_BVH_INTERSECT_RAY, one node at a time. Before a dispatch that traces through such a
// BVH, this class mirrors it on the GPU, without the CPU reading what the GPU wrote:
// - every leaf of the guest top-level BVH (an instance) becomes a host TLAS instance with the
//   inverse of the instance's world-to-object matrix and its mask;
// - every guest bottom-level BVH becomes a host BLAS of the triangles of its leaf lists: opaque
//   ones (geometry 0) and alpha tested ones (geometry 1), with a table from the primitive to the
//   guest list entry (its leaf pointer and primitive word).
// A shader then lets the hardware find opaque hits and runs the guest's own leaf code (triangle
// and alpha test) only for the alpha tested triangles a ray hits. BLASes the host has not seen are reported by the top-level walk, counted on the
// GPU and read back asynchronously; the host allocates them and builds them the next time.
//
// BLASes whose builds the command processor saw (games that build them with sce::Psr, see
// NoteGuestBlasBuilds()) do not wait for that: their slots are created, sized from the build's
// geometries, as the guest builds them and built at the next preparation, and the walk finds them
// in a table of the host's.
//
// The host memory is bounded: the readbacks list the slots each TLAS references, a slot no TLAS
// referenced for EvictFrames frames is evicted (its table entry, acceleration structure and
// buffers are released) and a slot whose BLAS grew releases its old structure. Whatever the GPU
// may still read is destroyed only after the work recorded so far has completed. The memory of
// the structures has a budget too (a share of the VRAM, KYTY_RT_ARENA_MB overrides it): a BLAS
// that would not fit, or is implausibly large, is not allocated, and over the budget the slots
// used least recently are evicted. A nearly empty arena chunk is emptied by moving what is left
// in it (the slots are built again) so that it can be released.
class NativeRayTracing {
public:
	NativeRayTracing(GraphicContext& graphics, CommandScheduler& scheduler,
	                 BufferCache& buffer_cache);
	~NativeRayTracing();
	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(NativeRayTracing);

	// Whether the device supports host ray tracing and it is enabled.
	[[nodiscard]] bool Enabled() const noexcept { return m_enabled; }
	// Whether shader compilation applies the traversal patches (set once at startup).
	[[nodiscard]] static bool PatchShaders() noexcept;
	// The device was created with the ray tracing extensions (before any shader compiles).
	static void SetDeviceSupport(bool supported) noexcept;

	// The guest TLAS of a known tracing shader: its header's address is the 64-bit value at
	// user data pointer (user SGPR pair `user_sgpr`) + `header_offset`; `root` its root node,
	// `layout` how the shader reads its instance records (Decoder::RayTracingLayout::Pack());
	// `header_slots` the flattened SRT dwords the shader reads the header's address from, when it
	// loads it from its user data (ShaderInfo::ray_query_header_slots).
	struct TlasSource {
		uint32_t                user_sgpr     = 0;
		uint32_t                header_offset = 0;
		uint32_t                root          = 0;
		std::array<uint32_t, 4> layout {};
		std::array<uint32_t, 2> header_slots {};
	};
	// The source of a program that traces through a guest TLAS (its info), or false.
	[[nodiscard]] static bool FindTlasSource(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ShaderInfo& info,
	                                         TlasSource& source) noexcept;

	// Records, before the dispatch, the walk of the guest TLAS whose header the 64-bit value at
	// `user_pointer + source.header_offset` points to (the dwords at `source.header_slots` of
	// `flattened_srt`, the dispatch's flattened SRT, when it has them), the builds of pending
	// BLASes and the TLAS build. Outside a render pass.
	void Prepare(const CommandRecorder& command, uint64_t user_pointer, const TlasSource& source,
	             const vk::DescriptorBufferInfo& flattened_srt, uint64_t frame);

	// The title's TLAS builds (see CommandProcessor::HleTlasDispatch()): records the build of a TLAS
	// in the game's format at `header_va` from the instance list the game's CPU writes (`count`
	// records of `stride` bytes at `input_va`, see hle_tlas.comp). Outside a render pass.
	void RecordHleTlas(const CommandRecorder& command, uint64_t input_va, uint32_t count,
	                   uint32_t stride, uint64_t header_va);
	// The instances one HLE TLAS build holds at most.
	static constexpr uint32_t HleTlasMaxInstances = 4096;
	// The first 128 bytes of the header hle_tlas.comp writes for `count` instances (it depends on
	// nothing else); returns the TLAS size.
	static uint32_t HleTlasHeader(uint32_t count, std::array<uint32_t, 32>& header) noexcept;

	// The title's BLAS refits (see CommandProcessor::HleBlasDispatch()): a geometry of a refit BLAS
	// with its vertex buffer V# and object matrix (column-major), as the game's CPU wrote them.
	struct HleRefitGeometry {
		uint64_t                 blas     = 0;
		uint32_t                 geometry = 0;
		uint32_t                 pad      = 0;
		std::array<uint32_t, 4>  vsharp {};
		std::array<float, 16>    matrix {};
	};
	// Records the refits of `blases` in the game's format: the vertices of the triangle nodes of
	// `geometries`, then the boxes of the box nodes (see hle_blas_refit.comp). Outside a render
	// pass.
	void RecordHleRefit(const CommandRecorder& command, std::span<const uint64_t> blases,
	                    std::span<const HleRefitGeometry> geometries);

	// A BLAS the game built with sce::Psr (see CommandProcessor::PsrBlasDispatch()): its address
	// and, per geometry in the build's order, its triangle count and whether it is opaque, as the
	// game's CPU wrote them in the build's geometry table.
	struct GuestBlasBuild {
		uint64_t                               blas_va = 0;
		std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, bool>> geometries;
	};
	// In operation order after the guest built the BLASes of `builds`: gives each a slot laid out
	// by primitive (each guest triangle at a position given by its geometry and triangle index, see
	// rt_blas_walk.comp) and builds it at the next preparation, from the guest BLAS as usual. A BLAS
	// whose build does not match the layout is given up (its slot is evicted) and from then on
	// found and counted by the walks.
	void NoteGuestBlasBuilds(std::span<const GuestBlasBuild> builds);

	// In operation order after sce::Psr decompressed a BLAS into the `memory_size` bytes at
	// `blas_va` (see CommandProcessor::PsrBlasDispatch()): gives it a slot sized from its memory and
	// builds it at the next preparation by walking the guest BLAS, instead of waiting for a walk of a
	// TLAS to find it.
	void NoteGuestBlasDecompressed(uint64_t blas_va, uint64_t memory_size);

	// The device address of the context table the shaders look their TLAS up in (see
	// ContextEntry in rt_tlas_walk.comp), 0 when disabled.
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t ContextAddress() const noexcept { return m_context_address; }

	static constexpr uint32_t MaxContexts = 4;

private:
	struct Allocation {
		Buffer*           buffer  = nullptr;
		uint64_t          offset  = 0;
		vk::DeviceAddress address = 0;
		uint64_t          size    = 0;
	};

	// Sub-allocates device memory for acceleration structures and their inputs. Allocations go to
	// the fullest chunk with a free range that fits (best fit inside it), so the other chunks
	// empty out; a chunk with nothing allocated is released (one standard chunk is kept to avoid
	// allocating memory again and again), and an allocation larger than half a chunk gets a
	// chunk of its own that is released with it. A chunk can be drained: new allocations avoid
	// it until the host has moved what is left in it elsewhere. Free() is for memory the GPU no
	// longer reads.
	class Arena {
	public:
		Arena(GraphicContext& graphics, CommandScheduler& scheduler): m_graphics(graphics),
		                                                              m_scheduler(scheduler) {}
		Allocation Allocate(uint64_t size, uint64_t alignment);
		void       Free(const Allocation& allocation);
		// Bytes allocated now, and the bytes of the chunks.
		[[nodiscard]] uint64_t Used() const noexcept { return m_used; }
		[[nodiscard]] uint64_t Reserved() const noexcept { return m_reserved; }
		// Starts draining the standard chunk with the least allocated, if the free space of the
		// others holds what it has; false when there is none.
		bool BeginDrain();
		void EndDrain() noexcept { m_draining = nullptr; }
		// The buffer of the chunk being drained, or null.
		[[nodiscard]] const Buffer* Draining() const noexcept { return m_draining; }

	private:
		static constexpr uint64_t ChunkSize = uint64_t {64} << 20u;
		struct Chunk {
			std::unique_ptr<Buffer>      buffer;
			// Free ranges by offset, and their total.
			std::map<uint64_t, uint64_t> free_ranges;
			uint64_t                     free_bytes = 0;
			// Holds a single large allocation.
			bool                         dedicated  = false;
		};
		GraphicContext&                     m_graphics;
		CommandScheduler&                   m_scheduler;
		std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Chunk>> m_chunks;
		uint64_t                            m_used     = 0;
		uint64_t                            m_reserved = 0;
		const Buffer*                       m_draining = nullptr;
	};

	// The sizes of the memory a slot needs.
	struct SlotSizes {
		uint32_t capacity0 = 0;
		uint32_t capacity1 = 0;
		uint64_t storage   = 0;
		uint64_t vertices0 = 0;
		uint64_t vertices1 = 0;
		uint64_t entries   = 0;
		uint64_t scratch   = 0;
		[[nodiscard]] uint64_t Total() const noexcept { return storage + vertices0 + vertices1 + entries; }
	};

	struct Slot {
		uint64_t                     blas_va     = 0;
		uint32_t                     root        = 0;
		uint32_t                     table_index = 0;
		uint32_t                     capacity0   = 0;
		uint32_t                     capacity1   = 0;
		// The leaves of the guest BLAS when it was counted (0: not known): its walk needs a queue
		// of about as many nodes in the pool.
		uint32_t                     leaf_count  = 0;
		Allocation                   vertices0;
		Allocation                   vertices1;
		Allocation                   entries;
		Allocation                   storage;
		vk::AccelerationStructureKHR handle      = nullptr;
		vk::DeviceAddress            as_address  = 0;
		uint64_t                     build_scratch = 0;
		bool                         built       = false;
		bool                         needs_build = false;
		// Until this preparation the slot is rebuilt every time (the guest changed it lately).
		uint32_t                     dynamic_until = 0;
		uint64_t                     built_frame   = UINT64_MAX;
		// The last HLE refit pass that refit the guest BLAS, and the one before the last host
		// build.
		uint64_t                     refit_seq       = 0;
		uint64_t                     built_refit_seq = 0;
		// Built for a fast build (see FastBlasFlags), gathered builds since the last walk.
		bool                         fast_built      = false;
		uint32_t                     gathers         = 0;
		// The last build allows updates (see UpdatableBlasFlags): a gathered build refits it.
		bool                         updatable       = false;
		// The last frame a TLAS referenced the slot (from the readbacks), or its creation.
		uint64_t                     last_use_frame  = 0;
		// Released: kept in m_retired's shadow until the readbacks that may name it are gone.
		bool                         evicted         = false;
		// A slot of a BLAS whose build the host saw: per guest geometry, its first host primitive,
		// triangle count and opacity (see NoteGuestBlasBuilds()), and its entry in the host table
		// (UINT32_MAX: none; table_index is then UINT32_MAX too).
		std::vector<std::array<uint32_t, 4>> layout;
		uint32_t                     host_table_index = UINT32_MAX;
	};

	// Acceleration structures and buffers the GPU may still read, destroyed once the work
	// recorded when they were released has completed. A released slot index is reused only after
	// every readback recorded before the release was processed.
	struct Retired {
		uint64_t                     tick       = 0;
		uint64_t                     prepare_id = 0;
		vk::AccelerationStructureKHR handle     = nullptr;
		std::array<Allocation, 4>    allocations {};
		uint32_t                     slot       = UINT32_MAX;
	};

	struct PendingSlot {
		uint64_t blas_va     = 0;
		uint32_t root        = 0;
		uint32_t table_index = 0;
		uint32_t leaf_count  = 0;
		uint32_t opaque      = 0;
		uint32_t alpha       = 0;
	};

	struct Readback {
		std::unique_ptr<Buffer> buffer;
		uint64_t                tick  = 0;
		uint32_t                build_count = 0;
		std::vector<uint32_t>   build_slots;
		// The TLAS source the preparation walked (user SGPR << 16 | header offset).
		uint32_t                source_key  = 0;
		// The frame of the preparation: the slots its TLAS referenced were used then.
		uint64_t                frame       = 0;
	};

	void CreatePipelines();
	void CreateBuffers();
	void CreateTlas(uint32_t capacity);
	// Creates the slot of a counted BLAS; false when no slot is free.
	bool CreateSlot(const PendingSlot& pending);
	// A slot in the host table for the BLAS at `blas_va` (root GuestBlasRoot), queued for a build;
	// its index, or UINT32_MAX when the table or the slots are full (m_mutex held).
	uint32_t CreateHostSlot(uint64_t blas_va, const SlotSizes& sizes);
	// The slot of the BLAS at `blas_va` with root GuestBlasRoot, or UINT32_MAX (m_mutex held).
	[[nodiscard]] uint32_t FindHostSlotIndex(uint64_t blas_va) const;
	// The sizes of a slot holding `opaque` and `alpha` tested triangles (plus room to grow, none
	// when `exact`: they are the capacities);
	// false when it is implausibly large, its build would not fit in the scratch buffer or it
	// would not fit in the budget (m_budget).
	bool ComputeSlotSizes(uint32_t opaque, uint32_t alpha, SlotSizes& sizes, bool exact = false);
	// Creates the acceleration structure of `slot` and allocates its memory (a grown or moved
	// slot has released its old memory, see RetireResources).
	void AllocateSlot(Slot& slot, const SlotSizes& sizes);
	[[nodiscard]] static uint64_t SlotBytes(const Slot& slot) noexcept;
	// A BLAS that could not be counted or given a slot: its table entry is forgotten so the walk
	// reports it again, a few times (m_mutex held).
	void ReportAgain(uint64_t blas_va, uint32_t root, uint32_t table_index);
	// Moves the acceleration structure and the buffers of `slot` to m_retired.
	// `slot_index` is the index of a slot released for good, UINT32_MAX for a grown slot.
	void RetireResources(Slot& slot, uint32_t slot_index);
	// Destroys what the GPU has finished with and recycles released slot indices.
	void DestroyRetired();
	// Evicts the slots no TLAS referenced lately (a bounded number per call), appending their
	// indices to `evicted`; the GPU side is written by the caller.
	void EvictUnused(std::vector<uint32_t>& evicted);
	// Over the budget, evicts the slots used least recently (same contract as EvictUnused).
	void EvictOverBudget(std::vector<uint32_t>& evicted);
	void EvictSlot(uint32_t index);
	// When the arena holds much more memory than it uses, moves the slots with memory in the
	// least used chunk to new memory (like a grown slot: they are built again), appending their
	// indices to `moved`.
	void Defragment(std::vector<uint32_t>& moved);
	void RecordBuilds(const CommandRecorder& command);
	void ProcessReadback(Readback& readback);

	GraphicContext&   m_graphics;
	CommandScheduler& m_scheduler;
	BufferCache&      m_buffer_cache;
	bool              m_enabled = false;
	bool              m_cleared = false;

	vk::DescriptorSetLayout m_descriptor_layout = nullptr;
	vk::PipelineLayout      m_tlas_layout       = nullptr;
	vk::PipelineLayout      m_blas_layout       = nullptr;
	vk::Pipeline            m_tlas_pipeline     = nullptr;
	vk::Pipeline            m_blas_pipeline     = nullptr;
	vk::PipelineLayout      m_hle_tlas_layout   = nullptr;
	vk::Pipeline            m_hle_tlas_pipeline = nullptr;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_hle_tlas_scratch;
	vk::PipelineLayout      m_hle_refit_layout   = nullptr;
	vk::Pipeline            m_hle_refit_pipeline = nullptr;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_hle_jobs;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_hle_pool;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_hle_state;

	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_state;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_queue;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_instance_nodes;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_instances;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_table;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_slots;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_missing;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_context;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_pool;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_verify_list;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_changed;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_jobs;
	// The layouts of the builds of a preparation (see Slot::layout).
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_layouts;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_build_scratch;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer> m_tlas_storage;
	vk::AccelerationStructureKHR m_tlas         = nullptr;
	vk::DeviceAddress            m_tlas_address = 0;
	uint64_t                     m_tlas_scratch_size = 0;
	uint32_t                     m_tlas_capacity     = 0;
	uint64_t                     m_context_address   = 0;
	Arena                        m_arena;

	std::array<Readback, 32> m_readbacks;
	uint32_t                m_readback_index = 0;

	// Host state the readbacks (deferred host operations) update.
	Common::Mutex             m_mutex;
	std::vector<PendingSlot>  m_new_slots;
	std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Slot>> m_slot_list;
	// The slots of each guest BLAS address, and the HLE refit passes so far.
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint32_t>> m_slots_by_blas;
	uint64_t m_refit_seq = 0;
	std::vector<uint32_t>     m_build_queue;
	std::vector<uint32_t>     m_dynamic;
	// Slots whose builds overflowed: slot, opaque and alpha tested triangles.
	std::vector<std::array<uint32_t, 3>> m_grow;
	// Table entries of BLASes that could not be counted, cleared so the walk reports them again.
	std::vector<uint32_t>     m_retry;
	// Reports of each BLAS (address and root) that could not be counted or given a slot, and the
	// table entry still holding the failed one. Bounded (see MaxRetryKeys).
	struct RetryState {
		uint32_t count       = 0;
		uint32_t table_index = 0;
	};
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, RetryState> m_retries;
	// Table entries of BLASes whose reports failed MaxRetries times, with the preparation they are
	// forgotten at (so the walk reports them again): a guest BLAS that cannot be counted now (the
	// pool was full, its memory was being written) may be countable later.
	std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint32_t>> m_late_retries;
	// Slot indices free for reuse, released slots and resources waiting for the GPU.
	std::vector<uint32_t>     m_free_slots;
	std::deque<Retired>       m_retired;
	// Bytes of the memory in m_retired.
	uint64_t                  m_retired_bytes     = 0;
	// The most the arena allocates, 0 for no limit (KYTY_RT_ARENA_MB, else a share of the VRAM).
	uint64_t                  m_budget            = 0;
	// No defragmentation before this preparation / since this preparation.
	uint64_t                  m_defrag_after      = 0;
	uint64_t                  m_defrag_started    = 0;
	uint64_t                  m_last_scan_prepare = 0;
	// The instance count of the last walk of each TLAS source (shaders trace different TLASes).
	std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> m_last_instance_counts;
	uint32_t                  m_prepare_id          = 0;
	uint64_t                  m_frame               = 0;
	// The host table (see FindHostSlot in rt_tlas_walk.comp): the key of each entry, and the
	// entries to write at the next preparation (index, key, slot + 1).
	std::vector<uint64_t>                                 m_host_keys;
	std::vector<std::tuple<uint32_t, uint64_t, uint32_t>> m_host_table_writes;
	// Slots that got new memory outside a preparation: their infos are written at the next one.
	std::vector<uint32_t>     m_moved_slots;
	// Slots whose layout build did not match: evicted at the next preparation.
	std::vector<uint32_t> m_give_up;

};

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_NATIVERAYTRACING_H_
