```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/occlusionQueries.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/hackNotice.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "gpu_tiler_shaders/occlusion_counters_spv.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/graphicContext.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/regionDefinitions.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/bufferCache.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/streamBuffer.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/commandRecorder.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/commandScheduler.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderContext.h"
#include "kernel/memory.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

namespace {

// Host queries waiting for their results; the title keeps a few dozen per frame in flight.
constexpr uint32_t PoolCapacity = 16384;

// Dumps of one command buffer whose running totals WriteForReaders() computes on the GPU.
constexpr uint32_t MaxGpuDumps = 65536;

constexpr uint64_t PageBits  = 12;
constexpr uint64_t ChunkBits = 6;

[[nodiscard]] size_t PageSlot(uint64_t page, size_t count) {
	return static_cast<size_t>((page ^ (page >> 12u)) % count);
}

// The 64-byte chunks of `page` that [address, address + size) covers.
[[nodiscard]] uint64_t PageChunks(uint64_t page, uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
	const auto page_begin = page << PageBits;
	const auto begin      = std::max(address, page_begin);
	const auto end        = std::min(address + size, page_begin + (uint64_t {1} << PageBits));
	if (begin >= end) {
		return 0;
	}
	const auto first = (begin - page_begin) >> ChunkBits;
	const auto count = ((end - 1u - page_begin) >> ChunkBits) - first + 1u;
	return (count >= 64u ? ~uint64_t {0} : (uint64_t {1} << count) - 1u) << first;
}

// The layouts of occlusion_counters.comp.
struct CounterDump {
	uint32_t first_slot = 0;
	uint32_t slot_count = 0;
	uint32_t uncounted  = 0;
	uint32_t pad        = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(CounterDump) == 16);

struct CounterWrite {
	uint64_t address  = 0;
	uint64_t known    = 0;
	uint32_t dump     = 0;
	uint32_t db_first = 0;
	uint32_t db_end   = 0;
	uint32_t pad      = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(CounterWrite) == 32);

struct CounterPush {
	uint64_t dumps       = 0;
	uint64_t writes      = 0;
	uint64_t results     = 0;
	uint64_t totals      = 0;
	uint64_t base        = 0;
	uint32_t dump_count  = 0;
	uint32_t write_count = 0;
	uint32_t capacity    = 0;
	uint32_t pad         = 0;
};
static_assert(sizeof(CounterPush) == 56);

} // namespace

OcclusionQueries::OcclusionQueries(RenderContext& context)
    : m_context(context), m_device(context.GetGraphics().device), m_segments(PoolCapacity) {
	const auto& graphics = context.GetGraphics();
	if (!graphics.occlusion_queries_enabled) {
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog("Occlusion queries: off (--no-occlusion-queries or no Vulkan "
		                          "hostQueryReset); they read always visible\n");
		return;
	}
	vk::QueryPoolCreateInfo info {};
	info.queryType  = vk::QueryType::eOcclusion;
	info.queryCount = PoolCapacity;
	if (m_device.createQueryPool(&info, nullptr, &m_pool) != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
		m_pool = nullptr;
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog("Occlusion queries: cannot create the query pool; they read "
		                          "always visible\n");
		return;
	}
	SetVulkanObjectNameF(m_device, m_pool, "Kyty.OcclusionQueries");
	m_device.resetQueryPool(m_pool, 0, PoolCapacity);
	if (graphics.occlusion_query_precise_enabled) {
		m_control = vk::QueryControlFlagBits::ePrecise;
	}
	m_results.resize(PoolCapacity);
	m_pending_pages.resize(PendingPageCount);
}

OcclusionQueries::~OcclusionQueries() {
	if (m_counter_pipeline) {
		m_device.destroyPipeline(m_counter_pipeline);
	}
	if (m_counter_layout) {
		m_device.destroyPipelineLayout(m_counter_layout);
	}
	if (m_pool != nullptr) {
		m_device.destroyQueryPool(m_pool, nullptr);
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::BeginQuery(const CommandRecorder& recorder) {
	EXIT_IF(m_query_active || !m_rendering);
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		if (!m_segments.AllocateSlot(m_active_slot)) {
			return;
		}
	}
	recorder.beginQuery(m_pool, m_active_slot, m_control);
	m_query_active = true;
}

void OcclusionQueries::EndQuery(const CommandRecorder& recorder) {
	EXIT_IF(!m_query_active);
	recorder.endQuery(m_pool, m_active_slot);
	m_query_active = false;
}

void OcclusionQueries::OnBeginRendering(const CommandRecorder& recorder) {
	m_rendering = true;
	if (m_pool != nullptr && m_segments.Counting()) {
		BeginQuery(recorder);
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::OnEndRendering(const CommandRecorder& recorder) {
	if (m_query_active) {
		EndQuery(recorder);
	}
	m_rendering = false;
}

void OcclusionQueries::OnFrame() {
	const auto open_before = m_segments.OpenQueries();
	m_segments.OnFrame();
	if (m_segments.OpenQueries() < open_before) {
		Common::HackNotice::Report("occlusion query begin without end dropped after 8 frames",
		                           "OcclusionQueries::OnFrame", 0, 0);
	}
	// The execution thread writes the end-of-pipe labels and flips that pace the guest before
	// the GPU runs the work, so the GPU can fall more than a frame behind them. The title
	// takes the counters of a frame a few frames later, and on the console they are there by
	// then: when a counter of its water was published a flip later than usual, the game drew a
	// frame of the water without reflections and waves. Wait for the GPU to finish the
	// dumps of earlier frames before this frame's flip (it usually already has).
	uint64_t tick = 0;
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		for (const auto& pending: m_pending) {
			if (pending.frame < m_frame) {
				tick = std::max(tick, pending.tick);
			}
		}
	}
	auto& scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	if (tick != 0 && !scheduler.GetMasterSemaphore().IsFree(tick)) {
		scheduler.Wait(tick);
	}
	m_frame++;
	PublishCompleted(true);
}

void OcclusionQueries::PublishCompleted(bool refresh) {
	auto&           master = m_context.GetCommandScheduler().GetMasterSemaphore();
	std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
	while (!m_pending.empty()) {
		if (!master.IsFree(m_pending.front().tick)) {
			if (!refresh) {
				break;
			}
			// Draws do not wait on dumps: the GPU's progress is only queried here.
			master.Refresh();
			refresh = false;
			continue;
		}
		Publish(m_pending.front());
		m_published_seq.store(m_pending.front().seq, std::memory_order_release);
		m_pending.pop_front();
	}
	if (!m_holds.empty()) {
		ReleaseSlots(m_published_slot);
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::OnUnmap(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
	std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
	for (auto& pending: m_pending) {
		if (pending.dump.address < address + size &&
		    address < pending.dump.address + OcclusionCounters::DumpSize) {
			pending.write = false;
		}
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::Dump(CommandScheduler& scheduler, uint64_t address) {
	EXIT_IF(m_pool == nullptr);
	// The counters reach memory in a completion, which cannot read memory back: bytes earlier GPU
	// work wrote under them are read back now, as for a label (see ExecuteReleaseMem()). The
	// readback may end the render pass, and with it the active query, before the code below.
	if (GuestRange {address, OcclusionCounters::DumpSize}.Valid() &&
	    m_context.GetBufferCache().HasGpuDirtyBytes(address, OcclusionCounters::DumpSize)) {
		m_context.PrepareGpuWrite(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(address), OcclusionCounters::DumpSize);
	}
	auto&      buffer   = scheduler.Current();
	const auto recorder = buffer.Handle();
	if (m_query_active) {
		EndQuery(recorder);
	}
	const auto tick = scheduler.CurrentTick();
	const auto seq  = ++m_dump_seq;
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		m_pending.push_back(
		    {.dump = m_segments.OnDump(address), .tick = tick, .frame = m_frame, .seq = seq});
	}
	NotePendingPages(address, seq);
	// The GPU writes the counters when it gets past the dump. Queued now, the completion runs
	// before those of any later operation: a guest that learns the GPU finished this work (a
	// suspend point, a flip) finds them in memory, as on the console. One completion per command
	// buffer publishes all of its dumps (ASTRO BOT dumps ~10,000 times a frame, one per object):
	// a completion per dump made the execution thread queue and track 10,000 operations a frame.
	// An unmap of counters a later dump of the command buffer wrote does not wait for it: the
	// unmap drops their publication instead (OnUnmap()).
	if (tick != m_completion_tick) {
		m_completion_tick = tick;
		scheduler.DeferPriorityOperation([this] { PublishCompleted(true); }, address,
		                                 OcclusionCounters::DumpSize);
	}
	PublishCompleted(false);
	if (m_segments.Counting() && buffer.IsRendering()) {
		EXIT_IF(!m_rendering);
		BeginQuery(recorder);
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::ResetSlots(uint64_t first_slot, uint64_t end_slot) {
	const auto capacity = m_segments.Capacity();
	while (first_slot < end_slot) {
		const auto slot  = static_cast<uint32_t>(first_slot % capacity);
		const auto count = static_cast<uint32_t>(
		    std::min<uint64_t>(end_slot - first_slot, uint64_t {capacity} - slot));
		m_device.resetQueryPool(m_pool, slot, count);
		first_slot += count;
	}
}

uint64_t OcclusionQueries::ReadSamples(uint64_t first_slot, uint64_t end_slot) {
	const auto capacity = m_segments.Capacity();
	uint64_t   samples  = 0;
	while (first_slot < end_slot) {
		const auto slot  = static_cast<uint32_t>(first_slot % capacity);
		const auto count = static_cast<uint32_t>(
		    std::min<uint64_t>(end_slot - first_slot, uint64_t {capacity} - slot));
		// The command buffers that ended these queries completed: nothing waits here.
		const auto result = m_device.getQueryPoolResults(
		    m_pool, slot, count, count * sizeof(uint64_t), m_results.data(), sizeof(uint64_t),
		    vk::QueryResultFlagBits::e64 | vk::QueryResultFlagBits::eWait);
		if (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
			Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format(
			    "Occlusion queries: vkGetQueryPoolResults failed ({}); the query reads visible\n",
			    vk::to_string(result)));
			samples += OcclusionCounters::UncountedSamples;
		} else {
			for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
				samples += m_results[i];
			}
		}
		first_slot += count;
	}
	return samples;
}

void OcclusionQueries::Publish(const PendingDump& pending) {
	const auto& dump = pending.dump;
	m_total += ReadSamples(dump.first_slot, dump.end_slot);
	if (dump.uncounted) {
		Common::HackNotice::Report("occlusion segment without a free host query slot reads visible",
		                           "OcclusionQueries::Publish", 0, 0);
		m_total += OcclusionCounters::UncountedSamples;
	}
	ReleaseSlots(dump.end_slot);
	if (!pending.write) {
		return;
	}
	// DB 0 last: once its ready bit is visible, the other DBs are too. Dump() read back the
	// GPU-written bytes under the counters; later GPU work may own the pages again.
	for (uint32_t db = OcclusionCounters::DbCount; db-- > 0;) {
		const auto value = OcclusionCounters::DbValue(db, m_total);
		m_context.WriteFromCompletion(
		    reinterpret_cast<void*>(dump.address + db * OcclusionCounters::DbStride), &value,
		    sizeof(value));
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::ReleaseSlots(uint64_t end_slot) {
	m_published_slot = std::max(m_published_slot, end_slot);
	auto        end    = m_published_slot;
	const auto& master = m_context.GetCommandScheduler().GetMasterSemaphore();
	while (!m_holds.empty() && master.IsFree(m_holds.front().tick)) {
		m_holds.pop_front();
	}
	if (!m_holds.empty()) {
		end = std::min(end, m_holds.front().slot);
	}
	if (end > m_reset_slot) {
		ResetSlots(m_reset_slot, end);
		m_segments.Release(end);
		m_reset_slot = end;
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::NotePendingPages(uint64_t address, uint64_t seq) {
	const auto published = m_published_seq.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
	const auto end       = address + OcclusionCounters::DumpSize;
	if (published + 1u >= seq) {
		// The only unpublished dump.
		m_pending_low  = address;
		m_pending_high = end;
	} else {
		m_pending_low  = std::min(m_pending_low, address);
		m_pending_high = std::max(m_pending_high, end);
	}
	for (auto page = address >> PageBits; page <= (end - 1u) >> PageBits; page++) {
		auto& entry = m_pending_pages[PageSlot(page, m_pending_pages.size())];
		if (entry.page != page) {
			if (entry.last_seq > published) {
				m_evicted_seq = std::max(m_evicted_seq, entry.last_seq);
			}
			entry = {.page = page};
		}
		if (entry.last_seq <= published) {
			entry.chunks = 0;
		}
		entry.last_seq = seq;
		entry.chunks |= PageChunks(page, address, OcclusionCounters::DumpSize);
	}
}

bool OcclusionQueries::MayReadPendingDump(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) const {
	const auto published = m_published_seq.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
	if (m_dump_seq <= published || size == 0 || address >= m_pending_high ||
	    address + size <= m_pending_low) {
		return false;
	}
	if (m_evicted_seq > published) {
		return true;
	}
	const auto first = address >> PageBits;
	const auto last  = (address + size - 1u) >> PageBits;
	if (last - first >= m_pending_pages.size()) {
		return true;
	}
	for (auto page = first; page <= last; page++) {
		const auto& entry = m_pending_pages[PageSlot(page, m_pending_pages.size())];
		if (entry.page == page && entry.last_seq > published &&
		    (entry.chunks & PageChunks(page, address, size)) != 0) {
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

void OcclusionQueries::WaitAndPublish(uint64_t tick) {
	auto& scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	if (!scheduler.GetMasterSemaphore().IsFree(tick)) {
		scheduler.Wait(tick);
	}
	PublishCompleted(true);
}

bool OcclusionQueries::PrepareRead(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
	if (m_pool == nullptr || !MayReadPendingDump(address, size)) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto first_dump = m_read_dumps.size();
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		for (const auto& pending: m_pending) {
			const auto dump_address = pending.dump.address;
			if (pending.write && dump_address < address + size &&
			    address < dump_address + OcclusionCounters::DumpSize) {
				m_read_dumps.push_back({dump_address, pending.seq});
			}
		}
	}
	if (m_read_dumps.size() == first_dump) {
		return false;
	}
	m_read_targets.push_back({.address    = address,
	                          .size       = size,
	                          .first_dump = first_dump,
	                          .end_dump   = m_read_dumps.size()});
	return true;
}

void OcclusionQueries::NoteReadTarget(uint64_t address, uint64_t size, const Buffer& buffer,
                                      uint64_t offset) {
	EXIT_IF(m_read_targets.empty());
	auto& target = m_read_targets.back();
	EXIT_IF(target.address != address || target.size != size || target.device_address != 0);
	const auto device_address = buffer.BufferDeviceAddress();
	// The shader stores dwords: the copy keeps the guest's dword alignment, which a stream copy of
	// an unaligned range does not.
	if (device_address == 0 || ((device_address + offset - address) & 3u) != 0) {
		Common::HackNotice::Report("occlusion counters read through an unaligned copy keep its bytes",
		                           "OcclusionQueries::NoteReadTarget", 0, address);
		m_read_dumps.resize(target.first_dump);
		m_read_targets.pop_back();
		return;
	}
	target.device_address = device_address + offset;
}

void OcclusionQueries::WaitForCounters(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
	if (m_pool == nullptr || !MayReadPendingDump(address, size)) {
		return;
	}
	uint64_t tick = 0;
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		for (const auto& pending: m_pending) {
			if (pending.dump.address < address + size &&
			    address < pending.dump.address + OcclusionCounters::DumpSize) {
				tick = std::max(tick, pending.tick);
			}
		}
	}
	if (tick != 0) {
		WaitAndPublish(tick);
	}
}

void OcclusionQueries::CreateCounterPipeline() {
	auto&       graphics = m_context.GetGraphics();
	auto&       scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	const auto  flags    = AllFlags | vk::BufferUsageFlagBits::eShaderDeviceAddress;
	m_slot_results = std::make_unique<Buffer>(graphics, scheduler, MemoryUsage::DeviceLocal, 0, flags,
	                                          uint64_t {PoolCapacity} * sizeof(uint64_t));
	m_totals       = std::make_unique<Buffer>(graphics, scheduler, MemoryUsage::DeviceLocal, 0, flags,
	                                          uint64_t {MaxGpuDumps} * sizeof(uint64_t));
	const vk::PushConstantRange  push {vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(CounterPush)};
	vk::PipelineLayoutCreateInfo layout_info {};
	layout_info.pushConstantRangeCount = 1;
	layout_info.pPushConstantRanges    = &push;
	RequireVulkanSuccess(m_device.createPipelineLayout(&layout_info, nullptr, &m_counter_layout),
	                     "create occlusion counter pipeline layout");
	const auto                        module = CompileSPV(OCCLUSION_COUNTERS_SPV, m_device);
	vk::PipelineShaderStageCreateInfo stage {};
	stage.stage  = vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute;
	stage.module = module;
	stage.pName  = "main";
	vk::ComputePipelineCreateInfo pipeline_info {};
	pipeline_info.stage  = stage;
	pipeline_info.layout = m_counter_layout;
	const auto result =
	    m_device.createComputePipelines(nullptr, 1, &pipeline_info, nullptr, &m_counter_pipeline);
	m_device.destroyShaderModule(module, nullptr);
	RequireVulkanSuccess(result, "create occlusion counter pipeline");
	SetVulkanObjectNameF(m_device, m_counter_pipeline, "Kyty.OcclusionCounters");
}

void OcclusionQueries::WriteForReaders() {
	if (m_read_targets.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	auto&    scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	uint64_t last_seq  = 0;
	for (const auto& target: m_read_targets) {
		if (target.device_address != 0) {
			for (size_t i = target.first_dump; i < target.end_dump; i++) {
				last_seq = std::max(last_seq, m_read_dumps[i].seq);
			}
		}
	}
	// The running total after each unpublished dump up to the last one read: the total of the
	// published ones plus the results of the host queries of each segment, which the GPU copies
	// once it has them. Their slots are reset only after it did (ReleaseSlots()).
	std::vector<CounterDump> dumps;
	std::vector<CounterWrite> writes;
	uint64_t                  base       = 0;
	uint64_t                  first_seq  = 0;
	uint64_t                  first_slot = 0;
	uint64_t                  end_slot   = 0;
	uint64_t                  wait_tick  = 0;
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		if (!m_pending.empty() && m_pending.front().seq <= last_seq) {
			const auto count = static_cast<size_t>(last_seq - m_pending.front().seq + 1u);
			if (count > MaxGpuDumps) {
				wait_tick = m_pending[count - 1u].tick;
			} else {
				base       = m_total;
				first_seq  = m_pending.front().seq;
				first_slot = m_pending.front().dump.first_slot;
				end_slot   = m_pending[count - 1u].dump.end_slot;
				dumps.reserve(count);
				for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
					const auto& dump = m_pending[i].dump;
					dumps.push_back(
					    {.first_slot = static_cast<uint32_t>(dump.first_slot % PoolCapacity),
					     .slot_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(dump.end_slot - dump.first_slot),
					     .uncounted  = dump.uncounted ? 1u : 0u});
				}
				// The first slot of the holds only grows: the front one bounds the release.
				const auto tick = scheduler.CurrentTick();
				if (m_holds.empty() || m_holds.back().tick != tick) {
					m_holds.push_back({.tick = tick, .slot = first_slot});
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if (wait_tick != 0) {
		// More dumps than the GPU side keeps totals for: their counters come from memory.
		WaitAndPublish(wait_tick);
	}
	for (const auto& target: m_read_targets) {
		if (target.device_address == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto target_end = target.address + target.size;
		for (size_t i = target.first_dump; i < target.end_dump; i++) {
			const auto& read = m_read_dumps[i];
			// The DBs whose counter lies inside the range.
			const uint64_t db_first =
			    read.address >= target.address
			        ? 0
			        : (target.address - read.address + OcclusionCounters::DbStride - 1u) /
			              OcclusionCounters::DbStride;
			const uint64_t db_end =
			    target_end < read.address + sizeof(uint64_t)
			        ? 0
			        : std::min<uint64_t>(OcclusionCounters::DbCount,
			                             (target_end - read.address - sizeof(uint64_t)) /
			                                     OcclusionCounters::DbStride +
			                                 1u);
			if (db_first >= db_end) {
				continue;
			}
			CounterWrite write {.address  = target.device_address + (read.address - target.address),
			                    .db_first = static_cast<uint32_t>(db_first),
			                    .db_end   = static_cast<uint32_t>(db_end)};
			if (first_seq != 0 && read.seq >= first_seq && read.seq - first_seq < dumps.size()) {
				write.dump = static_cast<uint32_t>(read.seq - first_seq);
			} else {
				// Published since PrepareRead(): DB 0 in memory holds its total.
				uint64_t value = 0;
				if (!LibKernel::Memory::TryReadBacking(read.address, &value, sizeof(value)) ||
				    (value & OcclusionCounters::ReadyBit) == 0) {
					Common::HackNotice::Report(
					    "occlusion counters of a copy keep its bytes while DB 0 is unread or not ready",
					    "OcclusionQueries::WriteForReaders", 0, read.address);
					continue;
				}
				write.known = value & OcclusionCounters::ValueMask;
				write.dump  = UINT32_MAX;
			}
			writes.push_back(write);
		}
	}
	DropReadTargets();
	if (writes.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	if (!m_counter_pipeline) {
		CreateCounterPipeline();
	}
	auto& command = scheduler.Current();
	command.EndRendering();
	const auto native = command.Handle();
	const bool gpu_totals = std::ranges::any_of(writes, [](const CounterWrite& write) {
		return write.dump != UINT32_MAX;
	});
	if (gpu_totals && end_slot > first_slot) {
		// The previous dispatch reads the results this copy replaces.
		vk::MemoryBarrier before {};
		before.srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead;
		before.dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eTransferWrite;
		native.pipelineBarrier(vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eComputeShader,
		                       vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTransfer, {}, 1, &before, 0, nullptr, 0,
		                       nullptr);
		// The queries ended earlier in the stream; the copy waits for their results on the GPU.
		const auto slot  = static_cast<uint32_t>(first_slot % PoolCapacity);
		const auto count = static_cast<uint32_t>(end_slot - first_slot);
		const auto head  = std::min(count, PoolCapacity - slot);
		const auto flags = vk::QueryResultFlagBits::e64 | vk::QueryResultFlagBits::eWait;
		native.copyQueryPoolResults(m_pool, slot, head, m_slot_results->Handle(),
		                            uint64_t {slot} * sizeof(uint64_t), sizeof(uint64_t), flags);
		if (count > head) {
			native.copyQueryPoolResults(m_pool, 0, count - head, m_slot_results->Handle(), 0,
			                            sizeof(uint64_t), flags);
		}
	}
	auto&      cache  = m_context.GetBufferCache();
	auto&      stream = cache.GetUtilityBuffer(MemoryUsage::Stream);
	const auto dumps_offset =
	    dumps.empty() ? 0 : cache.StreamUpload(dumps.data(), dumps.size() * sizeof(CounterDump), 16);
	const auto writes_offset =
	    cache.StreamUpload(writes.data(), writes.size() * sizeof(CounterWrite), 16);
	const CounterPush push {.dumps       = stream.BufferDeviceAddress() + dumps_offset,
	                        .writes      = stream.BufferDeviceAddress() + writes_offset,
	                        .results     = m_slot_results->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	                        .totals      = m_totals->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	                        .base        = base,
	                        .dump_count  = gpu_totals ? static_cast<uint32_t>(dumps.size()) : 0u,
	                        .write_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(writes.size()),
	                        .capacity    = PoolCapacity};
	// The copies were just uploaded or written by earlier work; the queries' results were copied.
	vk::MemoryBarrier before {};
	before.srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryWrite;
	before.dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite;
	native.pipelineBarrier(vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eAllCommands,
	                       vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eComputeShader, {}, 1, &before, 0, nullptr, 0,
	                       nullptr);
	native.bindPipeline(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_counter_pipeline);
	native.pushConstants(m_counter_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0, sizeof(push),
	                     &push);
	native.dispatch(1, 1, 1);
	vk::MemoryBarrier after {};
	after.srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite;
	after.dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryWrite;
	native.pipelineBarrier(vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eComputeShader,
	                       vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eAllCommands, {}, 1, &after, 0, nullptr, 0,
	                       nullptr);
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/occlusionQueries.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_OCCLUSIONQUERIES_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_OCCLUSIONQUERIES_H_

#include "common/common.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

class Buffer;
class CommandRecorder;
class CommandScheduler;
class RenderContext;

// The guest's occlusion counters. A ZPASS_DONE event dumps the sample counter of each of the 16
// DBs to address + db * 16, setting bit 63 once the value is there; a query is the difference of a
// dump at A (begin) and one at A + 8 (end), summed over the DBs.
namespace OcclusionCounters {

constexpr uint32_t DbCount  = 16;
constexpr uint64_t DbStride = 16;
// Bytes a dump may write.
constexpr uint64_t DumpSize  = (DbCount - 1u) * DbStride + sizeof(uint64_t);
constexpr uint64_t ReadyBit  = uint64_t {1} << 63u;
constexpr uint64_t ValueMask = ReadyBit - 1u;
// Added to a segment whose samples could not all be counted, so its queries read visible.
constexpr uint64_t UncountedSamples = uint64_t {1} << 24u;

// The value a dump writes for one DB: the whole count lives in DB 0, the others stay at zero.
[[nodiscard]] constexpr uint64_t DbValue(uint32_t db, uint64_t total) {
	return ReadyBit | (db == 0 ? (total & ValueMask) : 0u);
}

// Splits the stream of draws into segments at every dump. The samples of a segment are counted
// by host queries only while a guest query is open (a begin dump at A without the end dump at
// A + 8); the value published for a dump is the running total of every earlier segment, so any
// begin/end pairing (also nested or interleaved queries) reads the samples between its dumps.
class Segments {
public:
	struct Dump {
		uint64_t address    = 0;
		uint64_t first_slot = 0; // Host query slots of the segment the dump ends, [first, end).
		uint64_t end_slot   = 0;
		bool     uncounted  = false; // Some samples of the segment had no host query.
	};

	// `capacity`: slots of the host query pool; `max_open_frames`: frames after which a begin
	// dump that never saw its end stops keeping the counters running.
	explicit Segments(uint32_t capacity, uint32_t max_open_frames = 8)
	    : m_capacity(capacity), m_max_open_frames(max_open_frames) {}

	[[nodiscard]] Dump OnDump(uint64_t address) {
		Dump dump {.address    = address,
		           .first_slot = m_segment_first,
		           .end_slot   = m_next_slot,
		           .uncounted  = m_uncounted};
		m_segment_first  = m_next_slot;
		m_uncounted      = false;
		const auto begin = std::find_if(m_open.begin(), m_open.end(), [&](const Open& open) {
			return open.address + sizeof(uint64_t) == address;
		});
		if (begin != m_open.end()) {
			m_open.erase(begin);
		} else {
			m_open.push_back({address, m_frame});
		}
		return dump;
	}

	// Whether the samples of draws are needed now.
	[[nodiscard]] bool Counting() const noexcept { return !m_open.empty(); }

	// A slot for a host query of the current segment; false when every slot waits for its
	// results, and then the segment reads visible.
	[[nodiscard]] bool AllocateSlot(uint32_t& slot) {
		if (m_next_slot - m_released >= m_capacity) {
			m_uncounted = true;
			return false;
		}
		slot = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_next_slot % m_capacity);
		m_next_slot++;
		return true;
	}

	// Slots before `end_slot` are free again.
	void Release(uint64_t end_slot) { m_released = std::max(m_released, end_slot); }

	void OnFrame() {
		m_frame++;
		std::erase_if(
		    m_open, [this](const Open& open) { return open.frame + m_max_open_frames < m_frame; });
	}

	[[nodiscard]] uint32_t Capacity() const noexcept { return m_capacity; }
	[[nodiscard]] size_t   OpenQueries() const noexcept { return m_open.size(); }

private:
	struct Open {
		uint64_t address = 0;
		uint64_t frame   = 0;
	};

	uint32_t          m_capacity        = 0;
	uint32_t          m_max_open_frames = 0;
	uint64_t          m_next_slot       = 0;
	uint64_t          m_released        = 0;
	uint64_t          m_segment_first   = 0;
	uint64_t          m_frame           = 0;
	bool              m_uncounted       = false;
	std::vector<Open> m_open;
};

} // namespace OcclusionCounters

// Host occlusion queries behind the guest's ZPASS_DONE counters. Queries and dumps are recorded
// on the GPU execution thread, in operation order: Vulkan occlusion queries are active only inside
// render pass instances (they never split one). As on the console, a dump's counters reach guest
// memory when the GPU finishes the work before it: a priority completion queued with the dump
// writes them, in dump order and ahead of any later completion that tells the guest the GPU got
// there (a suspend point, a flip). The execution thread also publishes the dumps it finds
// finished, and at a flip, while the GPU is more than a frame behind, waits for it: the counters
// of a frame reach guest memory by the next frame's flip. GPU work that reads the counters later
// in the stream does not wait for that: the copy of memory it reads gets them on the GPU, from
// the host query results, right before it runs (see PrepareRead()).
class OcclusionQueries {
public:
	explicit OcclusionQueries(RenderContext& context);
	~OcclusionQueries();
	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(OcclusionQueries);

	// Whether host queries back the counters (the device supports hostQueryReset); otherwise a
	// dump publishes a count that always reads visible.
	[[nodiscard]] bool Enabled() const noexcept { return m_pool != nullptr; }

	// A ZPASS_DONE dump to `address` (8-byte aligned), in the command buffer being recorded.
	void Dump(CommandScheduler& scheduler, uint64_t address);
	// Called by the command buffer right after it began and before it ends a render pass instance.
	void OnBeginRendering(const CommandRecorder& recorder);
	void OnEndRendering(const CommandRecorder& recorder);
	// Once per guest frame, before its flip: publishes the dumps the GPU finished and those of
	// earlier frames.
	void OnFrame();
	// Publishes the dumps of command buffers the GPU finished; `refresh` queries the GPU's
	// progress first (a driver call). Any thread.
	void PublishCompleted(bool refresh);
	// The guest unmaps [address, address + size): pending dumps there are not written.
	void OnUnmap(uint64_t address, uint64_t size);
	// Whether a dump waits for the GPU before its counters reach guest memory.
	[[nodiscard]] bool HasPendingDumps() const {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		return !m_pending.empty();
	}
	// Whether the samples of the draws recorded now reach a guest occlusion counter.
	[[nodiscard]] bool Counting() const noexcept { return Enabled() && m_segments.Counting(); }

	// GPU work reads guest memory after earlier dumps there, as on the console, where a dump's
	// counters are in memory before later work of the stream runs. Execution thread, for each
	// range the operation being prepared reads, before its copy of the range is obtained: true
	// when dumps the GPU may not have finished are under it, and then NoteReadTarget() gives the
	// copy the operation reads, which WriteForReaders() fills before the operation's commands.
	[[nodiscard]] bool PrepareRead(uint64_t address, uint64_t size);
	void               NoteReadTarget(uint64_t address, uint64_t size, const Buffer& buffer,
	                                  uint64_t offset);
	void               WriteForReaders();
	// A new operation: copies noted for an operation that recorded no commands are dropped.
	void DropReadTargets() noexcept {
		m_read_targets.clear();
		m_read_dumps.clear();
	}
	// A read whose copy cannot be filled on the GPU (a CP DMA source): waits for the GPU to get past
	// the dumps under [address, address + size) and publishes them.
	void WaitForCounters(uint64_t address, uint64_t size);

private:
	void BeginQuery(const CommandRecorder& recorder);
	void EndQuery(const CommandRecorder& recorder);
	struct PendingDump {
		OcclusionCounters::Segments::Dump dump;
		uint64_t                          tick  = 0;
		uint64_t                          frame = 0;
		uint64_t                          seq   = 0;
		bool                              write = true;
	};
	// Pages with dumps the GPU may not have finished, for a cheap first look at every read. An
	// entry stays valid until the dumps up to `last_seq` are published; `chunks` marks the 64-byte
	// chunks of the page that those dumps write.
	struct PendingPage {
		uint64_t page     = UINT64_MAX;
		uint64_t last_seq = 0;
		uint64_t chunks   = 0;
	};
	static constexpr size_t PendingPageCount = 4096;
	struct ReadDump {
		uint64_t address = 0;
		uint64_t seq     = 0;
	};
	struct ReadTarget {
		uint64_t address        = 0;
		uint64_t size           = 0;
		uint64_t device_address = 0;
		size_t   first_dump     = 0;
		size_t   end_dump       = 0;
	};

	void                   Publish(const PendingDump& pending);
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t ReadSamples(uint64_t first_slot, uint64_t end_slot);
	void                   ResetSlots(uint64_t first_slot, uint64_t end_slot);
	// Resets and frees the slots of published dumps before `end_slot`, except those a command
	// buffer the GPU has not finished copies the results of.
	void                   ReleaseSlots(uint64_t end_slot);
	void                   NotePendingPages(uint64_t address, uint64_t seq);
	[[nodiscard]] bool     MayReadPendingDump(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) const;
	// Waits for the GPU to finish `tick` and publishes what it finished.
	void                   WaitAndPublish(uint64_t tick);
	void                   CreateCounterPipeline();

	RenderContext&              m_context;
	vk::Device                  m_device = nullptr;
	vk::QueryPool               m_pool   = nullptr;
	vk::QueryControlFlags       m_control;
	bool                        m_rendering    = false;
	bool                        m_query_active = false;
	uint32_t                    m_active_slot  = 0;
	uint64_t                    m_frame        = 0;
	// The execution thread records dumps and the priority completions publish them: the pending
	// dumps, the running total, the result scratch and the slots published dumps release.
	mutable std::mutex          m_mutex;
	OcclusionCounters::Segments m_segments;
	uint64_t                    m_total = 0;
	// Tick of the command buffer whose completion publishes the dumps recorded into it.
	uint64_t                    m_completion_tick = 0;
	std::deque<PendingDump>     m_pending;
	std::vector<uint64_t>       m_results;
	// Slots of published dumps end at m_published_slot, reset ones at m_reset_slot. A hold keeps
	// the slots from `slot` on until the GPU finishes `tick`, whose command buffer copies their
	// results (WriteForReaders()).
	struct SlotHold {
		uint64_t tick = 0;
		uint64_t slot = 0;
	};
	uint64_t                    m_published_slot = 0;
	uint64_t                    m_reset_slot     = 0;
	std::deque<SlotHold>        m_holds;
	// Sequence number of the last dump (execution thread) and of the last one published.
	uint64_t                    m_dump_seq = 0;
	std::atomic<uint64_t>       m_published_seq {0};
	// Execution thread: pages of unpublished dumps, and the newest dump whose page entry another
	// page took (until it is published every read takes the exact look).
	std::vector<PendingPage>    m_pending_pages;
	uint64_t                    m_evicted_seq = 0;
	// Execution thread: bounds of the dumps recorded since all earlier ones were published.
	uint64_t                    m_pending_low  = 0;
	uint64_t                    m_pending_high = 0;
	// Execution thread: the copies the operation being prepared reads under dumps of the command
	// buffer being recorded, and those dumps.
	std::vector<ReadTarget>     m_read_targets;
	std::vector<ReadDump>       m_read_dumps;
	// GPU side of WriteForReaders(): the host query results by slot and the running totals.
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer>     m_slot_results;
	std::unique_ptr<Buffer>     m_totals;
	vk::PipelineLayout          m_counter_layout   = nullptr;
	vk::Pipeline                m_counter_pipeline = nullptr;
};

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_OCCLUSIONQUERIES_H_
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/blendMapping.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/blendMapping.h"

#include "graphics/guest_gpu/hardwareContext.h"

#include <initializer_list>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

bool BlendFactorIsDualSource(uint8_t factor) {
	return factor >= static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kSrc1Color) &&
	       factor <= static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusSrc1Alpha);
}

namespace {

bool BlendFactorIsConstantColor(uint8_t factor) {
	return factor == static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kConstantColor) ||
	       factor == static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusConstantColor);
}

} // namespace

BlendMappingSupport ClassifyBlendMapping(const HW::BlendControl&                blend,
                                         const Prospero::ColorComponentMapping& mapping) {
	// Color constants are not swizzled with the exports; scalar constant alpha is unaffected.
	if (!mapping.IsIdentity() && (BlendFactorIsConstantColor(blend.color_srcblend) ||
	                              BlendFactorIsConstantColor(blend.color_destblend))) {
		return BlendMappingSupport::Unsupported;
	}
	if (mapping.Map(3) == 3u) {
		return BlendMappingSupport::Direct;
	}
	if (blend.separate_alpha_blend &&
	    blend.color_srcblend == static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kSrcAlpha) &&
	    blend.color_destblend == static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusSrcAlpha) &&
	    blend.alpha_destblend == blend.color_destblend &&
	    blend.color_comb_fcn == static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendOp::kAdd) &&
	    blend.alpha_comb_fcn == blend.color_comb_fcn) {
		switch (static_cast<Prospero::BlendFactor>(blend.alpha_srcblend)) {
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kZero: return BlendMappingSupport::SourceAlphaZero;
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kOne: return BlendMappingSupport::SourceAlphaOne;
			default: break;
		}
	}
	// Moving alpha requires the same equation for all channels.
	if (blend.separate_alpha_blend && (blend.alpha_srcblend != blend.color_srcblend ||
	                                   blend.alpha_destblend != blend.color_destblend ||
	                                   blend.alpha_comb_fcn != blend.color_comb_fcn)) {
		return BlendMappingSupport::Unsupported;
	}
	auto support = BlendMappingSupport::Direct;
	for (const auto factor: {blend.color_srcblend, blend.color_destblend}) {
		if (BlendFactorIsDualSource(factor)) {
			return BlendMappingSupport::Unsupported;
		}
		switch (static_cast<Prospero::BlendFactor>(factor)) {
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kSrcAlpha:
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusSrcAlpha:
				support = BlendMappingSupport::SourceAlpha;
				break;
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kDstAlpha:
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusDstAlpha:
			case Prospero::BlendFactor::kSrcAlphaSaturate: return BlendMappingSupport::Unsupported;
			default: break;
		}
	}
	return support;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/descriptorHeap.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/descriptorHeap.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/profiler.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/graphicContext.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/masterSemaphore.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

namespace Libs::Graphics {
namespace {

constexpr uint32_t   DescriptorHeapCount = 1024;
constexpr std::array DescriptorPoolSizes = {
    vk::DescriptorPoolSize {vk::DescriptorType::eStorageBuffer, 8192},
    vk::DescriptorPoolSize {vk::DescriptorType::eUniformBuffer, 4096},
    vk::DescriptorPoolSize {vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage, DescriptorHeap::MaxSampledImages},
    vk::DescriptorPoolSize {vk::DescriptorType::eStorageImage, 1024},
    vk::DescriptorPoolSize {vk::DescriptorType::eSampler, 1024},
};

// Sets of a layout that does not fit a default pool that its own pool holds.
constexpr uint32_t LargeSetsPerPool = 4;

std::mutex                                                                       g_layout_mutex;
std::unordered_map<vk::DescriptorSetLayout, std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize>> g_layout_sizes;

vk::DescriptorPoolSize* FindSize(std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize>& sizes,
                                 vk::DescriptorType                   type) {
	const auto size = std::find_if(sizes.begin(), sizes.end(),
	                               [&](const auto& size) { return size.type == type; });
	return size == sizes.end() ? nullptr : &*size;
}

// The default pool sizes, raised to hold LargeSetsPerPool sets of the layout.
std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize> LargePoolSizes(std::span<const vk::DescriptorPoolSize> layout) {
	std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize> sizes(DescriptorPoolSizes.begin(),
	                                          DescriptorPoolSizes.end());
	for (const auto& needed: layout) {
		const auto count = needed.descriptorCount * LargeSetsPerPool;
		if (auto* size = FindSize(sizes, needed.type); size != nullptr) {
			size->descriptorCount = std::max(size->descriptorCount, count);
		} else {
			sizes.push_back({needed.type, count});
		}
	}
	return sizes;
}

} // namespace

void DescriptorHeap::RegisterLayout(vk::DescriptorSetLayout                         layout,
                                    std::span<const vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBinding> bindings) {
	std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize> sizes;
	for (const auto& binding: bindings) {
		if (binding.descriptorCount == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		if (auto* size = FindSize(sizes, binding.descriptorType); size != nullptr) {
			size->descriptorCount += binding.descriptorCount;
		} else {
			sizes.push_back({binding.descriptorType, binding.descriptorCount});
		}
	}
	std::lock_guard lock(g_layout_mutex);
	g_layout_sizes[layout] = std::move(sizes);
}

DescriptorHeap::DescriptorHeap(GraphicContext& graphics, MasterSemaphore& master_semaphore)
    : m_graphics(graphics), m_master_semaphore(master_semaphore) {
	CreateDescriptorPool(DescriptorPoolSizes);
}

DescriptorHeap::~DescriptorHeap() {
	m_graphics.device.destroyDescriptorPool(m_current_pool.pool, nullptr);
	for (const auto& [pool, tick]: m_pending_pools) {
		m_master_semaphore.Wait(tick);
		m_graphics.device.destroyDescriptorPool(pool.pool, nullptr);
	}
}

vk::DescriptorSet DescriptorHeap::Commit(vk::DescriptorSetLayout layout) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	auto& batch = m_sets[layout];
	if (batch.size != 0) {
		return batch.sets[--batch.size];
	}
	if (Allocate(layout, batch)) {
		return batch.sets[--batch.size];
	}

	RetireCurrentPool();
	if (!m_master_semaphore.IsFree(m_pending_pools.front().second)) {
		m_master_semaphore.Refresh();
	}
	if (m_master_semaphore.IsFree(m_pending_pools.front().second)) {
		auto pool = std::move(m_pending_pools.front().first);
		m_pending_pools.pop_front();
		EXIT_IF(m_graphics.device.resetDescriptorPool(pool.pool, {}) != vk::Result::eSuccess);
		UsePool(std::move(pool));
	} else {
		CreateDescriptorPool(DescriptorPoolSizes);
	}

	m_sets.clear();
	auto& fresh_batch = m_sets[layout];
	if (Allocate(layout, fresh_batch)) {
		return fresh_batch.sets[--fresh_batch.size];
	}

	// The set has more descriptors of a type than an empty default pool holds (drivers such as
	// AMD's enforce the pool sizes): give it a pool that also holds a few of its sets.
	const auto sizes = LargePoolSizes(LayoutSizes(layout));
	RetireCurrentPool();
	CreateDescriptorPool(sizes);
	m_sets.clear();
	auto& large_batch = m_sets[layout];
	if (!Allocate(layout, large_batch)) {
		std::string counts;
		for (const auto& size: sizes) {
			counts += " " + vk::to_string(size.type) + "=" + std::to_string(size.descriptorCount);
		}
		EXIT("descriptor set does not fit a pool sized for it:%s\n", counts.c_str());
	}
	return large_batch.sets[--large_batch.size];
}

const std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize>&
DescriptorHeap::LayoutSizes(vk::DescriptorSetLayout layout) {
	auto found = m_layout_sizes.find(layout);
	if (found == m_layout_sizes.end()) {
		std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize> sizes;
		{
			std::lock_guard lock(g_layout_mutex);
			if (const auto registered = g_layout_sizes.find(layout);
			    registered != g_layout_sizes.end()) {
				sizes = registered->second;
			}
		}
		found = m_layout_sizes.emplace(layout, std::move(sizes)).first;
	}
	return found->second;
}

void DescriptorHeap::RetireCurrentPool() {
	m_pending_pools.emplace_back(std::move(m_current_pool), m_master_semaphore.CurrentTick());
	m_current_pool = {};
}

bool DescriptorHeap::Allocate(vk::DescriptorSetLayout layout, Batch& batch) {
	// Ask only for the sets that the pool has room for: a failed allocation can keep the room of
	// the sets it did create (AMD's driver does), so asking an empty default pool for 32 sets of
	// The title's bindless ray tracing table (20000-41000 sampled images each) left it unable to hold
	// even one.
	const auto& needs = LayoutSizes(layout);
	uint32_t    count = std::min(DescriptorSetBatch, m_free_sets);
	for (const auto& needed: needs) {
		const auto* free = FindSize(m_free, needed.type);
		count =
		    std::min(count, free == nullptr ? 0 : free->descriptorCount / needed.descriptorCount);
	}
	if (count == 0) {
		return false;
	}

	std::array<vk::DescriptorSetLayout, DescriptorSetBatch> layouts;
	layouts.fill(layout);

	vk::DescriptorSetAllocateInfo allocate {};
	allocate.descriptorPool     = m_current_pool.pool;
	allocate.descriptorSetCount = count;
	allocate.pSetLayouts        = layouts.data();

	const auto result = m_graphics.device.allocateDescriptorSets(&allocate, batch.sets.data());
	if (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
		EXIT_IF(result != vk::Result::eErrorOutOfPoolMemory &&
		        result != vk::Result::eErrorFragmentedPool);
		// The driver needs more room than the descriptor counts say, and the failure may have
		// used some of it up: take no more sets from this pool.
		m_free_sets = 0;
		return false;
	}
	m_free_sets -= count;
	for (const auto& needed: needs) {
		FindSize(m_free, needed.type)->descriptorCount -= needed.descriptorCount * count;
	}
	batch.size = count;
	return true;
}

void DescriptorHeap::CreateDescriptorPool(std::span<const vk::DescriptorPoolSize> sizes) {
	vk::DescriptorPoolCreateInfo create {};
	create.maxSets       = DescriptorHeapCount;
	create.poolSizeCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(sizes.size());
	create.pPoolSizes    = sizes.data();
	Pool pool;
	pool.sizes.assign(sizes.begin(), sizes.end());
	EXIT_IF(m_graphics.device.createDescriptorPool(&create, nullptr, &pool.pool) !=
	        vk::Result::eSuccess);
	UsePool(std::move(pool));
}

void DescriptorHeap::UsePool(Pool pool) {
	m_current_pool = std::move(pool);
	m_free         = m_current_pool.sizes;
	m_free_sets    = DescriptorHeapCount;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/descriptorHeap.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_DESCRIPTORHEAP_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_DESCRIPTORHEAP_H_

#include "common/common.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

#include <array>
#include <deque>
#include <span>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

struct GraphicContext;
class MasterSemaphore;

class DescriptorHeap {
public:
	DescriptorHeap(GraphicContext& graphics, MasterSemaphore& master_semaphore);
	~DescriptorHeap();
	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(DescriptorHeap);

	[[nodiscard]] vk::DescriptorSet Commit(vk::DescriptorSetLayout layout);

	// Records the descriptor counts of a layout whose sets come from this heap, so that the heap
	// asks a pool only for the sets it has room for, and a set larger than a default pool gets a
	// pool sized for it.
	static void RegisterLayout(vk::DescriptorSetLayout                         layout,
	                           std::span<const vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBinding> bindings);

	// Sampled images of one pool; bindless image tables take tens of thousands of them per set
	// (the title's ray tracing table: ~82000).
	static constexpr uint32_t MaxSampledImages = 262144;

private:
	static constexpr uint32_t DescriptorSetBatch = 32;

	struct Batch {
		std::array<vk::DescriptorSet, DescriptorSetBatch> sets {};
		uint32_t                                          size = 0;
	};

	struct Pool {
		vk::DescriptorPool                  pool = nullptr;
		std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize> sizes;
	};

	[[nodiscard]] bool Allocate(vk::DescriptorSetLayout layout, Batch& batch);
	[[nodiscard]] const std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize>&
	     LayoutSizes(vk::DescriptorSetLayout layout);
	void CreateDescriptorPool(std::span<const vk::DescriptorPoolSize> sizes);
	void UsePool(Pool pool);
	void RetireCurrentPool();

	GraphicContext&  m_graphics;
	MasterSemaphore& m_master_semaphore;
	Pool             m_current_pool;
	// Descriptors and sets that the current pool still has room for.
	std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize>                m_free;
	uint32_t                                           m_free_sets = 0;
	std::deque<std::pair<Pool, uint64_t>>              m_pending_pools;
	std::unordered_map<vk::DescriptorSetLayout, Batch> m_sets;
	std::unordered_map<vk::DescriptorSetLayout, std::vector<vk::DescriptorPoolSize>> m_layout_sizes;
};

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_DESCRIPTORHEAP_H_
```

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/descriptors.h"

#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/execHelpers.h"

#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/lodStats.h"

#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/render.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/occlusionQueries.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderContext.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/ShaderIR.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/passes/ResourceMaterialization.h"
#include "graphics/shader/shader.h"
#include "kernel/memory.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <limits>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

namespace {

using BindingKind = ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorBindingKind;

} // namespace

vk::DescriptorType NativeDescriptorType(BindingKind kind) {
	const auto image_class = ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageBindingResourceClass(kind);
	if (image_class == ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResourceClass::Sampled) {
		return vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage;
	}
	if (image_class == ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResourceClass::Storage) {
		return vk::DescriptorType::eStorageImage;
	}
	switch (kind) {
		case BindingKind::Samplers: return vk::DescriptorType::eSampler;
		case BindingKind::Buffers:
		case BindingKind::Gds:
		case BindingKind::BdaPagetable:
		case BindingKind::FaultBuffer:
		case BindingKind::FlattenedSrt:
		case BindingKind::ShaderData:
		case BindingKind::SharedMemory:
		case BindingKind::MipStats: return vk::DescriptorType::eStorageBuffer;
		case BindingKind::UniformBuffers: return vk::DescriptorType::eUniformBuffer;
		case BindingKind::Count: EXIT("invalid native descriptor binding kind");
	}
	EXIT("invalid native descriptor binding kind");
}

// Visits each bindless image table range once, with the first root image that samples it.
template <typename Fn>
void ForEachImageTable(const std::vector<ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource>& images, Fn&& fn) {
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < images.size(); i++) {
		const auto& image = images[i];
		if (image.table_capacity == 0u) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto kind  = *ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorBindingForImage(image);
		bool       first = true;
		for (uint32_t j = 0; j < i && first; j++) {
			first = images[j].table_capacity == 0u ||
			        images[j].table_descriptor_base != image.table_descriptor_base ||
			        ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorBindingForImage(images[j]) != kind;
		}
		if (first) {
			fn(i, kind);
		}
	}
}

vk::DescriptorImageInfo MakeImageInfo(const TextureBinding& texture, uint32_t element) {
	if (!texture.image_id) {
		EXIT_IF(texture.image_view != nullptr || !texture.mip_views.empty());
		return {nullptr, nullptr, vk::ImageLayout::eGeneral};
	}
	vk::ImageView view = nullptr;
	if (texture.mip_views.empty()) {
		if (element == 0u) {
			view = texture.image_view;
		}
	} else if (element < texture.mip_views.size()) {
		view = texture.mip_views[element];
	}
	EXIT_IF(view == nullptr || texture.layout == vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined);
	return {nullptr, view, texture.layout};
}

// A depth image a table names may be the depth target of a later draw, which samples it in the
// attachment layout: such elements are visited by every binding, so their descriptors follow the
// layout and AcquireRenderTargets() sees them.
static bool DepthTableElement(TextureCache& texture_cache, const TextureBinding& texture) {
	if (!texture.image_id) return false;
	return texture_cache.GetImage(texture.image_id).info.IsDepth();
}

static Prospero::ImageType TextureType(const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor) {
	const auto type = descriptor.Type();
	return type == Prospero::ImageType::kCube ? Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DArray : type;
}

// 1D textures are 2D images one texel high, so they share 2D surfaces at their address.
static Prospero::ImageType TextureBaseType(Prospero::ImageType type) {
	switch (type) {
		case Prospero::ImageType::kColor1D:
		case Prospero::ImageType::kColor1DArray:
		case Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DArray:
		case Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaa:
		case Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaaArray: return Prospero::ImageType::kColor2D;
		default: return type;
	}
}

static bool IsMultisampledTexture(Prospero::ImageType type) {
	return type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaa ||
	       type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaaArray;
}

static vk::DescriptorBufferInfo
NativeStorageBuffer(RenderContext& context, const PreparedBindings::BufferSource& source,
                    const ShaderRecompiler::IR::BufferResource& resource, uint32_t& buffer_offset) {
	buffer_offset = 0;

	const auto& [address, size, id] = source;
	if (address == 0 || size == 0) {
		// Null descriptors read zero and drop writes, with or without shader bounds checks.
		return {nullptr, 0, vk::WholeSize};
	}
	const auto& graphics  = context.GetGraphics();
	// A buffer with a uniform view aligns both views alike: they share the base adjustment.
	const auto  alignment =
	    resource.uniform_index == UINT32_MAX
	        ? graphics.StorageMinAlignment()
	        : std::max<vk::DeviceSize>(
	              graphics.StorageMinAlignment(),
	              graphics.GetPhysicalDeviceProperties().limits.minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment);
	if (size > graphics.GetPhysicalDeviceProperties().limits.maxStorageBufferRange) {
		EXIT("storage buffer range is unsupported\n");
	}
	// Occlusion counters the GPU has not finished dumping under the range reach the copy before
	// the operation runs (see OcclusionQueries::PrepareRead()).
	auto&      queries  = context.GetOcclusionQueries();
	const bool counters = queries.PrepareRead(address, size);
	auto [buffer, offset] = context.GetBufferCache().ObtainBuffer(
	    address, size, resource.written,
	    resource.formatted || (resource.read && Config::SyncRawImageBuffersEnabled()), id);
	if (counters) {
		queries.NoteReadTarget(address, size, *buffer, offset);
	}
	const auto aligned_offset = Common::AlignDown(offset, alignment);
	const auto adjustment     = offset - aligned_offset;
	const auto max_range      = graphics.GetPhysicalDeviceProperties().limits.maxStorageBufferRange;
	if (adjustment >= 256 || size > max_range - adjustment) {
		EXIT("storage buffer offset adjustment is unsupported\n");
	}
	buffer_offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(adjustment);
	const vk::DescriptorBufferInfo result {buffer->Handle(), aligned_offset, size + adjustment};
	if (resource.written) {
		context.GetTextureCache().InvalidateMemoryFromGPU(address, size);
	}
	return result;
}

// Reserved and unsupported T# fields must be zero; perf_mod only scales sampler state.
static bool IsCanonicalTextureEncoding(const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, bool r128) {
	constexpr uint32_t field1_reserved_mask = 0x200fff00u;
	constexpr uint32_t field2_reserved_mask = 0xf0003000u;
	const uint32_t     field3_expected = descriptor.DstSelXYZW() |
	                                     (static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.BaseLevel()) << 12u) |
	                                     (static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.LastLevel()) << 16u) |
	                                     (static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.TileMode()) << 20u) |
	                                     (static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Type()) << 28u);
	const uint32_t     field4_expected = descriptor.Depth() | (descriptor.BaseArray5() << 16u);
	const uint32_t     field5_expected = (static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.PerfMod5()) << 20u) |
	                                     (static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.MaxMip()) << 4u);
	if ((descriptor.fields[1] & field1_reserved_mask) != 0 ||
	    (descriptor.fields[2] & field2_reserved_mask) != 0 || descriptor.fields[3] != field3_expected) {
		return false;
	}
	if (r128) {
		return descriptor.fields[4] == 0 && descriptor.fields[5] == 0 && descriptor.fields[6] == 0 &&
		       descriptor.fields[7] == 0;
	}
	return descriptor.fields[4] == field4_expected && descriptor.fields[5] == field5_expected;
}

bool IsSupportedDepthTextureEncoding(const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, bool r128) {
	if (!IsCanonicalTextureEncoding(descriptor, r128)) {
		return false;
	}
	if (r128) {
		return true;
	}
	if (descriptor.MsaaDepth() && !IsMultisampledTexture(descriptor.Type())) {
		return false;
	}
	// Bits 0..7 name the mip-statistics counter (MipStatsCntId), which only counts LODs and leaves
	// the sampled data and its metadata alone.
	const auto metadata_control = descriptor.fields[6] & 0x00ffff00u;
	// Metadata pipe alignment (bit 19) only shapes how HTILE is addressed; without compression
	// (bit 21) there is no HTILE and the depth data is read as it is.
	constexpr uint32_t meta_pipe_aligned = 1u << 19u;
	if ((metadata_control & ~meta_pipe_aligned) == 0) {
		return true;
	}
	constexpr uint32_t htile_control = 0x00280000u;
	const uint32_t expected_control  = htile_control | (descriptor.MsaaDepth() ? (1u << 10u) : 0u);
	const auto     metadata_addr     = descriptor.MetaAddr() << 8u;
	return metadata_control == expected_control && GuestRange {metadata_addr, 1}.Valid() &&
	       (metadata_addr & 0x7fffu) == 0 &&
	       descriptor.TileMode() == Prospero::TileMode::kDepth;
}

struct SampledDepthBindingSupport {
	bool resource_ok = false;
	bool encoding_ok = false;
	bool view_ok     = false;

	[[nodiscard]] bool Supported() const { return resource_ok && encoding_ok && view_ok; }
};

static SampledDepthBindingSupport
CheckSampledDepthBinding(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                         const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, const Image& image,
                         vk::Format view_format) {
	return {
	    .resource_ok = IsSupportedSampledDepthResource(resource),
	    // Comparison sampling changes the host format, not the guest metadata encoding.
	    .encoding_ok = descriptor.TileMode() != Prospero::TileMode::kDepth ||
	                   IsSupportedDepthTextureEncoding(descriptor, resource.r128),
	    .view_ok =
	        IsSupportedSampledDepthView(image.info.pixel_format, view_format, descriptor.DstSelXYZW()),
	};
}

static void ValidateSampledDepthBinding(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                                        const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, const Image& image,
                                        vk::Format view_format, uint64_t size) {
	const auto [resource_ok, encoding_ok, view_ok] =
	    CheckSampledDepthBinding(resource, descriptor, image, view_format);
	if (resource_ok && encoding_ok && view_ok) {
		return;
	}
	const auto descriptor_pitch =
	    TileGetTexturePitch(descriptor.Format(), static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Width5()) + 1u,
	                        descriptor.TileMode());
	EXIT("unsupported sampled depth image: resource=%d encoding=%d view=%d "
	     "class=%u numeric=%u dimension=%u mip_mode=%u read=%d written=%d atomic=%d compare=%d "
	     "guest_format=%u swizzle=0x%03x image_format=%d view_format=%d image_layers=%u "
	     "descriptor_type=%u base_array=%u depth=%u descriptor_pitch=%u target_pitch=%u "
	     "addr=0x%016" PRIx64 " size=0x%016" PRIx64
	     " dwords=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x\n",
	     resource_ok, encoding_ok, view_ok,
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.resource_class),
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.numeric_class), static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.dimension),
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.mip_mode), resource.read, resource.written, resource.atomic,
	     resource.depth_compare, static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Format()),
	     descriptor.DstSelXYZW(), static_cast<int>(image.info.pixel_format),
	     static_cast<int>(view_format), image.info.resources.layers,
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Type()), descriptor.BaseArray5(), descriptor.Depth(),
	     descriptor_pitch, image.info.pitch, descriptor.Base40(), size, descriptor.fields[0],
	     descriptor.fields[1], descriptor.fields[2], descriptor.fields[3], descriptor.fields[4],
	     descriptor.fields[5], descriptor.fields[6], descriptor.fields[7]);
}

static bool IsSupportedStorageTextureDescriptor(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                                                const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor) {
	const auto tile              = descriptor.TileMode();
	const bool is_color_1d       = descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor1D;
	const bool is_color_1d_array = descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor1DArray;
	const bool valid_1d_slice =
	    (is_color_1d && descriptor.Depth() == 0 && descriptor.BaseArray5() == 0) ||
	    (is_color_1d_array && descriptor.BaseArray5() <= descriptor.Depth());
	const bool is_1d = resource.dimension == ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim1D &&
	                   descriptor.Height5() == 0 && valid_1d_slice;
	const bool is_1d_array =
	    resource.dimension == ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim1DArray &&
	    is_color_1d_array && descriptor.Height5() == 0 &&
	    descriptor.BaseArray5() <= descriptor.Depth();
	const bool is_color_2d       = descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2D;
	const bool is_color_2d_array = descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DArray;
	const bool valid_2d_slice =
	    (is_color_2d && descriptor.Depth() == 0 && descriptor.BaseArray5() == 0) ||
	    (is_color_2d_array && descriptor.BaseArray5() <= descriptor.Depth());
	const bool is_2d =
	    resource.dimension == ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2D && valid_2d_slice;
	// Storage cube coordinates address individual faces, including partial cube views.
	const bool is_cube = resource.cube && descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kCube &&
	                     descriptor.Width5() == descriptor.Height5() &&
	                     descriptor.BaseArray5() <= descriptor.Depth();
	const bool is_2d_array =
	    resource.dimension == ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2DArray &&
	    ((!resource.cube && is_color_2d_array && descriptor.BaseArray5() <= descriptor.Depth()) ||
	     is_cube);
	const bool is_3d = resource.dimension == ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim3D &&
	                   descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor3D &&
	                   descriptor.BaseArray5() == 0;
	const bool is_2d_msaa =
	    resource.dimension == ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2DMsaa &&
	    descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaa && descriptor.Depth() == 0 &&
	    descriptor.BaseArray5() == 0;
	TileTextureBlockLayout tile_layout {};
	bool                   supported_tile = false;
	switch (tile) {
		case Prospero::TileMode::kLinear: supported_tile = true; break;
		case Prospero::TileMode::kDepth:
			supported_tile =
			    !resource.read && !Prospero::IsFmaskTextureFormat(descriptor.Format()) &&
			    (is_2d || is_2d_array) &&
			    TileGetTextureBlockLayout(descriptor.Format(), tile, false, tile_layout);
			break;
		case Prospero::TileMode::kStandard256B:
			supported_tile =
			    (is_2d || is_2d_array) &&
			    TileGetTextureBlockLayout(descriptor.Format(), tile, false, tile_layout);
			break;
		case Prospero::TileMode::kStandard4KB:
		case Prospero::TileMode::kStandard64KB:
			supported_tile =
			    TileGetTextureBlockLayout(descriptor.Format(), tile, is_3d, tile_layout);
			break;
		case Prospero::TileMode::kRenderTarget:
			supported_tile =
			    TileGetTextureBlockLayout(descriptor.Format(), tile, false, tile_layout);
			break;
		default: break;
	}
	const auto swizzle = descriptor.DstSelXYZW();
	const bool supported_swizzle =
	    IsValidImageSwizzle(swizzle) &&
	    (swizzle == DstSel(4, 5, 6, 7) || !resource.read || resource.atomic);
	return (is_1d || is_1d_array || is_2d || is_2d_array || is_3d || is_2d_msaa) &&
	       supported_tile && descriptor.BaseLevel() <= descriptor.LastLevel() &&
	       descriptor.MinLod() == 0 && supported_swizzle && descriptor.BCSwizzle() == 0 &&
	       !descriptor.MsaaDepth();
}

void ValidateStorageTexture(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                            const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, uint64_t size) {
	const auto format        = descriptor.Format();
	const bool resource_ok   = IsSupportedStorageImageResource(resource);
	const bool descriptor_ok = IsSupportedStorageTextureDescriptor(resource, descriptor);
	const bool encoding_ok   = IsCanonicalTextureEncoding(descriptor, resource.r128);
	const bool uint_resource    = resource.numeric_class == Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Uint;
	const bool raw_sint_storage = uint_resource &&
	    ShaderRecompiler::IR::RawSignedStorageFormat(resource, format) != Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid;
	const auto numeric_class =
	    Prospero::SampledTextureNumericClass(Prospero::RemapTextureFormat(format));
	const bool raw_float_atomic = format == Prospero::BufferFormat::k32Float && uint_resource &&
	                              resource.atomic && !resource.atomic64;
	const bool format_ok =
	    raw_sint_storage || raw_float_atomic ||
	    (numeric_class != Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Unsupported &&
	     numeric_class != Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Sint &&
	     uint_resource == (numeric_class == Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Uint) &&
	     (!resource.atomic || format == (resource.atomic64 ? Prospero::BufferFormat::k32_32UInt
	                                                       : Prospero::BufferFormat::k32UInt)));
	if (resource_ok && descriptor_ok && encoding_ok && format_ok && size != 0) {
		return;
	}
	EXIT("unsupported storage texture: shader=0x%016" PRIx64 " resource=%d descriptor=%d encoding=%d "
	     "format=%d class=%u numeric=%u dimension=%u mip_mode=%u atomic=%d compare=%d "
	     "base_level=%u last_level=%u max_mip=%u min_lod=%u base_array=%u bc=%u msaa=%d "
	     "depth_tile_bpe=%u swizzle_ok=%d "
	     "addr=0x%016" PRIx64 " size=0x%016" PRIx64
	     " extent=%ux%ux%u type=%u format=%u tile=%u swizzle=0x%03x read=%d written=%d "
	     "dwords=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x\n",
	     Common::HackNotice::CurrentShaderSlot(), resource_ok, descriptor_ok,
	     encoding_ok, format_ok, static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.resource_class),
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.numeric_class), static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.dimension),
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.mip_mode), resource.atomic, resource.depth_compare,
	     descriptor.BaseLevel(), descriptor.LastLevel(), descriptor.MaxMip(), descriptor.MinLod(),
	     descriptor.BaseArray5(), descriptor.BCSwizzle(), descriptor.MsaaDepth(),
	     Prospero::RenderTargetBytesPerElement(format),
	     IsValidImageSwizzle(descriptor.DstSelXYZW()), descriptor.Base40(), size,
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Width5()) + 1u,
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Height5()) + 1u,
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Depth()) + 1u, static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Type()),
	     static_cast<uint32_t>(format), static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.TileMode()),
	     descriptor.DstSelXYZW(), resource.read, resource.written, descriptor.fields[0],
	     descriptor.fields[1], descriptor.fields[2], descriptor.fields[3], descriptor.fields[4],
	     descriptor.fields[5], descriptor.fields[6], descriptor.fields[7]);
}

// sRGB views decode before filtering; a sampler that skips degamma reads through a UNorm view.
static vk::Format SampledViewFormat(const GraphicContext& graphics, Prospero::BufferFormat format,
                                    vk::Format pixel_format, bool skip_degamma) {
	if (skip_degamma) return SrgbUnormViewFormat(pixel_format);
	switch (format) {
		case Prospero::BufferFormat::k8Srgb:
			return graphics.r8_srgb_views ? vk::Format::eR8Srgb : pixel_format;
		case Prospero::BufferFormat::k8_8Srgb:
			return graphics.r8g8_srgb_views ? vk::Format::eR8G8Srgb : pixel_format;
		default: return pixel_format;
	}
}

// Atomics and raw signed stores use unsigned integer views; sRGB images store through UNorm.
static vk::Format StorageViewFormat(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                                    Prospero::BufferFormat format, vk::Format pixel_format) {
	if (resource.atomic64) return vk::Format::eR64Uint;
	if (resource.atomic) return vk::Format::eR32Uint;
	const auto raw_sint_format = ShaderRecompiler::IR::RawSignedStorageFormat(resource, format);
	if (raw_sint_format != Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid) return VulkanFormat(raw_sint_format);
	return SrgbUnormViewFormat(pixel_format);
}

static ImageViewInfo TextureViewInfo(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                                     const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, vk::Format format,
                                     const SurfaceFormatInfo& surface_format, bool storage,
                                     uint32_t view_levels, uint32_t image_layers) {
	ImageViewInfo view {};
	view.format      = format;
	view.aspect      = vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor;
	view.base_level  = descriptor.BaseLevel();
	view.level_count = view_levels;
	if (descriptor.MinLod() > descriptor.LastLevel() * 256u) {
		EXIT("texture minimum LOD exceeds last mip level: min_lod=%u last_level=%u\n",
		     descriptor.MinLod(), descriptor.LastLevel());
	}
	const auto base_lod = view.base_level * 256u;
	if (descriptor.MinLod() > base_lod) {
		view.min_lod = descriptor.MinLod() - base_lod;
	}
	view.usage = storage ? vk::ImageUsageFlagBits::eStorage : vk::ImageUsageFlagBits::eSampled;
	view.mapping =
	    storage || resource.conversion_format != Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid
	        ? vk::ComponentMapping {}
	        : TextureGetComponentMapping(descriptor.DstSelXYZW(), surface_format.host_to_storage);
	switch (resource.dimension) {
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim3D:
			view.type        = vk::ImageViewType::e3D;
			view.base_layer  = 0;
			view.layer_count = 1;
			break;
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim1DArray:
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2DArray:
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2DMsaaArray:
			view.type       = vk::ImageViewType::e2DArray;
			view.base_layer = descriptor.BaseArray5();
			if (view.base_layer >= image_layers) {
				EXIT("texture array base layer is out of bounds\n");
			}
			view.layer_count = image_layers - view.base_layer;
			break;
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim1D:
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2D:
		case ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2DMsaa:
			view.type       = vk::ImageViewType::e2D;
			view.base_layer = descriptor.BaseArray5();
			if (view.base_layer >= image_layers) {
				EXIT("texture base layer is out of bounds\n");
			}
			view.layer_count = 1;
			break;
		default: EXIT("unsupported texture view dimension\n");
	}
	return view;
}

static bool ResolveTextureMipView(ImageInfo& info, uint32_t physical_levels, bool metadata,
                                  uint32_t view_levels, uint32_t& base_level) {
	if (!info.IsTiled()) {
		return false;
	}
	ImageInfo physical        = info;
	physical.resources.levels = physical_levels;
	physical.UpdateSize();
	info.UpdateSize();
	const auto same_mip = [&](uint32_t target, uint32_t source) {
		const auto& left  = physical.mip_layout[target];
		const auto& right = info.mip_layout[source];
		return left.offset == right.offset && left.size == right.size &&
		       left.pitch == right.pitch && left.height == right.height &&
		       left.tail_x == right.tail_x && left.tail_y == right.tail_y &&
		       left.surface_z == right.surface_z &&
		       physical.MipExtent(target) == info.MipExtent(source);
	};
	if (physical.first_tail_level == info.first_tail_level &&
	    physical.tiled_slice_stride == info.tiled_slice_stride &&
	    physical.data.size == info.data.size) {
		bool matches = true;
		for (uint32_t level = 0; level < physical_levels; ++level) {
			matches &= same_mip(level, level);
		}
		if (matches) {
			return true;
		}
	}
	if (metadata ||
	    (info.TransferLayers() > 1 && physical.tiled_slice_stride != info.tiled_slice_stride)) {
		return false;
	}
	// T# addresses the last mip. A view can select the same stored subresources
	// with different mip indices; inaccessible mips need no host representation.
	for (uint32_t base = 0; base + view_levels <= physical_levels; ++base) {
		bool matches = true;
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < view_levels; ++i) {
			const auto source = base_level + i;
			const auto target = base + i;
			if (!same_mip(target, source) ||
			    (target >= physical.first_tail_level) != (source >= info.first_tail_level)) {
				matches = false;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (matches) {
			info       = std::move(physical);
			base_level = base;
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

// What ResolveTexture derives from a T# and the shader's view of it before any texture-cache
// lookup: a pure function of both (EXITs on unsupported descriptors).
static TextureDescDerivation DeriveTextureDesc(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                                               const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor) {
	const bool storage = resource.written;
	const auto address         = descriptor.Base40();
	const auto width           = static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Width5()) + 1u;
	const auto height          = static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Height5()) + 1u;
	const auto base_level      = descriptor.BaseLevel();
	const auto last_level      = descriptor.LastLevel();
	const auto type            = TextureType(descriptor);
	const bool multisampled    = IsMultisampledTexture(type);
	const auto max_mip         = resource.r128 ? last_level : descriptor.MaxMip();
	const auto physical_levels = multisampled ? 1u : static_cast<uint32_t>(max_mip) + 1u;
	// IMAGE_STORE addresses BASE_LEVEL; only IMAGE_STORE_MIP selects other view mips.
	const bool single_storage_mip =
	    storage && resource.mip_mode != ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageMipMode::Dynamic;
	const auto view_levels = multisampled || single_storage_mip
	                             ? 1u
	                             : static_cast<uint32_t>(last_level - base_level) + 1u;
	auto levels =
	    multisampled ? 1u : std::max(physical_levels, base_level + view_levels);
	const auto tile       = descriptor.TileMode();
	const bool depth_tile = tile == Prospero::TileMode::kDepth;
	const bool msaa_tile  = depth_tile || tile == Prospero::TileMode::kRenderTarget;
	const bool msaa_array = type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaaArray;
	if ((!multisampled && base_level > last_level) ||
	    (multisampled &&
	     (base_level != 0 || last_level == 0 || last_level > 3 || max_mip != last_level ||
	      !msaa_tile || (descriptor.MsaaDepth() && !depth_tile) ||
	      (!msaa_array && (descriptor.Depth() != 0 || descriptor.BaseArray5() != 0))))) {
		EXIT("unsupported texture mip view: base=%u last=%u levels=%u max=%u type=%u tile=%u "
		     "class=%u numeric=%u dimension=%u mip_mode=%u read=%d written=%d "
		     "dwords=%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x,%08x\n",
		     base_level, last_level, levels, descriptor.MaxMip(),
		     static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Type()), static_cast<uint32_t>(tile),
		     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.resource_class),
		     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.numeric_class),
		     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.dimension), static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.mip_mode),
		     resource.read, resource.written, descriptor.fields[0], descriptor.fields[1],
		     descriptor.fields[2], descriptor.fields[3], descriptor.fields[4], descriptor.fields[5],
		     descriptor.fields[6], descriptor.fields[7]);
	}
	const auto samples = multisampled ? 1u << last_level : 1u;
	const auto depth          = static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.Depth()) + 1u;
	const auto format         = ShaderRecompiler::IR::ReadsDepthBits(resource)
	                                ? Prospero::BufferFormat::k16UNorm
	                                : descriptor.Format();
	const auto surface_format = TextureGetSurfaceFormatInfo(format);
	const bool shader_conversion =
	    surface_format.conversion_format != Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid;
	const bool sampled_numeric_class =
	    storage || resource.numeric_class ==
	                   Prospero::SampledTextureNumericClass(Prospero::RemapTextureFormat(format));
	if (!storage && resource.resource_class == ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResourceClass::Sampled &&
	    !sampled_numeric_class) {
		EXIT("sampled image numeric class mismatch: numeric=%u format=%u addr=0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
		     static_cast<uint32_t>(resource.numeric_class), static_cast<uint32_t>(format), address);
	}

	const bool    volume       = type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor3D;
	const bool    layered      = type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor1DArray ||
	                             type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DArray ||
	                             type == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DMsaaArray;
	const auto    image_layers = layered ? depth : 1u;
	auto          view_base    = static_cast<uint32_t>(base_level);
	auto pixel_format = surface_format.vk_format;
	if (resource.depth_compare) {
		if (const auto* depth_format = FindGuestDepthFormatPolicy(format)) {
			pixel_format = depth_format->depth_attachment_format;
		}
	}
	const auto view_format =
	    storage ? StorageViewFormat(resource, format, pixel_format) : pixel_format;
	const auto              block_bytes = Prospero::BlockCompressedBytesPerBlock(format);
	TextureCache::ImageDesc desc {};
	desc.info.data         = {address, 0};
	desc.info.pixel_format = pixel_format;
	desc.info.guest_format = format;
```
