```cpp
		                        sizeof(push_data), push_data.dwords.data());
	}

	if (!m_descriptor_writes.empty()) {
		if (pipeline.uses_push_descriptors) {
			vk_buffer.pushDescriptorSetKHR(pipeline_bind_point, pipeline.pipeline_layout, 0,
			                               static_cast<uint32_t>(m_descriptor_writes.size()),
			                               m_descriptor_writes.data());
		} else {
			const auto set = m_context.GetDescriptorHeap().Commit(pipeline.descriptor_set_layout);
			for (auto& write: m_descriptor_writes) {
				write.dstSet = set;
			}
			m_context.GetGraphics().device.updateDescriptorSets(
			    static_cast<uint32_t>(m_descriptor_writes.size()), m_descriptor_writes.data(), 0,
			    nullptr);
			vk_buffer.bindDescriptorSets(pipeline_bind_point, pipeline.pipeline_layout, 0, 1, &set,
			                             0, nullptr);
		}
	}
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_DESCRIPTORS_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_DESCRIPTORS_H_

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/bufferCache.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/textureCache.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/image/image.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

#include "graphics/shader/shaderBindings.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <type_traits>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

struct ShaderStageRuntime;

struct TextureDescDerivation;

// The state of a cached image that its lookups and acquisitions depend on. While an image keeps
// it (and the image set around its range is unchanged), looking it up again and acquiring its
// views finds the same image and views and changes nothing.
struct ImageLookupState {
	ImageId  id;
	ImageId  depth_id;
	uint64_t track_addr      = 0;
	uint64_t track_addr_end  = 0;
	bool     cpu_dirty       = false;
	bool     buffer_modified = false;
	bool     gpu_modified    = false;
	bool     render_target   = false;

	bool operator==(const ImageLookupState&) const = default;

	[[nodiscard]] static ImageLookupState Of(ImageId id, const Image& image) {
		return {.id              = id,
		        .depth_id        = image.depth_id,
		        .track_addr      = image.track_addr,
		        .track_addr_end  = image.track_addr_end,
		        .cpu_dirty       = image.IsCpuDirty(),
		        .buffer_modified = image.IsBufferModified(),
		        .gpu_modified    = image.IsGpuModified(),
		        .render_target   = image.usage.render_target};
	}
};

// The image state a bindless table element's view was last acquired in: while the image keeps
// it, the view still holds and acquiring it again would only refresh the image's use.
struct TableViewMemo {
	ImageLookupState state;
	bool             valid = false;
};

struct TextureBinding {
	ImageId                    image_id;
	vk::ImageView              image_view = nullptr;
	TextureCache::ImageDesc    desc;
	vk::ImageLayout            layout = vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined;
	std::vector<vk::ImageView> mip_views;
	// The description whose last lookup this binding reuses (image_view is set) or records once
	// its view is acquired; see RenderExecutor::ResolveTexture().
	TextureDescDerivation* lookup = nullptr;
	bool                   reused = false;
};

struct PreparedBindings {
	struct BufferSource {
		uint64_t address = 0;
		uint64_t size    = 0;
		BufferId id;
	};

	// The draw owns the immutable compiled-program/runtime-snapshot association through commit.
	const ShaderStageRuntime* runtime = nullptr;
	// Keep the resolved guest range through cache preparation; only the host buffer ID may
	// become stale and need resolving again when bindings are rebound.
	std::vector<BufferSource>             buffer_sources;
	std::vector<vk::DescriptorBufferInfo> buffers;
	// The uniform views of the buffers that have a uniform_index, by that index.
	std::vector<vk::DescriptorBufferInfo> uniform_buffers;
	std::vector<TextureBinding>           images;
	// The distinct bindless table elements, with the T# and the root image each was resolved
	// for, and, for every slot of every table range in binding order, the element it binds.
	// The title's ray tracing tables have ~16k slots that name far fewer distinct textures. The
	// bindings live in the executor's table resolutions (see
	// RenderExecutor::TableElementResolution), which keep them until ResetBindings().
	std::vector<TextureBinding*>                        table_images;
	std::vector<TableViewMemo*>                         table_views;
	std::vector<ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue> table_sources;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                               table_roots;
	// The change counter of each element (RenderExecutor::TableElementResolution::version_slot).
	std::vector<uint32_t>                               table_versions;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                               table_slots;
	// The program's table binding state (RenderExecutor::TableBindingState). When
	// `tables_reused`, the table vectors above stay empty: the tables bind what the state holds,
	// and `table_visits` lists the state's elements this binding looks up again.
	void*                                               table_state   = nullptr;
	bool                                                tables_reused = false;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                               table_visits;
	std::vector<vk::Sampler>              samplers;
	vk::DescriptorBufferInfo              gds {nullptr, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE};
	vk::DescriptorBufferInfo              flattened_srt;
	vk::DescriptorBufferInfo              shader_data_buffer;
	vk::DescriptorBufferInfo              shared_memory;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                 shader_data;
	// What the previous draw of this stage bound: a stage that binds the same program with the
	// same T#s and S#s again (about half of them) skips the description lookups.
	const void*                                        last_program          = nullptr;
	uint64_t                                           last_descs_generation = 0;
	std::vector<ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue> last_images;
	std::vector<ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue> last_samplers;
	// The description each T# of `last_images` has (null when its lookups are not reused).
	std::vector<TextureDescDerivation*>                image_descs;
};

[[nodiscard]] vk::DescriptorType
NativeDescriptorType(ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorBindingKind kind);
[[nodiscard]] vk::DescriptorImageInfo MakeImageInfo(const TextureBinding& texture,
                                                    uint32_t              element = 0);

template <typename T>
[[nodiscard]] T DecodeNativeDescriptor(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue& value) {
	static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<T>);
	static_assert(sizeof(T) % sizeof(uint32_t) == 0);
	T result {};
	EXIT_IF(value.dword_count < sizeof(result) / sizeof(uint32_t));
	std::memcpy(&result, value.dwords.data(), sizeof(result));
	return result;
}

[[nodiscard]] bool IsSupportedDepthTextureEncoding(const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor,
                                                   bool r128 = false);
void ValidateStorageTexture(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource& resource,
                            const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor, uint64_t size);

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_DESCRIPTORS_H_
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/imageHeap.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/imageHeap.h"

#include "common/alignment.h"
#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/profiler.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/pageManager.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/regionDefinitions.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/streamBuffer.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/render.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderContext.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/passes/ResourceMaterialization.h"
#include "kernel/memory.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <xxhash.h>

namespace Libs::Graphics {
namespace {

namespace IR = ShaderRecompiler::IR;

// Smaller tables are often written for one draw, so they enter on a second draw of a frame.
constexpr uint64_t MinTableBytes = 64ull * 1024ull;
constexpr uint32_t ElementMask   = (1u << IR::ImageHeapKindShift) - 1u;

template <typename Pred, typename Fn>
void ForEachRun(size_t begin, size_t end, Pred&& pred, Fn&& fn) {
	while (begin < end) {
		if (!pred(begin)) {
			++begin;
			continue;
		}
		auto run = begin + 1u;
		while (run < end && pred(run)) ++run;
		fn(begin, run);
		begin = run;
	}
}

// Grows [begin, end) to cover [first, last).
void Widen(size_t& begin, size_t& end, size_t first, size_t last) {
	const bool empty = begin == end;
	begin            = empty ? first : std::min(begin, first);
	end              = empty ? last : std::max(end, last);
}

// Probes at first + k * step whose first dword lies within a table of size bytes.
uint64_t Probes(uint64_t size, uint64_t first, uint64_t step) {
	return size >= first + 4u ? (size - first - 4u) / step + 1u : 0u;
}

// Tables grow a little on most frames, so their slot words get room to double.
std::unique_ptr<Buffer> SlotBuffer(RenderContext& context, uint64_t size) {
	return std::make_unique<Buffer>(
	    context.GetGraphics(), context.GetCommandScheduler(), MemoryUsage::DeviceLocal, 0,
	    vk::BufferUsageFlagBits::eTransferDst | vk::BufferUsageFlagBits::eStorageBuffer |
	        vk::BufferUsageFlagBits::eShaderDeviceAddress,
	    std::bit_ceil(size + 4u));
}

// Guest bytes of a table that its tracker pages [begin, end) cover.
std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t> PageRange(uint64_t base, uint64_t size, size_t begin, size_t end) {
	const auto origin = Common::AlignDown(base, TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE);
	return {std::max(base, origin + begin * TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE),
	        std::min(base + size, origin + end * TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE)};
}

} // namespace

size_t ImageHeap::DescriptorHash::operator()(const DescriptorValue& value) const noexcept {
	return XXH3_64bits(value.dwords.data(), sizeof(value.dwords));
}

ImageHeap::ImageHeap(RenderContext& context, PageManager& page_manager)
    : m_context(context), m_page_manager(page_manager) {
	auto& graphics = context.GetGraphics();
	vk::PhysicalDeviceVulkan12Properties limits {};
	vk::PhysicalDeviceProperties2        properties {};
	properties.pNext = &limits;
	graphics.physical_device.getProperties2(&properties);
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(std::min({limits.maxDescriptorSetUpdateAfterBindSampledImages,
	                               limits.maxPerStageDescriptorUpdateAfterBindSampledImages,
	                               limits.maxPerStageUpdateAfterBindResources}) <
	                     IR::ImageHeapCapacity);

	const vk::DescriptorBindingFlags binding_flags =
	    vk::DescriptorBindingFlagBits::ePartiallyBound |
	    vk::DescriptorBindingFlagBits::eUpdateAfterBind |
	    vk::DescriptorBindingFlagBits::eUpdateUnusedWhilePending;
	vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBindingFlagsCreateInfo flags_info {};
	flags_info.bindingCount  = 1;
	flags_info.pBindingFlags = &binding_flags;
	const vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBinding binding {0, vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage,
	                                              IR::ImageHeapCapacity,
	                                              vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eAll, nullptr};
	vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo layout_info {};
	layout_info.pNext        = &flags_info;
	layout_info.flags        = vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateFlagBits::eUpdateAfterBindPool;
	layout_info.bindingCount = 1;
	layout_info.pBindings    = &binding;
	EXIT_IF(graphics.device.createDescriptorSetLayout(&layout_info, nullptr, &m_layout) !=
	        vk::Result::eSuccess);
	const vk::DescriptorPoolSize pool_size {vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage,
	                                        IR::ImageHeapCapacity};
	vk::DescriptorPoolCreateInfo pool_info {};
	pool_info.flags         = vk::DescriptorPoolCreateFlagBits::eUpdateAfterBind;
	pool_info.maxSets       = 1;
	pool_info.poolSizeCount = 1;
	pool_info.pPoolSizes    = &pool_size;
	EXIT_IF(graphics.device.createDescriptorPool(&pool_info, nullptr, &m_pool) !=
	        vk::Result::eSuccess);
	vk::DescriptorSetAllocateInfo allocate {};
	allocate.descriptorPool     = m_pool;
	allocate.descriptorSetCount = 1;
	allocate.pSetLayouts        = &m_layout;
	EXIT_IF(graphics.device.allocateDescriptorSets(&allocate, &m_set) != vk::Result::eSuccess);
	graphics.image_heap_layout = m_layout;
	// Slot word 0 selects element 0, which stays a null image.
	m_elements.push_back({.binding = {.layout = vk::ImageLayout::eShaderReadOnlyOptimal}});
	m_writes.push_back(0u);
	WriteDescriptors();
}

ImageHeap::~ImageHeap() {
	for (const auto& memory: m_memories) Unwatch(*memory);
	auto& graphics             = m_context.GetGraphics();
	graphics.image_heap_layout = nullptr;
	graphics.device.destroyDescriptorPool(m_pool, nullptr);
	graphics.device.destroyDescriptorSetLayout(m_layout, nullptr);
}

bool ImageHeap::Acquire(const IR::ImageHeapRequest& request, IR::ImageHeapView& result) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	const auto size = request.size & ~uint64_t {3};
	if (request.count == 0u || request.step == 0u ||
	    ((request.base | request.first | request.step) & 3u) != 0u) {
		return false;
	}
	auto memory = std::ranges::find_if(
	    m_memories, [&](const auto& candidate) { return candidate->base == request.base; });
	if (memory == m_memories.end() && size < MinTableBytes &&
	    m_sightings.try_emplace(request.base, m_draw).first->second == m_draw) {
		return false;
	}
	// A table follows its descriptor's size, as the first program of a draw acquires it.
	if (memory == m_memories.end() || ((*memory)->size != size && (*memory)->draw != m_draw)) {
		if (!m_context.IsMapped(request.base, size)) return false;
		if (memory == m_memories.end()) {
			std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
			memory = m_memories.insert(m_memories.end(),
			                           std::make_unique<Memory>(Memory {.base = request.base}));
		}
		Resize(**memory, size);
	}
	// A draw refreshes a table and a view takes its changes once, so all programs of the draw see
	// one snapshot and one set of kinds.
	if ((*memory)->draw != m_draw) {
		if (!Refresh(**memory)) return false;
		(*memory)->draw = m_draw;
	}
	auto&      views   = (*memory)->views;
	const auto bytes   = (*memory)->size;
	const auto profile = IR::ImageHeapResource(*request.root, 0u);
	const auto probes  = Probes(size, request.first, request.step);
	const auto limit   = request.count < probes ? request.count : UINT64_MAX;
	auto       view    = std::ranges::find_if(views, [&](const auto& candidate) {
		return candidate->step == request.step && candidate->first == request.first &&
		       candidate->limit == limit && candidate->profile == profile;
	});
	if (view == views.end()) {
		const auto epoch   = Image::heap_epoch.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
		const auto count   = std::min(limit, Probes(bytes, request.first, request.step));
		auto       created = std::make_unique<View>(View {.memory        = **memory,
		                                                  .step          = request.step,
		                                                  .first         = request.first,
		                                                  .count         = count,
		                                                  .limit         = limit,
		                                                  .profile       = profile,
		                                                  .resolve_epoch = epoch,
		                                                  .layout_epoch  = epoch});
		created->slots.resize(bytes / 4u + 1u);
		created->buffer = SlotBuffer(m_context, bytes);
		UpdateProbes(*created, 0u, bytes);
		// The first upload also clears the slots no probe selects.
		created->dirty_begin = 0;
		created->dirty_end   = created->slots.size();
		view = views.insert(views.end(), std::move(created));
	} else {
		// Empty after the first acquire in a draw, since the table refreshes once per draw.
		UpdateProbes(**view, (*view)->changed_begin, (*view)->changed_end);
		(*view)->changed_begin = (*view)->changed_end = 0;
	}
	if (std::ranges::find(m_active, view->get()) == m_active.end()) m_active.push_back(view->get());
	const auto& selected = **view;
	result = {.slots      = selected.buffer->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	          .slot_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(selected.slots.size() - 1u),
	          .kinds      = selected.kinds};
	return true;
}

bool ImageHeap::AcquireList(const IR::ImageHeapList& list, IR::ImageHeapView& result) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	if (list.root == nullptr) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto profile = IR::ImageHeapResource(*list.root, 0u);
	auto       memory  = std::ranges::find_if(m_list_memories, [&](const auto& candidate) {
		       return candidate->views.front()->profile == profile;
	       });
	if (memory == m_list_memories.end()) {
		const auto epoch   = Image::heap_epoch.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
		auto       created = std::make_unique<Memory>();
		created->views.push_back(std::make_unique<View>(View {.memory        = *created,
		                                                      .profile       = profile,
		                                                      .resolve_epoch = epoch,
		                                                      .layout_epoch  = epoch}));
		memory = m_list_memories.insert(m_list_memories.end(), std::move(created));
	}
	auto& view = *(*memory)->views.front();
	auto& held = m_lists[{list.owner, list.resource}];
	held.view  = &view;
	// The new references come first, so elements both lists select stay alive.
	m_scratch.clear();
	m_scratch.reserve(list.values.size());
	for (auto value: list.values) {
		const auto kind = IR::ImageHeapKind(view.profile, value);
		m_scratch.push_back(kind == 0u ? 0u : Intern(view, kind, value));
	}
	const auto slots = list.values.size() + 2u;
	for (auto slot = slots - 1u; slot < held.slots.size(); ++slot) Assign(held, slot, 0u);
	const auto previous = held.slots.size();
	held.slots.resize(slots, 0u);
	if (previous < slots) Widen(held.dirty_begin, held.dirty_end, previous, slots);
	held.dirty_end   = std::min(held.dirty_end, slots);
	held.dirty_begin = std::min(held.dirty_begin, held.dirty_end);
	for (size_t value = 0; value < m_scratch.size(); ++value) Assign(held, value + 1u, m_scratch[value]);
	if (held.buffer == nullptr || slots * sizeof(uint32_t) > held.buffer->Size()) {
		if (held.buffer != nullptr && m_context.GetCommandScheduler().Active()) {
			m_context.GetCommandScheduler().DeferOperation([buffer = std::move(held.buffer)] {});
		}
		held.buffer = SlotBuffer(m_context, (slots - 1u) * sizeof(uint32_t));
		Widen(held.dirty_begin, held.dirty_end, 0u, slots);
	}
	if (std::ranges::find(m_active, &view) == m_active.end()) m_active.push_back(&view);
	if (std::ranges::find(m_active_lists, &held) == m_active_lists.end()) {
		m_active_lists.push_back(&held);
	}
	result = {.slots      = held.buffer->BufferDeviceAddress(),
	          .slot_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(slots - 1u),
	          .kinds      = view.kinds};
	return true;
}

bool ImageHeap::Refresh(Memory& memory) {
	// GPU writes leave no fault; reading the table downloads them.
	const bool gpu_dirty = m_context.GetBufferCache().HasGpuDirtyBytes(memory.base, memory.size);
	const auto pages     = memory.dirty_pages.size();
	m_runs.clear();
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
		// Watch before reading, so a write during the read faults the page again.
		ForEachRun(
		    0, pages, [&](size_t page) { return memory.dirty_pages[page] != 0u; },
		    [&](size_t begin, size_t end) {
			    std::fill(memory.dirty_pages.begin() + begin, memory.dirty_pages.begin() + end,
			              uint8_t {0});
			    Watch<true>(memory, begin, end);
			    m_runs.emplace_back(begin, end);
		    });
	}
	if (gpu_dirty) m_runs.assign(1u, {0u, pages});
	for (size_t run = 0; run < m_runs.size(); ++run) {
		const auto [address, end] = PageRange(memory.base, memory.size, m_runs[run].first,
		                                      m_runs[run].second);
		m_scratch.resize((end - address) / 4u);
		if (!LibKernel::Memory::TryReadBufferBacking(address, m_scratch.data(), end - address)) {
			std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
			for (; run < m_runs.size(); ++run) {
				MarkDirty(memory, m_runs[run].first, m_runs[run].second);
			}
			return false;
		}
		const auto words = std::span(memory.words).subspan((address - memory.base) / 4u,
		                                                   m_scratch.size());
		size_t     first = 0;
		size_t     last  = words.size();
		while (first < last && words[first] == m_scratch[first]) ++first;
		while (first < last && words[last - 1u] == m_scratch[last - 1u]) --last;
		if (first == last) continue;
		std::copy(m_scratch.begin() + first, m_scratch.begin() + last, words.begin() + first);
		const auto offset = address - memory.base;
		for (auto& view: memory.views) {
			Widen(view->changed_begin, view->changed_end, offset + first * 4u, offset + last * 4u);
		}
	}
	return true;
}

void ImageHeap::MarkDirty(Memory& memory, size_t begin, size_t end) {
	ForEachRun(
	    begin, end, [&](size_t page) { return memory.dirty_pages[page] == 0u; },
	    [&](size_t first, size_t last) {
		    std::fill(memory.dirty_pages.begin() + first, memory.dirty_pages.begin() + last,
		              uint8_t {1});
		    Watch<false>(memory, first, last);
	    });
}

template <bool track>
void ImageHeap::Watch(const Memory& memory, size_t begin, size_t end) {
	const auto [address, limit] = PageRange(memory.base, memory.size, begin, end);
	m_page_manager.UpdatePageWatchers<track>(address, limit - address);
}

void ImageHeap::Unwatch(const Memory& memory) {
	ForEachRun(
	    0, memory.dirty_pages.size(), [&](size_t page) { return memory.dirty_pages[page] == 0u; },
	    [&](size_t begin, size_t end) { Watch<false>(memory, begin, end); });
}

void ImageHeap::InvalidateMemory(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
	std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
	for (auto& memory: m_memories) {
		// Watches cover whole pages, so a write next to the table must unwatch its page too.
		const auto origin = Common::AlignDown(memory->base, TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE);
		const auto begin  = std::max(address, origin);
		const auto end    = std::min(address + size,
		                             origin + memory->dirty_pages.size() * TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE);
		if (begin >= end) continue;
		MarkDirty(*memory, (begin - origin) / TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE,
		          (end - 1u - origin) / TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE + 1u);
	}
}

void ImageHeap::UpdateProbes(View& view, uint64_t begin, uint64_t end) {
	// A probe reads its descriptor from first + probe * step.
	const uint64_t bytes = view.profile.r128 ? 16u : 32u;
	auto probe = begin < view.first + bytes ? 0u : (begin - view.first - bytes) / view.step + 1u;
	for (; probe < view.count && view.first + probe * view.step < end; ++probe) {
		UpdateProbe(view, probe);
	}
}

void ImageHeap::UpdateProbe(View& view, uint64_t probe) {
	const auto&     words  = view.memory.words;
	const auto      offset = (view.first + probe * view.step) / 4u;
	DescriptorValue value {.dword_count = 8u};
	std::copy_n(words.begin() + offset,
	            std::min<size_t>(view.profile.r128 ? 4u : 8u, words.size() - offset),
	            value.dwords.begin());
	// A buried word stays null in every view until its descriptor changes.
	auto& dead = view.memory.dead[offset];
	if (dead != 0u && dead != DescriptorHash {}(value)) dead = 0u;
	const auto kind = dead != 0u ? 0u : IR::ImageHeapKind(view.profile, value);
	Assign(view, offset, kind == 0u ? 0u : Intern(view, kind, value));
}

void ImageHeap::Assign(View& view, size_t slot, uint32_t entry) {
	const auto previous = std::exchange(view.slots[slot], entry);
	Release(view, previous);
	if (previous != entry) Widen(view.dirty_begin, view.dirty_end, slot, slot + 1u);
}

void ImageHeap::Assign(List& list, size_t slot, uint32_t entry) {
	const auto previous = std::exchange(list.slots[slot], entry);
	Release(*list.view, previous);
	if (previous != entry) Widen(list.dirty_begin, list.dirty_end, slot, slot + 1u);
}

void ImageHeap::Bury() {
	if (m_unmapped.empty()) return;
	for (const auto& memory: m_memories) {
		for (const auto& view: memory->views) {
			bool buried = false;
			for (const auto& [value, index]: view->elements) {
				const auto& binding = m_elements[index].binding;
				if (binding.image_id && std::ranges::any_of(m_unmapped, [&](GuestRange range) {
					    return ImageRangeOverlaps(binding.desc.info.data, range);
				    })) {
					m_elements[index].stale = buried = true;
				}
			}
			if (!buried) continue;
			for (uint64_t probe = 0; probe < view->count; ++probe) {
				const auto  slot    = (view->first + probe * view->step) / 4u;
				const auto& element = m_elements[view->slots[slot] & ElementMask];
				if (!element.stale) continue;
				memory->dead[slot] = DescriptorHash {}(element.value);
				Assign(*view, slot, 0u);
			}
		}
	}
	// Record-table candidates of unmapped textures read null; a later list resolves them again.
	for (const auto& memory: m_list_memories) {
		auto& view   = *memory->views.front();
		bool  buried = false;
		for (const auto& [value, index]: view.elements) {
			const auto& binding = m_elements[index].binding;
			if (binding.image_id && std::ranges::any_of(m_unmapped, [&](GuestRange range) {
				    return ImageRangeOverlaps(binding.desc.info.data, range);
			    })) {
				m_elements[index].stale = buried = true;
			}
		}
		if (!buried) continue;
		std::erase_if(view.elements, [&](const auto& item) { return m_elements[item.second].stale; });
		for (auto& [key, list]: m_lists) {
			if (list.view != &view) continue;
			for (size_t slot = 1; slot + 1u < list.slots.size(); ++slot) {
				if (m_elements[list.slots[slot] & ElementMask].stale) Assign(list, slot, 0u);
			}
		}
	}
	m_unmapped.clear();
}

uint32_t ImageHeap::Intern(View& view, uint32_t kind, const DescriptorValue& value) {
	const auto arm = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::ranges::find(view.kind_keys, kind) -
	                                       view.kind_keys.begin());
	if (arm == view.kind_keys.size()) {
		view.kind_keys.push_back(kind);
		view.kinds.push_back(value);
	}
	auto [found, inserted] = view.elements.try_emplace(value, 0u);
	if (inserted) {
		found->second    = Allocate();
		auto& element    = m_elements[found->second];
		element.value    = value;
		element.kind     = kind;
		view.pending.push_back(found->second);
	}
	++m_elements[found->second].refs;
	return arm << IR::ImageHeapKindShift | found->second;
}

void ImageHeap::Release(View& view, uint32_t entry) {
	const auto index = entry & ElementMask;
	if (index == 0u || --m_elements[index].refs != 0u) return;
	auto& element = m_elements[index];
	if (const auto found = view.elements.find(element.value);
	    found != view.elements.end() && found->second == index) {
		view.elements.erase(found);
	}
	Unreference(element);
	view.released.push_back(index);
}

void ImageHeap::Unreference(Element& element) {
	if (auto* image = ImageOf(element)) {
		image->heap_refs.fetch_sub(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		image->tick_accessed_last = m_context.GetCommandScheduler().CurrentTick();
	}
}

Image* ImageHeap::ImageOf(const Element& element) const {
	auto* image = m_context.GetTextureCache().m_slot_images.try_get(element.binding.image_id);
	return image != nullptr && image->serial == element.serial ? image : nullptr;
}

uint32_t ImageHeap::Allocate() {
	auto& scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	while (!m_retired.empty() && scheduler.IsFree(m_retired.front().first)) {
		m_free.push_back(m_retired.front().second);
		m_retired.pop_front();
	}
	if (m_free.empty()) {
		if (m_elements.size() == IR::ImageHeapCapacity) {
			EXIT("image heaps exceed %u resident images\n", IR::ImageHeapCapacity);
		}
		m_elements.emplace_back();
		return static_cast<uint32_t>(m_elements.size() - 1u);
	}
	const auto index = m_free.back();
	m_free.pop_back();
	m_elements[index] = {};
	return index;
}

void ImageHeap::Retire(View& view) {
	if (view.released.empty()) return;
	// A retired index is reused once its tick ends, so no held entry may keep it.
	std::erase_if(view.held, [&](uint32_t index) { return m_elements[index].refs == 0u; });
	const auto tick = m_context.GetCommandScheduler().CurrentTick();
	for (const auto index: view.released) m_retired.emplace_back(tick, index);
	view.released.clear();
}

void ImageHeap::Resize(Memory& memory, uint64_t size) {
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
		Unwatch(memory);
		memory.size = size;
		// The next refresh rereads the whole table.
		memory.dirty_pages.assign((Common::AlignUp(memory.base + size, TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE) -
		                           Common::AlignDown(memory.base, TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE)) /
		                              TRACKER_PAGE_SIZE,
		                          uint8_t {1});
	}
	memory.words.resize(size / 4u);
	memory.dead.resize(size / 4u);
	auto& scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	for (auto& view: memory.views) {
		const auto count = std::min(view->limit, Probes(size, view->first, view->step));
		for (auto probe = count; probe < view->count; ++probe) {
			Assign(*view, (view->first + probe * view->step) / 4u, 0u);
		}
		view->count       = count;
		const auto slots  = view->slots.size();
		view->slots.resize(size / 4u + 1u);
		view->dirty_end   = std::min(view->dirty_end, view->slots.size());
		view->dirty_begin = std::min(view->dirty_begin, view->dirty_end);
		if (view->slots.size() * sizeof(uint32_t) > view->buffer->Size()) {
			if (scheduler.Active()) {
				scheduler.DeferOperation([buffer = std::move(view->buffer)] {});
			}
			view->buffer = SlotBuffer(m_context, size);
			Widen(view->dirty_begin, view->dirty_end, 0u, view->slots.size());
		} else if (slots < view->slots.size()) {
			// Device words past the old end may hold stale slots.
			Widen(view->dirty_begin, view->dirty_end, slots, view->slots.size());
		}
	}
}

void ImageHeap::Rebind(RenderExecutor& executor) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	auto&      textures = m_context.GetTextureCache();
	const auto epoch    = Image::heap_epoch.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
	const auto serial   = Image::serials.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
	for (auto* view: m_active) {
		bool       stale = false;
		const auto mark  = [&](uint32_t index) { m_elements[index].stale = stale = true; };
		if (view->resolve_epoch != epoch) {
			view->resolve_epoch = epoch;
			for (const auto& [value, index]: view->elements) {
				const auto& binding = m_elements[index].binding;
				if (!binding.image_id) continue;
				const auto* image = ImageOf(m_elements[index]);
				if (image == nullptr || !image->registered || image->depth_id ||
				    image->binding.needs_rebind) {
					mark(index);
				} else {
					(void)textures.FindTexture(binding.image_id, binding.desc);
				}
			}
		}
		// Discovery applies the color metadata clears written since the last draw.
		std::erase_if(view->dcc, [&](uint32_t index) {
			const auto& element = m_elements[index];
			if (element.refs == 0u || element.stale) return true;
			if (executor.ResolveTexture(IR::ImageHeapResource(view->profile, element.kind),
			                            element.value).image_id == element.binding.image_id) {
				return false;
			}
			mark(index);
			return true;
		});
		// Held elements retry once an image is created, such as a render target of their extent.
		if (view->held_serial != serial) {
			view->held_serial = serial;
			std::erase_if(view->held, [&](uint32_t index) {
				const auto& element = m_elements[index];
				if (element.refs == 0u || element.stale) return true;
				const auto binding = executor.ResolveTexture(
				    IR::ImageHeapResource(view->profile, element.kind), element.value);
				if (binding.image_id) mark(index);
				// An unmapped texture stays null.
				return binding.image_id || binding.desc.info.data.Empty();
			});
		}
		if (stale) {
			// A changed image needs a new element; pending draws still read the old one. The new
			// element keeps the old value, since a view takes table changes only when acquired.
			std::erase_if(view->elements,
			              [&](const auto& item) { return m_elements[item.second].stale; });
			for (uint64_t probe = 0; probe < view->count; ++probe) {
				const auto  slot    = (view->first + probe * view->step) / 4u;
				const auto& element = m_elements[view->slots[slot] & ElementMask];
				if (!element.stale) continue;
				const auto value = element.value; // Intern may grow m_elements.
				Assign(*view, slot, Intern(*view, element.kind, value));
			}
			// Lists of record-table candidates take the new elements as table slots do.
			for (auto& [key, list]: m_lists) {
				if (list.view != view) continue;
				for (size_t slot = 1; slot + 1u < list.slots.size(); ++slot) {
					const auto& element = m_elements[list.slots[slot] & ElementMask];
					if (!element.stale) continue;
					const auto value = element.value;
					const auto kind  = element.kind;
					Assign(list, slot, Intern(*view, kind, value));
				}
			}
		}
		for (const auto index: view->pending) {
			if (m_elements[index].refs == 0u) continue;
			auto binding = executor.ResolveTexture(
			    IR::ImageHeapResource(view->profile, m_elements[index].kind),
			    m_elements[index].value);
			if (binding.image_id) {
				auto& image = textures.GetImage(binding.image_id);
				image.heap_refs.fetch_add(1u, std::memory_order_relaxed);
				m_elements[index].serial = image.serial;
				binding.layout     = image.ReadLayout();
				binding.image_view = textures.FindTexture(binding.image_id, binding.desc);
				if (binding.desc.info.metadata.kind == ImageMetadataKind::Dcc) {
					view->dcc.push_back(index);
				}
				view->away.push_back(index);
			} else if (!binding.desc.info.data.Empty()) {
				view->held.push_back(index);
			}
			m_elements[index].binding = std::move(binding);
			m_writes.push_back(index);
		}
		view->pending.clear();
	}
	WriteDescriptors();
}

void ImageHeap::WriteDescriptors() {
	if (m_writes.empty()) return;
	std::vector<vk::DescriptorImageInfo> infos;
	std::vector<vk::WriteDescriptorSet>  writes(m_writes.size());
	infos.reserve(m_writes.size());
	for (size_t write = 0; write < m_writes.size(); ++write) {
		const auto& binding = m_elements[m_writes[write]].binding;
		infos.push_back({nullptr, binding.image_view, binding.layout});
		writes[write].dstSet          = m_set;
		writes[write].dstArrayElement = m_writes[write];
		writes[write].descriptorCount = 1;
		writes[write].descriptorType  = vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage;
		writes[write].pImageInfo      = &infos.back();
	}
	m_context.GetGraphics().device.updateDescriptorSets(static_cast<uint32_t>(writes.size()),
	                                                    writes.data(), 0, nullptr);
	m_writes.clear();
}

void ImageHeap::Upload(CommandBuffer& buffer, const std::vector<uint32_t>& slots, Buffer& device,
                       size_t& dirty_begin, size_t& dirty_end) {
	if (dirty_begin == dirty_end) return;
	const auto words  = std::span(slots).subspan(dirty_begin, dirty_end - dirty_begin);
	auto&      stream = m_context.GetBufferCache().GetUtilityBuffer(MemoryUsage::Stream);
	const auto offset = stream.Copy(words.data(), words.size_bytes(), sizeof(uint32_t));
	device.CopyFrom(buffer, stream, offset, dirty_begin * sizeof(uint32_t), words.size_bytes());
	dirty_begin = dirty_end = 0;
}

void ImageHeap::Commit(CommandBuffer& buffer, vk::PipelineBindPoint bind_point,
                       vk::PipelineLayout layout) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	const auto epoch = Image::heap_epoch.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
	for (auto* list: m_active_lists) {
		Upload(buffer, list->slots, *list->buffer, list->dirty_begin, list->dirty_end);
	}
	m_active_lists.clear();
	for (auto* view: m_active) {
		if (view->buffer != nullptr) {
			Upload(buffer, view->slots, *view->buffer, view->dirty_begin, view->dirty_end);
		}
		Retire(*view);
		if (view->layout_epoch != epoch) {
			view->layout_epoch = epoch;
			view->away.clear();
			for (const auto& [value, index]: view->elements) view->away.push_back(index);
		}
		// This draw's own bindings own the layouts of its attachments and storage images. An image
		// this draw's discovery replaced lives until the tick ends, and its slots still select it.
		std::erase_if(view->away, [&](uint32_t index) {
			const auto& element = m_elements[index];
			auto*       image   = ImageOf(element);
			if (element.refs == 0u || image == nullptr) return true;
			if (image->binding.is_target || image->binding.shader_write ||
			    image->binding.force_general) {
				return false;
			}
			const auto& view_info = element.binding.desc.view_info;
			image->Transit(image->ReadLayout(), vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead,
			               ImageSubresourceRange {view_info.base_level, view_info.level_count,
			                                      view_info.base_layer, view_info.layer_count},
			               buffer.Handle());
			return true;
		});
	}
	m_active.clear();
	buffer.Handle().bindDescriptorSets(bind_point, layout, IR::ImageHeapSet, 1, &m_set, 0,
	                                   nullptr);
}

void ImageHeap::UnmapMemory(uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
	// Descriptors of textures in the range stay null even once it is mapped again.
	if (!m_unmapped.empty() && m_unmapped.back().End() == address) {
		m_unmapped.back().size += size;
	} else {
		m_unmapped.push_back({address, size});
	}
	std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
	std::erase_if(m_memories, [&](const std::unique_ptr<Memory>& memory) {
		if (address >= memory->base + memory->size || memory->base >= address + size) {
			return false;
		}
		Drop(*memory);
		return true;
	});
}

void ImageHeap::RunGarbageCollector() {
	// A smaller table rebuilt each frame moves to a new base. Larger ones keep their dead words.
	std::scoped_lock lock {m_mutex};
	std::erase_if(m_memories, [&](const std::unique_ptr<Memory>& memory) {
		if (memory->size >= MinTableBytes || memory->draw > m_suspend_draw) return false;
		Drop(*memory);
		return true;
	});
	m_suspend_draw = m_draw;
	m_sightings.clear();
}

void ImageHeap::Drop(Memory& memory) {
	auto& scheduler = m_context.GetCommandScheduler();
	Unwatch(memory);
	for (auto& view: memory.views) {
		std::erase(m_active, view.get());
		for (const auto& [value, index]: view->elements) {
			Unreference(m_elements[index]);
			view->released.push_back(index);
		}
		Retire(*view);
		if (scheduler.Active()) {
			scheduler.DeferOperation([buffer = std::move(view->buffer)] {});
		}
	}
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_IMAGEHEAP_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_IMAGEHEAP_H_

#include "common/common.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/descriptors.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/passes/SrtWalker.h"

#include <deque>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

class Buffer;
class CommandBuffer;
class PageManager;
class RenderContext;
class RenderExecutor;
struct ImageHeapTestAccess;

// Guest image tables that shaders index by GPU-computed offsets, kept resident in one bindless
// sampled-image array. A table is keyed by its base and follows its descriptor's size. Each view
// of a table owns device slot words, one per table dword, that select an array element. CPU
// writes to a table fault in its snapshot, which each draw refreshes once; a view takes the
// changes when a draw first acquires it. Changes to the images behind elements bump
// Image::heap_epoch. A smaller table leaves at a suspend point if the frame did not acquire it.
class ImageHeap final: public ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageHeapSource {
public:
	ImageHeap(RenderContext& context, PageManager& page_manager);
	~ImageHeap();
	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(ImageHeap);

	// Starts a draw or dispatch, before its programs acquire views.
	void BeginDraw() {
		++m_draw;
		Bury();
	}
	bool Acquire(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageHeapRequest& request,
	             ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageHeapView&          result) override;
	// The candidates of a root that selects descriptors through records. Roots with one profile
	// share a view (and so its elements and kinds); each root owns the slots of its last list.
	bool AcquireList(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageHeapList& list,
	                 ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageHeapView&       result) override;
	// Image discovery: resolves new elements and rediscovers changed images.
	void Rebind(RenderExecutor& executor);
	// Recording: uploads slots, moves resident images to their read layout and binds the array.
	void Commit(CommandBuffer& buffer, vk::PipelineBindPoint bind_point, vk::PipelineLayout layout);
	// CPU write fault, on any thread.
	void InvalidateMemory(uint64_t address, uint64_t size);
	void UnmapMemory(uint64_t address, uint64_t size);
	// At a suspend point.
	void RunGarbageCollector();

private:
	using DescriptorValue = ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue;

	struct DescriptorHash {
		size_t operator()(const DescriptorValue& value) const noexcept;
	};
	struct ListKey {
		const void* owner    = nullptr;
		uint32_t    resource = 0;
		bool        operator==(const ListKey&) const = default;
	};
	struct ListKeyHash {
		size_t operator()(const ListKey& key) const noexcept {
			return std::hash<const void*> {}(key.owner) ^ (size_t {key.resource} * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
		}
	};

	struct Element {
		DescriptorValue value;
		TextureBinding  binding;
		uint32_t        kind   = 0;
		uint32_t        refs   = 0; // Slots of the owning view that select it.
		bool            stale  = false;
		uint64_t        serial = 0; // Image::serial of binding.image_id.
	};

	struct Memory;

	struct View {
		Memory&                             memory;
		uint64_t                            step  = 0;
		uint64_t                            first = 0;
		uint64_t                            count = 0;
		uint64_t                            limit = 0; // Probes a key domain allows, if fewer.
		ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource profile;
		std::vector<uint32_t>               slots; // Plus a trailing null slot.
		std::vector<uint32_t>               kind_keys;
		std::vector<DescriptorValue>        kinds; // One representative per kind_keys entry.
		std::unordered_map<DescriptorValue, uint32_t, DescriptorHash> elements;
		std::vector<uint32_t>   pending;  // Not yet resolved.
		std::vector<uint32_t>   released; // No slot selects them after the next upload.
		std::vector<uint32_t>   away;     // Not yet moved to the read layout.
		std::vector<uint32_t>   dcc;      // Color metadata clears apply on each discovery.
		std::vector<uint32_t>   held;     // Another extent holds their address.
		std::unique_ptr<Buffer> buffer;
		size_t                  dirty_begin   = 0; // Slots to upload.
		size_t                  dirty_end     = 0;
		size_t                  changed_begin = 0; // Table bytes changed since it was probed.
		size_t                  changed_end   = 0;
		uint64_t                resolve_epoch = 0;
		uint64_t                layout_epoch  = 0;
		uint64_t                held_serial   = 0; // Image::serials when held was last retried.
	};

	struct Memory {
		uint64_t                           base = 0;
		uint64_t                           size = 0;
		std::vector<uint32_t>              words;
		std::vector<uint8_t>               dirty_pages; // Unwatched, so unread since a write.
		std::vector<uint64_t>              dead;        // Per word, a buried descriptor's hash.
		uint64_t                           draw = 0;    // Last draw that refreshed it.
		std::vector<std::unique_ptr<View>> views;
	};

	// A root's record-table candidates: slots like a view's, which select elements of its view.
	struct List {
		View*                   view = nullptr;
		std::vector<uint32_t>   slots; // Null slot, one per candidate, trailing null slot.
		std::unique_ptr<Buffer> buffer;
		size_t                  dirty_begin = 0; // Slots to upload.
		size_t                  dirty_end   = 0;
	};

	[[nodiscard]] bool Refresh(Memory& memory);
	void               MarkDirty(Memory& memory, size_t begin, size_t end);
	template <bool track>
	void     Watch(const Memory& memory, size_t begin, size_t end);
	void     Unwatch(const Memory& memory);
	void     Drop(Memory& memory);
	void     UpdateProbes(View& view, uint64_t begin, uint64_t end);
	void     UpdateProbe(View& view, uint64_t probe);
	void     Assign(View& view, size_t slot, uint32_t entry);
	void     Assign(List& list, size_t slot, uint32_t entry);
	void     Upload(CommandBuffer& buffer, const std::vector<uint32_t>& slots, Buffer& device,
	                size_t& dirty_begin, size_t& dirty_end);
	void     Bury();
	uint32_t Intern(View& view, uint32_t kind, const DescriptorValue& value);
	void     Release(View& view, uint32_t entry);
	void     Unreference(Element& element);
	Image*   ImageOf(const Element& element) const;
	uint32_t Allocate();
	void     Retire(View& view);
	void     Resize(Memory& memory, uint64_t size);
	void     WriteDescriptors();

	RenderContext&                       m_context;
	PageManager&                         m_page_manager;
	std::mutex                           m_mutex; // Fault-visible Memory state and m_memories.
	std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Memory>> m_memories;
	// Views of record-table candidates, one per profile (Memory holds no table), and each root's
	// last list.
	std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Memory>>          m_list_memories;
	std::unordered_map<ListKey, List, ListKeyHash> m_lists;
	std::vector<View*>                   m_active; // Acquired since the last commit.
	std::vector<List*>                   m_active_lists;
	uint64_t                             m_draw         = 1;
	uint64_t                             m_suspend_draw = 0; // m_draw at the last suspend point.
	std::vector<Element>                 m_elements;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                m_free;
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint64_t>    m_sightings; // Smaller tables: base, first draw.
	std::deque<std::pair<uint64_t, uint32_t>> m_retired; // Tick, element.
	std::vector<std::pair<size_t, size_t>>    m_runs;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_scratch;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_writes; // Elements whose descriptors changed.
	std::vector<GuestRange>                   m_unmapped; // Since the last Bury.
	vk::DescriptorSetLayout                   m_layout = nullptr;
	vk::DescriptorPool                        m_pool   = nullptr;
	vk::DescriptorSet                         m_set    = nullptr;

	friend struct ImageHeapTestAccess;
};

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_IMAGEHEAP_H_
```

```cpp
constexpr auto DriverCacheSaveInterval = std::chrono::minutes {1};
// After a pipeline that took this long to create, the driver cache is written sooner, but no more
// often than SlowCreationSaveInterval: the whole cache is written each time (hundreds of MB for some
// games), and with cold caches (a manifest replayed while the game loads) nearly every creation is

uint8_t RemapSourceAlphaFactor(uint8_t factor) {
	switch (static_cast<Prospero::BlendFactor>(factor)) {
		case Prospero::BlendFactor::kSrcAlpha:
			return static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kSrc1Alpha);
		case Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusSrcAlpha:
			return static_cast<uint8_t>(Prospero::BlendFactor::kOneMinusSrc1Alpha);
		default: return factor;
	}
}

vk::PolygonMode ResolvePolygonMode(const HW::ModeControl& mode, bool cull_front, bool cull_back) {
	// PA_SU_SC_MODE_CNTL.POLY_MODE disables both per-face modes when it is zero.
	if (mode.poly_mode == 0) {
		return vk::PolygonMode::eFill;
	}
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(mode.poly_mode != 1);
	if (cull_front && cull_back) {
		return vk::PolygonMode::eFill;
	}
	if (!cull_front && !cull_back && mode.polymode_front_ptype != mode.polymode_back_ptype) {
		EXIT("Pipeline: different polygon modes for two visible faces are unsupported\n");
	}
	// Vulkan has one polygon mode. A culled face does not constrain that mode.
	const auto polygon_mode = cull_front ? mode.polymode_back_ptype : mode.polymode_front_ptype;
	switch (polygon_mode) {
		case 0: return vk::PolygonMode::ePoint;
		case 1: return vk::PolygonMode::eLine;
		case 2: return vk::PolygonMode::eFill;
		default: EXIT("Pipeline: invalid polygon mode %u\n", polygon_mode);
	}
}

// Compute programs compiled with the native ray tracing patching on (see RayTracingPatch.h: the
// compiler patches the ones whose traversal loops it recognizes) differ from the stored software
// ones: they get their own program keys. `native`: false for the program of a dispatch without
// a TLAS (see PipelineCache::GetComputeProgram()).
void AppendNativeRayTracingKey(ShaderType stage, std::vector<uint32_t>& key, bool native = true) {
	if (native && stage == ShaderType::Compute && NativeRayTracing::PatchShaders()) {
		key.push_back(0x52545041u);
	}
}

// Whether the dispatch of a patched program reads a null TLAS header address from its flattened
// SRT (ShaderInfo::ray_query_header_slots): it has nothing to trace with the host structures.
bool ReadsNullTlas(const ShaderModule& module, const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSnapshot& resources) {
	const auto& info  = module.info.info;
	const auto& slots = info.ray_query_header_slots;
	const auto& flat  = resources.flattened_srt;
	return info.ray_query && slots[0] < flat.size() && slots[1] < flat.size() && flat[slots[0]] == 0 &&
	       flat[slots[1]] == 0;
}

std::string DriverCacheSignature(const vk::PhysicalDeviceProperties& properties) {
	constexpr char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
	std::string    uuid(VK_UUID_SIZE * 2, '0');
	for (size_t i = 0; i < VK_UUID_SIZE; i++) {
		uuid[i * 2]     = hex[properties.pipelineCacheUUID[i] >> 4u];
		uuid[i * 2 + 1] = hex[properties.pipelineCacheUUID[i] & 0xfu];
	}
	// Driver cache entries already distinguish shader code and pipeline state across builds.
	return fmt::format("KytyPC2:{:08x}:{:08x}:{:08x}:{}\n",
	                   properties.vendorID, properties.deviceID, properties.driverVersion, uuid);
}

	message += '\n';
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(message);

bool ReadAheadStrict(void* userdata, uint64_t address, std::span<uint32_t> values) {
	return !values.empty() && static_cast<GuestReadLog*>(userdata)->Read(address, values.data(),
	                                                                     values.size_bytes(), true);
}

bool ReadAheadShaderState(void* userdata, uint64_t address, void* data, uint64_t size) {
	// A table pointer below guest memory (0x40000) is null: the speculative walk follows both sides
	// of a branch it cannot decide and reads through it on the side the shader never takes.
	// Reading zero there is what the speculative walk means, as in upstream's x86 walker, and the
	// bytes are zero for every thread, so they need neither the backing nor a validation entry.
	if (address < 0x40000u && size != 0u) {
		std::memset(data, 0, size);
		return true;
	}
	return static_cast<GuestReadLog*>(userdata)->Read(address, data, size, false);
}

// The buffer ranges the dispatches and draws resolved lately ahead of execution write (resolution
// thread only): the GPU produces their bytes, and a walk ahead does not read there a load that
// only decides control flow (see SrtRuntime::gpu_produced), as the writer may not have run yet.
// Walks ask for most such loads, nearly all of them outside these ranges: a counting filter of
// the 64 KB blocks the ranges cover answers those without scanning the ranges.
struct AheadWrites {
	static constexpr size_t   Capacity        = 256;
	static constexpr uint64_t BlockShift      = 16;
	static constexpr size_t   FilterBits      = 12;
	static constexpr uint64_t MaxFilterBlocks = 4096; // Wider ranges (256 MB) are always scanned.
	std::array<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>, Capacity> ranges {};
	std::array<uint16_t, size_t {1} << FilterBits>     filter {};
	uint32_t                                            wide = 0;
	size_t                                              next = 0;

	static size_t Slot(uint64_t block) {
		return static_cast<size_t>((block * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull) >> (64u - FilterBits));
	}
	void Count(uint64_t begin, uint64_t end, int delta) {
		if (begin >= end) return;
		const auto first = begin >> BlockShift;
		const auto last  = (end - 1) >> BlockShift;
		if (last - first >= MaxFilterBlocks) {
			wide = static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int>(wide) + delta);
			return;
		}
		for (auto block = first; block <= last; block++) {
			auto& count = filter[Slot(block)];
			count       = static_cast<uint16_t>(count + delta);
		}
	}
	void Add(uint64_t begin, uint64_t end) {
		for (const auto& [b, e]: ranges) {
			if (b == begin && e == end) return;
		}
		Count(ranges[next].first, ranges[next].second, -1);
		ranges[next] = {begin, end};
		Count(begin, end, 1);
		next = (next + 1) % Capacity;
	}
	[[nodiscard]] bool Contains(uint64_t address) const {
		if (wide == 0 && filter[Slot(address >> BlockShift)] == 0) return false;
		for (const auto& [begin, end]: ranges) {
			if (address >= begin && address < end) return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
};
thread_local AheadWrites t_ahead_writes;
// Whether the walk of the stage being resolved left a GPU-produced load unread.
thread_local bool t_ahead_unread_load = false;

bool AheadGpuProduced(uint64_t address) {
	if (!t_ahead_writes.Contains(address)) return false;
	t_ahead_unread_load = true;
	return true;
}

void NoteAheadWrites(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourcePlan&     plan,
                     const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSnapshot& resources) {
	for (size_t i = 0; i < plan.info.buffers.size() && i < resources.buffers.size(); i++) {
		const auto& descriptor = resources.buffers[i];
		if (!plan.info.buffers[i].written || descriptor.dword_count != 4u) continue;
		// The V#'s base and size (NUM_RECORDS records of STRIDE bytes, or bytes without a stride).
		const uint64_t base    = descriptor.dwords[0] | (uint64_t {descriptor.dwords[1] & 0xffffu} << 32u);
		const uint32_t stride  = (descriptor.dwords[1] >> 16u) & 0x3fffu;
		const uint64_t size    = uint64_t {descriptor.dwords[2]} * (stride != 0u ? stride : 1u);
		if (base != 0 && size != 0) t_ahead_writes.Add(base, base + size);
	}
}

void RecordAheadLoad(void* userdata, uint64_t address, uint32_t value, uint32_t flat_slot) {
	static_cast<GuestReadLog*>(userdata)->RecordLoad(address, value, flat_slot);
}

class ProgramLockGuard {
public:
	explicit ProgramLockGuard(std::atomic_flag& flag): m_flag(flag) {
		while (m_flag.test_and_set(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
			while (m_flag.test(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
				Common::SpinPause();
			}
		}
	}
	~ProgramLockGuard() { m_flag.clear(std::memory_order_release); }
	ProgramLockGuard(const ProgramLockGuard&)            = delete;
	ProgramLockGuard& operator=(const ProgramLockGuard&) = delete;

private:
	std::atomic_flag& m_flag;
};

bool ReadShaderGuestMemory(void*, uint64_t address, std::span<uint32_t> values) {
	// Scalar and unformatted buffer dependencies use the same backing as native raw loads.
	// Image synchronization belongs to formatted buffer bindings, not these reads.
	return !values.empty() &&
	       Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadBufferBacking(address, values.data(), values.size_bytes());
}

void DumpShader(std::span<const uint32_t> words, const std::string& name) {
	if (!Config::GraphicsDebugDumpEnabled()) {
		return;
	}
	const auto path = Config::GetShaderLogFolder() / name;
	Common::File::CreateDirectories(path.parent_path());
	Common::File file(path);
	if (file.IsInvalid()) {
		const auto path_text = Common::PathToString(path);
		LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::BrightRed, "Can't create file: %s\n", path_text.c_str());
		return;
	}
	file.Write(words.data(), words.size_bytes());
}

void ValidateShaderSpirv(const char* stage, uint64_t shader_hash,
                         const std::vector<uint32_t>& spirv, bool maintenance8_enabled) {
	if (!Config::ShaderValidationEnabled()) {
		return;
	}
	spvtools::SpirvTools tools(SPV_ENV_VULKAN_1_3);
	std::string          messages;
	tools.SetMessageConsumer([&messages](spv_message_level_t, const char*,
	                                     const spv_position_t& position, const char* message) {
		messages += fmt::format("{}: {} ({}) {}\n", static_cast<int>(position.line),
		                        static_cast<int>(position.column), static_cast<int>(position.index),
		                        message);
	});
	spvtools::ValidatorOptions validator_options;
	validator_options.SetAllowOffsetTextureOperand(maintenance8_enabled);
	if (tools.Validate(spirv.data(), spirv.size(), validator_options)) {
		return;
	}
	spvtools::SpirvTools disassembler(SPV_ENV_VULKAN_1_2);
	std::string          text;
	disassembler.Disassemble(spirv, &text,
	                         static_cast<uint32_t>(SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_NO_HEADER) |
	                             static_cast<uint32_t>(SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_FRIENDLY_NAMES) |
	                             static_cast<uint32_t>(SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_COMMENT) |
	                             static_cast<uint32_t>(SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_INDENT) |
	                             static_cast<uint32_t>(SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_COLOR));
	LOGF("%s\n", text.c_str());
	EXIT("ShaderRecompiler %s SPIR-V validation failed hash=0x%016" PRIx64 ":\n%s", stage,
	     shader_hash, messages.c_str());
}

// Formats with a narrower host variant drop the components the shader does not read.
vk::Format NarrowInputFormat(vk::Format format, uint32_t used_components) {
	switch (format) {
		case vk::Format::eR32G32B32A32Sfloat:
			switch (used_components) {
				case 1: return vk::Format::eR32Sfloat;
				case 2: return vk::Format::eR32G32Sfloat;
				case 3: return vk::Format::eR32G32B32Sfloat;
				default: return format;
			}
		case vk::Format::eR32G32B32Sfloat:
			switch (used_components) {
				case 1: return vk::Format::eR32Sfloat;
				case 2: return vk::Format::eR32G32Sfloat;
				default: return format;
			}
		case vk::Format::eR16G16B16A16Sfloat:
			switch (used_components) {
				case 1: return vk::Format::eR16Sfloat;
				case 2: return vk::Format::eR16G16Sfloat;
				default: return format;
			}
		case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Unorm:
			switch (used_components) {
				case 1: return vk::Format::eR8Unorm;
				case 2: return vk::Format::eR8G8Unorm;
				default: return format;
			}
		case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Snorm:
			return used_components == 2 ? vk::Format::eR8G8Snorm : format;
		case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Uint:
			switch (used_components) {
				case 1: return vk::Format::eR8Uint;
				case 2: return vk::Format::eR8G8Uint;
				default: return format;
			}
		default: return format;
	}
}

vk::Format InputFormat(const ShaderBufferResource& resource, uint32_t used_components) {
	switch (resource.RawFormat()) {
		// Temporary: invalid PS5 buffer format 113 (VertexAttribFormat::k16_16SInt).
		case 113: return NarrowInputFormat(vk::Format::eR32G32B32A32Sfloat, used_components);
		case 121: return vk::Format::eR16G16Sfloat;
		default: break;
	}
	const auto format = VulkanFormat(resource.Format());
	if (format == vk::Format::eUndefined ||
	    ShaderRecompiler::Format::GetFormatInfo(resource.Format()).component_count == 0) {
		EXIT("unknown vertex format: fmt = %u\n", resource.RawFormat());
	}
	return NarrowInputFormat(format, used_components);
}

// The host format of each vertex input attribute, narrowed to the components the stage reads.
std::vector<vk::Format> VertexInputFormats(const ShaderVertexInputInfo&                    input_info,
                                           const ShaderRecompiler::IR::CompiledShaderInfo& program) {
	std::vector<vk::Format> formats(input_info.resources_num);
	for (int index = 0; index < input_info.resources_num; index++) {
		const auto registers_num = input_info.resources_dst[index].registers_num;
		EXIT_IF(registers_num < 1 || registers_num > 4);
		const auto fetched = program.info.vertex_fetch_components[index];
		formats[index] = InputFormat(input_info.resources[index],
		                             fetched > 0 ? fetched : static_cast<uint32_t>(registers_num));
	}
	return formats;
}

// A shader whose call targets are GPU data runs the functions its call tables name: a table that
// does not expand (not mapped, a target that is not a leaf function) leaves nothing to run.
[[noreturn]] void ExitCallExpansionFailure(uint64_t hash, const ShaderRecompiler::ShaderSource& source) {
	EXIT("shader 0x%016" PRIx64 ": its call tables do not expand: %s\n", hash,
	     source.refresh_failure.c_str());
}

} // namespace

std::string PipelineCacheTitleId() {
	std::string title_id;
	if ((!Loader::SystemContentParamSfoGetString("TITLE_ID", &title_id) || title_id.empty()) &&
	    (!Loader::SystemContentParamSfoGetString("CONTENT_ID", &title_id) || title_id.empty())) {
		return {};
	}
	if (!std::ranges::all_of(title_id, [](unsigned char c) {
		    return std::isalnum(c) != 0 || c == '-' || c == '_';
	    })) {
		return {};
	}
	return title_id;
}

ShaderRecompiler::Spirv::Profile SpirvProfile(const GraphicContext& graphics) {
	// AMD GPUs (vendor 0x1002) run NMin/NMax as v_min/v_max, which give the guest's NaN and
	// signed-zero results; GLSL.std.450 alone does not order -0 below +0.
	return {.maintenance8           = graphics.maintenance8_enabled,
	        .native_float_min_max   = graphics.physical_device_properties.vendorID == 0x1002u &&
	                                std::getenv("KYTY_EMULATED_FLOAT_MIN_MAX") == nullptr,
	        .device_clock_period_ps = graphics.device_clock_period_ps,
	        .robust_buffer_access   = graphics.robust_buffer_access_enabled,
	        .r8_srgb_views          = graphics.r8_srgb_views,
	        .r8g8_srgb_views        = graphics.r8g8_srgb_views};
}

std::filesystem::path ShaderStorePath() {
	if (KYTY_BUILD != KYTY_BUILD_RELEASE || !Config::ShaderCacheEnabled() ||
	    Config::GraphicsDebugDumpEnabled()) {
		return {};
	}
	const auto title_id = PipelineCacheTitleId();
	if (title_id.empty()) {
		return {};
	}
	return std::filesystem::path("_PipelineCache") / (title_id + ".shaders");
}

void GuestReadLog::Append(uint64_t address, const void* data, uint32_t size, bool strict) {
	m_gpu_written = m_gpu_written || Libs::LibKernel::Memory::MayBeGpuWritten(address, size);
	const auto offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_bytes.size());
	m_bytes.insert(m_bytes.end(), static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data),
	               static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data) + size);
	// Contiguous reads of the same kind are checked as one (strict reads up to the size the
	// check reads at once).
	if (!m_entries.empty()) {
		auto& last = m_entries.back();
		if (last.strict == strict && last.address + last.size == address &&
		    last.offset + last.size == offset &&
		    (!strict || last.size + size <= StrictCheckBytes)) {
			last.size += size;
			return;
		}
	}
	m_entries.push_back({address, size, offset, strict});
}

bool GuestReadLog::Read(uint64_t address, void* data, uint64_t size, bool strict) {
	if (size == 0 || size > UINT32_MAX ||
	    !Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadBacking(address, data, size)) {
		m_failed = true;
		return false;
	}
	Append(address, data, static_cast<uint32_t>(size), strict);
	return true;
}

void GuestReadLog::RecordLoad(uint64_t address, uint32_t value, uint32_t flat_slot) {
	if (ShaderRecompiler::IR::IsDescriptorSlot(flat_slot)) {
		const auto source = ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorSlotSource(flat_slot);
		const auto word   = ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorSlotWord(flat_slot);
		const auto kind   = m_plan != nullptr && source < m_plan->descriptor_refresh.size()
		                        ? m_plan->descriptor_refresh[source]
		                        : ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorRefresh::None;
		const auto offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_bytes.size());
		Append(address, &value, sizeof(value), false);
		const auto mask = ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorRefreshMask(kind, word);
		if (mask != 0) {
			auto&      entry = m_entries.back();
			const auto index = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_words.size());
			m_words.push_back(
			    {.offset = offset, .stage = m_stage, .source = source, .word = word, .mask = mask});
			if (entry.words_begin == entry.words_end) {
				entry.words_begin = index;
			}
			entry.words_end = index + 1;
		}
		return;
	}
	if (flat_slot != ShaderRecompiler::IR::NoFlatSlot) {
		if (!m_flat_loads.empty()) {
			auto& last = m_flat_loads.back();
			const auto next = last.address + uint64_t {last.count} * sizeof(uint32_t);
			if (last.stage == m_stage && next == address && last.slot + last.count == flat_slot &&
			    (address & 0xfffu) != 0) {
				last.count++;
				return;
			}
		}
		m_flat_loads.push_back({address, m_stage, flat_slot, 1});
		return;
	}
	Append(address, &value, sizeof(value), false);
}

void GuestReadLog::RefreshFlatLoads(std::span<ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSnapshot> resources,
                                    bool gpu_copies) const {
	for (auto& snapshot: resources) {
		snapshot.gpu_flat_loads.clear();
	}
	// As the execution thread's own walk loads: around the GPU's writes on the pages it owns,
	// directly elsewhere.
	// The loads of a draw alternate between a few pages, mostly those StillValid() just decided:
	// its answers still hold. A page it read back since no longer faults, and reading it around
	// the GPU's writes then finds no dirty bytes and takes the backing, which holds them.
	auto& checked = m_checked;
	for (const auto& load: m_flat_loads) {
		if (load.stage >= resources.size() ||
		    uint64_t {load.slot} + load.count > resources[load.stage].flattened_srt.size()) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto page_index = load.address >> 12u;
		auto&      page       = checked[page_index % checked.size()];
		if (page.page != page_index) {
			page.page    = page_index;
			page.owned   = Libs::LibKernel::Memory::MayFaultOnGpuRead(load.address & ~0xfffull, 4096);
			page.backing = page.owned ? Libs::LibKernel::Memory::FindAroundBackingPage(load.address)
			                          : nullptr;
		}
		auto*      values = resources[load.stage].flattened_srt.data() + load.slot;
		const auto bytes  = load.count * sizeof(uint32_t);
		// Bytes the GPU wrote to a cached buffer (no GPU-written image covers the page): reading
		// them here waits for the GPU (through the mirror or a readback). The shader reads them
		// when it runs, after the work that writes them: a copy on the GPU puts them there in time.
		if (gpu_copies && page.owned && page.backing != nullptr &&
		    Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HasGpuWrittenBytes(load.address, bytes)) {
			resources[load.stage].gpu_flat_loads.push_back({load.address, load.slot, load.count});
			continue;
		}
		const bool around =
		    page.owned &&
		    (page.backing != nullptr ? Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadAroundGpuWritesOnPage(
		                                   load.address, values, bytes, page.backing)
		                             : Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadAroundGpuWrites(
		                                   load.address, values, bytes));
		if (!around) {
			// The mirror did not hold them yet: the same copy instead of a readback.
			if (gpu_copies && page.owned && page.backing != nullptr) {
				resources[load.stage].gpu_flat_loads.push_back({load.address, load.slot, load.count});
				continue;
			}
			std::memcpy(values, reinterpret_cast<const void*>(load.address), bytes);
		}
	}
}

void GuestReadLog::ReadNow(const Entry& entry, uint8_t* bytes) const {
	if (!Libs::LibKernel::Memory::MayFaultOnGpuRead(entry.address, entry.size) ||
	    !Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadAroundGpuWrites(entry.address, bytes, entry.size)) {
		std::memcpy(bytes, reinterpret_cast<const void*>(entry.address), entry.size);
	}
}

bool GuestReadLog::OnlyRefreshableBitsChanged(const Entry& entry) const {
	static thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> now;
	now.resize(entry.size);
	ReadNow(entry, now.data());
	const auto* recorded = m_bytes.data() + entry.offset;
	auto        word     = entry.words_begin;
	for (uint32_t done = 0; done < entry.size; done += sizeof(uint32_t)) {
		uint32_t current  = 0;
		uint32_t previous = 0;
		const auto bytes  = std::min<uint32_t>(entry.size - done, sizeof(uint32_t));
		std::memcpy(&current, now.data() + done, bytes);
		std::memcpy(&previous, recorded + done, bytes);
		while (word < entry.words_end && m_words[word].offset < entry.offset + done) {
			word++;
		}
		const auto mask = word < entry.words_end && m_words[word].offset == entry.offset + done
		                      ? m_words[word].mask
		                      : 0u;
		if (((current ^ previous) & ~mask) != 0) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

void GuestReadLog::RefreshDescriptorWords(
    std::span<ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSnapshot>          resources,
    std::span<const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourcePlan* const> plans) const {
	using ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorRefresh;
	static thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> now;
	for (const auto index: m_refresh) {
		const auto& entry = m_entries[index];
		now.resize(entry.size);
		ReadNow(entry, now.data());
		for (uint32_t w = entry.words_begin; w < entry.words_end; w++) {
			const auto& load = m_words[w];
			uint32_t    value    = 0;
			uint32_t    previous = 0;
			std::memcpy(&value, now.data() + (load.offset - entry.offset), sizeof(value));
			std::memcpy(&previous, m_bytes.data() + load.offset, sizeof(previous));
			if (value == previous || load.stage >= resources.size() || load.stage >= plans.size() ||
			    plans[load.stage] == nullptr) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto& plan     = *plans[load.stage];
			auto&       snapshot = resources[load.stage];
			// The shader reads the same dword from the flattened SRT.
			const auto flat_word = uint64_t {load.source} * 8u + load.word;
			if (flat_word < plan.descriptor_word_flat.size() &&
			    plan.descriptor_word_flat[flat_word] < snapshot.flattened_srt.size()) {
				snapshot.flattened_srt[plan.descriptor_word_flat[flat_word]] = value;
			}
			// Descriptors the materialization cleared (invalid, unreached or of another type)
			// stay cleared: the refreshed bits do not decide that.
			const auto refresh = [&](ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue& descriptor) {
				if (load.word >= descriptor.dword_count ||
				    std::ranges::all_of(descriptor.dwords, [](uint32_t dword) { return dword == 0; })) {
					return;
				}
				descriptor.dwords[load.word] =
				    (descriptor.dwords[load.word] & ~load.mask) | (value & load.mask);
			};
			const auto kind = load.source < plan.descriptor_refresh.size()
			                      ? plan.descriptor_refresh[load.source]
			                      : DescriptorRefresh::None;
			if (kind == DescriptorRefresh::Buffer) {
				for (uint32_t k = 0; k < plan.info.buffers.size() && k < snapshot.buffers.size(); ++k) {
					if (plan.info.buffers[k].source == load.source) refresh(snapshot.buffers[k]);
				}
			} else if (kind == DescriptorRefresh::Image) {
				for (uint32_t k = 0; k < plan.info.images.size() && k < snapshot.images.size(); ++k) {
					if (plan.info.images[k].source == load.source) refresh(snapshot.images[k]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	m_refresh.clear();
}

// Most logged reads are a few dwords: compare those without a call.
static bool SameGuestBytes(const void* guest, const uint8_t* recorded, uint32_t size) {
	const auto load = [](const void* address, uint32_t offset, auto value) {
		std::memcpy(&value, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(address) + offset, sizeof(value));
		return value;
	};
	switch (size) {
		case 4: return load(guest, 0, uint32_t {}) == load(recorded, 0, uint32_t {});
		case 8: return load(guest, 0, uint64_t {}) == load(recorded, 0, uint64_t {});
		case 16:
			return ((load(guest, 0, uint64_t {}) ^ load(recorded, 0, uint64_t {})) |
			        (load(guest, 8, uint64_t {}) ^ load(recorded, 8, uint64_t {}))) == 0;
		case 32:
			return ((load(guest, 0, uint64_t {}) ^ load(recorded, 0, uint64_t {})) |
			        (load(guest, 8, uint64_t {}) ^ load(recorded, 8, uint64_t {})) |
			        (load(guest, 16, uint64_t {}) ^ load(recorded, 16, uint64_t {})) |
			        (load(guest, 24, uint64_t {}) ^ load(recorded, 24, uint64_t {}))) == 0;
		default: return std::memcmp(guest, recorded, size) == 0;
	}
}

bool GuestReadLog::StillValid() const {
	m_refresh.clear();
	if (m_failed) {
		return false;
	}
	std::array<uint8_t, StrictCheckBytes> buffer {};
	// Most entries lie on pages the GPU does not own: decide that once per page. The entries of
	// a draw alternate between a few pages (its descriptor tables and the GPU-owned pages around
	// them), so the last pages are kept, with the backing bytes of the GPU-owned ones for reading
	// around the GPU's writes there (see FindAroundBackingPage()). RefreshFlatLoads() reuses them.
	auto& checked = m_checked;
	checked.fill({});
	// An entry with descriptor words compares its other bits.
	const auto refreshable = [&](const Entry& entry) {
		if (entry.words_begin == entry.words_end || !OnlyRefreshableBitsChanged(entry)) {
			return false;
		}
		m_refresh.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(&entry - m_entries.data()));
		return true;
	};
	for (const auto& entry: m_entries) {
		const auto* recorded = m_bytes.data() + entry.offset;
		if (!entry.strict) {
			const auto  first_page   = entry.address >> 12u;
			const auto  last_page    = (entry.address + entry.size - 1) >> 12u;
			bool        gpu_owned    = false;
			const auto* page_backing = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(nullptr);
			if (first_page == last_page) {
				auto& page = checked[first_page % checked.size()];
				if (page.page != first_page) {
					page.page    = first_page;
					page.owned   = Libs::LibKernel::Memory::MayFaultOnGpuRead(entry.address, entry.size);
					page.backing = page.owned
					                   ? Libs::LibKernel::Memory::FindAroundBackingPage(entry.address)
					                   : nullptr;
				}
				gpu_owned    = page.owned;
				page_backing = page.backing;
			} else {
				gpu_owned = Libs::LibKernel::Memory::MayFaultOnGpuRead(entry.address, entry.size);
			}
			// On GPU-owned pages a direct load faults and reads back all the GPU's queued work:
			// bytes the GPU did not write compare from the backing store.
			bool around = gpu_owned;
			for (uint32_t done = 0; around && done < entry.size; done += sizeof(buffer)) {
				const auto bytes = std::min<uint32_t>(entry.size - done, sizeof(buffer));
				around           = page_backing != nullptr
				                       ? Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadAroundGpuWritesOnPage(
				                             entry.address + done, buffer.data(), bytes, page_backing)
				                       : Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadAroundGpuWrites(
				                             entry.address + done, buffer.data(), bytes);
				if (around && std::memcmp(buffer.data(), recorded + done, bytes) != 0) {
					if (!refreshable(entry)) {
						return false;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (around) {
				continue;
			}
			// A plain load, as the execution thread's own walk reads: GPU-owned pages fault and
			// read the GPU's bytes back.
			if (!SameGuestBytes(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(entry.address), recorded,
			                    entry.size) &&
			    !refreshable(entry)) {
				return false;
			}
			continue;
		}
		// As specialization memory is read on the execution thread: GPU-owned bytes fail. Large
		// reads (the key arrays of bindless tables) are checked from a scratch buffer.
		static thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> scratch;
		uint8_t* bytes = buffer.data();
		if (entry.size > buffer.size()) {
			scratch.resize(entry.size);
			bytes = scratch.data();
		}
		if (!Libs::LibKernel::Memory::TryReadGpuCleanBacking(entry.address, bytes, entry.size) ||
		    std::memcmp(bytes, recorded, entry.size) != 0) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

bool GraphicsPipelineKey::operator==(const GraphicsPipelineKey& other) const {
	return std::memcmp(this, &other, sizeof(*this)) == 0;
}

std::size_t PipelineCache::GraphicsPipelineKeyHash::operator()(const GraphicsPipelineKey& key) const {
	return XXH3_64bits(&key, sizeof(key));
}

std::span<const uint32_t> PipelineCache::Program::FunctionCode() const {
	return call_source
	    ? std::span<const uint32_t>(call_source->linked->code).subspan(call_source->code.size())
	    : std::span<const uint32_t>{};
}

bool PipelineCache::Program::RefreshCallSource(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtRuntime& runtime) {
	const auto revision = call_source->revision;
	ShaderRecompiler::RefreshShaderSource(*call_source, runtime);
	resource_plan.source_reads = call_source->reads;
	return revision != call_source->revision;
}

template <bool HasCalls>
ShaderModule* PipelineCache::Program::FindModule(const ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtRuntime& runtime,
                                                 uint32_t push_data_cursor, bool& failed) {
	failed = !ShaderRecompiler::IR::MaterializeResources(resource_plan, runtime, resources,
	                                                     specialization);
	if (failed) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	const auto matches = [&](const ShaderModule& candidate) {
		const auto& layout = candidate.info.bindings;
		if (layout.push_data_start_dword != ShaderRecompiler::IR::PushData::StartFor(
		        push_data_cursor, layout.ShaderDataDwords()) ||
		    candidate.specialization != specialization) {
			return false;
		}
		if constexpr (HasCalls) {
			if (!std::ranges::equal(candidate.function_code, FunctionCode())) return false;
		}
		return true;
	};
	auto& last = last_module[GuestGpu::IsGpuThread() ? 0u : 1u];
	if (last < modules.size() && matches(modules[last])) {
		return &modules[last];
	}
	const auto found = std::ranges::find_if(modules, matches);
	if (found == modules.end()) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	last = static_cast<size_t>(found - modules.begin());
	return &*found;
}

ShaderModule PipelineCache::BuildModule(const ProgramKey&                                  key,
                                       const ShaderRecompiler::CompileOptions&            options,
                                       ShaderRecompiler::TranslateResult                  translated,
                                       const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSpecialization& specialization,
                                       std::span<const uint32_t> function_code,
                                       uint32_t push_data_cursor, std::vector<uint32_t>& spirv,
                                       std::vector<uint32_t>& plain_spirv) const {
	Common::DebugCounters::ScopedTimer timer(Common::DebugCounters::Counter::ShadersCompiled,
	                                         Common::DebugCounters::Counter::ShaderCompileNs,
	                                         Common::DebugCounters::Peak::ShaderCompileNs);
	const auto profile         = SpirvProfile(m_graphics);
	auto       compile_options = options;
	compile_options.profile    = &profile;
	compile_options.plain_mip_stats_variant = key.stage == ShaderType::Pixel;
	auto result = ShaderRecompiler::CompileProgram(std::move(translated), compile_options,
	                                               specialization, push_data_cursor);
	auto info = std::move(result.program).TakeCompiledInfo();

	// The same inputs give the same module id across runs.
	ShaderRecompiler::IR::Writer inputs;
	ShaderRecompiler::IR::IoAll(inputs, key.stage, key.hash, key.user_data_count, key.static_state,
	                            info.bindings.push_data_start_dword, specialization);
	inputs.Raw(function_code.data(), function_code.size_bytes()); // Last, so it needs no size.
	const auto id = XXH3_64bits(inputs.bytes.data(), inputs.bytes.size());

	const auto* stage = ShaderRecompiler::StageName(key.stage);
	DumpShader(result.spirv, fmt::format("{}_{:016x}_{:016x}.spv", stage, key.hash, id));
	ValidateShaderSpirv(stage, key.hash, result.spirv, profile.maintenance8);
	ShaderModule module {
	    .id             = id,
	    .module         = CompileSPV(result.spirv, m_graphics.device),
	    .info           = std::move(info),
```
