```cpp
			    (pipeline.plain_pixel && pipeline.stages[3] == ManifestPipeline::NoStage)) {
				bad++;
				continue;
			}
			if (auto error = PipelineLinkError(pipeline, manifest.modules); !error.empty()) {
				bad++;
				if (unlinked != nullptr) {
					std::string ids;
					for (const auto token: std::span(tokens).subspan(1)) {
						if (std::ranges::any_of(PipelineStageKeys, [&](std::string_view key) {
							    return token.starts_with(key) && token.substr(key.size(), 1) == "=";
						    })) {
							ids += fmt::format("{}{}", ids.empty() ? "" : " ", token);
						}
					}
					unlinked->push_back(fmt::format("{} ({})", ids, error));
				}
				continue;
			}
			manifest.pipelines.push_back(pipeline);
		} else if (tokens[0] == "T") {
			std::pair<uint64_t, ShaderTessellationInputInfo> layout;
			if (ReadLayout(std::span(tokens).subspan(1), layout)) {
				manifest.tessellation_layouts.push_back(layout);
			} else {
				bad++;
			}
		}
	}
	set_skipped();
	return true;
}

// The manifest of the running title: what it lists (`warm`, immutable once loaded), what the
// session adds to it, and the state of the threads that compile the listed modules and pipelines.
struct PipelineCache::ManifestState {
	std::filesystem::path record_path; // Empty unless recording.
	// The shared manifest of the title (<title>_<version>.shared.kpm, which the launcher appends
	// what other players recorded to); empty when the title has no name for one.
	std::filesystem::path shared_path;
	std::jthread          watcher;
	// Only the thread that adds the listed records touches these, once the session runs: the
	// size and time of the shared file as last read, and what is listed, by identity.
	uintmax_t                             shared_size = 0;
	std::filesystem::file_time_type       shared_time {};
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t> warm_index;
	std::unordered_set<uint64_t>          warm_pipeline_ids;
	std::unordered_set<uint64_t>          warm_layout_keys;

	// Under `mutex`, from here on.
	std::mutex mutex;
	// The listed records (immutable once added, and they only grow, so references to them stay
	// valid): those of the files loaded at the start and those that arrive while the game runs.
	std::deque<ManifestModule>   warm_modules;
	std::deque<ManifestPipeline> warm_pipelines;
	// What the files listed at the start and what the session recorded or built of what is listed
	// since, by identity.
	PipelineManifest                       recorded;
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t> module_index;
	std::unordered_set<uint64_t>           pipeline_identities;
	std::unordered_set<uint64_t>           layout_keys;
	// This session's module ids, while recording: their record in `recorded` and whether the id is
	// the plain variant's.
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::pair<uint32_t, bool>> module_records;
	bool                                                    dirty           = false;
	uint32_t                                                added_modules   = 0;
	uint32_t                                                added_pipelines = 0;

	// Code of the listed modules, copied when the guest maps it.
	struct Code {
		std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<uint32_t>> words;
		std::vector<uint32_t>                        waiting;     // Module records it unblocks.
		uint32_t                                     readers = 0; // Records not started yet.
		bool                                         mapped  = false;
	};
	std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Code> code;
	std::vector<uint8_t>               missing_code;     // By module record.
	std::vector<const ShaderModule*>   modules;          // By module record, once compiled.
	std::vector<uint8_t>               module_failed;    // By module record.
	std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> module_pipelines; // By module record.
	std::vector<uint8_t>               missing_modules;  // By pipeline record.
	std::deque<uint32_t>               module_jobs;
	std::deque<uint32_t>               pipeline_jobs;
	std::condition_variable_any        available;
	uint32_t                           running = 0;

	// Progress.
	std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start;
	std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point last_log;
	bool                                  logged_idle      = true;
	uint32_t                              built            = 0;
	uint32_t                              found            = 0;
	uint32_t                              failed           = 0;
	uint32_t                              pipelines        = 0;
	uint32_t                              pipelines_known  = 0;
	uint32_t                              pipelines_failed = 0;
	uint32_t                              compute          = 0;
	// Records of any kind dropped after a fatal error (RunDroppable).
	std::atomic<uint32_t>                 dropped {0};
	uint64_t                              build_ns         = 0;
	uint64_t                              pipeline_ns      = 0;

	std::vector<std::jthread> threads;
	std::jthread              saver;
};

void PipelineCache::ManifestStateDeleter::operator()(ManifestState* state) const {
	delete state;
}

void PipelineCache::SetHostInput(ManifestModule& module) const {
	const auto& limits = m_graphics.GetPhysicalDeviceProperties().limits;
	if (auto* compute = std::get_if<ShaderComputeInputInfo>(&module.input)) {
		// As GetComputeProgram() sets them.
		compute->host_subgroup_size = m_graphics.SupportsComputeWave64() ? 64u : 32u;
		compute->lds_storage = compute->lds_size_dwords * 4u > limits.maxComputeSharedMemorySize;
	} else if (auto* vertex = std::get_if<ShaderVertexInputInfo>(&module.input)) {
		// As ResolveGraphicsPrograms() sets them.
		if (module.stage == ShaderType::Mesh) {
			vertex->mesh.host_subgroup_size = m_graphics.subgroup_size;
		}
		if (vertex->clip_space.enabled) {
			vertex->clip_space.half_extent[0] =
			    static_cast<float>(std::min(limits.maxViewportDimensions[0], 16384u)) * 0.5f;
			vertex->clip_space.half_extent[1] =
			    static_cast<float>(std::min(limits.maxViewportDimensions[1], 16384u)) * 0.5f;
		}
	}
}

const ShaderModule* PipelineCache::FindCompiledModule(
    const ProgramKey& key, const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSpecialization& specialization,
    uint32_t push_data_cursor) const {
	const auto entry = m_program_cache.find(key);
	if (entry == m_program_cache.end()) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	for (const auto& module: entry->second.modules) {
		const auto& layout = module.info.bindings;
		if (module.function_code.empty() && module.specialization == specialization &&
		    layout.push_data_start_dword == ShaderRecompiler::IR::PushData::StartFor(
		                                        push_data_cursor, layout.ShaderDataDwords())) {
			return &module;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

void PipelineCache::OpenManifest() {
	const bool warm   = Config::PipelineManifestEnabled();
	const bool record = Config::PipelineManifestRecord();
	const auto title  = PipelineCacheTitleId();
	if ((!warm && !record) || title.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	std::string version;
	Loader::SystemContentParamSfoGetString("APP_VER", &version);
	const auto name = SafeFileName(version.empty() ? title : title + "_" + version) + ".kpm";
	// The manifests built with the emulator, then the one this computer records.
	std::vector<std::filesystem::path> folders;
	if (const char* base = SDL_GetBasePath(); base != nullptr) {
		folders.push_back(Common::PathFromUtf8(base) / "assets" / "pipelines");
	}
	folders.emplace_back("_PipelineCache");
	std::vector<std::filesystem::path> files;
	for (const auto& folder: folders) {
		if (Common::File::IsFileExisting(folder / name)) {
			files.push_back(folder / name);
		}
	}
	// What other players recorded, which the launcher keeps next to this computer's recording.
	auto shared_name = name;
	shared_name.resize(shared_name.size() - std::string_view(".kpm").size());
	shared_name += ".shared.kpm";
	const auto shared_path = folders.back() / shared_name;
	// Another version's records name code by its hash: those the guest never maps stay unused.
	if (files.empty()) {
		for (const auto& folder: folders) {
			std::error_code error;
			for (const auto& entry: std::filesystem::directory_iterator(folder, error)) {
				const auto file = Common::PathToString(entry.path().filename());
				if (file.starts_with(title + "_") && file.ends_with(".kpm")) {
					files.push_back(entry.path());
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if (Common::File::IsFileExisting(shared_path) &&
	    std::ranges::find(files, shared_path) == files.end()) {
		files.push_back(shared_path);
	}

	m_manifest.reset(new ManifestState());
	auto& state = *m_manifest;
	auto& all   = state.recorded;
	if (warm) {
		state.shared_path = shared_path;
		std::error_code error;
		state.shared_size = std::filesystem::file_size(shared_path, error);
		if (error) state.shared_size = 0;
		state.shared_time = std::filesystem::last_write_time(shared_path, error);
	}
	for (const auto& path: files) {
		PipelineManifest loaded;
		uint32_t         skipped = 0;
		const auto       start   = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
		std::vector<std::string> unlinked;
		if (!LoadManifest(ReadFile(path), loaded, &skipped, &unlinked)) {
			ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: ignoring {} (another format)",
			            Common::PathToString(path));
			continue;
		}
		// The tessellation layouts go to the table the guest uses directly, and nothing in a shared
		// file can vouch for them: only the manifests of this computer provide them.
		if (Common::PathToString(path.filename()).ends_with(".shared.kpm")) {
			loaded.tessellation_layouts.clear();
		}
		std::vector<uint32_t> indices(loaded.modules.size());
		for (size_t i = 0; i < loaded.modules.size(); i++) {
			auto& module = loaded.modules[i];
			SetHostInput(module);
			const auto [found, inserted] =
			    state.module_index.try_emplace(ManifestModuleIdentity(module, StaticKey(module)),
			                                   static_cast<uint32_t>(all.modules.size()));
			if (inserted) {
				all.modules.push_back(std::move(module));
			}
			indices[i] = found->second;
		}
		for (auto& pipeline: loaded.pipelines) {
			for (auto& stage: pipeline.stages) {
				stage = stage == ManifestPipeline::NoStage ? stage : indices[stage];
			}
			if (state.pipeline_identities.insert(ManifestPipelineIdentity(pipeline)).second) {
				all.pipelines.push_back(pipeline);
			}
		}
		for (const auto& layout: loaded.tessellation_layouts) {
			if (state.layout_keys.insert(layout.first).second) {
				all.tessellation_layouts.push_back(layout);
			}
		}
		const auto load_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start;
		ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: {} modules, {} pipelines in {} (loaded in {:.1f} ms{})",
		            loaded.modules.size(), loaded.pipelines.size(), Common::PathToString(path),
		            Seconds(load_time) * 1000.0,
		            skipped != 0 ? fmt::format(", {} records left out", skipped) : std::string {});
		if (!unlinked.empty()) {
			ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: left out {} pipelines of {} that no draw creates from "
			            "the modules they name, such as {}",
			            unlinked.size(), Common::PathToString(path), unlinked.front());
		}
	}
	if (files.empty()) {
		ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: none for {}", name);
	}
	if (record) {
		state.record_path = folders.back() / name;
		ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: recording into {}",
		            Common::PathToString(state.record_path));
		// A crash, or a session that is killed, keeps what was recorded until the last write.
		state.saver = std::jthread([this](const std::stop_token& stop) {
			constexpr auto Period = std::chrono::seconds(10);
			auto           next   = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + Period;
			while (!stop.stop_requested()) {
				std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(250));
				if (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() >= next) {
					SaveManifestRecording();
					next = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + Period;
				}
			}
		});
	} else if (!warm || all.modules.empty()) {
		m_manifest.reset();
		return;
	}
	// A recording session starts the threads even without a manifest: records can arrive in the
	// shared file while the game runs.
	if (!warm) {
		return;
	}

	// Pipelines the shader store created are not created again.
	for (const auto& key: m_graphics_pipelines | std::views::keys) {
		m_claimed_graphics.insert(key);
	}
	for (const auto id: m_compute_pipelines | std::views::keys) {
		m_claimed_compute.insert(id);
	}
	m_manifest_warm = true;
	state.start     = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	state.last_log  = state.start;
	// What this session creates of the manifest comes from the listed records; recording adds
	// to a copy.
	if (record) {
		auto listed = all;
		AddManifestRecords(listed);
	} else {
		AddManifestRecords(all);
	}
	for (size_t i = 0; i < Common::ParallelThreads(); i++) {
		state.threads.emplace_back([this](const std::stop_token& stop) { ManifestWorker(stop); });
	}
	state.watcher = std::jthread([this](const std::stop_token& stop) {
		KYTY_PROFILER_THREAD("Thread_PipelineManifestShared");
		Common::Thread::LowerCurrentPriority();
		constexpr auto Period = std::chrono::seconds(15);
		auto           next   = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + Period;
		while (!stop.stop_requested()) {
			std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(250));
			if (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() >= next) {
				ReloadSharedManifest();
				next = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + Period;
			}
		}
	});
	// Shaders the guest mapped before are taken at once.
	ShaderSetMapListener(OnShaderMapped, this);
}

// Adds the records of `loaded` that the manifest does not list yet and queues them (modules
// whose shaders the guest mapped go straight to the compile queue). Returns the modules and
// pipelines added; `loaded` is left moved from.
std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> PipelineCache::AddManifestRecords(PipelineManifest& loaded) {
	auto&                 state = *m_manifest;
	std::vector<uint32_t> indices(loaded.modules.size(), ManifestPipeline::NoStage);
	std::vector<uint32_t> new_modules;
	std::vector<uint32_t> new_pipelines;
	// A record can name something this host does not have: a mesh shader module on a GPU without
	// mesh shaders could not be built. (Native ray tracing is not a case: the manifest builds the
	// programs unpatched, and a recording leaves out those the session patched.)
	const auto supported = [&](const ManifestModule& module) {
		return module.stage != ShaderType::Mesh || m_graphics.mesh_shader_enabled;
	};
	auto next_module = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.warm_modules.size());
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < loaded.modules.size(); i++) {
		auto& module = loaded.modules[i];
		if (!supported(module)) continue;
		const auto [found, inserted] = state.warm_index.try_emplace(
		    ManifestModuleIdentity(module, StaticKey(module)), next_module);
		if (inserted) {
			new_modules.push_back(i);
			next_module++;
		}
		indices[i] = found->second;
	}
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < loaded.pipelines.size(); i++) {
		auto& pipeline = loaded.pipelines[i];
		bool  dropped  = false;
		for (auto& stage: pipeline.stages) {
			if (stage != ManifestPipeline::NoStage) {
				stage   = indices[stage];
				dropped = dropped || stage == ManifestPipeline::NoStage;
			}
		}
		if (!dropped && state.warm_pipeline_ids.insert(ManifestPipelineIdentity(pipeline)).second) {
			new_pipelines.push_back(i);
		}
	}
	uint32_t new_layouts = 0;
	{
		LockPrograms();
		for (const auto& layout: loaded.tessellation_layouts) {
			if (state.warm_layout_keys.insert(layout.first).second) {
				m_tess_layouts.try_emplace(layout.first, layout.second);
				new_layouts++;
			}
		}
		UnlockPrograms();
	}
	if (new_modules.empty() && new_pipelines.empty()) {
		return {0, 0};
	}
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		for (const auto loaded_index: new_modules) {
			const auto index = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.warm_modules.size());
			state.warm_modules.push_back(std::move(loaded.modules[loaded_index]));
			const auto& module = state.warm_modules.back();
			state.missing_code.push_back(0);
			state.modules.push_back(nullptr);
			state.module_failed.push_back(0);
			state.module_pipelines.emplace_back();
			for (const auto hash: {module.code_hash, module.back_hash}) {
				if (hash == 0) continue;
				auto& code = state.code[hash];
				code.readers++;
				if (code.mapped && code.words != nullptr) continue; // Not taken yet: still there.
				// Either the guest has not mapped it, or the records before took it all: the
				// caller tells the listener about the shaders mapped so far again.
				code.mapped = false;
				code.waiting.push_back(index);
				state.missing_code[index]++;
			}
			if (state.missing_code[index] == 0) {
				state.module_jobs.push_back(index);
			}
		}
		for (const auto loaded_index: new_pipelines) {
			const auto  index    = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.warm_pipelines.size());
			const auto& pipeline = state.warm_pipelines.emplace_back(loaded.pipelines[loaded_index]);
			auto&       missing  = state.missing_modules.emplace_back(0);
			for (const auto stage: pipeline.stages) {
				if (stage == ManifestPipeline::NoStage || state.modules[stage] != nullptr) continue;
				if (state.module_failed[stage] != 0) {
					missing = UINT8_MAX;
				} else {
					state.module_pipelines[stage].push_back(index);
					missing = missing == UINT8_MAX ? missing : static_cast<uint8_t>(missing + 1);
				}
			}
			if (missing == 0) {
				state.pipeline_jobs.push_back(index);
			}
		}
		state.logged_idle = false;
	}
	state.available.notify_all();
	if (state.watcher.joinable()) {
		ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: {} new modules, {} new pipelines and {} tessellation "
		            "layouts from {}",
		            new_modules.size(), new_pipelines.size(), new_layouts,
		            Common::PathToString(state.shared_path));
	}
	return {static_cast<uint32_t>(new_modules.size()), static_cast<uint32_t>(new_pipelines.size())};
}

// Reads the shared manifest again when it changed and lists what is new in it.
void PipelineCache::ReloadSharedManifest() {
	auto&           state = *m_manifest;
	std::error_code error;
	const auto      size = std::filesystem::file_size(state.shared_path, error);
	if (error) return;
	const auto time = std::filesystem::last_write_time(state.shared_path, error);
	if (error || (size == state.shared_size && time == state.shared_time)) return;
	state.shared_size = size;
	state.shared_time = time;
	constexpr uintmax_t MaxSize = 1ull << 29;
	if (size > MaxSize) {
		ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: ignoring {} ({} bytes)",
		            Common::PathToString(state.shared_path), size);
		return;
	}
	// The launcher appends to the file: a record cut short by a read in the middle of a write
	// is left out, and the change that completes it brings it in.
	PipelineManifest loaded;
	uint32_t         skipped = 0;
	if (!LoadManifest(ReadFile(state.shared_path), loaded, &skipped)) {
		return;
	}
	// See OpenManifest(): no tessellation layouts from the shared file.
	loaded.tessellation_layouts.clear();
	for (auto& module: loaded.modules) {
		SetHostInput(module);
	}
	if (AddManifestRecords(loaded) != std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> {0, 0}) {
		// The shaders the guest mapped before these records arrived are taken at once.
		ShaderSetMapListener(OnShaderMapped, this);
	}
}

void PipelineCache::CloseManifest() {
	if (m_manifest == nullptr) {
		return;
	}
	auto& state   = *m_manifest;
	state.watcher = {};
	if (m_manifest_warm) {
		ShaderSetMapListener(nullptr, nullptr);
		for (auto& thread: state.threads) {
			thread.request_stop();
		}
		state.available.notify_all();
		state.threads.clear();
		ManifestProgress(true);
	}
	state.saver = {};
	SaveManifestRecording();
}

void PipelineCache::OnShaderMapped(void* userdata, uint64_t hash, std::span<const uint32_t> code) {
	auto& cache = *static_cast<PipelineCache*>(userdata);
	auto& state = *cache.m_manifest;
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		const auto       found = state.code.find(hash);
		if (found == state.code.end() || found->second.mapped) {
			return;
		}
		// The guest may unmap or reuse the memory later: the threads read a copy.
		auto& entry  = found->second;
		entry.words  = std::make_shared<const std::vector<uint32_t>>(code.begin(), code.end());
		entry.mapped = true;
		for (const auto index: entry.waiting) {
			if (--state.missing_code[index] == 0) {
				state.module_jobs.push_back(index);
			}
		}
		entry.waiting     = {};
		state.logged_idle = false;
	}
	state.available.notify_all();
}

void PipelineCache::ManifestWorker(const std::stop_token& stop) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_THREAD("Thread_PipelineManifest");
	Common::Thread::LowerCurrentPriority();
	auto& state = *m_manifest;
	for (;;) {
		std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<uint32_t>> code;
		std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<uint32_t>> back_code;
		uint32_t                                     index    = 0;
		bool                                         pipeline = false;
		{
			std::unique_lock lock(state.mutex);
			// Pipelines first: their modules are ready, and they are what stalls a draw.
			if (!state.available.wait(lock, stop, [&] {
				    return !state.pipeline_jobs.empty() || !state.module_jobs.empty();
			    })) {
				return;
			}
			pipeline   = !state.pipeline_jobs.empty();
			auto& jobs = pipeline ? state.pipeline_jobs : state.module_jobs;
			index      = jobs.front();
			jobs.pop_front();
			if (!pipeline) {
				const auto& module = state.warm_modules[index];
				for (auto [hash, words]: {std::pair {module.code_hash, &code},
				                          std::pair {module.back_hash, &back_code}}) {
					if (hash == 0) {
						continue;
					}
					auto& entry = state.code.at(hash);
					*words      = entry.words;
					if (--entry.readers == 0) {
						entry.words = nullptr;
					}
				}
			}
			state.running++;
		}
		if (pipeline) {
			CreateManifestPipeline(index);
		} else {
			BuildManifestModule(index, *code,
			                    back_code ? std::span<const uint32_t>(*back_code)
			                              : std::span<const uint32_t> {});
		}
		{
			std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
			state.running--;
		}
		ManifestProgress(false);
	}
}

void PipelineCache::BuildManifestModule(uint32_t index, std::span<const uint32_t> code,
                                        std::span<const uint32_t> back_code) {
	auto&       state  = *m_manifest;
	const auto& record = [&]() -> const ManifestModule& {
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		return state.warm_modules[index];
	}();
	const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	auto        input  = record.input;
	// As GetProgram() and RunCompileJob() set them; translation only reads the user data count.
	const std::vector<uint32_t>      user_data(record.user_data_count);
	ShaderRecompiler::CompileOptions options;
	ProgramKey                       key {.stage           = record.stage,
	                                      .hash            = record.ProgramHash(),
	                                      .user_data_count = record.user_data_count};
	std::visit(
	    [&]<typename InputInfo>(InputInfo& info) {
		    options.wave_size = info.wave_size;
		    if constexpr (std::is_same_v<InputInfo, ShaderVertexInputInfo>) {
			    options.stage             = info.logical_stage;
			    options.input_info.vertex = &info;
			    options.user_data_base    = 8;
			    if (options.stage == ShaderType::Mesh ||
			        options.stage == ShaderType::TessellationControl) {
				    options.user_data_base = 0;
				    options.wave_size =
				        options.stage == ShaderType::Mesh ? info.mesh.wave_size : 64u;
			    }
		    } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<InputInfo, ShaderPixelInputInfo>) {
			    options.stage            = ShaderType::Pixel;
			    options.input_info.pixel = &info;
		    } else {
			    options.stage              = ShaderType::Compute;
			    options.input_info.compute = &info;
		    }
		    BuildStageStaticKey(info, key.static_state);
	    },
	    input);
	options.shader_hash     = key.hash;
	options.user_data       = user_data;
	options.back_code       = back_code;
	options.dump_ir         = Config::GetShaderLogDirection() != Config::LogDirection::Silent;
	options.emit_debug_info = Config::GraphicsDebugDumpEnabled();

	const auto finish = [&](const ShaderModule* module, bool built) {
		const auto elapsed =
		    static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
		                              std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start)
		                              .count());
		// A recording names the modules of its pipelines by their place in `recorded`, which is
		// not their place in `warm_modules`: the records of the shared file that arrive while the
		// game runs are only listed, and a host without mesh shaders lists no mesh modules.
		const bool recording = !state.record_path.empty();
		const auto identity  = recording ? ManifestModuleIdentity(record, StaticKey(record)) : 0u;
		{
			std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
			state.modules[index] = module;
			if (module == nullptr) {
				state.module_failed[index] = 1;
				state.failed++;
			} else {
				(built ? state.built : state.found)++;
				state.build_ns += built ? elapsed : 0u;
				if (recording) {
					const auto [found, inserted] = state.module_index.try_emplace(
					    identity, static_cast<uint32_t>(state.recorded.modules.size()));
					if (inserted) {
						state.recorded.modules.push_back(record);
					}
					state.module_records[module->id] = {found->second, false};
					if (module->plain != nullptr) {
						state.module_records[module->plain->id] = {found->second, true};
					}
				}
			}
			for (const auto pipeline: state.module_pipelines[index]) {
				if (module == nullptr) {
					state.missing_modules[pipeline] = UINT8_MAX;
				} else if (state.missing_modules[pipeline] != UINT8_MAX &&
				           --state.missing_modules[pipeline] == 0) {
					state.pipeline_jobs.push_back(pipeline);
				}
			}
		}
		state.available.notify_all();
		if (module != nullptr && module->info.stage == ShaderType::Compute) {
			CreateManifestComputePipeline(*module);
		}
	};
	const ShaderModule* compiled = nullptr;
	LockPrograms();
	compiled = FindCompiledModule(key, record.specialization, record.push_data_cursor);
	UnlockPrograms();
	if (compiled != nullptr) {
		finish(compiled, false);
		return;
	}
	std::optional<ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourcePlan> plan;
	std::optional<ShaderModule>                       module;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                             spirv;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                             plain_spirv;
	// A record the translation or the driver cannot handle (it came from another computer) is
	// dropped, as are those of programs that link the functions they call from guest memory.
	const auto what = fmt::format("module {:016x}", record.code_hash);
	RunDroppable(state.dropped, record.code_hash, 0, what, [&] {
		auto source = ShaderRecompiler::PrepareShaderSource(code, options);
		if (!source.calls.empty() || source.unsupported_call_pc != UINT32_MAX) {
			return;
		}
		auto translated = ShaderRecompiler::TranslateProgram(source.decoded, options);
		plan            = ShaderRecompiler::IR::ExtractResourcePlan(translated.program);
		module          = BuildModule(key, options, std::move(translated), record.specialization, {},
		                              record.push_data_cursor, spirv, plain_spirv);
	});
	if (!module) {
		finish(nullptr, false);
		return;
	}
	bool added = false;
	{
		LockPrograms();
		auto entry = m_program_cache.find(key);
		if (entry == m_program_cache.end()) {
			entry =
			    m_program_cache.try_emplace(key, Program {.resource_plan = std::move(*plan)}).first;
		}
		auto& program = entry->second;
		compiled      = FindCompiledModule(key, record.specialization, record.push_data_cursor);
		if (compiled != nullptr || program.skip_dispatch || program.call_source != nullptr) {
			DestroyModule(*module);
		} else {
			compiled = &program.modules.emplace_back(std::move(*module));
			StoreModule(key, program, *compiled, spirv, plain_spirv);
			added = true;
		}
		UnlockPrograms();
	}
	finish(compiled, added);
}

void PipelineCache::CreateManifestPipeline(uint32_t index) {
	auto&                              state  = *m_manifest;
	std::array<const ShaderModule*, 4> stages {};
	const auto& record = [&]() -> const ManifestPipeline& {
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		return state.warm_pipelines[index];
	}();
	auto key = record.key;
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < stages.size(); i++) {
			if (record.stages[i] != ManifestPipeline::NoStage) {
				stages[i] = state.modules[record.stages[i]];
			}
		}
	}
	if (record.plain_pixel && stages[3] != nullptr) {
		stages[3] = stages[3]->plain.get();
	}
	if (stages[0] == nullptr ||
	    (record.stages[3] != ManifestPipeline::NoStage && stages[3] == nullptr)) {
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		state.pipelines_failed++;
		return;
	}
	for (size_t i = 0; i < stages.size(); i++) {
		key.stage_ids[i] = stages[i] != nullptr ? stages[i]->id : 0u;
	}
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(m_async_mutex);
		if (!m_claimed_graphics.insert(key).second) {
			std::scoped_lock manifest_lock(state.mutex);
			state.pipelines_known++;
			return;
		}
		m_async_pending_graphics.insert(key);
	}
	const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	Pipeline   pipeline;
	const auto key_hash = static_cast<uint64_t>(GraphicsPipelineKeyHash {}(key));
	const auto what     = fmt::format("pipeline {:016x}", key_hash);
	const bool ran = RunDroppable(state.dropped, stages[0]->info.shader_hash, key_hash, what, [&] {
		CreatePipelineInternal(m_graphics, pipeline, key, stages, m_driver_cache);
	});
	const bool created = ran && pipeline.pipeline != nullptr && pipeline.pipeline_layout != nullptr;
	if (created) {
		NoteCreatedPipeline(start);
	}
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(m_async_mutex);
		if (created) {
			m_async_ready.try_emplace(key, pipeline);
		} else if (ran) {
			m_async_failed_graphics.insert(key);
		} else {
			// Dropped: if a draw needs it, the draw creates it as it would without a manifest.
			m_claimed_graphics.erase(key);
		}
		m_async_pending_graphics.erase(key);
	}
	std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
	(created ? state.pipelines : state.pipelines_failed)++;
	state.pipeline_ns += static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
	                                               std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start)
	                                               .count());
}

void PipelineCache::CreateManifestComputePipeline(const ShaderModule& module) {
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(m_async_mutex);
		if (!m_claimed_compute.insert(module.id).second) {
			return;
		}
		m_async_pending_compute.insert(module.id);
	}
	const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	Pipeline   pipeline;
	auto&      state = *m_manifest;
	const auto what  = fmt::format("compute pipeline {:016x}", module.info.shader_hash);
	const bool ran   = RunDroppable(state.dropped, module.info.shader_hash, 0, what, [&] {
		CreatePipelineInternal(m_graphics, pipeline, module, m_driver_cache);
	});
	const bool created = ran && pipeline.pipeline != nullptr && pipeline.pipeline_layout != nullptr;
	if (created) {
		NoteCreatedPipeline(start);
	}
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(m_async_mutex);
		if (created) {
			m_async_ready_compute.try_emplace(module.id, pipeline);
		} else if (!ran) {
			m_claimed_compute.erase(module.id);
		}
		m_async_pending_compute.erase(module.id);
	}
	std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
	state.compute += created ? 1u : 0u;
	state.pipeline_ns += static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
	                                               std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start)
	                                               .count());
}

void PipelineCache::ManifestProgress(bool force) {
	auto&            state = *m_manifest;
	std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
	const auto       now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	const bool       idle =
	    state.module_jobs.empty() && state.pipeline_jobs.empty() && state.running == 0;
	if (!force &&
	    (state.logged_idle || (!idle && now - state.last_log < std::chrono::seconds(2)))) {
		return;
	}
	state.last_log   = now;
	uint32_t waiting = 0;
	for (const auto missing: state.missing_code) {
		waiting += missing != 0 ? 1u : 0u;
	}
	const auto modules   = state.warm_modules.size();
	const auto pipelines = state.warm_pipelines.size();
	if (!idle && !force) {
		ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: {}/{} modules, {}/{} pipelines ({} modules wait for "
		            "their shaders) at {:.1f} s",
		            state.built + state.found + state.failed, modules,
		            state.pipelines + state.pipelines_known + state.pipelines_failed, pipelines,
		            waiting, Seconds(now - state.start));
		return;
	}
	state.logged_idle = idle;
	ManifestLog("Pipeline manifest: {} at {:.1f} s: {} modules compiled ({:.0f} ms), {} compiled "
	            "already, {} failed, {} waiting for their shaders; {} pipelines and {} compute "
	            "pipelines created ({:.0f} ms), {} created already, {} failed; {} records dropped "
	            "after a fatal error",
	            idle ? "idle" : "stopped", Seconds(now - state.start), state.built,
	            Milliseconds(state.build_ns), state.found, state.failed, waiting, state.pipelines,
	            state.compute, Milliseconds(state.pipeline_ns), state.pipelines_known,
	            state.pipelines_failed, state.dropped.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
}

void PipelineCache::RecordModule(const ProgramKey&                       key,
                                 const ShaderRecompiler::CompileOptions& options,
                                 std::span<const uint32_t> code, uint32_t push_data_cursor,
                                 const ShaderModule& module) {
	if (m_manifest == nullptr || m_manifest->record_path.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	// A program the native ray tracing patched is a variant of this host: the manifest builds
	// every program unpatched, so the record would build a program that was never this one.
	if (module.info.info.ray_query) {
		return;
	}
	ManifestModule record {.stage            = key.stage,
	                       .code_hash        = key.hash,
	                       .user_data_count  = key.user_data_count,
	                       .push_data_cursor = push_data_cursor,
	                       .specialization   = module.specialization};
	if (!options.back_code.empty()) {
		record.code_hash = XXH3_64bits(code.data(), code.size_bytes());
		record.back_hash = XXH3_64bits(options.back_code.data(), options.back_code.size_bytes());
		if (record.ProgramHash() != key.hash) {
			return;
		}
	}
	switch (key.stage) {
		case ShaderType::Pixel: record.input = *options.input_info.pixel; break;
		case ShaderType::Compute: record.input = *options.input_info.compute; break;
		default: record.input = *options.input_info.vertex; break;
	}
	NormalizeManifestInput(record);
	const auto       identity = ManifestModuleIdentity(record, key.static_state);
	auto&            state    = *m_manifest;
	std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
	const auto [found, inserted] = state.module_index.try_emplace(
	    identity, static_cast<uint32_t>(state.recorded.modules.size()));
	if (inserted) {
		state.recorded.modules.push_back(std::move(record));
		state.added_modules++;
		state.dirty = true;
	}
	state.module_records[module.id] = {found->second, false};
	if (module.plain != nullptr) {
		state.module_records[module.plain->id] = {found->second, true};
	}
}

void PipelineCache::RecordPipeline(const GraphicsPipelineKey& key) {
	if (m_manifest == nullptr || m_manifest->record_path.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	auto&            state = *m_manifest;
	ManifestPipeline record {.key = key};
	record.key.stage_ids = {};
	std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < key.stage_ids.size(); i++) {
		if (key.stage_ids[i] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		// Programs that are not recorded (they call guest functions) leave the pipeline out.
		const auto found = state.module_records.find(key.stage_ids[i]);
		if (found == state.module_records.end() || (found->second.second && i != 3)) {
			return;
		}
		record.stages[i]   = found->second.first;
		record.plain_pixel = record.plain_pixel || found->second.second;
	}
	if (state.pipeline_identities.insert(ManifestPipelineIdentity(record)).second) {
		state.recorded.pipelines.push_back(record);
		state.added_pipelines++;
		state.dirty = true;
	}
}

void PipelineCache::RecordLayout(uint64_t key, const ShaderTessellationInputInfo& layout) {
	if (m_manifest == nullptr || m_manifest->record_path.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	auto&            state = *m_manifest;
	std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
	if (state.layout_keys.insert(key).second) {
		state.recorded.tessellation_layouts.emplace_back(key, layout);
		state.dirty = true;
	}
}

void PipelineCache::SaveManifestRecording() {
	auto& state = *m_manifest;
	if (state.record_path.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	PipelineManifest manifest;
	uint32_t         added_modules   = 0;
	uint32_t         added_pipelines = 0;
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(state.mutex);
		if (!state.dirty) {
			return;
		}
		manifest        = state.recorded;
		added_modules   = state.added_modules;
		added_pipelines = state.added_pipelines;
		state.dirty     = false;
	}
	const auto bytes     = SaveManifest(manifest);
	auto       temporary = state.record_path;
	temporary += ".tmp";
	Common::File::CreateDirectories(state.record_path.parent_path());
	{
		Common::File file;
		if (!file.Create(temporary)) {
			return;
		}
		file.Write(bytes.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes.size()));
	}
	std::error_code error;
	std::filesystem::rename(temporary, state.record_path, error);
	ManifestLog(
	    "Pipeline manifest: wrote {} ({} modules, {} pipelines, {:.1f} KB; {} modules and {} "
	    "pipelines new in this session)",
	    Common::PathToString(state.record_path), manifest.modules.size(), manifest.pipelines.size(),
	    static_cast<double>(bytes.size()) / 1024.0, added_modules, added_pipelines);
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineManifest.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_PIPELINE_PIPELINEMANIFEST_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_PIPELINE_PIPELINEMANIFEST_H_

#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineCache.h"

#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <variant>
#include <vector>

// A title's pipeline manifest: how the shader modules and pipelines of earlier sessions were asked
// for, in the guest's terms (shader hashes, stage input state, resource specializations, pipeline
// state) and without any code, translated or not. A session that has one compiles them as soon as
// the guest maps their shaders, ahead of the draws that need them. It is text, one record per line
// with named fields (pipelineManifest.cpp), so that git keeps readable diffs of it. Its bytes do
// not depend on the emulator build or on the host, and the same contents always give the same
// bytes.
namespace Libs::Graphics {

// Changes only when a field that files hold changes meaning: a new field reads its default from
// older files. Files of another format are ignored.
inline constexpr uint32_t ManifestFormat = 1;

// A shader module: its program's key, the stage input state it was compiled with and its
// resource specialization.
struct ManifestModule {
	ShaderType stage = ShaderType::Unknown;
	// The hash of the mapped code (ShaderMapUserData) and of a GS back half (0 without one).
	uint64_t code_hash        = 0;
	uint64_t back_hash        = 0;
	uint32_t user_data_count  = 0;
	uint32_t push_data_cursor = 0;
	// By stage: Vertex, Local, Mesh, TessellationControl and TessellationEvaluation read the
	// vertex input.
	std::variant<ShaderVertexInputInfo, ShaderPixelInputInfo, ShaderComputeInputInfo> input;
	ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourceSpecialization specialization;

	// The program hash of the module's cache key: the code hash, or both hashes' hash for a GS
	// front and back pair.
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t ProgramHash() const;
};

// A graphics pipeline. Compute pipelines are not listed: every compute module has one.
struct ManifestPipeline {
	static constexpr uint32_t NoStage = UINT32_MAX;

	// Module indices in the order of GraphicsPipelineKey::stage_ids.
	std::array<uint32_t, 4> stages {NoStage, NoStage, NoStage, NoStage};
	// The pixel stage is its module's plain variant (ShaderModule::plain).
	bool plain_pixel = false;
	// The key with zero stage ids.
	GraphicsPipelineKey key {};
};

struct PipelineManifest {
	std::vector<ManifestModule>                                   modules;
	std::vector<ManifestPipeline>                                 pipelines;
	std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, ShaderTessellationInputInfo>> tessellation_layouts;
};

// Clears what never reaches a module from a recorded stage input: guest addresses, per-dispatch
// sizes and host limits (PipelineCache sets those of the running host again).
void NormalizeManifestInput(ManifestModule& module);

// The file: a header line, then the records in their canonical order.
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<uint8_t> SaveManifest(const PipelineManifest& manifest);
// False, with `manifest` empty, for another format or damaged bytes.
// Records that do not read (or name modules that do not) are left out and counted in `skipped`,
// as are the pipelines that no draw creates from the modules they name (stages that a draw does
// not link, or a vertex input or patch size that is not their modules'): `unlinked` gets their
// stage fields and why.
bool LoadManifest(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, PipelineManifest& manifest,
                  uint32_t* skipped = nullptr, std::vector<std::string>* unlinked = nullptr);

// Equal for the records of one module or of one pipeline, whatever stage input fields outside
// the static key they hold. `static_state` is the stage's static key on the running host.
[[nodiscard]] uint64_t ManifestModuleIdentity(const ManifestModule&     module,
                                              std::span<const uint32_t> static_state);
[[nodiscard]] uint64_t ManifestPipelineIdentity(const ManifestPipeline& pipeline);

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_PIPELINE_PIPELINEMANIFEST_H_
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineSerialization.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineCache.h"

#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/parallelFor.h"
#include "common/stringUtils.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ShaderRecompiler.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/Serialize.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <ranges>
#include <xxhash.h>
#include <zstd.h>

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#endif

// The shader store: a header, then zstd-compressed records of everything a run created first.
// Records are only appended, so a store cut short by a crash keeps every complete record.
namespace Libs::Graphics {

namespace {

using ShaderRecompiler::IR::IoAll;
using ShaderRecompiler::IR::Reader;
using ShaderRecompiler::IR::Writer;

enum class Record : uint8_t { Module, GraphicsPipeline, TessellationLayout };

// Precedes each record's zstd frame.
struct Frame {
	uint32_t compressed_size = 0;
	uint32_t raw_size        = 0;
	uint64_t checksum        = 0; // XXH3 of the compressed bytes.
};

// Changes with every build, so records never meet code that encodes them differently. Zero when
// the executable cannot be found.
uint64_t BuildStamp() {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	std::array<wchar_t, 32768> name {};
	GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, name.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(name.size()));
	const std::filesystem::path path = name.data();
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
	std::array<char, 4096> name {};
	auto size = static_cast<uint32_t>(name.size());
	_NSGetExecutablePath(name.data(), &size);
	const std::filesystem::path path = name.data();
#else
	const std::filesystem::path path = "/proc/self/exe";
#endif
	std::error_code error;
	const auto      time = std::filesystem::last_write_time(path, error).time_since_epoch().count();
	return error ? 0 : static_cast<uint64_t>(time);
}

// What every record depends on besides its own fields; empty when the build is unknown.
std::vector<uint8_t> StoreHeader(const GraphicContext& graphics) {
	const auto stamp = BuildStamp();
	if (stamp == 0) {
		return {};
	}
	Writer header;
	IoAll(header, stamp, SpirvProfile(graphics),
	      graphics.GetPhysicalDeviceProperties().limits.maxComputeSharedMemorySize);
	return std::move(header.bytes);
}

// Record fields, shared by writing and reading.
template <class S, class Key> void IoKey(S& io, Key& key) {
	auto& [stage, hash, user_data_count, static_state] = key;
	IoAll(io, stage, hash, user_data_count, static_state);
}

template <class S, class Module> void IoModule(S& io, Module& stage) {
	// The handle and the SPIR-V size come from the SPIR-V; stored programs have no function code.
	// The plain variant is stored as its SPIR-V.
	auto& [id, handle, info, specialization, function_code, vertex_formats, rect_parameters,
	       mesh_task, spirv_words, plain] = stage;
	IoAll(io, id, info, specialization, vertex_formats, rect_parameters, mesh_task);
}

} // namespace

void ShaderStoreWriter::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::span<const uint8_t> header,
                             uint64_t kept) {
	Common::File::CreateDirectories(path.parent_path());
	if (kept == 0) {
		if (m_file.Create(path)) {
			m_file.Write(header.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(header.size()));
		}
	} else if (m_file.Open(path, Common::File::Mode::ReadWrite)) {
		m_file.Truncate(kept);
		m_file.Seek(kept);
	}
}

ShaderStoreWriter::ShaderStoreWriter() {
	m_thread = std::jthread([this](std::stop_token stop) {
		std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
		// Once stop is requested the wait returns false only when the queue is empty.
		while (m_ready.wait(lock, stop, [this] { return !m_jobs.empty(); })) {
			const auto job = std::move(m_jobs.front());
			m_jobs.pop();
			lock.unlock();
			job();
			lock.lock();
		}
	});
}

void ShaderStoreWriter::Append(std::vector<uint8_t>&& record) {
	Post([this, record = std::move(record)] {
		std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(sizeof(Frame) + ZSTD_compressBound(record.size()));
		const auto size = ZSTD_compress(bytes.data() + sizeof(Frame), bytes.size() - sizeof(Frame),
		                                record.data(), record.size(), 3);
		EXIT_IF(ZSTD_isError(size));
		const Frame frame {.compressed_size = static_cast<uint32_t>(size),
		                   .raw_size        = static_cast<uint32_t>(record.size()),
		                   .checksum        = XXH3_64bits(bytes.data() + sizeof(Frame), size)};
		std::memcpy(bytes.data(), &frame, sizeof(frame));
		// A failed write leaves a partial record; the next run drops it and everything after it.
		m_file.Write(bytes.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(sizeof(Frame) + size));
	});
}

void ShaderStoreWriter::Post(Common::UniqueFunction<void>&& job) {
	{
		std::scoped_lock lock(m_mutex);
		m_jobs.push(std::move(job));
	}
	m_ready.notify_one();
}

void PipelineCache::WarmUp(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	if (path.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	const auto header = StoreHeader(m_graphics);
	if (header.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	const auto           start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
	if (Common::File file;
	    Common::File::IsFileExisting(path) && file.Open(path, Common::File::Mode::Read)) {
		bytes.resize(file.Size());
		uint32_t read = 0;
		file.Read(bytes.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes.size()), &read);
		bytes.resize(read);
	}
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format(
	    "Shader cache: compiling shaders and pipelines from {} ({:.1f} MB) with {} threads\n",
	    Common::PathToString(path), static_cast<double>(bytes.size()) / 1'000'000.0,
	    Common::ParallelThreads()));
	auto       records = std::span<const uint8_t>(bytes);
	const bool reusable =
	    records.size() >= header.size() && std::ranges::equal(records.first(header.size()), header);
	if (reusable) {
		records = records.subspan(header.size());
		while (LoadRecord(records)) {
		}
	}
	// A damaged record ends the store; the records before it stay.
	m_store.Open(path, header, reusable ? bytes.size() - records.size() : 0);

	const auto modules = MapModules();
	std::vector<Common::UniqueFunction<void>> jobs;
	jobs.reserve(m_graphics_pipelines.size() + modules.size());
	for (auto& node: m_graphics_pipelines) {
		jobs.emplace_back([this, &modules, &node] {
			CreateGraphicsPipeline(node.second, node.first, modules);
		});
	}
	// A compute pipeline depends only on its module.
	for (const auto* module: modules | std::views::values) {
		if (module != nullptr && module->info.stage == ShaderType::Compute) {
			jobs.emplace_back([this, module, &pipeline = m_compute_pipelines[module->id]] {
				CreatePipelineInternal(m_graphics, pipeline, *module, m_driver_cache);
			});
		}
	}
	Common::ParallelFor(jobs.size(), [&](size_t i) { jobs[i](); });
	// A key with a stage missing from the store keeps no pipeline.
	std::erase_if(m_graphics_pipelines,
	              [](const auto& entry) { return entry.second.pipeline == nullptr; });
	if (!m_graphics_pipelines.empty() || !m_compute_pipelines.empty()) {
		CheckpointDriverCache();
	}
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format(
	    "Shader cache: loaded {} programs, {} modules, {} pipelines in {} ms\n",
	    m_program_cache.size(), modules.size() - 1,
	    m_graphics_pipelines.size() + m_compute_pipelines.size(),
	    std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() -
	                                                          start)
	        .count()));
}

bool PipelineCache::LoadRecord(std::span<const uint8_t>& records) {
	Frame frame;
	if (records.size() < sizeof(frame)) {
		return false;
	}
	std::memcpy(&frame, records.data(), sizeof(frame));
	if (records.size() - sizeof(frame) < frame.compressed_size) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto compressed = records.subspan(sizeof(frame), frame.compressed_size);
	if (XXH3_64bits(compressed.data(), compressed.size()) != frame.checksum ||
	    ZSTD_getFrameContentSize(compressed.data(), compressed.size()) != frame.raw_size) {
		return false;
	}
	std::vector<uint8_t> raw(frame.raw_size);
	if (ZSTD_decompress(raw.data(), raw.size(), compressed.data(), compressed.size()) != raw.size()) {
		return false;
	}
	Reader     reader {raw};
	auto       type     = Record::Module;
	const auto complete = [&] { return reader.ok && reader.bytes.empty(); };
	IoAll(reader, type);
	switch (type) {
		case Record::Module: {
			ProgramKey            key;
			std::vector<uint8_t>  plan;
			ShaderModule          module;
			std::vector<uint32_t> spirv;
			std::vector<uint32_t> plain_spirv;
			IoKey(reader, key);
			IoAll(reader, plan);
			IoModule(reader, module);
			IoAll(reader, spirv, plain_spirv);
			if (!complete()) {
				return false;
			}
			const auto [program, inserted] = m_program_cache.try_emplace(std::move(key));
			if (inserted &&
			    !ShaderRecompiler::IR::LoadResourcePlan(plan, program->second.resource_plan)) {
				m_program_cache.erase(program);
				return false;
			}
			module.module = CompileSPV(spirv, m_graphics.device);
			module.spirv_words = static_cast<uint32_t>(spirv.size());
			if (!plain_spirv.empty()) {
				module.plain = MakePlainModule(module, plain_spirv, m_graphics.device);
				if (module.plain == nullptr) {
					m_graphics.device.destroyShaderModule(module.module, nullptr);
					return false;
				}
			}
			program->second.modules.push_back(std::move(module));
			break;
		}
		case Record::GraphicsPipeline: {
			GraphicsPipelineKey key;
			reader.Raw(&key, sizeof(key));
			if (!complete()) {
				return false;
			}
			// WarmUp creates the pipeline once every record is loaded.
			m_graphics_pipelines.try_emplace(key);
			break;
		}
		case Record::TessellationLayout: {
			uint64_t                    key = 0;
			ShaderTessellationInputInfo layout;
			IoAll(reader, key, layout);
			if (!complete()) {
				return false;
			}
			m_tess_layouts.try_emplace(key, layout);
			break;
		}
		default: return false;
	}
	records = records.subspan(sizeof(frame) + compressed.size());
	return true;
}

// Records are encoded here, since programs and modules change later.
void PipelineCache::StoreModule(const ProgramKey& key, const Program& program,
                                const ShaderModule& module, const std::vector<uint32_t>& spirv,
                                const std::vector<uint32_t>& plain_spirv) {
	if (!m_store) {
		return;
	}
	Writer record;
	IoAll(record, Record::Module);
	IoKey(record, key);
	IoAll(record, ShaderRecompiler::IR::SaveResourcePlan(program.resource_plan));
	IoModule(record, module);
	IoAll(record, spirv, plain_spirv);
	m_store.Append(std::move(record.bytes));
}

void PipelineCache::StorePipeline(const GraphicsPipelineKey& key) {
	RecordPipeline(key);
	if (!m_store) {
		return;
	}
	Writer record;
	IoAll(record, Record::GraphicsPipeline);
	record.Raw(&key, sizeof(key));
	m_store.Append(std::move(record.bytes));
}

void PipelineCache::StoreLayout(uint64_t key, const ShaderTessellationInputInfo& layout) {
	RecordLayout(key, layout);
	if (!m_store) {
		return;
	}
	Writer record;
	IoAll(record, Record::TessellationLayout, key, layout);
	m_store.Append(std::move(record.bytes));
}

PipelineCache::ModuleMap PipelineCache::MapModules() const {
	ModuleMap modules {{0, nullptr}};
	for (const auto& program: m_program_cache | std::views::values) {
		for (const auto& module: program.modules) {
			modules.emplace(module.id, &module);
			if (module.plain != nullptr) {
				modules.emplace(module.plain->id, module.plain.get());
			}
		}
	}
	return modules;
}

bool PipelineCache::CreateGraphicsPipeline(Pipeline& pipeline, const GraphicsPipelineKey& key,
                                           const ModuleMap& modules) {
	std::array<const ShaderModule*, 4> stages {};
	for (size_t i = 0; i < stages.size(); i++) {
		const auto found = modules.find(key.stage_ids[i]);
		if (found == modules.end()) {
			return false;
		}
		stages[i] = found->second;
	}
	CreatePipelineInternal(m_graphics, pipeline, key, stages, m_driver_cache);
	return true;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/shaderResourceBarrier.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/shaderResourceBarrier.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineCache.h"
#include "graphics/shader/shader.h"
#include "graphics/shader/shaderBindings.h"

#include <cstring>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

vk::ShaderStageFlagBits NativeShaderStage(ShaderType stage) {
	switch (stage) {
		case ShaderType::Local:
		case ShaderType::Vertex: return vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eVertex;
		case ShaderType::Mesh: return vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eMeshEXT;
		case ShaderType::TessellationControl: return vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eTessellationControl;
		case ShaderType::TessellationEvaluation:
			return vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eTessellationEvaluation;
		case ShaderType::Pixel: return vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eFragment;
		case ShaderType::Compute: return vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute;
		default: EXIT("unknown native shader stage\n");
	}
}

vk::PipelineStageFlags ShaderPipelineStages(vk::ShaderStageFlags stages) {
	vk::PipelineStageFlags result = {};
	if (stages & vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eVertex) {
		result |= vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eVertexShader;
	}
	if (stages & vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eMeshEXT) {
		result |= vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eMeshShaderEXT;
	}
	if (stages & vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eTessellationControl) {
		result |= vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTessellationControlShader;
	}
	if (stages & vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eTessellationEvaluation) {
		result |= vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTessellationEvaluationShader;
	}
	if (stages & vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eFragment) {
		result |= vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eFragmentShader;
	}
	if (stages & vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute) {
		result |= vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eComputeShader;
	}
	return result;
}

vk::MemoryBarrier MakeShaderWriteDependency() {
	vk::MemoryBarrier barrier {};
	barrier.srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite;
	barrier.dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eVertexAttributeRead |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eIndexRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eUniformRead |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eIndirectCommandRead |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eTransferRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eTransferWrite |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eColorAttachmentRead |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eColorAttachmentWrite;
	return barrier;
}

vk::BufferMemoryBarrier MakeGdsDependency(vk::Buffer buffer) {
	vk::BufferMemoryBarrier barrier {};
	barrier.srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eHostWrite | vk::AccessFlagBits::eTransferWrite |
	                        vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite;
	barrier.dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite;
	barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
	barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
	barrier.buffer              = buffer;
	barrier.offset              = 0;
	barrier.size                = VK_WHOLE_SIZE;
	return barrier;
}

bool HasShaderBufferWrites(const ShaderStageRuntime& runtime) {
	const auto& program   = runtime.module->info;
	const auto& resources = *runtime.resources;
	EXIT_IF(resources.buffers.size() != program.info.buffers.size());
	// Address writes reach memory outside the bound buffer descriptors.
	bool has_writes = program.has_address_writes;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < program.info.buffers.size(); i++) {
		if (!program.info.buffers[i].written) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto&          value = resources.buffers[i];
		ShaderBufferResource descriptor;
		std::memcpy(descriptor.fields, value.dwords.data(), sizeof(descriptor.fields));
		// A zero stride means byte addressing. For either addressing mode a nonzero record
		// count is exactly the condition for a nonempty descriptor range.
		has_writes |= descriptor.Base48() != 0 && descriptor.NumRecords() != 0;
	}
	return has_writes;
}

void ShaderAccessBarrier(CommandRecorder vk_buffer, vk::PipelineStageFlags source_stages) {
	const vk::MemoryBarrier barrier {
	    .srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite,
	    .dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryWrite};
	vk_buffer.pipelineBarrier(source_stages, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eAllCommands,
	                          vk::DependencyFlags {}, 1, &barrier, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
}

void ShaderWriteHazardBarrier(CommandRecorder        vk_buffer,
                              vk::PipelineStageFlags destination_stages) {
	const vk::MemoryBarrier barrier {
	    .srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eMemoryWrite,
	    .dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead | vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderWrite};
	vk_buffer.pipelineBarrier(vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eAllCommands, destination_stages,
	                          vk::DependencyFlags {}, 1, &barrier, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
}

void ShaderWriteBarrier(CommandRecorder vk_buffer, vk::PipelineStageFlags source_stages) {
	const auto barrier = MakeShaderWriteDependency();
	vk_buffer.pipelineBarrier(source_stages,
	                          vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eComputeShader |
	                              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eAllGraphics |
	                              vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTransfer,
	                          vk::DependencyFlags {}, 1, &barrier, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```
