```cpp
	state.indirect_draw    = args.indirect.address != 0;
	if (!GetDrawTopology(ucfg, state.topology)) {
		ResetBindings();
		return true;
	}
	if (!PrepareDrawRenderState(buffer, shaders_resolved, draw, state)) {
		ResetBindings();
		return true;
	}

	const bool rect_list = Prospero::IsRectList(ucfg.GetPrimType());
	if (rect_list && state.vertex_info[0].buffers_num == 0 &&
	    state.vertex_info[0].stage.module->info.param_export_mask == 0 &&
	    state.ps_input_info.input_num != 0) {
		if (graphics_debug_dump_enabled()) {
			LOGF("DrawIndexAuto: skipping rect-list draw with no VS param exports and PS inputs: "
			     "ps_inputs=%u ps=0x%016" PRIx64 " es=0x%016" PRIx64 " gs=0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
			     state.ps_input_info.input_num, sh_ctx.GetPs().ps_regs.data_addr,
			     sh_ctx.GetVs().es_regs.data_addr, sh_ctx.GetVs().gs_regs.data_addr);
		}
		ResetBindings();
		return true;
	}

	LogDrawStateIfNeeded(buffer, draw, state, 0, nullptr);
	const auto emit = ResolveDrawEmit(ucfg, state.vertex_info[0], args.offset_source,
	                                  static_cast<int32_t>(args.first_vertex), args.first_instance,
	                                  args.indirect);
	if (emit) {
		ExecutePreparedDraw(buffer, draw, state, *emit, {});
	}
	ResetBindings();
	return emit.has_value();
}

bool RenderExecutor::ResolveColorTargets(CommandBuffer& buffer) {
	const auto& hw = buffer.GetRegisters();
	if (hw.GetColorControl().mode != 3) {
		return false;
	}

	const auto& src_rt = hw.GetRenderTarget(0);
	const auto& dst_rt = hw.GetRenderTarget(1);
	if (src_rt.base.addr == 0 || dst_rt.base.addr == 0) {
		return false;
	}

	RenderColorInfo src {};
	RenderColorInfo dst {};
	ResolveRenderColorTarget(buffer, src, 0, true, true);
	ResolveRenderColorTarget(buffer, dst, 1, true, true);
	if (src.desc.info.data.address == dst.desc.info.data.address &&
	    src.guest_mip_level == dst.guest_mip_level &&
	    src.guest_array_layer == dst.guest_array_layer) {
		return true;
	}

	auto& cache = m_context.GetTextureCache();
	cache.MarkGpuWritten(dst.image_id);
	auto& source      = cache.GetImage(src.image_id);
	auto& destination = cache.GetImage(dst.image_id);
	destination.Resolve(source,
	                    {src.desc.view_info.base_level, 1, src.desc.view_info.base_layer, 1},
	                    {dst.desc.view_info.base_level, 1, dst.desc.view_info.base_layer, 1});
	return true;
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderPssr.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/threads.h"
#include "gpu_blit_shaders/gpu_pssr_linear_spv.h"
#include "graphics/guest_gpu/pssr.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/graphicContext.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/image/image.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/shaderResourceBarrier.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/render.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderContext.h"
#include "graphics/shader/shaderBindings.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>

namespace Libs::Graphics {
namespace {

struct PssrParameters {
	uint32_t input_size[2];
	uint32_t output_size[2];
	uint32_t output_channels[4];
};

} // namespace

RenderExecutor::~RenderExecutor() {
	const auto device = m_context.GetGraphics().device;
	device.destroyPipeline(m_pssr_pipeline, nullptr);
	device.destroyPipelineLayout(m_pssr_pipeline_layout, nullptr);
	device.destroyDescriptorSetLayout(m_pssr_descriptor_layout, nullptr);
}

void RenderExecutor::ProcessPssr(CommandBuffer& buffer, const Pssr::Request& request) {
	m_context.GetCommandScheduler().PopPendingOperations();
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_context.GetMutex());
	ShaderTextureResource input_descriptor {}, output_descriptor {};
	std::copy_n(request.input, 8, input_descriptor.fields);
	std::copy_n(request.output, 8, output_descriptor.fields);
	const auto is_2d = [](const ShaderTextureResource& descriptor) {
		return !descriptor.IsNull() &&
		       (descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2D ||
		        descriptor.Type() == Prospero::ImageType::kColor2DArray) &&
		       descriptor.TileMode() != Prospero::TileMode::kDepth;
	};
	EXIT_IF(!is_2d(input_descriptor) || !is_2d(output_descriptor) ||
	        !Pssr::IsColorFormat(input_descriptor.Format()) ||
	        output_descriptor.Format() != Prospero::BufferFormat::k11_11_10Float ||
	        output_descriptor.TileMode() != Prospero::TileMode::kStandard256B ||
	        output_descriptor.BaseLevel() != 0 || output_descriptor.LastLevel() != 0 ||
	        output_descriptor.MaxMip() != 0 || output_descriptor.BaseArray5() != 0 ||
	        output_descriptor.Depth() != 0 || request.width == 0 || request.height == 0);
	const auto input_width = std::max(1u, (input_descriptor.Width5() + 1u) >>
	                                         input_descriptor.BaseLevel());
	const auto input_height = std::max(1u, (input_descriptor.Height5() + 1u) >>
	                                          input_descriptor.BaseLevel());
	EXIT_IF(request.width > input_width || request.height > input_height);
	PssrParameters parameters {{request.width, request.height},
	                           {output_descriptor.Width5() + 1u, output_descriptor.Height5() + 1u},
	                           {4, 4, 4, 4}};
	for (uint32_t component = 0; component < 3; ++component) {
		for (uint32_t source = 0; source < 4; ++source) {
			if (GetDstSel(output_descriptor.DstSelXYZW(), source) == 4u + component) {
				parameters.output_channels[component] = source;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	const auto resolve = [&](const uint32_t* words, bool output) {
		ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource resource {};
		resource.resource_class = output ? ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResourceClass::Storage
		                                 : ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResourceClass::Sampled;
		resource.numeric_class = Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float;
		resource.dimension = ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::ImageDimension::Dim2D;
		resource.read = !output;
		resource.written = output;
		ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue value {};
		std::copy_n(words, 8, value.dwords.begin());
		value.dword_count = 8;
		auto binding = ResolveTexture(resource, value);
		binding.desc.view_info.level_count = 1;
		binding.desc.view_info.min_lod = 0;
		return binding;
	};
	auto& cache = m_context.GetTextureCache();
	auto input = resolve(request.input, false);
	BindImage(input.image_id, false);
	auto output = resolve(request.output, true);
	BindImage(output.image_id, true);
	EXIT_IF(input.desc.info.data.address < output.desc.info.data.End() &&
	        output.desc.info.data.address < input.desc.info.data.End());
	const auto acquire = [&](TextureBinding& binding, const uint32_t* words, bool storage) {
		auto& previous = cache.GetImage(binding.image_id);
		if (!previous.registered || previous.binding.needs_rebind) {
			previous.binding = {};
			binding = resolve(words, storage);
			BindImage(binding.image_id, storage);
		}
		binding.image_view = cache.FindTexture(binding.image_id, binding.desc);
	};
	acquire(input, request.input, false);
	acquire(output, request.output, true);
	auto& source = cache.GetImage(input.image_id);
	auto& destination = cache.GetImage(output.image_id);
	const auto& source_view = input.desc.view_info;
	const auto& destination_view = output.desc.view_info;
	EXIT_IF(source.info.IsDepth() || destination.info.IsDepth() ||
	        source.backing.samples != 1 || destination.backing.samples != 1 ||
	        (input.image_id == output.image_id &&
	         source_view.base_level == destination_view.base_level &&
	         source_view.base_layer == destination_view.base_layer));

	auto& graphics = m_context.GetGraphics();
	if (m_pssr_pipeline == nullptr) {
		const std::array bindings {
		    vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBinding {0, vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage, 1,
		                                    vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute},
		    vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBinding {1, vk::DescriptorType::eStorageImage, 1,
		                                    vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute}};
		vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo descriptor_info {};
		descriptor_info.flags = vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateFlagBits::ePushDescriptorKHR;
		descriptor_info.bindingCount = bindings.size();
		descriptor_info.pBindings = bindings.data();
		RequireVulkanSuccess(graphics.device.createDescriptorSetLayout(
		                         &descriptor_info, nullptr, &m_pssr_descriptor_layout),
		                     "create upscaling descriptor layout");
		const vk::PushConstantRange push {vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute, 0,
		                                  sizeof(PssrParameters)};
		vk::PipelineLayoutCreateInfo layout_info {};
		layout_info.setLayoutCount = 1;
		layout_info.pSetLayouts = &m_pssr_descriptor_layout;
		layout_info.pushConstantRangeCount = 1;
		layout_info.pPushConstantRanges = &push;
		RequireVulkanSuccess(graphics.device.createPipelineLayout(
		                         &layout_info, nullptr, &m_pssr_pipeline_layout),
		                     "create upscaling pipeline layout");
		const auto shader = CompileSPV(GPU_PSSR_LINEAR_SPV, graphics.device);
		vk::ComputePipelineCreateInfo create {};
		create.stage.stage = vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute;
		create.stage.module = shader;
		create.stage.pName = "main";
		create.layout = m_pssr_pipeline_layout;
		const auto result = graphics.device.createComputePipelines(
		    nullptr, 1, &create, nullptr, &m_pssr_pipeline);
		graphics.device.destroyShaderModule(shader, nullptr);
		RequireVulkanSuccess(result, "create upscaling pipeline");
	}
	buffer.EndRendering();
	const auto command = buffer.Handle();
	source.Transit(vk::ImageLayout::eGeneral, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderRead,
	               ImageSubresourceRange {source_view.base_level, 1, source_view.base_layer, 1},
	               command);
	destination.Transit(vk::ImageLayout::eGeneral, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eShaderWrite,
	                    ImageSubresourceRange {destination_view.base_level, 1,
	                                           destination_view.base_layer, 1}, command);
	const std::array images {
	    vk::DescriptorImageInfo {nullptr, input.image_view, vk::ImageLayout::eGeneral},
	    vk::DescriptorImageInfo {nullptr, output.image_view, vk::ImageLayout::eGeneral}};
	std::array<vk::WriteDescriptorSet, 2> writes {};
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < writes.size(); ++i) {
		writes[i].dstBinding = i;
		writes[i].descriptorCount = 1;
		writes[i].descriptorType = i == 0 ? vk::DescriptorType::eSampledImage
		                                 : vk::DescriptorType::eStorageImage;
		writes[i].pImageInfo = &images[i];
	}
	command.pushDescriptorSetKHR(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_pssr_pipeline_layout,
	                             0, writes.size(), writes.data());
	command.bindPipeline(vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute, m_pssr_pipeline);
	command.pushConstants(m_pssr_pipeline_layout, vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute,
	                      0, sizeof(parameters), &parameters);
	command.dispatch((parameters.output_size[0] + 7) / 8,
	                 (parameters.output_size[1] + 7) / 8, 1);
	ShaderAccessBarrier(command, vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eComputeShader);
	ResetBindings();
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

```h
struct RenderAttachment {
	vk::ImageView           image_view    = nullptr;
	vk::ImageLayout         image_layout  = vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined;
	std::array<uint32_t, 2> clear_value   = {};
	bool                    has_depth     = false;
	bool                    depth_clear   = false;
	bool                    has_stencil   = false;
	bool                    stencil_clear = false;

	bool operator==(const RenderAttachment&) const = default;
};

struct RenderState {
	std::array<RenderAttachment, RENDER_COLOR_ATTACHMENTS_MAX> color_attachments;
	RenderAttachment                                           depth_stencil_attachment;
	uint32_t                                                   width                 = 0;
	uint32_t                                                   height                = 0;
	uint32_t                                                   num_layers            = 1;
	uint32_t                                                   num_color_attachments = 0;

	bool operator==(const RenderState&) const = default;
};

[[nodiscard]] inline constexpr uint32_t render_sample_count(uint32_t encoded_samples) {
	return encoded_samples <= 3 ? 1u << encoded_samples : 0;
}

[[nodiscard]] inline constexpr vk::SampleCountFlagBits vulkan_sample_count(uint32_t samples) {
	switch (samples) {
		case 1: return vk::SampleCountFlagBits::e1;
		case 2: return vk::SampleCountFlagBits::e2;
		case 4: return vk::SampleCountFlagBits::e4;
		case 8: return vk::SampleCountFlagBits::e8;
		default: return {};
	}
}

struct TargetViewInfo {
	uint32_t base_layer   = 0;
	uint32_t layer_count  = 0;
	uint32_t image_layers = 0;
};

inline constexpr TargetViewInfo ResolveTargetViewInfo(uint32_t base_layer, uint32_t last_layer) {
	return {base_layer, last_layer - base_layer + 1u, last_layer + 1u};
}
```

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/sync.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/bufferCache.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/render.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderContext.h"
#include "graphics/presentation/videoOut.h"
#include "kernel/eventQueue.h"
#include "kernel/pthread.h"
#include "libs/errno.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <limits>

namespace Libs::Graphics::Sync {

constexpr uint64_t GRAPHICS_REFERENCE_CLOCK_FREQUENCY = 100000000;

bool ScaleReferenceClock(uint64_t host_ticks, uint64_t host_frequency, uint64_t& value) {
	if (host_frequency == 0) {
		return false;
	}

	const auto     whole_seconds = host_ticks / host_frequency;
	const auto     remainder     = host_ticks % host_frequency;
	constexpr auto MAX_VALUE     = std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max();
	if (whole_seconds > MAX_VALUE / GRAPHICS_REFERENCE_CLOCK_FREQUENCY ||
	    remainder > MAX_VALUE / GRAPHICS_REFERENCE_CLOCK_FREQUENCY) {
		return false;
	}

	const auto whole_value      = whole_seconds * GRAPHICS_REFERENCE_CLOCK_FREQUENCY;
	const auto fractional_value = (remainder * GRAPHICS_REFERENCE_CLOCK_FREQUENCY) / host_frequency;
	if (whole_value > MAX_VALUE - fractional_value) {
		return false;
	}
	value = whole_value + fractional_value;
	return true;
}

uint64_t ReadReferenceClock() {
	const auto host_frequency = LibKernel::KernelGetTscFrequency();
	const auto host_ticks     = LibKernel::KernelReadTsc();
	uint64_t   value          = 0;
	if (!ScaleReferenceClock(host_ticks, host_frequency, value)) {
		EXIT("cannot scale host clock, ticks=0x%016" PRIx64 " frequency=%" PRIu64 "\n", host_ticks,
		     host_frequency);
	}
	return value;
}

uint64_t PrepareVideoOutFlip(CommandBuffer& buffer, int handle, int index, int flip_mode,
                             int64_t flip_arg) {
	for (;;) {
		uint64_t   request_id = 0;
		auto&      video_out  = buffer.GetContext().GetVideoOut();
		const auto result =
		    video_out.SubmitFlipFromGpu(buffer, handle, index, flip_mode, flip_arg, request_id);
		if (result == OK) {
			EXIT_IF(request_id == 0);
			return request_id;
		}
		if (result != VideoOut::VIDEO_OUT_ERROR_FLIP_QUEUE_FULL) {
			EXIT("GPU flip submission failed, result=%d handle=%d index=%d mode=%d arg=%" PRId64
			     "\n",
			     result, handle, index, flip_mode, flip_arg);
		}
		video_out.WaitForSubmitSlot(handle);
	}
}

static void InterruptEventResetFunc(LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelEqueueEvent* event) {
	EXIT_IF(event == nullptr);
	event->triggered    = false;
	event->event.fflags = 0;
	event->event.data   = 0;
}

static void InterruptEventTriggerFunc(LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelEqueueEvent* event,
                                      void*                                     trigger_data) {
	EXIT_IF(event == nullptr);

	const auto data = reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(trigger_data);
	// An interrupt of a context the guest has an unread interrupt of adds to it (its count in
	// fflags), as a kqueue event that triggers again before it is read: the guest learns the
	// GPU's progress from the labels the interrupts follow. Queuing every one grew without bound
	// when the guest reads fewer than the GPU raises (ASTRO BOT: ~45,000 a second, 1.4 GB after
	// 15 minutes); now there is at most one unread interrupt per context.
	if (event->triggered) {
		if (event->event.data == data) {
			event->event.fflags++;
			return;
		}
		for (auto& pending: event->pending_events) {
			if (pending.data == data) {
				pending.fflags++;
				return;
			}
		}
		auto triggered_event   = event->event;
		triggered_event.fflags = 1;
		triggered_event.data   = data;
		event->pending_events.push_back(triggered_event);
		return;
	}
	event->event.fflags++;
	event->event.data = data;
	event->triggered  = true;
}

int AddEqEvent(RenderContext& renderer, LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelEqueue eq, int id,
               void* udata) {
	LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelEqueueEvent event;
	event.triggered           = false;
	event.event.ident         = static_cast<uintptr_t>(id);
	event.event.filter        = LibKernel::EventQueue::KERNEL_EVFILT_GRAPHICS;
	event.event.udata         = udata;
	event.event.fflags        = 0;
	event.event.data          = id;
	event.filter.reset_func   = InterruptEventResetFunc;
	event.filter.trigger_func = InterruptEventTriggerFunc;

	int result = LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelAddEvent(eq, event);

	if (result == 0) {
		renderer.AddInterruptEq(eq, id);
	}

	return result;
}

int DeleteEqEvent(RenderContext& renderer, LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	int result = LibKernel::EventQueue::KernelDeleteEvent(
	    eq, static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), LibKernel::EventQueue::KERNEL_EVFILT_GRAPHICS);
	if (result == OK || result == LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ENOENT) {
		renderer.DeleteInterruptEq(eq, id);
	}

	return result;
}

void ReadGds(const Buffer& gds, uint32_t* dst, uint32_t dw_offset, uint32_t dw_size) {
	const auto offset = uint64_t {dw_offset} * sizeof(uint32_t);
	const auto size   = uint64_t {dw_size} * sizeof(uint32_t);
	EXIT_IF(dst == nullptr || offset > gds.Size() || size > gds.Size() - offset ||
	        gds.Mapped().empty());
	std::memcpy(dst, gds.Mapped().data() + offset, static_cast<size_t>(size));
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::Sync
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/targetDump.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/targetDump.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/graphicContext.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/textureCache.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/commandScheduler.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/gpuBreadcrumbs.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/pipeline/pipelineCache.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/render.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/renderContext.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <tuple>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics::TargetDump {

namespace {

enum class State : uint32_t { Idle, Requested, Capturing };

bool                  g_enabled  = false;
uint32_t              g_at_flip  = 0;
uint32_t              g_max      = 3500; // a heavy title frame has ~3200 draws
uint32_t              g_each_from = 1;   // draws dumped one by one (KYTY_TARGET_DUMP_DRAWS=a-b)
uint32_t              g_each_to   = 0;
std::atomic<State>    g_state {State::Idle};
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_flips {0};
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_waited {0};
uint32_t              g_frame    = 0;
uint32_t              g_draw     = 0;
std::FILE*            g_index    = nullptr;
std::filesystem::path g_folder;

vk::Buffer       g_staging = nullptr;
vk::DeviceMemory g_memory  = nullptr;
void*            g_mapped  = nullptr;
vk::DeviceSize   g_size    = 0;

float HalfToFloat(uint16_t h) {
	const uint32_t sign = (h >> 15u) & 1u;
	const uint32_t exp  = (h >> 10u) & 0x1fu;
	const uint32_t man  = h & 0x3ffu;
	float          v    = 0.0f;
	if (exp == 0) {
		v = std::ldexp(static_cast<float>(man), -24);
	} else if (exp == 31) {
		v = man != 0 ? 0.0f : 65504.0f;
	} else {
		v = std::ldexp(static_cast<float>(man | 0x400u), static_cast<int>(exp) - 25);
	}
	return sign != 0 ? -v : v;
}

// 11/10-bit unsigned floats of B10G11R11.
float SmallFloat(uint32_t bits, uint32_t mantissa_bits) {
	const uint32_t exp = bits >> mantissa_bits;
	const uint32_t man = bits & ((1u << mantissa_bits) - 1u);
	if (exp == 0) {
		return std::ldexp(static_cast<float>(man), -14 - static_cast<int>(mantissa_bits));
	}
	if (exp == 31) {
		return 0.0f;
	}
	return std::ldexp(1.0f + static_cast<float>(man) / static_cast<float>(1u << mantissa_bits),
	                  static_cast<int>(exp) - 15);
}

uint8_t Unorm(float v) {
	return static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
}

// HDR values: Reinhard, so bright pixels stay visible.
uint8_t Hdr(float v) {
	v = std::max(v, 0.0f);
	return Unorm(v / (1.0f + v));
}

struct FormatInfo {
	uint32_t bytes = 0;
};

std::optional<FormatInfo> Describe(vk::Format format) {
	switch (format) {
		case vk::Format::eR8Unorm: return FormatInfo {1};
		case vk::Format::eR8G8Unorm: case vk::Format::eR16Sfloat: case vk::Format::eR16Unorm:
			return FormatInfo {2};
		case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Unorm: case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Srgb:
		case vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Unorm: case vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Srgb:
		case vk::Format::eA2B10G10R10UnormPack32: case vk::Format::eA2R10G10B10UnormPack32:
		case vk::Format::eB10G11R11UfloatPack32: case vk::Format::eR32Sfloat:
		case vk::Format::eR16G16Sfloat: case vk::Format::eR16G16Unorm: case vk::Format::eR32Uint:
			return FormatInfo {4};
		case vk::Format::eR16G16B16A16Sfloat: case vk::Format::eR16G16B16A16Unorm:
		case vk::Format::eR32G32Sfloat:
			return FormatInfo {8};
		case vk::Format::eR32G32B32A32Sfloat: return FormatInfo {16};
		default: return std::nullopt;
	}
}

// One texel to 8-bit BGR.
void Convert(vk::Format format, const uint8_t* p, uint8_t* bgr) {
	uint8_t r = 0;
	uint8_t g = 0;
	uint8_t b = 0;
	uint32_t w = 0;
	std::memcpy(&w, p, std::min<size_t>(4, Describe(format)->bytes));
	const auto h = [&](int i) {
		uint16_t v = 0;
		std::memcpy(&v, p + i * 2, 2);
		return v;
	};
	const auto f = [&](int i) {
		float v = 0;
		std::memcpy(&v, p + i * 4, 4);
		return v;
	};
	switch (format) {
		case vk::Format::eR8Unorm: r = g = b = p[0]; break;
		case vk::Format::eR8G8Unorm: r = p[0]; g = p[1]; break;
		case vk::Format::eR16Sfloat: r = g = b = Hdr(HalfToFloat(h(0))); break;
		case vk::Format::eR16Unorm: r = g = b = static_cast<uint8_t>(h(0) >> 8u); break;
		case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Unorm: case vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Srgb:
			r = p[0]; g = p[1]; b = p[2]; break;
		case vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Unorm: case vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Srgb:
			b = p[0]; g = p[1]; r = p[2]; break;
		case vk::Format::eA2B10G10R10UnormPack32:
			r = static_cast<uint8_t>((w & 0x3ffu) >> 2u);
			g = static_cast<uint8_t>(((w >> 10u) & 0x3ffu) >> 2u);
			b = static_cast<uint8_t>(((w >> 20u) & 0x3ffu) >> 2u);
			break;
		case vk::Format::eA2R10G10B10UnormPack32:
			b = static_cast<uint8_t>((w & 0x3ffu) >> 2u);
			g = static_cast<uint8_t>(((w >> 10u) & 0x3ffu) >> 2u);
			r = static_cast<uint8_t>(((w >> 20u) & 0x3ffu) >> 2u);
			break;
		case vk::Format::eB10G11R11UfloatPack32:
			r = Hdr(SmallFloat(w & 0x7ffu, 6));
			g = Hdr(SmallFloat((w >> 11u) & 0x7ffu, 6));
			b = Hdr(SmallFloat((w >> 22u) & 0x3ffu, 5));
			break;
		case vk::Format::eR32Sfloat: r = g = b = Hdr(f(0)); break;
		case vk::Format::eR32Uint: r = g = b = static_cast<uint8_t>(w); break;
		case vk::Format::eR16G16Sfloat: r = Hdr(HalfToFloat(h(0))); g = Hdr(HalfToFloat(h(1))); break;
		case vk::Format::eR16G16Unorm: r = static_cast<uint8_t>(h(0) >> 8u); g = static_cast<uint8_t>(h(1) >> 8u); break;
		case vk::Format::eR16G16B16A16Sfloat:
			r = Hdr(HalfToFloat(h(0))); g = Hdr(HalfToFloat(h(1))); b = Hdr(HalfToFloat(h(2))); break;
		case vk::Format::eR16G16B16A16Unorm:
			r = static_cast<uint8_t>(h(0) >> 8u); g = static_cast<uint8_t>(h(1) >> 8u);
			b = static_cast<uint8_t>(h(2) >> 8u); break;
		case vk::Format::eR32G32Sfloat: r = Hdr(f(0)); g = Hdr(f(1)); break;
		case vk::Format::eR32G32B32A32Sfloat: r = Hdr(f(0)); g = Hdr(f(1)); b = Hdr(f(2)); break;
		default: break;
	}
	bgr[0] = b;
	bgr[1] = g;
	bgr[2] = r;
}

void WriteBmp(const std::filesystem::path& path, uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
              const std::vector<uint8_t>& bgr_rows) {
	const uint32_t row  = (width * 3u + 3u) & ~3u;
	const uint32_t size = 54u + row * height;
	uint8_t        header[54] {};
	const auto     put = [&](uint32_t offset, uint32_t value, uint32_t bytes) {
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bytes; ++i) header[offset + i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(value >> (8u * i));
	};
	header[0] = 'B';
	header[1] = 'M';
	put(2, size, 4);
	put(10, 54, 4);
	put(14, 40, 4);
	put(18, width, 4);
	put(22, static_cast<uint32_t>(-static_cast<int32_t>(height)), 4); // top-down rows
	put(26, 1, 2);
	put(28, 24, 2);
	put(34, row * height, 4);
	std::FILE* file = std::fopen(path.string().c_str(), "wb");
	if (file == nullptr) {
		return;
	}
	std::fwrite(header, 1, sizeof(header), file);
	std::fwrite(bgr_rows.data(), 1, bgr_rows.size(), file);
	std::fclose(file);
}

bool EnsureStaging(GraphicContext& graphics, vk::DeviceSize size) {
	if (size <= g_size) {
		return true;
	}
	if (g_staging != nullptr) {
		graphics.device.destroyBuffer(g_staging, nullptr);
		graphics.device.freeMemory(g_memory, nullptr);
		g_staging = nullptr;
	}
	vk::BufferCreateInfo info {};
	info.size  = size;
	info.usage = vk::BufferUsageFlagBits::eTransferDst;
	if (graphics.device.createBuffer(&info, nullptr, &g_staging) != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
		return false;
	}
	vk::MemoryRequirements requirements {};
	graphics.device.getBufferMemoryRequirements(g_staging, &requirements);
	const auto& props  = graphics.physical_device_memory_properties;
	const auto  wanted = vk::MemoryPropertyFlagBits::eHostVisible |
	                     vk::MemoryPropertyFlagBits::eHostCoherent |
	                     vk::MemoryPropertyFlagBits::eHostCached;
	uint32_t type = UINT32_MAX;
	for (int pass = 0; pass < 2 && type == UINT32_MAX; ++pass) {
		const auto need = pass == 0 ? wanted : (wanted & ~vk::MemoryPropertyFlags(vk::MemoryPropertyFlagBits::eHostCached));
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < props.memoryTypeCount; ++i) {
			if ((requirements.memoryTypeBits & (1u << i)) != 0 &&
			    (props.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & need) == need) {
				type = i;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	vk::MemoryAllocateInfo alloc {};
	alloc.allocationSize  = requirements.size;
	alloc.memoryTypeIndex = type;
	if (type == UINT32_MAX ||
	    graphics.device.allocateMemory(&alloc, nullptr, &g_memory) != vk::Result::eSuccess ||
	    graphics.device.bindBufferMemory(g_staging, g_memory, 0) != vk::Result::eSuccess ||
	    graphics.device.mapMemory(g_memory, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, {}, &g_mapped) != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
		return false;
	}
	g_size = size;
	return true;
}

} // namespace

void Init() {
	const char* enabled = std::getenv("KYTY_TARGET_DUMP");
	g_enabled           = enabled != nullptr && *enabled != '\0' && *enabled != '0';
	if (!g_enabled) {
		return;
	}
	if (const char* at = std::getenv("KYTY_TARGET_DUMP_AT_FLIP")) {
		g_at_flip = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(at, nullptr, 10));
	}
	if (const char* max = std::getenv("KYTY_TARGET_DUMP_MAX")) {
		g_max = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(max, nullptr, 10));
	}
	if (const char* draws = std::getenv("KYTY_TARGET_DUMP_DRAWS")) {
		char* end   = nullptr;
		g_each_from = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(draws, &end, 10));
		g_each_to   = end != nullptr && *end == '-' ? static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(end + 1, nullptr, 10))
		                                            : g_each_from;
	}
	GpuBreadcrumbs::TrackPipelines();
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("Target dump: on (F9{})\n",
	                                      g_at_flip != 0 ? fmt::format(", at flip {}", g_at_flip) : ""));
}

bool Enabled() noexcept {
	return g_enabled;
}

void RequestCapture() noexcept {
	auto expected = State::Idle;
	if (g_enabled && g_state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, State::Requested)) {
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog("Target dump: requested, starts at the next flip\n");
	}
}

void StartCapture() noexcept {
	auto expected = State::Idle;
	if (g_enabled && g_state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, State::Capturing)) {
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog("Target dump: started at the next draw\n");
	}
}

bool NoPipelineSkip() noexcept {
	return g_enabled && g_state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != State::Idle;
}

void NoteWaitedPipeline() noexcept {
	g_waited.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void OnFlip() noexcept {
	if (!g_enabled) {
		return;
	}
	if (const auto waited = g_waited.exchange(0); waited != 0) {
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("Target dump: {} draws waited for their pipelines instead of being skipped\n", waited));
	}
	const auto flips = g_flips.fetch_add(1) + 1;
	if (g_at_flip != 0 && flips == g_at_flip) {
		RequestCapture();
	}
	// The capture ends after g_max draws, not at a flip: the dump slows the GPU work down while
	// the presentation keeps flipping.
	auto expected = State::Requested;
	g_state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, State::Capturing);
}

namespace {

struct Pending {
	uint32_t             draw = 0;
	uint32_t             slot = 0;
	uint32_t             flip = 0;
	std::string          format;
	uint32_t             guest_width  = 0;
	uint32_t             guest_height = 0;
	uint64_t             address      = 0;
	std::string          shaders;
	uint32_t             width  = 0;
	uint32_t             height = 0;
	std::vector<uint8_t> pixels;
};

using TargetKey = std::tuple<uint64_t, uint32_t, uint32_t>; // guest address, mip, layer
std::map<TargetKey, Pending> g_pending; // the last draw of each target of the current pass

void Write(const Pending& p, char prefix) {
	const auto name = fmt::format("{}{:05}_t{}.bmp", prefix, p.draw, p.slot);
	WriteBmp(g_folder / name, p.width, p.height, p.pixels);
	std::fprintf(g_index, "%u,%u,%u,%s,%u,%u,0x%llx,%s,%s\n", p.draw, p.slot, p.flip, p.format.c_str(),
	             p.guest_width, p.guest_height, static_cast<unsigned long long>(p.address), name.c_str(),
	             p.shaders.c_str());
}

void FlushExcept(const std::vector<TargetKey>& keep) {
	for (auto it = g_pending.begin(); it != g_pending.end();) {
		if (std::find(keep.begin(), keep.end(), it->first) == keep.end()) {
			Write(it->second, 'p');
			it = g_pending.erase(it);
		} else {
			++it;
		}
	}
	std::fflush(g_index);
}

} // namespace

void AfterDraw(RenderContext& context, CommandBuffer& buffer, const DrawRenderState& state,
               vk::Pipeline pipeline) {
	if (!g_enabled || g_state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != State::Capturing) {
		return;
	}
	if (g_index == nullptr) {
		++g_frame;
		g_draw   = 0;
		g_folder = std::filesystem::path("_TargetDump") / fmt::format("frame_{}_{}", g_frame, g_flips.load());
		std::filesystem::create_directories(g_folder);
		g_index = std::fopen((g_folder / "index.csv").string().c_str(), "w");
		if (g_index == nullptr) {
			g_state.store(State::Idle);
			return;
		}
		std::fprintf(g_index, "draw,slot,flip,format,width,height,guest_address,file,shaders\n");
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("Target dump: frame {} started ({} draws)\n", g_frame, g_max));
	}
	const uint32_t draw = ++g_draw;
	auto& graphics = context.GetGraphics();
	auto& cache    = context.GetTextureCache();
	const auto shaders = GpuBreadcrumbs::Describe(pipeline);
	std::vector<TargetKey> targets;
	std::vector<Pending>   current;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < state.color_count; ++i) {
		const auto& color = state.colors[i];
		if (!color.image_id) {
			continue;
		}
		auto&      image  = cache.GetImage(color.image_id);
		const auto format = image.backing.format;
		const auto info   = Describe(format);
		const auto extent = color.Extent();
		const auto mip    = color.desc.view_info.base_level;
		const auto layer  = color.desc.view_info.base_layer;
		if (!info || image.backing.samples > 1 ||
		    !EnsureStaging(graphics, static_cast<vk::DeviceSize>(extent.width) * extent.height * info->bytes)) {
			std::fprintf(g_index, "%u,%u,%u,%d,%u,%u,0x%llx,,%s\n", draw, color.target_slot, g_flips.load(),
			             static_cast<int>(format), extent.width, extent.height,
			             static_cast<unsigned long long>(image.info.data.address), shaders.c_str());
			continue;
		}
		buffer.EndRendering();
		const auto command = buffer.Handle();
		image.Transit(vk::ImageLayout::eTransferSrcOptimal, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferRead, {}, command);
		vk::BufferImageCopy region {};
		region.imageSubresource = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, mip, layer, 1};
		region.imageExtent      = vk::Extent3D {extent.width, extent.height, 1};
		command.copyImageToBuffer(image.backing.image, vk::ImageLayout::eTransferSrcOptimal, g_staging, 1,
		                          &region);
		if (image.binding.attachment_layout != vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined) {
			image.Transit(image.binding.attachment_layout, image.binding.attachment_access, {}, command);
		}
		auto& scheduler = context.GetCommandScheduler();
		scheduler.Wait(scheduler.CurrentTick());

		const uint32_t step = std::max(1u, (extent.width + 1279u) / 1280u);
		Pending        p;
		p.draw         = draw;
		p.slot         = color.target_slot;
		p.flip         = g_flips.load();
		p.format       = vk::to_string(format);
		p.guest_width  = extent.width;
		p.guest_height = extent.height;
		p.address      = image.info.data.address;
		p.shaders      = shaders;
		p.width        = (extent.width + step - 1) / step;
		p.height       = (extent.height + step - 1) / step;
		const uint32_t row = (p.width * 3u + 3u) & ~3u;
		p.pixels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(row) * p.height);
		const auto* source = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(g_mapped);
		for (uint32_t y = 0; y < p.height; ++y) {
			for (uint32_t x = 0; x < p.width; ++x) {
				const size_t texel =
				    (static_cast<size_t>(y * step) * extent.width + x * step) * info->bytes;
				Convert(format, source + texel, &p.pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y) * row + x * 3u]);
			}
		}
		if (draw >= g_each_from && draw <= g_each_to) {
			Write(p, 'd');
		}
		targets.emplace_back(p.address, mip, layer);
		current.push_back(std::move(p));
	}
	// A draw to other targets ends the pass of the targets it does not use: their last draw's
	// image is final for that pass.
	// Depth-only draws (shadow maps, prepasses) leave the color passes open.
	if (!targets.empty()) {
		FlushExcept(targets);
	}
	for (size_t i = 0; i < current.size(); ++i) {
		g_pending[targets[i]] = std::move(current[i]);
	}
	if (draw >= g_max) {
		FlushExcept({});
		std::fclose(g_index);
		g_index = nullptr;
		g_state.store(State::Idle);
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("Target dump: frame {} done, {} draws in {}\n", g_frame,
		                                      draw, g_folder.string()));
	}
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::TargetDump
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/renderer/targetDump.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_TARGETDUMP_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_RENDERER_TARGETDUMP_H_

#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

namespace Libs::Graphics {
class CommandBuffer;
class RenderContext;
struct DrawRenderState;
} // namespace Libs::Graphics

// Render target dump (KYTY_TARGET_DUMP=1): for one guest frame, started with F9 or at guest flip
// KYTY_TARGET_DUMP_AT_FLIP, every draw's color targets are read back after the draw and saved as
// BMP files in _TargetDump/frame_<n>, with index.csv naming each draw's shaders. Slow (the GPU is
// waited for after each draw): only for finding the draw that renders something wrong.
namespace Libs::Graphics::TargetDump {

void Init();
[[nodiscard]] bool Enabled() noexcept;
void RequestCapture() noexcept;
// Starts the dump with the next draw instead of the next flip (the frame capture calls it with the GPU idle).
void StartCapture() noexcept;
// While a dump is requested or running, no draw is skipped while its pipeline compiles in the
// background: the draw waits (the replay and the game's reference then render the same draws).
[[nodiscard]] bool NoPipelineSkip() noexcept;
void NoteWaitedPipeline() noexcept;
// Called at each guest flip (presentation thread).
void OnFlip() noexcept;
// Called by the execution thread after a draw is recorded.
void AfterDraw(RenderContext& context, CommandBuffer& buffer, const DrawRenderState& state,
               vk::Pipeline pipeline);

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::TargetDump

#endif
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/buffer_scatter.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
// Batched uploads of the buffer cache (see BufferCache::FlushUploadBatch()): one workgroup per job
// copies `size` bytes from the staging buffer to a cached buffer, both by device address. Jobs
// whose addresses and size are 16-byte multiples copy 16 bytes per invocation, others 4.

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

struct Job {
	uint64_t source;
	uint64_t destination;
	uint     size;
	uint     pad0;
	uint64_t pad1;
};

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) readonly buffer Jobs {
	Job jobs[];
};
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) buffer U32x4 {
	uvec4 v[];
};
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) buffer U32 {
	uint v[];
};

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
	uint64_t jobs;
	uint     job_count;
	uint     pad;
} pc;

void main() {
	if (gl_WorkGroupID.x >= pc.job_count) {
		return;
	}
	const Job job = Jobs(pc.jobs).jobs[gl_WorkGroupID.x];
	if (((job.source | job.destination | uint64_t(job.size)) & 15ul) == 0ul) {
		U32x4 source      = U32x4(job.source);
		U32x4 destination = U32x4(job.destination);
		for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationID.x; i < job.size / 16u; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			destination.v[i] = source.v[i];
		}
	} else {
		U32 source      = U32(job.source);
		U32 destination = U32(job.destination);
		for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationID.x; i < job.size / 4u; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			destination.v[i] = source.v[i];
		}
	}
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/fault_buffer_process.comp`:

```comp
// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright 2024 shadPS4 Emulator Project
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later

#version 450
#extension GL_ARB_gpu_shader_int64 : enable

layout(local_size_x = 64, local_size_y = 1, local_size_z = 1) in;

layout(std430, binding = 0) buffer input_buf {
    uint fault_buffer[];
};

layout(std430, binding = 1) buffer output_buf {
    uint64_t download_buffer[];
};
layout(std430, binding = 1) buffer output_buf32 {
    uint download_buffer32[];
};

void main() {
    const uint id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
    uint word = fault_buffer[id];
    if (word == 0u) {
        return;
    }
    // Entry 0 holds the count; the bound area sets the capacity.
    const uint capacity = uint(download_buffer.length());
    const uint base_bit = id * 32u;
    while (word != 0u) {
        const uint store_index = atomicAdd(download_buffer32[0], 1u) + 1u;
        if (store_index >= capacity) {
            // Keep the pages the area has no room for: the next pass reports them.
            fault_buffer[id] = word;
            return;
        }
        const uint bit = findLSB(word);
        word &= word - 1;
        const uint page = base_bit + bit;
        download_buffer[store_index] = uint64_t(page) << CACHING_PAGEBITS;
    }
    fault_buffer[id] = 0u;
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_mesh_indirect.task`:

```task
#version 460
#extension GL_EXT_mesh_shader : require
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require

// One workgroup per indirect record of a mesh draw: it launches the record's groups, instances
// along y, and passes the record's draw parameters to the mesh shader in the payload
// (IR::PushData::MeshTaskPayloadDwordCount).
layout(local_size_x = 1) in;

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) readonly buffer Record {
	uint dwords[5];
};
// MeshTaskParams in renderDraw.cpp.
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) readonly buffer Params {
	uint64_t records;
	uint64_t index_address;
	uint     stride;
	uint     index_size;
	uint     index_limit;
	uint     primitive_size;
	uint     group_step;
	uint     max_groups;
	uint     max_instances;
	uint     max_total;
};
layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
	Params params;
};

taskPayloadSharedEXT uint payload[6];

void main() {
	Record   record        = Record(params.records + uint64_t(gl_WorkGroupID.x) * params.stride);
	uint     count         = record.dwords[0];
	uint     instances     = record.dwords[1];
	uint64_t index_address = params.index_address;
	// The base vertex and first instance follow the first index in indexed records.
	uint base = 2;
	if (params.index_size != 0) {
		// Indices past INDEX_BUFFER_SIZE are never read.
		const uint first = record.dwords[2];
		count = min(count, params.index_limit - min(first, params.index_limit));
		index_address += uint64_t(first) * params.index_size;
		base = 3;
	}
	payload[0] = count;
	payload[1] = record.dwords[base];
	payload[2] = params.index_size;
	payload[3] = uint(index_address);
	payload[4] = uint(index_address >> 32);
	payload[5] = record.dwords[base + 1];
	uint groups =
	    count < params.primitive_size ? 0 : (count - params.primitive_size) / params.group_step + 1;
	// Past the host launch limits, where direct draws exit, the record draws nothing.
	if (groups > params.max_groups || instances > params.max_instances ||
	    uint64_t(groups) * instances > params.max_total) {
		groups = 0;
	}
	EmitMeshTasksEXT(groups, instances, 1);
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_pssr_linear.comp`:

```comp
#version 450 core
#extension GL_EXT_samplerless_texture_functions : require

layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
layout(binding = 0) uniform texture2D source;
layout(binding = 1) writeonly uniform image2D destination;
layout(push_constant) uniform Parameters {
	uvec2 input_size;
	uvec2 output_size;
	uvec4 output_channels;
} parameters;

vec4 fetch_color(ivec2 coordinate) {
	return texelFetch(source, clamp(coordinate, ivec2(0), ivec2(parameters.input_size) - 1), 0);
}

void main() {
	uvec2 output_coordinate = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
	if (any(greaterThanEqual(output_coordinate, parameters.output_size))) return;
	vec2 input_coordinate = (vec2(output_coordinate) + 0.5) *
	                        vec2(parameters.input_size) / vec2(parameters.output_size) - 0.5;
	ivec2 lower = ivec2(floor(input_coordinate));
	vec2 weight = fract(input_coordinate);
	vec4 color = mix(mix(fetch_color(lower), fetch_color(lower + ivec2(1, 0)), weight.x),
	                 mix(fetch_color(lower + ivec2(0, 1)), fetch_color(lower + ivec2(1, 1)), weight.x),
	                 weight.y);
	vec4 stored = vec4(0.0);
	for (uint channel = 0; channel < 3; ++channel) {
		uint selected = parameters.output_channels[channel];
		if (selected < 4) stored[channel] = color[selected];
	}
	imageStore(destination, ivec2(output_coordinate), stored);
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_color.inc`:

```inc
// ColorTransform values match imageInfo.h. Preserve the component bit fields exactly.
uvec2 transform_color(uvec2 value, uint transform, bool to_host) {
	switch (transform) {
		case 1u:
			return uvec2((value.y & 0xffffu) | (value.x & 0xffff0000u),
			             (value.x & 0xffffu) | (value.y & 0xffff0000u));
		case 2u: {
			uint packed = value.x;
			if (to_host) {
				value.x = (packed >> 21u) | (((packed >> 10u) & 0x7ffu) << 11u) |
				          ((packed & 0x3ffu) << 22u);
			} else {
				value.x = (packed >> 22u) | (((packed >> 11u) & 0x7ffu) << 10u) |
				          ((packed & 0x7ffu) << 21u);
			}
			break;
		}
		case 3u:
			if (to_host) {
				value.x = (value.x >> 2u) | (value.x << 30u);
			} else {
				value.x = (value.x << 2u) | (value.x >> 30u);
			}
			break;
	}
	return value;
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_color_clear.comp`:

```comp
#version 450

// One workgroup per metadata slice; see TileManager::CheckColorClear.
layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) buffer Metadata { uint data[]; } metadata;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) writeonly buffer Predicates { uint data[]; } predicates;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Check {
	uint metadata_base;
	uint words;
	uint stride;
	uint keys;
	uint expand;
} params;

const uint Slots = 16u; // TileManager::ColorClearSlots

shared uint key;
shared uint mismatch;

void main() {
	const uint slice = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
	const uint base  = (params.metadata_base >> 2u) + slice * params.stride;
	// Each invocation reads, and may rewrite, only its own words.
	if (gl_LocalInvocationIndex == 0u) {
		key      = metadata.data[base] & 0xffu;
		mismatch = 0u;
	}
	barrier();
	const uint pattern = key * 0x01010101u;
	bool       same    = true;
	for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationIndex; same && i < params.words; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
		same = metadata.data[base + i] == pattern;
	}
	if (!same) {
		atomicOr(mismatch, 1u);
	}
	barrier();
	const uint slot = key >> 4u;
	const bool hit  = mismatch == 0u && (key & 0xfu) == 0u && (params.keys & (1u << slot)) != 0u;
	if (gl_LocalInvocationIndex < Slots) {
		predicates.data[slice * Slots + gl_LocalInvocationIndex] =
		    uint(hit && slot == gl_LocalInvocationIndex);
	}
	if (hit && params.expand != 0u) {
		for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationIndex; i < params.words; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			metadata.data[base + i] = 0xffffffffu;
		}
	}
}

```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_color_transform.comp`:

```comp
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require

layout(local_size_x = 64) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Input { uint data[]; } input_buffer;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) buffer Output { uint data[]; } output_buffer;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Conversion {
	uint src_base;
	uint dst_base;
	uint width;
	uint height;
	uint source_pitch;
	uint target_pitch;
	uint color_transform;
	uint to_host;
} params;

#include "gpu_tiler_color.inc"

void main() {
	uint pixel = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
	if (pixel >= params.width) {
		return;
	}
	uint words = params.color_transform == 1u ? 2u : 1u;
	uint src = (params.src_base >> 2u) + pixel * words;
	uint dst = (params.dst_base >> 2u) + pixel * words;
	uvec2 value = uvec2(input_buffer.data[src], 0u);
	if (words == 2u) value.y = input_buffer.data[src + 1u];
	value = transform_color(value, params.color_transform, params.to_host != 0u);
	output_buffer.data[dst] = value.x;
	if (words == 2u) output_buffer.data[dst + 1u] = value.y;
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_common.inc`:

```inc
#extension GL_EXT_shader_8bit_storage : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage : require

layout(local_size_x = 64) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Input { uint data[]; } input_buffer;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) buffer Output { uint data[]; } output_buffer;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Input8 { uint8_t data[]; } input_buffer8;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) buffer Output8 { uint8_t data[]; } output_buffer8;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Input16 { uint16_t data[]; } input_buffer16;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) buffer Output16 { uint16_t data[]; } output_buffer16;

struct Mip {
	uint src_base;
	uint dst_base;
	uint width;
	uint height;
	uint pitch_bytes;
	uint slice_bytes;
	uint tiled_slice_bytes;
	uint blocks_per_row;
	uint surface_z;
	uint tail_x;
	uint tail_y;
	uint num_texels;
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 2, std140) uniform TilingInfo {
	uint num_texels;
	uint color_transform;
	Mip mips[16];
} info;

#include "gpu_tiler_color.inc"

void copy_element(uint src, uint dst) {
	if ((ELEMENT_BYTES == 4u || ELEMENT_BYTES == 8u) && info.color_transform != 0u) {
		uvec2 value = uvec2(input_buffer.data[src >> 2], 0u);
		if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 8u) value.y = input_buffer.data[(src >> 2) + 1u];
		value = transform_color(value, info.color_transform, TILE == 0u);
		output_buffer.data[dst >> 2] = value.x;
		if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 8u) output_buffer.data[(dst >> 2) + 1u] = value.y;
	} else if (ELEMENT_BYTES >= 4) {
		for (uint i = 0; i < ELEMENT_BYTES; i += 4) {
			output_buffer.data[(dst + i) >> 2] = input_buffer.data[(src + i) >> 2];
		}
	} else if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 2) {
		output_buffer16.data[dst >> 1] = input_buffer16.data[src >> 1];
	} else {
		output_buffer8.data[dst] = input_buffer8.data[src];
	}
}

void main() {
	uint group = gl_WorkGroupID.y * gl_NumWorkGroups.x + gl_WorkGroupID.x;
	// Reject padding groups before multiplying: the active range may approach 4 GiB.
	if (group > (info.num_texels - 1u) / 64u) {
		return;
	}
	uint texel = group * 64u + gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
	if (texel >= info.num_texels) {
		return;
	}
	uint mip = 0u;
	uint mip_texels = info.mips[mip].num_texels;
	while (texel >= mip_texels) {
		texel -= mip_texels;
		mip_texels = info.mips[++mip].num_texels;
	}
	Mip params = info.mips[mip];
	uint row = texel / params.width;
	uint z = row / params.height;
	uvec3 p = uvec3(texel - row * params.width, row - z * params.height, z);

	uvec3 extent = block_extent();
	uvec3 block = p / extent;
	uvec3 swizzle = p + uvec3(params.tail_x, params.tail_y, params.surface_z);

	uint block_index = block.y * params.blocks_per_row + block.x;
	uint tiled = block.z * params.tiled_slice_bytes + block_index * BLOCK_BYTES +
	             block_offset(swizzle);
	uint linear = p.z * params.slice_bytes + p.y * params.pitch_bytes +
	              p.x * ELEMENT_BYTES;
	if (TILE == 0) {
		copy_element(params.src_base + tiled, params.dst_base + linear);
	} else {
		copy_element(params.src_base + linear, params.dst_base + tiled);
	}
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_demote_d16.comp`:

```comp
#version 450
#extension GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage : require

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint D32 = 0u;
layout(local_size_x = 64) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Input { uint data[]; } input_buffer;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) buffer Output { uint16_t data[]; } output_buffer;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Conversion {
	uint src_base;
	uint dst_base;
	uint width;
	uint height;
	uint source_pitch;
	uint target_pitch;
	uint color_transform;
	uint to_host;
} params;

uint decode(uint value) {
	float normalized = D32 != 0u
		? clamp(uintBitsToFloat(value), 0.0, 1.0)
		: float(value & 0x00ffffffu) / 16777215.0;
	return uint(round(normalized * 65535.0));
}

void main() {
	uint x = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
	uint y = gl_GlobalInvocationID.y;
	if (x >= params.width || y >= params.height) {
		return;
	}
	uint src = params.src_base + y * params.source_pitch + x * 4u;
	uint dst = params.dst_base + y * params.target_pitch + x * 2u;
	output_buffer.data[dst >> 1u] = uint16_t(decode(input_buffer.data[src >> 2u]));
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_depth.comp`:

```comp
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
layout(constant_id = 0) const uint ELEMENT_BYTES = 4u;
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint TILE = 0u;
const uint BLOCK_BYTES = 65536u;
uvec3 block_extent() {
	uint width = ELEMENT_BYTES <= 2 ? 256u : 128u;
	return uvec3(width, BLOCK_BYTES / (width * ELEMENT_BYTES), 1u);
}
uint block_offset(uvec3 p) {
	uint x = p.x, y = p.y;
	uint z = ((p.z & 8u) << 5) ^ ((p.z & 4u) << 7) ^
	         ((p.z & 2u) << 9) ^ ((p.z & 1u) << 11);
	switch (ELEMENT_BYTES) {
	case 1: return z ^ (x & 1u) ^ ((x << 1) & 0x004u) ^ ((x << 2) & 0x010u) ^
	               ((x << 3) & 0x040u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x300u) ^
	               ((x << 4) & 0x400u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^
	               ((x << 7) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x8000u) ^
	               ((y << 1) & 0x002u) ^ ((y << 2) & 0x008u) ^
	               ((y << 3) & 0x0a0u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0xf00u) ^
	               ((y << 6) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 7) & 0x4000u);
	case 2: return z ^ ((x << 1) & 0x002u) ^ ((x << 2) & 0x008u) ^
	               ((x << 3) & 0x020u) ^ ((x << 4) & 0x480u) ^
	               ((x << 5) & 0x300u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^
	               ((x << 7) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x8000u) ^
	               ((y << 2) & 0x004u) ^ ((y << 3) & 0x010u) ^
	               ((y << 4) & 0x040u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0xf00u) ^ ((y << 8) & 0x5000u);
	case 4: return z ^ ((x << 2) & 0x004u) ^ ((x << 3) & 0x010u) ^
	                ((x << 4) & 0x440u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x300u) ^
	                ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^ ((x << 9) & 0xa000u) ^
	                ((y << 3) & 0x008u) ^ ((y << 4) & 0x020u) ^
	                ((y << 5) & 0xf80u) ^ ((y << 9) & 0x1000u) ^
	                ((y << 8) & 0x4000u);
	default: return z ^ ((x << 3) & 0x008u) ^ ((x << 4) & 0x420u) ^
	                ((x << 5) & 0x380u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^
	                ((x << 10) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 9) & 0x8000u) ^
	                ((y << 4) & 0x010u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0xf40u) ^
	                ((y << 10) & 0x5000u);
	}
}
#include "gpu_tiler_common.inc"
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_promote_d16.comp`:

```comp
#version 450

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint D32 = 0u;
layout(local_size_x = 64) in;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Input { uint data[]; } input_buffer;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) buffer Output { uint data[]; } output_buffer;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Conversion {
	uint src_base;
	uint dst_base;
	uint width;
	uint height;
	uint source_pitch;
	uint target_pitch;
	uint color_transform;
	uint to_host;
} params;

void main() {
	uint x = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
	uint y = gl_GlobalInvocationID.y;
	if (x >= params.width || y >= params.height) {
		return;
	}
	uint src = params.src_base + y * params.source_pitch + x * 2u;
	uint packed = input_buffer.data[src >> 2u];
	uint value = (packed >> ((src & 2u) * 8u)) & 0xffffu;
	uint encoded = D32 != 0u
		? floatBitsToUint(float(value) / 65535.0)
		: value * 256u + (value + 128u) / 257u;
	uint dst = params.dst_base + y * params.target_pitch + x * 4u;
	output_buffer.data[dst >> 2u] = encoded;
}
```

```comp
	uvec4 s = ELEMENT_BYTES == 1 ? uvec4(7, 7, 6, 6) :
	          ELEMENT_BYTES == 2 ? uvec4(7, 6, 6, 5) :
	          ELEMENT_BYTES == 4 ? uvec4(6, 6, 5, 5) :
	          ELEMENT_BYTES == 8 ? uvec4(6, 5, 5, 4) : uvec4(5, 5, 4, 4);

	             (((p.x >> s.z) & 1u) << 10) ^ (((p.y >> s.w) & 1u) << 11);
	return standard64_offset(p.xy) ^ delta;
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_render_target.comp`:

```comp
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
layout(constant_id = 0) const uint ELEMENT_BYTES = 4u;
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint TILE = 0u;
const uint BLOCK_BYTES = 65536u;
uvec3 block_extent() {
	uint width = ELEMENT_BYTES <= 2 ? 256u : (ELEMENT_BYTES <= 8 ? 128u : 64u);
	return uvec3(width, BLOCK_BYTES / (width * ELEMENT_BYTES), 1u);
}
uint rt_offset(uint x, uint y) {
	switch (ELEMENT_BYTES) {
	case 1: return ((y << 2) & 0x008u) ^ ((y << 4) & 0x010u) ^
	               ((y << 3) & 0x0a0u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0xf00u) ^
	               ((y << 6) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 7) & 0x4000u) ^ (x & 7u) ^
	               ((x << 3) & 0x040u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x300u) ^
	               ((x << 4) & 0x400u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^
	               ((x << 7) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x8000u);
	case 2: return ((y << 4) & 0x070u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0xf00u) ^
	               ((y << 8) & 0x5000u) ^ ((x << 1) & 0x00eu) ^
	               ((x << 4) & 0x480u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x300u) ^
	               ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x2000u) ^
	               ((x << 8) & 0x8000u);
	case 4: return ((y << 4) & 0x070u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0xf00u) ^
	               ((y << 9) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 8) & 0x4000u) ^
	               ((x << 2) & 0x00cu) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x380u) ^
	               ((x << 4) & 0x400u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^ ((x << 9) & 0xa000u);
	case 8: return ((y << 4) & 0x010u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x080u) ^
	               ((y << 5) & 0xf00u) ^ ((y << 10) & 0x5000u) ^
	               ((x << 3) & 0x008u) ^ ((x << 4) & 0x460u) ^
	               ((x << 5) & 0x300u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^
	               ((x << 10) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 9) & 0x8000u);
	default: return ((x << 4) & 0x410u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x340u) ^
	                ((x << 6) & 0x800u) ^ ((x << 11) & 0xa000u) ^
	                ((y << 5) & 0xf20u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x080u) ^
	                ((y << 10) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 11) & 0x4000u);
	}
}
uint volume_z(uint z) {
	return ((z & 8u) << 5) ^ ((z & 4u) << 7) ^ ((z & 2u) << 9) ^ ((z & 1u) << 11);
}
uint block_offset(uvec3 p) { return rt_offset(p.x, p.y) ^ volume_z(p.z); }
#include "gpu_tiler_common.inc"
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_standard.inc`:

```inc
uint standard_offset(uvec2 p) {
	uint x = p.x, y = p.y;
	switch (ELEMENT_BYTES) {
	case 1: return ((y << 4) & 0x1f0u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0x400u) ^ (x & 0x00fu) ^
	               ((x << 5) & 0x200u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u);
	case 2: return ((y << 4) & 0x070u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0x100u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x400u) ^
	               ((x << 1) & 0x00eu) ^ ((x << 4) & 0x080u) ^
	               ((x << 5) & 0x200u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x800u);
	case 4: return ((y << 4) & 0x070u) ^ ((y << 5) & 0x100u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x400u) ^
	               ((x << 2) & 0x00cu) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x080u) ^
	               ((x << 6) & 0x200u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x800u);
	case 8: return ((y << 4) & 0x030u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x100u) ^ ((y << 7) & 0x400u) ^
	               ((x << 3) & 0x008u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x0c0u) ^
	               ((x << 6) & 0x200u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x800u);
	default: return ((y << 4) & 0x030u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x100u) ^ ((y << 7) & 0x400u) ^
	                ((x << 6) & 0x0c0u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x200u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x800u);
	}
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_tiler_standard4_3d.inc`:

```inc
uint standard3d_offset(uvec3 p) {
	uint x = p.x, y = p.y, z = p.z;
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 1)
		return (x & 3u) ^ ((x << 4) & 0x40u) ^ ((x << 6) & 0x200u) ^
		       ((y << 3) & 8u) ^ ((y << 4) & 0x20u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x100u) ^
		       ((y << 8) & 0x800u) ^ ((z << 2) & 4u) ^ ((z << 3) & 0x10u) ^
		       ((z << 5) & 0x80u) ^ ((z << 7) & 0x400u);
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 2)
		return ((x << 1) & 2u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x40u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x200u) ^
		       ((y << 3) & 8u) ^ ((y << 4) & 0x20u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x100u) ^
		       ((y << 8) & 0x800u) ^ ((z << 2) & 4u) ^ ((z << 3) & 0x10u) ^
		       ((z << 5) & 0x80u) ^ ((z << 7) & 0x400u);
	uint z_part = ((z << 4) & 0x10u) ^ ((z << 6) & 0x80u) ^ ((z << 8) & 0x400u);
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 4)
		return ((x << 2) & 4u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x40u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x200u) ^
		       ((y << 3) & 8u) ^ ((y << 4) & 0x20u) ^ ((y << 6) & 0x100u) ^
		       ((y << 8) & 0x800u) ^ z_part;
	uint y_part = ((y << 5) & 0x20u) ^ ((y << 7) & 0x100u) ^ ((y << 9) & 0x800u);
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 8)
		return ((x << 3) & 8u) ^ ((x << 5) & 0x40u) ^ ((x << 7) & 0x200u) ^ y_part ^ z_part;
	return ((x << 6) & 0x40u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x200u) ^ y_part ^ z_part;
}
```

```inc
#include "gpu_tiler_standard.inc"
uint standard64_offset(uvec2 p) {
	uint x = p.x, y = p.y;
	uint offset = standard_offset(p);
	switch (ELEMENT_BYTES) {
	case 1: return offset ^ ((x << 7) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x8000u) ^
	                       ((y << 6) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 7) & 0x4000u);
	case 2: return offset ^ ((x << 7) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 8) & 0x8000u) ^
	                       ((y << 7) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 8) & 0x4000u);
	case 4: return offset ^ ((x << 8) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 9) & 0x8000u) ^
	                       ((y << 7) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 8) & 0x4000u);
	case 8: return offset ^ ((x << 8) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 9) & 0x8000u) ^
	                       ((y << 8) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 9) & 0x4000u);
	default: return offset ^ ((x << 9) & 0x2000u) ^ ((x << 10) & 0x8000u) ^
	                        ((y << 8) & 0x1000u) ^ ((y << 9) & 0x4000u);
	}
}
```

```inc
#include "gpu_tiler_standard4_3d.inc"
uvec3 standard64_3d_extent() {
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 1) return uvec3(64, 32, 32);
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 2) return uvec3(32, 32, 32);
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 4) return uvec3(32, 32, 16);
	if (ELEMENT_BYTES == 8) return uvec3(32, 16, 16);
	return uvec3(16, 16, 16);
}
uint standard64_3d_offset(uvec3 p) {
	uvec4 s = ELEMENT_BYTES == 1 ? uvec4(4, 4, 4, 5) :
	          ELEMENT_BYTES == 2 ? uvec4(3, 4, 4, 4) :
	          ELEMENT_BYTES == 4 ? uvec4(3, 3, 4, 4) :
	          ELEMENT_BYTES == 8 ? uvec4(3, 3, 3, 4) : uvec4(2, 3, 3, 3);
	return standard3d_offset(p) ^ (((p.x >> s.x) & 1u) << 12) ^
	       (((p.z >> s.y) & 1u) << 13) ^ (((p.y >> s.z) & 1u) << 14) ^
	       (((p.x >> s.w) & 1u) << 15);
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_video_out_hdr10_to_sdr.inc`:

```inc
// Converts SMPTE ST 2084 PQ (or linear nits) Rec.2020 to sRGB-encoded Rec.709. The 250-nit SDR
// white scales to 1.0, then an extended Reinhard curve rolls off luminance above 0.75 so that
// 10,000 nits reaches 1.0.
vec3 Hdr10ToSdr(vec3 rgb, bool source_linear) {
	vec3 nits = clamp(rgb, 0.0, 10000.0);
	if (!source_linear) {
		vec3 powered = pow(rgb, vec3(32.0 / 2523.0));
		nits = 10000.0 * pow(max(powered - 3424.0 / 4096.0, 0.0) /
		                         (2413.0 / 128.0 - (2392.0 / 128.0) * powered),
		                     vec3(16384.0 / 2610.0));
	}
	const mat3 to_rec709 = (1.0 / 250.0) *
	    mat3(1.660491, -0.124550, -0.018151,
	         -0.587641, 1.132900, -0.100579,
	         -0.072850, -0.008349, 1.118730);
	vec3 linear = max(to_rec709 * nits, 0.0);
	const float knee = 0.75;
	const float span = 1.0 - knee;
	const float white = (10000.0 / 250.0 - knee) / span;
	float luma = dot(linear, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
	if (luma > knee) {
		float x = (luma - knee) / span;
		linear *= (knee + span * x * (1.0 + x / (white * white)) / (1.0 + x)) / luma;
	}
	linear = clamp(linear, 0.0, 1.0);
	return mix(linear * 12.92, 1.055 * pow(linear, vec3(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055,
	           greaterThan(linear, vec3(0.0031308)));
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/gpu_video_out_overlay.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require

layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;

vec3 SdrToHdr10(vec3 rgb, bool source_linear) {
	rgb = clamp(rgb, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 linear = source_linear ? rgb :
	    mix(rgb / 12.92, pow((rgb + 0.055) / 1.055, vec3(2.4)),
	        greaterThan(rgb, vec3(0.04045)));
	// Convert primaries and scale 250-nit reference white relative to 10,000 nits.
	const mat3 to_rec2020 = (250.0 / 10000.0) *
	    mat3(0.627404, 0.069097, 0.016391,
	         0.329283, 0.919540, 0.088013,
	         0.043313, 0.011362, 0.895595);
	vec3 powered = pow(to_rec2020 * linear, vec3(2610.0 / 16384.0));
	return pow((3424.0 / 4096.0 + (2413.0 / 128.0) * powered) /
	               (1.0 + (2392.0 / 128.0) * powered), vec3(2523.0 / 32.0));
}

#ifdef IMGUI_HDR
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform texture2D image;
layout(set = 1, binding = 0) uniform sampler image_sampler;
layout(location = 0) in struct { vec4 Color; vec2 UV; } In;

void main() {
	vec4 sampled = In.Color * texture(sampler2D(image, image_sampler), In.UV);
	color = vec4(SdrToHdr10(sampled.rgb, false), sampled.a);
}
#else
#include "gpu_video_out_hdr10_to_sdr.inc"

layout(location = 0) in vec2 uv;
layout(binding = 0) uniform sampler2D source;
layout(push_constant) uniform AlphaControl {
	uint flags; // bit 0: premultiplied, 1: HDR target, 2: PQ source, 3: linear source, 4: opaque
};

void main() {
	const uint HDR_TARGET = 2u;
	const uint PQ_SOURCE = 4u;
	vec4 sampled = texture(source, uv);
	if ((flags & 16u) != 0u) {
		sampled.a = 1.0;
	}
	bool premultiplied = (flags & 1u) != 0u;
	uint conversion = flags & (HDR_TARGET | PQ_SOURCE);
	bool convert = conversion == HDR_TARGET || conversion == PQ_SOURCE;
	if (convert && premultiplied) {
		sampled.rgb = sampled.a > 0.0 ? sampled.rgb / sampled.a : vec3(0.0);
	}
	if (conversion == HDR_TARGET) {
		sampled.rgb = SdrToHdr10(sampled.rgb, (flags & 8u) != 0u);
	} else if (conversion == PQ_SOURCE) {
		sampled.rgb = Hdr10ToSdr(sampled.rgb, (flags & 8u) != 0u);
	}
	if (!premultiplied || convert) {
		sampled.rgb *= sampled.a;
	}
	color = sampled;
}
#endif
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/hle_blas_refit.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
// HLE of the title's BLAS refits (see CommandProcessor::HleBlasDispatch()): every frame the game
// updates the BLASes of animated geometry in place: the vertices of their triangle nodes from
// the geometry's vertex buffer and then, bottom up, the boxes of their box32 nodes. The topology
// stays.
//
// BLAS header: +56.. refit bookkeeping (not needed here), +64 u64 offset of the vertex index
// table (5 u32 per triangle node), +80 u64 offset of the first triangle node of each geometry
// (u32 per geometry), +108 geometry count, +120 triangle node count, +124 first triangle node
// (64-byte units from the BLAS). Triangle node: 5 vertices (3 floats each), word 15 the
// barycentric remap. Box32 node: 4 child pointers, 4 boxes (lo.xyz hi.xyz), 16 bytes of ones.
// Leaves: lists of 8-byte entries at BLAS + 8 * (pointer >> 3): a triangle node pointer
// (type 0-3 = one of its 4 triangles, 7 = an AABB of the geometry entry pointer >> 3) and a
// primitive word (bit 31: last entry).
//
// MODE_VERTICES: one workgroup per geometry job (a geometry of a BLAS, as dispatched by the
// game, with its vertex buffer V# and object matrix): rewrites its triangle nodes' vertices.
// MODE_BOXES: one workgroup per BLAS: lists its box nodes level by level from the root, then
// recomputes the child boxes of each level from the deepest up (non-finite boxes become empty
// ones, degenerate triangles are skipped, as the game does).

#include "rt_common.inc"

layout(local_size_x = 512) in;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
	uint64_t jobs;
	uint64_t pool;
	uint64_t state;
	uint     mode;
	uint     job_count;
	uint     pool_capacity;
	uint     pad;
} pc;

const uint MODE_VERTICES = 0u;
const uint MODE_BOXES    = 1u;

// A geometry job (96 bytes).
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) buffer GeometryJob {
	uint64_t blas;
	uint     geometry;
	uint     pad;
	uvec4    vsharp;
	vec4     matrix[4];
};

// A BLAS job (16 bytes).
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer BlasJob {
	uint64_t blas;
	uint     pool_offset;
	uint     pool_size;
};

// The refit state (cleared before each refit).
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) buffer State {
	uint pool_cursor;
};

// Box reads and writes of the bottom-up pass see the writes of the level below (other
// invocations of the workgroup).
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) coherent buffer CoherentU32x4 { uvec4 v; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) coherent buffer CoherentU32 { uint v; };

// The child boxes of a box32 node (host address, 0 when not cached: zero boxes), coherently.
void LoadBoxes(uint64_t host, out vec3 lo[4], out vec3 hi[4]) {
	uint words[24];
	for (uint i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
		const uvec4 v    = host == 0 ? uvec4(0) : CoherentU32x4(host + 16 + i * 16).v;
		words[i * 4]     = v.x;
		words[i * 4 + 1] = v.y;
		words[i * 4 + 2] = v.z;
		words[i * 4 + 3] = v.w;
	}
	for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
		lo[c] = uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(words[c * 6], words[c * 6 + 1], words[c * 6 + 2]));
		hi[c] = uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(words[c * 6 + 3], words[c * 6 + 4], words[c * 6 + 5]));
	}
}

shared uint s_level_begin[65];
shared uint s_levels;
shared uint s_tail;
shared uint s_overflow;
shared uint s_base;
shared uint s_size;

// A buffer load with format of three components (BUFFER_LOAD_FORMAT_XYZ): the components of
// element `index` of the V# (0 out of range). Formats of 8, 16 and 32-bit components.
vec3 LoadFormatXyz(uvec4 v, uint index) {
	const uint64_t base  = uint64_t(v.x) | (uint64_t(v.y & 0xffffu) << 32);
	const uint     stride = (v.y >> 16) & 0x3fffu;
	const uint     records = v.z;
	const uint     format  = (v.w >> 12) & 0x7fu;
	if (index >= records) {
		return vec3(0.0);
	}
	const uint64_t va = base + uint64_t(index) * stride;
	// Component count, bits and type: 0 unorm, 1 snorm, 2 uscaled, 3 sscaled, 4 uint, 5 sint,
	// 6 float.
	uint comps = 0, bits = 0, type = 0;
	if (format >= 1u && format <= 6u) { comps = 1; bits = 8; type = format - 1u; }
	else if (format >= 7u && format <= 13u) { comps = 1; bits = 16; type = format - 7u; }
	else if (format >= 14u && format <= 19u) { comps = 2; bits = 8; type = format - 14u; }
	else if (format >= 20u && format <= 22u) { comps = 1; bits = 32; type = format - 20u + 4u; }
	else if (format >= 23u && format <= 29u) { comps = 2; bits = 16; type = format - 23u; }
	else if (format >= 56u && format <= 61u) { comps = 4; bits = 8; type = format - 56u; }
	else if (format >= 62u && format <= 64u) { comps = 2; bits = 32; type = format - 62u + 4u; }
	else if (format >= 65u && format <= 71u) { comps = 4; bits = 16; type = format - 65u; }
	else if (format >= 72u && format <= 74u) { comps = 3; bits = 32; type = format - 72u + 4u; }
	else if (format >= 75u && format <= 77u) { comps = 4; bits = 32; type = format - 75u + 4u; }
	else {
		return vec3(0.0);
	}
	vec3 result = vec3(0.0);
	for (uint c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
		if (c >= comps) {
			break;
		}
		const uint byte_offset = c * (bits / 8u);
		const uint64_t at      = va + byte_offset;
		const uint     word    = LoadGuestU32(at & ~uint64_t(3));
		const uint     shift   = uint(at & 3u) * 8u;
		uint           raw     = bits == 32u ? word : (word >> shift) & ((1u << bits) - 1u);
		if (bits != 32u && shift + bits > 32u) {
			raw = 0u; // unaligned element (not expected)
		}
		float value = 0.0;
		const uint sign_bit = 1u << (bits - 1u);
		const int  sraw     = bits == 32u ? int(raw) : int(raw ^ sign_bit) - int(sign_bit);
		switch (type) {
			case 0u: value = bits == 32u ? 0.0 : float(raw) / float((1u << bits) - 1u); break;
			case 1u: value = bits == 32u ? 0.0 : max(float(sraw) / float(sign_bit - 1u), -1.0); break;
			case 2u: value = float(raw); break;
			case 3u: value = float(sraw); break;
			case 4u: value = uintBitsToFloat(raw); break; // integer formats keep their bits
			case 5u: value = uintBitsToFloat(raw); break;
			case 6u:
				value = bits == 32u ? uintBitsToFloat(raw) : (bits == 16u ? unpackHalf2x16(raw).x : 0.0);
				break;
		}
		result[c] = value;
	}
	return result;
}

void VertexJob(uint job_index) {
	GeometryJob       job  = GeometryJob(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * 96);
	const uint64_t    blas = job.blas;
	if (blas == 0) {
		return;
	}
	const uint64_t index_table = blas + LoadGuestU64(blas + 64);
	const uint64_t first_table = blas + LoadGuestU64(blas + 80);
	const uint     geometries  = LoadGuestU32(blas + 108);
	const uint     node_count  = LoadGuestU32(blas + 120);
	const uint     node_first  = LoadGuestU32(blas + 124);
	const uint     g           = job.geometry;
	if (g >= geometries) {
		return;
	}
	const uint first = LoadGuestU32(first_table + uint64_t(g) * 4);
	const uint end   = g + 1u < geometries ? LoadGuestU32(first_table + uint64_t(g + 1u) * 4) : node_count;
	const uvec4 vsharp = job.vsharp;
	const mat4  m      = mat4(job.matrix[0], job.matrix[1], job.matrix[2], job.matrix[3]);
	for (uint n = first + gl_LocalInvocationID.x; n < end && n < node_count; n += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
		const uint64_t ids  = index_table + uint64_t(n) * 20;
		const uint64_t node = blas + (uint64_t(node_first + n) << 6);
		float          out_v[15];
		for (uint k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
			const vec3 p = LoadFormatXyz(vsharp, LoadGuestU32(ids + k * 4));
			vec3 q = vec3(m[0][0] * p.x + m[1][0] * p.y + m[2][0] * p.z + m[3][0],
			              m[0][1] * p.x + m[1][1] * p.y + m[2][1] * p.z + m[3][1],
			              m[0][2] * p.x + m[1][2] * p.y + m[2][2] * p.z + m[3][2]);
			if (any(isnan(q))) {
				q = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7f7fffffu));
			}
			out_v[k * 3]     = q.x;
			out_v[k * 3 + 1] = q.y;
			out_v[k * 3 + 2] = q.z;
		}
		// A 64-byte node never crosses a caching page.
		const uint64_t host = HostAddress(node);
		if (host != 0) {
			for (uint w = 0; w < 12; w += 4) {
				U32x4Ref(host + w * 4).v =
				    floatBitsToUint(vec4(out_v[w], out_v[w + 1], out_v[w + 2], out_v[w + 3]));
			}
			U32Ref(host + 48).v = floatBitsToUint(out_v[12]);
			U32Ref(host + 52).v = floatBitsToUint(out_v[13]);
			U32Ref(host + 56).v = floatBitsToUint(out_v[14]);
		}
	}
}

// The bounds of a leaf list: its triangles (degenerate ones skipped) and AABBs.
void LeafBounds(uint64_t blas, uint leaf, inout vec3 lo, inout vec3 hi) {
	const uint first = leaf >> 3;
	for (uint k = 0; k < kMaxLeafEntries; k++) {
		const uvec2    pair  = LoadGuestU32x2(blas + (uint64_t(first + k) << 3));
		const uint     tri   = pair.x;
		const uint     word  = pair.y;
		if (NodeType(tri) == 7u) {
			// AABB primitives: not refit here (no dynamic BLAS seen with them); keep bounds open
			// so the box stays conservative.
			lo = vec3(-uintBitsToFloat(0x7f7fffffu));
			hi = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7f7fffffu));
		} else if (NodeType(tri) < 4u) {
			const uint64_t node = blas + (uint64_t(tri >> 3) << 6);
			vec3 p[3];
			LoadTriangle(node, NodeType(tri), p);
			const vec3 a = p[0];
			const vec3 b = p[1];
			const vec3 c = p[2];
			if (!(all(equal(a, b)) || all(equal(a, c)) || all(equal(b, c)))) {
				lo = min(lo, min(a, min(b, c)));
				hi = max(hi, max(a, max(b, c)));
			}
		}
		if ((word & 0x80000000u) != 0) {
			break;
		}
	}
}

bool Finite(vec3 v) {
	return !any(isnan(v)) && !any(isinf(v));
}

void BoxJob(uint job_index) {
	const uint     lid  = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
	BlasJob        job   = BlasJob(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * 16);
	const uint64_t blas  = job.blas;
	State          state = State(pc.state);
	if (lid == 0) {
		s_levels   = 0;
		s_overflow = 0;
		s_tail     = 0;
		// Box nodes never outnumber the node limit of the BLAS.
		s_size = min(LoadGuestU32(blas + 88) + 1u, 1u << 20);
		s_base = atomicAdd(state.pool_cursor, s_size);
		if (blas == 0 || s_base + s_size > pc.pool_capacity || s_base + s_size < s_base) {
			s_overflow = 1;
		} else {
			U32Ref(pc.pool + uint64_t(s_base) * 4).v = 0x25u;
			s_tail           = 1;
			s_level_begin[0] = 0;
		}
	}
	barrier();
	if (s_overflow != 0) {
		return;
	}
	const uint64_t queue = pc.pool + uint64_t(s_base) * 4;
	// Top down: level l holds the queue entries [s_level_begin[l], s_level_begin[l + 1]).
	uint head = 0;
	for (uint level = 0; level < 64; level++) {
		const uint tail = s_tail;
		if (head == tail) {
			break;
		}
		for (uint i = head + lid; i < tail; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			const uint     node    = U32Ref(queue + uint64_t(i) * 4).v;
			const uint64_t address = blas + (uint64_t(node >> 3) << 6);
			const uvec4    children = LoadGuestU32x4(address);
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				const uint child = children[c];
				if (child != kInvalidNode && NodeType(child) == 5u) {
					const uint slot = atomicAdd(s_tail, 1u);
					if (slot < s_size) {
						U32Ref(queue + uint64_t(slot) * 4).v = child;
					} else {
						s_overflow = 1;
					}
				} else if (child != kInvalidNode && NodeType(child) == 4u) {
					// Refit BLASes have box32 nodes only: leave this one to its last boxes.
					s_overflow = 1;
				}
			}
		}
		barrier();
		if (lid == 0) {
			s_level_begin[level + 1] = min(s_tail, s_size);
			s_levels                 = level + 1;
			if (level == 63 && s_tail != tail) {
				s_overflow = 1;
			}
		}
		head = tail;
		barrier();
		if (s_overflow != 0) {
			break;
		}
	}
	barrier();
	if (s_overflow != 0) {
		return;
	}
	// Bottom up. A 64-byte node never crosses a caching page: one translation per node. The new
	// boxes of the four children are stored after all their reads, which can then overlap.
	for (int level = int(s_levels) - 1; level >= 0; level--) {
		const uint begin = s_level_begin[level];
		const uint end   = s_level_begin[level + 1];
		for (uint i = begin + lid; i < end; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			const uint     node     = U32Ref(queue + uint64_t(i) * 4).v;
			const uint64_t host     = HostAddress(blas + (uint64_t(node >> 3) << 6));
			if (host == 0) {
				continue;
			}
			const uvec4 children = U32x4Ref(host).v;
			vec3        lo[4], hi[4];
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				lo[c]            = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7f800000u));
				hi[c]            = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0xff800000u));
				const uint child = children[c];
				// Invalid children and padding (0x1e) keep their box.
				if (child == kInvalidNode || child == 0x1eu || NodeType(child) == 4u ||
				    NodeType(child) == 6u) {
					continue;
				}
				if (NodeType(child) == 5u) {
					const uint64_t child_host = HostAddress(blas + (uint64_t(child >> 3) << 6));
					const uvec4    grand      = child_host == 0 ? uvec4(0) : U32x4Ref(child_host).v;
					vec3           box_lo[4], box_hi[4];
					LoadBoxes(child_host, box_lo, box_hi);
					for (uint g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
						if (grand[g] != kInvalidNode && grand[g] != 0x1eu) {
							lo[c] = min(lo[c], box_lo[g]);
							hi[c] = max(hi[c], box_hi[g]);
						}
					}
				} else {
					LeafBounds(blas, child, lo[c], hi[c]);
				}
				if (!Finite(lo[c]) || !Finite(hi[c])) {
					lo[c] = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7f800000u));
					hi[c] = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0xff800000u));
				}
			}
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				const uint child = children[c];
				if (child == kInvalidNode || child == 0x1eu || NodeType(child) == 4u ||
				    NodeType(child) == 6u) {
					continue;
				}
				// 24 bytes at 8-byte alignment.
				const uint64_t at = host + 16 + c * 24;
				CoherentU32(at).v      = floatBitsToUint(lo[c].x);
				CoherentU32(at + 4).v  = floatBitsToUint(lo[c].y);
				CoherentU32(at + 8).v  = floatBitsToUint(lo[c].z);
				CoherentU32(at + 12).v = floatBitsToUint(hi[c].x);
				CoherentU32(at + 16).v = floatBitsToUint(hi[c].y);
				CoherentU32(at + 20).v = floatBitsToUint(hi[c].z);
			}
		}
		memoryBarrierBuffer();
		barrier();
	}
}

void main() {
	if (gl_WorkGroupID.x >= pc.job_count) {
		return;
	}
	if (pc.mode == MODE_VERTICES) {
		VertexJob(gl_WorkGroupID.x);
	} else {
		BoxJob(gl_WorkGroupID.x);
	}
}
```
