`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/hle_tlas.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
// HLE of the title's top-level BVH builds (the TLAS stage of its BVH compute queue, see
// CommandProcessor::HleTlasDispatch()): builds a TLAS in the game's format (header, box32 nodes,
// 128-byte instance records) from the instance list the game's CPU writes (96-byte records), in
// one workgroup, straight into guest memory through the BDA page table.
//
// Input record (96 B): +0 BLAS address; +8 mask (bits 24-31) and instance flags (bits 0-3);
// +12, +16 user data; +20 4x4 object-to-world matrix (column-major).
// Instance record (128 B): +0 world-to-object 3x4 (row-major), +48/+52 BLAS address >> 3 (42
// bits) with the flags at bits 54-63, +56 BLAS root, +60 mask << 24, +64 object-to-world 3x4,
// +112 index, +116/+120 user data.
// Tree: four children per box32 node, the root at header + 256 (node pointer 0x25), instance
// leaves = instance index << 3, built bottom up over the instances sorted by Morton code.

#include "rt_common.inc"

layout(local_size_x = 512) in;

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
	uint64_t input_va;
	uint64_t header_va;
	// Bounds of the instances (kMaxInstances), then of the nodes (see Bounds).
	uint64_t scratch;
	uint     count;
	uint     stride;
} pc;

const uint kMaxInstances = 4096u;
// Box nodes of a tree over kMaxInstances leaves (1024 + 256 + 64 + 16 + 4 + 1).
const uint kMaxNodes     = 1365u;
const uint kHeaderSize   = 256u;
const uint kNodeSize     = 128u;
const uint kBlasRoot     = 0x25u;

shared uint s_keys[kMaxInstances];
shared uint s_order[kMaxInstances];
shared uint s_scene[6];
shared uint s_level_count[8];
shared uint s_level_first[8];
shared uint s_levels;
shared uint s_nodes;

// The world bounds of an instance or a node, shared by the invocations of the workgroup.
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) coherent buffer Bounds {
	vec4 lo;
	vec4 hi;
};

Bounds InstanceBounds(uint i) {
	return Bounds(pc.scratch + uint64_t(i) * 32);
}

Bounds NodeBounds(uint slot) {
	return Bounds(pc.scratch + uint64_t(kMaxInstances + slot) * 32);
}

// Guest stores through the page table (dropped where the memory is not cached).
void StoreGuestU32x4(uint64_t va, uvec4 value) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(va);
	if (host != 0) {
		U32x4Ref(host).v = value;
	}
}

void StoreGuestU32(uint64_t va, uint value) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(va);
	if (host != 0) {
		U32Ref(host).v = value;
	}
}

// Order-preserving float <-> uint for atomic min/max.
uint FloatKey(float f) {
	const uint u = floatBitsToUint(f);
	return (u & 0x80000000u) != 0 ? ~u : (u | 0x80000000u);
}

float KeyFloat(uint k) {
	return uintBitsToFloat((k & 0x80000000u) != 0 ? (k & 0x7fffffffu) : ~k);
}

uint Spread(uint v) {
	v = (v | (v << 16)) & 0x030000ffu;
	v = (v | (v << 8)) & 0x0300f00fu;
	v = (v | (v << 4)) & 0x030c30c3u;
	v = (v | (v << 2)) & 0x09249249u;
	return v;
}

uint NodePointer(uint slot) {
	return ((4u + 2u * slot) << 3) | 5u;
}

uint64_t NodeVa(uint slot) {
	return pc.header_va + kHeaderSize + uint64_t(slot) * kNodeSize;
}

struct InputRecord {
	uint64_t blas;
	uint     flags_mask;
	uint     user0;
	uint     user1;
	mat3     o2w;
	vec3     o2w_t;
};

InputRecord LoadInput(uint i) {
	const uint64_t record = pc.input_va + uint64_t(i) * pc.stride;
	uint           words[24];
	for (uint q = 0; q < 6; q++) {
		const uvec4 v    = LoadGuestU32x4(record + q * 16);
		words[q * 4]     = v.x;
		words[q * 4 + 1] = v.y;
		words[q * 4 + 2] = v.z;
		words[q * 4 + 3] = v.w;
	}
	InputRecord r;
	r.blas       = uint64_t(words[0]) | (uint64_t(words[1]) << 32);
	r.flags_mask = words[2];
	r.user0      = words[3];
	r.user1      = words[4];
	// Column c of the 4x4 matrix: words[5 + 4c .. 8 + 4c].
	for (uint c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
		r.o2w[c] = uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(words[5 + 4 * c], words[6 + 4 * c], words[7 + 4 * c]));
	}
	r.o2w_t = uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(words[17], words[18], words[19]));
	return r;
}

void main() {
	const uint lid   = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
	const uint count = min(pc.count, kMaxInstances);
	if (lid == 0) {
		s_scene[0] = s_scene[1] = s_scene[2] = 0xffffffffu;
		s_scene[3] = s_scene[4] = s_scene[5] = 0u;
	}
	barrier();

	// Pass 1: world bounds of each instance (the BLAS bounds: the union of its root's children,
	// through the instance's transform) and the instance records, in input order.
	uint nodes_total = 0;
	{
		uint n = max((count + 3u) / 4u, 1u);
		for (;;) {
			nodes_total += n;
			if (n == 1u) {
				break;
			}
			n = (n + 3u) / 4u;
		}
	}
	const uint     instance_offset = kHeaderSize + nodes_total * kNodeSize;
	const uint64_t instances       = pc.header_va + instance_offset;
	for (uint i = lid; i < count; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
		const InputRecord r = LoadInput(i);
		vec3              lo = vec3(1e30), hi = vec3(-1e30);
		uint              blas_flags = 0u;
		if (r.blas != 0) {
			const BoxNode root = LoadBoxNode(r.blas, kBlasRoot);
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				if (root.children[c] != kInvalidNode && all(lessThanEqual(root.lo[c], root.hi[c]))) {
					lo = min(lo, root.lo[c]);
					hi = max(hi, root.hi[c]);
				}
			}
			blas_flags = LoadGuestU32(r.blas + 24);
		}
		vec3 world_lo = vec3(1e30), world_hi = vec3(-1e30);
		if (all(lessThanEqual(lo, hi))) {
			for (uint corner = 0; corner < 8; corner++) {
				const vec3 p = vec3((corner & 1u) != 0 ? hi.x : lo.x, (corner & 2u) != 0 ? hi.y : lo.y,
				                    (corner & 4u) != 0 ? hi.z : lo.z);
				const vec3 q = r.o2w * p + r.o2w_t;
				world_lo     = min(world_lo, q);
				world_hi     = max(world_hi, q);
			}
		}
		// No NaN bounds: an instance without valid bounds is never entered. The game's builder
		// rounds the transformed box differently: a few ulps of margin keep it inside ours.
		if (!all(lessThanEqual(world_lo, world_hi))) {
			world_lo = vec3(1e30);
			world_hi = vec3(-1e30);
		} else {
			world_lo -= abs(world_lo) * (1.0 / 2097152.0) + vec3(1.0 / 1048576.0);
			world_hi += abs(world_hi) * (1.0 / 2097152.0) + vec3(1.0 / 1048576.0);
		}
		InstanceBounds(i).lo = vec4(world_lo, 0.0);
		InstanceBounds(i).hi = vec4(world_hi, 0.0);
		if (all(lessThanEqual(world_lo, world_hi))) {
			const vec3 centre = (world_lo + world_hi) * 0.5;
			atomicMin(s_scene[0], FloatKey(centre.x));
			atomicMin(s_scene[1], FloatKey(centre.y));
			atomicMin(s_scene[2], FloatKey(centre.z));
			atomicMax(s_scene[3], FloatKey(centre.x));
			atomicMax(s_scene[4], FloatKey(centre.y));
			atomicMax(s_scene[5], FloatKey(centre.z));
		}

		// The record. Flags (bits 22-31 of +52): the input's (bits 0, 2, 3), 0x41 when the BLAS
		// holds only opaque geometry (its header +24 bit 13), 0x80 when it holds alpha tested
		// geometry (bit 14), and then 0x2 unless the instance forces opaque (input bit 0).
		const mat3 w2o   = inverse(r.o2w);
		const vec3 w2o_t = -(w2o * r.o2w_t);
		const bool opaque = (blas_flags & (1u << 13)) != 0;
		const bool alpha  = (blas_flags & (1u << 14)) != 0;
		uint       flags  = (r.flags_mask & 0xdu) | (opaque ? 0x41u : 0u) | (alpha ? 0x80u : 0u);
		if (alpha && (r.flags_mask & 1u) == 0) {
			flags |= 0x2u;
		}
		const uint64_t shifted = r.blas >> 3;
		const uint64_t dst     = instances + uint64_t(i) * 128;
		// Row j of a 3x4 matrix M|t: (M[0][j], M[1][j], M[2][j], t[j]) (glsl matrices are columns).
		for (uint j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
			StoreGuestU32x4(dst + j * 16, floatBitsToUint(vec4(w2o[0][j], w2o[1][j], w2o[2][j], w2o_t[j])));
			StoreGuestU32x4(dst + 64 + j * 16,
			                floatBitsToUint(vec4(r.o2w[0][j], r.o2w[1][j], r.o2w[2][j], r.o2w_t[j])));
		}
		StoreGuestU32x4(dst + 48, uvec4(uint(shifted), (uint(shifted >> 32) & 0x3fffffu) | (flags << 22),
		                                kBlasRoot, r.flags_mask & 0xff000000u));
		StoreGuestU32x4(dst + 112, uvec4(i, r.user0, r.user1, 0u));
	}
	memoryBarrierBuffer();
	barrier();

	// Pass 2: Morton keys and a bitonic sort of (key, index) over the padded power of two.
	const vec3 scene_lo = vec3(KeyFloat(s_scene[0]), KeyFloat(s_scene[1]), KeyFloat(s_scene[2]));
	const vec3 scene_hi = vec3(KeyFloat(s_scene[3]), KeyFloat(s_scene[4]), KeyFloat(s_scene[5]));
	const vec3 extent   = max(scene_hi - scene_lo, vec3(1e-6));
	uint       padded   = 1;
	while (padded < count) {
		padded <<= 1;
	}
	for (uint i = lid; i < padded; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
		uint key = 0xffffffffu;
		const vec3 lo = i < count ? InstanceBounds(i).lo.xyz : vec3(1);
		const vec3 hi = i < count ? InstanceBounds(i).hi.xyz : vec3(0);
		if (i < count && all(lessThanEqual(lo, hi))) {
			const vec3  n = clamp(((lo + hi) * 0.5 - scene_lo) / extent, 0.0, 1.0);
			const uvec3 q = uvec3(n * 1023.0);
			key           = (Spread(q.x) << 2) | (Spread(q.y) << 1) | Spread(q.z);
		} else if (i < count) {
			key = 0xfffffffeu; // no bounds: last
		}
		s_keys[i]  = key;
		s_order[i] = i;
	}
	barrier();
	for (uint size = 2; size <= padded; size <<= 1) {
		for (uint stride = size >> 1; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
			for (uint i = lid; i < padded; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
				const uint partner = i ^ stride;
				if (partner > i) {
					const bool ascending = (i & size) == 0;
					const uint a = s_keys[i], b = s_keys[partner];
					if ((a > b) == ascending) {
						s_keys[i]        = b;
						s_keys[partner]  = a;
						const uint t     = s_order[i];
						s_order[i]       = s_order[partner];
						s_order[partner] = t;
					}
				}
			}
			barrier();
		}
	}

	// Pass 3: the tree shape: level 0 nodes hold up to 4 instances, each higher level up to 4
	// nodes, up to one root. Slots run from the root down (the root at slot 0 = pointer 0x25).
	if (lid == 0) {
		uint n      = max((count + 3u) / 4u, 1u);
		uint levels = 0;
		for (;;) {
			s_level_count[levels++] = n;
			if (n == 1u || levels == 8u) {
				break;
			}
			n = (n + 3u) / 4u;
		}
		s_levels   = levels;
		uint first = 0;
		for (int l = int(levels) - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
			s_level_first[l] = first;
			first += s_level_count[l];
		}
		s_nodes = first;
	}
	barrier();

	// Box nodes, one level at a time from the bottom.
	for (uint l = 0; l < s_levels; l++) {
		const uint level_nodes = s_level_count[l];
		const uint first       = s_level_first[l];
		for (uint j = lid; j < level_nodes; j += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			uint children[4];
			vec3 lo[4], hi[4];
			vec3 node_lo = vec3(1e30), node_hi = vec3(-1e30);
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				const uint k = j * 4 + c;
				children[c]  = kInvalidNode;
				lo[c]        = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7f800000u));
				hi[c]        = vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0xff800000u));
				if (l == 0) {
					if (k < count) {
						const uint instance = s_order[k];
						children[c]         = instance << 3;
						lo[c]               = InstanceBounds(instance).lo.xyz;
						hi[c]               = InstanceBounds(instance).hi.xyz;
					}
				} else if (k < s_level_count[l - 1]) {
					const uint child_slot = s_level_first[l - 1] + k;
					children[c]           = NodePointer(child_slot);
					lo[c]                 = NodeBounds(child_slot).lo.xyz;
					hi[c]                 = NodeBounds(child_slot).hi.xyz;
				}
				if (children[c] != kInvalidNode && all(lessThanEqual(lo[c], hi[c]))) {
					node_lo = min(node_lo, lo[c]);
					node_hi = max(node_hi, hi[c]);
				}
			}
			const uint     slot = first + j;
			const uint64_t va   = NodeVa(slot);
			StoreGuestU32x4(va, uvec4(children[0], children[1], children[2], children[3]));
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c += 2) {
				// Two children per 48 bytes: lo.xyz hi.xyz lo.xyz hi.xyz.
				const uint64_t at = va + 16 + c * 24;
				StoreGuestU32x4(at, floatBitsToUint(vec4(lo[c], hi[c].x)));
				StoreGuestU32x4(at + 16, floatBitsToUint(vec4(hi[c].yz, lo[c + 1].xy)));
				StoreGuestU32x4(at + 32, floatBitsToUint(vec4(lo[c + 1].z, hi[c + 1])));
			}
			// The game's builder leaves all ones in the last 16 bytes.
			StoreGuestU32x4(va + 112, uvec4(0xffffffffu));
			NodeBounds(slot).lo = vec4(node_lo, 0.0);
			NodeBounds(slot).hi = vec4(node_hi, 0.0);
		}
		memoryBarrierBuffer();
		barrier();
	}

	// Header (also written by the host, see HleTlasHeader()).
	if (lid == 0) {
		const uint size = instance_offset + count * 128u;
		StoreGuestU32x4(pc.header_va, uvec4(0x5f525350u, 0x4c485642u, 0x5d1cba8cu, 0u));
		StoreGuestU32x4(pc.header_va + 16, uvec4(size, 0u, 0x00020024u, 0u));
		StoreGuestU32x4(pc.header_va + 48, uvec4(instance_offset, 0u, 0u, 0u));
		StoreGuestU32(pc.header_va + 88, count + 4u);
		StoreGuestU32(pc.header_va + 112, count);
	}
}

```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/indirect_thread_dispatch.comp`:

```comp
#version 450

// Converts DISPATCH_INDIRECT arguments given in threads (DISPATCH_INITIATOR
// USE_THREAD_DIMENSIONS) into workgroup counts for vkCmdDispatchIndirect, and publishes
// the thread counts as the shader's dispatch thread limit.

layout(local_size_x = 1, local_size_y = 1, local_size_z = 1) in;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer args_buf {
    uint args[];
};

layout(std430, binding = 1) writeonly buffer groups_buf {
    uint groups[];
};

layout(std430, binding = 2) writeonly buffer limit_buf {
    uint limit[];
};

layout(push_constant) uniform push_data {
    uvec3 local_size;
    uint  args_index;
    uint  groups_index;
    uint  limit_index;
};

void main() {
    for (uint axis = 0u; axis < 3u; axis++) {
        const uint threads = args[args_index + axis];
        const uint size    = max(local_size[axis], 1u);
        groups[groups_index + axis] = threads / size + ((threads % size) != 0u ? 1u : 0u);
        limit[limit_index + axis]   = threads;
    }
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/occlusion_counters.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
// The guest's occlusion counters on the GPU timeline (see OcclusionQueries::WriteForReaders()):
// the running sample total after each dump of the command buffer, from the host query results the
// command buffer copied, written as the dumps write them into the copies of guest memory that the
// next operation reads.

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

// A dump: the host query slots of the segment it ends, and whether some of its samples had none.
struct Dump {
	uint first_slot;
	uint slot_count;
	uint uncounted;
	uint pad;
};

// One dump's counters in a copy of guest memory: its DBs [db_first, db_end) at address + db * 16.
// The total is the one of dump `dump`, or `known` (a dump published already) when dump is ~0.
struct Write {
	uint64_t address;
	uint64_t known;
	uint     dump;
	uint     db_first;
	uint     db_end;
	uint     pad;
};

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) readonly buffer Dumps {
	Dump v[];
};
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) readonly buffer Writes {
	Write v[];
};
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) readonly buffer Results {
	uint64_t v[];
};
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer Totals {
	uint64_t v[];
};
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) buffer Dword {
	uint v;
};

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
	uint64_t dumps;
	uint64_t writes;
	uint64_t results;
	uint64_t totals;
	uint64_t base;
	uint     dump_count;
	uint     write_count;
	uint     capacity;
	uint     pad;
} pc;

const uint64_t ReadyBit         = 1ul << 63;
const uint64_t ValueMask        = ReadyBit - 1ul;
const uint64_t UncountedSamples = 1ul << 24;

shared uint64_t partial[256];

uint64_t Samples(uint index) {
	const Dump dump    = Dumps(pc.dumps).v[index];
	uint64_t   samples = dump.uncounted != 0u ? UncountedSamples : 0ul;
	for (uint i = 0u; i < dump.slot_count; i++) {
		samples += Results(pc.results).v[(dump.first_slot + i) % pc.capacity];
	}
	return samples;
}

void Store(uint64_t address, uint64_t value) {
	// Two dwords: a copy of guest memory needs no more than dword alignment.
	Dword(address).v      = uint(value);
	Dword(address + 4ul).v = uint(value >> 32);
}

void main() {
	const uint thread = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
	const uint per    = (pc.dump_count + 255u) / 256u;
	const uint first  = min(thread * per, pc.dump_count);
	const uint end    = min(first + per, pc.dump_count);
	uint64_t   sum    = 0ul;
	for (uint i = first; i < end; i++) {
		sum += Samples(i);
	}
	partial[thread] = sum;
	barrier();
	if (thread == 0u) {
		uint64_t running = pc.base;
		for (uint i = 0u; i < 256u; i++) {
			const uint64_t part = partial[i];
			partial[i]          = running;
			running += part;
		}
	}
	barrier();
	uint64_t running = partial[thread];
	for (uint i = first; i < end; i++) {
		running += Samples(i);
		Totals(pc.totals).v[i] = running;
	}
	memoryBarrierBuffer();
	barrier();
	for (uint i = thread; i < pc.write_count; i += 256u) {
		const Write    write = Writes(pc.writes).v[i];
		const uint64_t total = write.dump == ~0u ? write.known : Totals(pc.totals).v[write.dump];
		for (uint db = write.db_first; db < write.db_end; db++) {
			Store(write.address + uint64_t(db) * 16ul, db == 0u ? (ReadyBit | (total & ValueMask)) : ReadyBit);
		}
	}
}
```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/rt_blas_walk.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
// Native ray tracing: walks one guest bottom-level AMD BVH per workgroup (the title layout: box nodes
// whose leaves are lists of 8-byte entries in the BLAS buffer: an AMD triangle node pointer and a
// primitive word, bit 31 = last entry, bit 30 = opaque).
// MODE_COUNT: counts box nodes, leaves and triangles (opaque, alpha tested) of the BLASes the
//             top-level walk found missing.
// MODE_BUILD: writes the triangles (opaque ones as geometry 0, alpha tested ones as geometry 1)
//             with their entry table, and pads both geometries with inactive (NaN) triangles.
// MODE_VERIFY: recomputes the signature of the boxes of built slots and lists those that changed.
//
// A build with a layout (a BLAS whose build the host saw, see NativeRayTracing::NoteGuestBlasBuilds())
// places each triangle by its primitive: the geometry of its triangle node (the header's table of
// the geometry of each triangle node: +40 offset, +108 geometry count, +124 first triangle node)
// and the triangle index of its primitive word (bits 0-29), at the geometry's first host
// primitive plus that index, in the host geometry of the guest geometry's opacity. Positions no
// list entry names keep the inactive triangle the host filled them with, and a triangle named by
// several leaves (split) is written once per leaf with the same values. An entry that does not
// match the layout (no geometry, an index past the geometry's triangles, an opacity other than the
// geometry's) is counted and fails the build. So does memory that no longer holds the BLAS the
// layout describes (a header without the magic and version 9, or with another geometry count:
// released and reused, or rebuilt since), without placing anything. The host gives up such slots.

#include "rt_common.inc"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

// A build job (written by the host).
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer Job {
	uint64_t blas_va;
	uint     root;
	uint     slot;
	uint64_t vertices0;
	uint64_t vertices1;
	uint64_t entries;
	uint     capacity0;
	uint     capacity1;
	uint     result;
	uint     pad;
	// The layout of the build (0: none) and its geometries, then (written back) the entries that
	// did not match it.
	uint64_t layout_va;
	uint     layout_count;
	uint     mismatches;
	// Written back by a build: the leaves of the guest BLAS (the host sizes its next walk's queue).
	uint     leaves;
	uint     pad2;
};

// The layout of one guest geometry (written by the host): its first host primitive, its triangle
// count and whether it is opaque.
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) buffer LayoutRef {
	uvec4 v;
};

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) buffer TriangleRef {
	float v[9];
};

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) buffer EntryRef {
	uvec4 v;
};

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
	uint64_t jobs;
	uint64_t pool;
	uint64_t slots;
	uint64_t state;
	uint64_t changed;
	uint     mode;
	uint     pool_capacity;
	uint     job_count;
	uint     changed_capacity;
	// The preparation (see SlotInfo::rebase).
	uint     prepare_id;
	uint     pad;
} pc;

const uint MODE_COUNT  = 0u;
const uint MODE_BUILD  = 1u;
const uint MODE_VERIFY = 2u;
// MODE_GATHER: rewrites the triangles of built slots whose guest BLAS was only refit since,
//              through their entry tables (same triangles, same order).
const uint MODE_GATHER = 3u;

// The queue of a walk of a BLAS of known leaves: its box nodes (a 4 wide tree has about a third
// of the leaves, a chain of boxes as many as there are leaves) and some room for growth; a walk
// that needs more reports an overflow and the host builds the BLAS again with the node limit of
// its header (0 leaves: not known, the node limit is used at once).
uint QueueNodes(uint leaf_count) {
	return leaf_count == 0 ? 0u : leaf_count + leaf_count / 2 + 64;
}

const uint kJobStride = 80;
const uint kMaxQueue  = 1u << 20;

shared uint s_head;
shared uint s_tail;
shared uint s_next_tail;
shared uint s_leaves;
shared uint s_opaque;
shared uint s_alpha;
shared uint s_signature;
shared uint s_overflow;
shared uint s_queue_base;
shared uint s_queue_size;
shared uint s_capacity0;
shared uint s_capacity1;
// Layout builds: the guest geometries (the header's), the table of the geometry of each triangle
// node and the first triangle node, and the entries that did not match.
shared uint     s_layout_geometries;
shared uint64_t s_node_geometries;
shared uint     s_node_first;
shared uint     s_mismatches;
// A layout build of memory that does not hold a BVH (not written yet, or released and reused).
shared uint     s_layout_invalid;
// The box of the whole BLAS (lo > hi: unknown).
shared vec3 s_root_lo;
shared vec3 s_root_hi;

// The host position of a list entry of a layout build (see the top), or kInvalidNode when it
// does not match the layout.
uint LayoutPosition(Job job, uint tri, uint word, bool opaque) {
	if (NodeType(tri) > 3u || (tri >> 3) < s_node_first) {
		return kInvalidNode;
	}
	// The geometry of the triangle node (the game's own leaf code looks it up the same way).
	const uint lo = LoadGuestU32(s_node_geometries + uint64_t((tri >> 3) - s_node_first) * 4);
	if (lo >= s_layout_geometries) {
		return kInvalidNode;
	}
	const uvec4 geometry = LayoutRef(job.layout_va + uint64_t(lo) * 16).v;
	const uint  triangle = word & 0x3fffffffu;
	if (triangle >= geometry.y || (geometry.z != 0u) != opaque) {
		return kInvalidNode;
	}
	return geometry.x + triangle;
}

// Counts (and in MODE_BUILD writes) the triangles of a guest leaf list.
// `lo`/`hi`: the box of the leaf in its parent node (lo > hi: unknown, for a root leaf).
void EmitLeaf(uint64_t blas_va, uint64_t base, uint leaf, Job job, vec3 lo, vec3 hi) {
	atomicAdd(s_leaves, 1u);
	const uint first = leaf >> 3;
	for (uint k = 0; k < kMaxLeafEntries; k++) {
		const uvec2    pair   = LoadGuestU32x2(blas_va + (uint64_t(first + k) << 3));
		const uint     tri    = pair.x;
		const uint     word   = pair.y;
		const bool     opaque = ((word >> 30) & 1u) != 0;
		uint           index  = opaque ? atomicAdd(s_opaque, 1u) : atomicAdd(s_alpha, 1u);
		if (pc.mode == MODE_BUILD && job.layout_va != 0) {
			// Nothing to place from memory that holds another BLAS: the positions stay inactive.
			if (s_layout_invalid != 0) {
				return;
			}
			index = LayoutPosition(job, tri, word, opaque);
			if (index == kInvalidNode) {
				atomicAdd(s_mismatches, 1u);
			}
		}
		if (pc.mode == MODE_BUILD) {
			const uint capacity = opaque ? s_capacity0 : s_capacity1;
			if (index < capacity) {
				const uint64_t node = NodeAddress(base, tri);
				TriangleRef out_triangle =
				    TriangleRef((opaque ? job.vertices0 : job.vertices1) + uint64_t(index) * 36);
				// A vertex the hardware cannot take (non-finite or absurdly far, as in a node the
				// guest is rewriting) makes the triangle inactive (NaN) instead of undefined.
				vec3 p[3];
				LoadTriangle(node, NodeType(tri), p);
				bool usable = true;
				for (uint v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
					usable = usable && !any(isnan(p[v])) && all(lessThan(abs(p[v]), vec3(1e18)));
				}
				// A triangle outside its box is from a node the guest was writing. Of a BLAS the game
				// refits (job.pad 1: vehicles, peds) the box is the leaf's, which keeps the triangles
				// of half written nodes out; of the others (buildings) it is the box of the whole
				// BLAS, because the boxes of the leaves of those leave out triangles of their lists
				// (dropping them left the sun lighting the inside of a garage).
				// [HACK] The leaf's box drops triangles the game's boxes do not hold too: counted
				// (RtState.leaf_box_dropped), the host reports them.
				const bool leaf_box = job.pad != 0;
				const vec3 box_lo   = leaf_box ? lo : s_root_lo;
				const vec3 box_hi   = leaf_box ? hi : s_root_hi;
				if (all(lessThanEqual(box_lo, box_hi))) {
					const vec3 margin = (box_hi - box_lo) * 1e-3 + vec3(1e-3);
					const bool sane   = usable;
					for (uint v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
						usable = usable && all(greaterThanEqual(p[v], box_lo - margin)) &&
						         all(lessThanEqual(p[v], box_hi + margin));
					}
					if (leaf_box && sane && !usable) {
						atomicAdd(RtState(pc.state).leaf_box_dropped, 1u);
					}
				}
				for (uint v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
					const vec3 q = usable ? p[v] : vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7fc00000u));
					out_triangle.v[v * 3]     = q.x;
					out_triangle.v[v * 3 + 1] = q.y;
					out_triangle.v[v * 3 + 2] = q.z;
				}
				const uint table_index = opaque ? index : s_capacity0 + index;
				// The barycentric remap of the triangle (node word 15, 8 bits per triangle type).
				const uint remap = (LoadGuestU32(node + 60) >> (NodeType(tri) * 8u)) & 0xffu;
				EntryRef(job.entries + uint64_t(table_index) * 16).v =
				    uvec4((first + k) << 3, word, tri, remap);
			}
		}
		if ((word & 0x80000000u) != 0) {
			break;
		}
	}
}

// MODE_GATHER: triangle `index` of geometry `geometry` (0 opaque, 1 alpha tested) of a job.
void GatherTriangle(Job job, uint64_t base, uint index, uint geometry) {
	const uint     table_index  = geometry == 0u ? index : job.capacity0 + index;
	const uvec4    entry        = EntryRef(job.entries + uint64_t(table_index) * 16).v;
	const uint     tri          = entry.z;
	const uint64_t node         = NodeAddress(base, tri);
	TriangleRef    out_triangle = TriangleRef((geometry == 0u ? job.vertices0 : job.vertices1) + uint64_t(index) * 36);
	vec3 p[3];
	// A position of a layout build that no list entry named stays inactive.
	bool usable = entry.x != kInvalidNode;
	if (usable) {
		LoadTriangle(node, NodeType(tri), p);
	} else {
		p[0] = p[1] = p[2] = vec3(0.0);
	}
	for (uint v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
		usable = usable && !any(isnan(p[v])) && all(lessThan(abs(p[v]), vec3(1e18)));
	}
	for (uint v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
		const vec3 q = usable ? p[v] : vec3(uintBitsToFloat(0x7fc00000u));
		out_triangle.v[v * 3]     = q.x;
		out_triangle.v[v * 3 + 1] = q.y;
		out_triangle.v[v * 3 + 2] = q.z;
	}
}

void main() {
	const uint job_index  = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
	const uint lid        = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
	if (pc.mode == MODE_GATHER) {
		if (job_index >= pc.job_count) {
			return;
		}
		Job            job    = Job(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * kJobStride);
		SlotInfo       info   = SlotInfo(pc.slots + uint64_t(job.slot) * kSlotStride);
		const uint64_t base   = (job.blas_va >> 8) << 8;
		const uint     count0 = min(info.count0, job.capacity0);
		const uint     count1 = min(info.count1, job.capacity1);
		// The workgroups of a job (y) take its triangles in turns.
		const uint     stride = gl_WorkGroupSize.x * gl_NumWorkGroups.y;
		for (uint i = gl_WorkGroupID.y * gl_WorkGroupSize.x + lid; i < count0 + count1; i += stride) {
			if (i < count0) {
				GatherTriangle(job, base, i, 0u);
			} else {
				GatherTriangle(job, base, i - count0, 1u);
			}
		}
		if (lid == 0 && gl_WorkGroupID.y == 0) {
			info.rebase = 0x80000000u | (pc.prepare_id & 0x7fffffffu);
		}
		return;
	}
	RtState    state      = RtState(pc.state);
	uint64_t   blas_va    = 0;
	uint       root       = kInvalidNode;
	uint       slot       = 0;
	uint       queue_size = 0;
	Job        job        = Job(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * kJobStride);
	if (pc.mode == MODE_COUNT) {
		MissingEntry missing = MissingEntry(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * kMissingStride);
		blas_va = missing.blas_va;
		root    = missing.root;
	} else if (pc.mode == MODE_BUILD) {
		if (job_index >= pc.job_count) {
			return;
		}
		blas_va       = job.blas_va;
		root          = job.root;
		slot          = job.slot;
		SlotInfo info = SlotInfo(pc.slots + uint64_t(slot) * kSlotStride);
		queue_size    = QueueNodes(info.leaf_count);
	} else {
		slot          = U32Ref(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * 4).v;
		SlotInfo info = SlotInfo(pc.slots + uint64_t(slot) * kSlotStride);
		blas_va       = info.blas_va;
		root          = info.root;
		queue_size    = QueueNodes(info.leaf_count);
	}
	const uint64_t base = (blas_va >> 8) << 8;
	if (lid == 0) {
		s_head      = 0;
		s_tail      = 0;
		s_leaves    = 0;
		s_opaque    = 0;
		s_alpha     = 0;
		s_signature = 0;
		s_overflow  = 0;
		s_capacity0 = pc.mode == MODE_BUILD ? job.capacity0 : 0;
		s_capacity1 = pc.mode == MODE_BUILD ? job.capacity1 : 0;
		s_root_lo   = vec3(1e30);
		s_root_hi   = vec3(-1e30);
		s_mismatches        = 0;
		s_layout_geometries = 0;
		s_layout_invalid    = 0;
		s_node_first        = 0;
		s_node_geometries   = 0;
		if (pc.mode == MODE_BUILD && job.layout_va != 0) {
			// The header's geometries must be the layout's.
			const uint geometries = LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 108);
			s_layout_geometries   = geometries == job.layout_count ? geometries : 0u;
			s_node_geometries     = blas_va + LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 40);
			s_node_first          = LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 124);
			// "PSR_BVHL", version 9, and the geometries of the build the layout describes: the
			// guest may have built another BLAS there since (the build waits for a preparation).
			s_layout_invalid = LoadGuestU32(blas_va) != 0x5f525350u || LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 4) != 0x4c485642u ||
			                           LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 252) != 9u || geometries != job.layout_count
			                       ? 1u
			                       : 0u;
		}
		if (IsBoxNode(root)) {
			const BoxNode root_box = LoadBoxNode(base, root);
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				if (root_box.children[c] != kInvalidNode &&
				    all(lessThanEqual(root_box.lo[c], root_box.hi[c]))) {
					s_root_lo = min(s_root_lo, root_box.lo[c]);
					s_root_hi = max(s_root_hi, root_box.hi[c]);
				}
			}
		}
		// Box nodes never outnumber the node limit of the BVH descriptor, nor (with at least one
		// leaf or box child each) twice the leaves of a known BLAS.
		const uint limit = LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 88) + 1;
		s_queue_size = min(queue_size > 16 ? min(queue_size, limit) : limit, kMaxQueue);
		if (pc.mode == MODE_COUNT) {
			// The node limit of a BLAS can be huge: the BLASes counted together share a quarter
			// of the pool (the rest is for the builds and checks of this preparation), so that
			// one of them cannot take it all. One that does not fit its share reports an overflow
			// and is counted again later, with fewer of them missing.
			s_queue_size = min(s_queue_size, max(pc.pool_capacity / 4u / gl_NumWorkGroups.x, 64u));
		}
		s_queue_base = atomicAdd(state.pool_cursor, s_queue_size);
		if (s_queue_base + s_queue_size > pc.pool_capacity || s_queue_base + s_queue_size < s_queue_base) {
			s_queue_size = 0;
			s_overflow   = 4u;
			atomicAdd(state.pool_overflow, 1u);
		} else if (IsBoxNode(root)) {
			U32Ref(pc.pool + uint64_t(s_queue_base) * 4).v = root;
			s_tail = 1;
		}
	}
	barrier();
	if (lid == 0 && s_overflow == 0 && !IsBoxNode(root) && NodeType(root) < 4u &&
	    root != kInvalidNode) {
		if (pc.mode == MODE_VERIFY) {
			s_leaves = 1;
		} else {
			EmitLeaf(blas_va, base, root, job, vec3(1), vec3(0));
		}
	}
	const uint64_t queue          = pc.pool + uint64_t(s_queue_base) * 4;
	const uint     queue_capacity = s_queue_size;
	uint           depth          = 0;
	while (true) {
		const uint head = s_head;
		const uint tail = s_tail;
		if (head == tail || depth > 64) {
			break;
		}
		if (lid == 0) {
			s_next_tail = tail;
		}
		barrier();
		for (uint i = head + lid; i < tail; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			const uint    node = U32Ref(queue + uint64_t(i) * 4).v;
			const BoxNode box  = LoadBoxNode(base, node);
			uint          hash = Mix(0x1234567u, node);
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				const uint child = box.children[c];
				hash             = Mix(hash, child);
				if (child == kInvalidNode) {
					continue;
				}
				hash            = Mix(hash, floatBitsToUint(box.lo[c].x));
				hash            = Mix(hash, floatBitsToUint(box.lo[c].y));
				hash            = Mix(hash, floatBitsToUint(box.lo[c].z));
				hash            = Mix(hash, floatBitsToUint(box.hi[c].x));
				hash            = Mix(hash, floatBitsToUint(box.hi[c].y));
				hash            = Mix(hash, floatBitsToUint(box.hi[c].z));
				const uint type = NodeType(child);
				if (type == 4u || type == 5u) {
					const uint next = atomicAdd(s_next_tail, 1u);
					if (next < queue_capacity) {
						U32Ref(queue + uint64_t(next) * 4).v = child;
					} else {
						atomicOr(s_overflow, 1u);
					}
				} else if (type < 4u) {
					if (pc.mode == MODE_VERIFY) {
						atomicAdd(s_leaves, 1u);
					} else {
						EmitLeaf(blas_va, base, child, job, box.lo[c], box.hi[c]);
					}
				}
			}
			atomicAdd(s_signature, hash);
		}
		barrier();
		if (lid == 0) {
			s_head = tail;
			s_tail = min(s_next_tail, queue_capacity);
		}
		depth++;
		barrier();
	}
	if (depth > 64 && lid == 0) {
		s_overflow |= 2u;
	}
	barrier();
	const uint leaf_count = s_leaves;
	const uint opaque     = s_opaque;
	const uint alpha      = s_alpha;
	if (pc.mode == MODE_COUNT) {
		if (lid == 0) {
			MissingEntry missing = MissingEntry(pc.jobs + uint64_t(job_index) * kMissingStride);
			missing.leaf_count   = leaf_count;
			missing.box_count    = s_tail;
			missing.opaque_count = opaque;
			missing.alpha_count  = alpha;
			missing.node_limit   = LoadGuestU32(blas_va + 88);
			missing.flags        = s_overflow;
		}
		return;
	}
	SlotInfo info = SlotInfo(pc.slots + uint64_t(slot) * kSlotStride);
	if (pc.mode == MODE_BUILD && job.layout_va != 0) {
		// Every position is used (the host filled them with inactive triangles before the walk).
		if (lid == 0) {
			info.leaf_count = leaf_count;
			info.count0     = s_capacity0;
			info.count1     = s_capacity1;
			info.signature  = s_signature;
			info.rebase     = 0;
			job.mismatches  = s_mismatches;
			job.leaves      = leaf_count;
			job.result      = (s_overflow << 1) | (s_mismatches != 0 ? 16u : 0u) | (s_layout_invalid << 5);
		}
		return;
	}
	if (pc.mode == MODE_BUILD) {
		// Inactive triangles (a NaN vertex) fill the rest of both geometries.
		const float nan = uintBitsToFloat(0x7fc00000u);
		for (uint i = opaque + lid; i < s_capacity0; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			TriangleRef(job.vertices0 + uint64_t(i) * 36).v[0] = nan;
		}
		for (uint i = alpha + lid; i < s_capacity1; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			TriangleRef(job.vertices1 + uint64_t(i) * 36).v[0] = nan;
		}
		if (lid == 0) {
			info.leaf_count = leaf_count;
			info.count0     = opaque;
			info.count1     = alpha;
			info.signature  = s_signature;
			info.rebase     = 0;
			job.leaves      = leaf_count;
			const bool grow = opaque > s_capacity0 || alpha > s_capacity1;
			job.result      = (grow ? 1u : 0u) | (s_overflow << 1);
			// The host reads back the counts: to make room for them, or to give a slot with far
			// more room its exact size.
			job.capacity0 = opaque;
			job.capacity1 = alpha;
		}
		return;
	}
	// A walk without room in its queue found more boxes than the BLAS had: it changed.
	if (lid == 0 && s_overflow == 0 && info.rebase == (0x80000000u | (pc.prepare_id & 0x7fffffffu))) {
		// Gathered in this preparation: the guest's refit moved the boxes and the host followed.
		info.signature  = s_signature;
		info.leaf_count = leaf_count;
		info.rebase     = 0;
		return;
	}
	if (lid == 0 && (s_overflow & 4u) == 0 && (s_overflow == 0 || (s_overflow & 1u) != 0)) {
		if ((s_overflow & 1u) != 0 || info.signature != s_signature || info.leaf_count != leaf_count) {
			const uint index = atomicAdd(state.changed_count, 1u);
			if (index < pc.changed_capacity) {
				U32Ref(pc.changed + uint64_t(index) * 4).v = slot;
			}
			// Built again by the host; until then only reported once (a walk that overflowed saw
			// only part of the BLAS: it is reported until the build counts it).
			if (s_overflow == 0) {
				info.signature  = s_signature;
				info.leaf_count = leaf_count;
				info.rebase     = 0;
			}
		}
	}
}

```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/rt_common.inc`:

```inc
// Native ray tracing (see nativeRayTracing.h): shared definitions of the passes that read the
// guest's AMD BVHs through the BDA page table and write the host acceleration structures.

#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference2 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_atomic_int64 : require

#ifndef CACHING_PAGEBITS
#error CACHING_PAGEBITS must be defined
#endif

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) buffer U32Ref { uint v; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) buffer U32x4Ref { uvec4 v; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer U64Ref { uint64_t v; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer U32x2Ref { uvec2 v; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) buffer F32Ref { float v; };

// The BufferCache device-address page table: the host address of each caching page (0 when the
// page has no cached buffer).
layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer PageTable {
	uint64_t pages[];
};

const uint64_t kExtendedMemoryBase = 0x080000000000ul;
const uint64_t kLowerAddressSize   = 1ul << 40;
const uint     kPageMask           = (1u << CACHING_PAGEBITS) - 1u;
const uint     kInvalidNode        = 0xffffffffu;

// The host address of guest address `va`, 0 when it has no cached buffer.
uint64_t HostAddress(uint64_t va) {
	const uint64_t packed = va >= kExtendedMemoryBase ? va - kExtendedMemoryBase + kLowerAddressSize : va;
	const uint64_t page   = packed >> CACHING_PAGEBITS;
	if (page >= uint64_t(pages.length())) {
		return 0;
	}
	const uint64_t base = pages[uint(page)];
	return base == 0 ? 0 : base + (va & uint64_t(kPageMask));
}

// Guest loads (zero where the memory is not cached). Aligned 16-byte loads never cross a caching
// page.
uint LoadGuestU32(uint64_t va) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(va);
	return host == 0 ? 0u : U32Ref(host).v;
}

uvec4 LoadGuestU32x4(uint64_t va) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(va);
	return host == 0 ? uvec4(0) : U32x4Ref(host).v;
}

uvec2 LoadGuestU32x2(uint64_t va) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(va);
	return host == 0 ? uvec2(0) : U32x2Ref(host).v;
}

uint64_t LoadGuestU64(uint64_t va) {
	return uint64_t(LoadGuestU32(va)) | (uint64_t(LoadGuestU32(va + 4)) << 32);
}

// An AMD BVH node pointer: the node type in the low 3 bits, the 64-byte node index above.
uint NodeType(uint node) {
	return node & 7u;
}

uint64_t NodeAddress(uint64_t base, uint node) {
	return base + (uint64_t(node >> 3) << 6);
}

bool IsBoxNode(uint node) {
	return node != kInvalidNode && (NodeType(node) == 4u || NodeType(node) == 5u);
}

// A box node: four child pointers and their bounds (box16: fp16 pairs, box32: floats).
struct BoxNode {
	uint children[4];
	vec3 lo[4];
	vec3 hi[4];
};

// A 64-byte node never crosses a caching page: one translation (zeros where it is not cached).
uvec4 LoadNodeU32x4(uint64_t host, uint offset) {
	return host == 0 ? uvec4(0) : U32x4Ref(host + offset).v;
}

BoxNode LoadBoxNode(uint64_t base, uint node) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(NodeAddress(base, node));
	BoxNode        box;
	const uvec4    first = LoadNodeU32x4(host, 0);
	box.children[0] = first.x;
	box.children[1] = first.y;
	box.children[2] = first.z;
	box.children[3] = first.w;
	if (NodeType(node) == 4u) {
		const uvec4 a = LoadNodeU32x4(host, 16);
		const uvec4 b = LoadNodeU32x4(host, 32);
		const uvec4 c = LoadNodeU32x4(host, 48);
		const uint words[12] = uint[12](a.x, a.y, a.z, a.w, b.x, b.y, b.z, b.w, c.x, c.y, c.z, c.w);
		for (uint child = 0; child < 4; child++) {
			const vec2 xy = unpackHalf2x16(words[child * 3]);
			const vec2 zx = unpackHalf2x16(words[child * 3 + 1]);
			const vec2 yz = unpackHalf2x16(words[child * 3 + 2]);
			box.lo[child] = vec3(xy.x, xy.y, zx.x);
			box.hi[child] = vec3(zx.y, yz.x, yz.y);
		}
	} else {
		uint words[24];
		for (uint i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
			const uvec4 v = LoadNodeU32x4(host, 16 + i * 16);
			words[i * 4]     = v.x;
			words[i * 4 + 1] = v.y;
			words[i * 4 + 2] = v.z;
			words[i * 4 + 3] = v.w;
		}
		for (uint child = 0; child < 4; child++) {
			box.lo[child] = uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(words[child * 6], words[child * 6 + 1], words[child * 6 + 2]));
			box.hi[child] = uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(words[child * 6 + 3], words[child * 6 + 4], words[child * 6 + 5]));
		}
	}
	return box;
}

// The state of one preparation (NativeRayTracing::Prepare), cleared before the walks.
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer RtState {
	uint64_t header_va;
	uint64_t instance_base;
	uint     node_limit;
	uint     instance_count;
	uint     box_count;
	uint     overflow;
	uint     missing_count;
	uint     dispatch_x;
	uint     dispatch_y;
	uint     dispatch_z;
	uint     unknown_blas;
	uint     inactive;
	uint     max_depth;
	uint     verify_count;
	uint     verify_x;
	uint     verify_y;
	uint     verify_z;
	uint     changed_count;
	uint     pool_cursor;
	uint     pool_overflow;
	// Triangles of BLASes the game refits that the walk dropped for lying outside their leaf's
	// box (rt_blas_walk.comp).
	uint     leaf_box_dropped;
	uint     pad;
};

// A host BLAS: the guest BLAS it mirrors and its acceleration structure of triangles, in two
// geometries: 0 = opaque, 1 = alpha tested. Per primitive (geometry 1 after the capacity of
// geometry 0), the entry table holds (16 bytes) the guest leaf pointer of its list entry, its primitive
// word, its triangle node and the barycentric remap of the node (see rt_blas_walk.comp).
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer SlotInfo {
	uint64_t as_address;
	uint64_t entry_table;
	uint     capacity0;
	uint     capacity1;
	uint     count0;
	uint     count1;
	uint     signature;
	uint     state;
	uint64_t blas_va;
	uint     root;
	uint     stamp;
	uint     leaf_count;
	// Set by a gathered build (see MODE_GATHER in rt_blas_walk.comp) to bit 31 and the preparation:
	// the triangles follow the guest's refit boxes, so the check of that same preparation takes their
	// signature instead of reporting a change. A later check (the guest may have changed the BLAS
	// since) compares as usual.
	uint     rebase;
};

// A guest BLAS the top-level walk did not find, counted by the BLAS walk.
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer MissingEntry {
	uint64_t blas_va;
	uint     root;
	uint     table_index;
	uint     leaf_count;
	uint     box_count;
	uint     opaque_count;
	uint     alpha_count;
	uint     node_limit;
	uint     flags;
	uint     pad0;
	uint     pad1;
};

const uint kSlotStride    = 64;
const uint kMissingStride = 48;
const uint kSlotBuilt     = 1u;
// Entries of one guest leaf list at most.
const uint kMaxLeafEntries = 64;

// The vertices of triangle `type` (0-3) of an AMD triangle node with five vertices: (0,1,2),
// (1,3,2), (2,3,4), (2,4,0).
uvec3 TriangleVertexIds(uint type) {
	return uvec3(min(type, 2u), type == 0u ? 1u : (type == 3u ? 4u : 3u),
	             type == 2u ? 4u : (type == 3u ? 0u : 2u));
}

vec3 LoadVertex(uint64_t node, uint id) {
	return uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(LoadGuestU32(node + id * 12), LoadGuestU32(node + id * 12 + 4),
	                             LoadGuestU32(node + id * 12 + 8)));
}

// The three vertices of triangle `type` of a triangle node, read once with one translation (a
// 64-byte node of a BVH, whose base is 256-byte aligned, never crosses a caching page); zeros
// where the node is not cached, as LoadVertex().
void LoadTriangle(uint64_t node, uint type, out vec3 p[3]) {
	const uint64_t host = HostAddress(node);
	const uvec3    ids  = TriangleVertexIds(type);
	for (uint v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
		const uint64_t at = host + uint64_t(ids[v] * 12);
		p[v] = host == 0 ? vec3(0.0) : uintBitsToFloat(uvec3(U32Ref(at).v, U32Ref(at + 4).v, U32Ref(at + 8).v));
	}
}

// A guest TLAS instance record (128 bytes), laid out as the traversal shader that traces through
// the TLAS reads it (Decoder::RayTracingLayout::Pack(), derived from its code): the rows of the
// world to object 3x4 transform, the BLAS address and root node, the instance mask (0xff when the
// shader traces every instance) and flags (bit 0 opaque, bit 1 alpha tested anyway, bit 2 both
// facings, bit 3 the culled facing; 0 when the shader never reads them).
struct GuestInstance {
	vec4     rows[3];
	uint64_t blas;
	uint     root;
	uint     mask;
	uint     flags;
};

// The header field holding the offset of the instance records from the header.
uint LayoutInstanceOffset(uvec4 instance_layout) {
	return ((instance_layout.y >> 16) & 15u) * 8u;
}

// Whether instance leaf `node` is of the layout's inline type: its record is at header +
// LayoutInlineOffset() and its BLAS root LayoutInlineRoot().
bool LayoutInline(uvec4 instance_layout, uint node) {
	return ((instance_layout.w >> 19) & 1u) != 0 && NodeType(node) == ((instance_layout.w >> 16) & 7u);
}

uint LayoutInlineOffset(uvec4 instance_layout) {
	return (instance_layout.w & 0xffu) * 8u;
}

uint LayoutInlineRoot(uvec4 instance_layout) {
	return (instance_layout.w >> 8) & 0xffu;
}

// The record of instance leaf `node`.
uint64_t InstanceRecord(uint64_t header, uint64_t instance_base, uint node, uvec4 instance_layout) {
	return LayoutInline(instance_layout, node) ? header + LayoutInlineOffset(instance_layout)
	                                           : instance_base + (uint64_t(node >> 3) << 7);
}

// Whether, with flags bit 3 clear, the guest accepts the triangles the host sees from the back.
bool LayoutFlipFacing(uvec4 instance_layout) {
	return ((instance_layout.y >> 29) & 1u) != 0;
}

GuestInstance LoadGuestInstance(uint64_t record, uvec4 instance_layout) {
	const uvec4 q0 = LoadGuestU32x4(record);
	const uvec4 q1 = LoadGuestU32x4(record + 16);
	const uvec4 q2 = LoadGuestU32x4(record + 32);
	const uvec4 q3 = LoadGuestU32x4(record + 48);
	const uint  words[16] =
	    uint[16](q0.x, q0.y, q0.z, q0.w, q1.x, q1.y, q1.z, q1.w, q2.x, q2.y, q2.z, q2.w, q3.x, q3.y, q3.z, q3.w);
	GuestInstance instance;
	for (uint r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
		vec4 row;
		for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
			const uint index = r * 4 + c;
			row[c] = uintBitsToFloat(words[(instance_layout[index / 8] >> ((index % 8) * 4)) & 15u]);
		}
		instance.rows[r] = row;
	}
	const uint blas = (instance_layout.y >> 20) & 15u;
	const uint lo   = words[blas];
	const uint hi   = words[min(blas + 1u, 15u)];
	instance.blas   = ((instance_layout.y >> 24) & 1u) != 0 ? (uint64_t(lo) | (uint64_t(hi & 0x3fffffu) << 32)) << 3
	                                                : uint64_t(lo) | (uint64_t(hi) << 32);
	instance.root   = words[(instance_layout.y >> 25) & 15u];
	instance.mask   = ((instance_layout.z >> 19) & 1u) != 0 ? (words[instance_layout.z & 15u] >> ((instance_layout.z >> 4) & 31u)) & 0xffu
	                                                       : 0xffu;
	instance.flags  = ((instance_layout.z >> 13) & 1u) != 0 ? words[(instance_layout.z >> 9) & 15u] >> ((instance_layout.z >> 14) & 31u) : 0u;
	return instance;
}

// A cheap mix of 32-bit words for signatures.
uint Mix(uint hash, uint value) {
	hash ^= value + 0x9e3779b9u + (hash << 6) + (hash >> 2);
	return hash;
}

```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/shaders/rt_tlas_walk.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
// Native ray tracing: walks the guest's top-level AMD BVH (box nodes from the header, instance
// leaves whose node index is the instance index; the instance records at the offset a header field
// holds, laid out as the tracing shader reads them, see GuestInstance in rt_common.inc) and writes
// one host acceleration structure instance per leaf. BLASes the
// host has no slot for yet are reported once each (see nativeRayTracing.cpp), and the built ones
// the TLAS references are listed for verification.

#include "rt_common.inc"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer TableEntry {
	uint64_t key;
	uint     slot;
	uint     flags;
};

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 16) buffer InstanceRef {
	vec4     rows[3];
	uint     index_mask;
	uint     sbt_flags;
	uint64_t reference;
};

layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 8) buffer ContextEntry {
	uint64_t header_va;
	uint64_t tlas_address;
	uint64_t instance_nodes;
	uint64_t slots;
	uint     instance_count;
	uint     valid;
	uint64_t instance_base;
};

layout(push_constant, std430) uniform Push {
	uint64_t user_ptr_va;
	uint64_t state;
	uint64_t queue;
	uint64_t instance_nodes;
	uint64_t instances;
	uint64_t table;
	uint64_t slots;
	uint64_t missing;
	uint64_t context;
	uint64_t tlas_address;
	uint64_t verify_list;
	uint     header_offset;
	uint     root;
	uint     instance_capacity;
	uint     table_mask;
	uint     prepare_id;
	uint     verify;
	// The layout of the instance records (Decoder::RayTracingLayout::Pack()).
	uvec4    instance_layout;
} pc;

// QueueCapacity and MissingCapacity in nativeRayTracing.cpp.
const uint kQueueCapacity   = 1u << 16;
const uint kMissingCapacity = 256;
// RtState::overflow: part of the TLAS (a box node or an instance record) is in memory the host has
// not cached. The context stays invalid, so the guest traverses the TLAS itself this time, and its
// own reads of that memory get it cached.
const uint kUnmapped = 4u;
// Push::header_offset when the host copied the header address into the state (from the dwords
// the tracing shader reads it from; HeaderInState in nativeRayTracing.cpp).
const uint kHeaderInState = 0xffffffffu;

shared uint s_head;
shared uint s_tail;
shared uint s_next_tail;
shared uint s_valid;
shared uint64_t s_header;

const uint kSlotPending = 0xffffffffu;
// The key of a table entry the host released (an evicted slot, a BLAS to report again): lookups
// probe past it and new keys reuse it. Real keys are multiples of 8.
const uint64_t kTombstone = uint64_t(1);
const uint kNoEntry = 0xffffffffu;

TableEntry TableAt(uint index) {
	return TableEntry(pc.table + uint64_t(index) * 16);
}

// The slot of the BLAS an entry with its key holds; pending until the host writes slot + 1.
uint SlotOf(TableEntry entry) {
	const uint slot = entry.slot;
	return slot == 0 ? kSlotPending : slot - 1;
}

// Reports a BLAS whose entry was just claimed (the key was `previous` before); when the report
// list is full the entry is given back so the BLAS is reported again next time.
uint ReportMissing(TableEntry entry, uint index, uint64_t previous, uint64_t blas_va, uint root) {
	const uint missing = atomicAdd(RtState(pc.state).missing_count, 1u);
	if (missing < kMissingCapacity) {
		MissingEntry report = MissingEntry(pc.missing + uint64_t(missing) * kMissingStride);
		report.blas_va      = blas_va;
		report.root         = root;
		report.table_index  = index;
		report.leaf_count   = 0;
		report.box_count    = 0;
		report.node_limit   = 0;
		report.flags        = 0;
	} else {
		atomicExchange(entry.key, previous);
	}
	return kSlotPending;
}

// BLASes whose builds the host saw (see NativeRayTracing::NoteGuestBlasBuilds()) are in a second
// table, after the walk's own (pc.table_mask + 1 entries), that only the host writes: same
// entries and hash, empty keys end a probe chain and released ones (tombstones) are skipped. It
// is probed first, so such a BLAS never waits for a report.
const uint kHostTableEntries = 1u << 14;
const uint kHostTableProbes  = 32;

uint FindHostSlot(uint64_t blas_va, uint root) {
	const uint64_t key  = blas_va ^ (uint64_t(root) << 48);
	const uint     hash = uint(key >> 6) * 0x9e3779b1u ^ uint(key >> 32) * 0x85ebca6bu;
	for (uint probe = 0; probe < kHostTableProbes; probe++) {
		TableEntry     entry = TableAt(pc.table_mask + 1u + ((hash + probe) & (kHostTableEntries - 1u)));
		const uint64_t found = entry.key;
		if (found == 0) {
			break;
		}
		if (found == key) {
			return SlotOf(entry);
		}
	}
	return kNoEntry;
}

// Finds the slot of a BLAS. A BLAS the table does not have claims the first released entry of
// its probe chain (or the empty one ending the chain) and is reported in the missing list.
uint FindSlot(uint64_t blas_va, uint root) {
	const uint64_t key  = blas_va ^ (uint64_t(root) << 48);
	uint           hash = uint(key >> 6) * 0x9e3779b1u ^ uint(key >> 32) * 0x85ebca6bu;
	uint           released = kNoEntry;
	for (uint probe = 0; probe < 64; probe++) {
		const uint index = (hash + probe) & pc.table_mask;
		TableEntry entry = TableAt(index);
		uint64_t   found = entry.key;
		if (found == kTombstone) {
			if (released == kNoEntry) {
				released = index;
			}
			continue;
		}
		if (found == 0) {
			if (released != kNoEntry) {
				TableEntry reuse = TableAt(released);
				const uint64_t taken = atomicCompSwap(reuse.key, kTombstone, key);
				if (taken == kTombstone) {
					return ReportMissing(reuse, released, kTombstone, blas_va, root);
				}
				if (taken == key) {
					return SlotOf(reuse);
				}
				// Claimed for another BLAS meanwhile: the empty entry takes it.
			}
			found = atomicCompSwap(entry.key, uint64_t(0), key);
			if (found == 0) {
				return ReportMissing(entry, index, uint64_t(0), blas_va, root);
			}
		}
		if (found == key) {
			// The host writes slot + 1 once it has allocated the slot.
			return SlotOf(entry);
		}
	}
	if (released != kNoEntry) {
		// A full chain: reuse a released entry.
		TableEntry reuse = TableAt(released);
		const uint64_t taken = atomicCompSwap(reuse.key, kTombstone, key);
		if (taken == kTombstone) {
			return ReportMissing(reuse, released, kTombstone, blas_va, root);
		}
		if (taken == key) {
			return SlotOf(reuse);
		}
	}
	return kSlotPending;
}

void main() {
	const uint lid   = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
	RtState    state = RtState(pc.state);
	if (lid == 0) {
		const uint64_t header = pc.header_offset == kHeaderInState
		                            ? state.header_va
		                            : LoadGuestU64(pc.user_ptr_va + pc.header_offset);
		s_header              = header;
		s_valid               = header != 0 && (header & 255) == 0 && HostAddress(header) != 0 ? 1u : 0u;
		state.header_va       = header;
		if (s_valid != 0) {
			state.instance_base = header + LoadGuestU64(header + LayoutInstanceOffset(pc.instance_layout));
			state.node_limit    = LoadGuestU32(header + 88);
		}
		U32Ref(pc.queue).v = pc.root;
		s_head             = 0;
		s_tail             = 1;
	}
	barrier();
	if (s_valid == 0) {
		if (lid == 0 && pc.context != 0) {
			ContextEntry(pc.context).valid = 0;
		}
		return;
	}
	const uint64_t header        = s_header;
	const uint64_t instance_base = state.instance_base;
	uint           depth         = 0;
	// Level by level over the box nodes; the queue keeps every box node visited.
	while (true) {
		const uint head = s_head;
		const uint tail = s_tail;
		if (head == tail || depth > 64) {
			break;
		}
		if (lid == 0) {
			s_next_tail = tail;
		}
		barrier();
		for (uint i = head + lid; i < tail; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
			const uint node = U32Ref(pc.queue + uint64_t(i) * 4).v;
			const uint64_t address = NodeAddress(header, node);
			const uint64_t host    = HostAddress(address);
			if (host == 0) {
				atomicOr(state.overflow, kUnmapped);
				continue;
			}
			const uvec4 children = U32x4Ref(host).v;
			for (uint c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
				const uint child = children[c];
				if (child == kInvalidNode) {
					continue;
				}
				const uint type = NodeType(child);
				if (type == 4u || type == 5u) {
					const uint slot = atomicAdd(s_next_tail, 1u);
					if (slot < kQueueCapacity) {
						U32Ref(pc.queue + uint64_t(slot) * 4).v = child;
					} else {
						atomicOr(state.overflow, 1u);
					}
				} else if (type < 4u || LayoutInline(pc.instance_layout, child)) {
					const uint index = atomicAdd(state.instance_count, 1u);
					if (index < pc.instance_capacity) {
						U32Ref(pc.instance_nodes + uint64_t(index) * 4).v = child;
					} else {
						atomicOr(state.overflow, 2u);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		barrier();
		if (lid == 0) {
			s_head = tail;
			s_tail = min(s_next_tail, kQueueCapacity);
		}
		depth++;
		barrier();
	}
	if (lid == 0) {
		state.box_count = s_tail;
		state.max_depth = depth;
	}
	memoryBarrierBuffer();
	barrier();

	const uint count = min(state.instance_count, pc.instance_capacity);
	for (uint i = lid; i < count; i += gl_WorkGroupSize.x) {
		const uint     node   = U32Ref(pc.instance_nodes + uint64_t(i) * 4).v;
		const uint64_t      record = InstanceRecord(header, instance_base, node, pc.instance_layout);
		if (HostAddress(record) == 0) {
			atomicOr(state.overflow, kUnmapped);
		}
		const GuestInstance guest  = LoadGuestInstance(record, pc.instance_layout);
		const uint64_t      blas   = guest.blas;
		const uint          root   = LayoutInline(pc.instance_layout, node)
		                                 ? LayoutInlineRoot(pc.instance_layout)
		                                 : guest.root;
		const uint          mask   = guest.mask;
		// Instance flags: bit 0 opaque, bit 1 alpha tested anyway, bit 2 both faces, bit 3 which
		// face is culled. Host instance flags: 1 = facing cull disable, 2 = flip facing, 4 = force
		// opaque, 8 = force no opaque.
		const uint guest_flags = guest.flags;
		const uint flip        = LayoutFlipFacing(pc.instance_layout) ? 1u : 0u;
		uint       host_flags  = (guest_flags & 4u) != 0 ? 1u : ((((guest_flags >> 3) ^ flip) & 1u) != 0 ? 2u : 0u);
		host_flags |= (guest_flags & 2u) != 0 ? 8u : ((guest_flags & 1u) != 0 ? 4u : 0u);
		InstanceRef    out_instance = InstanceRef(pc.instances + uint64_t(i) * 64);
		uint64_t       reference    = 0;
		uint           slot         = kSlotPending;
		if (blas != 0 && mask != 0) {
			slot = FindHostSlot(blas, root);
			if (slot == kNoEntry) {
				slot = FindSlot(blas, root);
			}
			if (slot == kSlotPending) {
				atomicAdd(state.unknown_blas, 1u);
			} else {
				SlotInfo info = SlotInfo(pc.slots + uint64_t(slot) * kSlotStride);
				if (info.state == kSlotBuilt) {
					reference = info.as_address;
					if (pc.verify != 0 && atomicExchange(info.stamp, pc.prepare_id) != pc.prepare_id) {
						const uint v = atomicAdd(state.verify_count, 1u);
						U32Ref(pc.verify_list + uint64_t(v) * 4).v = slot;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		// The guest matrix maps world to object space; the host instance needs its inverse.
		const vec4 r0 = guest.rows[0];
		const vec4 r1 = guest.rows[1];
		const vec4 r2 = guest.rows[2];
		const mat3 a  = mat3(vec3(r0.x, r1.x, r2.x), vec3(r0.y, r1.y, r2.y), vec3(r0.z, r1.z, r2.z));
		const vec3 t  = vec3(r0.w, r1.w, r2.w);
		const float d = determinant(a);
		if (reference == 0 || !(abs(d) > 1e-30) || isnan(d) || isinf(d)) {
			atomicAdd(state.inactive, 1u);
			out_instance.rows[0]    = vec4(0);
			out_instance.rows[1]    = vec4(0);
			out_instance.rows[2]    = vec4(0);
			out_instance.index_mask = 0;
			out_instance.sbt_flags  = 0;
			out_instance.reference  = 0;
			continue;
		}
		const mat3 inv = inverse(a);
		const vec3 it  = -(inv * t);
		// A transform the hardware cannot use (non-finite or absurdly large values, as in a record
		// the guest is rewriting) leaves the instance inactive instead of undefined traversal.
		bool usable = true;
		for (uint c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
			const vec3 column = vec3(inv[c][0], inv[c][1], inv[c][2]);
			usable = usable && all(lessThan(abs(column), vec3(1e18))) && !any(isnan(column));
		}
		usable = usable && all(lessThan(abs(it), vec3(1e18))) && !any(isnan(it));
		if (!usable) {
			atomicAdd(state.inactive, 1u);
			out_instance.rows[0]    = vec4(0);
			out_instance.rows[1]    = vec4(0);
			out_instance.rows[2]    = vec4(0);
			out_instance.index_mask = 0;
			out_instance.sbt_flags  = 0;
			out_instance.reference  = 0;
			continue;
		}
		// Row-major 3x4 (VkTransformMatrixKHR).
		out_instance.rows[0]    = vec4(inv[0][0], inv[1][0], inv[2][0], it.x);
		out_instance.rows[1]    = vec4(inv[0][1], inv[1][1], inv[2][1], it.y);
		out_instance.rows[2]    = vec4(inv[0][2], inv[1][2], inv[2][2], it.z);
		out_instance.index_mask = (slot & 0xffffffu) | (mask << 24);
		out_instance.sbt_flags  = host_flags << 24;
		out_instance.reference  = reference;
	}
	memoryBarrierBuffer();
	barrier();
	if (lid == 0) {
		const uint missing = min(state.missing_count, kMissingCapacity);
		state.dispatch_x   = missing;
		state.dispatch_y   = 1;
		state.dispatch_z   = 1;
		state.verify_x     = state.verify_count;
		state.verify_y     = 1;
		state.verify_z     = 1;
		if (pc.context != 0) {
			ContextEntry context   = ContextEntry(pc.context);
			context.header_va      = s_header;
			context.tlas_address   = pc.tlas_address;
			context.instance_nodes = pc.instance_nodes;
			context.slots          = pc.slots;
			context.instance_count = count;
			context.instance_base  = instance_base;
			context.valid          = pc.tlas_address != 0 && (state.overflow & kUnmapped) == 0 ? 1u : 0u;
		}
	}
}

```

`src/graphics/host_gpu/vma.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

#if defined(__clang__)
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wnullability-completeness"
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wunused-private-field"
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wunused-variable"
#endif

#define VMA_IMPLEMENTATION
#include <vk_mem_alloc.h>

#if defined(__clang__)
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
#endif

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/profiler.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/graphicContext.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

namespace {

// Deleted images are kept for reuse by an image created with the same parameters: the texture
// cache recreates images whose use alternates (for example a buffer rendered as a color target
// and sampled as a depth texture every frame), and each dedicated allocation can stall the driver
// for hundreds of milliseconds when video memory is under pressure.
struct RecycledImage {
	vk::ImageCreateInfo create;
	VkImage             image      = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	VmaAllocation       allocation = nullptr;
	uint64_t            size       = 0;
};

constexpr size_t   RecycledImagesMax     = 32;
constexpr uint64_t RecycledImageBytesMax = 256ull * 1024 * 1024;

std::mutex                 g_recycled_mutex;
std::vector<RecycledImage> g_recycled;
uint64_t                   g_recycled_bytes = 0;

bool Recyclable(const vk::ImageCreateInfo& create) {
	return create.pNext == nullptr && create.tiling == vk::ImageTiling::eOptimal &&
	       create.sharingMode == vk::SharingMode::eExclusive &&
	       create.initialLayout == vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined;
}

bool SameCreateInfo(const vk::ImageCreateInfo& a, const vk::ImageCreateInfo& b) {
	return a.flags == b.flags && a.imageType == b.imageType && a.format == b.format &&
	       a.extent == b.extent && a.mipLevels == b.mipLevels && a.arrayLayers == b.arrayLayers &&
	       a.samples == b.samples && a.usage == b.usage;
}

// Retired images are destroyed on a worker thread. Releasing the memory of a large render target
// takes 0.2 to 0.4 ms in the driver, and a game that scales its resolution every frame (PPSA30528)
// retires about ten of them per frame on the thread that records the draws.
class ImageGraveyard {
public:
	ImageGraveyard() = default;
	~ImageGraveyard() {
		Flush();
		{
			std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
			m_stop = true;
		}
		m_wake.notify_one();
		if (m_thread.joinable()) {
			m_thread.join();
		}
	}
	ImageGraveyard(const ImageGraveyard&)            = delete;
	ImageGraveyard& operator=(const ImageGraveyard&) = delete;

	void Push(VmaAllocator allocator, VkImage image, VmaAllocation allocation) {
		{
			std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
			if (!m_thread.joinable()) {
				m_thread = std::thread([this] { Run(); });
			}
			m_items.push_back({allocator, image, allocation});
		}
		m_wake.notify_one();
	}

	// Returns once every image pushed so far is destroyed.
	void Flush() {
		std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
		m_idle.wait(lock, [this] { return m_items.empty() && !m_busy; });
	}

private:
	struct Item {
		VmaAllocator  allocator;
		VkImage       image;
		VmaAllocation allocation;
	};

	void Run() {
		std::vector<Item> batch;
		std::unique_lock  lock(m_mutex);
		for (;;) {
			m_wake.wait(lock, [this] { return m_stop || !m_items.empty(); });
			if (m_items.empty()) {
				return;
			}
			batch.swap(m_items);
			m_busy = true;
			lock.unlock();
			for (const auto& item: batch) {
				vmaDestroyImage(item.allocator, item.image, item.allocation);
			}
			batch.clear();
			lock.lock();
			m_busy = false;
			m_idle.notify_all();
		}
	}

	std::mutex              m_mutex;
	std::condition_variable m_wake;
	std::condition_variable m_idle;
	std::vector<Item>       m_items;
	bool                    m_busy = false;
	bool                    m_stop = false;
	std::thread             m_thread;
};

ImageGraveyard& Graveyard() {
	static ImageGraveyard graveyard;
	return graveyard;
}

void DestroyRecycledImages(VmaAllocator allocator) {
	Graveyard().Flush();
	std::lock_guard lock(g_recycled_mutex);
	for (const auto& entry: g_recycled) {
		vmaDestroyImage(allocator, entry.image, entry.allocation);
	}
	g_recycled.clear();
	g_recycled_bytes = 0;
}

} // namespace

bool GraphicContext::CreateAllocator() {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	EXIT_IF(instance == nullptr || physical_device == nullptr || device == nullptr ||
	        allocator != nullptr);

	VmaVulkanFunctions functions {};
	functions.vkGetInstanceProcAddr = VULKAN_HPP_DEFAULT_DISPATCHER.vkGetInstanceProcAddr;
	functions.vkGetDeviceProcAddr   = VULKAN_HPP_DEFAULT_DISPATCHER.vkGetDeviceProcAddr;

	VmaAllocatorCreateInfo info {};
	info.instance         = instance;
	info.physicalDevice   = physical_device;
	info.device           = device;
	info.pVulkanFunctions = &functions;
	info.vulkanApiVersion = VULKAN_TARGET_API_VERSION;
	info.flags = VMA_ALLOCATOR_CREATE_BUFFER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT;
	if (memory_budget_ext_enabled) {
		info.flags |= VMA_ALLOCATOR_CREATE_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_BIT;
	}

	const auto result = static_cast<vk::Result>(vmaCreateAllocator(&info, &allocator));
	if (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
		LOGF("vmaCreateAllocator failed: %s\n", vk::to_string(result).c_str());
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

void GraphicContext::DestroyAllocator() {
	if (allocator == nullptr) {
		return;
	}
	DestroyRecycledImages(allocator);
	vmaDestroyAllocator(allocator);
	allocator = nullptr;
}

void GraphicContext::LogMemoryBudget() const {
	if (allocator == nullptr || physical_device == nullptr) {
		return;
	}

	const auto& properties = physical_device_memory_properties;
	VmaBudget   budgets[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS] {};
	vmaGetHeapBudgets(allocator, budgets);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < properties.memoryHeapCount; i++) {
		LOGF("VMA heap %u: usage=%" PRIu64 ", budget=%" PRIu64 ", allocation=%" PRIu64
		     ", blocks=%" PRIu64 "\n",
		     i, static_cast<uint64_t>(budgets[i].usage), static_cast<uint64_t>(budgets[i].budget),
		     static_cast<uint64_t>(budgets[i].statistics.allocationBytes),
		     static_cast<uint64_t>(budgets[i].statistics.blockBytes));
	}
}

uint64_t GraphicContext::GetDeviceMemoryUsage() const {
	if (!CanReportMemoryUsage() || allocator == nullptr) {
		return 0;
	}
	VmaBudget budgets[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS] {};
	vmaGetHeapBudgets(allocator, budgets);
	const bool discrete =
	    physical_device_properties.deviceType == vk::PhysicalDeviceType::eDiscreteGpu;
	uint64_t usage = 0;
	for (uint32_t heap = 0; heap < physical_device_memory_properties.memoryHeapCount; heap++) {
		const bool device_local =
		    static_cast<bool>(physical_device_memory_properties.memoryHeaps[heap].flags &
		                      vk::MemoryHeapFlagBits::eDeviceLocal);
		if (!discrete || device_local) {
			usage += budgets[heap].usage;
		}
	}
	return usage;
}

uint32_t GraphicContext::GetHeapUsage(std::span<HeapUsage, VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS> heaps) const {
	if (allocator == nullptr) {
		return 0;
	}
	VmaBudget budgets[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS] {};
	vmaGetHeapBudgets(allocator, budgets);
	const auto count = physical_device_memory_properties.memoryHeapCount;
	for (uint32_t heap = 0; heap < count; heap++) {
		const auto& properties = physical_device_memory_properties.memoryHeaps[heap];
		heaps[heap] = {.usage        = budgets[heap].usage,
		               .budget       = budgets[heap].budget,
		               .allocations  = budgets[heap].statistics.allocationCount,
		               .device_local = static_cast<bool>(properties.flags &
		                                                 vk::MemoryHeapFlagBits::eDeviceLocal)};
	}
	return count;
}

uint64_t GraphicContext::GetTotalMemoryBudget() const {
	if (allocator == nullptr) {
		return 0;
	}
	VmaBudget budgets[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS] {};
	vmaGetHeapBudgets(allocator, budgets);
	const bool discrete =
	    physical_device_properties.deviceType == vk::PhysicalDeviceType::eDiscreteGpu;
	uint64_t budget = 0;
	uint64_t local  = 0;
	uint64_t usage  = 0;
	for (uint32_t heap = 0; heap < physical_device_memory_properties.memoryHeapCount; heap++) {
		const auto& properties = physical_device_memory_properties.memoryHeaps[heap];
		const bool  device_local =
		    static_cast<bool>(properties.flags & vk::MemoryHeapFlagBits::eDeviceLocal);
		if (device_local) {
			local += properties.size;
		}
		if (!discrete || device_local) {
			budget += CanReportMemoryUsage() ? budgets[heap].budget : properties.size;
			usage += CanReportMemoryUsage() ? budgets[heap].usage : 0;
		}
	}
	if (discrete) {
		return budget - std::min<uint64_t>(budget / 8, 1024ull * 1024 * 1024);
	}
	constexpr uint64_t system_reserve = 8ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
	const auto         available      = budget > usage ? budget - usage : uint64_t {0};
	return std::max(local, available > system_reserve ? available - system_reserve : uint64_t {0});
}

bool GraphicContext::CreateImage(const vk::ImageCreateInfo& image_info, VulkanImage& image) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	EXIT_IF(allocator == nullptr || image.image != nullptr || image.allocation != nullptr);

	VmaAllocationCreateInfo alloc_info {};
	alloc_info.flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_WITHIN_BUDGET_BIT;
	alloc_info.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE;

	vk::Image::CType native_image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	if (Recyclable(image_info)) {
		std::lock_guard lock(g_recycled_mutex);
		const auto      found =
		    std::find_if(g_recycled.begin(), g_recycled.end(), [&](const auto& entry) {
			    return SameCreateInfo(entry.create, image_info);
		    });
		if (found != g_recycled.end()) {
			native_image     = found->image;
			image.allocation = found->allocation;
			g_recycled_bytes -= found->size;
			g_recycled.erase(found);
		}
	}
	if (native_image == VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
		auto result = static_cast<vk::Result>(vmaCreateImage(
		    allocator, static_cast<const vk::ImageCreateInfo::NativeType*>(image_info), &alloc_info,
		    &native_image, &image.allocation, nullptr));
		if (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
			// Memory kept for reuse may be what the new image needs.
			DestroyRecycledImages(allocator);
			result = static_cast<vk::Result>(vmaCreateImage(
			    allocator, static_cast<const vk::ImageCreateInfo::NativeType*>(image_info),
			    &alloc_info, &native_image, &image.allocation, nullptr));
		}
		if (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
			image.image = native_image;
			LogMemoryBudget();
			return false;
		}
	}
	image.image = native_image;

	image.format     = image_info.format;
	image.image_type = image_info.imageType;
	image.extent     = image_info.extent;
	image.layers     = image_info.arrayLayers;
	image.mip_levels = image_info.mipLevels;
	image.samples    = static_cast<uint32_t>(image_info.samples);
	image.usage      = image_info.usage;
	image.recyclable = Recyclable(image_info);
	image.flags      = image_info.flags;
	image.state      = {.layout = image_info.initialLayout};
	image.subresource_states.clear();

	return true;
}

void GraphicContext::DeleteImage(VulkanImage& image) {
	KYTY_PROFILER_FUNCTION();
	EXIT_IF(allocator == nullptr || image.image == nullptr || image.allocation == nullptr);

	// Deleted images are idle (their owners defer deletion until the GPU is done with them).
	vk::ImageCreateInfo create {};
	create.flags         = image.flags;
	create.imageType     = image.image_type;
	create.format        = image.format;
	create.extent        = image.extent;
	create.mipLevels     = image.mip_levels;
	create.arrayLayers   = image.layers;
	create.samples       = static_cast<vk::SampleCountFlagBits>(image.samples);
	create.tiling        = vk::ImageTiling::eOptimal;
	create.usage         = image.usage;
	create.sharingMode   = vk::SharingMode::eExclusive;
	create.initialLayout = vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined;
	if (image.recyclable) {
		VmaAllocationInfo allocation_info {};
		vmaGetAllocationInfo(allocator, image.allocation, &allocation_info);
		std::lock_guard lock(g_recycled_mutex);
		g_recycled.push_back({create, image.image, image.allocation, allocation_info.size});
		g_recycled_bytes += allocation_info.size;
		while (g_recycled.size() > RecycledImagesMax || g_recycled_bytes > RecycledImageBytesMax) {
			const auto& oldest = g_recycled.front();
			Graveyard().Push(allocator, oldest.image, oldest.allocation);
			g_recycled_bytes -= oldest.size;
			g_recycled.erase(g_recycled.begin());
		}
	} else {
		Graveyard().Push(allocator, image.image, image.allocation);
	}
	image.image      = nullptr;
	image.allocation = nullptr;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

```cpp
constexpr auto MakeFormatLookup() {
	constexpr auto kMaxFormat = static_cast<size_t>(Prospero::BufferFormat::kBc7Srgb);
	std::array<vk::Format, kMaxFormat + 1> lookup {};
	lookup.fill(vk::Format::eUndefined);
	for (const auto& mapping: kFormatMappings) {
		lookup[static_cast<size_t>(mapping.guest)] = mapping.host;
	}
	return lookup;
}

constexpr auto kFormatLookup = MakeFormatLookup();

} // namespace

vk::Format VulkanFormat(Prospero::BufferFormat guest_format) {
	const auto index = static_cast<size_t>(guest_format);
	return index < kFormatLookup.size() ? kFormatLookup[index] : vk::Format::eUndefined;
}

void RequireVulkanSuccess(vk::Result result, const char* operation) {
	if (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) {
		EXIT("%s failed: %s (%d)\n", operation, vk::to_string(result).c_str(),
		     static_cast<int>(result));
	}
}

vk::ShaderModule CompileSPV(std::span<const uint32_t> code, vk::Device device) {
	vk::ShaderModuleCreateInfo create_info {};
	create_info.codeSize    = code.size_bytes();
	create_info.pCode       = code.data();
	vk::ShaderModule module = nullptr;
	RequireVulkanSuccess(device.createShaderModule(&create_info, nullptr, &module),
	                     "create SPIR-V shader module");
	return module;
}
```

```h
#define VULKAN_HPP_NO_CONSTRUCTORS

#define VMA_DYNAMIC_VULKAN_FUNCTIONS 1

#include "common/emulatorConfig.h"

[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsHdrSwapchainFormat(vk::Format format) {
	switch (format) {
		case vk::Format::eA2B10G10R10UnormPack32:
		case vk::Format::eA2R10G10B10UnormPack32: return true;
		default: return false;
	}
}

template <typename Handle, typename... Args>
void SetVulkanObjectNameF(vk::Device device, Handle handle, fmt::format_string<Args...> format,
                          Args&&... args) {
	if (!Config::GraphicsDebugDumpEnabled() || device == nullptr || handle == nullptr ||
	    VULKAN_HPP_DEFAULT_DISPATCHER.vkSetDebugUtilsObjectNameEXT == nullptr) {
		return;
	}

	const auto                      name = fmt::format(format, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
	vk::DebugUtilsObjectNameInfoEXT info {};
	info.objectType   = Handle::objectType;
	info.objectHandle = static_cast<uint64_t>(
	    reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(static_cast<typename Handle::CType>(handle)));
	info.pObjectName = name.c_str();
	(void)device.setDebugUtilsObjectNameEXT(&info);
}

template <typename T, typename Enumerator>
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<T> EnumerateVulkan(const char* operation, Enumerator&& enumerate) {
	for (;;) {
		uint32_t count = 0;
		RequireVulkanSuccess(enumerate(&count, nullptr), operation);
		if (count == 0) {
			return {};
		}

		std::vector<T> values(count);
		const auto     result = enumerate(&count, values.data());
		if (result == vk::Result::eSuccess) {
			values.resize(count);
			return values;
		}
		if (result != vk::Result::eIncomplete) {
			RequireVulkanSuccess(result, operation);
		}
	}
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_HOST_GPU_VULKANCOMMON_H_
```
