```cpp
DdsImage::~DdsImage() {
	if (m_descriptor != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
		ImGui_ImplVulkan_RemoveTexture(m_descriptor);
	}
	m_graphics.device.destroyImageView(m_view, nullptr);
	if (m_image.image != nullptr) {
		m_graphics.DeleteImage(m_image);
	}
	if (m_staging != VK_NULL_HANDLE) {
		vmaDestroyBuffer(m_graphics.allocator, m_staging, m_staging_allocation);
	}
}

bool DdsImage::Load(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
	EXIT_IF(m_image.image != nullptr || m_staging != VK_NULL_HANDLE);
	Common::File file(path, Common::File::Mode::Read);
	if (file.IsInvalid()) {
		return false;
	}

	std::array<uint32_t, 37> header {};
	uint32_t                 read = 0;
	file.Read(header.data(), sizeof(header), &read);
	const auto width  = header[4];
	const auto height = header[3];
	if (read != sizeof(header) || header[0] != 0x20534444 || header[1] != 124 || header[19] != 32 ||
	    header[20] != 4 || header[21] != 0x30315844 || header[32] != 98 || header[33] != 3 ||
	    header[34] != 0 || header[35] != 1 || header[6] != 0 || header[7] != 1 || header[28] != 0 ||
	    width == 0 || height == 0 || width > 3840 || height > 2160) {
		return false;
	}
	const uint32_t size = ((width + 3) / 4) * ((height + 3) / 4) * 16;
	if (file.Size() != sizeof(header) + size) {
		return false;
	}

	constexpr auto format   = vk::Format::eBc7UnormBlock;
	constexpr auto features = vk::FormatFeatureFlagBits::eSampledImage |
	                          vk::FormatFeatureFlagBits::eSampledImageFilterLinear |
	                          vk::FormatFeatureFlagBits::eTransferDst;
	if ((m_graphics.GetFormatProperties(format).optimalTilingFeatures & features) != features) {
		LOGF("[Splash] host does not support BC7 textures\n");
		return false;
	}

	vk::BufferCreateInfo buffer {};
	buffer.size  = size;
	buffer.usage = vk::BufferUsageFlagBits::eTransferSrc;
	VmaAllocationCreateInfo allocation {};
	allocation.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST;
	allocation.flags =
	    VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_BIT;
	VmaAllocationInfo mapped {};
	if (vmaCreateBuffer(m_graphics.allocator, static_cast<const VkBufferCreateInfo*>(buffer),
	                    &allocation, &m_staging, &m_staging_allocation, &mapped) != VK_SUCCESS) {
		LOGF("[Splash] could not allocate DDS upload buffer\n");
		return false;
	}
	file.Read(mapped.pMappedData, size, &read);
	if (read != size) {
		return false;
	}
	RequireVulkanSuccess(static_cast<vk::Result>(vmaFlushAllocation(m_graphics.allocator,
	                                                                m_staging_allocation, 0, size)),
	                     "flush splash image upload");

	vk::ImageCreateInfo image {};
	image.imageType   = vk::ImageType::e2D;
	image.extent      = {width, height, 1};
	image.mipLevels   = 1;
	image.arrayLayers = 1;
	image.format      = format;
	image.tiling      = vk::ImageTiling::eOptimal;
	image.usage       = vk::ImageUsageFlagBits::eTransferDst | vk::ImageUsageFlagBits::eSampled;
	image.samples     = vk::SampleCountFlagBits::e1;
	if (!m_graphics.CreateImage(image, m_image)) {
		LOGF("[Splash] could not allocate DDS image\n");
		return false;
	}
	vk::ImageViewCreateInfo view {};
	view.image            = m_image.image;
	view.viewType         = vk::ImageViewType::e2D;
	view.format           = format;
	view.subresourceRange = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 1, 0, 1};
	RequireVulkanSuccess(m_graphics.device.createImageView(&view, nullptr, &m_view),
	                     "create splash image view");
	m_descriptor = ImGui_ImplVulkan_AddTexture(static_cast<VkImageView>(m_view),
	                                           VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
	return true;
}

void DdsImage::Upload(vk::CommandBuffer command) {
	if (m_image.state.layout == vk::ImageLayout::eShaderReadOnlyOptimal) {
		return;
	}
	vk::ImageMemoryBarrier barrier {};
	barrier.dstAccessMask       = vk::AccessFlagBits::eTransferWrite;
	barrier.oldLayout           = vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined;
	barrier.newLayout           = vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal;
	barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
	barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
	barrier.image               = m_image.image;
	barrier.subresourceRange    = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 1, 0, 1};
	command.pipelineBarrier(vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTopOfPipe,
	                        vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTransfer, {}, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1,
	                        &barrier);
	vk::BufferImageCopy copy {};
	copy.imageSubresource = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 0, 1};
	copy.imageExtent      = m_image.extent;
	command.copyBufferToImage(m_staging, m_image.image, vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal, 1,
	                          &copy);
	barrier.srcAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eTransferWrite;
	barrier.dstAccessMask = vk::AccessFlagBits::eShaderRead;
	barrier.oldLayout     = vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal;
	barrier.newLayout     = vk::ImageLayout::eShaderReadOnlyOptimal;
	command.pipelineBarrier(vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eTransfer,
	                        vk::PipelineStageFlagBits::eFragmentShader, {}, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr,
	                        1, &barrier);
	m_image.state.layout = vk::ImageLayout::eShaderReadOnlyOptimal;
}

ImTextureRef DdsImage::Texture() const {
	return ImTextureRef {static_cast<ImTextureID>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(m_descriptor))};
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics
```

`src/graphics/presentation/frameStepHack.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/presentation/frameStepHack.h"

#include "common/hackNotice.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/timer.h"
#include "common/virtualMemory.h"
#include "loader/systemContent.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::VideoOut::FrameStepHack {

// [HACK] ASTRO BOT runs in slow motion when the emulator presents fewer frames than its frame
// rate: at 30 fps the game moves at half speed. Its simulation never measures time: at start-up it
// sets a frame rate (60) and stores it in three globals of its executable, the rate (a double),
// the frame in seconds (a float) and the frame in microseconds (a 64-bit integer). Each frame the
// main update gets 1 / rate as its time step, the physics world steps by the float, and most
// objects convert the microseconds into their smoothing factors. About 180 functions also read a
// 1/60 float constant of the executable as the step of their own per-frame updates (timers,
// velocities, the targets of keyframed physics bodies). Guest clocks play no part.
//
// While the game presents fewer frames than its rate, the three globals now hold the time between
// presented frames (averaged over about eight frames, at most MaxStep), as if the game had set
// that frame rate, and the constant grows in the same ratio; at its rate they keep the game's own
// values. ASTRO BOT also paces its frames by sleeping until 90 % of 1 / rate has passed; that one
// reader is redirected to the game's own frame time, so that the pacing does not hold the game at
// the slower rate.
//
// ASTRO's PLAYROOM (PPSA01325) runs on the same engine, with the same three globals, getters and
// main update, and about 50 readers of the 1/60 constant. It does not pace its frames by 1 / rate
// (the rate is only read by the 1 / rate getter, which only its updates call), so it has no pacing
// site to redirect.
//
// The disc, digital and Japanese releases and their updates place this code and data at different
// addresses, so FindSites finds them by their code; nothing is written unless each one is found
// exactly once.
//
// To be removed when the game runs at its frame rate in the emulator.
namespace {

struct Title {
	std::string_view id;
	const char*      name;
	bool             pacing; // paces its frames by 1 / rate
};

constexpr std::array<Title, 5> Titles {{
    {"PPSA21559", "ASTRO BOT", true},
    {"PPSA21564", "ASTRO BOT", true},
    {"PPSA21567", "ASTRO BOT", true},
    {"PPSA21568", "ASTRO BOT", true},
    {"PPSA01325", "ASTRO's PLAYROOM", false},
}};

constexpr float OwnFrameConstant = 1.0f / 60.0f;

// Longest step: below that frame rate the game slows down again instead of taking larger steps
// (or a step across a pause or a load).
constexpr double MaxStep = 1.0 / 15.0;
// The presented frame time is averaged over about this many frames (presentation is quantized to
// vblanks: at 24 fps the frames alternate 2 and 3 vblanks).
constexpr double AverageFrames = 8.0;
// Within this ratio of the game's frame the game keeps its own values.
constexpr double FullRateSlack = 1.08;

// Offsets from the load address.
struct Sites {
	uint64_t rate           = 0; // double, frames per second
	uint64_t step           = 0; // float, seconds per frame (rate + 8)
	uint64_t period         = 0; // uint64_t, microseconds per frame (rate + 16)
	uint64_t frame_constant = 0; // float 1/60, the step of fixed-step updates
	uint64_t pacing_site    = 0; // call <1 / rate>; vmulsd xmm0, xmm0, [1000.0] (13 bytes), or 0
	uint64_t pacing_frame   = 0; // 8 bytes of int3 padding: the pacing's frame time (double, ms)
};

struct State {
	bool        active       = false;
	const char* name         = nullptr;
	uint64_t    base         = 0;
	Sites       sites;
	double      own_rate     = 0.0; // the rate the game set, 0 until seen
	float       own_step     = 0.0f;
	uint64_t    own_period   = 0;
	double      written_rate = 0.0; // the rate in the game's global after our last look at it
	uint64_t    last_counter = 0;
	double      frequency    = 0.0;
	double      average      = 0.0;
	bool        scaled       = false;
};

State& GetState() {
	static State state;
	return state;
}

template <typename T>
T Read(uint64_t address) {
	return std::atomic_ref<T>(*reinterpret_cast<T*>(address)).load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

template <typename T>
void Write(uint64_t address, T value) {
	std::atomic_ref<T>(*reinterpret_cast<T*>(address)).store(value, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

std::string ParamString(const char* name) {
	std::string value;
	return Loader::SystemContentParamSfoGetString(name, &value) ? value : std::string("?");
}

// The loaded executable, read through offsets from its load address.
class Image {
public:
	Image(uint64_t base, uint64_t size)
	    : m_data(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(base)), m_size(size) {}

	[[nodiscard]] bool Has(uint64_t offset, uint64_t size) const {
		return offset <= m_size && size <= m_size - offset;
	}
	[[nodiscard]] bool Is(uint64_t offset, std::span<const uint8_t> bytes) const {
		return Has(offset, bytes.size()) &&
		       std::memcmp(m_data + offset, bytes.data(), bytes.size()) == 0;
	}
	template <typename T>
	[[nodiscard]] T Get(uint64_t offset) const {
		T value {};
		std::memcpy(&value, m_data + offset, sizeof(T));
		return value;
	}
	// The target of the rip-relative disp32 at `disp` of an instruction that ends at `end`.
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t Target(uint64_t disp, uint64_t end) const {
		return end + static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(Get<int32_t>(disp)));
	}
	[[nodiscard]] bool IsDouble(uint64_t offset, double value) const {
		return Has(offset, sizeof(double)) && Get<double>(offset) == value;
	}
	// Calls f with every offset in [begin, end) where `bytes` starts.
	template <typename F>
	void ForEach(uint64_t begin, uint64_t end, std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, F&& f) const {
		end = std::min(end, m_size);
		if (begin >= end || end - begin < bytes.size()) {
			return;
		}
		const auto* first = m_data + begin;
		const auto* last  = m_data + end;
		const std::boyer_moore_horspool_searcher searcher(bytes.begin(), bytes.end());
		for (auto it = std::search(first, last, searcher); it != last;
		     it      = std::search(it + 1, last, searcher)) {
			f(static_cast<uint64_t>(it - m_data));
		}
	}

private:
	const uint8_t* m_data;
	uint64_t       m_size;
};

constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 4> VmovsdLoad {0xc5, 0xfb, 0x10, 0x05}; // vmovsd xmm0, [rip + d]
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 4> VdivsdLoad {0xc5, 0xfb, 0x5e, 0x05}; // vdivsd xmm0, xmm0, [rip + d]
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 4> VmulsdLoad {0xc5, 0xfb, 0x59, 0x05}; // vmulsd xmm0, xmm0, [rip + d]
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 4> VmovssLoad {0xc5, 0xfa, 0x10, 0x05}; // vmovss xmm0, [rip + d]
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 3> MovRaxLoad {0x48, 0x8b, 0x05};       // mov rax, [rip + d]
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 4> Vcvtsd2ss {0xc5, 0xfb, 0x5a, 0xc0};  // vcvtsd2ss xmm0, xmm0, xmm0
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 1> Call {0xe8};                         // call rel32
constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 8> Int3x8 {0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc, 0xcc};
constexpr uint8_t                Ret = 0xc3;

// Fills `sites` from the code of the executable, or returns why it cannot. Without `pacing` the
// game must have no pacing site.
std::string_view FindSites(const Image& image, std::span<const CodeRange> code, bool pacing,
                           Sites* sites) {
	// The frame-rate getters, next to each other: mov rax, [period]; ret, then
	// vmovsd xmm0, [1.0]; vdivsd xmm0, xmm0, [rate]; ret, then vmovss xmm0, [step]; ret, with
	// step = rate + 8 and period = rate + 16.
	uint64_t getter  = 0;
	uint32_t getters = 0;
	for (const auto& range: code) {
		image.ForEach(range.begin, range.end, VmovsdLoad, [&](uint64_t p) {
			if (!image.Has(p, 17) || !image.Is(p + 8, VdivsdLoad) ||
			    image.Get<uint8_t>(p + 16) != Ret || !image.IsDouble(image.Target(p + 4, p + 8), 1.0)) {
				return;
			}
			const auto rate          = image.Target(p + 12, p + 16);
			bool       period_getter = false;
			for (uint64_t q = p >= 32 ? p - 32 : 0; q < p && !period_getter; q++) {
				period_getter = image.Is(q, MovRaxLoad) && image.Get<uint8_t>(q + 7) == Ret &&
				                image.Target(q + 3, q + 7) == rate + 16;
			}
			bool step_getter = false;
			for (uint64_t q = p + 17; q < p + 64 && image.Has(q, 9) && !step_getter; q++) {
				step_getter = image.Is(q, VmovssLoad) && image.Get<uint8_t>(q + 8) == Ret &&
				              image.Target(q + 4, q + 8) == rate + 8;
			}
			if (period_getter && step_getter && image.Has(rate, 24)) {
				getter      = p;
				sites->rate = rate;
				getters++;
			}
		});
	}
	if (getters != 1) {
		return getters == 0 ? "frame-rate getters not found" : "frame-rate getters found twice";
	}
	sites->step   = sites->rate + 8;
	sites->period = sites->rate + 16;

	// The calls of the 1 / rate getter: the pacing multiplies its result by 1000.0 and the main
	// update converts it to a float.
	uint32_t pacing_sites = 0;
	bool     update       = false;
	for (const auto& range: code) {
		image.ForEach(range.begin, range.end, Call, [&](uint64_t p) {
			if (!image.Has(p, 21) || image.Target(p + 1, p + 5) != getter) {
				return;
			}
			if (image.Is(p + 5, VmulsdLoad) && image.IsDouble(image.Target(p + 9, p + 13), 1000.0)) {
				sites->pacing_site = p;
				pacing_sites++;
			}
			for (uint64_t q = p + 5; q + Vcvtsd2ss.size() <= p + 21 && !update; q++) {
				update = image.Is(q, Vcvtsd2ss);
			}
		});
	}
	if (!pacing && pacing_sites != 0) {
		return "unexpected frame pacing found";
	}
	if (pacing && pacing_sites != 1) {
		return pacing_sites == 0 ? "frame pacing not found" : "frame pacing found twice";
	}
	if (!update) {
		return "main update not found";
	}

	// The int3 padding closest before the pacing site, within 64 KB of it in its code range.
	if (pacing) {
		const auto range = std::find_if(code.begin(), code.end(), [&](const CodeRange& r) {
			return sites->pacing_site >= r.begin && sites->pacing_site < r.end;
		});
		const uint64_t start =
		    sites->pacing_site >= 8 ? (sites->pacing_site - 8) & ~uint64_t {7} : 0;
		for (uint64_t a = start; a >= range->begin && a + 0x10000 > sites->pacing_site && a >= 8;
		     a -= 8) {
			if (image.Is(a, Int3x8)) {
				sites->pacing_frame = a;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (sites->pacing_frame == 0) {
			return "padding for the pacing frame time not found";
		}
	}

	// The 1/60 float that the code reads the most (instructions that end with their rip-relative
	// disp32, as the loads and arithmetic of the fixed-step updates do), other than the step.
	std::vector<uint64_t> constants;
	image.ForEach(0, UINT64_MAX, std::bit_cast<std::array<uint8_t, 4>>(OwnFrameConstant),
	              [&](uint64_t a) {
		              if (a % 4 == 0 && (a < sites->rate || a >= sites->rate + 24)) {
			              constants.push_back(a);
		              }
	              });
	if (constants.empty()) {
		return "1/60 constant not found";
	}
	std::vector<uint32_t> reads(constants.size());
	for (const auto& r: code) {
		for (uint64_t p = r.begin; p + 4 <= r.end && image.Has(p, 4); p++) {
			const auto target = image.Target(p, p + 4);
			if (target < constants.front() || target > constants.back()) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto it = std::lower_bound(constants.begin(), constants.end(), target);
			if (it != constants.end() && *it == target) {
				reads[static_cast<size_t>(it - constants.begin())]++;
			}
		}
	}
	const auto most   = std::max_element(reads.begin(), reads.end());
	uint32_t   second = 0;
	for (auto it = reads.begin(); it != reads.end(); ++it) {
		second = it != most ? std::max(second, *it) : second;
	}
	// 01.007.000 of PPSA21564: 218 reads, 01.905.000 of PPSA01325: 47; no other 1/60 float is read.
	if (*most < 32 || *most < 8 * second) {
		return "1/60 constant of the fixed-step updates not found";
	}
	sites->frame_constant = constants[static_cast<size_t>(most - reads.begin())];
	return {};
}

// What SetFrameRate stores: the rate, 1 / rate as a float and 1000000 / rate truncated.
bool IsOwnFrameRate(double rate, float step, uint64_t period) {
	return rate >= 20.0 && rate <= 240.0 &&
	       std::fabs(static_cast<double>(step) * rate - 1.0) < 1e-4 &&
	       period == static_cast<uint64_t>(1000000.0 / rate);
}

// The game's frame lasts `frame` seconds: what SetFrameRate(1 / frame) would store, and the 1/60
// constant in the same ratio to the game's own frame.
void WriteFrame(State* state, double frame) {
	const double rate  = 1.0 / frame;
	const auto&  sites = state->sites;
	Write<double>(state->base + sites.rate, rate);
	Write<float>(state->base + sites.step, static_cast<float>(1.0 / rate));
	Write<uint64_t>(state->base + sites.period, static_cast<uint64_t>(1000000.0 / rate));
	Write<float>(state->base + sites.frame_constant,
	             static_cast<float>(OwnFrameConstant * frame * state->own_rate));
	state->written_rate = rate;
}

void WriteOwnFrame(State* state) {
	const auto& sites = state->sites;
	Write<double>(state->base + sites.rate, state->own_rate);
	Write<float>(state->base + sites.step, state->own_step);
	Write<uint64_t>(state->base + sites.period, state->own_period);
	Write<float>(state->base + sites.frame_constant, OwnFrameConstant);
	state->written_rate = state->own_rate;
}

} // namespace

void PatchMainProgram(uint64_t base_vaddr, uint64_t size, std::span<const CodeRange> code) noexcept {
	const auto id    = ParamString("TITLE_ID");
	const auto title = std::find_if(Titles.begin(), Titles.end(),
	                                [&](const Title& t) { return t.id == id; });
	if (title == Titles.end()) {
		return;
	}
	const auto version = ParamString("APP_VER");
	Sites      sites;
	const auto failure = base_vaddr == 0
	                         ? std::string_view("no executable")
	                         : FindSites(Image(base_vaddr, size), code, title->pacing, &sites);
	if (!failure.empty()) {
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("[HACK] {} frame time: not applied to {} {} ({})\n",
		                                      title->name, id, version, failure));
		return;
	}

	if (sites.pacing_site != 0) {
		// The pacing reads the game's own frame time from the padding instead of 1 / rate:
		// vmovsd xmm0, [rip + disp32] (8 bytes) and a 5-byte nop.
		constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 5> nop5 {0x0f, 0x1f, 0x44, 0x00, 0x00};
		const auto                       site = base_vaddr + sites.pacing_site;
		const int32_t disp = static_cast<int32_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(sites.pacing_frame) -
		                                          static_cast<int64_t>(sites.pacing_site + 8));
		std::array<uint8_t, 13> pacing {};
		std::memcpy(pacing.data(), VmovsdLoad.data(), VmovsdLoad.size());
		std::memcpy(pacing.data() + 4, &disp, sizeof(disp));
		std::memcpy(pacing.data() + 8, nop5.data(), nop5.size());
		std::array<uint8_t, 13> original {};
		std::memcpy(original.data(), reinterpret_cast<const void*>(site), original.size());
		Write<double>(base_vaddr + sites.pacing_frame, (1.0 / 60.0) * 1000.0);
		std::memcpy(reinterpret_cast<void*>(site), pacing.data(), pacing.size());
		if (!Common::VirtualMemory::FlushInstructionCache(site, pacing.size())) {
			std::memcpy(reinterpret_cast<void*>(site), original.data(), original.size());
			Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(
			    fmt::format("[HACK] {} frame time: not applied to {} {} (code write failed)\n",
			                title->name, id, version));
			return;
		}
	}

	auto& state     = GetState();
	state.base      = base_vaddr;
	state.sites     = sites;
	state.frequency = 1e9; // Common::SteadyNs() counts nanoseconds.
	state.name      = title->name;
	state.active    = true;
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format(
	    "[HACK] {} frame time ({} {}: rate {:#x}, constant {:#x}, pacing {:#x}): below the game's "
	    "frame rate its frame time follows the presented frames (at most {:.0f} ms), so that it "
	    "does not run in slow motion\n",
	    title->name, id, version, sites.rate, sites.frame_constant, sites.pacing_site,
	    MaxStep * 1000.0));
}

void OnPresentedFrame() noexcept {
	auto& state = GetState();
	if (!state.active) {
		return;
	}
	const auto counter = Common::SteadyNs();
	const auto last    = std::exchange(state.last_counter, counter);

	const auto& sites = state.sites;
	const auto  rate  = Read<double>(state.base + sites.rate);
	if (rate != state.written_rate) {
		// The game set its frame rate (at start-up, or for another video mode): it owns the three
		// globals again, and the pacing follows its rate.
		const auto step   = Read<float>(state.base + sites.step);
		const auto period = Read<uint64_t>(state.base + sites.period);
		if (!IsOwnFrameRate(rate, step, period)) {
			return; // Not set yet, or being set.
		}
		if (rate != state.own_rate) {
			Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("[HACK] {} frame time: the game runs at {:.2f} fps\n",
			                                      state.name, rate));
		}
		state.own_rate     = rate;
		state.own_step     = step;
		state.own_period   = period;
		state.written_rate = rate;
		state.average      = 0.0;
		state.scaled       = false;
		Write<float>(state.base + sites.frame_constant, OwnFrameConstant);
		if (sites.pacing_frame != 0) {
			Write<double>(state.base + sites.pacing_frame, (1.0 / rate) * 1000.0);
		}
	}
	if (last == 0 || state.own_rate == 0.0) {
		return;
	}

	const double own_frame = 1.0 / state.own_rate;
	const double frame = std::min(static_cast<double>(counter - last) / state.frequency, MaxStep);
	state.average =
	    state.average == 0.0 ? frame : state.average + (frame - state.average) / AverageFrames;
	if (state.average <= own_frame * FullRateSlack) {
		if (state.scaled) {
			WriteOwnFrame(&state);
			state.scaled = false;
		}
		return;
	}

	WriteFrame(&state, state.average);
	state.scaled = true;
	Common::HackNotice::Report("Frame time follows the presented frames",
	                           "FrameStepHack::OnPresentedFrame", 0, 0,
	                           fmt::format("{}: frame {:.1f} ms instead of {:.1f} ms", state.name,
	                                       state.average * 1000.0, own_frame * 1000.0));
}

} // namespace Libs::VideoOut::FrameStepHack
```

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_PRESENTATION_FRAMESTEPHACK_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_PRESENTATION_FRAMESTEPHACK_H_

#include <cstdint>
#include <span>

namespace Libs::VideoOut::FrameStepHack {

// [HACK] ASTRO BOT (PPSA21559, PPSA21564, PPSA21567, PPSA21568) advances its simulation by one
// frame of its frame rate for each frame, whatever the time between frames. Below that rate the
// game's frame time follows the presented frames instead. No effect on other titles, or on
// executables where the patched code and data are not found.

// Offsets from the load address of an executable segment.
struct CodeRange {
	uint64_t begin = 0;
	uint64_t end   = 0;
};

// Called once with the main executable, after relocation and before the game runs.
void PatchMainProgram(uint64_t base_vaddr, uint64_t size, std::span<const CodeRange> code) noexcept;

// Called on the presentation thread for each presented main-bus guest flip.
void OnPresentedFrame() noexcept;

} // namespace Libs::VideoOut::FrameStepHack

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_PRESENTATION_FRAMESTEPHACK_H_
```

```cpp
enum Action { TRIGGER, SQUEEZE, STICK, STICK_CLICK, PRIMARY, SECONDARY, MENU, GRIP, ACTION_COUNT };

// Touch controller bindings: the path under /user/hand/<side>/input/ per hand, or null.

constexpr const char* HANDS[2] = {"left", "right"};

// Eye images move from the render thread to the headset thread through these. One is being written,
// one is the latest recorded frame and one may be held by the headset thread until the GPU is done.
constexpr int STAGING_COUNT = 3;

struct Staging {
	VulkanImage image;
	uint64_t    tick = 0;
	VrPose head; // The head pose the game last read, so the picture can be placed in the world.

State g;

bool Ok(XrResult result, const char* what) {
	if (XR_SUCCEEDED(result)) {
		return true;
	}
	char text[XR_MAX_RESULT_STRING_SIZE] = {};
	xrResultToString(g.instance, result, text);
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("OpenXR: {} failed: {}\n", what, text));
	return false;
}

// Destroying the instance also destroys the session, spaces, swapchain and actions.
void DestroyInstance(const char* reason) {
	if (reason != nullptr) {
		Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(
		    fmt::format("OpenXR: {}; showing the eye image in the window only\n", reason));
	}
	if (g.instance != XR_NULL_HANDLE) {
		xrDestroyInstance(g.instance);
	}
	g.instance = XR_NULL_HANDLE;
	g.session  = XR_NULL_HANDLE;
}

struct Access {
	vk::PipelineStageFlags2 stage;
	vk::AccessFlags2        access;
};

constexpr Access NO_ACCESS {vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eNone, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eNone};
constexpr Access TRANSFER {vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer, vk::AccessFlagBits2::eNone};
constexpr Access TRANSFER_READ {vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer,
                                vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferRead};
constexpr Access TRANSFER_WRITE {vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eTransfer,
                                 vk::AccessFlagBits2::eTransferWrite};
constexpr Access COLOR_ATTACHMENT {vk::PipelineStageFlagBits2::eColorAttachmentOutput,
                                   vk::AccessFlagBits2::eColorAttachmentRead |
                                       vk::AccessFlagBits2::eColorAttachmentWrite};

template <typename Command>
void Barrier(const Command& command, vk::Image image, vk::ImageLayout from, vk::ImageLayout to,
             uint32_t layers, Access src, Access dst) {
	vk::ImageMemoryBarrier2 barrier {};
	barrier.srcStageMask        = src.stage;
	barrier.srcAccessMask       = src.access;
	barrier.dstStageMask        = dst.stage;
	barrier.dstAccessMask       = dst.access;
	barrier.oldLayout           = from;
	barrier.newLayout           = to;
	barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
	barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
	barrier.image               = image;
	barrier.subresourceRange    = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 1, 0, layers};
	vk::DependencyInfo dependency {};
	dependency.imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1;
	dependency.pImageMemoryBarriers    = &barrier;
	command.pipelineBarrier2(dependency);
}

XrQuaternionf Multiply(const XrQuaternionf& a, const XrQuaternionf& b) {
	return {a.w * b.x + a.x * b.w + a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
	        a.w * b.y - a.x * b.z + a.y * b.w + a.z * b.x,
	        a.w * b.z + a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x + a.z * b.w,
	        a.w * b.w - a.x * b.x - a.y * b.y - a.z * b.z};
}

XrVector3f Rotate(const XrQuaternionf& q, const XrVector3f& v) {
	const XrVector3f t {2.0f * (q.y * v.z - q.z * v.y), 2.0f * (q.z * v.x - q.x * v.z),
	                    2.0f * (q.x * v.y - q.y * v.x)};
	return {v.x + q.w * t.x + (q.y * t.z - q.z * t.y), v.y + q.w * t.y + (q.z * t.x - q.x * t.z),
	        v.z + q.w * t.z + (q.x * t.y - q.y * t.x)};
}

VrPose Locate(XrSpace space, XrTime time) {
	VrPose          pose;
	XrSpaceLocation location {XR_TYPE_SPACE_LOCATION};
	if (XR_SUCCEEDED(xrLocateSpace(space, g.local_space, time, &location)) &&
	    (location.locationFlags & XR_SPACE_LOCATION_ORIENTATION_VALID_BIT) != 0) {
		const auto& [q, p] = location.pose;
		pose               = {true, {q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w}, {p.x, p.y, p.z}};
	}
	return pose;
}

// The swapchain stores the eyes in a gamma-encoded format, so a raw copy of the display-encoded
// game image comes out right. Staging uses the same layout with UNORM, which a blit writes from the
// raw UNORM or float presentation frame without conversion.
bool CreateSwapchain() {
	uint32_t count = 0;
	xrEnumerateSwapchainFormats(g.session, 0, &count, nullptr);
	std::vector<int64_t> formats(count);
	xrEnumerateSwapchainFormats(g.session, count, &count, formats.data());
	constexpr std::pair<vk::Format, vk::Format> candidates[] = {
	    {vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Srgb, vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Unorm},
	    {vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Srgb, vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Unorm},
	    {vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Unorm, vk::Format::eR8G8B8A8Unorm},
	    {vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Unorm, vk::Format::eB8G8R8A8Unorm},
	};
	const auto* format =
	    std::find_if(std::begin(candidates), std::end(candidates), [&](const auto& c) {
		    return std::find(formats.begin(), formats.end(), static_cast<int64_t>(c.first)) !=
			       formats.end();
	    });
	if (format == std::end(candidates)) {
		return false;
	}
	XrSwapchainCreateInfo info {XR_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO};
	info.usageFlags = XR_SWAPCHAIN_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | XR_SWAPCHAIN_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
	info.format     = static_cast<int64_t>(format->first);
	info.sampleCount = 1;
	info.width       = g.eye.width;
	info.height      = g.eye.height;
	info.faceCount   = 1;
	info.arraySize   = 2;
	info.mipCount    = 1;
	if (!Ok(xrCreateSwapchain(g.session, &info, &g.swapchain), "xrCreateSwapchain")) {
		return false;
	}
	xrEnumerateSwapchainImages(g.swapchain, 0, &count, nullptr);
	g.swapchain_images.assign(count, {XR_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGE_VULKAN_KHR});
	xrEnumerateSwapchainImages(
	    g.swapchain, count, &count,
	    reinterpret_cast<XrSwapchainImageBaseHeader*>(g.swapchain_images.data()));

	vk::ImageCreateInfo staging {};
	staging.imageType   = vk::ImageType::e2D;
	staging.format      = format->second;
	staging.extent      = vk::Extent3D {g.eye.width * 2, g.eye.height, 1};
	staging.mipLevels   = 1;
	staging.arrayLayers = 1;
	staging.samples     = vk::SampleCountFlagBits::e1;
	staging.tiling      = vk::ImageTiling::eOptimal;
	staging.usage = vk::ImageUsageFlagBits::eTransferSrc | vk::ImageUsageFlagBits::eTransferDst;
	for (auto& slot: g.staging) {
		if (!g.graphics->CreateImage(staging, slot.image)) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("OpenXR: eye swapchain {}x{} {}\n", g.eye.width,
	                                      g.eye.height, vk::to_string(format->first)));
	return true;
}

bool CreateInput() {
	XrActionSetCreateInfo set {XR_TYPE_ACTION_SET_CREATE_INFO};
	std::strcpy(set.actionSetName, "gameplay");
	std::strcpy(set.localizedActionSetName, "Gameplay");
	if (!Ok(xrCreateActionSet(g.instance, &set, &g.action_set), "xrCreateActionSet")) {
		return false;
	}
	for (int hand = 0; hand < 2; hand++) {
		xrStringToPath(g.instance, fmt::format("/user/hand/{}", HANDS[hand]).c_str(),
		               &g.hand_path[hand]);
	}
	std::vector<XrActionSuggestedBinding> bindings;
	for (int i = 0; i < ACTION_COUNT; i++) {
		XrActionCreateInfo info {XR_TYPE_ACTION_CREATE_INFO};
		info.actionType          = ACTIONS[i].type;
		info.countSubactionPaths = 2;
		info.subactionPaths      = g.hand_path;
		std::strcpy(info.actionName, ACTIONS[i].name);
		std::strcpy(info.localizedActionName, ACTIONS[i].name);
		if (!Ok(xrCreateAction(g.action_set, &info, &g.actions[i]), "xrCreateAction")) {
			return false;
		}
		for (int hand = 0; hand < 2; hand++) {
			if (ACTIONS[i].path[hand] != nullptr) {
				XrPath path = XR_NULL_PATH;
				xrStringToPath(
				    g.instance,
				    fmt::format("/user/hand/{}/input/{}", HANDS[hand], ACTIONS[i].path[hand])
				        .c_str(),
				    &path);
				bindings.push_back({g.actions[i], path});
			}
		}
	}
	XrInteractionProfileSuggestedBinding suggested {XR_TYPE_INTERACTION_PROFILE_SUGGESTED_BINDING};
	xrStringToPath(g.instance, "/interaction_profiles/oculus/touch_controller",
	               &suggested.interactionProfile);
	suggested.countSuggestedBindings = static_cast<uint32_t>(bindings.size());
	suggested.suggestedBindings      = bindings.data();
	XrSessionActionSetsAttachInfo attach {XR_TYPE_SESSION_ACTION_SETS_ATTACH_INFO};
	attach.countActionSets = 1;
	attach.actionSets      = &g.action_set;
	if (!Ok(xrSuggestInteractionProfileBindings(g.instance, &suggested), "suggest bindings") ||
	    !Ok(xrAttachSessionActionSets(g.session, &attach), "attach action sets")) {
		return false;
	}
	for (int hand = 0; hand < 2; hand++) {
		XrActionSpaceCreateInfo space {XR_TYPE_ACTION_SPACE_CREATE_INFO};
		space.action            = g.actions[GRIP];
		space.subactionPath     = g.hand_path[hand];
		space.poseInActionSpace = {{0, 0, 0, 1}, {0, 0, 0}};
		if (!Ok(xrCreateActionSpace(g.session, &space, &g.grip_space[hand]), "grip space")) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

// The head is tracked while the frame loop runs; the controllers only while the session has focus.
void PollInput(XrTime time) {
	const auto        head = Locate(g.view_space, time);
	VrControllerInput input[2];
	XrActiveActionSet active {g.action_set, XR_NULL_PATH};
	XrActionsSyncInfo sync {XR_TYPE_ACTIONS_SYNC_INFO};
	sync.countActiveActionSets = 1;
	sync.activeActionSets      = &active;
	if (g.action_set != XR_NULL_HANDLE && g.session_state == XR_SESSION_STATE_FOCUSED &&
	    XR_SUCCEEDED(xrSyncActions(g.session, &sync))) {
		for (int hand = 0; hand < 2; hand++) {
			const auto get = [&](Action action, auto read, auto state) {
				XrActionStateGetInfo info {XR_TYPE_ACTION_STATE_GET_INFO};
				info.action        = g.actions[action];
				info.subactionPath = g.hand_path[hand];
				read(g.session, &info, &state);
				return state;
			};
			const auto value = [&](Action action) {
				return get(action, xrGetActionStateFloat,
				           XrActionStateFloat {XR_TYPE_ACTION_STATE_FLOAT})
				    .currentState;
			};
			const auto flag = [&](Action action) {
				return get(action, xrGetActionStateBoolean,
				           XrActionStateBoolean {XR_TYPE_ACTION_STATE_BOOLEAN})
				           .currentState == XR_TRUE;
			};
			const auto stick = get(STICK, xrGetActionStateVector2f,
			                       XrActionStateVector2f {XR_TYPE_ACTION_STATE_VECTOR2F});
			auto&      out   = input[hand];
			out.trigger      = value(TRIGGER);
			out.squeeze      = value(SQUEEZE);
			out.stick_x      = stick.currentState.x;
			out.stick_y      = stick.currentState.y;
			out.stick_click  = flag(STICK_CLICK);
			out.primary      = flag(PRIMARY);
			out.secondary    = flag(SECONDARY);
			out.menu         = flag(MENU);
			out.pose         = Locate(g.grip_space[hand], time);
			out.connected =
			    get(GRIP, xrGetActionStatePose, XrActionStatePose {XR_TYPE_ACTION_STATE_POSE})
			        .isActive == XR_TRUE;
		}
	}
	std::lock_guard lock(g.input_mutex);
	g.head     = head;
	g.input[0] = input[0];
	g.input[1] = input[1];
}

void HandleEvents() {
	for (XrEventDataBuffer event {XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_BUFFER};
	     xrPollEvent(g.instance, &event) == XR_SUCCESS; event = {XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_BUFFER}) {
		if (event.type == XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_INSTANCE_LOSS_PENDING) {
			g.running = false;
			continue;
		}
		if (event.type != XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_SESSION_STATE_CHANGED) {
			continue;
		}
		g.session_state = reinterpret_cast<const XrEventDataSessionStateChanged&>(event).state;
		LOGF("OpenXR: session state %d\n", static_cast<int>(g.session_state));
		switch (g.session_state) {
			case XR_SESSION_STATE_READY: {
				XrSessionBeginInfo begin {XR_TYPE_SESSION_BEGIN_INFO};
				begin.primaryViewConfigurationType = XR_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_TYPE_PRIMARY_STEREO;
				g.session_running = Ok(xrBeginSession(g.session, &begin), "xrBeginSession");
				break;
			}
			case XR_SESSION_STATE_STOPPING: {
				xrEndSession(g.session);
				g.session_running = false;
				std::lock_guard lock(g.input_mutex);
				g.head     = {};
				g.input[0] = {};
				g.input[1] = {};
				break;
			}
			case XR_SESSION_STATE_EXITING:
			case XR_SESSION_STATE_LOSS_PENDING: g.running = false; break;
			default: break;
		}
	}
}

bool CopyToSwapchain(const VulkanImage& staging) {
	uint32_t                    image = 0;
	XrSwapchainImageAcquireInfo acquire {XR_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGE_ACQUIRE_INFO};
	{
		Common::LockGuard queue_lock(g.graphics->queue_mutex);
		if (!Ok(xrAcquireSwapchainImage(g.swapchain, &acquire, &image), "acquire")) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	XrSwapchainImageWaitInfo wait {XR_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGE_WAIT_INFO};
	wait.timeout = XR_INFINITE_DURATION;
	bool copied  = Ok(xrWaitSwapchainImage(g.swapchain, &wait), "wait swapchain image");
	if (copied) {
		const auto target = g.swapchain_images[image].image;
		(void)g.command.reset();
		vk::CommandBufferBeginInfo begin {};
		begin.flags = vk::CommandBufferUsageFlagBits::eOneTimeSubmit;
		(void)g.command.begin(&begin);
		Barrier(g.command, target, vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined,
		        vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal, 2, NO_ACCESS, TRANSFER_WRITE);
		vk::ImageCopy copies[2] {};
		for (uint32_t eye = 0; eye < 2; eye++) {
			copies[eye].srcSubresource = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 0, 1};
			copies[eye].srcOffset = vk::Offset3D {static_cast<int32_t>(eye * g.eye.width), 0, 0};
			copies[eye].dstSubresource = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, eye, 1};
			copies[eye].extent         = vk::Extent3D {g.eye.width, g.eye.height, 1};
		}
		g.command.copyImage(staging.image, vk::ImageLayout::eTransferSrcOptimal, target,
		                    vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal, 2, copies);
		Barrier(g.command, target, vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal,
		        vk::ImageLayout::eColorAttachmentOptimal, 2, TRANSFER_WRITE, COLOR_ATTACHMENT);
		(void)g.command.end();
		vk::SubmitInfo submit {};
		submit.commandBufferCount = 1;
		submit.pCommandBuffers    = &g.command;
		(void)g.graphics->device.resetFences(1, &g.fence);
		vk::Result result {};
		{
			Common::LockGuard queue_lock(g.graphics->queue_mutex);
			result = g.graphics->queue.submit(1, &submit, g.fence);
		}
		copied = result == vk::Result::eSuccess &&
		         g.graphics->device.waitForFences(1, &g.fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX) ==
		             vk::Result::eSuccess;
	}
	XrSwapchainImageReleaseInfo release {XR_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGE_RELEASE_INFO};
	Common::LockGuard           queue_lock(g.graphics->queue_mutex);
	return Ok(xrReleaseSwapchainImage(g.swapchain, &release), "release") && copied;
}

// Holds the newest recorded eye image until the GPU has finished it, without waiting, then copies
// it into the swapchain. The swapchain keeps the last copy, so frames in between show it again.
bool UpdateSwapchain() {
	int              index     = -1;
	MasterSemaphore* semaphore = nullptr;
	{
		std::lock_guard lock(g.mutex);
		if (g.held < 0 && g.latest >= 0 && g.staging[g.latest].tick != g.shown_tick) {
			g.held = g.latest;
		}
		index     = g.held;
		semaphore = g.semaphore;
	}
	if (index >= 0) {
		const auto& slot = g.staging[index];
		semaphore->Refresh();
		if (semaphore->IsFree(slot.tick)) {
			if (CopyToSwapchain(slot.image)) {
				g.shown_tick = slot.tick;
				g.shown_head = slot.head;
			}
			std::lock_guard lock(g.mutex);
			g.held = -1;
		}
	}
	return g.shown_tick != 0;
}

// The game drew the picture for the head pose it read, so it is placed in the world at that pose
// and the runtime reprojects it as the head moves. Eye offsets come from the runtime.
void PlaceViews(XrTime time, XrCompositionLayerProjection& layer,
                XrCompositionLayerProjectionView (&views)[2]) {
	XrViewLocateInfo locate {XR_TYPE_VIEW_LOCATE_INFO};
	locate.viewConfigurationType = XR_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_TYPE_PRIMARY_STEREO;
	locate.displayTime           = time;
	locate.space                 = g.view_space;
	XrViewState state {XR_TYPE_VIEW_STATE};
	XrView      located[2] {{XR_TYPE_VIEW}, {XR_TYPE_VIEW}};
	uint32_t    count = 0;
	const bool  valid =
	    XR_SUCCEEDED(xrLocateViews(g.session, &locate, &state, 2, &count, located)) &&
	    (state.viewStateFlags & XR_VIEW_STATE_POSITION_VALID_BIT) != 0;
	const auto&         head = g.shown_head;
	const XrQuaternionf head_q {head.orientation[0], head.orientation[1], head.orientation[2],
	                            head.orientation[3]};
	const XrVector3f    head_p {head.position[0], head.position[1], head.position[2]};
	// The outer side of each eye is its temporal side: left for the left eye.
	const float out    = std::atan(Hmd2::FOV_TAN_OUT);
	const float in     = std::atan(Hmd2::FOV_TAN_IN);
	const float top    = std::atan(Hmd2::FOV_TAN_TOP);
	const float bottom = std::atan(Hmd2::FOV_TAN_BOTTOM);
	for (int eye = 0; eye < 2; eye++) {
		const float side = eye == 0 ? -Hmd2::EYE_OFFSET_M : Hmd2::EYE_OFFSET_M;
		auto&       view = views[eye];
		view.pose        = valid ? located[eye].pose : XrPosef {{0, 0, 0, 1}, {side, 0, 0}};
		if (head.valid) {
			const auto offset     = Rotate(head_q, view.pose.position);
			view.pose.position    = {head_p.x + offset.x, head_p.y + offset.y, head_p.z + offset.z};
			view.pose.orientation = Multiply(head_q, view.pose.orientation);
		}
		view.fov                = {eye == 0 ? -out : -in, eye == 0 ? in : out, top, -bottom};
		view.subImage.swapchain = g.swapchain;
		view.subImage.imageRect = {
		    {0, 0}, {static_cast<int32_t>(g.eye.width), static_cast<int32_t>(g.eye.height)}};
		view.subImage.imageArrayIndex = static_cast<uint32_t>(eye);
	}
	layer.space     = head.valid ? g.local_space : g.view_space;
	layer.viewCount = 2;
	layer.views     = views;
}

void ThreadMain() {
	while (g.running) {
		HandleEvents();
		XrFrameWaitInfo wait {XR_TYPE_FRAME_WAIT_INFO};
		XrFrameState    frame {XR_TYPE_FRAME_STATE};
		if (!g.session_running || !Ok(xrWaitFrame(g.session, &wait, &frame), "xrWaitFrame")) {
			std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
			continue;
		}
		PollInput(frame.predictedDisplayTime);
		XrFrameBeginInfo begin {XR_TYPE_FRAME_BEGIN_INFO};
		{
			Common::LockGuard queue_lock(g.graphics->queue_mutex);
			if (!Ok(xrBeginFrame(g.session, &begin), "xrBeginFrame")) {
				continue;
			}
		}
		XrCompositionLayerProjection     layer {XR_TYPE_COMPOSITION_LAYER_PROJECTION};
		XrCompositionLayerProjectionView views[2] {{XR_TYPE_COMPOSITION_LAYER_PROJECTION_VIEW},
		                                           {XR_TYPE_COMPOSITION_LAYER_PROJECTION_VIEW}};
		const auto*    layers = reinterpret_cast<const XrCompositionLayerBaseHeader*>(&layer);
		XrFrameEndInfo end {XR_TYPE_FRAME_END_INFO};
		end.displayTime          = frame.predictedDisplayTime;
		end.environmentBlendMode = XR_ENVIRONMENT_BLEND_MODE_OPAQUE;
		if (frame.shouldRender == XR_TRUE && UpdateSwapchain()) {
			PlaceViews(frame.predictedDisplayTime, layer, views);
			end.layerCount = 1;
			end.layers     = &layers;
		}
		Common::LockGuard queue_lock(g.graphics->queue_mutex);
		(void)Ok(xrEndFrame(g.session, &end), "xrEndFrame");
	}
}

} // namespace

void OpenXrInit() {
	if (!Config::VrEnabled()) {
		return;
	}
	if (const char* env = std::getenv("KYTY_OPENXR");
	    env != nullptr && std::strcmp(env, "0") == 0) {
		return;
	}
	const char*          extensions[] = {XR_KHR_VULKAN_ENABLE_EXTENSION_NAME};
	XrInstanceCreateInfo info {XR_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
	std::strcpy(info.applicationInfo.applicationName, "KytyPS5");
	std::strcpy(info.applicationInfo.engineName, "Kyty");
	info.applicationInfo.apiVersion = XR_API_VERSION_1_0;
	info.enabledExtensionCount      = 1;
	info.enabledExtensionNames      = extensions;
	if (XR_FAILED(xrCreateInstance(&info, &g.instance))) {
		DestroyInstance("no runtime available");
		return;
	}
	XrSystemGetInfo system {XR_TYPE_SYSTEM_GET_INFO};
	system.formFactor = XR_FORM_FACTOR_HEAD_MOUNTED_DISPLAY;
	if (XR_FAILED(xrGetSystem(g.instance, &system, &g.system))) {
		DestroyInstance("no headset available");
		return;
	}
	PFN_xrGetVulkanGraphicsRequirementsKHR get_requirements = nullptr;
	PFN_xrGetVulkanInstanceExtensionsKHR   get_extensions[2] {};
	xrGetInstanceProcAddr(g.instance, "xrGetVulkanGraphicsRequirementsKHR",
	                      reinterpret_cast<PFN_xrVoidFunction*>(&get_requirements));
	xrGetInstanceProcAddr(g.instance, "xrGetVulkanInstanceExtensionsKHR",
	                      reinterpret_cast<PFN_xrVoidFunction*>(&get_extensions[0]));
	// Both queries share one signature.
	xrGetInstanceProcAddr(g.instance, "xrGetVulkanDeviceExtensionsKHR",
	                      reinterpret_cast<PFN_xrVoidFunction*>(&get_extensions[1]));
	xrGetInstanceProcAddr(g.instance, "xrGetVulkanGraphicsDeviceKHR",
	                      reinterpret_cast<PFN_xrVoidFunction*>(&g.get_graphics_device));
	XrGraphicsRequirementsVulkanKHR requirements {XR_TYPE_GRAPHICS_REQUIREMENTS_VULKAN_KHR};
	if (get_requirements == nullptr || get_extensions[0] == nullptr ||
	    get_extensions[1] == nullptr || g.get_graphics_device == nullptr ||
	    XR_FAILED(get_requirements(g.instance, g.system, &requirements))) {
		DestroyInstance("the runtime does not support XR_KHR_vulkan_enable");
		return;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
		uint32_t size = 0;
		get_extensions[i](g.instance, g.system, 0, &size, nullptr);
		std::string names(size, '\0');
		get_extensions[i](g.instance, g.system, size, &size, names.data());
		g.extensions[i] = Common::Split(names.c_str(), ' ');
	}
	XrViewConfigurationView views[2] {{XR_TYPE_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_VIEW},
	                                  {XR_TYPE_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_VIEW}};
	uint32_t                count = 0;
	xrEnumerateViewConfigurationViews(g.instance, g.system,
	                                  XR_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_TYPE_PRIMARY_STEREO, 2, &count, views);
	g.eye = {views[0].recommendedImageRectWidth, views[0].recommendedImageRectHeight};
	XrSystemProperties properties {XR_TYPE_SYSTEM_PROPERTIES};
	xrGetSystemProperties(g.instance, g.system, &properties);
	Log::WriteToConsoleAndLog(fmt::format("OpenXR: headset '{}' ready\n", properties.systemName));
}

void OpenXrAppendExtensions(std::vector<const char*>&                   out,
                            const std::vector<vk::ExtensionProperties>& available, bool device) {
	if (g.instance == XR_NULL_HANDLE) {
		return;
	}
	for (const auto& name: g.extensions[device ? 1 : 0]) {
		const auto same = [&](const char* other) { return name == other; };
		if (std::any_of(available.begin(), available.end(),
		                [&](const auto& extension) { return same(extension.extensionName); }) &&
		    std::none_of(out.begin(), out.end(), same)) {
			out.push_back(name.c_str());
		}
	}
}

bool OpenXrPhysicalDevice(vk::Instance instance, vk::PhysicalDevice& out) {
	VkPhysicalDevice device = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	if (g.instance == XR_NULL_HANDLE ||
	    XR_FAILED(g.get_graphics_device(g.instance, g.system, static_cast<VkInstance>(instance),
	                                    &device))) {
		return false;
	}
	out = vk::PhysicalDevice(device);
	return true;
}

void OpenXrStartSession(GraphicContext& graphics) {
	if (g.instance == XR_NULL_HANDLE) {
		return;
	}
	// The runtime must be asked for its GPU before a session is created.
	vk::PhysicalDevice required;
	if (!OpenXrPhysicalDevice(graphics.instance, required) ||
	    required != graphics.physical_device) {
		DestroyInstance("the headset runs on another GPU; select it with --gpu-index");
		return;
	}
	g.graphics = &graphics;
	XrGraphicsBindingVulkanKHR binding {XR_TYPE_GRAPHICS_BINDING_VULKAN_KHR};
	binding.instance         = static_cast<VkInstance>(graphics.instance);
	binding.physicalDevice   = static_cast<VkPhysicalDevice>(graphics.physical_device);
	binding.device           = static_cast<VkDevice>(graphics.device);
	binding.queueFamilyIndex = graphics.queue_family;
	binding.queueIndex       = 0;
	XrSessionCreateInfo info {XR_TYPE_SESSION_CREATE_INFO};
	info.next     = &binding;
	info.systemId = g.system;
	XrReferenceSpaceCreateInfo space {XR_TYPE_REFERENCE_SPACE_CREATE_INFO};
	space.poseInReferenceSpace = {{0, 0, 0, 1}, {0, 0, 0}};
	const auto reference       = [&](XrReferenceSpaceType type, XrSpace& out) {
		space.referenceSpaceType = type;
		return Ok(xrCreateReferenceSpace(g.session, &space, &out), "xrCreateReferenceSpace");
	};
	if (!Ok(xrCreateSession(g.instance, &info, &g.session), "xrCreateSession") ||
	    !reference(XR_REFERENCE_SPACE_TYPE_VIEW, g.view_space) ||
	    !reference(XR_REFERENCE_SPACE_TYPE_LOCAL, g.local_space) || !CreateSwapchain()) {
		DestroyInstance("the headset session could not be created");
		return;
	}
	if (!CreateInput()) {
		g.action_set = XR_NULL_HANDLE;
	}
	vk::CommandPoolCreateInfo pool {};
	pool.queueFamilyIndex = graphics.queue_family;
	pool.flags            = vk::CommandPoolCreateFlagBits::eResetCommandBuffer;
	(void)graphics.device.createCommandPool(&pool, nullptr, &g.pool);
	vk::CommandBufferAllocateInfo allocate {};
	allocate.commandPool        = g.pool;
	allocate.level              = vk::CommandBufferLevel::ePrimary;
	allocate.commandBufferCount = 1;
	(void)graphics.device.allocateCommandBuffers(&allocate, &g.command);
	vk::FenceCreateInfo fence {};
	(void)graphics.device.createFence(&fence, nullptr, &g.fence);

	g.running = true;
	g.thread  = std::thread(ThreadMain);
}

void OpenXrShutdown() {
	g.running = false;
	if (g.thread.joinable()) {
		g.thread.join();
	}
	DestroyInstance(nullptr);
	if (g.graphics == nullptr) {
		return;
	}
	{
		Common::LockGuard queue_lock(g.graphics->queue_mutex);
		(void)g.graphics->device.waitIdle();
	}
	for (auto& slot: g.staging) {
		if (slot.image.image != nullptr) {
			g.graphics->DeleteImage(slot.image);
		}
	}
	g.graphics->device.destroyFence(g.fence, nullptr);
	g.graphics->device.destroyCommandPool(g.pool, nullptr);
	g.graphics = nullptr;
}

VrPose OpenXrGetHeadPose() {
	if (!g.running) {
		return {};
	}
	std::lock_guard lock(g.input_mutex);
	if (g.head.valid) {
		g.last_head_read = g.head;
	}
	return g.head;
}

VrControllerInput OpenXrGetController(int hand) {
	if (!g.running) {
		return {};
	}
	std::lock_guard lock(g.input_mutex);
	return g.input[hand];
}

void OpenXrQueueEyeSource(CommandBuffer& command, const VulkanImage& source) {
	if (!g.running) {
		return;
	}
	std::lock_guard lock(g.mutex);
	int             index = 0;
	while (index == g.held || index == g.latest) {
		index++;
	}
	auto&      slot       = g.staging[index];
	const auto vk_command = command.Handle();
	Barrier(vk_command, slot.image.image, vk::ImageLayout::eUndefined,
	        vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal, 1, TRANSFER, TRANSFER_WRITE);
	vk::ImageBlit blit {};
	blit.srcSubresource = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 0, 1};
	blit.srcOffsets[1]  = vk::Offset3D {static_cast<int32_t>(source.extent.width),
	                                    static_cast<int32_t>(source.extent.height), 1};
	blit.dstSubresource = {vk::ImageAspectFlagBits::eColor, 0, 0, 1};
	blit.dstOffsets[1]  = vk::Offset3D {static_cast<int32_t>(slot.image.extent.width),
	                                    static_cast<int32_t>(slot.image.extent.height), 1};
	vk_command.blitImage(source.image, vk::ImageLayout::eTransferSrcOptimal, slot.image.image,
	                     vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal, 1, &blit, vk::Filter::eLinear);
	Barrier(vk_command, slot.image.image, vk::ImageLayout::eTransferDstOptimal,
	        vk::ImageLayout::eTransferSrcOptimal, 1, TRANSFER_WRITE, TRANSFER_READ);
	auto& scheduler = command.GetContext().GetCommandScheduler();
	slot.tick       = scheduler.CurrentTick();
	g.semaphore     = &scheduler.GetMasterSemaphore();
	g.latest        = index;
	std::lock_guard input_lock(g.input_mutex);
	slot.head = g.last_head_read;
}

} // namespace Libs::Vr
```

```h
#include "graphics/host_gpu/vulkanCommon.h"

namespace Libs::Graphics {
struct GraphicContext;
struct VulkanImage;
class CommandBuffer;
} // namespace Libs::Graphics

// Output to a real headset through OpenXR. Everything here is inert unless the virtual headset is
// enabled (--vr) and an OpenXR runtime with a headset is available; KYTY_OPENXR=0 turns it off.
namespace Libs::Vr {

// Creates the OpenXR instance. Call before the Vulkan instance exists, because the runtime names
// the Vulkan extensions and the GPU it needs.
void OpenXrInit();

// Appends the Vulkan instance or device extensions the runtime needs, when available.
void OpenXrAppendExtensions(std::vector<const char*>&                   out,
                            const std::vector<vk::ExtensionProperties>& available, bool device);

// The physical device the runtime renders with. False when OpenXR is not in use.
bool OpenXrPhysicalDevice(vk::Instance instance, vk::PhysicalDevice& out);

// Creates the session and starts the headset thread. Call once the device and queue exist.
void OpenXrStartSession(Graphics::GraphicContext& graphics);

// Stops the headset thread and destroys the session. Call before the device is destroyed.
void OpenXrShutdown();

// Render thread, headset flips only: scales the side-by-side eye image into a staging image for the
// headset thread. The source is in transfer-source layout.
void OpenXrQueueEyeSource(Graphics::CommandBuffer& command, const Graphics::VulkanImage& source);

} // namespace Libs::Vr

#endif // EMULATOR_SRC_GRAPHICS_PRESENTATION_OPENXRHEADSET_H_
```
