`src/graphics/shader/recompiler/Tessellation.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/Tessellation.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ShaderRecompiler.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/frontend/decode/ShaderDecoder.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/ShaderIR.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/passes/ConstantPropagation.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/passes/DeadCodeElimination.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <optional>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>

#include <cstdio>
#define TESS_LOG(...) do { LOGF(__VA_ARGS__); std::fprintf(stderr, "[tess] " __VA_ARGS__); } while (0)

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler {
namespace {

struct TessellationAddress {
	enum class Kind { Unknown, Affine, PackedControlPoint };
	Kind     kind        = Kind::Unknown;
	uint32_t coefficient = 0;
	uint32_t constant    = 0;

	bool operator==(const TessellationAddress&) const = default;
};

// An HS store to the control-point ring, by pc: its address register and immediate offset.
struct TessellationStore {
	TessellationAddress address;
	uint32_t            offset = 0;
	uint32_t            bytes  = 0;
};
using TessellationStores = std::unordered_map<uint32_t, TessellationStore>;

// The integer operations ReflectTessellationLayout follows: they write only their VGPR.
bool IsAddressOpcode(Decoder::Opcode opcode) {
	using Decoder::Opcode;
	switch (opcode) {
		case Opcode::V_BFE_U32:
		case Opcode::V_AND_B32:
		case Opcode::V_ADD_NC_U32:
		case Opcode::V_MUL_LO_U32:
		case Opcode::V_MUL_U32_U24:
		case Opcode::V_MAD_U32_U24:
		case Opcode::V_LSHL_ADD_U32:
		case Opcode::V_LSHLREV_B32:
		case Opcode::V_SUB_NC_U32: return true;
		default: return false;
	}
}

// Reflects the LS output stride, or the HS output stride and patch constant range.
// With `ordinal_stores`, it only collects the HS ring stores, with the patch ordinal (the low
// byte of the packed HS ID) as the variable of their addresses instead of the control point.
void ReflectTessellationLayout(const Decoder::Program& program, bool local,
                               ShaderTessellationInputInfo& info,
                               TessellationStores*          ordinal_stores = nullptr) {
	using namespace Decoder;
	using Address   = TessellationAddress;
	using Kind      = Address::Kind;
	using Registers = std::array<Address, IR::NumVectorRegs>;

	const auto control_points = local ? info.input_control_points : info.output_control_points;
	const bool ordinal        = ordinal_stores != nullptr;
	// The largest value of the variable: the last control point, or the last patch ordinal.
	const auto variable_max = ordinal ? 0xffu : control_points - 1u;
	TessellationStores walked;
	auto&              stores = ordinal ? *ordinal_stores : walked;
	Registers  entry {}, registers;
	entry[local ? 3u : 1u] =
	    local ? Address {Kind::Affine, 1u, 0u} : Address {Kind::PackedControlPoint};
	const auto constant = [](uint32_t value) { return Address {Kind::Affine, 0u, value}; };
	const auto patch    = [&] { return ordinal ? Address {Kind::Affine, 1u, 0u} : constant(0u); };
	// By patch ordinal, the scalar constants it is multiplied by (s_movk_i32 vcc_lo, 0xd0 in
	// Nightreign's HS f00136a119cad6b0); folded to 0, the ordinal gives 0 whatever the scalar.
	// One holds from the s_mov that sets it until a join, or until an instruction that may write
	// scalar registers other than a scalar load's own.
	std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> scalars;
	const auto scalar_key = [](const Operand& operand) -> std::optional<uint32_t> {
		if (operand.kind != OperandKind::Sgpr && operand.kind != OperandKind::VccLo &&
		    operand.kind != OperandKind::VccHi)
			return std::nullopt;
		return static_cast<uint32_t>(operand.kind) << 8u | operand.reg;
	};
	const auto read = [&](const Operand& operand) -> Address {
		if (operand.absolute || operand.negate || operand.sdwa_sext || operand.op_sel ||
		    operand.op_sel_hi || operand.negate_hi || operand.dpp)
			return {};
		Address value;
		if (operand.kind == OperandKind::IntegerInlineConstant ||
		    operand.kind == OperandKind::LiteralConstant) {
			value = constant(operand.value);
		} else if (operand.kind == OperandKind::Vgpr) {
			value = registers.at(operand.reg);
		} else if (const auto key = scalar_key(operand); ordinal && key) {
			if (const auto found = scalars.find(*key); found != scalars.end())
				value = constant(found->second);
		}
		// The native packed HS ID's low byte is the patch ordinal. The logical
		// interface addresses one patch, as in the frontend's v1 initialization.
		if (value.kind == Kind::PackedControlPoint && operand.sdwa_sel == 0u) return patch();
		return operand.sdwa_sel == 6u ? value : Address {};
	};
	const auto affine = [](uint64_t coefficient, uint64_t offset) {
		return coefficient <= UINT32_MAX && offset <= UINT32_MAX
		           ? Address {Kind::Affine, static_cast<uint32_t>(coefficient),
		                      static_cast<uint32_t>(offset)}
		           : Address {};
	};
	const auto add = [&](Address lhs, Address rhs) {
		return lhs.kind == Kind::Affine && rhs.kind == Kind::Affine
		           ? affine(uint64_t {lhs.coefficient} + rhs.coefficient,
		                    uint64_t {lhs.constant} + rhs.constant)
		           : Address {};
	};
	const auto multiply = [&](Address lhs, Address rhs) {
		if ((lhs.kind == Kind::Affine && lhs.coefficient == 0u && lhs.constant == 0u) ||
		    (rhs.kind == Kind::Affine && rhs.coefficient == 0u && rhs.constant == 0u))
			return constant(0u);
		if (lhs.kind != Kind::Affine || rhs.kind != Kind::Affine) return Address {};
		if (rhs.coefficient != 0u) std::swap(lhs, rhs);
		return rhs.coefficient == 0u ? affine(uint64_t {lhs.coefficient} * rhs.constant,
		                                      uint64_t {lhs.constant} * rhs.constant)
		                             : Address {};
	};
	const auto low24 = [&](Address value) {
		if (value.kind == Kind::Affine && value.coefficient == 0u)
			return constant(value.constant & 0xffffffu);
		return value.kind == Kind::Affine &&
		               uint64_t {value.coefficient} * variable_max + value.constant <= 0xffffffu
		           ? value
		           : Address {};
	};
	// A branch joins its target with the fallthrough path. Definitions that differ between
	// the paths are unknown there. Loop headers repeat the walk until back edges are stable.
	std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Registers> joins, loops;
	const auto merge = [](Registers& into, const Registers& from) {
		bool changed = false;
		for (uint32_t index = 0; index < into.size(); index++) {
			if (into[index] == from[index]) continue;
			changed |= into[index] != Address {};
			into[index] = {};
		}
		return changed;
	};

	uint32_t stride = 0, patch_begin = UINT32_MAX, patch_end = 0;
	for (bool repeat = true; repeat;) {
		repeat    = false;
		registers = entry;
		scalars.clear();
		for (const auto& inst: program.instructions) {
			if (ordinal) {
				const auto key = scalar_key(inst.dst);
				if (joins.contains(inst.pc) || loops.contains(inst.pc)) scalars.clear();
				if ((inst.opcode == Opcode::S_MOVK_I32 || inst.opcode == Opcode::S_MOV_B32) &&
				    key && (inst.src0.kind == OperandKind::IntegerInlineConstant ||
				            inst.src0.kind == OperandKind::LiteralConstant)) {
					scalars.insert_or_assign(*key, inst.src0.value);
				} else if (inst.family == Family::SMEM && inst.dst.kind == OperandKind::Sgpr) {
					for (uint32_t index = 0; index < std::max(inst.data_dwords, 1u); index++) {
						auto dword = inst.dst;
						dword.reg += index;
						scalars.erase(*scalar_key(dword));
					}
				} else if (inst.family != Family::SOPP && inst.family != Family::DS &&
				           inst.family != Family::MUBUF &&
				           !(inst.dst.kind == OperandKind::Vgpr && IsAddressOpcode(inst.opcode))) {
					scalars.clear();
				}
			}
			if (const auto join = joins.find(inst.pc); join != joins.end()) {
				merge(registers, join->second);
				joins.erase(join);
			}
			if (const auto loop = loops.find(inst.pc); loop != loops.end())
				merge(registers, loop->second);
			if (IsDirectBranch(inst.opcode)) {
				const bool back = inst.branch_target <= inst.pc;
				const auto [join, inserted] =
				    (back ? loops : joins).try_emplace(inst.branch_target, registers);
				const bool changed = !inserted && merge(join->second, registers);
				repeat |= back && (inserted || changed);
			}
			const bool local_store  = IsDsWriteOpcode(inst.opcode);
			const bool buffer_store = inst.opcode == Opcode::BUFFER_STORE_DWORD ||
			                          inst.opcode == Opcode::BUFFER_STORE_DWORDX2 ||
			                          inst.opcode == Opcode::BUFFER_STORE_DWORDX3 ||
			                          inst.opcode == Opcode::BUFFER_STORE_DWORDX4;
			const bool control_store = !local && buffer_store &&
			                           inst.src2.kind == OperandKind::Sgpr && inst.src2.reg == 2u;
			if ((local && local_store) || control_store) {
				const auto address = read(inst.src0);
				if (control_store) {
					stores.insert_or_assign(inst.pc,
					                        TessellationStore {address, inst.offset, 4u * inst.data_dwords});
				}
				if (ordinal) continue;
				if (address.kind != Kind::Affine) {
					EXIT("%s tessellation address is not affine at pc 0x%08x\n",
					     local ? "LS" : "HS", inst.pc);
				}
				if (address.coefficient != 0u) {
					EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED((address.coefficient & 3u) != 0u ||
					                     (stride != 0u && stride != address.coefficient));
					stride = address.coefficient;
				} else if (control_store) {
					// Control-point-independent HS outputs are patch constants.
					const auto begin = address.constant + inst.offset;
					patch_begin      = std::min(patch_begin, begin);
					patch_end        = std::max(patch_end, begin + 4u * inst.data_dwords);
				}
			}
			// Store vdata is a source, despite occupying the decoder's dst field.
			if (local_store || buffer_store || inst.dst.kind != OperandKind::Vgpr) continue;
			const auto lhs   = read(inst.src0);
			const auto rhs   = read(inst.src1);
			const auto third = read(inst.src2);
			Address    value;
			switch (inst.opcode) {
				case Opcode::V_BFE_U32:
					if (lhs.kind == Kind::PackedControlPoint && rhs.kind == Kind::Affine &&
					    rhs.coefficient == 0u && third.kind == Kind::Affine &&
					    third.coefficient == 0u) {
						// By patch ordinal, the control point is the only one, 0.
						if (rhs.constant == 8u && third.constant == 5u)
							value = ordinal ? constant(0u) : Address {Kind::Affine, 1u, 0u};
						if (rhs.constant == 0u && third.constant == 8u) value = patch();
					}
					break;
				case Opcode::V_AND_B32: {
					// The patch ordinal (low byte of the packed HS ID) as an AND instead of a BFE (Wolverine's
					// terrain HS a9f31c39ad53f06c, the title's tree trunk HS): one patch, so 0. Any mask that
					// keeps only bits of that byte gives 0.
					const auto mask_of = [](Address operand) {
						return operand.kind == Kind::Affine && operand.coefficient == 0u &&
						       (operand.constant & ~0xffu) == 0u;
					};
					// By patch ordinal, only the whole byte is the ordinal itself.
					if ((lhs.kind == Kind::PackedControlPoint && mask_of(rhs)) ||
					    (rhs.kind == Kind::PackedControlPoint && mask_of(lhs)))
						value = !ordinal ? constant(0u)
						        : lhs == constant(0xffu) || rhs == constant(0xffu) ? patch()
						                                                         : Address {};
					if ((lhs.kind == Kind::PackedControlPoint && rhs == constant(0x1f00u)) ||
					    (rhs.kind == Kind::PackedControlPoint && lhs == constant(0x1f00u)))
						value = ordinal ? constant(0u) : Address {Kind::Affine, 256u, 0u};
					break;
				}
				case Opcode::V_ADD_NC_U32: value = add(lhs, rhs); break;
				case Opcode::V_MUL_LO_U32: value = multiply(lhs, rhs); break;
				case Opcode::V_MUL_U32_U24: value = multiply(low24(lhs), low24(rhs)); break;
				case Opcode::V_MAD_U32_U24:
					value = add(multiply(low24(lhs), low24(rhs)), third);
					break;
				case Opcode::V_LSHL_ADD_U32:
					if (rhs.kind == Kind::Affine && rhs.coefficient == 0u && rhs.constant < 32u)
						value = add(multiply(lhs, constant(1u << rhs.constant)), third);
					break;
				case Opcode::V_LSHLREV_B32:
					if (lhs.kind == Kind::Affine && lhs.coefficient == 0u && lhs.constant < 32u)
						value = multiply(rhs, constant(1u << lhs.constant));
					break;
				case Opcode::V_SUB_NC_U32:
					if (lhs.kind == Kind::Affine && rhs.kind == Kind::Affine &&
					    lhs.coefficient >= rhs.coefficient && lhs.constant >= rhs.constant)
						value =
						    affine(lhs.coefficient - rhs.coefficient, lhs.constant - rhs.constant);
					break;
				default: break;
			}
			if (inst.dst.sdwa_sel != 6u || inst.dst.op_sel || inst.dst.omod || inst.dst.clamp ||
			    inst.dst.dpp)
				value = {};
			for (uint32_t index = 0;
			     index < std::max(inst.data_dwords, 1u) && inst.dst.reg + index < registers.size();
			     index++) {
				registers[inst.dst.reg + index] = {};
			}
			registers.at(inst.dst.reg) = value;
		}
	}
	if (ordinal) return;
	if (!local && stride == 0u && control_points == 1u) {
		// With one output control point, no HS output address depends on the control point, so the
		// walk above takes the control point's outputs for patch constants too (Nightreign's HS
		// 1554cda5fbe937c4). The patch ordinal separates them: patch P's control point is at
		// P * stride, while its patch constants count down from the end of the ring.
		TessellationStores ordinals;
		ReflectTessellationLayout(program, false, info, &ordinals);
		patch_begin = UINT32_MAX;
		patch_end   = 0;
		for (const auto& [pc, store]: walked) {
			const auto& by_ordinal = ordinals.at(pc).address;
			const auto  begin      = store.address.constant + store.offset;
			if (by_ordinal.kind == Kind::Affine && by_ordinal.coefficient != 0u) {
				EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED((by_ordinal.coefficient & 3u) != 0u ||
				                     (stride != 0u && stride != by_ordinal.coefficient) ||
				                     begin + store.bytes > by_ordinal.coefficient);
				stride = by_ordinal.coefficient;
			} else {
				patch_begin = std::min(patch_begin, begin);
				patch_end   = std::max(patch_end, begin + store.bytes);
			}
		}
	}
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(!joins.empty() || stride == 0u);
	(local ? info.ls_stride : info.hs_stride) = stride;
	if (patch_end != 0u) {
		EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(patch_begin < stride * control_points);
		info.patch_base = patch_begin;
		info.patch_size = patch_end - patch_begin;
	}
}

const IR::Inst* TessellationBufferBase(const IR::Inst& inst) {
	if (IR::BufferAccessOf(inst.GetOpcode()) == IR::BufferAccess::None || inst.NumArgs() <= 3u)
		return nullptr;
	const auto* base = inst.Arg(3).Resolve().TryInstruction();
	return base != nullptr && base->GetOpcode() == IR::ValueOpcode::TessellationBase ? base
	                                                                                 : nullptr;
}

// Whether an access predicate, possibly a conjunction of EXEC masks, implies a condition.
bool Implies(IR::Value predicate, IR::Value condition) {
	predicate = predicate.Resolve();
	if (predicate == condition.Resolve()) return true;
	const auto* inst = predicate.TryInstruction();
	return inst != nullptr && inst->GetOpcode() == IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd &&
	       (Implies(inst->Arg(0), condition) || Implies(inst->Arg(1), condition));
}

IR::Value ActiveAddress(IR::Block& block, IR::Block::iterator before, IR::Value value,
                        IR::Value predicate, std::unordered_map<IR::Inst*, IR::Value>& resolved) {
	using namespace IR;
	value        = value.Resolve();
	auto* source = value.TryInstruction();
	if (source == nullptr) return value;
	if (const auto found = resolved.find(source); found != resolved.end()) return found->second;
	if (source->GetOpcode() == ValueOpcode::SelectU32) {
		return Implies(predicate, source->Arg(0))
		           ? ActiveAddress(block, before, source->Arg(1), predicate, resolved)
		           : value;
	}
	// Pure address arithmetic that stays behind EXEC selects; mul24 lowers to IMul32 of BFEs.
	const auto opcode = source->GetOpcode();
	if (opcode != ValueOpcode::IAdd32 && opcode != ValueOpcode::ISub32 &&
	    opcode != ValueOpcode::IMul32 && opcode != ValueOpcode::BitFieldUExtract)
		return value;
	std::array<Value, 3> args;
	bool                 changed = false;
	for (size_t index = 0; index < source->NumArgs(); index++) {
		args[index] = ActiveAddress(block, before, source->Arg(index), predicate, resolved);
		changed |= args[index] != source->Arg(index).Resolve();
	}
	if (changed) {
		const auto flags = source->Flags<uint64_t>();
		const auto copy =
		    source->NumArgs() == 2u
		        ? block.PrependNewInst(before, opcode, {args[0], args[1]}, flags)
		        : block.PrependNewInst(before, opcode, {args[0], args[1], args[2]}, flags);
		value = Value(&*copy);
	}
	resolved.emplace(source, value);
	return value;
}

} // namespace

bool AnalyzeTessellationPrograms(std::span<const uint32_t> local, std::span<const uint32_t> control,
                                 ShaderTessellationInputInfo& info) {
	const auto       local_program = Decoder::DecodeFrontProgram(local);
	Decoder::Program control_program;
	Decoder::DecodeProgram(control, control_program);
	ReflectTessellationLayout(local_program, true, info);
	ReflectTessellationLayout(control_program, false, info);
	LOGF("Tessellation interface: input_cp=%u output_cp=%u ls_stride=%u hs_stride=%u "
	     "patch_base=0x%x patch_size=%u\n",
	     info.input_control_points, info.output_control_points, info.ls_stride, info.hs_stride,
	     info.patch_base, info.patch_size);
	return true;
}

bool LowerTessellationMemory(IR::Program& program, const CompileOptions& options) {
	using namespace IR;
	if (options.stage != ShaderType::Local && options.stage != ShaderType::TessellationControl &&
	    options.stage != ShaderType::TessellationEvaluation) {
		return true;
	}
	const auto unsupported = [&](const char* what) {
		TESS_LOG("%s tessellation lowering does not model %s\n",
		     options.stage == ShaderType::Local                 ? "LS"
		     : options.stage == ShaderType::TessellationControl ? "HS"
		                                                       : "TES",
		     what);
		return false;
	};
	const auto& tess = options.input_info.vertex->tess;
	// The HS ID is InvocationId << 8; its low byte (the patch ordinal) is 0 for the one patch
	// an invocation group runs. The terrain HS a9f31c39ad53f06c reads it with an AND 0xff or a
	// byte extract, which constant propagation does not fold: fold those to 0 here, so the
	// patch-relative ring and factor addresses become immediates.
	{
		const auto shift_amount = [](const Value& value, uint32_t& amount) {
			const auto* shl = value.Resolve().TryInstruction();
			if (shl == nullptr || shl->GetOpcode() != ValueOpcode::ShiftLeftLogical32 ||
			    !shl->Arg(1).Resolve().IsImmediate())
				return false;
			amount = shl->Arg(1).Resolve().U32();
			return amount < 32u;
		};
		for (auto* block: program.blocks) {
			for (auto& inst: *block) {
				uint32_t amount = 0;
				if (inst.GetOpcode() == ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32) {
					for (uint32_t side = 0; side < 2u; side++) {
						const auto mask = inst.Arg(side).Resolve();
						if (mask.IsImmediate() && shift_amount(inst.Arg(1u - side), amount) &&
						    (mask.U32() >> amount) == 0u) {
							inst.ReplaceUsesWith(Value(0u));
							break;
						}
					}
				} else if (inst.GetOpcode() == ValueOpcode::BitFieldUExtract &&
				           inst.Arg(1).Resolve().IsImmediate() &&
				           inst.Arg(2).Resolve().IsImmediate() &&
				           shift_amount(inst.Arg(0), amount) &&
				           inst.Arg(1).Resolve().U32() + inst.Arg(2).Resolve().U32() <= amount) {
					inst.ReplaceUsesWith(Value(0u));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// Ring addresses can reuse data VGPRs. Their inactive values are irrelevant to
	// a store guarded by the same EXEC predicate, but must remain intact elsewhere.
	for (auto* block: program.blocks) {
		for (auto it = block->begin(); it != block->end(); ++it) {
			if (TessellationBufferBase(*it) == nullptr) continue;
			std::unordered_map<Inst*, Value> resolved;
			it->SetArg(
			    2, ActiveAddress(*block, it, it->Arg(2), it->Arg(it->NumArgs() - 1u), resolved));
		}
	}
	ConstantPropagationPass(program.blocks, program.wave_size);
	uint32_t reads = 0, writes = 0, factors = 0, patches = 0;
	for (auto* block: program.blocks) {
		for (auto it = block->begin(); it != block->end(); ++it) {
			auto&      inst   = *it;
			const auto shared = SharedAccessOf(inst.GetOpcode());
			const auto buffer = BufferAccessOf(inst.GetOpcode());
			if (shared == SharedAccess::None && buffer == BufferAccess::None) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto&           memory = program.memory_info.at(inst.Flags<MemoryFlags>().index);
			bool                  write  = false;
			uint32_t              components = 0;
			TessellationAttribute kind;
			Value                 address, predicate;
			if (shared != SharedAccess::None && memory.kind == ResourceKind::Lds) {
				write = shared == SharedAccess::Write;
				if (memory.data_bits != 32u ||
				    (options.stage == ShaderType::Local
				         ? !write
				         : options.stage != ShaderType::TessellationControl ||
				               shared != SharedAccess::Read)) {
					return unsupported("this LDS access");
				}
				kind       = write ? TessellationAttribute::LocalOutput
				                   : TessellationAttribute::ControlInput;
				components = SharedComponentCount(inst.GetOpcode());
				address    = inst.Arg(0);
				predicate  = inst.Arg(inst.NumArgs() - 1u);
			} else if (buffer != BufferAccess::None && memory.kind == ResourceKind::Buffer) {
				const auto* base = TessellationBufferBase(inst);
				if (base == nullptr) {
					continue;
				}
				if (memory.data_bits != 32u || memory.formatted || memory.idxen || !memory.offen ||
				    buffer == BufferAccess::Atomic) {
					return unsupported("this ring buffer access");
				}
				write      = buffer == BufferAccess::Write;
				components = BufferComponentCount(inst.GetOpcode());
				address    = inst.Arg(2).Resolve();
				predicate  = inst.Arg(inst.NumArgs() - 1u);
				if (base->Arg(0).U32() == 1u) {
					if (!write || options.stage != ShaderType::TessellationControl) {
						return unsupported("a tessellation factor access outside the HS");
					}
					kind = TessellationAttribute::Factor;
					factors += components;
				} else {
					// After its barrier, the HS may read back outputs of other control points.
					const bool output = options.stage == ShaderType::TessellationControl;
					EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(
					    !output && (write || options.stage != ShaderType::TessellationEvaluation));
					kind = output ? TessellationAttribute::ControlOutput
					              : TessellationAttribute::EvaluationInput;
					if (address.IsImmediate() &&
					    address.U32() >= tess.hs_stride * tess.output_control_points) {
						const auto begin = address.U32() + memory.offset;
						EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(begin < tess.patch_base ||
						                     begin + 4u * components >
						                         tess.patch_base + tess.patch_size);
						kind = output ? TessellationAttribute::PatchOutput
						              : TessellationAttribute::PatchInput;
						// HS read-backs must not hide misplaced patch stores from the check below.
						if (write || !output) patches += components;
					}
				}
			} else {
				continue;
			}
			const auto emit = [&](ValueOpcode opcode, std::initializer_list<Value> args) {
				return Value(&*block->PrependNewInst(it, opcode, args));
			};
			std::array<Value, 4> values;
			for (uint32_t component = 0; component < components; component++) {
				const auto offset = memory.offset + 4u * component;
				const auto byte_address =
				    offset == 0u ? address : emit(ValueOpcode::IAdd32, {address, Value(offset)});
				if (write) {
					Value data = shared != SharedAccess::None ? inst.Arg(component + 1u)
					             : components == 1u
					                 ? inst.Arg(4)
					                 : emit(components == 2u   ? ValueOpcode::CompositeExtractU32x2
					                        : components == 3u ? ValueOpcode::CompositeExtractU32x3
					                                           : ValueOpcode::CompositeExtractU32x4,
					                        {inst.Arg(4), Value(component)});
					emit(ValueOpcode::SetTessellationAttribute,
					     {Value(static_cast<uint32_t>(kind)), byte_address, data, predicate});
					writes++;
				} else {
					values[component] =
					    emit(ValueOpcode::GetTessellationAttribute,
					         {Value(static_cast<uint32_t>(kind)), byte_address, predicate});
					reads++;
				}
			}
			if (!write) {
				Value replacement = values[0];
				if (components == 2u)
					replacement =
					    emit(ValueOpcode::CompositeConstructU32x2, {values[0], values[1]});
				if (components == 3u)
					replacement = emit(ValueOpcode::CompositeConstructU32x3,
					                   {values[0], values[1], values[2]});
				if (components == 4u)
					replacement = emit(ValueOpcode::CompositeConstructU32x4,
					                   {values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3]});
				inst.ReplaceUsesWith(replacement);
			}
			inst.Invalidate();
		}
	}
	ConstantPropagationPass(program.blocks, program.wave_size);
	RemoveIdentities(program);
	EliminateDeadCode(program.blocks);
	// Patch constant stores whose EXEC selects were not stripped would land in control points.
	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(options.stage == ShaderType::TessellationControl &&
	                     tess.patch_size != 0u && patches == 0u);
	LOGF("%s tessellation lowering: reads=%u writes=%u factors=%u patches=%u\n",
	     options.stage == ShaderType::Local                 ? "LS"
	     : options.stage == ShaderType::TessellationControl ? "HS"
	                                                       : "TES",
	     reads, writes, factors, patches);
	return true;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler
```

`src/graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/SpirvBuilder.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/SpirvBuilder.h"

#include "common/assert.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv {

static constexpr size_t InitialSpirvSectionReserve         = 4096;
static constexpr size_t InitialSpirvFunctionSectionReserve = 32768;

static void AppendInstructionWords(std::vector<uint32_t>& section, const uint32_t* words,
                                   size_t words_num) {
	if (words_num == 0) {
		return;
	}
	const uint32_t opcode     = words[0];
	const auto     word_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(words_num);
	section.push_back((word_count << spv::WordCountShift) | opcode);
	section.insert(section.end(), words + 1, words + words_num);
}

Builder::Builder(uint32_t version): m_version(version) {
	m_debug.reserve(InitialSpirvSectionReserve);
	m_annotations.reserve(InitialSpirvSectionReserve);
	m_declarations.reserve(InitialSpirvSectionReserve);
	m_functions.reserve(InitialSpirvFunctionSectionReserve);
}

uint32_t Builder::AllocateId() {
	return m_next_id++;
}

void Builder::RequireVersion(uint32_t version) {
	m_version = std::max(m_version, version);
}

void Builder::RequireCapability(spv::Capability capability) {
	if (m_required_capabilities.insert(capability).second) {
		AppendInstruction(m_capabilities, spv::OpCapability, capability);
	}
}

void Builder::RequireExtension(const char* name) {
	if (m_required_extensions.emplace(name).second) {
		std::vector<uint32_t> operands;
		AppendString(operands, name);
		AppendInstruction(m_extensions, spv::OpExtension, operands);
	}
}

uint32_t Builder::Import(const char* name) {
	if (const auto it = m_import_ids.find(name); it != m_import_ids.end()) {
		return it->second;
	}
	const auto id = AllocateId();
	m_import_ids.emplace(name, id);
	std::vector<uint32_t> operands = {id};
	AppendString(operands, name);
	AppendInstruction(m_ext_inst_imports, spv::OpExtInstImport, operands);
	return id;
}

uint32_t Builder::DeclareType(spv::Op opcode, std::initializer_list<TypeAnnotation> annotations) {
	const auto operand_count = m_key[1];
	m_key.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(annotations.size()));
	for (const auto& annotation: annotations) {
		AppendOperand(m_key, annotation.opcode);
		m_key.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(annotation.operands.size()));
		m_key.insert(m_key.end(), annotation.operands.begin(), annotation.operands.end());
	}
	if (const auto it = m_declaration_ids.find(m_key); it != m_declaration_ids.end()) {
		return it->second;
	}
	const auto id = AllocateId();
	AppendInstruction(m_declarations, opcode, id,
	                  std::span<const uint32_t>(m_key).subspan(2, operand_count));
	m_declaration_ids.emplace(m_key, id);
	for (const auto& annotation: annotations) {
		AppendInstruction(m_annotations, annotation.opcode, id, annotation.operands);
	}
	return id;
}

uint32_t Builder::DeclareConstant(spv::Op opcode) {
	if (const auto it = m_declaration_ids.find(m_key); it != m_declaration_ids.end()) {
		return it->second;
	}
	const auto id = AllocateId();
	AppendInstruction(m_declarations, opcode, m_key[1], id,
	                  std::span<const uint32_t>(m_key).subspan(2));
	m_declaration_ids.emplace(m_key, id);
	return id;
}

uint32_t Builder::DefineGlobalVariable(uint32_t pointer_type, spv::StorageClass storage_class) {
	const auto id = AllocateId();
	DefineGlobalVariable(id, pointer_type, storage_class);
	return id;
}

void Builder::DefineGlobalVariable(uint32_t id, uint32_t pointer_type,
                                   spv::StorageClass storage_class) {
	AppendInstruction(m_declarations, spv::OpVariable, pointer_type, id, storage_class);
}

void Builder::DefineGlobalVariable(uint32_t id, uint32_t pointer_type,
                                   spv::StorageClass storage_class, uint32_t initializer) {
	AppendInstruction(m_declarations, spv::OpVariable, pointer_type, id, storage_class, initializer);
}

void Builder::AppendString(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, const char* text) {
	const auto len        = text != nullptr ? std::strlen(text) : 0;
	const auto word_count = (len + 1u + 3u) / 4u;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < word_count; i++) {
		uint32_t word = 0;
		for (size_t byte = 0; byte < 4; byte++) {
			const auto index = i * 4u + byte;
			if (index < len) {
				word |= static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(text[index]))
				        << (byte * 8u);
			}
		}
		words.push_back(word);
	}
}

void Builder::AddMemoryModel(spv::AddressingModel addressing_model, spv::MemoryModel memory_model) {
	AppendInstruction(m_memory_model, spv::OpMemoryModel, addressing_model, memory_model);
}

void Builder::AddEntryPoint(spv::ExecutionModel execution_model, uint32_t entry_point,
                            const char* name, const std::vector<uint32_t>& interfaces) {
	std::vector<uint32_t> operands;
	AppendOperands(operands, execution_model, entry_point);
	AppendString(operands, name);
	operands.insert(operands.end(), interfaces.begin(), interfaces.end());
	if (m_version >= 0x00010400u) {
		for (size_t offset = 0; offset < m_declarations.size();) {
			const auto count = m_declarations[offset] >> spv::WordCountShift;
			if ((m_declarations[offset] & spv::OpCodeMask) == spv::OpVariable) {
				const auto id = m_declarations[offset + 2u];
				if (std::find(interfaces.begin(), interfaces.end(), id) == interfaces.end()) {
					operands.push_back(id);
				}
			}
			offset += count;
		}
	}
	AppendInstruction(m_entry_points, spv::OpEntryPoint, operands);
}

uint32_t Builder::AddString(const char* text) {
	const auto id = AllocateId();
	std::vector<uint32_t> operands = {id};
	AppendString(operands, text);
	AppendInstruction(m_debug, spv::OpString, operands);
	return id;
}

void Builder::AddName(uint32_t target, const char* name) {
	if (!m_emit_names) {
		return;
	}
	std::vector<uint32_t> operands = {target};
	AppendString(operands, name);
	AppendInstruction(m_debug, spv::OpName, operands);
}

void Builder::AddFunction(std::span<const uint32_t> words) {
	AppendInstructionWords(m_functions, words.data(), words.size());
}

void Builder::InsertFunctionWords(size_t offset, std::span<const uint32_t> words) {
	EXIT_IF(offset > m_functions.size() || m_unpatched_phi_incomings != 0);
	m_functions.insert(m_functions.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset), words.begin(), words.end());
}

void Builder::PatchFunctionWord(size_t offset, uint32_t expected, uint32_t value) {
	EXIT_IF(offset >= m_functions.size() || m_functions[offset] != expected);
	m_functions[offset] = value;
}

DeferredPhi Builder::AddDeferredPhi(uint32_t type, uint32_t result, size_t incoming_count) {
	const DeferredPhi phi {m_functions.size()};
	const auto word_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(3u + incoming_count * 2u);
	m_functions.push_back((word_count << spv::WordCountShift) | spv::OpPhi);
	m_functions.push_back(type);
	m_functions.push_back(result);
	m_functions.resize(m_functions.size() + incoming_count * 2u);
	m_unpatched_phi_incomings += incoming_count;
	return phi;
}

void Builder::PatchDeferredPhi(DeferredPhi phi, size_t incoming, uint32_t value, uint32_t parent) {
	const auto incoming_count =
	    ((m_functions.at(phi.word_offset) >> spv::WordCountShift) - 3u) / 2u;
	EXIT_IF(incoming >= incoming_count || value == 0 || parent == 0);
	const auto value_word  = phi.word_offset + 3u + incoming * 2u;
	const auto parent_word = value_word + 1u;
	EXIT_IF(m_functions.at(value_word) != 0 || m_functions.at(parent_word) != 0);
	m_functions[value_word]  = value;
	m_functions[parent_word] = parent;
	m_unpatched_phi_incomings--;
}

std::vector<uint32_t> Builder::Build() const {
	EXIT_IF(m_unpatched_phi_incomings != 0);

	std::vector<uint32_t> module;
	module.reserve(5u + m_capabilities.size() + m_extensions.size() + m_ext_inst_imports.size() +
	               m_memory_model.size() + m_entry_points.size() + m_execution_modes.size() +
	               m_debug.size() + m_annotations.size() + m_declarations.size() +
	               m_functions.size());

	module.push_back(spv::MagicNumber);
	module.push_back(m_version);
	module.push_back(0u);
	module.push_back(m_next_id);
	module.push_back(0u);

	module.insert(module.end(), m_capabilities.begin(), m_capabilities.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_extensions.begin(), m_extensions.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_ext_inst_imports.begin(), m_ext_inst_imports.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_memory_model.begin(), m_memory_model.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_entry_points.begin(), m_entry_points.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_execution_modes.begin(), m_execution_modes.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_debug.begin(), m_debug.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_annotations.begin(), m_annotations.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_declarations.begin(), m_declarations.end());
	module.insert(module.end(), m_functions.begin(), m_functions.end());

	return module;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv
```

`src/graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/SpirvBuilder.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_SHADER_RECOMPILER_SPIRVBUILDER_H_
#define EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_SHADER_RECOMPILER_SPIRVBUILDER_H_

#include "common/common.h"

#include <initializer_list>
#include <iterator>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <span>
#include <spirv/unified1/spirv.hpp>
#include <string>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv {

struct TypeAnnotation {
	spv::Op               opcode = spv::OpNop;
	std::vector<uint32_t> operands; // Already encoded operand words.
};

struct DeferredPhi {
	size_t word_offset    = 0;
};

class Builder {
public:
	explicit Builder(uint32_t version = 0x00010300u);
	~Builder() = default;
	KYTY_CLASS_DEFAULT_COPY(Builder);

	uint32_t AllocateId();
	void     RequireVersion(uint32_t version);
	void     RequireCapability(spv::Capability capability);
	void     RequireExtension(const char* name);
	uint32_t Import(const char* name);
	template <typename... Args>
	uint32_t Type(spv::Op opcode, const Args&... operands) {
		return DecoratedType(opcode, {}, operands...);
	}

	template <typename... Args>
	uint32_t DecoratedType(spv::Op opcode, std::initializer_list<TypeAnnotation> annotations,
	                       const Args&... operands) {
		const auto operand_count = static_cast<uint32_t>((0u + ... + OperandWordCount(operands)));
		m_key.clear();
		AppendOperands(m_key, opcode, operand_count, operands...);
		return DeclareType(opcode, annotations);
	}

	template <typename... Args>
	uint32_t Constant(spv::Op opcode, uint32_t type, const Args&... operands) {
		m_key.clear();
		AppendOperands(m_key, opcode, type, operands...);
		return DeclareConstant(opcode);
	}

	uint32_t DefineGlobalVariable(uint32_t pointer_type, spv::StorageClass storage_class);
	void DefineGlobalVariable(uint32_t id, uint32_t pointer_type, spv::StorageClass storage_class);
	void DefineGlobalVariable(uint32_t id, uint32_t pointer_type, spv::StorageClass storage_class,
	                          uint32_t initializer);

	void AddMemoryModel(spv::AddressingModel addressing_model, spv::MemoryModel memory_model);
	void AddEntryPoint(spv::ExecutionModel execution_model, uint32_t entry_point, const char* name,
	                   const std::vector<uint32_t>& interfaces);
	template <typename... Args>
	void AddExecutionMode(uint32_t entry_point, spv::ExecutionMode mode, const Args&... operands) {
		AppendInstruction(m_execution_modes, spv::OpExecutionMode, entry_point, mode, operands...);
	}

	uint32_t AddString(const char* text);
	void EnableNames() { m_emit_names = true; }
	void AddName(uint32_t target, const char* name);
	template <typename... Args>
	void AddAnnotation(spv::Op opcode, const Args&... operands) {
		AppendInstruction(m_annotations, opcode, operands...);
	}

	template <typename... Args>
	void AddFunction(spv::Op opcode, const Args&... operands) {
		AppendInstruction(m_functions, opcode, operands...);
	}

	void        AddFunction(std::span<const uint32_t> words);
	// Function words emitted so far, and words inserted at such a position later (once every
	// deferred Phi is patched: their offsets would move).
	[[nodiscard]] size_t FunctionWordCount() const noexcept { return m_functions.size(); }
	void                 InsertFunctionWords(size_t offset, std::span<const uint32_t> words);
	void                 PatchFunctionWord(size_t offset, uint32_t expected, uint32_t value);
	DeferredPhi AddDeferredPhi(uint32_t type, uint32_t result, size_t incoming_count);
	void        PatchDeferredPhi(DeferredPhi phi, size_t incoming, uint32_t value, uint32_t parent);

	[[nodiscard]] std::vector<uint32_t> Build() const;

private:
	static void AppendOperand(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, uint32_t value) {
		words.push_back(value);
	}

	static void AppendOperand(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, int32_t value) {
		words.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(value));
	}

	template <typename T>
	requires std::is_enum_v<T>
	static void AppendOperand(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, T value) {
		static_assert(sizeof(T) == sizeof(uint32_t));
		words.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(value));
	}

	static void AppendOperand(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, std::span<const uint32_t> values) {
		words.insert(words.end(), values.begin(), values.end());
	}

	template <typename... Args>
	static void AppendOperands(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, const Args&... operands) {
		(AppendOperand(words, operands), ...);
	}

	template <typename T>
	static size_t OperandWordCount(const T& operand) {
		if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T> || std::is_enum_v<T>) {
			return 1;
		} else {
			return std::size(operand);
		}
	}

	template <typename... Args>
	static void AppendInstruction(std::vector<uint32_t>& section, spv::Op opcode,
	                              const Args&... operands) {
		const auto offset = section.size();
		AppendOperands(section, opcode, operands...);
		const auto word_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(section.size() - offset);
		section[offset] |= word_count << spv::WordCountShift;
	}

	uint32_t    DeclareType(spv::Op opcode, std::initializer_list<TypeAnnotation> annotations);
	uint32_t    DeclareConstant(spv::Op opcode);
	static void AppendString(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, const char* text);

	uint32_t                                  m_next_id = 1;
	uint32_t                                  m_version = 0;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_capabilities;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_extensions;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_ext_inst_imports;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_memory_model;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_entry_points;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_execution_modes;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_debug;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_annotations;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_declarations;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_functions;
	std::set<spv::Capability>                 m_required_capabilities;
	std::set<std::string>                     m_required_extensions;
	std::map<std::string, uint32_t>           m_import_ids;
	std::map<std::vector<uint32_t>, uint32_t> m_declaration_ids;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                     m_key; // Reused declaration lookup key.
	size_t                                    m_unpatched_phi_incomings = 0;
	bool                                      m_emit_names              = false;
};

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv

#endif /* EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_SHADER_RECOMPILER_SPIRVBUILDER_H_ */
```

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/SpirvEmitter.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/spirvEmitterInternal.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/ShaderIR.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv {

namespace {

[[noreturn]] void Fail(const IR::Program& program, const char* reason) {
	EXIT("SPIR-V validation failed: hash=0x%016" PRIx64 " stage=%u reason=%s\n",
	     program.shader_hash, static_cast<unsigned>(program.stage), reason);
	std::abort();
}

} // namespace

bool UsesMipStats(const IR::Program& program) {
	if (program.stage != ShaderType::Pixel) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto& images = program.info.images;
	// Images whose T# the draw supplies; table elements and heap images have no field.
	const auto drawn = [&](uint32_t resource) {
		return resource < images.size() && !images[resource].heap &&
		       images[resource].table_capacity == 0u;
	};
	for (const auto* block: program.blocks) {
		for (const auto& inst: *block) {
			if (inst.GetOpcode() != IR::ValueOpcode::ImageSampleRaw) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto index = inst.Flags<IR::MemoryFlags>().index;
			if (index >= program.memory_info.size()) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto resource = program.memory_info[index].resource;
			if (drawn(resource)) {
				return true;
			}
			if (resource < images.size() &&
			    std::ranges::any_of(images[resource].indirect_resources, drawn)) {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}
	return false;
}

std::vector<uint32_t> EmitProgram(IR::Program& program, ShaderStageInputInfo input_info,
                                  uint32_t push_data_start_dword, const Profile& profile,
                                  bool emit_debug_info,
                                  bool mip_stats_records) {
	using namespace Emitter;

	if (!program.srt_plan_complete || !program.resource_tracking_complete ||
	    !program.shader_info_complete) {
		Fail(program, "SPIR-V emitter requires a fully planned native shader program");
	}
	IR::ValidateProgram(program);
	program.bindings = {.push_data_start_dword = push_data_start_dword};
	EmitterState state(program, input_info, profile);
	if (emit_debug_info) {
		char name[64];
		std::snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "rdna2-%016" PRIx64 "-block-byte-pc-plus-one",
		              program.shader_hash);
		state.debug_source = state.builder.AddString(name);
		state.builder.EnableNames();
	}
	state.mip_stats_records     = mip_stats_records;
	const auto* workgroup = ShaderWorkgroupInput(program.stage, input_info);
	state.lane_count =
	    workgroup != nullptr && program.wave_size == 64u && workgroup->host_subgroup_size == 32u
	        ? 2u
	        : 1u;
	DefineModule(state);
	EmitProgram(state);
	state.builder.AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModelForStage(state.program.stage), state.main_func,
	                            "main", state.interface_variables);

	return state.builder.Build();
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv
```

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_SHADER_RECOMPILER_SPIRVEMITTER_H_
#define EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_SHADER_RECOMPILER_SPIRVEMITTER_H_

#include "common/common.h"
#include "common/stringUtils.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/ShaderIR.h"

#include <vector>

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv {

// Host device capabilities that change the emitted SPIR-V. Built once per device.
struct Profile {
	bool maintenance8         = false; // Dynamic texel offsets on image samples.
	bool native_float_min_max = false; // NMin/NMax give the guest's NaN and signed-zero results.
	// OpReadClockKHR Device tick in picoseconds; 0 without shaderDeviceClock.
	uint32_t device_clock_period_ps = 0;
	// Storage buffer elements past the descriptor range, to the byte, read zero and drop writes.
	bool robust_buffer_access = false;
	// 8 and 8_8 sRGB textures sample through sRGB views; without one the shader decodes them.
	bool r8_srgb_views   = false;
	bool r8g8_srgb_views = false;
};

inline constexpr Profile DefaultProfile {};

// Resets and writes backend IDs and descriptor indices; do not emit the same program concurrently.
// mip_stats_records=false emits the plain variant of a pixel shader instrumented for GET_LOD_STATS
// (UsesMipStats): the same bindings and code without the per-sample recording, whose storage
// buffer atomics make the driver run the depth and stencil tests after a shader that can discard.
std::vector<uint32_t> EmitProgram(IR::Program& program, ShaderStageInputInfo input_info,
                                  uint32_t       push_data_start_dword = 0,
                                  const Profile& profile               = DefaultProfile,
                                  bool           emit_debug_info       = false,
                                  bool           mip_stats_records     = true);

// A pixel shader that samples an image through a T# the draw supplies records GET_LOD_STATS
// mip statistics for it (see LodStatsCounter).
[[nodiscard]] bool UsesMipStats(const IR::Program& program);
} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv

#endif /* EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_GRAPHICS_SHADER_RECOMPILER_SPIRVEMITTER_H_ */
```

`src/graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/spirvEmitterAlu.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/spirvEmitterInstructions.h"

#include <array>

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv::Emitter {
namespace {

uint32_t EmitMinMaxF64(EmitterState& state, uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs, bool max_value) {
	const auto bits_type = TypeU32Vector(state, 2);
	const auto lhs_bits = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, bits_type, lhs);
	const auto rhs_bits = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, bits_type, rhs);
	const auto ordered = Binary(state, max_value ? spv::OpFOrdGreaterThan : spv::OpFOrdLessThan,
	                            TypeBool(state), lhs, rhs);
	auto result = Select(state, TypeF64(state), ordered, lhs, rhs);

	// Equal values have identical bits except signed zero: min chooses -0, max chooses +0.
	const auto equal = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdEqual, TypeBool(state), lhs, rhs);
	const auto equal_bits = Binary(state, max_value ? spv::OpBitwiseAnd : spv::OpBitwiseOr,
	                               bits_type, lhs_bits, rhs_bits);
	result = Select(state, TypeF64(state), equal,
	                Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF64(state), equal_bits), result);

	// Non-IEEE mode selects the other operand for NaN, and lhs when both are NaN. The ordered
	// compares already pick rhs for a NaN lhs.
	return Select(state, TypeF64(state), Unary(state, spv::OpIsNan, TypeBool(state), rhs),
	              lhs, result);
}

uint32_t EmitMulHigh(EmitterState& state, uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs, bool signed_value) {
	const auto operand_type = signed_value ? TypeI32(state) : TypeU32(state);
	const auto pair_type    = signed_value ? TypeI32Pair(state) : TypeU32Pair(state);
	uint32_t   lhs_operand  = lhs;
	uint32_t   rhs_operand  = rhs;
	if (signed_value) {
		lhs_operand = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeI32(state), lhs);
		rhs_operand = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeI32(state), rhs);
	}
	const auto extended = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(signed_value ? spv::OpSMulExtended : spv::OpUMulExtended, pair_type,
	                          extended, lhs_operand, rhs_operand);
	const auto high = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, operand_type, high, extended, 1);
	return signed_value ? Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32(state), high) : high;
}

uint32_t EmitFMinMax3(EmitterState& state, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t c, bool max_value) {
	return EmitMinMaxF32Value(state, EmitMinMaxF32Value(state, a, b, max_value), c, max_value);
}

uint32_t EmitExt(EmitterState& state, uint32_t type, uint32_t opcode,
                 std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, type, result, GlslStd450(state), opcode, args);
	return result;
}

uint32_t EmitF32ToU32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t src, bool signed_value) {
	// Clamping first keeps the truncating conversion defined; NaN and values past the largest
	// float below the integer limit are selected afterwards.
	const auto clamped =
	    EmitExt(state, TypeF32(state), GLSLstd450NClamp,
	            {src, ConstantF32(state, signed_value ? 0xcf000000u : 0u),
	             ConstantF32(state, signed_value ? 0x4effffffu : 0x4f7fffffu)});
	const auto converted = signed_value
	                           ? Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32(state),
	                                   Unary(state, spv::OpConvertFToS, TypeI32(state), clamped))
	                           : Unary(state, spv::OpConvertFToU, TypeU32(state), clamped);
	const auto above     = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdGreaterThanEqual, TypeBool(state), src,
	                              ConstantF32(state, signed_value ? 0x4f000000u : 0x4f800000u));
	const auto high =
	    Select(state, TypeU32(state), above,
	           ConstantU32(state, signed_value ? 0x7fffffffu : 0xffffffffu), converted);
	return Select(state, TypeU32(state), Unary(state, spv::OpIsNan, TypeBool(state), src),
	              ConstantU32(state, 0), high);
}

} // namespace

uint32_t EmitF32BitsToF16RtzBits(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits) {
	// Native half conversion causes regressions; use compact integer RTZ conversion.
	const auto abs  = EmitAndConstant(state, bits, 0x7fffffffu);
	const auto sign = EmitAndConstant(
	    state, Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), bits, ConstantU32(state, 16)),
	    0x8000u);
	const auto exp = Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), abs,
	                        ConstantU32(state, 23));
	const auto mant = EmitAndConstant(state, abs, 0x007fffffu);

	// Align the hidden bit to the half subnormal mantissa. Even unused shifts must be < 32.
	const auto shift = EmitUMin32(
	    state, Binary(state, spv::OpISub, TypeU32(state), ConstantU32(state, 126), exp),
	    ConstantU32(state, 31));
	const auto sub = Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state),
	                        EmitOrU32(state, mant, ConstantU32(state, 0x00800000u)), shift);

	// Drop 13 mantissa bits and rebias the exponent; finite overflow saturates to max half.
	const auto truncated = Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), abs,
	                              ConstantU32(state, 13));
	const auto normal = EmitUMin32(
	    state, Binary(state, spv::OpISub, TypeU32(state), truncated, ConstantU32(state, 0x1c000u)),
	    ConstantU32(state, 0x7bffu));
	const auto finite = Select(state, TypeU32(state),
	                           EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpULessThan, abs, 0x38800000u),
	                           sub, normal);
	const auto nan = EmitOrU32(state, EmitAndConstant(state, truncated, 0x03ffu),
	                           ConstantU32(state, 0x7e00u));
	const auto special = Select(state, TypeU32(state),
	                            EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual, mant, 0),
	                            ConstantU32(state, 0x7c00u), nan);
	const auto magnitude = Select(
	    state, TypeU32(state),
	    EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpUGreaterThanEqual, abs, 0x7f800000u), special, finite);
	return EmitOrU32(state, sign, magnitude);
}

uint32_t EmitFPFma32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t c) {
	const auto result = EmitGlsl<GLSLstd450Fma, IR::Type::F32>(state, a, b, c);
	state.builder.AddAnnotation(spv::OpDecorate, result, spv::DecorationNoContraction);
	return result;
}

uint32_t EmitFPMad32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t c) {
	// Explicit denormal checks typically drop 3DMiniGolf menu FPS from 28-29 to 21-24
	// on NVIDIA RTX 5080 Laptop GPU, so leave them disabled for this experiment.
	// a = EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(state, a);
	// b = EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(state, b);
	// c = EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(state, c);
	const auto product = EmitFPMul32(state, a, b);
	state.builder.AddAnnotation(spv::OpDecorate, product, spv::DecorationNoContraction);
	// const auto sum = EmitFPAdd32(state, EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(state, product), c);
	const auto sum = EmitFPAdd32(state, product, c);
	state.builder.AddAnnotation(spv::OpDecorate, sum, spv::DecorationNoContraction);
	// return EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(state, sum);
	return sum;
}

uint32_t EmitConvertU16U32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return EmitNative<spv::OpBitwiseAnd, IR::Type::U16>(state, arg0, ConstantU32(state, 0xffffu));
}

uint32_t EmitConvertU8U32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return EmitNative<spv::OpBitwiseAnd, IR::Type::U8>(state, arg0, ConstantU32(state, 0xffu));
}

// The F16 bits of an F32 in the low half of a U32 (PackHalf2x16 rounding).
uint32_t EmitF32ToF16Bits(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	const auto pair = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), pair, arg0,
	                          ConstantF32(state, 0));
	return EmitPackHalf2x16(state, pair);
}

namespace {

uint32_t HalfOfU32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits, uint32_t lane) {
	const auto halves = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF16x2(state), bits);
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeF16(state), result, halves, lane);
	return result;
}

uint32_t LaneOf(IR::Value lane) {
	return lane.Resolve().U32() != 0u ? 1u : 0u;
}

uint32_t HalfOperation(EmitterState& state, spv::Op opcode, uint32_t glsl,
                       std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args, bool exact) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto* arg   = args.begin();
	if (opcode != spv::OpExtInst) {
		if (args.size() == 1) {
			state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, TypeF16(state), result, arg[0]);
		} else {
			state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, TypeF16(state), result, arg[0], arg[1]);
		}
	} else if (args.size() == 1) {
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF16(state), result, GlslStd450(state), glsl,
		                          arg[0]);
	} else if (args.size() == 2) {
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF16(state), result, GlslStd450(state), glsl,
		                          arg[0], arg[1]);
	} else {
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF16(state), result, GlslStd450(state), glsl,
		                          arg[0], arg[1], arg[2]);
	}
	if (exact) {
		state.builder.AddAnnotation(spv::OpDecorate, result, spv::DecorationNoContraction);
	}
	return result;
}

} // namespace

// F16 values are native halves; U16 values and F16 bits live in the low half of a U32.
uint32_t EmitConvertF16F32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return HalfOfU32(state, EmitF32ToF16Bits(state, arg0), 0u);
}

uint32_t EmitConvertF32F16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return Unary(state, spv::OpFConvert, TypeF32(state), arg0);
}

uint32_t EmitBitCastF16U16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return HalfOfU32(state, arg0, 0u);
}

uint32_t EmitBitCastU16F16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	const auto halves = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeF16x2(state), halves, arg0,
	                          state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstant, TypeF16(state), 0u));
	return Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32(state), halves);
}

uint32_t EmitExtractF16Lane(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits, IR::Value lane) {
	return HalfOfU32(state, bits, LaneOf(lane));
}

uint32_t EmitInsertF16Lane(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits, uint32_t value, IR::Value lane) {
	const auto halves   = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF16x2(state), bits);
	const auto inserted = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeInsert, TypeF16x2(state), inserted, value, halves,
	                          LaneOf(lane));
	return Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32(state), inserted);
}

uint32_t EmitFPAdd16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpFAdd, 0, {arg0, arg1}, true);
}

uint32_t EmitFPSub16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpFSub, 0, {arg0, arg1}, true);
}

uint32_t EmitFPMul16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpFMul, 0, {arg0, arg1}, true);
}

uint32_t EmitFPFma16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpExtInst, GLSLstd450Fma, {arg0, arg1, arg2}, true);
}

uint32_t EmitFPMin16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpExtInst, GLSLstd450NMin, {arg0, arg1}, false);
}

uint32_t EmitFPMax16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpExtInst, GLSLstd450NMax, {arg0, arg1}, false);
}

uint32_t EmitFPAbs16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpExtInst, GLSLstd450FAbs, {arg0}, false);

	return HalfOperation(state, spv::OpFNegate, 0, {arg0}, false);

uint32_t EmitConvertS32F32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return EmitF32ToU32(state, arg0, true);
}

uint32_t EmitConvertU32F32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return EmitF32ToU32(state, arg0, false);
}

uint32_t EmitConvertF32F64(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	const auto converted = Unary(state, spv::OpFConvert, TypeF32(state), arg0);
	const auto source    = EmitNative<spv::OpCompositeExtract, IR::Type::U32>(
	    state, Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32Vector(state, 2), arg0), 1u);
	const auto exponent = EmitAndConstant(state, source, 0x7ff00000u);
	const auto overflow =
	    Binary(state, spv::OpLogicalAnd, TypeBool(state),
	           EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpUGreaterThan, exponent, 0x47e00000u),
	           EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpULessThan, exponent, 0x7ff00000u));
	const auto clamped = EmitOrU32(state, EmitAndConstant(state, source, 0x80000000u),
	                               ConstantU32(state, 0x7f7fffffu));
	return EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(
	    state, Select(state, TypeF32(state), overflow,
	                  Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF32(state), clamped), converted));
}

uint32_t EmitConvertF64F32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	return EmitNative<spv::OpFConvert, IR::Type::F64>(state,
	                                                  EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(state, arg0));
}

uint32_t EmitCompositeConstructU64(ValueEmitContext& ctx, uint32_t arg0, IR::Value arg1) {
	arg1 = arg1.Resolve();
	return arg1.IsImmediate() && arg1.U32() == 0u
	           ? Unary(ctx.state, spv::OpUConvert, TypeU64(ctx.state), arg0)
	           : PackU64(ctx.state, arg0, ctx.Def(arg1));
}

uint32_t EmitCompositeExtractU64(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, IR::Value arg1) {
	const auto value = arg1.U32() == 0u ? arg0
	                                    : Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU64(state),
	                                             arg0, ConstantU32(state, 32));
	return Unary(state, spv::OpUConvert, TypeU32(state), value);
}

uint32_t EmitCompositeExtractU32x2(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, IR::Value arg1) {
	return EmitNative<spv::OpCompositeExtract, IR::Type::U32>(state, arg0, arg1.U32());
}

uint32_t EmitPackFloat2x16Rtz(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return EmitNative<spv::OpBitFieldInsert, IR::Type::U32>(
	    state, EmitF32BitsToF16RtzBits(state, EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, arg0)),
	    EmitF32BitsToF16RtzBits(state, EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, arg1)),
	    ConstantU32(state, 16), ConstantU32(state, 16));
}

uint32_t EmitFPSaturate32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0) {
	// The clamp modifier runs in DX10 clamp mode: NaN becomes 0, as NClamp's NMax step does.
	return EmitExt(state, TypeF32(state), GLSLstd450NClamp,
	               {arg0, ConstantF32(state, 0), ConstantF32(state, 0x3f800000u)});
}

namespace {

// Packed F16 values stay U32 in the module; each operation bitcasts its operands to an F16
// vector, which host compilers fold into one native two-lane instruction (HFMA2 and kin).
uint32_t PackedF16Operation(EmitterState& state, spv::Op opcode, uint32_t glsl,
                            std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
	std::array<uint32_t, 3> halves {};
	size_t                  count = 0;
	for (const auto arg: args) {
		halves[count++] = Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF16x2(state), arg);
	}
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	if (opcode == spv::OpExtInst) {
		if (count == 2) {
			state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF16x2(state), result, GlslStd450(state),
			                          glsl, halves[0], halves[1]);
		} else {
			state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF16x2(state), result, GlslStd450(state),
			                          glsl, halves[0], halves[1], halves[2]);
		}
	} else {
		state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, TypeF16x2(state), result, halves[0], halves[1]);
	}
	// Each guest operation rounds once; keep the host compiler from fusing a mul and an add.
	state.builder.AddAnnotation(spv::OpDecorate, result, spv::DecorationNoContraction);
	return Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32(state), result);
}

} // namespace

uint32_t EmitPackedFPAdd16x2(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return PackedF16Operation(state, spv::OpFAdd, 0, {arg0, arg1});
}

uint32_t EmitPackedFPMul16x2(EmitterState& state, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t arg1) {
	return PackedF16Operation(state, spv::OpFMul, 0, {arg0, arg1});
}

	return PackedF16Operation(state, spv::OpExtInst, GLSLstd450Fma, {arg0, arg1, arg2});
}

	// One NaN operand yields the other, as for the F32 forms (see EmitMinMaxF32Value).
	return PackedF16Operation(state, spv::OpExtInst, GLSLstd450NMin, {arg0, arg1});
}

}
```

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/spirvEmitterInternal.h"

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv::Emitter {

uint32_t EmitAndConstant(EmitterState& state, uint32_t value, uint32_t mask) {
	const auto ret = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), ret, value,
	                          ConstantU32(state, mask));
	return ret;
}

uint32_t EmitCompareU32Constant(EmitterState& state, spv::Op opcode, uint32_t value,
                                uint32_t constant) {
	const auto ret = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, TypeBool(state), ret, value, ConstantU32(state, constant));
	return ret;
}

F32Class EmitClassifyF32Bits(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits) {
	const auto abs_bits = EmitAndConstant(state, bits, 0x7fffffffu);
	return {EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpUGreaterThan, abs_bits, 0x7f800000u),
	        EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual, abs_bits, 0)};
}

static uint32_t EmitClassMaskBitMatch(EmitterState& state, uint32_t mask, uint32_t bit,
                                      uint32_t class_match) {
	const auto selected =
	    EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpINotEqual, EmitAndConstant(state, mask, 1u << bit), 0);
	return EmitLogicalAndBool(state, selected, class_match);
}

static uint32_t EmitClassMaskBits(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits, uint32_t mask, bool half) {
	const uint32_t sign_mask     = half ? 0x8000u : 0x80000000u;
	const uint32_t exponent_mask = half ? 0x7c00u : 0x7f800000u;
	const uint32_t mantissa_mask = half ? 0x03ffu : 0x007fffffu;
	const uint32_t quiet_mask    = half ? 0x0200u : 0x00400000u;
	const auto     sign_bits     = EmitAndConstant(state, bits, sign_mask);
	const auto     abs_bits      = EmitAndConstant(state, bits, sign_mask - 1u);
	const auto     exponent_bits = EmitAndConstant(state, abs_bits, exponent_mask);
	const auto     mantissa_bits = EmitAndConstant(state, abs_bits, mantissa_mask);
	const auto     quiet_bits    = EmitAndConstant(state, mantissa_bits, quiet_mask);

	const auto sign             = EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpINotEqual, sign_bits, 0);
	const auto positive         = EmitLogicalNotBool(state, sign);
	const auto exponent_zero    = EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual, exponent_bits, 0);
	const auto exponent_nonzero = EmitLogicalNotBool(state, exponent_zero);
	const auto exponent_inf =
	    EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual, exponent_bits, exponent_mask);
	const auto finite_exponent  = EmitLogicalNotBool(state, exponent_inf);
	const auto mantissa_zero    = EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual, mantissa_bits, 0);
	const auto mantissa_nonzero = EmitLogicalNotBool(state, mantissa_zero);
	const auto quiet            = EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpINotEqual, quiet_bits, 0);

	const auto nan_common = EmitLogicalAndBool(state, exponent_inf, mantissa_nonzero);
	const auto snan       = EmitLogicalAndBool(state, nan_common, EmitLogicalNotBool(state, quiet));
	const auto qnan       = EmitLogicalAndBool(state, nan_common, quiet);
	const auto inf        = EmitLogicalAndBool(state, exponent_inf, mantissa_zero);
	const auto normal     = EmitLogicalAndBool(state, exponent_nonzero, finite_exponent);
	const auto denorm     = EmitLogicalAndBool(state, exponent_zero, mantissa_nonzero);
	const auto zero       = EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual, abs_bits, 0);

	uint32_t match = EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 0, snan);
	match          = EmitLogicalOrBool(state, match, EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 1, qnan));
	match          = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match, EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 2, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, inf, sign)));
	match = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match,
	    EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 3, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, normal, sign)));
	match = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match,
	    EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 4, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, denorm, sign)));
	match = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match, EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 5, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, zero, sign)));
	match = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match,
	    EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 6, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, zero, positive)));
	match = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match,
	    EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 7, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, denorm, positive)));
	match = EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match,
	    EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 8, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, normal, positive)));
	return EmitLogicalOrBool(
	    state, match,
	    EmitClassMaskBitMatch(state, mask, 9, EmitLogicalAndBool(state, inf, positive)));
}

uint32_t EmitClassMaskF32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t value, uint32_t mask) {
	return EmitClassMaskBits(state, EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, value), mask, false);
}

uint32_t EmitClassMaskF16(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits, uint32_t mask) {
	return EmitClassMaskBits(state, bits, mask, true);
}

static uint32_t EmitMinMaxF32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs, uint32_t lhs_bits,
                              uint32_t rhs_bits, bool max_value) {
	// PS5 V_MIN/V_MAX_F32 return the other source for a NaN source (S0 when both are NaN)
	// and order -0 below +0. An ordered compare takes S1 for a NaN S0 and, unlike NMin/NMax,
	// always returns the exact bits of one source.
	const auto either    = EmitOrU32(state, lhs_bits, rhs_bits);
	const auto both_zero = EmitCompareU32Constant(state, spv::OpIEqual,
	                                              EmitAndConstant(state, either, 0x7fffffffu), 0);
	const auto zero =
	    EmitBitcastU32ToF32(state, max_value ? EmitAndU32(state, lhs_bits, rhs_bits) : either);
	const auto keep_lhs =
	    Binary(state, max_value ? spv::OpFOrdGreaterThanEqual : spv::OpFOrdLessThan,
		       TypeBool(state), lhs, rhs);
	const auto ordered = Select(state, TypeF32(state), keep_lhs, lhs, rhs);
	const auto numeric = Select(state, TypeF32(state), both_zero, zero, ordered);
	return Select(state, TypeF32(state), Unary(state, spv::OpIsNan, TypeBool(state), rhs), lhs,
	              numeric);
}

uint32_t EmitMinMaxF32Value(EmitterState& state, uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs, bool max_value) {
	if (state.profile.native_float_min_max) {
		const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32(state), result, GlslStd450(state),
		                          max_value ? GLSLstd450NMax : GLSLstd450NMin, lhs, rhs);
		return result;
	}
	return EmitMinMaxF32(state, lhs, rhs, EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, lhs),
	                     EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, rhs), max_value);
}

uint32_t EmitFPMedTri32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t c) {
	const auto a_bits = EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, a);
	const auto b_bits = EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, b);
	const auto c_bits = EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, c);
	// The NaN path is RDNA2 MIN3, which keeps the later source when two are NaN.
	const auto min_ba = EmitMinMaxF32(state, b, a, b_bits, a_bits, false);
	const auto min3 =
	    EmitMinMaxF32(state, c, min_ba, c_bits, EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, min_ba), false);
	const auto max_ab = EmitMinMaxF32(state, a, b, a_bits, b_bits, true);
	const auto max3 =
	    EmitMinMaxF32(state, max_ab, c, EmitBitcastF32ToU32(state, max_ab), c_bits, true);
	// RDNA2 compares numerically against MAX3, including ties between signed zeros, then takes
	// V_MAX_F32 of the other two sources in their original order.
	const auto a_is_max = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdEqual, TypeBool(state), max3, a);
	const auto b_is_max = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdEqual, TypeBool(state), max3, b);
	const auto x        = Select(state, TypeF32(state), a_is_max, b, a);
	const auto y =
	    Select(state, TypeF32(state), EmitLogicalOrBool(state, a_is_max, b_is_max), c, b);
	const auto median = EmitMinMaxF32Value(state, x, y, true);
	const auto is_nan = [&](uint32_t value) {
		return Unary(state, spv::OpIsNan, TypeBool(state), value);
	};
	const auto any_nan =
	    EmitLogicalOrBool(state, EmitLogicalOrBool(state, is_nan(a), is_nan(b)), is_nan(c));
	return Select(state, TypeF32(state), any_nan, min3, median);
}

uint32_t EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(EmitterState& state, uint32_t value) {
	// x * 0 keeps the sign of a denormal; NaN and infinity fail the ordered compare.
	const auto magnitude = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32(state), magnitude, GlslStd450(state),
	                          GLSLstd450FAbs, value);
	const auto denormal = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdLessThan, TypeBool(state), magnitude,
	                             ConstantF32(state, 0x00800000u));
	return Select(state, TypeF32(state), denormal,
	              Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state), value, ConstantF32(state, 0)), value);
}

uint32_t EmitTrigCycleF32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t src, bool preserve_signed_zero) {
	// Finite values of magnitude 2^23 and above are integers, so fract already gives them +0.
	const auto fract = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32(state), fract, GlslStd450(state),
	                          GLSLstd450Fract, src);
	if (!preserve_signed_zero) {
		return fract;
	}
	const auto abs_bits = Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state),
	                             Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU32(state), src),
	                             ConstantU32(state, 0x7fffffffu));
	return Select(state, TypeF32(state),
	              Binary(state, spv::OpIEqual, TypeBool(state), abs_bits, ConstantU32(state, 0)),
	              src, fract);
}

uint32_t EmitConvertF32F16Lane(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits, IR::Value lane) {
	// UnpackHalf2x16 reads either half directly; hosts select the half in the conversion.
	const auto unpacked = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto ret      = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), unpacked, GlslStd450(state),
	                          GLSLstd450UnpackHalf2x16, bits);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeF32(state), ret, unpacked,
	                          lane.Resolve().U32() != 0u ? 1u : 0u);
	return ret;
}

uint32_t EmitF16BitsToF32(EmitterState& state, uint32_t bits) {
	const auto unpacked = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto ret      = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), unpacked, GlslStd450(state),
	                          GLSLstd450UnpackHalf2x16, bits);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeF32(state), ret, unpacked, 0);
	return ret;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv::Emitter
```
