		values[index] = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
		ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBitFieldSExtract, TypeI32(ctx.state), values[index],
		                              packed, ConstantU32(ctx.state, index * 8u),
		                              ConstantU32(ctx.state, 6));
	}
	const auto result = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
	ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeI32Vector(ctx.state, components),
	                              result, std::span(values).first(components));
	return result;
}

uint32_t HorizontalOffsets(EmitterState& state) {
	const auto count      = ConstantU32(state, 4);
	const auto array_type = state.builder.Type(spv::OpTypeArray, TypeI32Vector(state, 2), count);
	uint32_t   offsets[4] {};
	for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 4u; index++) {
		offsets[index] = state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstantComposite, TypeI32Vector(state, 2),
		                                        ConstantI32(state, static_cast<int32_t>(index) - 1),
		                                        ConstantI32(state, 0));
	}
	return state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstantComposite, array_type, offsets[0], offsets[1],
	                              offsets[2], offsets[3]);
}

uint32_t InverseSwizzle(uint32_t swizzle, uint32_t component) {
	for (uint32_t source = 0; source < 4u; source++) {
		if (((swizzle >> (source * 3u)) & 7u) == 4u + component) return source;
	}
	return UINT32_MAX;
}

Format::BufferFormatInfo ImageConversionFormat(const EmitterState&   state,
                                               const IR::MemoryInfo& mem) {
	const auto& image = state.program.info.images[mem.resource];
	const auto format = image.conversion_format;
	if (format == Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid) return {};
	const auto info = Format::GetFormatInfo(format);
	if (IR::ReadsDepthBits(image)) return info;
	const bool raw_signed = IR::RawSignedStorageFormat(image, format) != Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid;
	EXIT_IF((Prospero::RemapTextureFormat(format) == format && !raw_signed) || info.component_count == 0u ||
	        info.component_count > 4u);
	EXIT_IF(!raw_signed && info.type != Format::ComponentType::Uscaled &&
	        info.type != Format::ComponentType::Sscaled &&
	        ((info.type != Format::ComponentType::Uint &&
	          info.type != Format::ComponentType::Unorm) || !info.packed_bitfield ||
	         info.byte_size != sizeof(uint32_t)));
	return info;
}

// 8 and 8_8 sRGB decode after filtering where the device has no sRGB view of them. Correctly
// rounded multiplies keep 0 and 1, so the view's swizzle constants pass through.
uint32_t DecodeSrgb(EmitterState& state, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t value) {
	const auto format = state.program.info.images[mem.resource].srgb_decode;
	if (format == Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid ||
	    (format == Prospero::BufferFormat::k8Srgb ? state.profile.r8_srgb_views
	                                              : state.profile.r8g8_srgb_views)) {
		return value;
	}
	const auto type     = TypeF32Vector(state, 4);
	const auto constant = [&](float scalar) {
		const auto id = ConstantF32Value(state, scalar);
		return state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstantComposite, type, id, id, id, id);
	};
	const auto curve = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(
	    spv::OpExtInst, type, curve, GlslStd450(state), GLSLstd450Pow,
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, type,
	           Binary(state, spv::OpFAdd, type, value, constant(0.055f)), constant(1.0f / 1.055f)),
	    constant(2.4f));
	const auto low = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdLessThanEqual, TypeBoolVector(state, 4), value,
	                        constant(0.04045f));
	return Select(state, type, low,
	              Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, type, value, constant(1.0f / 12.92f)), curve);
}

uint32_t ExtractPackedImageComponent(EmitterState& state, const Format::BufferFormatInfo& info,
                                     uint32_t packed, uint32_t type, uint32_t component) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBitFieldUExtract, type, result, packed,
	                          ConstantU32(state, info.component_bit_offset[component]),
	                          ConstantU32(state, info.component_bits[component]));
	return result;
}

uint32_t ImageGatherSource(const EmitterState& state, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem) {
	const auto component = ImageGatherComponent(mem.dmask);
	const auto info      = ImageConversionFormat(state, mem);
	if (info.format == Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid) return component;
	if (info.packed_bitfield) return 0u;
	const auto selector =
	    (state.program.info.images[mem.resource].shader_swizzle >> (component * 3u)) & 7u;
	return selector >= 4u ? (selector - 4u) % info.component_count : 0u;
}

// A *SCALED image is backed by the UNorm/SNorm format of the same width; this is the factor
// that turns its normalized texel back into the integer the guest sees (as a float).
float ScaledTexelFactor(const Format::BufferFormatInfo& info) {
	if (info.type != Format::ComponentType::Uscaled && info.type != Format::ComponentType::Sscaled) {
		return 255.0f;
	}
	const auto bits = info.component_bits[0];
	return static_cast<float>(info.type == Format::ComponentType::Sscaled ? (1u << (bits - 1u)) - 1u
	                                                                      : (1u << bits) - 1u);
}

// `exact` is for texel fetches, which return the stored integer exactly after rounding the
// product; filtered samples keep the interpolated value. 8-bit UScaled predates this and keeps
// its unrounded product.
uint32_t UnpackImageTexel(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t texel,
                          bool exact = false) {
	const auto info = ImageConversionFormat(ctx.state, mem);
	if (info.format == Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid) return DecodeSrgb(ctx.state, mem, texel);

	const auto numeric_class = ctx.state.program.info.images[mem.resource].numeric_class;
	const auto scalar_type   = ImageScalarType(ctx.state, numeric_class);
	const bool integer       = info.packed_bitfield || info.type == Format::ComponentType::Uint;
	uint32_t   packed        = 0;
	if (info.packed_bitfield) {
		packed = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
		ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, scalar_type, packed, texel, 0u);
	}
	uint32_t components[4] {};
	for (uint32_t component = 0; component < info.component_count; component++) {
		if (info.packed_bitfield) {
			components[component] =
			    ExtractPackedImageComponent(ctx.state, info, packed, scalar_type, component);
			components[component] =
			    NormalizeFormatComponent(ctx.state, info, component, components[component]);
		} else {
			components[component] = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
			ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, scalar_type,
			                              components[component], texel, component);
			// UNorm/SNorm backing preserves the guest's filtering; scaling precedes swizzle
			// constants.
			const auto scale = info.type == Format::ComponentType::Sscaled
			                       ? ScaledTexelFactor(info)
			                       : static_cast<float>((1u << info.component_bits[component]) - 1u);
			components[component] = Binary(ctx.state, spv::OpFMul, scalar_type, components[component],
			                               ConstantF32Value(ctx.state, scale));
			if (integer) {
				// Depth bits: round back to the stored UNorm code.
				components[component] =
				    Unary(ctx.state, spv::OpConvertFToU, TypeU32(ctx.state),
				          Binary(ctx.state, spv::OpFAdd, scalar_type, components[component],
				                 ConstantF32Value(ctx.state, 0.5f)));
			} else if (exact && (info.type == Format::ComponentType::Sscaled ||
			                     (info.type == Format::ComponentType::Uscaled &&
			                      info.component_bits[0] > 8u))) {
				const auto rounded = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
				ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, scalar_type, rounded,
				                              GlslStd450(ctx.state), GLSLstd450RoundEven,
				                              components[component]);
				components[component] = rounded;
			}
		}
	}
	for (uint32_t component = info.component_count; component < 4u; component++) {
		components[component] = components[component % info.component_count];
	}

	const auto swizzle = ctx.state.program.info.images[mem.resource].shader_swizzle;
	uint32_t   selected[4] {};
	for (uint32_t component = 0; component < 4u; component++) {
		const auto selector = (swizzle >> (component * 3u)) & 7u;
		if (selector == 1u) {
			selected[component] = integer
			    ? ConstantU32(ctx.state, Format::FormattedConstantBits(info, Format::FormattedSourceKind::One))
			    : ConstantF32Value(ctx.state, 1.0f);
		} else if (selector >= 4u) {
			selected[component] = components[selector - 4u];
		} else {
			selected[component] = integer ? ConstantU32(ctx.state, 0u) : ZeroF32(ctx.state);
		}
	}
	const auto result = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
	ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct,
	                              integer ? TypeU32Vector(ctx.state, 4) : TypeF32Vector(ctx.state, 4),
	                              result, selected[0], selected[1], selected[2], selected[3]);
	return info.type == Format::ComponentType::Unorm
	           ? Unary(ctx.state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF32Vector(ctx.state, 4), result) : result;
}

uint32_t UnpackImageGather(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t gathered) {
	const auto info = ImageConversionFormat(ctx.state, mem);
	if (info.format == Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid) {
		return DecodeSrgb(ctx.state, mem, gathered);
	}

	const auto component = ImageGatherComponent(mem.dmask);
	const auto selector =
	    (ctx.state.program.info.images[mem.resource].shader_swizzle >> (component * 3u)) & 7u;
	const auto numeric_class = ctx.state.program.info.images[mem.resource].numeric_class;
	const auto vector_type   = ImageVectorType(ctx.state, numeric_class, 4);
	if (selector < 4u) {
		uint32_t value;
		switch (info.type) {
			case Format::ComponentType::Uscaled:
			case Format::ComponentType::Sscaled:
				value = ConstantF32Value(ctx.state, selector == 1u ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
				break;
			default: value = ConstantU32(ctx.state, selector == 1u ? 1u : 0u); break;
		}
		return ctx.state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstantComposite, vector_type, value, value,
		                                  value, value);
	}
	if (!info.packed_bitfield) {
		const auto scale  = ConstantF32Value(ctx.state, ScaledTexelFactor(info));
		const auto scales = ctx.state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstantComposite, vector_type,
		                                                scale, scale, scale, scale);
		return Binary(ctx.state, spv::OpFMul, vector_type, gathered, scales);
	}

	return ExtractPackedImageComponent(ctx.state, info, gathered, TypeU32Vector(ctx.state, 4),
	                                   (selector - 4u) % info.component_count);
}

uint32_t SamplePackedUnormLz(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t coord) {
	auto& state = ctx.state;
	const auto& image = state.program.info.images[mem.resource];
	const auto info = ImageConversionFormat(state, mem);
	const auto sampled = MakeSampledImage(state, mem.resource,
	                                     LoadSamplerDescriptor(state, mem.sampler));
	const auto gathered = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpImageGather, TypeU32Vector(state, 4), gathered, sampled,
	                          coord, ConstantU32(state, 0u));
	state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityImageQuery);
	const auto size = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpImageQuerySizeLod, TypeU32Vector(state, 2), size,
	                          LoadImageDescriptor(state, mem.resource), ConstantU32(state, 0u));
	const auto size_f32 = Unary(state, spv::OpConvertUToF, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), size);
	const auto half = ConstantF32Value(state, 0.5f);
	const auto halves = state.builder.Constant(spv::OpConstantComposite,
	                                           TypeF32Vector(state, 2), half, half);
	const auto fractions = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(
	    spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), fractions, GlslStd450(state), GLSLstd450Fract,
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFSub, TypeF32Vector(state, 2),
	           Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), coord, size_f32), halves));
	uint32_t fraction[2];
	uint32_t complement[2];
	for (uint32_t axis = 0; axis < 2u; axis++) {
		fraction[axis] = state.builder.AllocateId();
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeF32(state), fraction[axis],
		                          fractions, axis);
		complement[axis] = Binary(state, spv::OpFSub, TypeF32(state),
		                          ConstantF32Value(state, 1.0f), fraction[axis]);
	}
	// Gather order is (x0, y1), (x1, y1), (x1, y0), (x0, y0).
	const auto weights = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(
	    spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeF32Vector(state, 4), weights,
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state), complement[0], fraction[1]),
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state), fraction[0], fraction[1]),
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state), fraction[0], complement[1]),
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state), complement[0], complement[1]));
	uint32_t decoded[4] {};
	uint32_t selected[4] {ZeroF32(state), ZeroF32(state), ZeroF32(state), ZeroF32(state)};
	for (uint32_t component = 0; component < 4u; component++) {
		if ((mem.dmask & (1u << component)) == 0u) continue;
		const auto selector = (image.shader_swizzle >> (component * 3u)) & 7u;
		if (selector == 1u) {
			selected[component] = ConstantF32Value(state, 1.0f);
		} else if (selector >= 4u) {
			const auto physical = (selector - 4u) % info.component_count;
			if (decoded[physical] == 0u) {
				const auto texels = Unary(
				    state, spv::OpConvertUToF, TypeF32Vector(state, 4),
				    ExtractPackedImageComponent(state, info, gathered,
				                                TypeU32Vector(state, 4), physical));
				decoded[physical] = Binary(
				    state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state),
				    Binary(state, spv::OpDot, TypeF32(state), texels, weights),
				    ConstantF32Value(state, 1.0f / ((1u << info.component_bits[physical]) - 1u)));
			}
			selected[component] = decoded[physical];
		}
	}
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeF32Vector(state, 4), result,
	                          selected[0], selected[1], selected[2], selected[3]);
	return result;
}

uint32_t StoreTexel(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t data, bool integer) {
	const auto swizzle = ctx.state.program.info.images[mem.resource].shader_swizzle;
	const auto info = ImageConversionFormat(ctx.state, mem);
	const bool converted = info.format != Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid;
	const bool packed = info.packed_bitfield;
	EXIT_IF(converted && info.type != Format::ComponentType::Sint &&
	        (!packed || (info.type != Format::ComponentType::Uint &&
	                     info.type != Format::ComponentType::Unorm)));
	const auto zero = ConstantU32(ctx.state, 0);
	uint32_t values[4] {zero, zero, zero, zero};
	auto packed_value = zero;
	const auto dmask = mem.dmask != 0u ? mem.dmask : 1u;
	for (uint32_t component = 0; component < (converted ? info.component_count : 4u); component++) {
		const auto source = InverseSwizzle(swizzle, component);
		const bool selected = source < 4u && ((dmask >> source) & 1u) != 0u;
		uint32_t raw = zero;
		if (selected) {
			const auto packed_index = DmaskComponentIndex(dmask, source);
			raw                     = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
			ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeU32(ctx.state), raw, data,
			                              mem.data_bits == 16u ? packed_index / 2u : packed_index);
			if (mem.data_bits == 16u) {
				if ((packed_index & 1u) != 0u) {
					raw = Binary(ctx.state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(ctx.state), raw,
					             ConstantU32(ctx.state, 16u));
				}
				if (!packed) {
					raw = Binary(ctx.state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(ctx.state), raw,
					             ConstantU32(ctx.state, 0xffffu));
				}
			}
		}
		if (converted) {
			if (!selected) continue;
			if (!packed) {
				values[component] =
				    EncodeFormattedStoreComponent(ctx.state, info, component, raw, mem.data_bits);
				continue;
			}
			const auto value =
			    EncodePackedColorComponent(ctx.state, info, component, raw, mem.data_bits);
			packed_value = packed_value == zero ? value
			    : Binary(ctx.state, spv::OpBitwiseOr, TypeU32(ctx.state), packed_value, value);
			continue;
		}
		values[component] = integer ? raw
		                    : mem.data_bits == 16u
		                        ? EmitF16BitsToF32(ctx.state, raw)
		                        : Unary(ctx.state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeF32(ctx.state), raw);
	}
	if (packed) values[0] = packed_value;
	const auto texel = ctx.state.builder.AllocateId();
	ctx.state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct,
	                              integer ? TypeU32Vector(ctx.state, 4)
	                                      : TypeF32Vector(ctx.state, 4),
	                              texel, values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3]);
	return texel;
}

template <typename Emit>
auto EmitImageAccess(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst, uint32_t result_type,
                     const Emit& emit) {
	auto& state = ctx.state;
	const auto& mem = ctx.Memory(inst);
	const auto& image = state.program.info.images.at(mem.resource);
	if (image.table_capacity != 0u) return emit(mem.resource, ImageTableElement(ctx, inst, image));
	if (image.indirect_root != mem.resource) return emit(mem.resource, 0u);
	const auto* handle = inst.Arg(0).ResolveInstruction();
	const auto* source = image.source < state.program.descriptor_sources.size()
	                         ? &state.program.descriptor_sources[image.source]
	                         : nullptr;
	if (handle == nullptr || source == nullptr || !source->indirect_descriptor.has_value() ||
	    handle->NumArgs() == 0u) {
		ctx.Fail(inst, "has invalid indirect image key provenance");
	}
	const auto key = ctx.Def(handle->Arg(0));
	if (state.flattened_srt_variable == 0 ||
	    image.indirect_resources.size() < 2u) {
		ctx.Fail(inst, "has no indirect image runtime mapping");
	}
	if (image.heap) {
		// The blocks a record-table root's records name hold slots of its list, whose slot count
		// and address precede the mapping.
		const auto entry = IsRecordTableSource(state, image.source)
		    ? EmitImageHeapEntry(state,
		                         Binary(state, spv::OpShiftLeftLogical, TypeU32(state),
		                                EmitRecordTableIndex(state, key, ctx.Def(handle->Arg(1)),
		                                                     image.indirect_mapping_offset,
		                                                     image.indirect_search_iterations),
		                                ConstantU32(state, 2u)),
		                         image.indirect_mapping_offset - 3u)
		    : EmitImageHeapEntry(state, key, image.indirect_mapping_offset);
		const auto kinds = static_cast<uint32_t>(image.indirect_resources.size()) - 1u;
		// One kind leaves every slot word a bare element.
		if (kinds == 1u) return emit(image.indirect_resources[1], entry);
		const auto element = Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), entry,
		                            ConstantU32(state, (1u << IR::ImageHeapKindShift) - 1u));
		const auto EmitKind = [&](uint32_t kind) {
			return emit(image.indirect_resources[kind + 1u], element);
		};
		return EmitIndexSwitch(state,
		                       Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), entry,
		                              ConstantU32(state, IR::ImageHeapKindShift)),
		                       kinds, result_type, EmitKind);
	}
	const auto selected = IsRecordTableSource(state, image.source)
	    ? EmitRecordTableIndex(state, key, ctx.Def(handle->Arg(1)), image.indirect_mapping_offset,
	                           image.indirect_search_iterations)
	    : EmitIndirectResourceIndex(state, key, image.indirect_mapping_offset,
	                                image.indirect_search_iterations, 0u);
	const auto SameType = [&](uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {
		const auto& first = state.program.info.images[lhs];
		const auto& second = state.program.info.images[rhs];
		return first.dimension == second.dimension && first.cube == second.cube &&
		       IR::DescriptorBindingForImage(first) == IR::DescriptorBindingForImage(second) &&
		       (inst.GetOpcode() != IR::ValueOpcode::ImageWrite ||
		        first.shader_swizzle == second.shader_swizzle) &&
		       first.mip_count == 1u && second.mip_count == 1u;
	};
	// Descriptor order is unrelated to image type. Share each typed access and
	// select its descriptor slot independently, including gaps between native roots.
	struct ImageGroup { uint32_t resource; uint32_t count; };
	std::vector<ImageGroup> groups;
	std::vector<uint32_t> ordinal_groups;
	for (const auto resource: image.indirect_resources) {
		const auto found = std::ranges::find_if(groups, [&](const ImageGroup& group) {
			return SameType(resource, group.resource);
		});
		ordinal_groups.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(found - groups.begin()));
		if (found == groups.end()) groups.push_back({resource, 1u});
		else ++found->count;
	}
	const bool dynamic_slot = std::ranges::any_of(groups, [](const ImageGroup& group) {
		return group.count > 1u;
	});
	auto group_index = ConstantU32(state, 0u);
	auto slot_bias = ConstantU32(state, image.descriptor_index);
	auto previous_bias = image.descriptor_index;
	for (uint32_t ordinal = 1; ordinal < image.indirect_resources.size(); ++ordinal) {
		const auto& candidate = state.program.info.images[image.indirect_resources[ordinal]];
		const auto bias = candidate.descriptor_index - ordinal;
		const bool select_group = ordinal_groups[ordinal] != ordinal_groups[ordinal - 1u];
		const bool select_slot = dynamic_slot && bias != previous_bias;
		previous_bias = bias;
		if (!select_group && !select_slot) continue;
		const auto at_or_after = Binary(state, spv::OpUGreaterThanEqual, TypeBool(state),
		                               selected, ConstantU32(state, ordinal));
		if (select_group) group_index = Select(state, TypeU32(state), at_or_after,
		                                      ConstantU32(state, ordinal_groups[ordinal]), group_index);
		if (select_slot) slot_bias = Select(state, TypeU32(state), at_or_after,
		                                   ConstantU32(state, bias), slot_bias);
	}
	const auto slot = dynamic_slot
	    ? Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), selected, slot_bias) : 0u;
	const auto EmitGroup = [&](uint32_t index) {
		const auto& group = groups[index];
		return emit(group.resource, group.count == 1u ? 0u : slot);
	};
	return groups.size() == 1u
	           ? EmitGroup(0u)
	           : EmitIndexSwitch(state, group_index, static_cast<uint32_t>(groups.size()),
	                             result_type, EmitGroup);
}

template <typename Emit>
uint32_t EmitImageResult(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst, const Emit& emit) {
	auto& state = ctx.state;
	const auto& mem = ctx.Memory(inst);
	const auto& image = state.program.info.images[mem.resource];
	const bool gather = inst.GetOpcode() == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageGatherRaw;
	const bool dref = HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagCompare);
	const bool scalar = dref && !gather;
	const bool mixed = std::ranges::any_of(image.indirect_resources, [&](uint32_t resource) {
		return state.program.info.images[resource].numeric_class != image.numeric_class;
	});
	const auto native_type = [&](uint32_t resource) {
		return scalar ? TypeF32(state) : ImageVectorType(
		    state, dref ? Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float
		                : state.program.info.images[resource].numeric_class, 4);
	};
	const auto result_bits = [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t value) {
		auto candidate_mem = mem;
		candidate_mem.resource = resource;
		if (!scalar) {
			value = gather ? UnpackImageGather(ctx, candidate_mem, value)
			               : UnpackImageTexel(ctx, candidate_mem, value,
			                                  inst.GetOpcode() == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageRead);
		}
		return ResultVector(ctx, value,
		                    dref ? Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float
		                         : state.program.info.images[resource].numeric_class,
		                    scalar, candidate_mem, gather);
	};
	// RDNA returns register bits. Convert per typed run only when the join mixes
	// numeric classes; homogeneous accesses keep their single conversion after it.
	const auto value = EmitImageAccess(
	    ctx, inst, mixed ? TypeU32Vector(state, 4) : native_type(mem.resource),
	    [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index) {
		    const auto native = emit(resource, array_index, native_type(resource));
		    return mixed ? result_bits(resource, native) : native;
	    });
	return mixed ? value : result_bits(mem.resource, value);
}

// Ordinals outside the table select candidates[0]. Past ordinal 0, a consecutive table is an
// offset of ordinal - 1, which wraps at 0 so that one unsigned compare checks both ends.
uint32_t SamplerArrayIndex(EmitterState& state, uint32_t ordinal,
                           const std::vector<uint32_t>& candidates) {
	const auto count = static_cast<uint32_t>(candidates.size());
	const auto gap = std::adjacent_find(candidates.begin() + 1, candidates.end(),
	    [](uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) { return rhs != lhs + 1u; });
	if (count == 1u || gap != candidates.end()) {
		return EmitIndexSwitch(state, ordinal, count, TypeU32(state),
		                       [&](uint32_t item) { return ConstantU32(state, candidates[item]); });
	}
	const auto offset = Binary(state, spv::OpISub, TypeU32(state), ordinal, ConstantU32(state, 1u));
	const auto in_table = Binary(state, spv::OpULessThan, TypeBool(state), offset,
	                             ConstantU32(state, count - 1u));
	const auto index = Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), offset,
	                          ConstantU32(state, candidates[1]));
	return Select(state, TypeU32(state), in_table, index, ConstantU32(state, candidates[0]));
}

struct ImageSampler {
	uint32_t id = 0;
	bool dynamic = false;
};

std::array<ImageSampler, 2> LoadImageSamplers(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst) {
	auto& state = ctx.state;
	const auto& mem = ctx.Memory(inst);
	const auto& samplers = state.program.info.samplers;
	const auto& root = samplers.at(mem.sampler);
	std::array<ImageSampler, 2> result {};
	const auto load = [&](const IR::ImageResource& image) {
		const bool integer = image.numeric_class != Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float;
		auto& sampler = result[integer];
		if (sampler.id != 0u) return;
		uint32_t index = mem.sampler;
		if (root.integer_border != integer) {
			const auto found = std::ranges::find_if(samplers, [&](const auto& candidate) {
				return candidate.snapshot_index == root.snapshot_index &&
				       candidate.integer_border == integer;
			});
			if (found == samplers.end()) ctx.Fail(inst, "has no typed sampler variant");
			index = static_cast<uint32_t>(found - samplers.begin());
		}
		uint32_t array_index = 0;
		const auto& candidates = samplers[index].indirect_resources;
		if (!candidates.empty()) {
			const auto* handle = inst.Arg(1).ResolveInstruction();
			if (handle == nullptr || handle->GetOpcode() != IR::ValueOpcode::GetSamplerResource)
				ctx.Fail(inst, "has invalid finite sampler key provenance");
			auto selected = ctx.Def(handle->Arg(0));
			if (samplers[index].indirect_root != IR::SamplerResource::NoIndirectSampler)
				selected = IsRecordTableSource(state, samplers[index].source)
				    ? EmitRecordTableIndex(state, selected, ctx.Def(handle->Arg(1)),
				                           samplers[index].indirect_mapping_offset,
				                           samplers[index].indirect_search_iterations)
				    : EmitIndirectResourceIndex(state, selected,
				          samplers[index].indirect_mapping_offset,
				          samplers[index].indirect_search_iterations, 0u);
			array_index = SamplerArrayIndex(state, selected, candidates);
		}
		sampler = {LoadSamplerDescriptor(state, index, array_index), array_index != 0u};
	};
	const auto& image = state.program.info.images[mem.resource];
	load(image);
	for (const auto candidate: image.indirect_resources) load(state.program.info.images[candidate]);
	return result;
}

// GET_LOD_STATS feedback. The per-draw shader data holds one field per image
// (LodStatsReport::ImageField): counter id in bits 0..7, T# BASE_LEVEL in bits 8..11, bit 15 = no
// counter, U4.8 count threshold (T# MIN_LOD) in bits 16..27. The mip_stats buffer holds 257
// finest-level words followed by 257 counts. The field is uniform per draw, so one lane per
// subgroup records the subgroup's finest level and whether any lane counts.
constexpr uint32_t MipStatsEntries       = 257;
constexpr uint32_t MipStatsNoCounterFlag = 0x8000u;

uint32_t MipStatsElement(EmitterState& state, uint32_t index) {
	const auto pointer = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAccessChain, TypeStorageBufferElementPointer(state), pointer,
	                          state.mip_stats_variable, ConstantU32(state, 0), index);
	return pointer;
}

struct MipStatsSample {
	uint32_t finest  = 0; // subgroup minimum of the absolute mip level
	uint32_t counted = 0; // 1 when a lane's level is below the field's threshold
};

// The finest mip a sample wanted, as an absolute level: floor of the unclamped LOD plus the view's
// BASE_LEVEL, limited to 0..14, reduced to the subgroup minimum. A lane counts when that level is
// below the T# MIN_LOD: the resident-level clamp raised the sample.
MipStatsSample EmitMipStatsSample(EmitterState& state, uint32_t field, uint32_t lod) {
	state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityGroupNonUniform);
	state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityGroupNonUniformArithmetic);
	const auto base_level = Binary(
	    state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state),
	    Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), field, ConstantU32(state, 8)),
	    ConstantU32(state, 0xfu));
	// The queried LOD is relative to the view's base level.
	const auto absolute = Binary(state, spv::OpFAdd, TypeF32(state), lod,
	                             Unary(state, spv::OpConvertUToF, TypeF32(state), base_level));
	const auto clamped  = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32(state), clamped, GlslStd450(state),
	                          GLSLstd450FClamp, absolute, ConstantF32Value(state, 0.0f),
	                          ConstantF32Value(state, 14.0f));
	const auto floored = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpExtInst, TypeF32(state), floored, GlslStd450(state),
	                          GLSLstd450Floor, clamped);
	const auto level = Unary(state, spv::OpConvertFToU, TypeU32(state), floored);
	MipStatsSample sample;
	sample.finest = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpGroupNonUniformUMin, TypeU32(state), sample.finest,
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeSubgroup), spv::GroupOperationReduce,
	                          level);
	// Compared with the clamped level, so that magnification (a LOD below 0) of a texture whose
	// MIN_LOD is 0 is not a clamp.
	const auto threshold_fixed = Binary(
	    state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state),
	    Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), field, ConstantU32(state, 16)),
	    ConstantU32(state, 0xfffu));
	const auto threshold =
	    Binary(state, spv::OpFMul, TypeF32(state),
	           Unary(state, spv::OpConvertUToF, TypeF32(state), threshold_fixed),
	           ConstantF32Value(state, 1.0f / 256.0f));
	const auto below = Binary(state, spv::OpFOrdLessThan, TypeBool(state), clamped, threshold);
	const auto below_u32 =
	    Select(state, TypeU32(state), below, ConstantU32(state, 1), ConstantU32(state, 0));
	sample.counted = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpGroupNonUniformUMax, TypeU32(state), sample.counted,
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeSubgroup), spv::GroupOperationReduce,
	                          below_u32);
	return sample;
}

// Recording for an image whose T# has a counter (checked by the caller, uniformly per draw). Per
// subgroup, one lane
//  - issues the finest-level AtomicUMin only when a relaxed atomic load shows a larger value. The
//    finest words only decrease between resets (UMin is their only shader writer, and the resets
//    are transfer fills ordered against all shader access), so a skipped UMin would not change
//    the word;
//  - adds 1 to the count when a lane counted (the game only tests the count for zero).
void EmitMipStatsRecord(EmitterState& state, uint32_t field, uint32_t lod) {
	const auto counter =
	    Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), field, ConstantU32(state, 0xffu));
	const auto sample  = EmitMipStatsSample(state, field, lod);
	const auto elected = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpGroupNonUniformElect, TypeBool(state), elected,
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeSubgroup));
	EmitIfCondition(state, elected, [&]() {
		const auto finest_pointer = MipStatsElement(state, counter);
		const auto current        = state.builder.AllocateId();
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAtomicLoad, TypeU32(state), current, finest_pointer,
		                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeDevice),
		                          ConstantU32(state, spv::MemorySemanticsMaskNone));
		const auto lower =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpULessThan, TypeBool(state), sample.finest, current);
		EmitIfCondition(state, lower, [&]() {
			const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
			state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAtomicUMin, TypeU32(state), result, finest_pointer,
			                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeDevice),
			                          ConstantU32(state, spv::MemorySemanticsMaskNone),
			                          sample.finest);
		});
		const auto any =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpINotEqual, TypeBool(state), sample.counted, ConstantU32(state, 0));
		EmitIfCondition(state, any, [&]() {
			const auto count_index = Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), counter,
			                                ConstantU32(state, MipStatsEntries));
			const auto result      = state.builder.AllocateId();
			state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAtomicIAdd, TypeU32(state), result,
			                          MipStatsElement(state, count_index),
			                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeDevice),
			                          ConstantU32(state, spv::MemorySemanticsMaskNone),
			                          ConstantU32(state, 1));
		});
	});
}

} // namespace

void EmitImage(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst) {
	const auto op         = inst.GetOpcode();
	const auto image_info = IR::ImageOpcodeInfoOf(op);
	auto&       state     = ctx.state;
	const auto& mem       = ctx.Memory(inst);
	const auto  image_arg = inst.Arg(0);
	ctx.ResourceIndex(image_arg, IR::ValueOpcode::GetImageResource);
	const auto& image   = state.program.info.images.at(mem.resource);
	const auto* address = ctx.ImageAddress(inst.Arg(image_info.needs_sampler ? 2 : 1));
	if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageQueryDimensions) {
		state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityImageQuery);
		ctx.Define(inst, EmitImageAccess(ctx, inst, TypeU32Vector(state, 4),
		    [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index) {
			    return QueryDimensions(ctx, mem, *address, resource, array_index);
		    }));
		return;
	}
	if (image_info.needs_sampler &&
	    image.conversion_format == Prospero::BufferFormat::k11_11_10UNorm) {
		if (op != IR::ValueOpcode::ImageSampleRaw ||
		    image.dimension != ImageDimension::Dim2D ||
		    mem.image_dimension != ImageDimension::Dim2D || mem.data_bits != 32u ||
		    mem.image_sample_flags != Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLevelZero ||
		    image.indirect_root != IR::ImageResource::NoIndirectImage ||
		    !state.program.info.samplers.at(mem.sampler).indirect_resources.empty()) {
			ctx.Fail(inst, "packed UNorm sampling requires a direct 2D sample_lz");
			return;
		}
		const auto coord = CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, Layout(mem).coord, 2u);
		ctx.Define(inst, ResultVector(ctx, SamplePackedUnormLz(ctx, mem, coord),
		                              Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float, false, mem));
		return;
	}
	if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageQueryLod) {
		state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityImageQuery);
		const auto sampler = LoadSamplerDescriptor(state, mem.sampler);
		const auto lod = EmitImageAccess(ctx, inst, TypeF32Vector(state, 2),
		    [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index) {
			    const auto& candidate = state.program.info.images[resource];
			    const auto query = state.builder.AllocateId();
			    state.builder.AddFunction(
			        spv::OpImageQueryLod, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), query,
			        MakeSampledImage(state, resource, sampler, 0u, array_index),
			        CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, 0,
			                 ImageDimensionInfoFor(candidate.dimension).spatial_components,
			                 candidate.cube, RowCenter(state, candidate.dimension)));
			    return query;
		    });
		uint32_t values[4] = {ConstantU32(state, 0), ConstantU32(state, 0), ConstantU32(state, 0),
		                      ConstantU32(state, 0)};
		for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 2u; index++) {
			const auto component = state.builder.AllocateId();
			state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeF32(state), component, lod,
			                          index);
			values[index] = FloatBits(ctx, component);
		}
		const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeU32Vector(state, 4), result,
		                          values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3]);
		ctx.Define(inst, result);
		return;
	}
	if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageRead) {
		const auto condition = ctx.Arg(inst, 2);
		ctx.Define(
		    inst,
		    EmitValueOrDefaultIfCondition(
		        state, condition, TypeU32Vector(state, 4), ConstantU32CompositeZero(state, 4),
		        [&]() {
			        return EmitImageResult(
			            ctx, inst, [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index, uint32_t result_type) {
				        const auto& candidate = state.program.info.images[resource];
				        const auto dimension = candidate.dimension;
				        const auto& dimension_info = ImageDimensionInfoFor(dimension);
				        const auto descriptor = LoadImageDescriptor(state, resource, 0u, array_index);
				        const auto fetched = state.builder.AllocateId();
				        const auto coord = CoordU32(ctx, mem, *address, dimension);
				        if (dimension_info.multisampled != 0u) {
					        state.builder.AddFunction(
					            spv::OpImageFetch, result_type, fetched,
					            descriptor, coord, spv::ImageOperandsSampleMask,
					            AddressU32(ctx, mem, *address, dimension_info.coordinate_components));
				        } else {
					        state.builder.AddFunction(
					            spv::OpImageFetch, result_type, fetched,
					            descriptor, coord, spv::ImageOperandsLodMask,
					            LodU32(ctx, mem, *address, mem.image_dimension));
				        }
				        return fetched;
			            });
		        }));
		return;
	}
	if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageWrite) {
		EmitIfCondition(state, ctx.Arg(inst, 3), [&]() {
			EmitImageAccess(ctx, inst, 0u, [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index) {
				const auto& candidate = state.program.info.images[resource];
				auto selected = mem;
				selected.resource = resource;
				const auto mip_lod = candidate.mip_mode == IR::ImageMipMode::Dynamic
				    ? LodU32(ctx, mem, *address, mem.image_dimension) : 0u;
				const auto coord = CoordU32(ctx, mem, *address, candidate.dimension);
				const auto& dimension_info = ImageDimensionInfoFor(candidate.dimension);
				const auto sample = dimension_info.multisampled != 0u
				    ? AddressU32(ctx, mem, *address, dimension_info.coordinate_components) : 0u;
				const auto texel = StoreTexel(ctx, selected, ctx.Arg(inst, 2),
				    candidate.numeric_class == Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Uint);
				EmitStorageImageWrite(state, resource, mip_lod, coord, texel, array_index, sample);
			});
		});
		return;
	}
	if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageSampleRaw || op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageGatherRaw) {
		const auto  dimension      = image.dimension;
		const auto& dimension_info = ImageDimensionInfoFor(dimension);
		const auto  layout         = Layout(mem);
		const bool  dref           = HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagCompare);
		IR::Value offset_value;
		if (layout.offset != NoImageComponent) {
			const auto value = address->Arg(layout.offset).Resolve();
			offset_value = IR::ResolveActiveU32(value, inst.Arg(inst.NumArgs() - 1u).Resolve());
			if (offset_value.IsEmpty()) offset_value = value;
		}
		if (dref && state.program.info.images[mem.resource].conversion_format !=
		                Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid) {
			ctx.Fail(inst, "uses depth comparison with a converted image");
			return;
		}
		if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageGatherRaw) {
			uint32_t component_or_dref;
			if (dref) {
				component_or_dref = layout.dref != NoImageComponent
				                        ? AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.dref)
				                        : ZeroF32(state);
			} else {
				component_or_dref = ConstantU32(state, ImageGatherSource(state, mem));
			}
			const auto samplers = LoadImageSamplers(ctx, inst);
			const auto EmitGather = [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index, uint32_t result_type) {
				const auto& candidate = state.program.info.images[resource];
				const auto sampler = samplers[candidate.numeric_class != Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float];
				const auto dimension = candidate.dimension;
				const auto coord = CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.coord,
				                            ImageDimensionInfoFor(dimension).coordinate_components,
				                            candidate.cube, RowCenter(state, dimension));
				uint32_t operand_mask = 0;
				uint32_t offset = 0;
				if (HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagGatherHorizontal)) {
					operand_mask = spv::ImageOperandsConstOffsetsMask;
					offset       = HorizontalOffsets(state);
				} else if (layout.offset != NoImageComponent) {
					offset = PackedOffset(ctx, offset_value, dimension, operand_mask);
				}
				const auto EmitMip = [&](uint32_t mip) {
					const auto sampled = MakeSampledImage(state, resource, sampler.id, mip, array_index,
					                                      sampler.dynamic);
					const auto sample = state.builder.AllocateId();
					const std::array operands {operand_mask, offset};
					state.builder.AddFunction(
					    dref ? spv::OpImageDrefGather : spv::OpImageGather, result_type,
					    sample, sampled, coord, component_or_dref,
					    std::span(operands).first(operand_mask != 0u ? 2u : 0u));
					return sample;
				};
				const auto gathered =
				    candidate.mip_mode == IR::ImageMipMode::Dynamic && candidate.mip_count > 1u
				        ? EmitIndexSwitch(
				              state,
				              GatherMip(ctx, inst, mem, *address, layout, candidate.mip_count),
				              candidate.mip_count, result_type, EmitMip)
				        : EmitMip(0u);
				// Host row 0 holds a 1D image's texels in w and z; x and y read row 1, which is out
				// of range. Horizontal gathers read row 0 in every component.
				if (!ImageDimensionInfoFor(dimension).one_dimensional ||
				    HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagGatherHorizontal)) {
					return gathered;
				}
				const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
				state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpVectorShuffle, result_type, result, gathered,
				                          gathered, 3u, 2u, 2u, 3u);
				return result;
			};
			ctx.Define(inst, EmitImageResult(ctx, inst, EmitGather));
			return;
		}
		const bool explicit_lod = HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagDerivative) ||
		                          HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLod) ||
		                          HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLevelZero) ||
		                          state.program.stage != ShaderType::Pixel;
		auto       opcode       = spv::OpImageSampleImplicitLod;
		if (explicit_lod) {
			opcode = dref ? spv::OpImageSampleDrefExplicitLod : spv::OpImageSampleExplicitLod;
		} else if (dref) {
			opcode = spv::OpImageSampleDrefImplicitLod;
		}
		uint32_t dref_value  = 0;
		if (dref) {
			dref_value  = ZeroF32(state);
			if (layout.dref != NoImageComponent) {
				dref_value = AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.dref);
			}
		}
		// _cl clamps the computed LOD from below.
		uint32_t min_lod = 0;
		if (layout.clamp != NoImageComponent) {
			min_lod = AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.clamp);
		}
		std::array<uint32_t, 5> operands {};
		size_t operand_count = 0;
		if (HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagDerivative)) {
			// A 1D image's host row does not vary.
			const auto row = dimension_info.one_dimensional ? ZeroF32(state) : 0u;
			operands[0]    = spv::ImageOperandsGradMask;
			operands[1]    = CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.grad_x,
			                          dimension_info.spatial_components, false, row);
			operands[2]    = CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.grad_y,
			                          dimension_info.spatial_components, false, row);
			operand_count  = 3;
		} else if (explicit_lod) {
			auto lod = ZeroF32(state);
			if (HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLod) && layout.lod != NoImageComponent) {
				lod = AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.lod);
			}
			// SPIR-V takes MinLod only with implicit LOD or Grad.
			if (min_lod != 0) {
				lod     = EmitGlsl<GLSLstd450FMax, IR::Type::F32>(state, lod, min_lod);
				min_lod = 0;
			}
			operands[0] = spv::ImageOperandsLodMask;
			operands[1] = lod;
			operand_count = 2;
		} else if (layout.bias != NoImageComponent) {
			operands[0] = spv::ImageOperandsBiasMask;
			operands[1] = AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.bias);
			operand_count = 2;
		}
		if (layout.offset != NoImageComponent && !offset_value.IsImmediate() &&
		    !state.profile.maintenance8) {
			ctx.Fail(inst, "requires maintenance8 for a dynamic sample texel offset");
		}
		const auto samplers = LoadImageSamplers(ctx, inst);
		const auto EmitSample = [&](uint32_t resource, uint32_t array_index, uint32_t result_type) {
			const auto& candidate = state.program.info.images[resource];
			const auto sampler = samplers[candidate.numeric_class != Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float];
			auto sample_operands = operands;
			auto sample_operand_count = operand_count;
			if (layout.offset != NoImageComponent) {
				sample_operand_count = std::max(size_t{1}, sample_operand_count);
				sample_operands[sample_operand_count++] = PackedOffset(
				    ctx, offset_value, candidate.dimension, sample_operands[0]);
			}
			// MinLod follows the offset in operand order.
			if (min_lod != 0) {
				state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityMinLod);
				sample_operand_count = std::max(size_t{1}, sample_operand_count);
				sample_operands[0] |= spv::ImageOperandsMinLodMask;
				sample_operands[sample_operand_count++] = min_lod;
			}
			const auto coord =
			    CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.coord,
			             ImageDimensionInfoFor(candidate.dimension).coordinate_components,
			             candidate.cube, RowCenter(state, candidate.dimension));
			const auto sampled = MakeSampledImage(state, resource, sampler.id, 0u, array_index,
			                                      sampler.dynamic);
			const auto sample = state.builder.AllocateId();
			state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, result_type, sample, sampled, coord,
			                          std::span(&dref_value, dref ? 1u : 0u),
			                          std::span<const uint32_t>(sample_operands).first(sample_operand_count));
			// GET_LOD_STATS feedback for an image whose T# the draw supplies (a dynamically
			// selected slot of a group of images has no single field).
			if (state.mip_stats_variable != 0 && state.mip_stats_records && array_index == 0u &&
			    !candidate.heap && candidate.table_capacity == 0u &&
			    resource < state.program.bindings.mip_stats_count) {
				// The field is uniform per draw: without a counter, the LOD query and the atomics
				// are skipped.
				const auto field = EmitShaderDataDwordLoad(
				    state, state.program.bindings.MipStatsDword() + resource);
				const auto has_counter = Binary(
				    state, spv::OpIEqual, TypeBool(state),
				    Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), field,
				           ConstantU32(state, MipStatsNoCounterFlag)),
				    ConstantU32(state, 0));
				EmitIfCondition(state, has_counter, [&]() {
					auto lod = ZeroF32(state);
					if (HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLevelZero)) {
						// Level 0 explicitly.
					} else if (HasFlag(mem, Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLod) &&
					           layout.lod != NoImageComponent) {
						lod = AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.lod);
					} else {
						// Implicit or gradient sampling: the unclamped LOD (before MIN_LOD and the
						// resident range), which is what a texture streamer needs to know.
						// OpSampledImage must sit in the block of its consumer.
						state.builder.RequireCapability(spv::CapabilityImageQuery);
						const auto query = state.builder.AllocateId();
						state.builder.AddFunction(
						    spv::OpImageQueryLod, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), query,
						    MakeSampledImage(state, resource, sampler.id, 0u, 0u, sampler.dynamic),
						    CoordF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.coord,
						             ImageDimensionInfoFor(candidate.dimension).spatial_components,
						             candidate.cube, RowCenter(state, candidate.dimension)));
						lod = state.builder.AllocateId();
						state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeExtract, TypeF32(state), lod,
						                          query, 1u);
						// IMAGE_SAMPLE_B: the shader bias adds to the computed LOD.
						if (!explicit_lod && layout.bias != NoImageComponent) {
							lod = Binary(state, spv::OpFAdd, TypeF32(state), lod,
							             AddressF32(ctx, mem, *address, layout.bias));
						}
					}
					EmitMipStatsRecord(state, field, lod);
				});
			}
			return sample;
		};
		ctx.Define(inst, EmitImageResult(ctx, inst, EmitSample));
		return;
	}
	if (image_info.access == IR::ImageAccess::Atomic) {
		const auto dimension = image.dimension;
		const auto result_type = TypeId(state, inst.GetType());
		const auto zero = image.atomic64 ? ConstantU64(state, 0) : ConstantU32(state, 0);
		ctx.Define(inst, EmitValueOrDefaultIfCondition(
		                     state, ctx.Arg(inst, inst.NumArgs() - 1), result_type, zero, [&]() {
			           const auto pointer      = state.builder.AllocateId();
			           const auto pointer_type =
			               state.builder.Type(spv::OpTypePointer, spv::StorageClassImage,
			                                  image.atomic64 ? TypeU64(state) : TypeU32(state));
			           state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpImageTexelPointer, pointer_type, pointer,
			                                     ImageDescriptorPointer(state, mem.resource),
			                                     CoordU32(ctx, mem, *address, dimension),
			                                     ConstantU32(state, 0));
			           if (op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageAtomicFMin32 ||
			               op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageAtomicFMax32) {
				           return AtomicUpdate(state, pointer, IR::ResourceKind::Image,
				                               [&](uint32_t old) {
					                               return EmitFloatAtomicReplacement(
					                                   state, old, ctx.Arg(inst, 2),
					                                   op == IR::ValueOpcode::ImageAtomicFMax32);
				                               });
			           }
			           const auto old = EmitAtomicOperation(ctx, inst, pointer, spv::ScopeDevice);
			           EmitAtomicMemoryBarrier(state, IR::ResourceKind::Image);
			           return old;
		           }));
		return;
	}
	ctx.Fail(inst, "has no image SPIR-V emitter");
}

bool IsImageTableSampleLod(const EmitterState& state, const IR::Inst& inst) {
	if (inst.GetOpcode() != IR::ValueOpcode::ImageSampleRaw || state.flattened_srt_variable == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto& mem   = state.program.memory_info.at(inst.Flags<IR::MemoryFlags>().index);
	const auto& image = state.program.info.images.at(mem.resource);
	return mem.image_sample_flags == Decoder::ImageSampleFlagLod && mem.data_bits == 32u &&
	       image.table_capacity != 0u && image.table_descriptor_base != UINT32_MAX &&
	       image.dimension == ImageDimension::Dim2D && !image.cube &&
	       image.numeric_class == Prospero::TextureNumericClass::Float &&
	       image.conversion_format == Prospero::BufferFormat::kInvalid;
}

// As the instruction's own sample (EmitImage), with the table entry, coordinates and level given.
uint32_t EmitImageTableSampleLod(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& sample, uint32_t key,
                                 uint32_t u, uint32_t v, uint32_t lod) {
	auto&       state    = ctx.state;
	const auto& mem      = ctx.Memory(sample);
	const auto& image    = state.program.info.images.at(mem.resource);
	const auto  samplers = LoadImageSamplers(ctx, sample);
	const auto& sampler  = samplers[0];
	const auto  sampled  = MakeSampledImage(state, mem.resource, sampler.id, 0u,
	                                        ImageTableSlot(state, image, key), sampler.dynamic);
	const auto  coord    = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeF32Vector(state, 2), coord, u, v);
	const auto texel = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpImageSampleExplicitLod,
	                          ImageVectorType(state, image.numeric_class, 4), texel, sampled, coord,
	                          spv::ImageOperandsLodMask, lod);
	return ResultVector(ctx, UnpackImageTexel(ctx, mem, texel), image.numeric_class, false, mem);
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv::Emitter

template <spv::Op opcode>
uint32_t EmitShift64(ValueEmitContext& ctx, uint32_t value, IR::Value shift) {
	shift = shift.Resolve();
	if (shift.IsImmediate()) {
		const auto amount = shift.U32() & 63u;
		return amount == 0u ? value
		                    : Binary(ctx.state, opcode, TypeU64(ctx.state), value,
		                             ConstantU32(ctx.state, amount));
	}
	return Binary(ctx.state, opcode, TypeU64(ctx.state), value,
	              EmitAndConstant(ctx.state, ctx.Def(shift), 63u));
}

template <spv::Op opcode>
uint32_t EmitFloatCompare32(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst) {
	// SPIR-V's DenormFlushToZero mode does not require comparison operands to flush.
	const bool flush = inst.Flags<IR::FPCompareFlags>().flush_input_denorms;
	const auto operand = [&](size_t index) {
		const auto value = inst.Arg(index);
		if (flush && value.IsImmediate()) {
			const auto bits = std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(value.F32Value());
			return ConstantF32(ctx.state, (bits & 0x7fffffffu) < 0x00800000u
			                                  ? bits & 0x80000000u : bits);
		}
		const auto id = ctx.Arg(inst, index);
		return flush ? EmitFlushF32DenormToSignedZero(ctx.state, id) : id;
	};
	return EmitNative<opcode, IR::Type::U1>(ctx.state, operand(0), operand(1));
}

struct EmitterState {
	EmitterState(IR::Program& program_, ShaderStageInputInfo input_info_, const Profile& profile_)
	    : builder(program_.stage == ShaderType::Mesh ? 0x00010400u : 0x00010300u),
	      program(program_), input_info(input_info_), profile(profile_) {
		if (ShaderWorkgroupInput(program.stage, input_info) != nullptr) {
			lds_storage_class = spv::StorageClassWorkgroup;
		}
		if (program.info.uses_lds && program.stage == ShaderType::Compute &&
		    input_info.compute->lds_storage) {
			lds_storage_class = spv::StorageClassStorageBuffer;
		}
	}

	Builder                                          builder;
	IR::Program&                                     program;
	ShaderStageInputInfo                             input_info;
	const Profile&                                      profile;
	uint32_t                                        debug_source = 0;
	uint32_t                                        void_type = 0;

	uint32_t                                        i32_pair_type = 0;

	std::array<uint32_t, 3>                          u32_vector_types {};
	std::array<uint32_t, 3>                          i32_vector_types {};
	std::array<uint32_t, 3>                          f32_vector_types {};
	std::array<uint32_t, IR::NumTessellationAttributes> tess_variables {};
	uint32_t                                         tess_inner_variable = 0;

	uint32_t                                         lane_count              = 1;
	uint32_t                                         lane_half               = 0;
	std::array<BufferDefinition, 4>                  storage_buffers {};
	std::vector<uint32_t>                           memory_byte_offsets;
	std::vector<uint32_t>                           memory_byte_sizes;
	uint32_t                                         bda_pagetable_variable  = 0;
	uint32_t                                         fault_buffer_variable   = 0;
	uint32_t                                         bda_pointer_function    = 0;
	// Counts (Private, per invocation) the device-address accesses that found no cached page and
	// read zeros instead of guest memory. The exits of loops with device-address accesses are taken
	// once the count reaches BdaFaultedReadsBeforeLoopExit (FinishBdaLoopExits). Whether a loop has
	// such accesses is known once its body is emitted, so the loop exits are recorded and the
	// checks, the counter and its increment in get_bda_pointer (at `bda_fault_count_insert`, with
	// the mark of the invocation that reaches the count; the parent of the fault path in the Phi
	// of get_bda_pointer is at `bda_fault_phi_parent`) are
	// inserted after the program: shaders without such a loop keep their SPIR-V.
	struct PendingLoopExit {
		const IR::Block* merge          = nullptr;
		size_t           insert         = 0; // before the merge instruction of the branch
		size_t           condition_word = 0;
		uint32_t         condition      = 0;
		bool             exits_on_true  = false;
	};
	static constexpr uint32_t                        BdaFaultedReadsBeforeLoopExit = 4096;
	size_t                                           bda_fault_count_insert   = SIZE_MAX;
	size_t                                           bda_fault_phi_parent     = SIZE_MAX;
	uint32_t                                         bda_fault_label          = 0;
	std::vector<PendingLoopExit>                     pending_loop_exits;
	// Loop headers by merge block, and the device-address calls emitted before each block: a loop
	// has device-address accesses when more were emitted before its merge block than before its
	// header.
	std::unordered_map<const IR::Block*, std::vector<const IR::Block*>> loop_headers_by_merge;
	std::unordered_map<const IR::Block*, uint32_t>   block_device_address_mark;
	uint32_t                                         device_address_calls     = 0;
	uint32_t                                         indirect_format_function = 0;
	uint32_t                                         indirect_format_geometry_function = 0;
	std::map<std::array<uint32_t, 4>, uint32_t>        indirect_buffer_load_functions;
	uint32_t                                         bvh_intersect_function  = 0;
	uint32_t                                         bvh8_result_type       = 0;
	uint32_t                                         bvh8_intersect_function = 0;
	uint32_t                                         bvh_stack_function      = 0;
	// Native ray tracing: per site and emulated lane half (see spirvEmitterRayQuery.cpp).
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_variables {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_states {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_nodes {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_slots {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_lists {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_counts {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_currents {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_bases {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_inline_records {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_result_t {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_result_word {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_result_instance {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_result_u {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_result_v {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_result_node {};
	// Wave-uniform: the selected key and the instance whose setup ran last.
	std::array<uint32_t, 4>                          ray_query_selected_instance {};
	std::array<uint32_t, 4>                          ray_query_selected_leaf {};
	std::array<uint32_t, 4>                          ray_query_setup_instance {};
	std::array<uint32_t, 4>                          ray_query_reuse {};
	// Rounds of a site's native traversal (a wave never runs more than MaxRayQueryRounds).
	std::array<uint32_t, 4>                          ray_query_rounds {};
	// The per-lane alpha test (RayQueryAlpha): per site and half, its arguments; the guest leaf
	// code's sample of the bindless table it samples (nullptr: the sites run the leaf code).
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_alpha {};
	std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 2>, 4>           ray_query_alpha_cache {};
	std::array<bool, 4>                              ray_query_alpha_sites {};
	// Sites whose alpha test reads its data as a closest hit leaf code does (RayQueryAlphaLane),
	// and sites whose opacity comes from the geometry only (RayQueryInitGeometryOpacity).
	std::array<bool, 4>                              ray_query_alpha_lane {};
	std::array<bool, 4>                              ray_query_geometry_opacity {};
	// The format of the guest data each site's alpha test reads (RayQueryAlpha's last argument,
	// Decoder::RayTracingAlphaFields::Pack()).
	std::array<uint32_t, 4>                          ray_query_alpha_format {};
	const IR::Inst*                                  ray_query_alpha_sample = nullptr;
	uint32_t                                         gds_variable            = 0;
	uint32_t                                         gds_length              = 0;
	uint32_t                                         push_constant_variable  = 0;
	uint32_t                                         shader_data_storage_variable = 0;
	// GET_LOD_STATS counters (DescriptorBindingKind::MipStats); mip_stats_records is false for the

	uint32_t                                         mip_stats_variable      = 0;

	uint32_t                                         flattened_srt_variable  = 0;
	uint32_t                                         uniform_buffer_variable = 0;
	spv::StorageClass                                lds_storage_class = spv::StorageClassFunction;
	// Per-invocation memory (scratch and function-local LDS) lives in Function variables of

	std::array<uint32_t, 2>                          scratch_variable {};
	std::array<ImageDefinition, IR::ImageBindingCount> images {};
	std::array<ImageDefinition, IR::ImageBindingCount> heap_images {};
	uint32_t                   sampler_variable                      = 0;
	uint32_t                   sampler_type                          = 0;

	uint32_t                   main_func                             = 0;
	uint32_t                   mesh_guest_func                       = 0;

inline void EmitLabel(EmitterState& state, uint32_t label) {
	state.current_label = label;
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpLabel, label);
	if (state.debug_source != 0 && state.current_block != nullptr) {
		// Source lines encode the containing native block's byte offset plus one.
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpLine, state.debug_source,
		                          state.current_block->start_pc + 1u, 0u);
	}
}

uint32_t TypeId(EmitterState& state, IR::Type type);

// Function control of the shared memory helpers (BDA pointer, runtime-V# buffer loads, format
// conversion). Programs of inlined call targets call them from hundreds of sites, and the NVIDIA
// compiler inlining each copy ran out of time and memory: Wolverine's 0xe6d76d24f59f8015 did
// not compile in 10 minutes and 25 GB with them inlined, and takes 166 s and 5.5 GB with one
// copy of each. Other programs keep inlining them.
inline spv::FunctionControlMask SharedHelperControl(const EmitterState& state) {
	return state.program.inlined_call_entries.empty() ? spv::FunctionControlMaskNone
	                                                  : spv::FunctionControlDontInlineMask;
}

// Shared instruction construction; typed aliases add no forwarding functions.
template <spv::Op opcode, IR::Type type, typename... Args>
uint32_t EmitNative(EmitterState& state, Args... args) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, TypeId(state, type), result, args...);
	if constexpr (type == IR::Type::F64 &&
	              (opcode == spv::OpFMul || opcode == spv::OpFDiv || opcode == spv::OpExtInst)) {
		state.builder.AddAnnotation(spv::OpDecorate, result, spv::DecorationNoContraction);
	}
	return result;
}

uint32_t GlslStd450(EmitterState& state);

template <GLSLstd450 opcode, IR::Type type, typename... Args>
uint32_t EmitGlsl(EmitterState& state, Args... args) {
	return EmitNative<spv::OpExtInst, type>(state, GlslStd450(state), opcode, args...);
}

inline uint32_t Unary(EmitterState& state, spv::Op opcode, uint32_t type, uint32_t value) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, type, result, value);
	return result;
}

inline uint32_t PackU64(EmitterState& state, uint32_t low, uint32_t high) {
	const auto pair = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpCompositeConstruct, TypeU32Vector(state, 2), pair, low, high);
	return Unary(state, spv::OpBitcast, TypeU64(state), pair);
}

inline uint32_t Binary(EmitterState& state, spv::Op opcode, uint32_t type, uint32_t lhs,
                       uint32_t rhs) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(opcode, type, result, lhs, rhs);
	return result;
}

inline uint32_t Select(EmitterState& state, uint32_t type, uint32_t condition, uint32_t true_value,
                       uint32_t false_value) {
	const auto result = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpSelect, type, result, condition, true_value, false_value);
	return result;
}

// These templates accept local lambdas from several emitter translation units.
template <typename Fn>
auto EmitIndexSwitch(EmitterState& state, uint32_t index, uint32_t count,
                        uint32_t result_type, Fn&& emit) {
	constexpr bool has_result = !std::is_void_v<std::invoke_result_t<Fn, uint32_t>>;
	EXIT_IF(count == 0u);
	const auto merge_label = state.builder.AllocateId();
	std::vector<uint32_t> labels(count);
	std::vector<uint32_t> words {spv::OpSwitch, index, merge_label};
	for (uint32_t item = 0; item < count; item++) {
		labels[item] = state.builder.AllocateId();
		words.push_back(item);
		words.push_back(labels[item]);
	}
	if constexpr (has_result) {
		words[2] = labels.front();
	}
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpSelectionMerge, merge_label, spv::SelectionControlMaskNone);
	state.builder.AddFunction(words);
	std::vector<uint32_t> phi;
	if constexpr (has_result) {
		phi = {spv::OpPhi, result_type, state.builder.AllocateId()};
	}
	for (uint32_t item = 0; item < count; item++) {
		EmitLabel(state, labels[item]);
		if constexpr (has_result) {
			phi.push_back(emit(item));
			phi.push_back(state.current_label);
		} else {
			emit(item);
		}
		state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranch, merge_label);
	}
	EmitLabel(state, merge_label);
	if constexpr (has_result) {
		state.builder.AddFunction(phi);
		return phi[2];
	}
}

template <typename Fn>
void EmitIfCondition(EmitterState& state, uint32_t condition, Fn&& fn) {
	if (condition == ConstantBool(state, true)) {
		fn();
		return;
	}
	const auto then_label  = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto merge_label = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpSelectionMerge, merge_label, spv::SelectionControlMaskNone);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranchConditional, condition, then_label, merge_label);
	EmitLabel(state, then_label);
	fn();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranch, merge_label);
	EmitLabel(state, merge_label);
}

template <typename Fn>
uint32_t EmitValueOrDefaultIfCondition(EmitterState& state, uint32_t condition, uint32_t type,
                                       uint32_t default_value, Fn&& fn) {
	if (condition == ConstantBool(state, true)) return fn();
	const auto then_label  = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto header     = state.current_label;
	const auto merge_label = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpSelectionMerge, merge_label, spv::SelectionControlMaskNone);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranchConditional, condition, then_label, merge_label);
	EmitLabel(state, then_label);
	const auto then_value = fn();
	const auto then_exit  = state.current_label;
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranch, merge_label);
	EmitLabel(state, merge_label);
	const auto value = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpPhi, type, value, then_value, then_exit, default_value,
	                          header);
	return value;
}

template <typename Fn>
uint32_t EmitValueOrZeroIfCondition(EmitterState& state, uint32_t condition, Fn&& fn) {
	return EmitValueOrDefaultIfCondition(state, condition, TypeU32(state), ConstantU32(state, 0),
	                                     std::forward<Fn>(fn));
}

template <typename Fn>
uint32_t AtomicUpdate(EmitterState& state, uint32_t pointer, IR::ResourceKind kind, Fn&& desired) {
	const auto scope     = kind == IR::ResourceKind::Lds ? spv::ScopeWorkgroup : spv::ScopeDevice;
	const auto preheader = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto header    = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto cont      = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto merge     = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto initial   = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto observed  = state.builder.AllocateId();
	const auto exchanged = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranch, preheader);
	EmitLabel(state, preheader);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAtomicLoad, TypeU32(state), initial, pointer,
	                          ConstantU32(state, scope),
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::MemorySemanticsMaskNone));
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranch, header);
	EmitLabel(state, header);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpPhi, TypeU32(state), observed, initial, preheader, exchanged,
	                          cont);
	const auto next = desired(observed);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAtomicCompareExchange, TypeU32(state), exchanged, pointer,
	                          ConstantU32(state, scope),
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::MemorySemanticsMaskNone),
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::MemorySemanticsMaskNone), next, observed);
	const auto success = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpIEqual, TypeBool(state), success, exchanged, observed);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpLoopMerge, merge, cont, spv::LoopControlMaskNone);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranchConditional, success, merge, cont);
	EmitLabel(state, cont);
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpBranch, header);
	EmitLabel(state, merge);
	EmitAtomicMemoryBarrier(state, kind);
	return observed;
}

#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/backend/spirv/spirvEmitterInstructions.h"

#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/cache/bufferCache.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/frontend/decode/ShaderDecoder.h"

#include <bit>
#include <utility>

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Spirv::Emitter {
namespace {

uint32_t AndCondition(EmitterState& state, uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {
	return Binary(state, spv::OpLogicalAnd, TypeBool(state), lhs, rhs);
}

uint32_t EmitDsMaskedLaneRead(EmitterState& state, uint32_t source, uint32_t target,
                              uint32_t exec) {
	if (state.lane_count == 2) {
		target = Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), target, ConstantU32(state, 31));
	}
	const auto shuffled = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpGroupNonUniformShuffle, TypeU32(state), shuffled,
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeSubgroup), source, target);
	const auto source_exec = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpGroupNonUniformShuffle, TypeBool(state), source_exec,
	                          ConstantU32(state, spv::ScopeSubgroup), exec, target);
	const auto source_active =
	    AndCondition(state, source_exec, EmitSubgroupLaneActiveBool(state, target));
	return Select(state, TypeU32(state), source_active, shuffled, ConstantU32(state, 0));
}

struct BufferAddress {
	uint32_t offset;
	uint32_t byte;
};

BufferAddress CalculateBufferAddress(EmitterState& state, uint32_t index, uint32_t offset,
                                     uint32_t soffset, uint32_t immediate, uint32_t stride,
                                     uint32_t swizzle, uint32_t index_stride) {
	const auto zero = ConstantU32(state, 0);
	const auto one  = ConstantU32(state, 1);
	const auto add = [&](uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {
		return lhs == zero ? rhs : rhs == zero ? lhs
		                                      : Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), lhs, rhs);
	};
	const auto mul = [&](uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {
		return lhs == zero || rhs == zero ? zero
		       : lhs == one              ? rhs
		       : rhs == one              ? lhs
		                                 : Binary(state, spv::OpIMul, TypeU32(state), lhs, rhs);
	};
	if (immediate != 0u) {
		offset = add(offset, ConstantU32(state, immediate));
	}
	auto address = add(mul(index, stride), offset);
	if (swizzle != 0u) {
		const auto index_shift =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), index_stride, ConstantU32(state, 3));
		const auto indices = Binary(state, spv::OpShiftLeftLogical, TypeU32(state),
		                            ConstantU32(state, 1), index_shift);
		const auto index_msb =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpShiftRightLogical, TypeU32(state), index, index_shift);
		const auto index_lsb =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), index,
		           Binary(state, spv::OpISub, TypeU32(state), indices, ConstantU32(state, 1)));
		const auto offset_msb =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), offset, ConstantU32(state, ~3u));
		const auto offset_lsb =
		    Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), offset, ConstantU32(state, 3u));
		const auto msb = mul(add(mul(index_msb, stride), offset_msb), indices);
		const auto lsb = add(Binary(state, spv::OpShiftLeftLogical, TypeU32(state), index_lsb,
		                            ConstantU32(state, 2u)), offset_lsb);
		address = Select(state, TypeU32(state), swizzle, add(msb, lsb), address);
	}
	return {offset, add(address, soffset)};
}

uint32_t BufferLane(EmitterState& state) {
	return Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), EmitSubgroupLocalInvocationId(state),
	              ConstantU32(state, 63));
}

uint32_t BufferByteAddress(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem) {
	auto&      state  = ctx.state;
	const auto packed = StorageBufferPackedStride(state, mem);
	const auto stride = packed & 0x3fffu;
	auto       index  = ctx.Arg(inst, 1);
	if ((packed & (1u << 20u)) != 0u) {
		index = Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), index, BufferLane(state));
	}
	const bool swizzle = stride != 0u && (packed & (1u << 14u)) != 0u;
	return CalculateBufferAddress(state, index, ctx.Arg(inst, 2), ctx.Arg(inst, 3), mem.offset,
	                              ConstantU32(state, stride),
	                              swizzle ? ConstantBool(state, true) : 0u,
	                              ConstantU32(state, (packed >> 16u) & 3u))
	    .byte;
}

uint32_t AddU64Low(EmitterState& state, uint32_t low, uint32_t high, uint32_t add_low,
                   uint32_t add_high, uint32_t& out_high) {
	const auto result = Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), low, add_low);
	const auto carry  = Binary(state, spv::OpULessThan, TypeBool(state), result, low);
	out_high =
	    Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state),
	           Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU32(state), high, add_high),
	           Select(state, TypeU32(state), carry, ConstantU32(state, 1), ConstantU32(state, 0)));
	return result;
}

uint32_t AddAddressOffset(EmitterState& state, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t low,
                          uint32_t& high) {
	const auto immediate = static_cast<int32_t>(mem.offset);
	if (immediate == 0) return low;
	const auto immediate_low  = ConstantU32(state, static_cast<uint32_t>(immediate));
	const auto immediate_high = ConstantU32(state, immediate < 0 ? UINT32_MAX : 0u);
	return AddU64Low(state, low, high, immediate_low, immediate_high, high);
}

uint32_t ScratchByteAddress(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem, uint32_t low,
                            uint32_t high) {
	auto& state = ctx.state;
	low = AddAddressOffset(state, mem, low, high);
	const auto valid = Binary(state, spv::OpIEqual, TypeBool(state), high, ConstantU32(state, 0));
	return Select(state, TypeU32(state), valid, low, ConstantU32(state, UINT32_MAX));
}

uint32_t GuestAddress(ValueEmitContext& ctx, const IR::Inst& inst, const IR::MemoryInfo& mem) {
	auto& state = ctx.state;
	auto  low   = ctx.Arg(inst, 1);
	if (mem.kind == IR::ResourceKind::ScalarAddress) {
		low = Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), low, ConstantU32(state, ~3u));
	}
	uint32_t address = 0;
	if (mem.address_is_full) {
		address = PackU64(state, low, ctx.Arg(inst, 2));
	} else {
		const auto* handle = inst.Arg(0).Resolve().TryInstruction();
		if (handle == nullptr || handle->GetOpcode() != IR::ValueOpcode::GetAddressResource ||
		    handle->NumArgs() != 2) {
			ctx.Fail(inst, "has no address base pair");
			return ConstantU64(state, 0);
		}
		auto base_low = ctx.Arg(*handle, 0);
		if (mem.kind == IR::ResourceKind::ScalarAddress) {
			base_low = Binary(state, spv::OpBitwiseAnd, TypeU32(state), base_low,
			                  ConstantU32(state, ~3u));
		}
		const auto base = PackU64(state, base_low, ctx.Arg(*handle, 1));
		address         = Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU64(state), base,
		                         Unary(state, spv::OpUConvert, TypeU64(state), low));
	}
	auto immediate = static_cast<int32_t>(mem.offset);
	if (mem.kind == IR::ResourceKind::ScalarAddress) {
		immediate = static_cast<int32_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(immediate) & ~3u);
	}
	return immediate == 0
	           ? address
	           : Binary(state, spv::OpIAdd, TypeU64(state), address,
	                    ConstantU64(state, static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(immediate))));
}

uint32_t FaultElementPointer(EmitterState& state, uint32_t index) {
	const auto pointer = state.builder.AllocateId();
	state.builder.AddFunction(spv::OpAccessChain, TypeStorageBufferElementPointer(state), pointer,
