```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/frontend/decode/RayTracingPatch.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/frontend/translate/Translator.h"
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/RayQuery.h"

// The pseudo instructions of the native ray tracing patch (see RayTracingPatch.h).

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Frontend {

namespace {

Decoder::Operand VectorOperand(uint32_t reg) {
	Decoder::Operand operand;
	operand.kind = Decoder::OperandKind::Vgpr;
	operand.reg  = reg;
	return operand;
}

Decoder::Operand ExecOperand() {
	Decoder::Operand operand;
	operand.kind = Decoder::OperandKind::ExecLo;
	return operand;
}

} // namespace

void Translator::EmitRayTracing(const Decoder::Instruction& inst) {
	using Flag = IR::RayQueryFlagKind;
	using Mark = IR::RayQueryMarkKind;
	const auto site = inst.offset;
	if (site >= IR::MaxRayQuerySites) {
		EXIT("ray tracing patch site %u out of range at pc 0x%08x", site, inst.pc);
	}
	const auto flags = [site](auto variant) {
		return IR::RayQueryFlags(site, static_cast<uint32_t>(variant));
	};
	const auto flag = [&](Flag kind) {
		return IR::U1(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryFlag, {}, flags(kind)));
	};
	const auto mark = [&](Mark kind, IR::U1 value) {
		ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryMark, {value}, flags(kind));
	};
	const auto write_mask = [&](const Decoder::Operand& operand, IR::U1 value) {
		WriteMask(operand, value, BallotMask(value));
	};
	const auto any_lane = [&](IR::U1 lanes) {
		const auto mask = BallotMask(lanes);
		return ir.INotEqual(ir.BitwiseOr(mask[0], mask[1]), IR::U32(IR::Value(0u)));
	};

	switch (inst.opcode) {
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_INIT: {
			std::array<IR::U32, 8> ray;
			for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
				// A site without a mask VGPR has a wave-wide mask (src2) or a constant one.
				if (i == 7 && inst.image_nsa_addr[i] == Decoder::NoRegister) {
					ray[i] = inst.src2.kind == Decoder::OperandKind::Sgpr ? ReadU32(inst.src2)
					                                                      : IR::U32(IR::Value(inst.image_nsa_addr[8]));
					continue;
				}
				ray[i] = ReadU32(VectorOperand(inst.image_nsa_addr[i]));
			}
			const auto header    = ReadU32Pair(inst.src0);
			const auto alpha_off = ReadU32(inst.src1);
			// The lanes that cull facings: every lane, none when an SGPR is 0, or those of a mask.
			auto cull = IR::U1(IR::Value(true));
			if ((inst.dmask & 4u) != 0) {
				cull = ir.INotEqual(ReadU32(inst.src3), IR::U32(IR::Value(0u)));
			} else if ((inst.dmask & 8u) != 0) {
				cull = ReadMask(inst.src3);
			}
			const auto native = IR::U1(ir.Emit(
			    IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryInit,
			    {ray[0], ray[1], ray[2], ray[3], ray[4], ray[5], ray[6], ray[7], header[0], header[1], alpha_off,
			     ir.GetExec(), cull},
			    flags(inst.dmask & 3u)));
			// The same in every lane: the host has (or not) the TLAS of the header.
			ir.SetScc(any_lane(native));
			return;
		}
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_SELECT: {
			// The wave's smallest (instance, leaf) key: uniform values.
			const auto next     = ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryNext, {}, flags(0u));
			const auto instance = IR::U32(ir.CompositeExtract(next, 0));
			const auto has      = ir.INotEqual(IR::U32(ir.CompositeExtract(next, 2)), IR::U32(IR::Value(0u)));
			const auto match    = IR::U1(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryMatch, {}, flags(0u)));
			WriteOperand(inst.dst, instance);
			write_mask(inst.dst2, match);
			write_mask(ExecOperand(), match);
			ir.SetScc(has);
			return;
		}
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_REUSE: ir.SetScc(flag(Flag::Reuse)); return;
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_SETUP: {
			// The setup runs for every lane with a key of the instance, so that later keys of the
			// instance can reuse its registers.
			ir.SetScc(flag(Flag::NeedRestore));
			const auto lanes = flag(Flag::InstanceMatch);
			mark(Mark::SetupBegin, lanes);
			write_mask(ExecOperand(), lanes);
			return;
		}
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_LEAF: {
			// The leaf runs for the lanes with its key that the instance setup kept.
			const auto lanes = ir.LogicalAnd(flag(Flag::Matched), ReadMask(inst.src0));
			WriteOperand(inst.dst,
			             IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQuerySelectedLeaf, {}, flags(0u))));
			write_mask(inst.src0, lanes);
			write_mask(ExecOperand(), lanes);
			write_mask(inst.dst2, lanes);
			mark(Mark::Enter, lanes);
			return;
		}
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_RESOLVE:
			mark(inst.dmask != 0 ? Mark::CullResolve : Mark::Resolve, ReadMask(inst.src0));
			return;
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_EXIT_CHECK: ir.SetScc(flag(Flag::NeedRestore)); return;
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_COMMIT: {
			// Lanes whose result is an opaque hit the hardware found: the registers the guest
			// leaf code writes for an accepted hit.
			using Result      = IR::RayQueryResultKind;
			const auto result = [&](Result kind) {
				return IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryResult, {}, flags(kind)));
			};
			auto has = ir.INotEqual(result(Result::Has), IR::U32(IR::Value(0u)));
			if (inst.dmask != 0) {
				// Closest hit: only when nearer than the hit the registers hold (or the t max).
				const auto as_float = [&](IR::U32 value) {
					return IR::F32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::BitCastF32U32, {value}));
				};
				const auto current = IR::U32(ir.GetVectorReg(
				    static_cast<IR::VectorReg>(inst.image_nsa_addr[0])));
				has = ir.LogicalAnd(has, IR::U1(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::FPOrdLessThanEqual32,
				                                         {as_float(result(Result::T)),
				                                          as_float(current)})));
			}
			const std::array<std::pair<uint32_t, Result>, 7> outputs {{
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[0], Result::T},
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[1], Result::Word},
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[2], Result::InstanceLo},
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[3], Result::InstanceHi},
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[4], Result::U},
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[5], Result::V},
			    {inst.image_nsa_addr[6], Result::Node},
			}};
			for (const auto& [reg, kind]: outputs) {
				if (reg == Decoder::NoRegister) {
					continue;
				}
				const auto vreg = static_cast<IR::VectorReg>(reg);
				ir.SetVectorReg(vreg, ir.Select(has, result(kind), ir.GetVectorReg(vreg)));
			}
			return;
		}
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_EXIT:
			write_mask(ExecOperand(), flag(Flag::InTraversal));
			mark(Mark::Exit, IR::U1(IR::Value(true)));
			return;
		case Decoder::Opcode::RT_ALPHA: {
			// The values the per-lane alpha test reads (see RayTracingAlphaTest): the level of
			// detail term, the cone spread, the threshold factor (1.0 without one), the V#s of the
			// material table and of the buffer table, which the guest leaf code loads from user
			// data, the threshold (the lane's reference when the site has one) and the format of
			// the guest data (Decoder::RayTracingAlphaFields::Pack()).
			const auto material = LoadScalarAddressDwords(inst.src2.reg, inst.image_nsa_addr[1], 4, inst.pc);
			const auto buffers  = LoadScalarAddressDwords(inst.src3.reg, inst.image_nsa_addr[2], 4, inst.pc);
			const auto factor   = inst.src1.kind == Decoder::OperandKind::Sgpr ? ReadU32(inst.src1)
			                                                                    : IR::U32(IR::Value(0x3f800000u));
			const auto threshold = inst.image_nsa_addr[5] != Decoder::NoRegister
			                           ? ReadU32(VectorOperand(inst.image_nsa_addr[5]))
			                           : IR::U32(IR::Value(inst.image_nsa_addr[3]));
			ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::RayQueryAlpha,
			        {ReadU32(VectorOperand(inst.image_nsa_addr[0])), ReadU32(inst.src0), factor, material[0],
			         material[1], material[2], material[3], buffers[0], buffers[1], buffers[2], buffers[3], threshold,
			         IR::U32(IR::Value(inst.image_nsa_addr[4])), IR::U32(IR::Value(inst.image_nsa_addr[6]))},
			        flags(inst.dmask));
			return;
		}
		default: FailMissingTranslation(inst);
	}
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Frontend
```

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/frontend/translate/Translator.h"

namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Frontend {

void Translator::EmitScalar(const Decoder::Instruction& inst) {
	using O = Decoder::Opcode;
	switch (inst.opcode) {
		case O::S_MOV_B32:
		case O::S_MOVK_I32: MOV_B32(inst, false); return;
		case O::S_MOV_B64: S_MOV_B64(inst); return;
		case O::S_WQM_B32: S_WQM(inst, false); return;
		case O::S_WQM_B64: S_WQM(inst, true); return;
		case O::S_GETPC_B64:
		case O::S_SWAPPC_B64: S_GETPC_B64(inst); return;
		case O::S_SETPC_B64: return;
		case O::S_SUBVECTOR_LOOP_BEGIN: S_SUBVECTOR_LOOP(inst, true); return;
		case O::S_SUBVECTOR_LOOP_END: S_SUBVECTOR_LOOP(inst, false); return;
		case O::S_CSELECT_B32: S_CSELECT_B32(inst); return;
		case O::S_CSELECT_B64: ScalarSelect64(inst, inst.src1); return;
		case O::S_CMOV_B64: ScalarSelect64(inst, inst.dst); return;
		case O::S_GETREG_B32:
			if (!graphics_compute || (inst.src0.value != 0x1818u && inst.src0.value != 0x0a18u))
				EXIT("unsupported S_GETREG_B32 at pc 0x%08x: selector=0x%04x graphics_compute=%u",
				     inst.pc, inst.src0.value, static_cast<unsigned>(graphics_compute));
			// HW_ID2 identifies graphics compute as QUEUE=6, ME=0.
			WriteOperand(inst.dst, IR::Value(inst.src0.value == 0x1818u ? 6u : 0u));
			return;
		case O::S_SETREG_B32: EmitControlNop(); return;
		case O::S_WAITCNT_VSCNT: S_WAITCNT_VSCNT(inst); return;
		case O::S_WAITCNT: return;

		case O::S_AND_SAVEEXEC_B32:
			S_SAVEEXEC(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, false, false, false);
			return;
		case O::S_ANDN1_SAVEEXEC_B32:
			S_SAVEEXEC(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, false, true, false);
			return;
		case O::S_ORN2_SAVEEXEC_B32:
			S_SAVEEXEC(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalOr, true, false, false);
			return;
		case O::S_AND_SAVEEXEC_B64:
			S_SAVEEXEC(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, false, false, true);
			return;
		case O::S_ANDN1_SAVEEXEC_B64:
			S_SAVEEXEC(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, false, true, true);
			return;
		case O::S_ORN2_SAVEEXEC_B64:
			S_SAVEEXEC(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalOr, true, false, true);
			return;
		case O::S_ADD_U32: ADD_U32(inst, false, false); return;
		case O::S_ADDC_U32: ADD_U32(inst, false, true); return;
		case O::S_SUB_U32: SUB_U32(inst, false, false); return;
		case O::S_SUBB_U32: SUBB_U32(inst, false, false); return;
		case O::S_ABSDIFF_I32: S_ABSDIFF_I32(inst); return;
		case O::S_ADD_I32: S_ADD_SUB_I32(inst, false); return;
		case O::S_SUB_I32: S_ADD_SUB_I32(inst, true); return;
		case O::S_LSHL1_ADD_U32: S_LSHL_ADD_U32(inst, 1u); return;
		case O::S_LSHL2_ADD_U32: S_LSHL_ADD_U32(inst, 2u); return;
		case O::S_LSHL3_ADD_U32: S_LSHL_ADD_U32(inst, 3u); return;
		case O::S_LSHL4_ADD_U32: S_LSHL_ADD_U32(inst, 4u); return;
		case O::S_MIN_I32:
			ScalarMinMax32(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SMin32, IR::ValueOpcode::SLessThan32);
			return;
		case O::S_MAX_I32:
			ScalarMinMax32(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SMax32, IR::ValueOpcode::SGreaterThan32);
			return;
		case O::S_MIN_U32:
			ScalarMinMax32(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::UMin32, IR::ValueOpcode::ULessThan32);
			return;
		case O::S_MAX_U32:
			ScalarMinMax32(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::UMax32, IR::ValueOpcode::UGreaterThan32);
			return;

		case O::S_CMP_EQ_U32:
		case O::S_CMP_EQ_I32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::IEqual32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_LG_U32:
		case O::S_CMP_LG_I32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::INotEqual32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_GT_U32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::UGreaterThan32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_GE_U32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::UGreaterThanEqual32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_LT_U32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ULessThan32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_LE_U32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ULessThanEqual32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_GT_I32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SGreaterThan32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_GE_I32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SGreaterThanEqual32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_LT_I32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SLessThan32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_LE_I32:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SLessThanEqual32, IR::Type::U32, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_EQ_U64:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::IEqual64, IR::Type::U64, true);
			return;
		case O::S_CMP_LG_U64:
			EmitIntegerCompare(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::INotEqual64, IR::Type::U64, true);
			return;

		case O::S_AND_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32,
			                  false, false, false);
		case O::S_ANDN2_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32,
			                  true, false, false);
		case O::S_OR_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalOr, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseOr32, false,
			                  false, false);
		case O::S_ORN2_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalOr, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseOr32, true,
			                  false, false);
		case O::S_XOR_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalXor, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseXor32,
			                  false, false, false);
		case O::S_NAND_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32,
			                  false, true, false);
		case O::S_NOR_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalOr, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseOr32, false,
			                  true, false);
		case O::S_XNOR_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalXor, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseXor32,
			                  false, true, false);
		case O::S_NOT_B64:
			return S_U64_MASK(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::LogicalAnd, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32,
			                  false, false, true);

		case O::S_ABS_I32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::IAbs32, IR::Type::U32, false, false, true);
		case O::S_SEXT_I32_I8:
		case O::S_SEXT_I32_I16: {
			// Sign extension leaves SCC unchanged.
			const auto bits = inst.opcode == O::S_SEXT_I32_I8 ? 8u : 16u;
			WriteOperand(inst.dst, IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::BitFieldSExtract,
			    {ReadU32(inst.src0), IR::Value(0u), IR::Value(bits)})));
			return;
		}
		case O::S_MUL_I32:
		case O::S_MULK_I32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::IMul32, IR::Type::U32, false, false, false);
		case O::S_MUL_HI_U32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::UMulHi, IR::Type::U32, false, false, false);
		case O::S_MUL_HI_I32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::SMulHi, IR::Type::U32, false, false, false);
		case O::S_AND_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     true);
		case O::S_OR_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseOr32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     true);
		case O::S_XOR_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseXor32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     true);
		case O::S_NOT_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseNot32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     true);
		case O::S_BREV_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitReverse32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     false);
		case O::S_BREV_B64: {
			const auto value = ReadU32Pair(inst.src0);
			WriteU32Pair(inst.dst, {IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::BitReverse32, {value[1]})),
			                        IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::BitReverse32, {value[0]}))});
			return;
		}
		case O::S_BCNT0_I32_B32:
		case O::S_FF0_I32_B32: {
			const auto value = ir.BitwiseNot(ReadU32(inst.src0));
			const bool count = inst.opcode == O::S_BCNT0_I32_B32;
			const auto result = IR::U32(ir.Emit(count ? IR::ValueOpcode::BitCount32
			                                       : IR::ValueOpcode::FindILsb32, {value}));
			WriteOperand(inst.dst, result);
			if (count) {
				ir.SetScc(ir.INotEqual(result, IR::U32(IR::Value(0u))));
			}
			return;
		}
		case O::S_BCNT1_I32_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitCount32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     true);
		case O::S_BCNT0_I32_B64:
		case O::S_BCNT1_I32_B64: {
			// Vulkan bit counts operate on 32-bit words; avoid packing only to split again.
			auto value = ReadU32Pair(inst.src0);
			if (inst.opcode == O::S_BCNT0_I32_B64) {
				value[0] = ir.BitwiseNot(value[0]);
				value[1] = ir.BitwiseNot(value[1]);
			}
			const auto low    = IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::BitCount32, {value[0]}));
			const auto high   = IR::U32(ir.Emit(IR::ValueOpcode::BitCount32, {value[1]}));
			const auto result = ir.IAdd(low, high);
			WriteOperand(inst.dst, result);
			ir.SetScc(ir.INotEqual(result, IR::U32(IR::Value(0u))));
			return;
		}
		case O::S_FF1_I32_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::FindILsb32, IR::Type::U32, false, false,
			                     false);
		case O::S_LSHL_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ShiftLeftLogical32, IR::Type::U32, false,
			                     true, true);
		case O::S_LSHR_B32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ShiftRightLogical32, IR::Type::U32, false,
			                     true, true);
		case O::S_ASHR_I32:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ShiftRightArithmetic32, IR::Type::U32,
			                     false, true, true);
		case O::S_LSHL_B64:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ShiftLeftLogical64, IR::Type::U64, false,
			                     false, true);
		case O::S_LSHR_B64:
			return SimpleInteger(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::ShiftRightLogical64, IR::Type::U64, false,
			                     false, true);
		case O::S_ASHR_I64: return S_ASHR_I64(inst);

		case O::S_ANDN2_B32:
			return ComposedIntegerBinary(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32, true, false, true);
		case O::S_ORN2_B32:
			return ComposedIntegerBinary(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseOr32, true, false, true);
		case O::S_NAND_B32:
			return ComposedIntegerBinary(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseAnd32, false, true, true);
		case O::S_NOR_B32:
			return ComposedIntegerBinary(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseOr32, false, true, true);
		case O::S_XNOR_B32:
			return ComposedIntegerBinary(inst, IR::ValueOpcode::BitwiseXor32, false, true, true);
		case O::S_FF0_I32_B64: return S_FF_I32_B64(inst, true, false, false);
		case O::S_FF1_I32_B64: return S_FF_I32_B64(inst, false, false, false);
		case O::S_FLBIT_I32_B32: return V_FFBH_32(inst, false);
		case O::S_FLBIT_I32_B64: return S_FF_I32_B64(inst, false, true, false);
		case O::S_FLBIT_I32: return V_FFBH_32(inst, true);
		case O::S_FLBIT_I32_I64: return S_FF_I32_B64(inst, false, true, true);

		case O::S_BITSET0_B32: return S_BITSET_B32(inst, false);
		case O::S_BITSET1_B32: return S_BITSET_B32(inst, true);
		case O::S_BITSET0_B64: return S_BITSET_B64(inst, false);
		case O::S_BITSET1_B64: return S_BITSET_B64(inst, true);
		case O::S_BITREPLICATE_B64_B32: return S_BITREPLICATE_B64_B32(inst);
		case O::S_QUADMASK_B32: return S_QUADMASK(inst, false);
		case O::S_QUADMASK_B64: return S_QUADMASK(inst, true);
		case O::S_BFM_B32: return BFM_B32(inst);
		case O::S_BFM_B64: return S_BFM_B64(inst);
		case O::S_BFE_U32: return S_BFE_U32(inst, false);
		case O::S_BFE_I32: return S_BFE_U32(inst, true);
		case O::S_BFE_U64: return S_BFE_U64(inst);
		case O::S_BITCMP0_B32: return S_BITCMP_B32(inst, false);
		case O::S_BITCMP1_B32: return S_BITCMP_B32(inst, true);
		case O::S_BITCMP0_B64: return S_BITCMP_B64(inst, false);
		case O::S_BITCMP1_B64: return S_BITCMP_B64(inst, true);
		case O::S_PACK_LL_B32_B16: return PackB16(inst, false, false);
		case O::S_PACK_LH_B32_B16: return PackB16(inst, false, true);
		case O::S_PACK_HH_B32_B16: return PackB16(inst, true, true);

		case O::S_NOP:
		case O::S_SLEEP:
		case O::S_SETPRIO:
		case O::S_TRAP: EmitControlNop(); return;
		case O::S_WAITCNT_DEPCTR:
		case O::S_CLAUSE: return;
		case O::S_BARRIER: S_BARRIER(); return;
		case O::S_SENDMSG: S_SENDMSG(inst); return;
		case O::S_TTRACEDATA: S_TTRACEDATA(); return;
		case O::S_INST_PREFETCH: S_INST_PREFETCH(); return;
		case O::S_BRANCH:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_SCC0:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_SCC1:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_VCCZ:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_VCCNZ:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_EXECZ:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_EXECNZ:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_CDBGSYS:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_CDBGUSER:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_CDBGSYS_OR_USER:
		case O::S_CBRANCH_CDBGSYS_AND_USER:
		case O::S_ENDPGM: return;
		default: return FailMissingTranslation(inst);
	}
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::Frontend
```
