`src/graphics/shader/shaderVertexMetadata.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/shaderVertexMetadata.h"

#include <array>
#include <cstring>

namespace Libs::Graphics {

const char* ShaderReadVertexMetadata(const ShaderMappedData& data, uint32_t max_user_sgprs,
                                     ShaderVertexMetadata& metadata) {
	if (data.user_data == nullptr) {
		return "missing user-data header";
	}

	ShaderUserData user_data {};
	std::memcpy(&user_data, data.user_data, sizeof(user_data));

	constexpr uint32_t DirectResourceCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(DirectResourceType::Last) + 1u;
	if (user_data.direct_resource_count > DirectResourceCount) {
		return "direct-resource count exceeds the known resource domain";
	}

	std::array<uint16_t, DirectResourceCount> direct_offsets {};
	const auto                                direct_size =
	    static_cast<uint64_t>(user_data.direct_resource_count) * sizeof(uint16_t);
	if (direct_size != 0) {
		if (user_data.direct_resource_offset == nullptr) {
			return "missing direct-resource offsets";
		}
		std::memcpy(direct_offsets.data(), user_data.direct_resource_offset, direct_size);
	}

	ShaderVertexMetadata next;
	for (uint32_t type = 0; type < user_data.direct_resource_count; type++) {
		const auto reg = direct_offsets[type];
		if (reg == ILLEGAL_DIRECT_OFFSET) {
			continue;
		}
		switch (static_cast<DirectResourceType>(type)) {
			case DirectResourceType::PtrVertexBufferTable: next.vertex_buffer_reg = reg; break;
			case DirectResourceType::PtrVertexAttribDescTable: next.vertex_attrib_reg = reg; break;
			default: break;
		}
	}

	if (next.vertex_attrib_reg >= 0 && next.vertex_buffer_reg < 0) {
		return "vertex attribute table requires a vertex buffer table";
	}
	if (next.vertex_buffer_reg < 0) {
		metadata = next;
		return nullptr;
	}
	if (static_cast<uint32_t>(next.vertex_buffer_reg) + 1u >= max_user_sgprs) {
		return "vertex table pointer exceeds the user-SGPR domain";
	}
	if (next.vertex_attrib_reg < 0) {
		metadata = next;
		return nullptr;
	}
	if (static_cast<uint32_t>(next.vertex_attrib_reg) + 1u >= max_user_sgprs) {
		return "vertex table pointer exceeds the user-SGPR domain";
	}
	if (data.num_input_semantics == 0 ||
	    data.num_input_semantics > ShaderVertexInputInfo::RES_MAX) {
		return "vertex semantic count is outside the supported domain";
	}

	if (data.input_semantics == nullptr) {
		return "missing vertex input semantics";
	}
	next.input_semantics = {data.input_semantics, data.num_input_semantics};
	metadata                   = next;
	return nullptr;
}

} // namespace Libs::Graphics

```

`src/hybrid/hybrid.h`:

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_SRC_HYBRID_HYBRID_H_
#define EMULATOR_SRC_HYBRID_HYBRID_H_

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

// The AnyPS5 executable hosts Kyty's GPU as kyty_gpu.dll (the hybrid). The executable owns guest memory,
// threads, the exception handler and events; Kyty only tracks and draws. Aps5Host is the table of the
// executable's callbacks that kyty_gpu_init hands over (version 2).
struct Aps5Host {
	uint32_t version;
	// tracker: 0 = no tracking protection, 1 = read-only, 2 = no access; per 4 KiB page of donated memory.
	bool (*protect_host)(uint64_t address, uint64_t bytes, uint32_t tracker);
	// The executable's own export of a guest library NID (libkernel first), SysV ABI, or 0.
	uint64_t (*resolve)(const char* nid);
};

namespace Hybrid {

// KYTY_FAULT_STATS: time this thread spent in the fault handler's slow parts (protect_host, buffer
// readback, the texture cache lock), read before and after each stage of a fault. Dry.
struct FaultStageTime {
	uint64_t protect_ns = 0, protect_calls = 0, readback_ns = 0, readbacks = 0, texture_lock_ns = 0;
	uint64_t buffer_ns = 0, texture_ns = 0, heap_ns = 0;
};
inline thread_local FaultStageTime g_fault_stage_time;
[[nodiscard]] uint64_t FaultStageClockNs() noexcept;

// [hib-cp] every 10 s with [hib-flip]: the host memory queries (VirtualQuery) of the borrowed-mode readers,
// on all threads and on the CP (Thread_Gpu), the CP's processors and affinity, and the busiest threads.
void NoteHostQuery(uint64_t ns) noexcept;
// ClampRangeSize in the hybrid: ranges inside one donated mapping, and the rest by the host's region type.
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> g_clamp_donated {0}, g_clamp_image {0}, g_clamp_mapped {0}, g_clamp_private {0}, g_clamp_other {0};
void SetCpThread() noexcept;

[[nodiscard]] bool            Enabled() noexcept;
[[nodiscard]] const Aps5Host* Host() noexcept;
void                          SetHost(const Aps5Host* host) noexcept;

// The executable's event queues (the guest's): Kyty's interrupt (kind 0: count in fflags, context in data,
// one pending event per context) and video out (kind 1) trigger semantics, built in the executable.
int AddEvent(int64_t eq, uint64_t ident, int16_t filter, void* udata, int kind, bool triggered, int64_t data);
int TriggerEvent(int64_t eq, uint64_t ident, int16_t filter, void* trigger_data);
int DeleteEvent(int64_t eq, uint64_t ident, int16_t filter);

// The executable's automated input (APS5_PAD_INPUT_FILE and what drives it) replaces the pad data while
// it runs; nothing changes otherwise.
void PadInjection(void* pad_data, uint64_t bytes);

// At each guest flip: every 10 s a [hib-flip] line (flips, interval p50/p99, draws per frame; the bench reads the
// draws to detect the world).
void NoteFlip();
// Guest flips presented so far (the frame capture ends a frame when it changes).
[[nodiscard]] uint64_t FlipCount() noexcept;

// F9 arms the executable's frame capture instead of the target dump when APS5_KYTY_CAPTURE_TRIGGER is "F9";
// the capture takes the press once.
[[nodiscard]] bool CaptureOnHotkey() noexcept;
void               PressCaptureHotkey() noexcept;
[[nodiscard]] bool TakeCaptureHotkey() noexcept;

// One of the executable's own helpers by name (KytyGpu*_nid_no_patch), or null outside the hybrid.
template <typename Function>
Function Executable(const char* name) noexcept {
	const auto* host = Host();
	return host == nullptr ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<Function>(host->resolve(name));
}

// In the hybrid, the executable's implementation of a kernel NID instead of Kyty's own `function`.
template <typename Function>
Function Kernel(const char* nid, Function function) noexcept {
	const auto* host = Host();
	return host == nullptr ? function : reinterpret_cast<Function>(host->resolve(nid));
}

} // namespace Hybrid

#endif
```

`src/hybrid/hybridState.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "hybrid/hybrid.h"

#include "common/debugCounters.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string_view>
#include <array>
#include <string>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

#include <atomic>
#include <unordered_map>

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
#include <windows.h> // IWYU pragma: keep
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#endif

namespace Hybrid {

namespace {
std::atomic<const Aps5Host*> g_host {nullptr};
} // namespace

bool Enabled() noexcept {
	return g_host.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != nullptr;
}

const Aps5Host* Host() noexcept {
	return g_host.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

void SetHost(const Aps5Host* host) noexcept {
	g_host.store(host, std::memory_order_release);
}

// EBADF, as the executable answers for a queue it does not know.
constexpr int BadQueue = static_cast<int>(0x80020009u);

int AddEvent(int64_t eq, uint64_t ident, int16_t filter, void* udata, int kind, bool triggered, int64_t data) {
	static const auto add = Executable<int (*)(int64_t, uint64_t, int16_t, void*, int, int, int64_t)>(
	    "KytyGpuAddEvent_nid_no_patch");
	return add == nullptr ? BadQueue : add(eq, ident, filter, udata, kind, triggered ? 1 : 0, data);
}

int TriggerEvent(int64_t eq, uint64_t ident, int16_t filter, void* trigger_data) {
	static const auto trigger = Executable<int (*)(int64_t, uint64_t, int16_t, void*)>("KytyGpuTriggerEvent_nid_no_patch");
	return trigger == nullptr ? BadQueue : trigger(eq, ident, filter, trigger_data);
}

int DeleteEvent(int64_t eq, uint64_t ident, int16_t filter) {
	static const auto remove = Executable<int (*)(int64_t, uint64_t, int16_t)>("KytyGpuDeleteEvent_nid_no_patch");
	return remove == nullptr ? BadQueue : remove(eq, ident, filter);
}

void PadInjection(void* pad_data, uint64_t bytes) {
	static const auto inject = Executable<bool (*)(int, void*, uint64_t)>("KytyGpuPadInjection_nid_no_patch");
	if (inject != nullptr) {
		inject(0, pad_data, bytes);
	}
}

namespace {
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_query_calls {0}, g_query_ns {0}, g_cp_query_calls {0}, g_cp_query_ns {0}, g_cp_processors {0};
thread_local bool     t_is_cp = false;
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
std::atomic<HANDLE> g_cp_thread {nullptr};

// Sampled (1 of 16) VirtualQuery callers: three frames above the query helper, and the calling thread.
struct Tallies {
	std::mutex                                            mutex;
	std::vector<std::pair<std::array<uint64_t, 3>, std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>>> rows;
};
Tallies g_query_sites, g_query_threads;

void Tally(Tallies& tallies, const std::array<uint64_t, 3>& key, uint64_t ns) {
	std::scoped_lock lock(tallies.mutex);
	for (auto& [k, value]: tallies.rows) {
		if (k == key) {
			value.first++;
			value.second += ns;
			return;
		}
	}
	if (tallies.rows.size() < 256) {
		tallies.rows.push_back({key, {1, ns}});
	}
}

std::string Symbol(uint64_t address) {
	if (address == 0) {
		return "-";
	}
	HMODULE module = nullptr;
	char    path[MAX_PATH] = "?";
	if (GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, reinterpret_cast<LPCSTR>(address), &module) && module != nullptr) {
		GetModuleFileNameA(module, path, MAX_PATH);
	}
	const char* file = std::strrchr(path, '\\');
	char        text[MAX_PATH + 32];
	std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "%s+0x%llx", file != nullptr ? file + 1 : path, static_cast<unsigned long long>(address - reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(module)));
	return text;
}

void ReportCallers() {
	for (auto* tallies: {&g_query_sites, &g_query_threads}) {
		std::vector<std::pair<std::array<uint64_t, 3>, std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>>> rows;
		{
			std::scoped_lock lock(tallies->mutex);
			rows.swap(tallies->rows);
		}
		std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.second.second > b.second.second; });
		std::string line = tallies == &g_query_sites ? "[hib-cp] VirtualQuery callers (sampled 1/16; calls, ms, 3 frames):" : "[hib-cp] VirtualQuery threads (sampled 1/16; tid, calls, ms):";
		for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.size() && i < 8; ++i) {
			char item[64];
			std::snprintf(item, sizeof(item), " %llu %.2f", static_cast<unsigned long long>(rows[i].second.first), static_cast<double>(rows[i].second.second) / 1e6);
			if (tallies == &g_query_sites) {
				line += item + std::string(" ") + Symbol(rows[i].first[0]) + " < " + Symbol(rows[i].first[1]) + " < " + Symbol(rows[i].first[2]) + ";";
			} else {
				line += " " + std::to_string(rows[i].first[0]) + item + ";";
			}
		}
		std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line.c_str());
	}
}

void ReportThreads(uint64_t frames) {
	static std::unordered_map<DWORD, uint64_t> previous;
	struct Busy {
		DWORD    tid;
		uint64_t ns;
		int      priority;
		std::string name;
		std::string start;
	};
	std::vector<Busy>                    busy;
	std::unordered_map<DWORD, uint64_t> now;
	const auto                           snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
	if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
		return;
	}
	using Describe = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PWSTR*);
	using Query    = LONG(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, int, PVOID, ULONG, PULONG);
	static const auto describe = reinterpret_cast<Describe>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll"), "GetThreadDescription")));
	static const auto query    = reinterpret_cast<Query>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll"), "NtQueryInformationThread")));
	THREADENTRY32 entry {};
	entry.dwSize = sizeof(entry);
	for (BOOL more = Thread32First(snapshot, &entry); more; more = Thread32Next(snapshot, &entry)) {
		if (entry.th32OwnerProcessID != GetCurrentProcessId()) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto thread = OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, entry.th32ThreadID);
		if (thread == nullptr) {
			continue;
		}
		FILETIME created {}, exited {}, kernel {}, user {};
		if (GetThreadTimes(thread, &created, &exited, &kernel, &user)) {
			const auto total = ((static_cast<uint64_t>(kernel.dwHighDateTime) << 32u | kernel.dwLowDateTime) +
			                    (static_cast<uint64_t>(user.dwHighDateTime) << 32u | user.dwLowDateTime)) * 100;
			now[entry.th32ThreadID] = total;
			const auto before = previous.find(entry.th32ThreadID);
			Busy b {entry.th32ThreadID, total - (before != previous.end() ? before->second : 0), GetThreadPriority(thread), {}, {}};
			PWSTR text = nullptr;
			if (describe != nullptr && SUCCEEDED(describe(thread, &text)) && text != nullptr) {
				for (const wchar_t* c = text; *c != 0; ++c) {
					b.name += static_cast<char>(*c < 128 ? *c : '?');
				}
				LocalFree(text);
			}
			void* start = nullptr;
			if (query != nullptr && query(thread, 9, &start, sizeof(start), nullptr) == 0 && start != nullptr) {
				HMODULE module = nullptr;
				char    path[MAX_PATH] = "?";
				if (GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, static_cast<LPCSTR>(start), &module) && module != nullptr) {
					GetModuleFileNameA(module, path, MAX_PATH);
				}
				const char* file = std::strrchr(path, '\\');
				char        site[MAX_PATH + 32];
				std::snprintf(site, sizeof(site), "%s+0x%llx", file != nullptr ? file + 1 : path, static_cast<unsigned long long>(reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(start) - reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(module)));
				b.start = site;
			}
			busy.push_back(std::move(b));
		}
		CloseHandle(thread);
	}
	CloseHandle(snapshot);
	previous = std::move(now);
	std::sort(busy.begin(), busy.end(), [](const Busy& a, const Busy& b) { return a.ns > b.ns; });
	std::string line = "[hib-cp] busiest threads (ms per frame, priority, name, start):";
	for (size_t i = 0; i < busy.size() && i < 8; ++i) {
		char item[512];
		std::snprintf(item, sizeof(item), " %lu %.2f p%d %s %s;", busy[i].tid, frames != 0 ? static_cast<double>(busy[i].ns) / 1e6 / static_cast<double>(frames) : 0.0, busy[i].priority, busy[i].name.empty() ? "-" : busy[i].name.c_str(), busy[i].start.empty() ? "?" : busy[i].start.c_str());
		line += item;
	}
	std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line.c_str());
}
#endif

void ReportHostQueries(uint64_t frames) {
	const auto per = [frames](uint64_t value) { return frames != 0 ? static_cast<double>(value) / static_cast<double>(frames) : 0.0; };
	const auto calls = g_query_calls.exchange(0), ns = g_query_ns.exchange(0), cp_calls = g_cp_query_calls.exchange(0), cp_ns = g_cp_query_ns.exchange(0);
	const auto processors = g_cp_processors.exchange(0);
	unsigned long long affinity = 0, ideal = 0;
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	if (const auto cp = g_cp_thread.load()) {
		GROUP_AFFINITY group {};
		PROCESSOR_NUMBER number {};
		if (GetThreadGroupAffinity(cp, &group)) {
			affinity = group.Mask;
		}
		if (GetThreadIdealProcessorEx(cp, &number)) {
			ideal = number.Number;
		}
	}
#endif
	std::fprintf(stderr,
	             "[hib-cp] per frame: VirtualQuery CP %.1f calls %.3f ms, all threads %.1f calls %.3f ms; CP ran on processors 0x%llx, affinity 0x%llx, ideal %llu\n",
	             per(cp_calls), per(cp_ns) / 1e6, per(calls), per(ns) / 1e6, static_cast<unsigned long long>(processors), affinity, ideal);
	const auto donated = g_clamp_donated.exchange(0), image = g_clamp_image.exchange(0), mapped = g_clamp_mapped.exchange(0), priv = g_clamp_private.exchange(0), other = g_clamp_other.exchange(0);
	std::fprintf(stderr, "[hib-cp] ClampRangeSize per frame: inside one donated mapping %.1f; to the system: image %.1f, mapped %.1f, private %.1f, other %.1f\n",
	             per(donated), per(image), per(mapped), per(priv), per(other));
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	ReportThreads(frames);
	ReportCallers();
#endif
}
} // namespace

void NoteHostQuery(uint64_t ns) noexcept {
	const auto call = g_query_calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
	g_query_ns.fetch_add(ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	if (call % 16 == 0) {
		void* frames[4] {};
		const auto captured = RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(1, 4, frames, nullptr);
		std::array<uint64_t, 3> site {};
		for (USHORT i = 1; i < captured && i < 4; ++i) {
			site[i - 1] = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(frames[i]);
		}
		Tally(g_query_sites, site, ns);
		Tally(g_query_threads, std::array<uint64_t, 3> {GetCurrentThreadId(), 0, 0}, ns);
	}
#else
	static_cast<void>(call);
#endif
	if (t_is_cp) {
		g_cp_query_calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		g_cp_query_ns.fetch_add(ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		g_cp_processors.fetch_or(uint64_t {1} << (GetCurrentProcessorNumber() & 63u), std::memory_order_relaxed);
#endif
	}
}

void SetCpThread() noexcept {
	t_is_cp = true;
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	HANDLE self = nullptr;
	if (DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &self, THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, 0)) {
		g_cp_thread.store(self);
	}
#endif
}

uint64_t FaultStageClockNs() noexcept {
	return static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}

namespace {
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_flip_count {0};
} // namespace

namespace {
std::atomic<bool> g_capture_hotkey {false};
} // namespace

bool CaptureOnHotkey() noexcept {
	static const bool on_hotkey = [] {
		const char* trigger = std::getenv("APS5_KYTY_CAPTURE_TRIGGER");
		return trigger != nullptr && std::string_view(trigger) == "F9";
	}();
	return on_hotkey;
}

void PressCaptureHotkey() noexcept {
	g_capture_hotkey.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
	std::fputs("[kyty-gpu] F9: frame capture armed\n", stderr);
}

bool TakeCaptureHotkey() noexcept {
	return g_capture_hotkey.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
}

uint64_t FlipCount() noexcept {
	return g_flip_count.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

void NoteFlip() {
	if (!Enabled()) {
		return;
	}
	g_flip_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
	using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
	static std::mutex              mutex;
	static Clock::time_point       last {};
	static Clock::time_point       period {};
	static std::vector<double>     intervals;
	static uint64_t                draws_before = 0;
	std::lock_guard                lock(mutex);
	const auto                     now = Clock::now();
	if (period == Clock::time_point {}) {
		Common::DebugCounters::SetEnabled(true); // draws/quadro needs the counter even without the overlay
		period       = now;
		draws_before = Common::DebugCounters::Get(Common::DebugCounters::Counter::Draws);
	}
	if (last != Clock::time_point {}) {
		intervals.push_back(std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(now - last).count());
	}
	last = now;
	if (now - period < std::chrono::seconds(10) || intervals.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	std::sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end());
	const auto draws = Common::DebugCounters::Get(Common::DebugCounters::Counter::Draws);
	const auto flips = intervals.size();
	std::fprintf(stderr, "[hib-flip] 10 s: %zu flips, intervalo p50 %.1f ms p99 %.1f ms, draws/quadro %llu\n", flips,
	             intervals[flips / 2], intervals[std::min(flips - 1, flips * 99 / 100)],
	             static_cast<unsigned long long>((draws - draws_before) / flips));
	ReportHostQueries(flips);
	intervals.clear();
	period       = now;
	draws_before = draws;
}

} // namespace Hybrid

```

`src/hybrid/kytyGpu.cpp`:

```cpp
// kyty_gpu.dll: the Kyty GPU libraries (Graphics5 = Agc, Graphics5Driver = AgcDriver, VideoOut) and Pad as a
// DLL inside the AnyPS5 executable, which resolves them by NID and reports its guest memory to them. Every
// export catches at the border: no exception crosses into the executable (hybrid requirement 8).
#include "common/emulatorConfig.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/profiler.h"
#include "common/subsystems.h"
#include "common/threads.h"
#include "kernel/pthread.h"
#include "libs/agc.h"
#include "libs/controller.h"
#include "graphics/presentation/window.h"
#include "graphics/host_gpu/renderer/targetDump.h"
#include "graphics/presentation/videoOut.h"

#include "hybrid/hybrid.h"
#include "kernel/memory.h"
#include "libs/libs.h"

#include <cstdlib>

#include <exception>
#include <future>

#include <mutex>

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
#include <windows.h> // IWYU pragma: keep
#endif

namespace Libs {
LIB_DEFINE(InitAgcDriver_1);
LIB_DEFINE(InitPad_1);
namespace LibGen5 {
LIB_DEFINE(InitVideoOut_1);
} // namespace LibGen5
} // namespace Libs

namespace {

Loader::SymbolDatabase& Database() {
	static Loader::SymbolDatabase database;
	static std::once_flag         once;
	std::call_once(once, [] {
		Libs::InitAgcDriver_1(&database);
		Libs::LibGen5::InitVideoOut_1(&database);
		Libs::InitPad_1(&database);
	});
	return database;
}

void Failed(const char* export_name, const char* what) noexcept {
	std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] %s failed: %s\n", export_name, what);
	std::fflush(stderr);
}

template <typename Body>
auto Guarded(const char* export_name, Body&& body, decltype(body()) fallback) noexcept {
	try {
		return body();
	} catch (const std::exception& error) {
		Failed(export_name, error.what());
	} catch (...) {
		Failed(export_name, "unknown exception");
	}
	return fallback;
}

// The pipeline cache is keyed by the title's TITLE_ID, which pure Kyty reads from param.json when it loads the
// game; in the hybrid the executable loads it, so read it here (the run's directory has app0 next to the exe).
void LoadTitleForPipelineCache() noexcept {
	try {
		const std::filesystem::path param_json = std::filesystem::path("app0") / "sce_sys" / "param.json";
		if (!std::filesystem::exists(param_json)) {
			std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] no %s: the Vulkan pipeline cache stays off\n", param_json.string().c_str());
			return;
		}
		Loader::SystemContentLoadParamSfo(param_json);
		std::string title_id;
		if (!Loader::SystemContentParamSfoGetString("TITLE_ID", &title_id) || title_id.empty()) {
			std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] %s has no TITLE_ID: the Vulkan pipeline cache stays off\n", param_json.string().c_str());
			return;
		}
		const auto cache = std::filesystem::path("_PipelineCache") / (title_id + ".bin");
		std::error_code error;
		const auto bytes = std::filesystem::file_size(cache, error);
		std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] Vulkan pipeline cache %s: %s\n", std::filesystem::absolute(cache).string().c_str(),
		             error ? "absent, written once a minute while running" :(std::to_string(bytes) + " bytes").c_str());
	} catch (const std::exception& error) {
		std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] param.json not loaded (%s): the Vulkan pipeline cache stays off\n", error.what());
	}
}

} // namespace

// The SysV-ABI entry point of the Kyty function or object registered under this NID, or 0 when Kyty
// does not have it.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) uint64_t kyty_gpu_resolve(const char* nid) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_resolve",
	    [&]() -> uint64_t {
		    if (nid == nullptr) {
			    return 0;
		    }
		    const std::string key(nid);
		    const auto&       database = Database();
		    for (const auto type: {Loader::SymbolType::Func, Loader::SymbolType::Object}) {
			    if (const auto* record = database.FindByNid(key, type); record != nullptr) {
				    return record->vaddr;
			    }
		    }
		    return 0;
	    },
	    uint64_t {0});
}

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void kyty_gpu_init(const Aps5Host* host) {
	Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_init",
	    [&]() -> bool {
		    if (host == nullptr || host->version != 2) {
			    Failed("kyty_gpu_init", "unsupported host table");
			    return false;
		    }
		    Hybrid::SetHost(host);
		    // What the emulator's Init runs, minus the loader, network, file system and audio, which the
		    // executable owns, on a thread of the DLL that stays in the window loop as the emulator's main
		    // thread does. The executable's startup thread waits until the subsystems are up.
		    std::promise<void> started;
		    auto               ready = started.get_future();
		    std::thread([started = std::move(started)]() mutable {
			    Common::InitializeThreads();
			    static Common::Subsystems subsystems(false);
			    subsystems.Initialize<Config::Lifecycle>();
			    Config::ConfigOptions options {};
			    options.screen_width          = 1920;
			    options.screen_height         = 1080;
			    options.readback_tiled_images = true;
			    // The game asks the executable for its user (libSceUserService stays in the executable): Kyty's
			    // pad maps players by that id.
			    options.user_id = 0x10000000;
			    // The same knobs as pure Kyty's --vblank-frequency and --present-mode, for measuring without vsync.
			    if (const char* hz = std::getenv("KYTY_HYB_VBLANK_HZ"); hz != nullptr && std::atoi(hz) > 0) {
				    options.vblank_frequency = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::atoi(hz));
			    }
			    if (const char* mode = std::getenv("KYTY_HYB_PRESENT_MODE"); mode != nullptr) {
				    const std::string value(mode);
				    if (value == "Fifo") {
					    options.present_mode = Config::PresentMode::Fifo;
				    } else if (value == "Mailbox") {
					    options.present_mode = Config::PresentMode::Mailbox;
				    } else if (value == "Immediate") {
					    options.present_mode = Config::PresentMode::Immediate;
				    }
			    }
			    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] vblank %u Hz, present mode %d (KYTY_HYB_VBLANK_HZ, KYTY_HYB_PRESENT_MODE)\n",
			                 options.vblank_frequency, static_cast<int>(options.present_mode));
			    Config::Load(options);
			    subsystems.Initialize<Log::Lifecycle>();
			    subsystems.Initialize<Libs::LibKernel::PthreadLifecycle>();
			    subsystems.Initialize<Profiler::Lifecycle>();
			    KYTY_PROFILER_THREAD("Thread_KytyMain");
			    subsystems.Initialize<Libs::LibKernel::Memory::Lifecycle>();
			    subsystems.Initialize<Libs::Controller::Lifecycle>();
			    LoadTitleForPipelineCache();
			    subsystems.Initialize<Libs::Graphics::Lifecycle>();
			    started.set_value();
			    Libs::Graphics::WindowRun();
			    // The window closed (Alt+F4): the executable owns the process, so its exit path runs (its shutdown,
			    // then TerminateProcess). quick_exit ended in ExitProcess, whose DLL detach ran this DLL's static
			    // destructors against threads already gone, and the process hung.
			    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] window closed: asking the executable to exit\n");
			    if (const auto request_exit = Hybrid::Executable<void (*)(int)>("LibcRequestExit_nid_postfix")) {
				    request_exit(0);
				    return;
			    }
			    TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0);
		    }).detach();
		    ready.wait();
		    return true;
	    },
	    false);
}

// The executable's frame capture starts the render target dump (KYTY_TARGET_DUMP=1) with the next draw, with the

// The executable's frame capture: Kyty's state from the calls made before it starts (mapped shaders,
// tessellation rings, video out ports) as words, written with the GPU idle and put back by the replay.
constexpr uint64_t CaptureStateMagic = 0x3354535954594bull; // "KYTYST3"

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) uint64_t kyty_gpu_capture_state(uint64_t* out, uint64_t capacity) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_capture_state",
	    [&]() -> uint64_t {
		    std::vector<uint64_t> words {CaptureStateMagic, 0};
		    Libs::Graphics::ShaderForEachMapped([&](uint64_t addr, const Libs::Graphics::ShaderMappedData& data) {
			    words[1]++;
			    words.insert(words.end(), {addr, static_cast<uint64_t>(data.type), reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(data.user_data),
			                               reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(data.input_semantics), data.num_input_semantics,
			                               (static_cast<uint64_t>(data.code_size_bytes) << 32u) | data.scratch_size_dwords});
		    });
		    uint64_t tessellation[5] {};
		    Libs::Graphics::HybridGetTessellationState(tessellation);
		    words.insert(words.end(), std::begin(tessellation), std::end(tessellation));
		    const auto registers_at = words.size();
		    words.push_back(0);
		    Libs::Graphics::HybridCaptureRegisters(words);
		    words[registers_at] = words.size() - registers_at - 1;
		    const auto blocked_at = words.size();
		    words.push_back(0);
		    Libs::Graphics::HybridCaptureBlocked(words);
		    words[blocked_at] = words.size() - blocked_at - 1;
		    Libs::VideoOut::HybridCaptureState(words);
		    if (out != nullptr && capacity >= words.size()) {
			    std::copy(words.begin(), words.end(), out);
		    }
		    return words.size();
	    },
	    uint64_t {0});
}

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool kyty_gpu_restore_state(const uint64_t* words, uint64_t count) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_restore_state",
	    [&]() -> bool {
		    if (words == nullptr || count < 7 || words[0] != CaptureStateMagic || count < 2 + words[1] * 6 + 5) {
			    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] restore: not a Kyty state record (%llu words)\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(count));
			    return false;
		    }
		    const auto* at = words + 2;
		    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < words[1]; i++, at += 6) {
			    Libs::Graphics::ShaderMappedData data;
			    data.type                = static_cast<Libs::Graphics::Prospero::ShaderBinaryType>(at[1]);
			    data.user_data           = reinterpret_cast<Libs::Graphics::ShaderUserData*>(at[2]);
			    data.input_semantics     = reinterpret_cast<Libs::Graphics::ShaderSemantic*>(at[3]);
			    data.num_input_semantics = static_cast<uint32_t>(at[4]);
			    data.code_size_bytes     = static_cast<uint32_t>(at[5] >> 32u);
			    data.scratch_size_dwords = static_cast<uint32_t>(at[5]);
			    Libs::Graphics::ShaderMapUserData(at[0], data);
		    }
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] restore: %llu shaders mapped\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(words[1]));
		    Libs::Graphics::HybridSetTessellationState(at);
		    at += 5;
		    std::fputs("[kyty-gpu] restore: tessellation rings set\n", stderr);
		    const auto registers = at < words + count ? *at++ : 0;
		    if (registers > static_cast<uint64_t>(words + count - at) || !Libs::Graphics::HybridRestoreRegisters(at, at + registers)) {
			    std::fputs("[kyty-gpu] restore: the command processor registers do not match this DLL\n", stderr);
			    return false;
		    }
		    at += registers;
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] restore: command processor registers set (%llu words)\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(registers));
		    const auto blocked = at < words + count ? *at++ : 0;
		    if (blocked > static_cast<uint64_t>(words + count - at) || !Libs::Graphics::HybridRestoreBlocked(at, at + blocked)) {
			    std::fputs("[kyty-gpu] restore: the blocked submissions could not be queued\n", stderr);
			    return false;
		    }
		    at += blocked;
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] restore: blocked submissions queued (%llu words)\n", static_cast<unsigned long long>(blocked));
		    const bool restored = Libs::VideoOut::HybridRestoreState(at, words + count);
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] restored %llu shaders, the tessellation rings and the video out ports: %s\n",
		                 static_cast<unsigned long long>(words[1]), restored ? "ok" : "FAILED");
		    return restored;
	    },
	    false);
}

// The frame capture's wait for an idle GPU, bounded: the calling game thread may be the one that writes
// the memory the GPU waits on, so an unbounded wait would freeze the game.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool kyty_gpu_wait_idle_for(uint32_t millis) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_wait_idle_for",
	    [&] {
		    if (Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridWaitGpuIdleFor(millis)) {
			    return true;
		    }
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] the GPU is still busy after %u ms:\n%s", millis,
		                 Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridDescribeGpuBusy().c_str());
		    return false;
	    },
	    false);
}

// Quiet: nothing processed or executed and every queued submission blocked; `blocked` gets their number.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool kyty_gpu_wait_quiet_for(uint32_t millis, uint32_t* blocked) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_wait_quiet_for",
	    [&] {
		    if (Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridWaitGpuQuietFor(millis, blocked)) {
			    return true;
		    }
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] the GPU is not quiet after %u ms:\n%s", millis,
		                 Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridDescribeGpuBusy().c_str());
		    return false;
	    },
	    false);
}

// The replay's offline check that a requeued submission waits on its rewind until the bit is set.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool kyty_gpu_self_test_rewind() {
	return Guarded("kyty_gpu_self_test_rewind", [] { return Libs::Graphics::HybridSelfTestRewind(); }, false);
}

// The frame capture, with the GPU quiet and before its snapshot: GPU-written images to guest memory.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool kyty_gpu_flush_images() {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_flush_images",
	    [] {
		    Libs::Graphics::HybridFlushGpuImages();
		    return true;
	    },
	    false);
}

// The same, for the graphics queue only (compute queues may keep running); on timeout it logs the busy queues.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool kyty_gpu_wait_gfx_idle_for(uint32_t millis) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_wait_gfx_idle_for",
	    [&] {
		    if (Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridWaitGpuGfxIdleFor(millis)) {
			    return true;
		    }
		    std::fprintf(stderr, "[kyty-gpu] the graphics queue is still busy after %u ms:\n%s", millis,
		                 Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridDescribeGpuBusy().c_str());
		    return false;
	    },
	    false);
}

// The queues with queued submissions into `out` (0 = gfx); returns how many there are.
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) uint32_t kyty_gpu_busy_queues(uint32_t* out, uint32_t capacity) {
	return Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_busy_queues",
	    [&]() -> uint32_t {
		    const auto busy = Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridGpuBusyQueues();
		    for (uint32_t i = 0; out != nullptr && i < capacity && i < busy.size(); i++) {
			    out[i] = busy[i];
		    }
		    return static_cast<uint32_t>(busy.size());
	    },
	    0u);
}

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void kyty_gpu_prepare_host_write(uint64_t address, uint64_t bytes) {
	Guarded(
	    "kyty_gpu_prepare_host_write",
	    [&]() -> bool {
		    Libs::LibKernel::Memory::HybridPrepareHostWrite(address, bytes);
		    return true;
	    },
	    false);
}
```

`src/kernel/eventFlag.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "kernel/eventFlag.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/common.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/stringUtils.h"
#include "common/threads.h"
#include "common/timer.h"
#include "libs/errno.h"
#include "libs/libs.h"

namespace Libs::LibKernel::EventFlag {

LIB_NAME("libkernel", "libkernel");

class KernelEventFlagPrivate {
public:
	enum class Result { Ok, AlreadyWaiting, TimedOut, Canceled, Deleted };

	enum class ClearMode { None, All, Bits };

	enum class WaitMode { And, Or };

	KernelEventFlagPrivate(const std::string& name, bool single, bool /*fifo*/, uint64_t bits)
	    : m_name(name), m_single_thread(single), m_bits(bits) {}
	virtual ~KernelEventFlagPrivate();

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(KernelEventFlagPrivate);

	void   Set(uint64_t bits);
	void   Clear(uint64_t bits);
	void   Cancel(uint64_t bits, int* num_waiting_threads);
	Result Wait(uint64_t bits, WaitMode wait_mode, ClearMode clear_mode, uint64_t* result,
	            uint32_t* ptr_micros);

	Result Poll(uint64_t bits, WaitMode wait_mode, ClearMode clear_mode, uint64_t* result) {
		uint32_t micros = 0;
		return Wait(bits, wait_mode, clear_mode, result, &micros);
	}

private:
	enum class Status { Set, Canceled, Deleted };

	Common::Mutex   m_mutex;
	Common::CondVar m_cond_var;
	Status          m_status          = Status::Set;
	int             m_waiting_threads = 0;
	std::string     m_name;
	bool            m_single_thread = false;
	uint64_t        m_bits          = 0;
};

namespace {

struct EventFlagWaitMode {
	KernelEventFlagPrivate::WaitMode  wait  = KernelEventFlagPrivate::WaitMode::And;
	KernelEventFlagPrivate::ClearMode clear = KernelEventFlagPrivate::ClearMode::None;
};

EventFlagWaitMode DecodeEventFlagWaitMode(uint32_t wait_mode) {
	EventFlagWaitMode mode;

	switch (wait_mode & 0xfu) {
		case 0x01: mode.wait = KernelEventFlagPrivate::WaitMode::And; break;
		case 0x02: mode.wait = KernelEventFlagPrivate::WaitMode::Or; break;
		default: EXIT("unknown mode: %u\n", wait_mode);
	}

	switch (wait_mode & 0xf0u) {
		case 0x00: mode.clear = KernelEventFlagPrivate::ClearMode::None; break;
		case 0x10: mode.clear = KernelEventFlagPrivate::ClearMode::All; break;
		case 0x20: mode.clear = KernelEventFlagPrivate::ClearMode::Bits; break;
		default: EXIT("unknown mode: %u\n", wait_mode);
	}

	return mode;
}

} // namespace

KernelEventFlagPrivate::~KernelEventFlagPrivate() {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	while (m_status != Status::Set) {
		m_mutex.Unlock();
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(10);
		m_mutex.Lock();
	}

	m_status = Status::Deleted;

	m_cond_var.SignalAll();

	while (m_waiting_threads > 0) {
		m_mutex.Unlock();
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(10);
		m_mutex.Lock();
	}
}

KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result KernelEventFlagPrivate::Wait(uint64_t bits, WaitMode wait_mode,
                                                            ClearMode clear_mode, uint64_t* result,
                                                            uint32_t* ptr_micros) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	uint32_t micros     = 0;
	bool     infinitely = true;
	if (ptr_micros != nullptr) {
		micros     = *ptr_micros;
		infinitely = false;
	}

	uint32_t      elapsed = 0;
	Common::Timer t;

	auto update_timeout = [&]() {
		if (ptr_micros != nullptr) {
			*ptr_micros = (elapsed >= micros ? 0 : micros - elapsed);
		}
	};

	if (m_single_thread && m_waiting_threads > 0) {
		return Result::AlreadyWaiting;
	}

	while (!((wait_mode == WaitMode::And && (m_bits & bits) == bits) ||
	         (wait_mode == WaitMode::Or && (m_bits & bits) != 0))) {
		if ((elapsed >= micros && !infinitely)) {
			if (result != nullptr) {
				*result = m_bits;
			}
			update_timeout();
			return Result::TimedOut;
		}

		m_waiting_threads++;

		if (infinitely) {
			m_cond_var.Wait(&m_mutex);
		} else {
			m_cond_var.WaitFor(&m_mutex, micros - elapsed);
		}

		m_waiting_threads--;

		elapsed = static_cast<uint32_t>(t.GetTimeS() * 1000000.0);

		switch (m_status) {
			case Status::Canceled:
				if (result != nullptr) {
					*result = m_bits;
				}
				update_timeout();
				return Result::Canceled;
			case Status::Deleted:
				if (result != nullptr) {
					*result = m_bits;
				}
				update_timeout();
				return Result::Deleted;
			case Status::Set: break;
		}
	}

	if (result != nullptr) {
		*result = m_bits;
	}
	update_timeout();

	switch (clear_mode) {
		case ClearMode::All: m_bits = 0; break;
		case ClearMode::Bits: m_bits &= ~bits; break;
		case ClearMode::None: break;
	}

	return Result::Ok;
}

void KernelEventFlagPrivate::Set(uint64_t bits) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(m_status == Status::Deleted);

	while (m_status != Status::Set) {
		m_mutex.Unlock();
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(10);
		m_mutex.Lock();
	}

	m_bits |= bits;

	m_cond_var.SignalAll();
}

void KernelEventFlagPrivate::Clear(uint64_t bits) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(m_status == Status::Deleted);

	while (m_status != Status::Set) {
		m_mutex.Unlock();
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(10);
		m_mutex.Lock();
	}

	m_bits &= bits;
}

void KernelEventFlagPrivate::Cancel(uint64_t bits, int* num_waiting_threads) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(m_status == Status::Deleted);

	while (m_status != Status::Set) {
		m_mutex.Unlock();
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(10);
		m_mutex.Lock();
	}

	if (num_waiting_threads != nullptr) {
		*num_waiting_threads = m_waiting_threads;
	}

	m_status = Status::Canceled;
	m_bits   = bits;

	m_cond_var.SignalAll();

	while (m_waiting_threads > 0) {
		m_mutex.Unlock();
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(10);
		m_mutex.Lock();
	}

	m_status = Status::Set;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelCreateEventFlag(KernelEventFlag* ef, const char* name, uint32_t attr,
                                        uint64_t init_pattern, const void* param) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr || name == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	if (param != nullptr || (attr & ~0x33u) != 0) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	bool single = true;
	bool fifo   = true;

	switch (attr & 0x0fu) {
		case 0x00:
		case 0x01: fifo = true; break;
		case 0x02: fifo = false; break;
		default: return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	switch (attr & 0xf0u) {
		case 0x00:
		case 0x10: single = true; break;
		case 0x20: single = false; break;
		default: return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	*ef = new KernelEventFlagPrivate(std::string(name), single, fifo, init_pattern);

	LOGF("\tEventFlag create: %s\n", name);

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteEventFlag(KernelEventFlag ef) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ESRCH;
	}

	delete ef;

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelWaitEventFlag(KernelEventFlag ef, uint64_t bit_pattern, uint32_t wait_mode,
                                      uint64_t* result_pat, KernelUseconds* timeout) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ESRCH;
	}

	if (bit_pattern == 0) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	const auto mode   = DecodeEventFlagWaitMode(wait_mode);
	auto       result = ef->Wait(bit_pattern, mode.wait, mode.clear, result_pat, timeout);

	int ret = OK;

	switch (result) {
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::Ok: ret = OK; break;
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::AlreadyWaiting: ret = KERNEL_ERROR_EPERM; break;
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::TimedOut: ret = KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT; break;
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::Canceled: ret = KERNEL_ERROR_ECANCELED; break;
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::Deleted: ret = KERNEL_ERROR_EACCES; break;
	}

	return ret;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelPollEventFlag(KernelEventFlag ef, uint64_t bit_pattern, uint32_t wait_mode,
                                      uint64_t* result_pat) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ESRCH;
	}

	if (bit_pattern == 0) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	const auto mode   = DecodeEventFlagWaitMode(wait_mode);
	auto       result = ef->Poll(bit_pattern, mode.wait, mode.clear, result_pat);

	int ret = OK;

	switch (result) {
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::Ok: ret = OK; break;
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::AlreadyWaiting: ret = KERNEL_ERROR_EPERM; break;
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::TimedOut:
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::Canceled:
		case KernelEventFlagPrivate::Result::Deleted: ret = KERNEL_ERROR_EBUSY; break;
	}

	return ret;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelSetEventFlag(KernelEventFlag ef, uint64_t bit_pattern) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ESRCH;
	}

	ef->Set(bit_pattern);

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelClearEventFlag(KernelEventFlag ef, uint64_t bit_pattern) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ESRCH;
	}

	ef->Clear(bit_pattern);

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelCancelEventFlag(KernelEventFlag ef, uint64_t set_pattern,
                                        int* num_wait_threads) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ef == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ESRCH;
	}

	ef->Cancel(set_pattern, num_wait_threads);

	return OK;
}

} // namespace Libs::LibKernel::EventFlag
```

`src/kernel/eventQueue.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "kernel/eventQueue.h"

#include "hybrid/hybrid.h"

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/common.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/stringUtils.h"
#include "common/threads.h"
#include "common/timer.h"
#include "libs/errno.h"
#include "libs/libs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <limits>
#include <list>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace Libs::LibKernel::EventQueue {

LIB_NAME("libkernel", "libkernel");

constexpr uint16_t EV_ADD     = 0x01;
constexpr uint16_t EV_ONESHOT = 0x10;
constexpr uint16_t EV_CLEAR   = 0x20;
constexpr uint16_t EV_ERROR   = 0x4000;

static std::unordered_map<KernelEqueue, KernelEqueueRef> g_equeues;
static Common::Mutex                                     g_equeues_mutex;
static uint64_t                                          g_next_equeue = 1;

class KernelEqueuePrivate {
public:
	explicit KernelEqueuePrivate(KernelEqueue handle): m_handle(handle) {}
	virtual ~KernelEqueuePrivate();

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(KernelEqueuePrivate);

	[[nodiscard]] const std::string& GetName() const { return m_name; }
	void                             SetName(const std::string& m_name) { this->m_name = m_name; }

	int AddEvent(const KernelEqueueEvent& event);
	int TriggerEvent(uintptr_t ident, int16_t filter, void* trigger_data);
	int DeleteEvent(uintptr_t ident, int16_t filter);

	int  GetTriggeredEvents(KernelEvent* ev, int num);
	int  WaitForEvents(KernelEvent* ev, int num, uint32_t micros);
	void Close();

private:
	void TriggerExpiredTimers(uint64_t now_ns);
	bool GetNextTimerWaitMicros(uint64_t now_ns, uint32_t* wait_micros) const;

	std::list<KernelEqueueEvent> m_events;
	Common::Mutex                m_mutex;
	Common::CondVar              m_cond_var;
	std::string                  m_name;
	KernelEqueue                 m_handle = KERNEL_EQUEUE_INVALID;
	bool                         m_closed = false;
};

KernelEqueuePrivate::~KernelEqueuePrivate() {
	Close();
}

void KernelEqueuePrivate::Close() {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	if (m_closed) {
		return;
	}
	m_closed = true;
	for (auto& event: m_events) {
		if (event.filter.delete_event_func != nullptr) {
			auto owner = event.filter.owner;
			event.filter.delete_event_func(m_handle, &event);
		}
	}
	m_events.clear();
	m_cond_var.SignalAll();
}

int KernelEqueuePrivate::GetTriggeredEvents(KernelEvent* ev, int num) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	EXIT_IF(num < 1);
	if (m_closed) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}

	TriggerExpiredTimers(Common::SteadyNs());

	int ret = 0;

	for (auto it = m_events.begin(); it != m_events.end();) {
		auto& event = *it;
		bool  erase = false;
		while (event.triggered) {
			ev[ret++] = event.event;
			if ((event.event.flags & EV_ONESHOT) != 0) {
				erase = true;
				break;
			}

			if (event.filter.reset_func != nullptr) {
				event.filter.reset_func(&event);
			} else if ((event.event.flags & EV_CLEAR) != 0) {
				event.triggered    = false;
				event.event.fflags = 0;
				event.event.data   = 0;
			}

			if (!event.pending_events.empty()) {
				event.event = event.pending_events.front();
				event.pending_events.pop_front();
				event.triggered = true;
			} else {
				// A persistent level is delivered again by the next wait, not this batch.
				break;
			}

			if (ret >= num) {
				break;
			}
		}
		it = (erase ? m_events.erase(it) : std::next(it));
		if (ret >= num) {
			break;
		}
	}

	return ret;
}

void KernelEqueuePrivate::TriggerExpiredTimers(uint64_t now_ns) {
	for (auto& event: m_events) {
		if (event.deadline_ns != 0 && event.deadline_ns <= now_ns) {
			if (event.event.filter == KERNEL_EVFILT_TIMER) {
				const auto count = event.interval_ns == 0 ? !event.triggered :
				    1 + (now_ns - event.deadline_ns) / event.interval_ns;
				event.event.data += static_cast<intptr_t>(count);
				event.deadline_ns += count * event.interval_ns;
			}
			event.triggered = true;
		}
	}
}

bool KernelEqueuePrivate::GetNextTimerWaitMicros(uint64_t now_ns, uint32_t* wait_micros) const {
	EXIT_IF(wait_micros == nullptr);

	uint64_t nearest_deadline = UINT64_MAX;
	for (const auto& event: m_events) {
		if (!event.triggered && event.deadline_ns != 0) {
			nearest_deadline = std::min(nearest_deadline, event.deadline_ns);
		}
	}
	if (nearest_deadline == UINT64_MAX) {
		return false;
	}

	const auto remaining_ns = nearest_deadline > now_ns ? nearest_deadline - now_ns : 0;
	const auto rounded_us   = std::max<uint64_t>(1, (remaining_ns + 999u) / 1000u);
	*wait_micros            = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(rounded_us, UINT32_MAX));
	return true;
}

int KernelEqueuePrivate::WaitForEvents(KernelEvent* ev, int num, uint32_t micros) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	EXIT_IF(num < 1);
	if (m_closed) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}

	uint32_t      elapsed = 0;
	Common::Timer t;

	for (;;) {
		int ret = GetTriggeredEvents(ev, num);

		if (ret != 0 || (elapsed >= micros && micros != 0)) {
			return ret;
		}

		uint32_t   timer_wait = 0;
		const bool has_timer  = GetNextTimerWaitMicros(Common::SteadyNs(), &timer_wait);
		if (micros == 0 && !has_timer) {
			m_cond_var.Wait(&m_mutex);
		} else {
			const auto external_wait = micros != 0 ? micros - elapsed : UINT32_MAX;
			m_cond_var.WaitFor(&m_mutex,
			                   has_timer ? std::min(external_wait, timer_wait) : external_wait);
		}

		elapsed = static_cast<uint32_t>(t.GetTimeS() * 1000000.0);
	}

	return 0;
}

int KernelEqueuePrivate::AddEvent(const KernelEqueueEvent& event) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	if (m_closed) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}
	auto it = std::find_if(m_events.begin(), m_events.end(),
	                       [ident = event.event.ident, filter = event.event.filter](const auto& e) {
		                       return e.event.ident == ident && e.event.filter == filter;
	                       });
	if (it != m_events.end()) {
		TriggerExpiredTimers(Common::SteadyNs());
		it->deadline_ns = event.deadline_ns;
		it->interval_ns = event.interval_ns;
		it->event.udata = event.event.udata;
		for (auto& pending: it->pending_events) {
			pending.udata = event.event.udata;
		}
	} else {
		m_events.push_back(event);
	}

	m_cond_var.Signal();
	return OK;
}

int KernelEqueuePrivate::TriggerEvent(uintptr_t ident, int16_t filter, void* trigger_data) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	if (m_closed) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}
	auto it = std::find_if(m_events.begin(), m_events.end(), [ident, filter](const auto& e) {
		return e.event.ident == ident && e.event.filter == filter;
	});
	if (it != m_events.end()) {
		auto& event = *it;

		if (event.filter.trigger_func != nullptr) {
			event.filter.trigger_func(&event, trigger_data);
		} else {
			event.triggered = true;
		}

		m_cond_var.Signal();

		return OK;
	}

	return KERNEL_ERROR_ENOENT;
}

static void UserEventTriggerFunc(KernelEqueueEvent* event, void* trigger_data) {
	EXIT_IF(event == nullptr);
	event->triggered   = true;
	event->event.data  = reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(trigger_data);
	event->event.udata = trigger_data;
}

static void AmprEventTriggerFunc(KernelEqueueEvent* event, void* trigger_data) {
	EXIT_IF(event == nullptr);
	auto triggered_event = event->event;
	triggered_event.data = static_cast<intptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(trigger_data));
	if (event->triggered) {
		event->pending_events.push_back(triggered_event);
	} else {
		event->event     = triggered_event;
		event->triggered = true;
	}
}

static void UserEventResetFunc(KernelEqueueEvent* event) {
	EXIT_IF(event == nullptr);
	if ((event->event.flags & EV_CLEAR) != 0) {
		event->triggered    = false;
		event->event.fflags = 0;
		event->event.data   = 0;
	}
}

int KernelEqueuePrivate::DeleteEvent(uintptr_t ident, int16_t filter) {
	Common::LockGuard lock(m_mutex);

	if (m_closed) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}
	auto it = std::find_if(m_events.begin(), m_events.end(), [ident, filter](const auto& e) {
		return e.event.ident == ident && e.event.filter == filter;
	});
	if (it != m_events.end()) {
		auto& event = *it;

		if (event.filter.delete_event_func != nullptr) {
			auto owner = event.filter.owner;
			event.filter.delete_event_func(m_handle, &event);
		}

		m_events.erase(it);

		return OK;
	}

	return KERNEL_ERROR_ENOENT;
}

KernelEqueueRef KernelPinEqueue(KernelEqueue eq) {
	if (eq == KERNEL_EQUEUE_INVALID) {
		return {};
	}

	Common::LockGuard lock(g_equeues_mutex);
	const auto        entry = g_equeues.find(eq);
	return entry != g_equeues.end() ? entry->second : KernelEqueueRef {};
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelCreateEqueue(KernelEqueue* eq, const char* name) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (eq == nullptr || name == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	{
		Common::LockGuard lock(g_equeues_mutex);
		if (g_next_equeue > static_cast<uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<KernelEqueue>::max())) {
			EXIT("event queue handle space exhausted\n");
		}
		*eq        = static_cast<KernelEqueue>(g_next_equeue++);
		auto owner = std::make_shared<KernelEqueuePrivate>(*eq);
		owner->SetName(std::string(name));
		g_equeues.emplace(*eq, std::move(owner));
	}

	LOGF("\tEqueue create: %s\n", name);

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddEvent(KernelEqueue eq, const KernelEqueueEvent& event) {
	if (Hybrid::Enabled()) {
		return Hybrid::AddEvent(eq, event.event.ident, event.event.filter, event.event.udata,
		                        event.event.filter == KERNEL_EVFILT_VIDEO_OUT ? 1 : 0, event.triggered,
		                        event.event.data);
	}
	auto owner = KernelPinEqueue(eq);
	if (!owner) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}

	return owner->AddEvent(event);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelTriggerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, uintptr_t ident, int16_t filter,
                                     void* trigger_data) {
	if (Hybrid::Enabled()) {
		return Hybrid::TriggerEvent(eq, ident, filter, trigger_data);
	}
	auto owner = KernelPinEqueue(eq);
	if (!owner) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}

	return owner->TriggerEvent(ident, filter, trigger_data);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteEvent(KernelEqueue eq, uintptr_t ident, int16_t filter) {
	if (Hybrid::Enabled()) {
		return Hybrid::DeleteEvent(eq, ident, filter);
	}
	auto owner = KernelPinEqueue(eq);
	if (!owner) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}

	return owner->DeleteEvent(ident, filter);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteEqueue(KernelEqueue eq) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	KernelEqueueRef owner;

	{
		Common::LockGuard lock(g_equeues_mutex);
		const auto        entry = g_equeues.find(eq);
		if (entry == g_equeues.end()) {
			return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
		}
		owner = std::move(entry->second);
		g_equeues.erase(entry);
	}

	LOGF("\tEqueue delete: %s\n", owner->GetName().c_str());
	owner->Close();

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelWaitEqueue(KernelEqueue eq, KernelEvent* ev, int num, int* out,
                                   const KernelUseconds* timo) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	auto owner = KernelPinEqueue(eq);
	if (!owner) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}

	if (ev == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
	}

	if (num < 1) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(out == nullptr);

	LOGF("\tEqueue wait: %s, caller = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", ev = 0x%016" PRIx64
	     ", num = %d, timo = %s, thread_id = %d\n",
	     owner->GetName().c_str(), reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(__builtin_return_address(0)),
	     static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ev), num,
	     (timo == nullptr ? "inf" : fmt::format("{}", *timo).c_str()),
	     Common::Thread::GetThreadIdUnique());

	if (timo == nullptr) {
		*out = owner->WaitForEvents(ev, num, 0);
	}

	if (timo != nullptr) {
		if (*timo == 0) {
			*out = owner->GetTriggeredEvents(ev, num);
		} else {
			*out = owner->WaitForEvents(ev, num, *timo);
		}
	}

	if (*out == KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EBADF;
	}
	if (*out == 0) {
		LOGF("\tEqueue wait timedout: %s\n", owner->GetName().c_str());
		return KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT;
	}

	LOGF("\tEqueue wait received %u events: ident = 0x%016" PRIx64
	     ", filter = %d, flags = 0x%04" PRIx16 ", fflags = 0x%08" PRIx32 ", data = 0x%016" PRIx64
	     ", udata = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
	     *out, static_cast<uint64_t>(ev[0].ident), ev[0].filter, ev[0].flags, ev[0].fflags,
	     static_cast<uint64_t>(ev[0].data), reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ev[0].udata));

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddUserEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t user event add: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d\n", static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id);

	KernelEqueueEvent event {};
	event.event.ident         = static_cast<uintptr_t>(id);
	event.event.filter        = KERNEL_EVFILT_USER;
	event.event.flags         = EV_ADD;
	event.event.fflags        = 0;
	event.event.data          = 0;
	event.event.udata         = nullptr;
	event.filter.trigger_func = UserEventTriggerFunc;
	event.filter.reset_func   = UserEventResetFunc;

	return KernelAddEvent(eq, event);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddUserEventEdge(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t user event edge add: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d\n", static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id);

	KernelEqueueEvent event {};
	event.event.ident         = static_cast<uintptr_t>(id);
	event.event.filter        = KERNEL_EVFILT_USER;
	event.event.flags         = EV_ADD | EV_CLEAR;
	event.event.fflags        = 0;
	event.event.data          = 0;
	event.event.udata         = nullptr;
	event.filter.trigger_func = UserEventTriggerFunc;
	event.filter.reset_func   = UserEventResetFunc;

	return KernelAddEvent(eq, event);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelTriggerUserEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, void* udata) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t user event trigger: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d, udata = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
	     static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id, reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(udata));

	return KernelTriggerEvent(eq, static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), KERNEL_EVFILT_USER, udata);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelTriggerUserEventForAll(int id, void* udata) {
	int                          triggered = 0;
	std::vector<KernelEqueueRef> queues;

	{
		Common::LockGuard lock(g_equeues_mutex);
		queues.reserve(g_equeues.size());
		for (const auto& [handle, queue]: g_equeues) {
			queues.push_back(queue);
		}
	}
	for (const auto& eq: queues) {
		if (eq->TriggerEvent(static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), KERNEL_EVFILT_USER, udata) == OK) {
			triggered++;
		}
	}

	return (triggered > 0 ? OK : KERNEL_ERROR_ENOENT);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteUserEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t user event delete: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d\n", static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id);

	return KernelDeleteEvent(eq, static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), KERNEL_EVFILT_USER);
}

static int AddTimerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, uint64_t delay_ns, bool periodic, void* udata) {
	const auto now_ns = Common::SteadyNs();
	KernelEqueueEvent event {};
	event.deadline_ns  = delay_ns <= UINT64_MAX - now_ns ? now_ns + delay_ns : UINT64_MAX;
	event.interval_ns  = periodic ? delay_ns : 0;
	event.event.ident  = static_cast<uintptr_t>(id);
	event.event.filter = periodic ? KERNEL_EVFILT_TIMER : KERNEL_EVFILT_HRTIMER;
	event.event.flags  = EV_ADD | (periodic ? EV_CLEAR : EV_ONESHOT);
	event.event.udata  = udata;
	return KernelAddEvent(eq, event);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddTimerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, KernelUseconds usec, void* udata) {
	return AddTimerEvent(eq, id, static_cast<uint64_t>(usec) * 1000, true, udata);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteTimerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	return KernelDeleteEvent(eq, static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), KERNEL_EVFILT_TIMER);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddHRTimerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, const KernelTimespec* ts,
                                        void* udata) {
	if (ts == nullptr) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
	}
	if (ts->tv_sec < 0 || ts->tv_nsec < 0 || ts->tv_nsec >= 1000000000ll ||
	    static_cast<uint64_t>(ts->tv_sec) >
	        (UINT64_MAX - static_cast<uint64_t>(ts->tv_nsec)) / 1000000000ull) {
		return KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL;
	}

	const auto delay_ns =
	    static_cast<uint64_t>(ts->tv_sec) * 1000000000ull + static_cast<uint64_t>(ts->tv_nsec);
	return AddTimerEvent(eq, id, delay_ns, false, udata);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteHRTimerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	return KernelDeleteEvent(eq, static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), KERNEL_EVFILT_HRTIMER);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddAmprEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, void* udata) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t AMPR event add: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d, udata = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
	     static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id, reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(udata));

	if (eq != KERNEL_EQUEUE_INVALID) {
		KernelEqueueEvent event {};
		event.event.ident         = static_cast<uintptr_t>(id);
		event.event.filter        = KERNEL_EVFILT_AMPR;
		event.event.flags         = EV_ADD | EV_CLEAR;
		event.event.fflags        = 0;
		event.event.data          = 0;
		event.event.udata         = udata;
		event.filter.trigger_func = AmprEventTriggerFunc;
		event.filter.reset_func   = UserEventResetFunc;
		(void)KernelAddEvent(eq, event);
	}

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddAmprSystemEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, void* udata) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t AMPR system event add: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d, udata = 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
	     static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id, reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(udata));

	return KernelAddAmprEvent(eq, id, udata);
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteAmprEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t AMPR event delete: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d\n", static_cast<uint64_t>(eq), id);

	if (eq != KERNEL_EQUEUE_INVALID) {
		(void)KernelDeleteEvent(eq, static_cast<uintptr_t>(id), KERNEL_EVFILT_AMPR);
	}

	return OK;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteAmprSystemEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	LOGF("\t AMPR system event delete: eq = 0x%016" PRIx64 ", id = %d\n", static_cast<uint64_t>(eq),
	     id);

	return KernelDeleteAmprEvent(eq, id);
}

intptr_t KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelGetEventData(const KernelEvent* ev) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ev != nullptr) {
		return ev->data;
	}

	return 0;
}

intptr_t KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelGetEventFflags(const KernelEvent* ev) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ev != nullptr) {
		return ev->fflags;
	}

	return 0;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelGetEventFilter(const KernelEvent* ev) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ev != nullptr) {
		return ev->filter;
	}

	return 0;
}

uintptr_t KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelGetEventId(const KernelEvent* ev) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ev != nullptr) {
		return ev->ident;
	}

	return 0;
}

void* KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelGetEventUserData(const KernelEvent* ev) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ev != nullptr) {
		return ev->udata;
	}

	return nullptr;
}

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelGetEventError(const KernelEvent* ev) {
	PRINT_NAME();

	if (ev != nullptr && (ev->flags & EV_ERROR) != 0) {
		return static_cast<int>(ev->data);
	}

	return 0;
}
```

```h
#ifndef EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_KERNEL_EVENTQUEUE_H_
#define EMULATOR_INCLUDE_EMULATOR_KERNEL_EVENTQUEUE_H_

#include "common/abi.h"
#include "common/common.h"
#include "kernel/pthread.h"

#include <deque>
#include <memory>

namespace Libs::LibKernel::EventQueue {

constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_TIMER     = -7;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_READ      = -1;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_WRITE     = -2;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_USER      = -11;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_FILE      = -4;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_GRAPHICS  = -14;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_VIDEO_OUT = -13;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_HRTIMER   = -15;
constexpr int16_t KERNEL_EVFILT_AMPR      = -25;

class KernelEqueuePrivate;
struct KernelEqueueEvent;

using KernelEqueue    = int64_t;
using KernelEqueueRef = std::shared_ptr<KernelEqueuePrivate>;

constexpr KernelEqueue KERNEL_EQUEUE_INVALID = 0;

using trigger_func_t = void (*)(KernelEqueueEvent* event, void* trigger_data);
using reset_func_t   = void (*)(KernelEqueueEvent* event);
using delete_func_t  = void (*)(KernelEqueue eq, KernelEqueueEvent* event);

struct KernelEvent {
	uintptr_t ident  = 0;
	int16_t   filter = 0;
	uint16_t  flags  = 0;
	uint32_t  fflags = 0;
	intptr_t  data   = 0;
	void*     udata  = nullptr;
};

struct KernelFilter {
	void*                 data = nullptr;
	std::shared_ptr<void> owner;
	trigger_func_t        trigger_func      = nullptr;
	reset_func_t          reset_func        = nullptr;
	delete_func_t         delete_event_func = nullptr;
};

struct KernelEqueueEvent {
	bool                    triggered   = false;
	uint64_t                deadline_ns = 0;
	uint64_t                interval_ns = 0;
	KernelEvent             event;
	KernelFilter            filter;
	std::deque<KernelEvent> pending_events;
};

[[nodiscard]] KernelEqueueRef KernelPinEqueue(KernelEqueue eq);

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddEvent(KernelEqueue eq, const KernelEqueueEvent& event);

                                     void* trigger_data);

                                   const KernelUseconds* timo);

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddUserEventEdge(KernelEqueue eq, int id);

int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelDeleteUserEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id);
int KYTY_SYSV_ABI KernelAddTimerEvent(KernelEqueue eq, int id, KernelUseconds usec,
                                      void* udata);

                                        void* udata);
```

```cpp
#include "kernel/fileSystem.h"

#include "common/archive.h"

namespace Libs::LibKernel::FileSystem {

LIB_NAME("libkernel", "libkernel");

constexpr int      DESCRIPTOR_MIN = 3;
constexpr uint64_t DIR_BLOCK_SIZE = 512;

enum class SpecialFile {
	None,
	Random,
};

class MountPoints {
public:
	struct MountPair {
		std::filesystem::path dir;
		std::string           point;
		std::shared_ptr<Common::ArchiveReader> archive;
	};

	MountPoints() { EXIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(!Common::Thread::IsMainThread()); }

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(MountPoints);

	void Mount(const std::filesystem::path& folder, const std::string& point);
	void Umount(const std::string& folder_or_point);

	[[nodiscard]] std::filesystem::path ResolvePath(const std::string& mounted_name);

	std::vector<MountPair> m_mount_pairs;

struct File {
	Common::File                        f;
	std::string                         name;
	std::filesystem::path               real_name;
	std::atomic_bool                    opened;
	std::atomic_bool                    directory;
	std::atomic_bool                    readable;
	std::atomic_bool                    writable;
	std::atomic_bool                    append;
	std::atomic_bool                    sync_writes;
	std::atomic_bool                    close_on_exec;

class FileDescriptors {

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(FileDescriptors);
```
