// Internal memory address-space helpers included by memory.cpp.
// Kept in the same translation unit because they depend on memory.cpp-local helpers.

static constexpr uint64_t HOST_SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN  = 0x0000040000ull;
static constexpr uint64_t HOST_SYSTEM_MANAGED_MAX  = 0x07ffffbfffull;
#if defined(__APPLE__) && (defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64))
static constexpr uint64_t HOST_SYSTEM_RESERVED_MAX = 0x0fbfffffffull;
static constexpr uint64_t HOST_USER_MIN            = 0x7000000000ull;
#else
static constexpr uint64_t HOST_SYSTEM_RESERVED_MAX = 0x0fffffffffull;
static constexpr uint64_t HOST_USER_MIN            = 0x1000000000ull;
#endif
static constexpr uint64_t HOST_USER_MAX = 0xfbffffffffull;

static bool GuestFreeRangeContains(uint64_t base, uint64_t range_size, uint64_t candidate,
                                   uint64_t size) {
	const auto range_end = base + range_size;
	return candidate <= range_end && size <= range_end - candidate;
}

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
static bool CoalescePlaceholders(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
	return VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr), size,
	                   MEM_RELEASE | MEM_COALESCE_PLACEHOLDERS) != 0;
}
#endif

// Whether the host has [vaddr, vaddr + size) committed and readable.
static bool HostReadable(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	struct Timed {
		uint64_t start = Hybrid::FaultStageClockNs();
		~Timed() { Hybrid::NoteHostQuery(Hybrid::FaultStageClockNs() - start); }
	} timed;
	for (uint64_t cursor = vaddr; cursor < vaddr + size;) {
		MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION info {};
		if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(cursor), &info, sizeof(info)) == 0 ||
		    info.State != MEM_COMMIT || (info.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)) != 0) {
			return false;
		}
		cursor = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(info.BaseAddress) + info.RegionSize;
	}
#endif
	return true;
}

template <typename Regions, typename Region, typename Gap>
static void ForEachSparseRange(const Regions& regions, uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size,
                               Region&& region, Gap&& gap) {
	const auto end     = vaddr + size;
	auto       mapping = regions.lower_bound(vaddr);
	if (mapping != regions.begin()) {
		auto previous = std::prev(mapping);
		if (previous->second.vaddr + previous->second.size > vaddr) {
			mapping = previous;
		}
	}

	auto cursor = vaddr;
	for (; mapping != regions.end() && mapping->second.vaddr < end; ++mapping) {
		const auto& entry = mapping->second;
		const auto  start = std::max(vaddr, entry.vaddr);
		const auto  bytes = std::min(end, entry.vaddr + entry.size) - start;
		if (cursor < start) {
			gap(cursor, start - cursor);
		}
		region(entry, start, bytes);
		cursor = start + bytes;
	}
	if (cursor < end) {
		gap(cursor, end - cursor);
	}
}

template <typename Regions, typename Source, typename Gap>
static void CopySparseRange(const Regions& regions, uint64_t vaddr, void* data, uint64_t size,
                            Source&& source, Gap&& gap) {
	auto* destination = static_cast<uint8_t*>(data);
	ForEachSparseRange(
	    regions, vaddr, size,
	    [&](const auto& entry, uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) {
		    std::memcpy(destination + (start - vaddr), source(entry, start), bytes);
	    },
	    [&](uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) { gap(start, destination + (start - vaddr), bytes); });
}

// Ranges whose guest mapping is briefly absent while the emulator replaces it: a guest mmap with
// MAP_FIXED over an existing mapping (unmapped, then mapped again), and, on Windows, the parts of a
// file view that stay mapped when part of it is unmapped (Windows splits a view only by unmapping
// all of it). On the console these replacements are atomic, so guest threads keep using the
// memory: the title's streamer decompresses into buffers whose 64 KiB pages are mapped again or
// neighbour an unmap. A fault inside such a range waits until the mapping is back and is retried
// instead of being reported as an access violation.
struct TransientUnmapWindow {
	std::atomic<uint64_t> id {0};
	std::atomic<uint64_t> start {0};
	std::atomic<uint64_t> end {0};
	std::atomic<int64_t>  closed_ns {0}; // 0 while the range is being remapped
};

class TransientUnmapWindows {
public:
	using Window = TransientUnmapWindow;

	class Scope {
	public:
		Scope(uint64_t start, uint64_t end) noexcept: m_window(Open(start, end)) {}
		~Scope() { m_window->closed_ns.store(Now(), std::memory_order_release); }
		KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(Scope);

	private:
		Window* m_window;
	};

	// The newest range being remapped recently that holds vaddr (0: none). Waits while it still
	// is being remapped.
	static uint64_t Wait(uint64_t vaddr) noexcept {
		constexpr int64_t Second  = 1000000000;
		uint64_t          matched = 0;
		for (auto& window: s_windows) {
			if (vaddr < window.start.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
			    vaddr >= window.end.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto begin = Now();
			for (uint32_t spins = 0; window.closed_ns.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0; spins++) {
				if (Now() - begin > Second * 10) {
					return 0; // never closed: report the fault
				}
				if (spins < 4096) {
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
					_mm_pause();
#endif
				} else {
					std::this_thread::yield();
				}
			}
			// The fault may be handled after the mapping is already back.
			if (Now() - window.closed_ns.load(std::memory_order_acquire) < Second) {
				matched = std::max(matched, window.id.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
			}
		}
		return matched;
	}

private:
	static Window* Open(uint64_t start, uint64_t end) noexcept {
		auto& window = s_windows[s_next.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) % s_windows.size()];
		window.closed_ns.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		window.id.store(s_opened.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1,
		                std::memory_order_relaxed);
		window.start.store(start, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		window.end.store(end, std::memory_order_seq_cst);
		return &window;
	}

	static int64_t Now() noexcept {
		return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(
		           std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
		    .count();
	}

	inline static std::array<Window, 16> s_windows {};
	inline static std::atomic<uint32_t>  s_next {0};
	inline static std::atomic<uint64_t>  s_opened {0};
};

class GuestBackingStore {
public:
	enum class FailureReason {
		None,
		FixedMapViewFailed,
		PlaceholderMapFailed,
		ProtectFailed,
		AddressRangeUnavailable,
	};

	// borrowed: the hybrid, where the AnyPS5 executable owns the sections and each mapping's
	// backing_offset holds the absolute address of Kyty's own view of the executable's memory.
	GuestBackingStore(uint64_t size, bool borrowed): m_size(size), m_borrowed(borrowed) {
		if (m_borrowed) {
			return;
		}
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		m_handle = CreateFileMappingA(
		    INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, nullptr, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | SEC_COMMIT,
		    static_cast<DWORD>(m_size >> 32u), static_cast<DWORD>(m_size & 0xffffffffu), nullptr);
		if (m_handle == nullptr) {
			EXIT("could not reserve %" PRIu64 " MB for guest direct memory: 0x%08" PRIx32
			     ". Windows commits\n"
			     "this up front, so the paging file is usually what needs to be larger.\n",
			     m_size / (1024U * 1024U), static_cast<uint32_t>(GetLastError()));
		}
		m_backing_base = static_cast<uint8_t*>(
		    MapViewOfFile(m_handle, FILE_MAP_READ | FILE_MAP_WRITE, 0, 0, m_size));
		if (m_backing_base == nullptr) {
			EXIT("direct-memory backing: writable alias failed: 0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
			     static_cast<uint32_t>(GetLastError()));
		}
#elif KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_LINUX
#if defined(__APPLE__)
		{
			char shm_name[64];
			snprintf(shm_name, sizeof(shm_name), "/kyty-dm-%d-%llx", static_cast<int>(getpid()),
			         static_cast<unsigned long long>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(this)));
			m_fd = shm_open(shm_name, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_EXCL, 0600);
			if (m_fd >= 0) {
				shm_unlink(shm_name);
			}
		}
#else
		m_fd = static_cast<int>(syscall(SYS_memfd_create, "KytyDirectMemory", 0));
#endif
		if (m_fd < 0) {
			EXIT("direct-memory backing: shared fd creation failed: %d\n", errno);
		}
		if (ftruncate(m_fd, static_cast<off_t>(m_size)) != 0) {
			EXIT("direct-memory backing: ftruncate to %" PRIu64 " MB failed: %d\n",
			     m_size / (1024U * 1024U), errno);
		}
		auto* backing = mmap(nullptr, m_size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, m_fd, 0);
		if (backing == MAP_FAILED) {
			EXIT("direct-memory backing: writable alias failed: %d\n", errno);
		}
		m_backing_base = static_cast<uint8_t*>(backing);
#endif
	}

	~GuestBackingStore() {
		if (m_borrowed) {
			return;
		}
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		for (const auto& [_, entry]: m_maps) {
			UnmapViewPreservePlaceholder(reinterpret_cast<void*>(entry.vaddr), entry.size);
		}
		MapsChangedUnlocked();
		UnmapViewOfFile(m_backing_base);
		CloseHandle(m_handle);
#elif KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_LINUX
		for (const auto& [_, entry]: m_maps) {
			EXIT_IF(
			    !UnmapViewPreservePlaceholder(reinterpret_cast<void*>(entry.vaddr), entry.size));
		}
		MapsChangedUnlocked();
		munmap(m_backing_base, m_size);
		close(m_fd);
#endif
	}

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(GuestBackingStore);

	static const char* GetFailureReasonName(FailureReason reason) {
		switch (reason) {
			case FailureReason::None: return "n/a";
			case FailureReason::FixedMapViewFailed: return "fixed-map-view-failed";
			case FailureReason::PlaceholderMapFailed: return "placeholder-map-failed";
			case FailureReason::ProtectFailed: return "protect-failed";
			case FailureReason::AddressRangeUnavailable: return "address-range-unavailable";
			default: return "unknown";
		}
	}

	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t GetBackingBase() const {
		return reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(m_backing_base);
	}

	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t GetBackingSize() const { return m_size; }

	[[nodiscard]] bool Borrowed() const { return m_borrowed; }

	// The hybrid: writes the executable's mappings through Kyty's views (no fault on pages Kyty protects)
	// and the rest in place; false, writing nothing, when part of the range is not readable by the host.
	bool WriteBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, const void* data, uint64_t size) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		bool       ok     = true;
		const auto source = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
		ForEachSparseRange(m_maps, vaddr, size, [](const auto&, uint64_t, uint64_t) {},
		                   [&](uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) { ok = ok && HostReadable(start, bytes); });
		if (!ok) {
			return false;
		}
		ForEachSparseRange(
		    m_maps, vaddr, size,
		    [&](const auto& entry, uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) {
			    std::memcpy(At(entry.backing_offset + start - entry.vaddr), source + (start - vaddr), bytes);
		    },
		    [&](uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) {
			    std::memcpy(reinterpret_cast<void*>(start), source + (start - vaddr), bytes);
		    });
		return true;
	}

	void ZeroRange(uint64_t backing_offset, uint64_t size) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		std::memset(m_backing_base + backing_offset, 0, size);
#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
		g_test_backing_bytes_zeroed += size;
#endif
	}

	void WriteBacking(uint64_t vaddr, const void* data, uint64_t size) {
		const auto* source = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
		if (TryCachedTransfer(vaddr, size, [source](uint8_t* backing, size_t bytes) {
			    std::memcpy(backing, source, bytes);
		    })) {
			return;
		}

		// Skip unbacked gaps, mirroring sparse reads that zero-fill them.
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		const auto      end = vaddr + size;
		ForEachSparseRange(
		    m_maps, vaddr, size,
		    [&](const auto& entry, uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) {
			    if (start == vaddr && start + bytes == end) {
				    RememberMapping(entry, vaddr, end);
			    }
			    std::memcpy(At(entry.backing_offset + start - entry.vaddr), source + (start - vaddr),
			                bytes);
		    },
		    [](uint64_t, uint64_t) {});
	}

	bool TryReadBacking(uint64_t vaddr, void* data, uint64_t size) {
		if (data == nullptr || size == 0 || UINT64_MAX - vaddr < size) {
			return false;
		}

		auto* destination = static_cast<uint8_t*>(data);
		if (TryCachedTransfer(vaddr, size, [destination](uint8_t* backing, size_t bytes) {
			    std::memcpy(destination, backing, bytes);
		    })) {
			return true;
		}

		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
		if (g_test_backing_read != nullptr) {
			g_test_backing_read(vaddr, size);
		}
#endif
		const auto end   = vaddr + size;
		auto       first = m_maps.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (m_borrowed && !CoveredUnlocked(vaddr, size)) {
			if (!HostReadable(vaddr, size)) {
				return false;
			}
			std::memcpy(destination, reinterpret_cast<const void*>(vaddr), size);
			return true;
		}
		if (first == m_maps.begin()) {
			return false;
		}
		--first;
		auto current = vaddr;
		for (auto mapping = first; current < end; ++mapping) {
			if (mapping == m_maps.end() || current < mapping->second.vaddr ||
			    current >= mapping->second.vaddr + mapping->second.size) {
				return false;
			}
			current = std::min(end, mapping->second.vaddr + mapping->second.size);
		}

		RememberMapping(first->second, vaddr, end);
		current = vaddr;
		for (auto mapping = first; current < end; ++mapping) {
			const auto& entry  = mapping->second;
			const auto  bytes  = std::min(end, entry.vaddr + entry.size) - current;
			const auto  offset = entry.backing_offset + current - entry.vaddr;
			std::memcpy(destination + (current - vaddr), At(offset), bytes);
			current += bytes;
		}
		return true;
	}

	// The backing alias of a range that one mapping holds, or null. The alias stays mapped for
	// the store's lifetime, so the pointer can be read later, even after the guest range changed.
	const uint8_t* FindBackingPointer(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		if (size == 0 || UINT64_MAX - vaddr < size) {
			return nullptr;
		}
		const uint8_t* result = nullptr;
		if (TryCachedTransfer(vaddr, size, [&](uint8_t* backing, size_t) { result = backing; })) {
			return result;
		}

		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		const auto       end     = vaddr + size;
		auto             mapping = m_maps.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (mapping == m_maps.begin()) {
			return nullptr;
		}
		const auto& entry = std::prev(mapping)->second;
		if (vaddr < entry.vaddr || end > entry.vaddr + entry.size) {
			return m_borrowed && !CoveredUnlocked(vaddr, size) && HostReadable(vaddr, size)
			           ? reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(vaddr)
			           : nullptr;
		}
		RememberMapping(entry, vaddr, end);
		return At(entry.backing_offset + (vaddr - entry.vaddr));
	}

	template <typename Gap>
	void ReadSparseBacking(uint64_t vaddr, void* data, uint64_t size, Gap&& gap) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
		if (g_test_backing_read != nullptr) {
			g_test_backing_read(vaddr, size);
		}
#endif
		CopySparseRange(m_maps, vaddr, data, size,
		                [this](const auto& entry, uint64_t start) {
			                return At(entry.backing_offset + start - entry.vaddr);
		                },
		                gap);
	}

	bool ProtectViews(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		bool             ok = true;
		ForEachSparseRange(
		    m_maps, vaddr, size,
		    [&](const auto&, uint64_t start, uint64_t bytes) {
			    ok = ok && VirtualMemory::Protect(start, bytes, mode);
		    },
		    [&](uint64_t, uint64_t) { ok = false; });
		return ok;
	}

	bool MapFixed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, uint64_t backing_offset,
	              VirtualMemory::Mode mode, FailureReason* failure_reason = nullptr) {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		if (!ReplacePlaceholderView(vaddr, size, backing_offset, mode, failure_reason)) {
			return false;
		}
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
#else
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		if (!MapView(vaddr, size, backing_offset, mode, failure_reason)) {
			return false;
		}
		RemoveMappingsUnlocked(vaddr, size);
#endif
		m_maps.emplace(vaddr, MapEntry {vaddr, size, backing_offset, mode});
		MapsChangedUnlocked();
		BumpBackingEpoch(vaddr, size);
		return true;
	}

	// The hybrid: the executable mapped [vaddr, vaddr + size) and `host` is Kyty's view of the same bytes.
	void MapBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, const uint8_t* host, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		RemoveMappingsUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		m_maps.emplace(vaddr, MapEntry {vaddr, size, reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(host), mode});
		MapsChangedUnlocked();
		BumpBackingEpoch(vaddr, size);
	}

	void UnmapBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		BumpBackingEpoch(vaddr, size);
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		RemoveMappingsUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		MapsChangedUnlocked();
	}

	void ProtectBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		ForEachSparseRange(
		    m_maps, vaddr, size, [&](const auto& entry, uint64_t, uint64_t) { const_cast<MapEntry&>(entry).mode = mode; },
		    [](uint64_t, uint64_t) {});
		MapsChangedUnlocked();
	}

	bool Unmap(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		BumpBackingEpoch(vaddr, size);
		const auto            end = vaddr + size;
		std::vector<MapEntry> targets;
		{
			std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
			auto            current = vaddr;
			while (current < end) {
				const auto* entry = FindContainingUnlocked(current);
				if (entry == nullptr) {
					return false;
				}
				const auto part_size = std::min(end, entry->vaddr + entry->size) - current;
				targets.push_back({current, part_size,
				                   entry->backing_offset + current - entry->vaddr, entry->mode});
				current += part_size;
			}
		}

		size_t removed  = 0;
		auto   rollback = [&] {
			while (removed != 0) {
				const auto& previous = targets[--removed];
				EXIT_IF(!MapFixed(previous.vaddr, previous.size, previous.backing_offset,
				                  previous.mode));
			}
		};
		for (const auto& entry: targets) {
			if (!UnmapOne(entry.vaddr, entry.size)) {
				rollback();
				return false;
			}
			++removed;
		}

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		// Each unmapped file view becomes a separate Windows placeholder. The address-space owner
		// records this contiguous guest span as one free range, so normalize fragmented backing
		// views into one placeholder before publishing it there.
		if (removed > 1 && !CoalescePlaceholders(vaddr, size)) {
			rollback();
			return false;
		}
#endif

		return true;
	}

	bool UnmapOne(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
		if (g_test_backing_store_unmaps_before_failure == 0) {
			g_test_backing_store_unmaps_before_failure = UINT32_MAX;
			return false;
		}
		if (g_test_backing_store_unmaps_before_failure != UINT32_MAX) {
			g_test_backing_store_unmaps_before_failure--;
		}
#endif

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		MapEntry old {};
		{
			std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
			old = m_maps.extract(std::prev(m_maps.upper_bound(vaddr))).mapped();
			MapsChangedUnlocked();
		}
		// The parts that stay mapped vanish until they are mapped again (see
		// TransientUnmapWindows), and come back with the view's protection: give them back their
		// own (guest mprotect, GPU write and read tracking) before faults there are retried.
		std::vector<KeptProtection>                 kept_protections;
		std::optional<TransientUnmapWindows::Scope> transient;
		if (vaddr != old.vaddr || size != old.size) {
			kept_protections = SnapshotProtections(old, vaddr, size);
			transient.emplace(old.vaddr, old.vaddr + old.size);
		}
		if (!UnmapViewPreservePlaceholder(reinterpret_cast<void*>(old.vaddr), old.size)) {
			std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
			m_maps.emplace(old.vaddr, old);
			MapsChangedUnlocked();
			return false;
		}

		const uint64_t left_size  = vaddr - old.vaddr;
		const uint64_t right_addr = vaddr + size;
		const uint64_t right_size = old.vaddr + old.size - right_addr;
		bool           ok         = true;
		if (left_size != 0) {
			ok = SplitPlaceholder(old.vaddr, left_size) && ok;
		}
		if (right_size != 0) {
			ok = SplitPlaceholder(vaddr, size) && ok;
		}
		if (left_size != 0) {
			ok = MapFixed(old.vaddr, left_size, old.backing_offset, old.mode) && ok;
		}
		if (right_size != 0) {
			ok = MapFixed(right_addr, right_size, old.backing_offset + (right_addr - old.vaddr),
			              old.mode) &&
			     ok;
		}
		if (ok) {
			RestoreProtections(kept_protections);
			return true;
		}

		if (left_size != 0 && Contains(old.vaddr, left_size)) {
			EXIT_IF(!UnmapOne(old.vaddr, left_size));
		}
		if (right_size != 0 && Contains(right_addr, right_size)) {
			EXIT_IF(!UnmapOne(right_addr, right_size));
		}
		EXIT_IF(!CoalescePlaceholders(old.vaddr, old.size));
		EXIT_IF(!MapFixed(old.vaddr, old.size, old.backing_offset, old.mode));
		RestoreProtections(kept_protections);
		return false;
#else
		// Replace only the requested range so concurrent accesses and GPU watch
		// protections on the surviving mappings remain intact.
		if (!UnmapViewPreservePlaceholder(reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr), size)) {
			return false;
		}

		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		RemoveMappingsUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		MapsChangedUnlocked();

		return true;
#endif
	}

	bool Contains(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		const auto      end     = vaddr + size;
		auto            current = vaddr;

		while (current < end) {
			const auto* entry = FindContainingUnlocked(current);
			if (entry == nullptr) {
				return false;
			}
			current = std::min(end, entry->vaddr + entry->size);
		}

		return true;
	}

	// The whole range lies inside one mapping (the hybrid's ClampRangeSize shortcut).
	bool ContainedInOne(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		const auto* entry = FindContainingUnlocked(vaddr);
		return entry != nullptr && size <= entry->vaddr + entry->size - vaddr;
	}

private:
	struct MapEntry {
		uint64_t            vaddr          = 0;
		uint64_t            size           = 0;
		uint64_t            backing_offset = 0;
		VirtualMemory::Mode mode           = VirtualMemory::Mode::NoAccess;
	};

	// Under m_mutex: whether any mapping overlaps the range.
	[[nodiscard]] bool CoveredUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) const {
		bool covered = false;
		ForEachSparseRange(
		    m_maps, vaddr, size, [&](const auto&, uint64_t, uint64_t) { covered = true; },
		    [](uint64_t, uint64_t) {});
		return covered;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] uint8_t* At(uint64_t backing_offset) const {
		return m_borrowed ? reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(backing_offset) : m_backing_base + backing_offset;
	}

	void RemoveMappingsUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		const auto end = vaddr + size;
		auto       it = m_maps.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (it != m_maps.begin()) {
			--it;
		}
		while (it != m_maps.end() && it->first < end) {
			const auto old     = it->second;
			const auto old_end = old.vaddr + old.size;
			if (old_end <= vaddr) {
				++it;
				continue;
			}
			it = m_maps.erase(it);
			if (old.vaddr < vaddr) {
				m_maps.emplace(old.vaddr,
				               MapEntry {old.vaddr, vaddr - old.vaddr, old.backing_offset, old.mode});
			}
			if (end < old_end) {
				m_maps.emplace(end, MapEntry {end, old_end - end,
				                             old.backing_offset + end - old.vaddr, old.mode});
			}
		}
	}

	// The mapping of each 64 KB of guest addresses that a transfer started in, direct mapped:
	// GPU threads stream thousands of small buffers per frame from rings spread over more
	// mappings than the round-robin entries hold.
	static constexpr uint32_t SlotBits  = 16;
	static constexpr size_t   SlotCount = 1024;
	struct LookupCache {
		const GuestBackingStore*         owner      = nullptr;
		uint64_t                         generation = 0;
		uint32_t                         next       = 0;
		std::array<MapEntry, 4>          entries {};
		std::array<MapEntry, SlotCount>  slots {};
	};

	[[nodiscard]] static size_t SlotOf(uint64_t vaddr) noexcept {
		return static_cast<size_t>(vaddr >> SlotBits) % SlotCount;
	}

	static LookupCache& ThreadLookupCache() noexcept {
		thread_local LookupCache cache;
		return cache;
	}

	// Called after every change of m_maps, under m_mutex. The generation is shared by all stores,
	// so a store recreated at the address of a destroyed one never matches a stale lookup.
	static void MapsChangedUnlocked() noexcept {
		s_maps_generation.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
	}

	inline static std::atomic<uint64_t> s_maps_generation {0};

	// The GPU thread streams thousands of small buffers per frame from a few mappings: reuse the
	// lookups it made last, without the lock, while no mapping changed. The entries and the
	// generation were read together under m_mutex, and every change of m_maps advances the
	// generation under m_mutex, so observing it unchanged (acquire) means no change completed
	// since. A change racing with this transfer orders as if it followed it: the backing alias
	// stays mapped for the store's lifetime, and host views are never unmapped under m_mutex
	// either.
	template <typename Transfer>
	bool TryCachedTransfer(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, Transfer transfer) {
		const auto& cached = ThreadLookupCache();
		if (cached.owner != this ||
		    cached.generation != s_maps_generation.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
			return false;
		}
		const auto end  = vaddr + size;
		const auto& slot = cached.slots[SlotOf(vaddr)];
		if (vaddr >= slot.vaddr && end <= slot.vaddr + slot.size && slot.size != 0) {
			transfer(At(slot.backing_offset + (vaddr - slot.vaddr)),
			         static_cast<size_t>(size));
			return true;
		}
		for (const auto& entry: cached.entries) {
			if (vaddr >= entry.vaddr && end <= entry.vaddr + entry.size) {
				transfer(At(entry.backing_offset + (vaddr - entry.vaddr)),
				         static_cast<size_t>(size));
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	// Called under m_mutex (shared or exclusive) after a lookup: remembers a mapping that holds
	// the whole transfer [entry.vaddr <= vaddr, end].
	void RememberMapping(const MapEntry& entry, uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t end) {
		if (end > entry.vaddr + entry.size) {
			return;
		}
		auto&      cached     = ThreadLookupCache();
		const auto generation = s_maps_generation.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
		if (cached.owner != this || cached.generation != generation) {
			cached.owner      = this;
			cached.generation = generation;
			cached.next       = 0;
			cached.entries.fill({});
			cached.slots.fill({});
		}
		cached.entries[cached.next++ % cached.entries.size()] = entry;
		cached.slots[SlotOf(vaddr)]                           = entry;
	}

	const MapEntry* FindContainingUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr) const {
		auto next = m_maps.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (next == m_maps.begin()) {
			return nullptr;
		}
		const auto& entry = std::prev(next)->second;
		return vaddr < entry.vaddr + entry.size ? &entry : nullptr;
	}

	static void SetFailure(FailureReason* out, FailureReason reason) {
		if (out != nullptr) {
			*out = reason;
		}
	}

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	static DWORD GetProtect(VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		switch (mode) {
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Read: return PAGE_READONLY;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Write:
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ReadWrite: return PAGE_READWRITE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Execute: return PAGE_EXECUTE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteRead: return PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteWrite:
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteReadWrite: return PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::NoAccess:
			default: return PAGE_NOACCESS;
		}
	}

	static bool ApplyProtection(void* ptr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		DWORD old_protect = 0;
		return VirtualProtect(ptr, size, GetProtect(mode), &old_protect) != 0;
	}

	struct KeptProtection {
		uint64_t vaddr   = 0;
		uint64_t size    = 0;
		DWORD    protect = 0;
	};

	// The protections, other than the view's own, of the parts of a view that stay mapped when
	// [vaddr, vaddr + size) is unmapped from it.
	static std::vector<KeptProtection> SnapshotProtections(const MapEntry& view, uint64_t vaddr,
	                                                       uint64_t size) {
		std::vector<KeptProtection> kept;
		const auto                  view_protect = GetProtect(view.mode);
		for (const auto& [start, end]:
		     {std::pair {view.vaddr, vaddr}, std::pair {vaddr + size, view.vaddr + view.size}}) {
			for (auto current = start; current < end;) {
				MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION info {};
				if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(current), &info, sizeof(info)) == 0) {
					break;
				}
				const auto region_end =
				    std::min(end, reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(info.BaseAddress) + info.RegionSize);
				if (region_end <= current) {
					break;
				}
				if (info.State == MEM_COMMIT && info.Protect != view_protect) {
					kept.push_back({current, region_end - current, info.Protect});
				}
				current = region_end;
			}
		}
		return kept;
	}

	static void RestoreProtections(const std::vector<KeptProtection>& kept) {
		for (const auto& part: kept) {
			DWORD old_protect = 0;
			if (VirtualProtect(reinterpret_cast<void*>(part.vaddr), part.size, part.protect,
			                   &old_protect) == 0) {
				LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Red,
				           "\t view split: protection 0x%lx of [0x%016" PRIx64 ", 0x%016" PRIx64
				           ") not restored, error=0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
				           static_cast<unsigned long>(part.protect), part.vaddr,
				           part.vaddr + part.size, static_cast<uint32_t>(GetLastError()));
			}
		}
	}

	static bool SplitPlaceholder(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		return VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr), size,
		                   MEM_RELEASE | MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER) != 0;
	}

	bool ReplacePlaceholderView(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, uint64_t backing_offset,
	                            VirtualMemory::Mode mode, FailureReason* failure_reason) {
		const DWORD map_protect =
		    mode == VirtualMemory::Mode::NoAccess ? PAGE_READWRITE : GetProtect(mode);
		void* ptr =
		    MapViewOfFile3(m_handle, GetCurrentProcess(), reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr),
		                   backing_offset, size, MEM_REPLACE_PLACEHOLDER, map_protect, nullptr, 0);
		if (ptr == nullptr || reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ptr) != vaddr) {
			if (ptr != nullptr) {
				UnmapViewOfFile2(GetCurrentProcess(), ptr, MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER);
			}
			SetFailure(failure_reason, FailureReason::PlaceholderMapFailed);
			return false;
		}

		if (mode == VirtualMemory::Mode::NoAccess && !ApplyProtection(ptr, size, mode)) {
			UnmapViewOfFile2(GetCurrentProcess(), ptr, MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER);
			SetFailure(failure_reason, FailureReason::ProtectFailed);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	static bool UnmapViewPreservePlaceholder(void* vaddr, uint64_t /*size*/) {
		return UnmapViewOfFile2(GetCurrentProcess(), vaddr, MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER) != 0;
	}

	HANDLE m_handle = nullptr;
#elif KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_LINUX
	static int GetProtect(VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		switch (mode) {
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Read: return PROT_READ;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Write:
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ReadWrite: return PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Execute: return PROT_EXEC;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteRead: return PROT_EXEC | PROT_READ;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteWrite:
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteReadWrite: return PROT_EXEC | PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::NoAccess:
			default: return PROT_NONE;
		}
	}

	bool MapView(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, uint64_t backing_offset, VirtualMemory::Mode mode,
	             FailureReason* failure_reason) {
#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
		if (const auto callback = g_test_before_backing_map) {
			g_test_before_backing_map = nullptr;
			callback(vaddr, size);
		}
#endif
		if (mmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr), size, GetProtect(mode), MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED,
		         m_fd, static_cast<off_t>(backing_offset)) == MAP_FAILED) {
			SetFailure(failure_reason, FailureReason::FixedMapViewFailed);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	// Replace the file view atomically instead of exposing an unmapped hole in the
	// process-lifetime guest reservation.
	static bool UnmapViewPreservePlaceholder(void* vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		return mmap(vaddr, size, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0) !=
		       MAP_FAILED;
	}

	int m_fd = -1;
#endif

	uint8_t*                     m_backing_base = nullptr;
	uint64_t                     m_size         = 0;
	bool                         m_borrowed     = false;
	std::shared_mutex            m_mutex;
	std::map<uint64_t, MapEntry> m_maps;
};

class GuestAddressSpace {
public:
	GuestAddressSpace(uint64_t backing_size, bool borrowed) {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		SYSTEM_INFO info {};
		GetSystemInfo(&info);
		m_granularity = info.dwAllocationGranularity;
#endif
		if (!borrowed) {
			ReserveGuestRegions();
		}
		m_backing = new GuestBackingStore(backing_size, borrowed);
	}

	void MapBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, const uint8_t* host, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		m_backing->MapBorrowed(vaddr, size, host, mode);
	}

	void UnmapBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) { m_backing->UnmapBorrowed(vaddr, size); }

	void ProtectBorrowed(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		m_backing->ProtectBorrowed(vaddr, size, mode);
	}

	~GuestAddressSpace() {
		delete m_backing;
		m_backing = nullptr;
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		for (const auto& [start, size]: m_owned) {
			const auto end     = start + size;
			auto       current = start;
			while (current < end) {
				MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION info {};
				EXIT_IF(VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(current), &info, sizeof(info)) ==
				        0);
				const auto region_start = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(info.BaseAddress);
				const auto region_end   = region_start + static_cast<uint64_t>(info.RegionSize);
				if (info.State == MEM_COMMIT) {
					EXIT_IF(VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(region_start), info.RegionSize,
					                    MEM_RELEASE | MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER) == 0);
					continue;
				}
				if (info.State == MEM_RESERVE) {
					EXIT_IF(VirtualFree(info.AllocationBase, 0, MEM_RELEASE) == 0);
				}
				current = region_end;
			}
		}
#else
		for (const auto& [start, size]: m_owned) {
			munmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(start), size);
		}
#endif
	}

	KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(GuestAddressSpace);

	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t GetGranularity() const { return m_granularity; }
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t GetBackingBase() const { return m_backing->GetBackingBase(); }
	[[nodiscard]] uint64_t GetBackingSize() const { return m_backing->GetBackingSize(); }

	void ZeroBacking(uint64_t backing_offset, uint64_t size) {
		m_backing->ZeroRange(backing_offset, size);
	}

	[[nodiscard]] bool Owns(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		if (size == 0 || UINT64_MAX - vaddr < size) {
			return false;
		}
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		return std::any_of(m_owned.begin(), m_owned.end(), [vaddr, size](const auto& range) {
			return vaddr >= range.first && vaddr + size <= range.first + range.second;
		});
	}

#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
	[[nodiscard]] bool OverlapsOwned(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		return std::any_of(m_owned.begin(), m_owned.end(), [vaddr, size](const auto& range) {
			return VirtualRangesOverlap(vaddr, size, range.first, range.second);
		});
	}
#endif

	// Writes the backed bytes of a range that holds no private mappings.
	bool TryWriteBacking(uint64_t vaddr, const void* data, uint64_t size) {
		if (m_backing->Borrowed()) {
			return m_backing->WriteBorrowed(vaddr, data, size);
		}
		if (!Owns(vaddr, size)) {
			return false;
		}
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		if (OverlapsPrivateUnlocked(vaddr, size)) {
			return false;
		}
		m_backing->WriteBacking(vaddr, data, size);
		return true;
	}

	bool TryReadBacking(uint64_t vaddr, void* data, uint64_t size) {
		return m_backing->TryReadBacking(vaddr, data, size);
	}

	const uint8_t* FindBackingPointer(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		return m_backing->FindBackingPointer(vaddr, size);
	}

	template <bool copy_private>
	bool CopySparseMemory(uint64_t vaddr, void* data, uint64_t size) {
		if (data != nullptr && m_backing->Borrowed()) {
			// The hybrid: the executable's mappings are read through their views, the rest in place where the
			// host has it readable, zero elsewhere.
			m_backing->ReadSparseBacking(vaddr, data, size, [](uint64_t start, uint8_t* destination, uint64_t bytes) {
				if (!HostReadable(start, bytes)) {
					std::memset(destination, 0, bytes);
					return;
				}
				std::memcpy(destination, reinterpret_cast<const void*>(start), bytes);
			});
			return true;
		}
		if (data == nullptr || !Owns(vaddr, size)) {
			return false;
		}
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		if constexpr (!copy_private) {
			if (OverlapsPrivateUnlocked(vaddr, size)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		m_backing->ReadSparseBacking(
		    vaddr, data, size, [&](uint64_t start, uint8_t* destination, uint64_t bytes) {
			    const auto zero = [](uint64_t, uint8_t* output, uint64_t length) {
				    std::memset(output, 0, length);
			    };
			    if constexpr (copy_private) {
				    // Backing gaps can contain private mappings or reservations only.
				    CopySparseRange(
				        m_mapped, start, destination, bytes,
				        [](const auto&, uint64_t address) {
					        return reinterpret_cast<const void*>(address);
				        },
				        zero);
			    } else {
				    zero(start, destination, bytes);
			    }
		    });
		return true;
	}

	bool BackingContains(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) { return m_backing->Contains(vaddr, size); }
	bool BackingContainedInOne(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) { return m_backing->ContainedInOne(vaddr, size); }

	bool Protect(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		return ProtectMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, mode);
	}

	// Tracker protections only read m_mapped; the page tracker orders them per page.
	bool ProtectTransient(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		return ProtectMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, mode);
	}

	bool MapBacking(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, uint64_t backing_offset,
	                VirtualMemory::Mode               mode,
	                GuestBackingStore::FailureReason* failure_reason = nullptr) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_LINUX
		const bool replacing = ContainsMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, MappingType::Backing);
#else
		constexpr bool replacing = false;
#endif
		if (!replacing && !ConsumeUnlocked(vaddr, size)) {
			if (failure_reason != nullptr) {
				*failure_reason = GuestBackingStore::FailureReason::AddressRangeUnavailable;
			}
			return false;
		}
		const auto host_mode = VirtualMemory::IsExecute(mode)
		                           ? VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteReadWrite
		                           : VirtualMemory::Mode::ReadWrite;
		if (m_backing->MapFixed(vaddr, size, backing_offset, host_mode, failure_reason)) {
			if (!replacing) {
				AddMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, MappingType::Backing);
			}
			return true;
		}
		if (!replacing) {
			AddFreeUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		}
		return false;
	}

	bool UnmapBacking(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		if (!ContainsMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, MappingType::Backing)) {
			return false;
		}
		if (!m_backing->Unmap(vaddr, size)) {
			return false;
		}
		RemoveMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		AddFreeUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		return true;
	}

	uint64_t FindFreeAligned(uint64_t search_start, uint64_t search_end, uint64_t size,
	                         uint64_t alignment) {
		alignment = std::max<uint64_t>(alignment, PageSize());
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		return FindFreeAlignedUnlocked(search_start, search_end, size, alignment);
	}

	bool ContainsFree(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		std::shared_lock lock(m_mutex);
		return FindContaining(vaddr, size) != m_free.end();
	}

	bool Commit(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		if (!ConsumeUnlocked(vaddr, size)) {
			return false;
		}
		const auto host_mode = VirtualMemory::IsExecute(mode)
		                           ? VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteReadWrite
		                           : VirtualMemory::Mode::ReadWrite;

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		auto* ptr = VirtualAlloc2(GetCurrentProcess(), reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr), size,
		                          MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT | MEM_REPLACE_PLACEHOLDER,
		                          GetProtect(host_mode), nullptr, 0);
		if (ptr == nullptr || reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ptr) != vaddr) {
			if (ptr != nullptr) {
				VirtualFree(ptr, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
			}
			AddFreeUnlocked(vaddr, size);
			return false;
		}
		AddMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, MappingType::Private);
		return true;
#else
		if (VirtualMemory::Protect(vaddr, size, host_mode)) {
			AddMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, MappingType::Private);
			return true;
		}
		AddFreeUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		return false;
#endif
	}

	bool ReleaseCommitted(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		if (!IsPageAligned(vaddr) || !IsPageAligned(size)) {
			return false;
		}
		std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
		if (!ContainsMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size, MappingType::Private)) {
			return false;
		}
		const auto end     = vaddr + size;
		auto       current = vaddr;
		std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> regions;
		while (current < end) {
			const auto it       = FindMappedContainingUnlocked(current);
			const auto part_end = std::min(end, it->second.vaddr + it->second.size);
			regions.emplace_back(current, part_end - current);
			current = part_end;
		}
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		for (const auto& [region_vaddr, region_size]: regions) {
			EXIT_IF(VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(region_vaddr), region_size,
			                    MEM_RELEASE | MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER) == 0);
		}
		// ReleaseCommitted also publishes the aggregate span as one logical free range.
		EXIT_IF(regions.size() > 1 && !CoalescePlaceholders(vaddr, size));
#else
		for (const auto& [region_vaddr, region_size]: regions) {
			RestorePlaceholder(region_vaddr, region_size);
		}
#endif
		RemoveMappedUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		AddFreeUnlocked(vaddr, size);
		return true;
	}

	bool SelfTest() {
		auto addr = FindFreeAligned(HOST_SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN, HOST_SYSTEM_MANAGED_MAX + 1u,
		                            PageSize(), PageSize());
		if (addr == 0) {
			addr = FindFreeAligned(HOST_USER_MIN, HOST_USER_MAX + 1u, PageSize(), PageSize());
		}
		if (addr == 0) {
			LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Red,
			           "\t guest address-space self-test: 16 KiB range unavailable\n");
			return false;
		}
		if (!Commit(addr, PageSize(), VirtualMemory::Mode::ReadWrite)) {
			LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Red, "\t guest address-space self-test: commit failed\n");
			return false;
		}

		auto* ptr = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(addr);
		*ptr      = 0x4b59545950484f4cull; // "KYTYPHOL"

		if (!ReleaseCommitted(addr, PageSize())) {
			LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Red,
			           "\t guest address-space self-test: release-committed failed\n");
			return false;
		}

		LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Green, "\t guest address-space self-test: ok\n");
		return true;
	}

private:
	enum class MappingType { Backing, Private };

	struct MappedRegion {
		uint64_t    vaddr = 0;
		uint64_t    size  = 0;
		MappingType type  = MappingType::Private;
	};

	static constexpr uint64_t PageSize() { return 0x4000; }

	static uint64_t AlignUp(uint64_t value, uint64_t alignment) {
		const auto remainder = value % alignment;
		return remainder != 0 ? value + (alignment - remainder) : value;
	}

	static uint64_t AlignDown(uint64_t value, uint64_t alignment) {
		return value & ~(alignment - 1u);
	}

	[[nodiscard]] static bool IsPageAligned(uint64_t value) {
		return (value & (PageSize() - 1u)) == 0;
	}

	bool ProtectMappedUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		const auto end = vaddr + size;
		auto       it  = m_mapped.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (it != m_mapped.begin()) {
			--it;
		}
		for (; it != m_mapped.end() && it->second.vaddr < end; ++it) {
			const auto& region      = it->second;
			const auto  range_start = std::max(vaddr, region.vaddr);
			const auto  range_end   = std::min(end, region.vaddr + region.size);
			if (range_start >= range_end) {
				continue;
			}
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
			// Rollback can split a backing view without changing the owner interval.
			// Windows protection calls must stay within each actual view.
			if (region.type == MappingType::Backing) {
				if (!m_backing->ProtectViews(range_start, range_end - range_start, mode)) {
					return false;
				}
				continue;
			}
#endif
			if (!VirtualMemory::Protect(range_start, range_end - range_start, mode)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	bool ConsumeUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		const auto it = FindContaining(vaddr, size);
		if (it == m_free.end() || !SplitUnlocked(it, vaddr, size)) {
			return false;
		}
		m_free.erase(vaddr);
		return true;
	}

	std::map<uint64_t, MappedRegion>::iterator FindMappedContainingUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr) {
		auto next = m_mapped.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (next == m_mapped.begin()) {
			return m_mapped.end();
		}
		auto it = std::prev(next);
		return vaddr < it->second.vaddr + it->second.size ? it : m_mapped.end();
	}

	bool ContainsMappedUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, MappingType type) {
		const auto end     = vaddr + size;
		auto       current = vaddr;
		while (current < end) {
			const auto it = FindMappedContainingUnlocked(current);
			if (it == m_mapped.end() || it->second.type != type) {
				return false;
			}
			current = std::min(end, it->second.vaddr + it->second.size);
		}
		return true;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] bool OverlapsPrivateUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) const {
		// Backing-store writes and reads ask this for a few bytes at a time, mostly within the
		// mapping they asked for last (labels, query results, WRITE_DATA): remember, per thread,
		// the last shared mapping that held the whole range until the mappings change.
		struct LastShared {
			const void* space      = nullptr;
			uint64_t    generation = 0;
			uint64_t    begin      = 0;
			uint64_t    end        = 0;
		};
		thread_local LastShared last;
		const auto generation = m_mapped_generation.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
		if (last.space == this && last.generation == generation && vaddr >= last.begin &&
		    vaddr + size <= last.end) {
			return false;
		}
		auto mapping = m_mapped.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (mapping != m_mapped.begin()) {
			--mapping;
		}
		for (; mapping != m_mapped.end() && mapping->second.vaddr < vaddr + size; ++mapping) {
			const auto& region = mapping->second;
			if (region.vaddr + region.size <= vaddr) {
				continue;
			}
			if (region.type == MappingType::Private) {
				return true;
			}
			if (region.vaddr <= vaddr && vaddr + size <= region.vaddr + region.size) {
				last = {this, generation, region.vaddr, region.vaddr + region.size};
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	void AddMappedUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size, MappingType type) {
		m_mapped_generation.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
		m_mapped.emplace(vaddr, MappedRegion {vaddr, size, type});
	}

	void RemoveMappedUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		const auto end     = vaddr + size;
		auto       current = vaddr;
		while (current < end) {
			const auto it           = FindMappedContainingUnlocked(current);
			const auto original     = it->second;
			const auto original_end = original.vaddr + original.size;
			const auto part_end     = std::min(end, original_end);
			m_mapped.erase(it);
			m_mapped_generation.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
			if (original.vaddr < current) {
				AddMappedUnlocked(original.vaddr, current - original.vaddr, original.type);
			}
			if (part_end < original_end) {
				AddMappedUnlocked(part_end, original_end - part_end, original.type);
			}
			current = part_end;
		}
	}

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	static DWORD GetProtect(VirtualMemory::Mode mode) {
		switch (mode) {
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Read: return PAGE_READONLY;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Write:
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ReadWrite: return PAGE_READWRITE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::Execute: return PAGE_EXECUTE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteRead: return PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteWrite:
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::ExecuteReadWrite: return PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE;
			case VirtualMemory::Mode::NoAccess:
			default: return PAGE_NOACCESS;
		}
	}
#endif

	void ReserveGuestRegions() {
		const std::array<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>, 3> regions {{
		    {HOST_SYSTEM_MANAGED_MIN, HOST_SYSTEM_RESERVED_MAX + 1u},
		    {HOST_USER_MIN, HOST_USER_MAX + 1u},
		    {kExtendedMemoryBase, kExtendedMemoryBase + kExtendedMemorySize},
		}};

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		constexpr uint64_t MinimumRegionSize = 0x1000000;
		const auto         process           = GetCurrentProcess();
		for (const auto& [guest_start, guest_end]: regions) {
			auto next_addr = guest_start;
			while (next_addr < guest_end) {
				MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION info {};
				if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(next_addr), &info, sizeof(info)) == 0) {
					EXIT("failed to inspect guest address space at 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n", next_addr);
				}

				const auto region_base = reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(info.BaseAddress);
				const auto region_end = std::min<uint64_t>(
				    guest_end, region_base + static_cast<uint64_t>(info.RegionSize));
				const auto reserve_start =
				    AlignUp(std::max(region_base, guest_start), m_granularity);
				const auto reserve_end = AlignDown(region_end, m_granularity);

				if (info.State == MEM_FREE && reserve_end > reserve_start &&
				    reserve_end - reserve_start > MinimumRegionSize) {
					auto* ptr = VirtualAlloc2(
					    process, reinterpret_cast<void*>(reserve_start), reserve_end - reserve_start,
					    MEM_RESERVE | MEM_RESERVE_PLACEHOLDER, PAGE_NOACCESS, nullptr, 0);
					if (reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ptr) != reserve_start) {
						EXIT("failed to reserve guest address space at 0x%016" PRIx64
						     ", size 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
						     reserve_start, reserve_end - reserve_start);
					}
					AddFreeUnlocked(reserve_start, reserve_end - reserve_start);
					m_owned.emplace_back(reserve_start, reserve_end - reserve_start);
				}

				next_addr = region_end;
			}
		}
#else
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_LINUX && !defined(__APPLE__)
		std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> occupied;
		FILE*                                      maps = fopen("/proc/self/maps", "r");
		EXIT_IF(maps == nullptr);

		char line[512];
		while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), maps) != nullptr) {
			unsigned long long mapping_start = 0;
			unsigned long long mapping_end   = 0;
			if (sscanf(line, "%llx-%llx", &mapping_start, &mapping_end) == 2) {
				occupied.emplace_back(static_cast<uint64_t>(mapping_start),
				                      static_cast<uint64_t>(mapping_end));
			}
		}
		fclose(maps);

		auto reserve_range = [this](uint64_t start, uint64_t end) {
			start = AlignUp(start, PageSize());
			end   = AlignDown(end, PageSize());
			if (end <= start) {
				return;
			}

			const auto size = end - start;
			int        flags = MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_NORESERVE;
#if defined(KYTY_LINKED_GUEST_ADDRESS_SPACE)
			flags |= MAP_FIXED;
#elif defined(MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE)
			flags |= MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE;
#endif

			void* ptr = mmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(start), size, PROT_NONE, flags, -1, 0);
			if (ptr == MAP_FAILED || reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ptr) != start) {
				if (ptr != MAP_FAILED) {
					munmap(ptr, size);
				}
				return;
			}

			AddFreeUnlocked(start, size);
			m_owned.emplace_back(start, size);
		};

		for (const auto& [region_start, region_end]: regions) {
			auto current = region_start;

			for (const auto& [mapping_start, mapping_end]: occupied) {
				if (mapping_end <= current) {
					continue;
				}
				if (mapping_start >= region_end) {
					break;
				}

				if (mapping_start > current) {
					reserve_range(current, std::min(mapping_start, region_end));
				}

				current = std::max(current, mapping_end);
				if (current >= region_end) {
					break;
				}
			}

			if (current < region_end) {
				reserve_range(current, region_end);
			}
		}
#else
		for (const auto& [start, end]: regions) {
			int flags = MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_NORESERVE;
#if defined(KYTY_LINKED_GUEST_ADDRESS_SPACE)
			flags |= MAP_FIXED;
#elif defined(MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE)
			flags |= MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE;
#endif
			void* ptr = mmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(start), end - start, PROT_NONE, flags, -1, 0);
			if (ptr == MAP_FAILED || reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(ptr) != start) {
				if (ptr != MAP_FAILED) {
					munmap(ptr, end - start);
				}
				EXIT("failed to reserve guest address space at 0x%016" PRIx64
				     ", size 0x%016" PRIx64 "\n",
				     start, end - start);
			}
			AddFreeUnlocked(start, end - start);
			m_owned.emplace_back(start, end - start);
		}
#endif
#endif
	}

	uint64_t FindFreeAlignedUnlocked(uint64_t search_start, uint64_t search_end, uint64_t size,
	                                 uint64_t alignment) const {
		// Include the predecessor because search_start can lie inside a free range.
		auto it = m_free.upper_bound(search_start);
		if (it != m_free.begin()) {
			--it;
		}
		for (; it != m_free.end() && it->first < search_end; ++it) {
#if defined(KYTY_VIRTUAL_MEMORY_ALLOCATION_TESTS)
			g_test_free_range_visits.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
#endif
			const auto& [base, range_size] = *it;
			const auto candidate           = AlignUp(std::max(base, search_start), alignment);
			if (candidate < search_end && size <= search_end - candidate &&
			    GuestFreeRangeContains(base, range_size, candidate, size)) {
				return candidate;
			}
		}
		return 0;
	}

	std::map<uint64_t, uint64_t>::iterator FindContaining(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		auto next = m_free.upper_bound(vaddr);
		if (next == m_free.begin()) {
			return m_free.end();
		}
		auto it = std::prev(next);
		return GuestFreeRangeContains(it->first, it->second, vaddr, size) ? it : m_free.end();
	}

	bool SplitUnlocked(std::map<uint64_t, uint64_t>::iterator it, uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		const auto base = it->first;
		const auto end  = it->first + it->second;
		if (base != vaddr) {
			const auto left_size = vaddr - base;
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
			if (VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(base), left_size,
			                MEM_RELEASE | MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER) == 0) {
				LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Red,
				           "\t guest placeholder split failed: base=0x%016" PRIx64
				           " size=0x%016" PRIx64 " requested=0x%016" PRIx64
				           " request_size=0x%016" PRIx64 " error=0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
				           base, end - base, vaddr, size, static_cast<uint32_t>(GetLastError()));
				return false;
			}
#endif
			it->second = left_size;
			it         = m_free.emplace(vaddr, end - vaddr).first;
		}

		if (it->second != size) {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
			if (VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(it->first), size,
			                MEM_RELEASE | MEM_PRESERVE_PLACEHOLDER) == 0) {
				LOGF_COLOR(Log::Color::Red,
				           "\t guest placeholder split failed: base=0x%016" PRIx64
				           " size=0x%016" PRIx64 " requested=0x%016" PRIx64
				           " request_size=0x%016" PRIx64 " error=0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
				           it->first, it->second, vaddr, size,
				           static_cast<uint32_t>(GetLastError()));
				return false;
			}
#endif
			const auto right_start = it->first + size;
			const auto right_size  = it->second - size;
			it->second             = size;
			m_free.emplace(right_start, right_size);
		}

		return true;
	}

	void AddFreeUnlocked(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
		auto [it, inserted] = m_free.emplace(vaddr, size);
		if (!inserted) {
			it->second = size;
		}

		auto base = it->first;
		auto end  = it->first + it->second;

		auto first = it;
		while (first != m_free.begin()) {
			auto prev = std::prev(first);
			if (prev->first + prev->second != base) {
				break;
			}
			base  = prev->first;
			first = prev;
		}

		auto last = std::next(it);
		while (last != m_free.end() && end == last->first) {
			end  = last->first + last->second;
			last = std::next(last);
		}

		if (base != it->first || end != it->first + it->second) {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
			if (CoalescePlaceholders(base, end - base)) {
				m_free.erase(first, last);
				m_free.emplace(base, end - base);
			}
#else
			m_free.erase(first, last);
			m_free.emplace(base, end - base);
#endif
		}
	}

	void RestorePlaceholder(uint64_t vaddr, uint64_t size) {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM != KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
		// The address remains owned for the process lifetime; MAP_FIXED only replaces one of our
		// mappings and never acquires a new guest address.
		void* ptr = mmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(vaddr), size, PROT_NONE,
		                 MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
		EXIT_IF(ptr == MAP_FAILED);
#else
		(void)vaddr;
		(void)size;
#endif
	}

	std::shared_mutex                          m_mutex;
	std::map<uint64_t, uint64_t>               m_free;
	std::map<uint64_t, MappedRegion>            m_mapped;
	// Advances on every change of m_mapped (under the exclusive lock; read under either).
	std::atomic<uint64_t>                       m_mapped_generation {1};
	std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> m_owned;
	uint64_t                                   m_granularity = 0x10000;
	GuestBackingStore*                         m_backing     = nullptr;
};

#if KYTY_PLATFORM != KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS && (defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__))
#include <x86intrin.h>

#ifdef pthread_attr_getguardsize

#endif

namespace Libs {

namespace LibcInternalExt {
void RunThreadAtexitDestructors();
} // namespace LibcInternalExt

namespace LibKernel {

LIB_NAME("libkernel", "libkernel");

// macOS's <pthread.h>/<limits.h> define PTHREAD_STACK_MIN as a macro; the emulator
// wants its own guest-side value with the same name, so drop the host macro here.
#ifdef PTHREAD_STACK_MIN
#undef PTHREAD_STACK_MIN
#endif

constexpr int      KEYS_MAX                = 256;
constexpr int      DESTRUCTOR_ITERATIONS   = 4;
constexpr size_t   PTHREAD_STACK_DEFAULT   = 0x100000;
constexpr size_t   GUEST_PTHREAD_STACK_MIN = 0x4000;
constexpr size_t   PTHREAD_STACK_PAGE      = 0x4000;
constexpr size_t   PTHREAD_STACK_INITIAL   = 0x200000;
constexpr size_t   PTHREAD_STACK_EXTRA     = 0x100000;
constexpr uint64_t PTHREAD_STACK_TOP       = 0x7efff8000ull;
constexpr uint64_t PTHREAD_STACK_BOTTOM    = 0x0000040000ull;
constexpr uint32_t SIGNAL_APC_POLL_MICROS  = 10000;

static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME          = 0;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_VIRTUAL           = 1;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_PROF              = 2;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_MONOTONIC         = 4;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_UPTIME            = 5;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_UPTIME_PRECISE    = 7;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_UPTIME_FAST       = 8;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME_PRECISE  = 9;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME_FAST     = 10;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_MONOTONIC_PRECISE = 11;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_MONOTONIC_FAST    = 12;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_SECOND            = 13;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID = 14;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_PROCTIME          = 15;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_NETWORK       = 16;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_DEBUG_NETWORK = 17;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_AD_NETWORK    = 18;
static constexpr KernelClockid KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_RAW_NETWORK   = 19;

static constexpr int KERNEL_PTHREAD_MUTEX_ERRORCHECK = 1;
static constexpr int KERNEL_PTHREAD_MUTEX_RECURSIVE  = 2;
static constexpr int KERNEL_PTHREAD_MUTEX_NORMAL     = 3;
static constexpr int KERNEL_PTHREAD_MUTEX_ADAPTIVE   = 4;

#if KYTY_PLATFORM != KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
// OS-level thread id reported to the guest.
static uint64_t GetHostThreadId() {
#if defined(__APPLE__)
	uint64_t tid = 0;
	pthread_threadid_np(nullptr, &tid);
	return tid;
#else
	return static_cast<uint64_t>(::syscall(SYS_gettid));
#endif
}
#endif

static constexpr uint64_t NANOS_PER_SEC = 1000000000;

static uint64_t KernelHostTsc() {
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
	return __rdtsc();
#else
	return Common::SteadyNs();
#endif
}

static uint64_t KernelHostTscFrequency() {
	static const uint64_t frequency = [] {
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
		KernelHostTsc();
		std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
		KernelHostTsc();

		const auto host_start = Common::SteadyNs();
		const auto tsc_start  = KernelHostTsc();
		std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
		const auto host_end = Common::SteadyNs();
		const auto tsc_end  = KernelHostTsc();

		const auto freq = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<long double>(tsc_end - tsc_start) *
		                                        static_cast<long double>(NANOS_PER_SEC) /
		                                        static_cast<long double>(host_end - host_start));
		static constexpr uint64_t ROUND_TO = 100000;
		return (freq + ROUND_TO / 2) / ROUND_TO * ROUND_TO;
#else
		return NANOS_PER_SEC;
#endif
	}();

	return frequency;
}

// The console counter runs at 1.6 GHz and some games hardcode that rate instead of calling
// sceKernelGetTscFrequency(); --guest-tsc presents it on every host and the loader rewrites guest
// RDTSC/RDTSCP to the same product.
static constexpr uint64_t GUEST_TSC_FREQUENCY = 1600000000;

uint64_t KernelGuestTscMultiplier() {
	static const uint64_t multiplier =
	    ((GUEST_TSC_FREQUENCY << 32u) + KernelHostTscFrequency() / 2) / KernelHostTscFrequency();
	return multiplier;
}

static uint64_t KernelReadTscNative() {
	if (!Config::GuestTscEnabled()) {
		return KernelHostTsc();
	}
	return static_cast<uint64_t>(
	    (static_cast<unsigned __int128>(KernelHostTsc()) * KernelGuestTscMultiplier()) >> 32u);
}

static uint64_t KernelGetTscFrequencyNative() {
	return Config::GuestTscEnabled() ? GUEST_TSC_FREQUENCY : KernelHostTscFrequency();
}

static uint64_t KernelGetInitialTsc() {
	static const uint64_t initial_tsc = KernelReadTscNative();
	return initial_tsc;
}

static uint64_t KernelGetElapsedTsc() {
	const auto initial_tsc = KernelGetInitialTsc();
	const auto current_tsc = KernelReadTscNative();
	return current_tsc >= initial_tsc ? current_tsc - initial_tsc : 0;
}

static uint64_t KernelGetProcessTimeUsNative() {
	return static_cast<uint64_t>((static_cast<long double>(KernelGetElapsedTsc()) * 1000000.0L) /
	                             static_cast<long double>(KernelGetTscFrequencyNative()));
}

static void KernelUsToTimespec(uint64_t us, KernelTimespec* tp) {
	EXIT_IF(tp == nullptr);
	tp->tv_sec  = static_cast<int64_t>(us / 1000000);
	tp->tv_nsec = static_cast<int64_t>((us % 1000000) * 1000);
}

#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
static uint64_t KernelFiletimeTo100ns(FILETIME ft) {
	ULARGE_INTEGER v {};
	v.LowPart  = ft.dwLowDateTime;
	v.HighPart = ft.dwHighDateTime;
	return v.QuadPart;
}

static void Kernel100nsToTimespec(uint64_t value, KernelTimespec* tp) {
	EXIT_IF(tp == nullptr);
	tp->tv_sec  = static_cast<int64_t>(value / 10000000);
	tp->tv_nsec = static_cast<int64_t>((value % 10000000) * 100);
}

static bool KernelRealtimeToTimespec(bool precise, KernelTimespec* tp) {
	EXIT_IF(tp == nullptr);

	FILETIME ft {};
	if (precise) {
		GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime(&ft);
	} else {
		GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&ft);
	}

	static constexpr uint64_t WINDOWS_UNIX_EPOCH_DELTA_100NS = 116444736000000000ULL;
	const auto                value                          = KernelFiletimeTo100ns(ft);
	if (value < WINDOWS_UNIX_EPOCH_DELTA_100NS) {
		return false;
	}

	Kernel100nsToTimespec(value - WINDOWS_UNIX_EPOCH_DELTA_100NS, tp);
	return true;
}

static bool KernelClockGettimeSpecial(KernelClockid clock_id, KernelTimespec* tp, int* error) {
	EXIT_IF(tp == nullptr);
	EXIT_IF(error == nullptr);

	if (clock_id == KERNEL_CLOCK_PROCTIME) {
		KernelUsToTimespec(KernelGetProcessTimeUsNative(), tp);
		return true;
	}

	FILETIME create_time {};
	FILETIME exit_time {};
	FILETIME kernel_time {};
	FILETIME user_time {};

	switch (clock_id) {
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME_PRECISE:
			if (!KernelRealtimeToTimespec(true, tp)) {
				*error = KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
			}
			return true;
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME_FAST:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_SECOND:
			if (!KernelRealtimeToTimespec(false, tp)) {
				*error = KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
			}
			if (clock_id == KERNEL_CLOCK_SECOND) {
				tp->tv_nsec = 0;
			}
			return true;
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_MONOTONIC:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_UPTIME:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_UPTIME_PRECISE:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_UPTIME_FAST:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_MONOTONIC_PRECISE:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_MONOTONIC_FAST:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_NETWORK:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_DEBUG_NETWORK:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_AD_NETWORK:
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_EXT_RAW_NETWORK: {
			const auto ns = Common::SteadyNs();
			tp->tv_sec    = static_cast<int64_t>(ns / NANOS_PER_SEC);
			tp->tv_nsec   = static_cast<int64_t>(ns % NANOS_PER_SEC);
			return true;
		}
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID:
			if (!GetThreadTimes(GetCurrentThread(), &create_time, &exit_time, &kernel_time,
			                    &user_time)) {
				*error = KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
				return true;
			}
			Kernel100nsToTimespec(
			    KernelFiletimeTo100ns(kernel_time) + KernelFiletimeTo100ns(user_time), tp);
			return true;
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_VIRTUAL:
			if (!GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &create_time, &exit_time, &kernel_time,
			                     &user_time)) {
				*error = KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
				return true;
			}
			Kernel100nsToTimespec(KernelFiletimeTo100ns(user_time), tp);
			return true;
		case KERNEL_CLOCK_PROF:
			if (!GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &create_time, &exit_time, &kernel_time,
			                     &user_time)) {
				*error = KERNEL_ERROR_EFAULT;
				return true;
			}
			Kernel100nsToTimespec(KernelFiletimeTo100ns(kernel_time), tp);
			return true;
		default: return false;
	}
}
#else
static bool KernelClockGettimeSpecial(KernelClockid clock_id, KernelTimespec* tp, int* error) {
	EXIT_IF(tp == nullptr);
	EXIT_IF(error == nullptr);

	if (clock_id == KERNEL_CLOCK_PROCTIME) {
		KernelUsToTimespec(KernelGetProcessTimeUsNative(), tp);
		return true;
	}

	return false;
}
#endif

struct PthreadMutexPrivate {
	struct Waiter {
		Pthread                 thread = nullptr;
		std::condition_variable cv;
		Waiter*                 previous = nullptr;
		Waiter*                 next     = nullptr;
	};
	uint8_t                 reserved[256];
	std::string             name;
	std::mutex              m;
	Pthread                 owner     = nullptr;
	uint32_t                count     = 0;
	int                     type      = 1;
	int                     pprotocol = PTHREAD_PRIO_NONE;
	Waiter*                 first_waiter = nullptr;
	Waiter*                 last_waiter  = nullptr;
};

struct PthreadMutexattrPrivate {
	uint8_t             reserved[64];
	pthread_mutexattr_t p;
	int                 pprotocol;
	int                 type;
};

struct PthreadAttrPrivate {
	uint8_t        reserved[64];
	KernelCpumask  affinity;
	size_t         guard_size;
	void*          stack_addr;
	size_t         stack_size;
	bool           stack_user;
	uint64_t       stack_map_addr;
	size_t         stack_map_size;
	int            policy;
	int            guest_priority;
	int            inherit_sched;
	int            solosched;
	bool           detached;
	pthread_attr_t p;
};

struct PthreadGuestData {
	int32_t thread_id;
	uint8_t reserved[4092];
};

static_assert(sizeof(PthreadGuestData) == 4096);

struct PthreadPrivate {
	PthreadGuestData      guest;
	std::string           name;
	pthread_t             p;
	PthreadAttr           attr;
	pthread_entry_func_t  entry;
	void*                 arg;
	int                   unique_id;
	std::atomic_bool      detached;
	std::atomic_bool      almost_done;
	std::atomic_bool      free;
	uint64_t              host_thread_id;
	uintptr_t             guest_host_rbx;
	uintptr_t             guest_host_rsp;
	uintptr_t             guest_host_rbp;
	uint64_t              cond_sequence = 0;
	std::condition_variable cond_cv;
	std::atomic<uint64_t> pending_signal_mask {0};
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	uintptr_t guest_host_gs8;
	uintptr_t guest_host_gs10;
#endif
};

static PthreadAttrPrivate* GetPthreadAttrValue(const PthreadAttr* attr, const char* func_name) {
	if (attr == nullptr) {
		return nullptr;
	}

	auto* attr_value = *attr;
	if (attr_value == nullptr || reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(attr_value) < 0x10000u) {
		(void)func_name;
		return nullptr;
	}

	return attr_value;
}

struct PthreadRwlockPrivate {
	struct Reader {
		Pthread  thread = nullptr;
		uint32_t count  = 0;
	};

	uint8_t                 reserved[256];
	std::string             name;
	std::mutex              m;
	std::condition_variable cv;
	Pthread                 writer          = nullptr;
	uint32_t                writer_count    = 0;
	uint32_t                reader_count    = 0;
	uint32_t                waiting_writers = 0;
	std::vector<Reader>     readers;
};

struct PthreadRwlockattrPrivate {
	uint8_t              reserved[64];
	int                  type;
	pthread_rwlockattr_t p;
};

struct PthreadCondattrPrivate {
	uint8_t            reserved[64];
	pthread_condattr_t p;
	KernelClockid      clock_id = KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME;
};

struct PthreadCondPrivate {
	uint8_t                 reserved[256];
	std::string             name;
	std::mutex              m;
	KernelClockid           clock_id = KERNEL_CLOCK_REALTIME;
	std::vector<Pthread>    waiters;
};

static void CondAddWaiter(PthreadCondPrivate* cond, Pthread thread) {
	EXIT_IF(cond == nullptr);
	EXIT_IF(thread == nullptr);

	cond->waiters.push_back(thread);
}

static void CondRemoveWaiter(PthreadCondPrivate* cond, Pthread thread) {
	EXIT_IF(cond == nullptr);
	EXIT_IF(thread == nullptr);

	std::erase(cond->waiters, thread);
}

static void CondWakeWaiter(PthreadCondPrivate* cond, Pthread thread) {
	EXIT_IF(cond == nullptr);

	if (thread == nullptr) {
		if (cond->waiters.empty()) {
			return;
		}
		thread = cond->waiters.front();
	}

	auto it = std::find(cond->waiters.begin(), cond->waiters.end(), thread);
	if (it == cond->waiters.end()) {
		return;
	}

	cond->waiters.erase(it);
	thread->cond_sequence++;
	// Notify while holding cond->m so the selected waiter cannot exit and be freed first.
	thread->cond_cv.notify_one();
}

void PthreadWakeForSignal(Pthread thread) {
	if (thread != nullptr) {
		thread->cond_cv.notify_one();
	}
}

void KernelDispatchPendingSignalForCurrentThread();

static void SchedulerBackoffOnce() {
#if KYTY_PLATFORM == KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
	if (SwitchToThread() == 0) {
		Sleep(0);
	}
#else
	std::this_thread::yield();
#endif
}

static void SleepMicroWithSignalPoll(uint64_t microseconds) {
	if (microseconds == 0) {
		KernelDispatchPendingSignalForCurrentThread();
		return;
	}

	while (microseconds > 0) {
		const auto step = std::min<uint64_t>(microseconds, SIGNAL_APC_POLL_MICROS);
		Common::Thread::SleepMicro(step);
		microseconds -= step;
		KernelDispatchPendingSignalForCurrentThread();
	}
}

static void SleepNanoWithSignalPoll(uint64_t nanoseconds) {
	if (nanoseconds == 0) {
		KernelDispatchPendingSignalForCurrentThread();
		return;
	}

	constexpr uint64_t poll_nanos = static_cast<uint64_t>(SIGNAL_APC_POLL_MICROS) * 1000ull;
	while (nanoseconds > 0) {
		const auto step = std::min<uint64_t>(nanoseconds, poll_nanos);
		Common::Thread::SleepNano(step);
		nanoseconds -= step;
		KernelDispatchPendingSignalForCurrentThread();
	}
}
