```cpp
QString KeypadName(int key) {
	if (key >= Qt::Key_0 && key <= Qt::Key_9) {
		return QStringLiteral("Keypad %1").arg(key - Qt::Key_0);
	}

	switch (key) {
		case Qt::Key_Return:
		case Qt::Key_Enter: return QStringLiteral("Keypad Enter");
		case Qt::Key_Slash: return QStringLiteral("Keypad /");
		case Qt::Key_Asterisk: return QStringLiteral("Keypad *");
		case Qt::Key_Minus: return QStringLiteral("Keypad -");
		case Qt::Key_Plus: return QStringLiteral("Keypad +");
		case Qt::Key_Period: return QStringLiteral("Keypad .");
		case Qt::Key_Equal: return QStringLiteral("Keypad =");
		case Qt::Key_Comma: return QStringLiteral("Keypad ,");
		default: return {};
	}
}

QString KeyName(const QKeyEvent& event) {
	const int key = event.key();
	if (event.modifiers().testFlag(Qt::KeypadModifier)) {
		return KeypadName(key);
	}
	if (key >= Qt::Key_A && key <= Qt::Key_Z) {
		return QChar(key);
	}
	if (key >= Qt::Key_0 && key <= Qt::Key_9) {
		return QChar(key);
	}
	if (key >= Qt::Key_F1 && key <= Qt::Key_F24) {
		return QStringLiteral("F%1").arg(key - Qt::Key_F1 + 1);
	}

	switch (key) {
		case Qt::Key_Space: return QStringLiteral("Space");
		case Qt::Key_Return:
		case Qt::Key_Enter: return QStringLiteral("Return");
		case Qt::Key_Backspace: return QStringLiteral("Backspace");
		case Qt::Key_Tab: return QStringLiteral("Tab");
		case Qt::Key_Shift: return QStringLiteral("Left Shift");
		case Qt::Key_Control: return QStringLiteral("Left Ctrl");
		case Qt::Key_Alt: return QStringLiteral("Left Alt");
		case Qt::Key_Meta: return QStringLiteral("Left GUI");
		case Qt::Key_Insert: return QStringLiteral("Insert");
		case Qt::Key_Delete: return QStringLiteral("Delete");
		case Qt::Key_Home: return QStringLiteral("Home");
		case Qt::Key_End: return QStringLiteral("End");
		case Qt::Key_PageUp: return QStringLiteral("PageUp");
		case Qt::Key_PageDown: return QStringLiteral("PageDown");
		case Qt::Key_Left: return QStringLiteral("Left");
		case Qt::Key_Right: return QStringLiteral("Right");
		case Qt::Key_Up: return QStringLiteral("Up");
		case Qt::Key_Down: return QStringLiteral("Down");
		case Qt::Key_CapsLock: return QStringLiteral("CapsLock");
		case Qt::Key_NumLock: return QStringLiteral("Numlock");
		case Qt::Key_ScrollLock: return QStringLiteral("ScrollLock");
		case Qt::Key_Pause: return QStringLiteral("Pause");
		case Qt::Key_Print: return QStringLiteral("PrintScreen");
		default: break;
	}

	if (event.modifiers() != Qt::NoModifier) {
		return {};
	}
	const auto name = QKeySequence(key).toString(QKeySequence::PortableText);
	return name.size() == 1 ? name : QString();
}

class InputCaptureDialog final: public QDialog {
public:
	explicit InputCaptureDialog(QWidget* parent): QDialog(parent) {
		setWindowTitle(tr("Set Binding"));
		setModal(true);
		setMinimumWidth(360);

		auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
		m_label      = new QLabel(
		    tr("Press a key or mouse button.\nF1, F2, F7, F8, and F11 are reserved; Esc cancels."),
		    this);
		m_label->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
		layout->addWidget(m_label);
	}

	[[nodiscard]] const QString& Binding() const { return m_binding; }

protected:
	void keyPressEvent(QKeyEvent* event) override {
		if (event->isAutoRepeat()) {
			return;
		}
		if (event->key() == Qt::Key_Escape) {
			reject();
			return;
		}
		if (event->key() == Qt::Key_F1 || event->key() == Qt::Key_F2 ||
		    event->key() == Qt::Key_F7 || event->key() == Qt::Key_F8 ||
		    event->key() == Qt::Key_F11) {
			m_label->setText(tr("That key is reserved by the emulator."));
			return;
		}

		m_binding = KeyName(*event);
		if (!m_binding.isEmpty()) {
			accept();
		} else {
			m_label->setText(tr("That key is not supported."));
		}
	}

	void mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent* event) override {
		switch (event->button()) {
			case Qt::LeftButton: m_binding = QStringLiteral("Mouse:Left"); break;
			case Qt::RightButton: m_binding = QStringLiteral("Mouse:Right"); break;
			case Qt::MiddleButton: m_binding = QStringLiteral("Mouse:Middle"); break;
			case Qt::BackButton: m_binding = QStringLiteral("Mouse:X1"); break;
			case Qt::ForwardButton: m_binding = QStringLiteral("Mouse:X2"); break;
			default: return;
		}
		accept();
	}

private:
	QLabel* m_label = nullptr;
	QString m_binding;
};

class PadCaptureDialog final: public QDialog {
public:
	PadCaptureDialog(ControllerPreview* preview, QWidget* parent): QDialog(parent) {
		setWindowTitle(tr("Set Binding"));
		setModal(true);
		setMinimumWidth(360);

		auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
		m_label      = new QLabel(this);
		m_label->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
		m_label->setWordWrap(true);
		layout->addWidget(m_label);

		if (preview == nullptr) {
			return;
		}
		// Inputs already held when the dialog opens must be released before they count.
		m_held = preview->RawPressed();
		connect(preview, &ControllerPreview::StateChanged, this, [this, preview] {
			const auto& pressed = preview->RawPressed();
			m_held.intersect(pressed);
			for (const auto& name: pressed) {
				if (!m_held.contains(name)) {
					m_binding = name;
					accept();
					return;
				}
			}
			UpdateText(preview);
		});
		UpdateText(preview);
	}

	[[nodiscard]] const QString& Binding() const { return m_binding; }

private:
	void UpdateText(const ControllerPreview* preview) {
		m_label->setText(preview->DeviceName().isEmpty()
		                     ? tr("No controller connected.\nConnect one, or press Esc to cancel.")
		                     : tr("Press a button or trigger on %1.\nEsc cancels.")
		                           .arg(preview->DeviceName()));
	}

	QLabel*       m_label = nullptr;
	QString       m_binding;
	QSet<QString> m_held;
};

void AssignBinding(QHash<QString, QString>& bindings, const QString& id, const QString& binding) {
	for (auto item = bindings.begin(); item != bindings.end();) {
		if (item.value().compare(binding, Qt::CaseInsensitive) == 0) {
			item = bindings.erase(item);
		} else {
			++item;
		}
	}
	bindings.insert(id, binding);
}

QHash<QString, QString> ParseMapping(const QStringList& mapping) {
	QHash<QString, QString> result;
	for (const auto& entry: mapping) {
		if (entry == QLatin1String(KEYBOARD_DISABLED) || entry == QLatin1String(PAD_DISABLED) ||
		    entry.startsWith(QLatin1String(MOUSE_SENSITIVITY)) ||
		    entry.startsWith(QLatin1String(TOUCH_PARTICLE_SKIN)) ||
		    entry.startsWith(QLatin1String("TouchCursorImage=")) ||
		    entry.startsWith(QLatin1String(PAD_PREFIX))) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto separator = entry.indexOf(QLatin1Char('='));
		if (separator > 0 && separator + 1 < entry.size()) {
			AssignBinding(result, entry.left(separator), entry.mid(separator + 1));
		}
	}
	return result;
}

QString ParseTouchParticleSkin(const QStringList& mapping) {
	for (const auto& entry: mapping) {
		if (entry.startsWith(QLatin1String(TOUCH_PARTICLE_SKIN))) {
			return entry.mid(sizeof(TOUCH_PARTICLE_SKIN) - 1);
		}
	}
	return QStringLiteral("Classic");
}

double ParseMouseSensitivity(const QStringList& mapping) {
	for (const auto& entry: mapping) {
		if (entry.startsWith(QLatin1String(MOUSE_SENSITIVITY))) {
			return entry.mid(sizeof(MOUSE_SENSITIVITY) - 1).toDouble();
		}
	}
	return DEFAULT_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY;
}

} // namespace

InputMappingDialog::InputMappingDialog(const QStringList& mapping, ControllerPreview* preview,
                                       QWidget* parent)
    : QDialog(parent), m_preview(preview) {
	setWindowTitle(tr("Controls"));
	resize(QSize(1360, 780).boundedTo(screen()->availableGeometry().size()));

	m_bindings        = ParseMapping(mapping);
	m_custom_bindings = !m_bindings.isEmpty() || mapping.contains(QLatin1String(KEYBOARD_DISABLED));
	m_custom_pad      = mapping.contains(QLatin1String(PAD_DISABLED));
	for (const auto& entry: mapping) {
		if (!entry.startsWith(QLatin1String(PAD_PREFIX))) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto body      = entry.mid(static_cast<int>(sizeof(PAD_PREFIX)) - 1);
		const auto separator = body.indexOf(QLatin1Char('='));
		if (separator > 0 && separator + 1 < body.size()) {
			AssignBinding(m_pad_bindings, body.left(separator), body.mid(separator + 1));
			m_custom_pad = true;
		}
	}
	for (const auto& control: PAD_CONTROLS) {
		const auto id = QString::fromLatin1(control.id);
		if (!m_custom_bindings && control.keyboard_default[0] != '\0') {
			m_bindings.insert(id, QString::fromLatin1(control.keyboard_default));
		}
		if (!m_custom_pad && control.pad_default != nullptr) {
			m_pad_bindings.insert(id, QString::fromLatin1(control.pad_default));
		}
	}

	auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
	layout->setSpacing(10);

	m_tabs = new QTabWidget(this);
	m_tabs->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("inputTabs"));
	m_tabs->setDocumentMode(true);
	m_tabs->addTab(BuildTab(true), tr("Gamepad"));
	m_tabs->addTab(BuildTab(false), tr("Keyboard && Mouse"));
	layout->addWidget(m_tabs, 1);
	m_sensitivity->setValue(ParseMouseSensitivity(mapping));

	auto* touch_group  = new QGroupBox(tr("Emulated touch pad (shared by both tabs)"), this);
	auto* touch_layout = new QHBoxLayout(touch_group);
	touch_layout->addWidget(new QLabel(tr("Particle skin"), touch_group));
	m_particle_skin = new QComboBox(touch_group);
	m_particle_skin->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("touchParticleSkin"));
	m_particle_skin->addItem(tr("Classic"), QStringLiteral("Classic"));
	m_particle_skin->addItem(tr("Blue neon"), QStringLiteral("BlueNeon"));
	m_particle_skin->addItem(tr("Monochrome"), QStringLiteral("Monochrome"));
	m_particle_skin->addItem(tr("Crimson"), QStringLiteral("Crimson"));
	m_particle_skin->addItem(tr("Red/Blue"), QStringLiteral("RedBlue"));
	touch_layout->addWidget(m_particle_skin);
	m_touch_cursor = new QCheckBox(tr("Show hand cursor and trail"), touch_group);
	m_touch_cursor->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("touchCursorImage"));
	m_touch_cursor->setToolTip(tr("When off, the emulated touch pad still works but the hand "
	                              "image and drawing trail are not shown."));
	m_touch_cursor->setChecked(!mapping.contains(QLatin1String(TOUCH_CURSOR_OFF)));
	touch_layout->addWidget(m_touch_cursor);
	touch_layout->addStretch();
	touch_layout->addWidget(new QLabel(
	    tr("Toggle with the touch pad mode key (F6 by default); draw with left mouse / Cross."),
	    touch_group));
	layout->addWidget(touch_group);
	const auto skin_index = m_particle_skin->findData(ParseTouchParticleSkin(mapping));
	m_particle_skin->setCurrentIndex(skin_index >= 0 ? skin_index : 0);

	auto* buttons  = new QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox::RestoreDefaults |
	                                          QDialogButtonBox::Save | QDialogButtonBox::Cancel,
	                                      this);
	auto* defaults = buttons->button(QDialogButtonBox::RestoreDefaults);
	defaults->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("defaults"));
	defaults->setAutoDefault(false);
	defaults->setToolTip(tr("Restore the defaults of the current tab."));
	auto* tip = new QLabel(tr("Tip: right-click a binding to unmap it."), this);
	auto* footer = new QHBoxLayout;
	footer->addWidget(tip);
	footer->addStretch();
	footer->addWidget(buttons);
	layout->addLayout(footer);

	connect(defaults, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &InputMappingDialog::RestoreDefaults);
	connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::accepted, this, &QDialog::accept);
	connect(buttons, &QDialogButtonBox::rejected, this, &QDialog::reject);
	if (m_preview != nullptr) {
		connect(m_preview, &ControllerPreview::StateChanged, this,
		        &InputMappingDialog::UpdatePreview);
		m_preview->SetPreviewEnabled(true);
	}
	UpdateButtons();
	UpdatePreview();
}

InputMappingDialog::~InputMappingDialog() {
	if (m_preview != nullptr) {
		m_preview->SetPreviewEnabled(false);
	}
}

QWidget* InputMappingDialog::BuildTab(bool pad) {
	auto* page   = new QWidget(this);
	auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(page);
	layout->setSpacing(10);

	auto* hint = new QLabel(
	    pad ? tr("Choose which button on your gamepad triggers each PS5 control. Click a "
	             "binding, then press the button or trigger you want to use.")
	        : tr("Choose which keyboard key or mouse button triggers each PS5 control. Click a "
	             "binding, then press the key or mouse button."),
	    page);
	hint->setWordWrap(true);
	layout->addWidget(hint);
	if (pad) {
		m_status = new QLabel(page);
		m_status->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("controllerStatus"));
		m_status->setWordWrap(true);
		layout->addWidget(m_status);
	}

	auto* body = new QHBoxLayout;
	body->setSpacing(14);
	layout->addLayout(body, 1);

	auto* scroll = new QScrollArea(page);
	scroll->setWidgetResizable(true);
	scroll->setFrameShape(QFrame::NoFrame);
	auto* content = new QWidget(scroll);
	auto* columns = new QGridLayout(content);
	columns->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 8, 0);
	columns->setSpacing(12);
	columns->setAlignment(Qt::AlignTop);

	// Section order and the column each one lives in.
	static constexpr Section ORDER[] = {Face, Dpad, Shoulders, Sticks, System, LeftStick,
	                                    RightStick, Shortcuts};
	int                      column_rows[2] = {0, 0};
	for (const auto section: ORDER) {
		QGroupBox*   group = nullptr;
		QGridLayout* rows  = nullptr;
		int          row   = 0;
		for (const auto& control: PAD_CONTROLS) {
			if (control.section != section || (pad && control.pad_default == nullptr)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (group == nullptr) {
				group = new QGroupBox(tr(SECTION_TITLES[section]), content);
				rows  = new QGridLayout(group);
				rows->setHorizontalSpacing(12);
				rows->setVerticalSpacing(6);
				rows->setColumnStretch(0, 1);
				rows->setColumnMinimumWidth(1, 190);
			}
			const auto id    = QString::fromLatin1(control.id);
			const auto label = !pad && id == QLatin1String("TouchPad") ? tr("Touch pad left")
			                                                           : tr(control.label);
			auto* name = new QLabel(label, group);
			auto* button = new QPushButton(group);
			button->setObjectName((pad ? QStringLiteral("padBinding_") : QStringLiteral("binding_")) +
			                      id);
			button->setAutoDefault(false);
			button->setMinimumWidth(190);
			button->setContextMenuPolicy(Qt::CustomContextMenu);
			button->setAccessibleName(tr(SECTION_TITLES[section]) + QStringLiteral(" / ") + label);
			rows->addWidget(name, row, 0);
			rows->addWidget(button, row, 1);
			++row;
			(pad ? m_pad_buttons : m_buttons).insert(id, button);
			connect(button, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, pad, id] {
				pad ? ChangePadBinding(id) : ChangeKeyboardBinding(id);
			});
			connect(button, &QPushButton::customContextMenuRequested, this,
			        [this, pad, id] { ClearBinding(pad, id); });
		}
		if (group != nullptr) {
			const int target = column_rows[0] <= column_rows[1] ? 0 : 1;
			columns->addWidget(group, column_rows[target]++, target);
		}
	}
	columns->setColumnStretch(0, 1);
	columns->setColumnStretch(1, 1);
	scroll->setWidget(content);
	scroll->setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt::ScrollBarAlwaysOff);
	scroll->setMinimumWidth(pad ? 640 : 700);
	body->addWidget(scroll, 3);

	if (pad) {
		m_controller = new DualSenseWidget(page);
		m_controller->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("controllerDiagram"));
		m_controller->setMinimumWidth(320);
		body->addWidget(m_controller, 2);
		connect(m_controller, &DualSenseWidget::ControlClicked, this,
		        [this](const QString& id) {
			        ChangePadBinding(id == QLatin1String("TouchPadRight") ? QStringLiteral("TouchPad")
			                                                               : id);
		        });
		auto* note = new QLabel(tr("The gyro emulation toggle activates tilt mode on gamepads "
		                           "without a gyroscope: the right stick then controls pitch and "
		                           "roll. It defaults to the View/Back button."),
		                        page);
		note->setWordWrap(true);
		layout->addWidget(note);
	} else {
		auto* sensitivity_layout = new QHBoxLayout;
		sensitivity_layout->addWidget(new QLabel(tr("Mouse sensitivity"), page));
		m_sensitivity = new QDoubleSpinBox(page);
		m_sensitivity->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("mouseSensitivity"));
		m_sensitivity->setRange(0.1, 5.0);
		m_sensitivity->setSingleStep(0.1);
		m_sensitivity->setDecimals(1);
		m_sensitivity->setSuffix(QStringLiteral("×"));
		m_sensitivity->setValue(DEFAULT_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY);
		sensitivity_layout->addWidget(m_sensitivity);
		sensitivity_layout->addWidget(
		    new QLabel(tr("F7 in-game toggles mouse movement on the right stick."), page));
		sensitivity_layout->addStretch();
		layout->addLayout(sensitivity_layout);

	}
	return page;
}

QStringList InputMappingDialog::Mapping() const {
	QStringList result;
	if (m_custom_bindings) {
		for (const auto& control: PAD_CONTROLS) {
			const auto id      = QString::fromLatin1(control.id);
			const auto binding = m_bindings.value(id);
			if (!binding.isEmpty()) {
				result.append(id + QLatin1Char('=') + binding);
			}
		}
		if (result.isEmpty()) {
			result.append(QLatin1String(KEYBOARD_DISABLED));
		}
	}
	if (m_custom_pad) {
		const auto start = result.size();
		for (const auto& control: PAD_CONTROLS) {
			const auto id     = QString::fromLatin1(control.id);
			const auto source = m_pad_bindings.value(id);
			if (!source.isEmpty()) {
				result.append(QLatin1String(PAD_PREFIX) + id + QLatin1Char('=') + source);
			}
		}
		if (result.size() == start) {
			result.append(QLatin1String(PAD_DISABLED));
		}
	}
	if (m_sensitivity->value() != DEFAULT_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY) {
		result.append(QLatin1String(MOUSE_SENSITIVITY) +
		              QString::number(m_sensitivity->value(), 'f', 1));
	}
	const auto skin = m_particle_skin->currentData().toString();
	if (skin != QLatin1String("Classic")) {
		result.append(QLatin1String(TOUCH_PARTICLE_SKIN) + skin);
	}
	if (!m_touch_cursor->isChecked()) {
		result.append(QLatin1String(TOUCH_CURSOR_OFF));
	}
	return result;
}

void InputMappingDialog::ChangeKeyboardBinding(const QString& id) {
	if (!m_buttons.contains(id)) {
		return;
	}
	m_selected = id;
	UpdateHighlights();
	InputCaptureDialog dialog(this);
	dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Set binding — %1").arg(m_buttons.value(id)->accessibleName()));
	if (dialog.exec() == QDialog::Accepted) {
		AssignBinding(m_bindings, id, dialog.Binding());
		m_custom_bindings = true;
	}
	m_selected.clear();
	UpdateButtons();
}

void InputMappingDialog::ChangePadBinding(const QString& id) {
	if (!m_pad_buttons.contains(id)) {
		return;
	}
	m_selected = id;
	UpdateHighlights();
	PadCaptureDialog dialog(m_preview, this);
	dialog.setWindowTitle(tr("Set binding — %1").arg(m_pad_buttons.value(id)->accessibleName()));
	if (dialog.exec() == QDialog::Accepted) {
		AssignBinding(m_pad_bindings, id, dialog.Binding());
		m_custom_pad = true;
	}
	m_selected.clear();
	UpdateButtons();
}

void InputMappingDialog::ClearBinding(bool pad, const QString& id) {
	if (pad) {
		m_pad_bindings.remove(id);
		m_custom_pad = true;
	} else {
		m_bindings.remove(id);
		m_custom_bindings = true;
	}
	UpdateButtons();
}

void InputMappingDialog::RestoreDefaults() {
	if (m_tabs->currentIndex() == 0) {
		m_pad_bindings.clear();
		for (const auto& control: PAD_CONTROLS) {
			if (control.pad_default != nullptr) {
				m_pad_bindings.insert(QString::fromLatin1(control.id),
				                      QString::fromLatin1(control.pad_default));
			}
		}
		m_custom_pad = false;
	} else {
		m_bindings.clear();
		for (const auto& control: PAD_CONTROLS) {
			if (control.keyboard_default[0] != '\0') {
				m_bindings.insert(QString::fromLatin1(control.id),
				                  QString::fromLatin1(control.keyboard_default));
			}
		}
		m_sensitivity->setValue(DEFAULT_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY);
		m_custom_bindings = false;
	}
	UpdateButtons();
}

void InputMappingDialog::UpdateButtons() {
	for (auto item = m_buttons.begin(); item != m_buttons.end(); ++item) {
		auto*      button  = item.value();
		const auto binding = m_bindings.value(item.key());
		const auto label   = binding.isEmpty() ? tr("None") : binding;
		button->setText(QString(label).replace(QLatin1Char('&'), QLatin1String("&&")));
		button->setToolTip(
		    tr("%1: %2. Click to change, right-click to clear.").arg(button->accessibleName(), label));
	}
	for (auto item = m_pad_buttons.begin(); item != m_pad_buttons.end(); ++item) {
		auto*      button  = item.value();
		const auto source  = m_pad_bindings.value(item.key());
		const auto label   = source.isEmpty() ? tr("None") : PadSourceLabel(source);
		button->setText(QString(label).replace(QLatin1Char('&'), QLatin1String("&&")));
		button->setToolTip(
		    tr("%1: %2. Click to change, right-click to clear.").arg(button->accessibleName(), label));
	}
	UpdateHighlights();
}

void InputMappingDialog::UpdatePreview() {
	m_pad_pressed.clear();
	if (m_preview != nullptr) {
		const auto& raw = m_preview->RawPressed();
		for (auto item = m_pad_bindings.begin(); item != m_pad_bindings.end(); ++item) {
			if (raw.contains(item.value())) {
				m_pad_pressed.insert(item.key());
			}
		}
		if (m_pad_pressed.contains(QStringLiteral("TouchPad"))) {
			m_pad_pressed.insert(QStringLiteral("TouchPadRight"));
		}
		for (const auto& name: m_preview->Pressed()) {
			// Stick directions and touch pad fingers are shown as the pad reports them.
			if (name.startsWith(QLatin1String("LeftStick")) ||
			    name.startsWith(QLatin1String("RightStick")) ||
			    name.startsWith(QLatin1String("TouchPad"))) {
				m_pad_pressed.insert(name);
			}
		}
	}
	m_controller->SetPressed(m_pad_pressed);
	m_controller->SetSticks(m_preview != nullptr ? m_preview->LeftStick() : QPointF(),
	                        m_preview != nullptr ? m_preview->RightStick() : QPointF());
	UpdateHighlights();
	if (m_preview != nullptr && !m_preview->Error().isEmpty()) {
		m_status->setText(tr("Controller preview unavailable: %1").arg(m_preview->Error()));
	} else if (m_preview != nullptr && !m_preview->DeviceName().isEmpty()) {
		m_status->setText(tr("Connected: %1").arg(m_preview->DeviceName()));
	} else {
		m_status->setText(tr("No controller connected"));
	}
}

void InputMappingDialog::UpdateHighlights() {
	m_controller->SetSelected(m_selected);
	for (auto item = m_pad_buttons.begin(); item != m_pad_buttons.end(); ++item) {
		const bool down   = m_pad_pressed.contains(item.key());
		auto       colors = palette();
		if (down) {
			colors.setColor(QPalette::Button, colors.color(QPalette::Highlight));
			colors.setColor(QPalette::ButtonText, colors.color(QPalette::HighlightedText));
		} else if (item.key() == m_selected) {
			colors.setColor(QPalette::ButtonText, colors.color(QPalette::Highlight));
		}
		auto label_font = font();
		label_font.setBold(down);
		item.value()->setPalette(colors);
		item.value()->setFont(label_font);
	}
	for (auto item = m_buttons.begin(); item != m_buttons.end(); ++item) {
		auto colors = palette();
		if (item.key() == m_selected) {
			colors.setColor(QPalette::ButtonText, colors.color(QPalette::Highlight));
		}
		item.value()->setPalette(colors);
	}
}
```

`src/launcher/src/launcherTheme.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "launcherTheme.h"

#include <QApplication>
#include <QEvent>
#include <QFile>
#include <QObject>
#include <QTimer>

namespace {

class PaletteChangeFilter final: public QObject {
public:
	explicit PaletteChangeFilter(QApplication& application)
	    : QObject(&application), m_application(application) {}

protected:
	bool eventFilter(QObject* watched, QEvent* event) override {
		if (event->type() == QEvent::ApplicationPaletteChange && !m_refresh_pending) {
			m_refresh_pending = true;
			QTimer::singleShot(0, &m_application, [this] {
				m_application.setStyleSheet(m_application.styleSheet());
				m_refresh_pending = false;
			});
		}

		return QObject::eventFilter(watched, event);
	}

private:
	QApplication& m_application;
	bool          m_refresh_pending = false;
};

} // namespace

namespace LauncherTheme {

void Initialize(QApplication& application) {
	QFile style_sheet_file(QStringLiteral(":/styles/launcher.qss"));
	if (style_sheet_file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
		application.setStyleSheet(QString::fromUtf8(style_sheet_file.readAll()));
		application.installEventFilter(new PaletteChangeFilter(application));
	}
}
} // namespace LauncherTheme
```

```cpp
#include "mainDialog.h"
#include "launcherTheme.h"

#include <QApplication>
#include <QIcon>

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
	QApplication a(argc, argv);
	// Title bars and taskbars get the bolder small-size artwork.
	const QIcon small_art(QStringLiteral(":/icons/kyty-small.svg"));
	const QIcon large_art(QStringLiteral(":/icons/kyty.svg"));
	QIcon       icon;
	for (int size: {16, 24, 32, 48, 64}) {
		icon.addPixmap(small_art.pixmap(QSize(size, size), 1.0));
	}
	for (int size: {128, 256}) {
		icon.addPixmap(large_art.pixmap(QSize(size, size), 1.0));
	}
	QApplication::setWindowIcon(icon);
	LauncherTheme::Initialize(a);

	MainDialog w;

	w.emit Start();

	w.show();

	return QApplication::exec();
}
```

```cpp
constexpr char  CMD_EXE[]      = "cmd.exe";
constexpr DWORD CMD_X_CHARS    = 175;
constexpr DWORD CMD_Y_CHARS    = 1000;
#else
constexpr char EMULATOR_EXE[] = "kyty_emulator";
#endif
constexpr char SETTINGS_MAIN_DIALOG[]        = "MainDialog";
constexpr char SETTINGS_MAIN_LAST_GEOMETRY[] = "geometry";
constexpr char SETTINGS_CHECK_UPDATES[]      = "check_updates_on_startup";
constexpr char SETTINGS_CLOSE_TERMINAL[]     = "close_terminal";
constexpr char SETTINGS_THEME[]              = "theme";

class MainDialogPrivate: public QObject {
	Q_OBJECT

public:
	explicit MainDialogPrivate(QObject* parent = nullptr): QObject(parent) {}
	~MainDialogPrivate() override;

	void Setup(MainDialog* main_dialog);

	/*slots:*/

	void Update();
	void FindInterpreter();
	void Run();

	[[nodiscard]] const QString& GetInterpreter() const { return m_interpreter; }

	static void WriteSettings(QSettings& s);
	static void ReadSettings(QSettings& s);

private:
	static QByteArray g_last_geometry;
	static bool       g_check_updates_on_startup;
	static bool       g_close_terminal;
	static int        g_theme;

	static void ApplyTheme(int theme) {
		auto scheme = Qt::ColorScheme::Unknown;
		switch (theme) {
			case 1: scheme = Qt::ColorScheme::Dark; break;
			case 2: scheme = Qt::ColorScheme::Light; break;
			default: break;
		}
		QApplication::styleHints()->setColorScheme(scheme);
	}

	Ui::MainDialog* m_ui             = {nullptr};
	MainDialog*     m_main_dialog    = nullptr;
	UpdateChecker*  m_update_checker = nullptr;
	ControllerPreview m_controller_preview;
	TitleSound      m_title_sound;
	QString         m_interpreter;
	QString         m_emulator_version;

	int m_running_games = 0;
};

QByteArray MainDialogPrivate::g_last_geometry;
bool       MainDialogPrivate::g_check_updates_on_startup = true;
bool       MainDialogPrivate::g_close_terminal           = false;
int        MainDialogPrivate::g_theme                    = 0;

MainDialog::MainDialog(QWidget* parent): QDialog(parent), m_p(new MainDialogPrivate(this)) {
	m_p->Setup(this);
}

MainDialogPrivate::~MainDialogPrivate() {
	delete m_ui;
}

void MainDialogPrivate::Setup(MainDialog* main_dialog) {
	m_ui = new Ui::MainDialog;
	m_ui->setupUi(main_dialog);
	m_ui->widget->SetControllerPreview(&m_controller_preview);

	m_main_dialog = main_dialog;
	m_update_checker = new UpdateChecker(main_dialog);
	m_ui->check_updates_on_startup->setChecked(g_check_updates_on_startup);
	m_ui->close_terminal->setChecked(g_close_terminal);
	m_ui->theme_combo->setCurrentIndex(g_theme);
	m_ui->share_pipelines->setVisible(PipelineSharing::Available());
	m_ui->share_pipelines->setChecked(PipelineSharing::Enabled());
	ApplyTheme(g_theme);
	m_ui->check_updates_link->setVisible(UpdateChecker::IsSupported());
	m_ui->check_updates_on_startup->setVisible(UpdateChecker::IsSupported());
#if defined(__APPLE__)
	m_ui->close_terminal->setVisible(false); // The emulator runs without a terminal.
#endif

	main_dialog->setWindowFlags(Qt::Dialog | Qt::WindowMinMaxButtonsHint |
	                            Qt::WindowCloseButtonHint);

	connect(main_dialog, &MainDialog::Start, this, &MainDialogPrivate::FindInterpreter,
	        Qt::QueuedConnection);
	connect(m_ui->widget, &ConfigurationListWidget::Select, this, [this]() {
		Update();
		const auto* item = m_ui->widget->GetSelectedItem();
		m_title_sound.SetTitle(m_running_games == 0 && item != nullptr ? item->GetInfo().basedir
		                                                               : QString());
	});
	connect(m_ui->widget, &ConfigurationListWidget::PreviewControllerColor, this,
	        [this](const QString& color) {
		        if (m_running_games == 0) {
			        m_controller_preview.SetColor(color);
		        }
	        });
	connect(m_ui->widget, &ConfigurationListWidget::Run, this, &MainDialogPrivate::Run);
	connect(m_ui->check_updates_link, &QLabel::linkActivated, this,
	        [this](const QString&) { m_update_checker->Check(true); });
	connect(m_update_checker, &UpdateChecker::CheckingChanged, m_ui->check_updates_link,
	        &QLabel::setDisabled);
	connect(m_update_checker, &UpdateChecker::InstallingChanged, this, &MainDialogPrivate::Update);
	connect(m_ui->check_updates_on_startup, &QCheckBox::toggled, this, [this](bool checked) {
		g_check_updates_on_startup = checked;
		m_ui->widget->WriteSettings();
	});
	connect(m_ui->close_terminal, &QCheckBox::toggled, this, [this](bool checked) {
		g_close_terminal = checked;
		m_ui->widget->WriteSettings();
	});
	connect(m_ui->share_pipelines, &QCheckBox::toggled, this, [this](bool checked) {
		PipelineSharing::SetEnabled(checked);
		m_ui->widget->WriteSettings();
	});
	connect(m_ui->theme_combo, &QComboBox::currentIndexChanged, this, [this](int index) {
		g_theme = index;
		ApplyTheme(index);
		m_ui->widget->WriteSettings();
	});
	connect(main_dialog, &MainDialog::Resize, [this]() {
		g_last_geometry = m_main_dialog->saveGeometry();
		m_ui->widget->WriteSettings();
	});

	m_ui->label_settings_file->setText(tr("Settings file: ") + m_ui->widget->GetSettingsFile());

	m_main_dialog->restoreGeometry(g_last_geometry);

	Update();
}

void MainDialogPrivate::FindInterpreter() {
	UpdateChecker::ShowPreviousResult(m_main_dialog);
	QDir search_dir(QApplication::applicationDirPath());
	m_interpreter = search_dir.absoluteFilePath(EMULATOR_EXE);

	if (!QFile::exists(m_interpreter)) {
		search_dir.cdUp();
		m_interpreter = search_dir.absoluteFilePath(EMULATOR_EXE);
	}

	bool found = QFile::exists(m_interpreter);
	m_ui->widget->SetRuntimeDirectory(QFileInfo(m_interpreter).absolutePath());

	if (found) {
		m_ui->label_Interpreter->setText(tr("Emulator: ") + m_interpreter);

		QProcess test;
		test.setProgram(m_interpreter);
		test.start();
		test.waitForFinished();

		auto output = QString(test.readAllStandardOutput());
		auto lines  = output.split(QRegularExpression("[\r\n]"), Qt::SkipEmptyParts);

		if (lines.count() >= 2) {
			m_emulator_version = lines.at(0).startsWith("exe_name") ? lines.at(1) : lines.at(0);
			m_ui->label_Version->setText(
			    tr("Version: ") + (lines.at(0).startsWith("exe_name") ? lines.at(1) : lines.at(0)));
		} else {
			found = false;
		}
	}

	if (!found) {
		QMessageBox::critical(m_main_dialog, tr("Error"), tr("Can't find emulator"));
		QApplication::quit();
		return;
	}

	// Prompt for a game folder when none are configured, but keep the launcher
	// open if the user dismisses the dialog (quitting here can segfault during
	// nested modal shutdown / background compatibility load).
	m_ui->widget->EnsureGameDirectory();

	m_ui->label_settings_file->setText(tr("Settings file: ") + m_ui->widget->GetSettingsFile());

	Update();
	if (m_ui->check_updates_on_startup->isChecked()) {
		m_update_checker->Check(false);
	}
}

static void AddFlag(QStringList& args, bool enabled, const char* name) {
	if (enabled) {
		args << name;
	}
}

static QStringList CreateEmulatorArgs(const Configuration& info) {
	QStringList args;
	auto        r = Configuration::NormalizeResolution(info.screen_resolution).split('x');

	if (r.size() != 2) {
		return {};
	}

	args << "--screen-width" << r.at(0);
	args << "--screen-height" << r.at(1);
	args << "--user-name" << info.user_name;
	args << "--user-id" << QString::number(info.user_id);
	if (!info.audio_input_device.isEmpty()) {
		args << "--mic" << info.audio_input_device;
	}
	if (!info.controller.color.isEmpty()) {
		args << "--controller-color" << info.controller.color;
	}
	args << "--controller-volume" << QString::number(info.controller.speaker_volume);
	args << "--controller-vibration" << QString::number(info.controller.vibration_intensity);
	args << "--keyboard-player" << QString::number(info.controller.keyboard_player);
	args << "--present-mode" << EnumToText(info.present_mode);
	if (info.gpu_index >= 0) {
		args << "--gpu" << QString::number(info.gpu_index);
	}
	AddFlag(args, info.fullscreen_enabled, "--fullscreen");
	AddFlag(args, info.hdr_enabled, "--hdr");
	AddFlag(args, info.hide_cursor_enabled, "--hide-cursor");
	AddFlag(args, info.stretch_enabled, "--stretch");
	AddFlag(args, !info.readback_linear_images, "--no-readback-linear-images");
	AddFlag(args, info.readback_tiled_images, "--readback-tiled-images");
	AddFlag(args, info.sync_raw_image_buffers, "--sync-raw-image-buffers");
	AddFlag(args, !info.trophy_enabled, "--no-trophy-notifications");
	args << "--trophy-duration" << QString::number(info.trophy_duration_seconds);
	AddFlag(args, info.perf_overlay_enabled, "--perf-overlay");
	AddFlag(args, info.skip_notice_screen, "--skip-notice-screen");
	AddFlag(args, info.network_connected, "--network-connected");
	AddFlag(args, info.psn_emulation_enabled, "--emulate-psn");
	AddFlag(args, !info.tessellation_enabled, "--no-tessellation");
	AddFlag(args, !info.occlusion_queries_enabled, "--no-occlusion-queries");
	AddFlag(args, info.shader_cache_enabled, "--shader-cache");
	AddFlag(args, !info.async_pipelines_enabled, "--no-async-pipelines");
	AddFlag(args, info.native_ray_tracing_enabled, "--native-raytracing");
	AddFlag(args, info.pipeline_manifest_record, "--record-pipeline-manifest");
	args << "--vblank-frequency" << QString::number(info.vblank_frequency);
	args << "--console-language" << QString::number(info.console_language);
	AddFlag(args, info.vulkan_validation_enabled, "--vulkan-validation");
	AddFlag(args, info.shader_validation_enabled, "--shader-validation");
	args << "--shader-log-direction" << EnumToText(info.shader_log_direction);
	args << "--shader-log-folder" << info.shader_log_folder;
	AddFlag(args, info.command_buffer_dump_enabled, "--command-buffer-dump");
	args << "--command-buffer-dump-folder" << info.command_buffer_dump_folder;
	args << "--printf-direction" << EnumToText(info.printf_direction);
	args << "--printf-output-file" << info.printf_output_file;
	AddFlag(args, info.profiler_enabled, "--profile");
	AddFlag(args, info.pro_enabled, "--trinity");
	AddFlag(args, info.amd_cpu_enabled, "--amd-cpu");
	AddFlag(args, !info.guest_tsc_enabled, "--no-guest-tsc");
#if defined(_WIN32)
	AddFlag(args, !info.red_zone_protection_enabled, "--no-redzone");
#endif
	for (const auto& binding: info.host_input_mapping) {
		args << "--keymap" << binding;
	}
	AddFlag(args, info.renderdoc_enabled, "--rd");

	QString game = info.basedir;
	if (!info.elf.isEmpty() && !GameContent::IsArchive(info.basedir)) {
		game = QDir(info.basedir).filePath(info.elf);
	}
	args << "--game" << game;
	if (!info.addons_dir.isEmpty()) {
		args << "--addcont-dir" << info.addons_dir;
	}
	for (const auto& entry: info.addcont) {
		args << "--addcont" << entry;
	}

	const auto patch_plan = Cheats::PlanPath(info.title_id);
	if (QFileInfo::exists(patch_plan)) {
		args << "--game-patch" << patch_plan;
	}

	return args;
}

#ifdef __linux__
// Runs the command in bash, then waits for a key (with close_on_clean_exit, only after an error).
// The command goes in as positional parameters ("$@"), so it needs no quoting.
static QStringList BashCommand(const QString& interpreter, const QStringList& args,
                               bool close_on_clean_exit) {
	const QString run = close_on_clean_exit ? "\"$@\" && exit" : "\"$@\"";
	return QStringList {"bash", "-c", run + "; echo Press any key...; read -n1", "kyty",
	                    interpreter} +
	       args;
}

// Find a terminal and its command separator.
static bool FindTerminal(QString* program, QStringList* prefix) {
	struct TerminalSpec {
		const char* executable;
		const char* separator; // nullptr when the command follows immediately
	};

	static const TerminalSpec candidates[] = {
	    {"x-terminal-emulator", "-e"},
	    {"gnome-terminal", "--"},
	    {"konsole", "-e"},
	    {"xfce4-terminal", "-x"},
	    {"mate-terminal", "--"},
	    {"tilix", "-e"},
	    {"alacritty", "-e"},
	    {"kitty", nullptr},
	    {"foot", nullptr},
	    {"wezterm", "-e"},
	    {"urxvt", "-e"},
	    {"xterm", "-e"},
	};

	const auto try_candidate = [program, prefix](const QString& executable, const char* separator) {
		const auto resolved = QStandardPaths::findExecutable(executable);
		if (resolved.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		*program = resolved;
		prefix->clear();
		if (separator != nullptr) {
			*prefix << QString::fromLatin1(separator);
		}
		return true;
	};

	if (const auto from_env = qEnvironmentVariable("TERMINAL"); !from_env.isEmpty()) {
		// Reuse the known separator for an explicit terminal.
		const auto  env_name  = QFileInfo(from_env).fileName();
		const char* separator = "-e";
		for (const auto& candidate: candidates) {
			if (env_name == QLatin1String(candidate.executable)) {
				separator = candidate.separator;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (try_candidate(from_env, separator)) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	for (const auto& candidate: candidates) {
		if (try_candidate(QString::fromLatin1(candidate.executable), candidate.separator)) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}
#endif

#if defined(_WIN32)
// cmd /K arguments that keep the console open (with close_on_clean_exit, only after an error).
// A quote is written as "" rather than \" so cmd's quote count stays even and operators inside
// arguments stay quoted.
static QString CmdCommand(const QString& interpreter, const QStringList& args,
                          bool close_on_clean_exit) {
	static const QRegularExpression quote_or_end(QStringLiteral(R"((\\*)("|\z))"));
	// The UCRT reads 2n backslashes before a quote as n.
	auto quoted = QStringList {interpreter} + args;
	quoted.replaceInStrings(quote_or_end, QStringLiteral(R"(\1\1\2\2)"));
	return QStringLiteral("/K \"\"") + quoted.join(QStringLiteral("\" \"")) +
	       (close_on_clean_exit ? "\" && exit\"" : "\"\"");
}
#endif

void MainDialog::RunInterpreter(QProcess* process, const Configuration& info, bool close_terminal) {
	const auto& interpreter = m_p->GetInterpreter();

	auto args = CreateEmulatorArgs(info);
	if (args.isEmpty()) {
		QMessageBox::critical(this, tr("Error"), tr("Invalid emulator configuration"));
		QApplication::quit();
		return;
	}

	// Without a terminal, the emulator runs directly.
	process->setProgram(interpreter);
	process->setArguments(args);
#ifdef __linux__
	QString     terminal;
	QStringList terminal_prefix;
	if (FindTerminal(&terminal, &terminal_prefix)) {
		process->setProgram(terminal);
		process->setArguments(terminal_prefix + BashCommand(interpreter, args, close_terminal));
	}
#elif defined(_WIN32)
	// Use nativeArguments so Qt does not re-quote the /K command string.
	process->setProgram(CMD_EXE);
	process->setArguments({});
	process->setNativeArguments(
	    CmdCommand(QDir::toNativeSeparators(interpreter), args, close_terminal));
#endif
	process->setWorkingDirectory(QFileInfo(interpreter).absolutePath());
#if defined(_WIN32)
	process->setCreateProcessArgumentsModifier([](QProcess::CreateProcessArguments* args) {
		args->flags |= static_cast<uint32_t>(CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE);
		args->startupInfo->dwFlags &= ~static_cast<DWORD>(STARTF_USESTDHANDLES);
		args->startupInfo->dwFlags |= static_cast<DWORD>(STARTF_USECOUNTCHARS);
		args->startupInfo->dwXCountChars = CMD_X_CHARS;
		args->startupInfo->dwYCountChars = CMD_Y_CHARS;
		// args->startupInfo->dwFlags |= static_cast<DWORD>(STARTF_USEFILLATTRIBUTE);
		// args->startupInfo->dwFillAttribute =
		//     static_cast<DWORD>(BACKGROUND_BLUE) | static_cast<DWORD>(FOREGROUND_RED) |
		//     static_cast<DWORD>(FOREGROUND_INTENSITY);
	});
#endif
	process->start();
#if !defined(_WIN32)
	// Report immediate launch failures.
	if (!process->waitForStarted(5000)) {
		QMessageBox::critical(
		    this, tr("Error"),
		    tr("Failed to start:\n%1\n\n%2").arg(process->program(), process->errorString()));
		return;
	}
#endif
	process->waitForFinished(100);
}

	MainDialogPrivate::WriteSettings(s);

void MainDialog::ReadSettings(QSettings& s) {
	MainDialogPrivate::ReadSettings(s);

void MainDialogPrivate::WriteSettings(QSettings& s) {
	s.beginGroup(SETTINGS_MAIN_DIALOG);

	if (!g_last_geometry.isEmpty()) {
		s.setValue(SETTINGS_MAIN_LAST_GEOMETRY, g_last_geometry);
	}
	s.setValue(SETTINGS_CHECK_UPDATES, g_check_updates_on_startup);
	s.setValue(SETTINGS_CLOSE_TERMINAL, g_close_terminal);
	s.setValue(SETTINGS_THEME, g_theme);

	s.endGroup();
	PipelineSharing::WriteSettings(s);
}

void MainDialogPrivate::ReadSettings(QSettings& s) {
	s.beginGroup(SETTINGS_MAIN_DIALOG);

	g_last_geometry = s.value(SETTINGS_MAIN_LAST_GEOMETRY, g_last_geometry).toByteArray();
	g_check_updates_on_startup = s.value(SETTINGS_CHECK_UPDATES, true).toBool();
	g_close_terminal           = s.value(SETTINGS_CLOSE_TERMINAL, false).toBool();
	g_theme                    = s.value(SETTINGS_THEME, 0).toInt();
	if (g_theme < 0 || g_theme > 2) {
		g_theme = 0;
	}

	s.endGroup();
	PipelineSharing::ReadSettings(s);
}

// This fork tests every game with these settings. They came from the title:
// without red zone protection its streaming thread crashes, without linear image readback cars
// deform wildly in collisions, without tiled image readback boats and jet skis do not ride the
// waves, and without tessellation the trunks of nearby trees are not drawn. Native ray tracing
// is experimental and is turned off by the emulator on GPUs without ray queries. Without the
// PS5 TSC rate Red Dead Redemption (PPSA30528) and Demon's Souls (PPSA01341) run too fast;
// configurations saved before it became the default keep it off. PS5 Pro mode stays off: Days
// Gone (PPSA28180) and Marvel's Wolverine crash with it. The vblank runs at the console's 60 Hz:
// faster vblanks only help development measurements, and some games pace or time themselves by
// them. Offers to launch with these settings when the configuration differs in any of them.
// Returns false to cancel the launch.
static bool ApplyRecommendedSettings(QWidget* parent, Configuration* info) {
	QStringList missing;
#if defined(_WIN32)
	if (!info->red_zone_protection_enabled) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Windows SysV red zone crash protection (streaming crashes)");
	}
#endif
	if (!info->readback_linear_images) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Read back linear images (vehicle damage)");
	}
	if (!info->readback_tiled_images) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Read back small tiled images (water level for boats and jet skis)");
	}
	if (!info->tessellation_enabled) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Tessellation support (trunks of nearby trees)");
	}
	if (!info->shader_cache_enabled) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Cache shaders (shader and pipeline compilation stutter)");
	}
	if (!info->native_ray_tracing_enabled) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Native ray tracing (experimental; faster ray traced shadows and "
		                       "reflections)");
	}
	if (!info->guest_tsc_enabled) {
		missing << QObject::tr("PS5 TSC rate (games that run too fast, such as Red Dead "
		                       "Redemption)");
	}
	if (info->pro_enabled) {
		missing << QObject::tr("PS5 Pro mode turned off (Days Gone and Marvel's Wolverine crash "
		                       "with it)");
	}
	if (info->vblank_frequency != 60) {
		missing << QObject::tr("Vblank frequency of 60 Hz (now %1 Hz; other values are only advisable "
		                       "during development, as some games may not work correctly)")
		               .arg(info->vblank_frequency);
	}
	if (missing.isEmpty()) {
		return true;
	}
	QMessageBox box(QMessageBox::Warning, QObject::tr("Recommended settings"),
	                QObject::tr("This fork tests every game with these settings, which this "
	                            "configuration does not use:\n\n- %1\n\nLaunch with them?")
	                    .arg(missing.join(QStringLiteral("\n- "))),
	                QMessageBox::NoButton, parent);
	auto* recommended = box.addButton(QObject::tr("Launch with recommended settings"),
	                                  QMessageBox::AcceptRole);
	auto* as_is = box.addButton(QObject::tr("Launch as configured"), QMessageBox::DestructiveRole);
	box.addButton(QMessageBox::Cancel);
	box.setDefaultButton(recommended);
	box.exec();
	if (box.clickedButton() == recommended) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
		info->red_zone_protection_enabled = true;
#endif
		info->readback_linear_images = true;
		info->readback_tiled_images  = true;
		info->tessellation_enabled       = true;
		info->shader_cache_enabled       = true;
		info->native_ray_tracing_enabled = true;
		info->guest_tsc_enabled          = true;
		info->pro_enabled                = false;
		info->vblank_frequency           = 60;
		return true;
	}
	return box.clickedButton() == as_is;
}

void MainDialogPrivate::Run() {
	if (m_update_checker->IsInstalling()) {
		return;
	}
	QPointer<ConfigurationItem> item = m_ui->widget->GetSelectedItem();
	if (item == nullptr) {
		return;
	}

	auto info = m_ui->widget->CreateConfiguration(*item);
	if (!ApplyRecommendedSettings(m_main_dialog, info.get())) {
		return;
	}

	// The first launch asks whether to share pipeline data. Sharing needs the emulator to record
	// its manifest.
	const bool share = PipelineSharing::EnsureConsent(m_main_dialog);
	{
		const QSignalBlocker blocker(m_ui->share_pipelines);
		m_ui->share_pipelines->setChecked(share);
	}
	m_ui->widget->WriteSettings();
	if (share) {
		info->pipeline_manifest_record = true;
	}

	item->SetRunning(true);
	m_running_games++;
	m_controller_preview.SetSuspended(true);
	m_title_sound.SetTitle({});

	auto* process = new QProcess(this);
	connect(process, &QProcess::stateChanged, this,
	        [this, process, item](QProcess::ProcessState state) {
		        if (state == QProcess::NotRunning) {
			        if (item != nullptr) {
				        item->SetRunning(false);
			        }
			        m_running_games--;
			        process->deleteLater();
			        Update();
		        }
	        });
	m_main_dialog->RunInterpreter(process, *info, g_close_terminal);
	if (share && !info->title_id.isEmpty()) {
		new PipelineShareSession(process, info->title_id, QFileInfo(m_interpreter).absolutePath(),
		                         m_emulator_version, this);
	}

	Update();
}

void MainDialogPrivate::Update() {
	const auto* item = m_ui->widget->GetSelectedItem();

	bool run_enabled = item != nullptr && !item->IsRunning() && !m_update_checker->IsInstalling();

	if (run_enabled) {
		const auto& info = item->GetInfo();
		auto        dir  = info.basedir;
		run_enabled      = !dir.isEmpty() && (QDir(dir).exists() || GameContent::IsArchive(dir));
	}

	m_ui->widget->SetRunEnabled(run_enabled);
	m_update_checker->SetGameRunning(m_running_games > 0);
	if (m_running_games > 0) {
		m_controller_preview.SetSuspended(true);
		return;
	}
	m_controller_preview.SetSuspended(false);
	m_controller_preview.SetColor(m_ui->widget->GetGlobalControllerColor());
}
```

```cpp
#include "mandatoryLineEdit.h"

#include <QColor>
#include <QLine>
#include <QPainter>
#include <QPen>
#include <QVariant>
#include <QtCore>

class QPaintEvent;
class QWidget;

MandatoryLineEdit::MandatoryLineEdit(QWidget* parent): QLineEdit(parent) {
	this->setProperty(MANDATORY_AND_EMPTY, true);

	connect(this, &QLineEdit::textChanged, this, &MandatoryLineEdit::changed);
}

void MandatoryLineEdit::paintEvent(QPaintEvent* event) {
	QLineEdit::paintEvent(event);

	if (this->property(MANDATORY_AND_EMPTY).toBool() && this->isEnabled()) {
		QPainter painter(this);
		QLine    line(4, this->height() - 4, this->width() - 4, this->height() - 4);
		painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 0, 0), 1.0, Qt::DotLine));
		painter.drawLine(line);
	}
}

bool MandatoryLineEdit::FindEmpty(QObject* p) {
	const QList<QLineEdit*>& ch_list = p->findChildren<QLineEdit*>();

	foreach (QLineEdit* ch, ch_list) {
		if (ch->isVisible() && ch->property(MANDATORY_AND_EMPTY).toBool() && ch->isEnabled()) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

void MandatoryLineEdit::changed(const QString& text) {
	this->setProperty(MANDATORY_AND_EMPTY, text.isEmpty());
}
```

```cpp
void ShowMods(QListWidget* list, const QJsonDocument& document, bool checkable) {
	list->clear();
	for (const auto& value: document.object().value(QStringLiteral("mods")).toArray()) {
		const auto mod  = value.toObject();
		auto*      item = new QListWidgetItem(mod.value(QStringLiteral("name")).toString(), list);
		if (checkable) {
			item->setFlags(item->flags() | Qt::ItemIsUserCheckable);
			item->setCheckState(mod.value(QStringLiteral("enabled")).toBool(true) ? Qt::Checked
			                                                                      : Qt::Unchecked);
		}
	}
}

	auto* enable_all  = selection->addButton(tr("Enable all"), QDialogButtonBox::ActionRole);

		}

	connect(m_files, &QTreeWidget::currentItemChanged, this, &PatchesDialog::PreviewRemote);

	m_repository = new Cheats::CheatRepository(this);
	connect(
	    m_repository, &Cheats::CheatRepository::CatalogLoaded, this,
	    [this](QList<Cheats::RemoteFile> files, const QString& error) {
		    std::stable_sort(files.begin(), files.end(), [this](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
			    return (a.version == m_version) > (b.version == m_version);
		    });

		    for (qsizetype index = 0; index < m_remote_files.size(); ++index) {
			    const auto& file = m_remote_files[index];
			    auto*       item = new QTreeWidgetItem(
			        m_files, {file.version == m_version ? tr("%1 (installed)").arg(file.version)
			                                            : file.version,
			                  file.format.toUpper(), file.name});
			    item->setData(0, Qt::UserRole, index);
			    for (int column = 0; column < 3; ++column) {
				    item->setToolTip(column, file.title);
			    }
		    }
		    auto status =
		        m_remote_files.isEmpty() && error.isEmpty()
		            ? tr("No remote cheats found for %1.").arg(m_title_id)
		            : tr("%1 remote file(s) for %2.").arg(m_remote_files.size()).arg(m_title_id);
		    if (!error.isEmpty()) {

			                 .arg(status, error);
		    }
		    m_remote_status->setText(status);
		    m_refresh->setEnabled(true);
	    });
	connect(
	    m_repository, &Cheats::CheatRepository::FileLoaded, this,
	    [this](const QByteArray& data, QString error) {
		    if (error.isEmpty()) {
			    error = Cheats::ParseDocument(data, &m_remote_document);
		    }
		    if (!error.isEmpty()) {
			    m_preview_status->setText(
			        tr("Could not preview this file: %1\nSelect another file or refresh to retry.")
			            .arg(error));
			    return;
		    }
		    ShowMods(m_preview, m_remote_document, false);
		    error = Cheats::ValidateImport(m_remote_document, m_title_id, m_version, m_process);
		    const auto  root = m_remote_document.object();
		    QStringList creators;
		    for (const auto& value: root.value(QStringLiteral("credits")).toArray()) {
			    if (value.isString()) {
				    creators.append(value.toString());
			    }
		    }
		    const auto metadata =
		        tr("%1\nCredits: %2 · Version: %3")
		            .arg(root.value(QStringLiteral("name")).toString(),
		                 creators.isEmpty() ? root.value(QStringLiteral("author")).toString()

		                 root.value(QStringLiteral("version")).toString());
		    m_preview_status->setText(
		        metadata + QStringLiteral("\n\n") +
		        (error.isEmpty() ? tr("Import to Local, then select the cheats to enable. Changes "
		                              "take effect on the next game launch.")
		                         : error));
		    m_import->setEnabled(error.isEmpty());
	    });
	Load();
	LoadRemote();
}

void PatchesDialog::Load() {
	m_patches->clear();
	m_local_data.clear();
	m_local_document = {};
	m_local_readable = false;
	m_apply->setEnabled(false);
	const auto path = Cheats::PlanPath(m_title_id);
	if (path.isEmpty()) {
		m_status->setText(tr("Unsupported title ID."));
		return;
	}
	QFile file(path);
	if (!file.exists()) {
		m_local_readable = true;
		m_status->setText(tr("No local cheat file: %1").arg(path));
		return;
	}
	if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly)) {
		m_status->setText(tr("Could not read cheat file: %1").arg(file.errorString()));
		return;
	}
	m_local_data = file.readAll();
	if (file.error() != QFile::NoError) {
		m_status->setText(tr("Could not read cheat file: %1").arg(file.errorString()));
		return;
	}
	m_local_readable = true;
	const auto error = Cheats::ParseDocument(m_local_data, &m_local_document);
	if (!error.isEmpty()) {
		m_status->setText(tr("%1\n%2").arg(error, path));
		return;
	}
	ShowMods(m_patches, m_local_document, true);
	m_apply->setEnabled(m_patches->count() > 0);
	m_status->setText(tr("Loaded %1 cheat(s) from %2.").arg(m_patches->count()).arg(path));
}

void PatchesDialog::Save() {
	QList<bool> enabled;
	for (int index = 0; index < m_patches->count(); ++index) {
		enabled.append(m_patches->item(index)->checkState() == Qt::Checked);
	}
	const auto document = Cheats::WithSelection(m_local_document, enabled);
	const auto error = Cheats::SaveDocument(Cheats::PlanPath(m_title_id), document, m_local_data);
	if (!error.isEmpty()) {
		m_status->setText(error);
		return;
	}
	m_local_document = document;
	m_local_data     = document.toJson();
	m_status->setText(tr("Cheat selection saved. Changes take effect on the next game launch."));
}

void PatchesDialog::LoadRemote() {
	m_repository->CancelFetch();
	m_files->clear();
	m_remote_files.clear();
	m_preview->clear();
	m_remote_document = {};
	m_import->setEnabled(false);
	m_refresh->setEnabled(false);
	m_preview_status->clear();
	m_remote_status->setText(tr("Loading remote cheats…"));
	m_repository->Load(m_title_id);
}

void PatchesDialog::PreviewRemote() {
	m_repository->CancelFetch();
	m_preview->clear();
	m_remote_document = {};
	m_import->setEnabled(false);
	m_preview_status->clear();
	const auto* item = m_files->currentItem();
	if (item == nullptr) {
		return;
	}
	const auto index = item->data(0, Qt::UserRole).toInt();
	if (index < 0 || index >= m_remote_files.size()) {
		return;
	}
	m_preview_status->setText(tr("Loading cheat preview…"));
	m_repository->Fetch(m_remote_files[index]);
}

void PatchesDialog::ImportRemote() {
	const auto error = Cheats::ValidateImport(m_remote_document, m_title_id, m_version, m_process);
	if (!error.isEmpty()) {
		m_preview_status->setText(error);
		return;
	}
	if (!m_local_readable) {
		m_preview_status->setText(
		    tr("Could not read the local cheat file. Open Local and reload it before importing."));
		return;
	}
	const auto path = Cheats::PlanPath(m_title_id);
	if (QFile::exists(path) &&
	    QMessageBox::question(this, tr("Replace local cheats?"),
	                          tr("Replace the local cheat file and selections for %1? Imported "
	                             "cheats will start unchecked.")
	                              .arg(m_title_id),
	                          QMessageBox::Yes | QMessageBox::No,
	                          QMessageBox::No) != QMessageBox::Yes) {
		return;
	}
	const auto mods     = m_remote_document.object().value(QStringLiteral("mods")).toArray();
	const auto document = Cheats::WithSelection(m_remote_document, QList<bool>(mods.size(), false));
	const auto save_error = Cheats::SaveDocument(path, document, m_local_data);
	if (!save_error.isEmpty()) {
		m_preview_status->setText(save_error);
		return;
	}
	Load();
	m_status->setText(
	    tr("Imported %1 cheat(s). Select cheats and apply your selection for the next game launch.")
	        .arg(mods.size()));
	m_tabs->setCurrentIndex(1);
}
```

`src/launcher/src/pipelineShareSync.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "pipelineShareSync.h"

#include <QByteArrayView>
#include <QCryptographicHash>
#include <QDir>
#include <QFile>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QFutureWatcher>
#include <QJsonArray>
#include <QJsonDocument>
#include <QJsonObject>
#include <QJsonValue>
#include <QNetworkAccessManager>
#include <QNetworkReply>
#include <QNetworkRequest>
#include <QSaveFile>
#include <QSet>
#include <QtConcurrent>

#include <algorithm>

namespace {

constexpr char       FORMAT_PREFIX[]  = "# kyty pipeline manifest v";
constexpr qsizetype  MAX_RECORD_BYTES = 8192;
constexpr qsizetype  MAX_REQUEST_RECORDS = 5000;
constexpr qsizetype  MAX_REQUEST_BYTES   = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr qint64     MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES  = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr qint64     MAX_FILE_BYTES      = 512ll * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr int        MAX_REQUESTS_PER_ROUND = 64;
constexpr int        REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS  = 30000;
constexpr int        PROTOCOL            = 2;
// Hashes of the records the client has that one request carries (the server takes up to
// 200000 per partition and the body is limited to 4 MiB).
constexpr qsizetype  MAX_HAVE            = 150000;

QString LogPrefix() {
	return QStringLiteral("Pipeline sharing: ");
}

// A record the manifest reader would take: one line of printable ASCII that starts with the
// letter of a record type.
bool ValidRecord(const QByteArray& line) {
	if (line.size() < 3 || line.size() > MAX_RECORD_BYTES || line[1] != ' ' ||
	    (line[0] != 'M' && line[0] != 'P' && line[0] != 'T')) {
		return false;
	}
	return std::none_of(line.begin(), line.end(),
	                    [](char c) { return static_cast<unsigned char>(c) < 0x20 || static_cast<unsigned char>(c) > 0x7e; });
}

QByteArray RecordHash(const QByteArray& line) {
	return QCryptographicHash::hash(line, QCryptographicHash::Sha256).left(8).toHex();
}

// The complete lines of a manifest file: the first line (the format) in `header` and the records
// in file order. A last line without its newline is still being written and is left out.
QList<QByteArray> ReadLines(const QString& path, QByteArray* header = nullptr) {
	QList<QByteArray> records;
	QFile             file(path);
	if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly) || file.size() > MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
		return records;
	}
	const QByteArray data = file.readAll();
	qsizetype        start = 0;
	bool             first = true;
	while (start < data.size()) {
		const auto end = data.indexOf('\n', start);
		if (end < 0) {
			break;
		}
		auto line = data.mid(start, end - start);
		start     = end + 1;
		if (line.endsWith('\r')) {
			line.chop(1);
		}
		if (line.isEmpty()) {
			continue;
		}
		if (first && header != nullptr) {
			*header = line;
		}
		first = false;
		if (line[0] != '#') {
			records.append(line);
		}
	}
	return records;
}

struct State {
	quint64          cursor = 0;
	QSet<QByteArray> uploaded;
	// SHA-256 of the assets/pipelines file the cursor refers to ("" when there was none). A
	// state without it is from a client that did not reconcile.
	bool             has_assets = false;
	QString          assets;
};

// SHA-256 of a manifest file, to notice that the emulator was updated (another release brings
// other manifests); "" when the file does not exist.
QString FileDigest(const QString& path) {
	QFile file(path);
	if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly) || file.size() > MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
		return {};
	}
	QCryptographicHash hash(QCryptographicHash::Sha256);
	hash.addData(&file);
	return QString::fromLatin1(hash.result().toHex());
}

State LoadState(const QString& path) {
	State state;
	QFile file(path);
	if (!file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly)) {
		return state;
	}
	const auto document = QJsonDocument::fromJson(file.readAll());
	if (!document.isObject()) {
		return state;
	}
	const auto object = document.object();
	state.cursor      = object.value(QStringLiteral("cursor")).toString().toULongLong();
	state.has_assets  = object.contains(QStringLiteral("assets"));
	state.assets      = object.value(QStringLiteral("assets")).toString();
	for (const auto& value: object.value(QStringLiteral("uploaded")).toArray()) {
		state.uploaded.insert(value.toString().toLatin1());
	}
	return state;
}

bool SaveState(const QString& path, const State& state) {
	QJsonArray uploaded;
	for (const auto& hash: state.uploaded) {
		uploaded.append(QString::fromLatin1(hash));
	}
	QJsonObject object;
	object.insert(QStringLiteral("cursor"), QString::number(state.cursor));
	if (state.has_assets) {
		object.insert(QStringLiteral("assets"), state.assets);
	}
	object.insert(QStringLiteral("uploaded"), uploaded);
	QDir().mkpath(QFileInfo(path).absolutePath());
	QSaveFile file(path);
	if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly)) {
		return false;
	}
	file.write(QJsonDocument(object).toJson(QJsonDocument::Compact));
	return file.commit();
}

} // namespace

PipelineShareSync::PipelineShareSync(Options options, QObject* parent)
    : QObject(parent), m_options(std::move(options)), m_network(new QNetworkAccessManager(this)) {}

PipelineShareSync::~PipelineShareSync() = default;

PipelineShareSync::Prepared PipelineShareSync::Prepare(const Options& options) {
	Prepared    prepared;
	const QDir  cache(QDir(options.emulator_dir).filePath(QStringLiteral("_PipelineCache")));
	const auto  prefix = options.title_id + QLatin1Char('_');
	// The recording of the newest version: <title>_<version>.kpm, not the shared manifest.
	QFileInfo recorded;
	for (const auto& entry: cache.entryInfoList({prefix + QStringLiteral("*.kpm")}, QDir::Files)) {
		if (entry.fileName().endsWith(QStringLiteral(".shared.kpm"))) {
			continue;
		}
		if (!recorded.exists() || entry.lastModified() > recorded.lastModified()) {
			recorded = entry;
		}
	}
	if (!recorded.exists()) {
		prepared.nothing_recorded = true;
		return prepared;
	}
	const auto name = recorded.fileName();
	prepared.version = name.mid(prefix.size(), name.size() - prefix.size() - 4);
	if (prepared.version.isEmpty()) {
		prepared.nothing_recorded = true;
		return prepared;
	}
	const auto stem = name.left(name.size() - 4);
	prepared.shared_path = cache.filePath(stem + QStringLiteral(".shared.kpm"));
	prepared.assets_path =
	    QDir(options.emulator_dir).filePath(QStringLiteral("assets/pipelines/") + name);
	prepared.state_path = cache.filePath(QStringLiteral("share/") + stem + QStringLiteral(".json"));

	QByteArray header;
	const auto lines = ReadLines(recorded.filePath(), &header);
	if (!header.startsWith(FORMAT_PREFIX)) {
		prepared.error = QStringLiteral("%1 is not a pipeline manifest").arg(name);
		return prepared;
	}
	prepared.format = QString::fromLatin1(header);

	QSet<QByteArray> known;
	for (const auto& line: ReadLines(prepared.assets_path)) {
		known.insert(line);
	}
	for (const auto& line: ReadLines(prepared.shared_path)) {
		known.insert(line);
	}
	const auto state = LoadState(prepared.state_path);
	// With other manifests than the ones the cursor was taken with (a new installation, an
	// update of the emulator, a client that never did this), start over and tell the server what
	// we have, so that it only sends the rest.
	prepared.assets_digest = FileDigest(prepared.assets_path);
	prepared.reconcile     = state.cursor == 0 || !state.has_assets || state.assets != prepared.assets_digest;
	prepared.cursor        = prepared.reconcile ? 0 : state.cursor;
	if (prepared.reconcile) {
		for (const auto& line: known) {
			if (prepared.have.size() >= MAX_HAVE) {
				break;
			}
			prepared.have.append(RecordHash(line));
		}
	}
	for (const auto& line: lines) {
		if (known.contains(line) || !ValidRecord(line)) {
			continue;
		}
		const auto hash = RecordHash(line);
		if (!state.uploaded.contains(hash)) {
			prepared.records.append(line);
			prepared.hashes.append(hash);
		}
	}
	return prepared;
}

PipelineShareSync::Applied PipelineShareSync::Apply(const Prepared&         prepared,
                                                    const QList<QByteArray>& received,
                                                    const QList<QByteArray>& uploaded,
                                                    quint64                  cursor,
                                                    bool                     reconciled) {
	Applied applied;
	// The shared manifest keeps the format of the recording; one of another format is left alone.
	QByteArray header;
	auto       known_lines = ReadLines(prepared.shared_path, &header);
	const bool exists      = QFileInfo::exists(prepared.shared_path);
	if (exists && !header.isEmpty() && header != prepared.format.toLatin1()) {
		applied.error = QStringLiteral("the shared manifest has another format");
		return applied;
	}
	QSet<QByteArray> known(known_lines.begin(), known_lines.end());
	for (const auto& line: ReadLines(prepared.assets_path)) {
		known.insert(line);
	}
	QByteArray added;
	for (const auto& line: received) {
		if (ValidRecord(line) && !known.contains(line)) {
			known.insert(line);
			added += line;
			added += '\n';
			applied.stored++;
		}
	}
	if (!added.isEmpty()) {
		QDir().mkpath(QFileInfo(prepared.shared_path).absolutePath());
		QFile file(prepared.shared_path);
		if (!file.open(QIODevice::Append)) {
			applied.error = QStringLiteral("cannot write %1").arg(prepared.shared_path);
			return applied;
		}
		QByteArray out;
		if (file.size() == 0) {
			out = prepared.format.toLatin1() + '\n';
		} else {
			// A write that was cut short leaves a line without its end.
			QFile check(prepared.shared_path);
			if (check.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly) && check.seek(check.size() - 1) &&
			    check.read(1) != "\n") {
				out = "\n";
			}
		}
		out += added;
		if (file.write(out) != out.size()) {
			applied.error = QStringLiteral("cannot write %1").arg(prepared.shared_path);
			return applied;
		}
	}
	auto state   = LoadState(prepared.state_path);
	state.cursor = cursor;
	if (reconciled) {
		state.has_assets = true;
		state.assets     = prepared.assets_digest;
	}
	for (const auto& hash: uploaded) {
		state.uploaded.insert(hash);
	}
	if (!SaveState(prepared.state_path, state)) {
		applied.error = QStringLiteral("cannot write %1").arg(prepared.state_path);
	}
	return applied;
}

void PipelineShareSync::Start() {
	if (m_running) {
		return;
	}
	m_running  = true;
	m_requests = m_uploaded = m_received = 0;
	m_position                         = 0;
	m_more                             = false;
	auto* watcher = new QFutureWatcher<Prepared>(this);
	connect(watcher, &QFutureWatcher<Prepared>::finished, this, [this, watcher] {
		m_prepared = watcher->result();
		watcher->deleteLater();
		if (!m_prepared.error.isEmpty()) {
			Finish(false, m_prepared.error);
		} else if (m_prepared.nothing_recorded) {
			Finish(true, QStringLiteral("nothing recorded yet"));
		} else {
			m_cursor      = m_prepared.cursor;
			m_reconciling = m_prepared.reconcile;
			SendNext();
		}
	});
	watcher->setFuture(QtConcurrent::run(&PipelineShareSync::Prepare, m_options));
}

void PipelineShareSync::SendNext() {
	if (m_requests++ >= MAX_REQUESTS_PER_ROUND) {
		Finish(true, QStringLiteral("stopped after %1 requests").arg(MAX_REQUESTS_PER_ROUND));
		return;
	}
	// The records of this request: none while the server has more to send.
	QJsonArray records;
	qsizetype  bytes = 0;
	m_sent_count     = 0;
	while (!m_more && m_position + m_sent_count < m_prepared.records.size() &&
	       m_sent_count < MAX_REQUEST_RECORDS && bytes < MAX_REQUEST_BYTES) {
		const auto& record = m_prepared.records[m_position + m_sent_count];
		records.append(QString::fromLatin1(record));
		bytes += record.size();
		m_sent_count++;
	}
	QJsonObject body;
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("client"), m_options.client_id);
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("emulator"), m_options.emulator_version.left(64));
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("format"), m_prepared.format);
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("title"), m_options.title_id);
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("version"), m_prepared.version);
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("cursor"), static_cast<qint64>(m_cursor));
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("records"), records);
	body.insert(QStringLiteral("proto"), PROTOCOL);
	if (m_reconciling) {
		// The reply leaves out these; it is repeated in every page until `more` is false.
		QJsonArray have;
		for (const auto& hash: m_prepared.have) {
			have.append(QString::fromLatin1(hash));
		}
		body.insert(QStringLiteral("have"), have);
	}

	auto url = m_options.url;
	url.setPath(url.path() + QStringLiteral("/v1/sync"));
	QNetworkRequest request(url);
	request.setHeader(QNetworkRequest::ContentTypeHeader, QStringLiteral("application/json"));
	request.setRawHeader("User-Agent", m_options.user_agent.toUtf8());
	request.setRawHeader("Accept", "application/json");
	request.setTransferTimeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
	// A redirect would turn the POST into a GET: the address is the server's.
	request.setAttribute(QNetworkRequest::RedirectPolicyAttribute,
	                     QNetworkRequest::ManualRedirectPolicy);
	auto* reply = m_network->post(request, QJsonDocument(body).toJson(QJsonDocument::Compact));
	connect(reply, &QNetworkReply::finished, this, [this, reply] { OnReply(reply); });
}

void PipelineShareSync::OnReply(QNetworkReply* reply) {
	reply->deleteLater();
	const int status = reply->attribute(QNetworkRequest::HttpStatusCodeAttribute).toInt();
	if (reply->error() != QNetworkReply::NoError || status != 200) {
		Finish(false, QStringLiteral("the server answered %1 (%2)")
		                  .arg(status)
		                  .arg(reply->errorString()));
		return;
	}
	if (reply->bytesAvailable() > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
		Finish(false, QStringLiteral("the answer is too large"));
		return;
	}
	QJsonParseError error;
	const auto      document = QJsonDocument::fromJson(reply->readAll(), &error);
	if (error.error != QJsonParseError::NoError || !document.isObject()) {
		// A page of a proxy (a challenge, an error) instead of the server's answer.
		Finish(false, QStringLiteral("the answer is not JSON"));
		return;
	}
	const auto object = document.object();
	if (!object.value(QStringLiteral("cursor")).isDouble() ||
	    !object.value(QStringLiteral("records")).isArray()) {
		Finish(false, QStringLiteral("the answer is not a sync answer"));
		return;
	}
	const auto cursor = static_cast<quint64>(object.value(QStringLiteral("cursor")).toDouble());
	QList<QByteArray> received;
	for (const auto& value: object.value(QStringLiteral("records")).toArray()) {
		if (value.isString()) {
			received.append(value.toString().toLatin1());
		}
	}
	m_more = object.value(QStringLiteral("more")).toBool();
	QList<QByteArray> uploaded = m_prepared.hashes.mid(m_position, m_sent_count);
	m_position += m_sent_count;
	m_uploaded += static_cast<int>(m_sent_count);
	m_cursor = cursor;
	// The reconciliation ends with the last page; the new manifests are noted then.
	const bool reconciled = m_reconciling && !m_more;
	if (reconciled) {
		m_reconciling = false;
	}

	auto* watcher = new QFutureWatcher<Applied>(this);
	connect(watcher, &QFutureWatcher<Applied>::finished, this, [this, watcher] {
		const auto applied = watcher->result();
		watcher->deleteLater();
		m_received += applied.stored;
		if (!applied.error.isEmpty()) {
			Finish(false, applied.error);
		} else if (m_more || m_position < m_prepared.records.size()) {
			SendNext();
		} else {
			Finish(true, QStringLiteral("%1 records uploaded, %2 received")
			                 .arg(m_uploaded)
			                 .arg(m_received));
		}
	});
	watcher->setFuture(QtConcurrent::run(&PipelineShareSync::Apply, m_prepared, received, uploaded,
	                                     cursor, reconciled));
}

void PipelineShareSync::Finish(bool ok, const QString& message) {
	m_running  = false;
	m_prepared = {};
	emit Finished(ok, LogPrefix() + m_options.title_id + QStringLiteral(": ") + message);
}
```
