`tests/ShaderRayTracingGpuTests.inc`:

```inc
TestCase TrinityBvhIntersections(bool compressed, bool bary, bool sorted,
                                 bool wide_sort, u32 heuristic = 0, bool triangles_first = false,
                                 u32 wave_size = 32, bool edges = false) {
  TestCase test;
  test.name = compressed ? (sorted ? "TrinityCompressedSorted" : "TrinityCompressedUnsorted")
                         : (sorted ? "TrinityFp32Sorted" : "TrinityFp32Unsorted");
  if (!bary) test.name = "TrinityTriangleIds";
  if (heuristic == 1) test.name = "TrinityLargestInterval";
  if (heuristic == 2) test.name = "TrinityClosestMidpoint";
  if (triangles_first) test.name = "TrinityTrianglesFirst";
  if (wave_size == 64) test.name = "TrinityBvhWave64";
  if (edges) test.name = compressed ? "TrinityCompressedEdges" : "TrinityFp32Edges";
  constexpr u32 NodeStart = 4096, OutputStart = 2048, GuestBase = 0x10000;
  constexpr u32 Invalid = ~0u, Infinity = 0x7f800000, Flag = 0x8484, Shape = 0x12345678;
  const auto bits = [](float x) { return std::bit_cast<u32>(x); };
  test.initial.resize(NodeStart + 256 * 16);
  auto& data = test.initial;
  const std::array<float, 12> vertices {-1,-1,2, 1,-1,2, 0,1,2, 2,1,2};
  for (u32 i = 0; i < vertices.size(); ++i) data[NodeStart + i] = bits(vertices[i]);
  data[NodeStart + 14] = Shape;
  data[NodeStart + 15] = Flag;
  const std::array<float, 12> matrix {2,0,0,1, 0,3,0,-2, 0,0,4,3};
  for (u32 i = 0; i < matrix.size(); ++i) data[NodeStart + 16 + i] = bits(matrix[i]);
  data[NodeStart + 28] = 0x1000;
  data[NodeStart + 29] = 9u << 22; // Force opaque and flip facing.
  data[NodeStart + 30] = 0x98;
  data[NodeStart + 31] = 0x04123456;
  const std::array<float, 8> nearDist {5,1,3,7,4,2,6,8};
  const std::array<float, 8> length {1,8,3,5,7,2,4,6};
  const std::array<u32, 8> children {128,138,171,190,256,266,299,318};
  const auto set_bits = [&](u32 base, u32 offset, u32 count, u32 value) {
    for (u32 bit = 0; bit < count; ++bit)
      data[base + (offset + bit) / 32] |= ((value >> bit) & 1) << ((offset + bit) % 32);
  };
  for (u32 slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot) {
    const u32 base = NodeStart + (3 + slot * (compressed ? 1 : 2)) * 16;
    if (compressed) {
      set_bits(base, 0, 29, slot ? 32 : 16);
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) set_bits(base, 29 + i * 3, 3, children[slot * 4 + i] & 7);
      set_bits(base, 56, 8, 127); set_bits(base, 64, 8, 127); set_bits(base, 72, 8, 130);
    }
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
      const u32 index = slot * 4 + i;
      if (compressed) {
        // Exact integer minima; positive maxima round outward within one quantization step.
        const std::array<u32, 6> planes {0x30000, 0x30000, u32(nearDist[index]) * 8192,
            0x10000, 0x10000, u32(nearDist[index] + length[index]) * 8192};
        for (u32 axis = 0; axis < 6; ++axis) set_bits(base, 80 + i * 108 + axis * 18, 18, planes[axis]);
      } else {
        data[base + i] = children[index];
        const std::array<float, 6> bounds {-1,-1,nearDist[index], 1,1,nearDist[index] + length[index]};
        for (u32 axis = 0; axis < 6; ++axis) data[base + 4 + i * 6 + axis] = bits(bounds[axis]);
      }
    }
  }
  if (compressed) {
    std::copy_n(data.begin() + NodeStart + 3 * 16, 16, data.begin() + NodeStart + 10 * 16);
  } else {
    constexpr std::array<u32, 4> lo {0x4500, 0x3c00, 0x4200, 0x4700};
    constexpr std::array<u32, 4> hi {0x4600, 0x4880, 0x4600, 0x4a00};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
      data[NodeStart + 160 + i] = children[i];
      data[NodeStart + 164 + i * 3] = 0xbc00bc00;
      data[NodeStart + 165 + i * 3] = 0x3c000000 | lo[i];
      data[NodeStart + 166 + i * 3] = (hi[i] << 16) | 0x3c00;
    }
  }
  if (edges) {
    // Slot zero ends exactly at the descriptor limit; slot one lies beyond it.
    std::copy_n(data.begin() + NodeStart + 3 * 16, compressed ? 16 : 32,
                data.begin() + NodeStart + (compressed ? 253 : 252) * 16);
    for (u32 index : {12u, 13u})
      std::copy_n(data.begin() + NodeStart, 16, data.begin() + NodeStart + index * 16);
    data[NodeStart + 12 * 16 + 15] = 0xc4c4; // Opaque procedural pair.
    data[NodeStart + 13 * 16 + 15] = 0x9494; // Opaque, double-sided pair.
    if (compressed) {
      std::copy_n(data.begin() + NodeStart + 3 * 16, 16, data.begin() + NodeStart + 11 * 16);
      set_bits(NodeStart + 11 * 16, 41, 4, 1);
      set_bits(NodeStart + 11 * 16, 45, 4, 2);
      set_bits(NodeStart + 11 * 16, 49, 4, 3);
    }
  }
  std::vector<std::array<u32, 16>> expected(wave_size);
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < wave_size; ++lane) {
    const u32 which = lane % 16, input = lane * 16;
    auto& out = expected[lane];
    out.fill(Invalid);
    data[input + 2] = bits(20); data[input + 3] = 4; data[input + 9] = bits(1);
    const auto miss = [&](u32 slot, bool invalid = false) {
      out[slot * 4] = Infinity; out[slot * 4 + 1] = bits(1);
      out[slot * 4 + 2] = !invalid && bary ? 0 : Invalid; out[slot * 4 + 3] = 0;
    };
    const auto hit = [&](u32 slot, float u, float v) {
      out[slot * 4] = bits(-8); out[slot * 4 + 1] = bits(-4);
      out[slot * 4 + 2] = bary ? bits(u) : Flag + slot;
      out[slot * 4 + 3] = bary ? bits(v) : 1;
    };
    if (which <= 2 || which >= 9 && which <= 14) {
      data[input + 10] = which == 1 || which == 2 ? 1 : 0;
      miss(0); miss(1);
      out[8] = Shape;
      if (which == 1) {
        data[input + 4] = bits(1); hit(1, 2, 1); out[9] = Shape;
      } else {
        hit(0, 1, 1);
        if (which == 2) { miss(1); out[9] = Shape; }
      }
      if (which == 9 || which == 10 || which == 11) {
        if (which == 9) data[input + 4] = 0x7fc00000;
        if (which == 10) data[input + 10] = 0xfff8;
        if (which == 11) data[input + 1] = 0x41u << 22;
        miss(0, true); miss(1, true); out[8] = out[9] = Invalid;
      } else if (which == 12) {
        data[input + 1] = 0x100u << 22; miss(0);
      } else if (which == 13) {
        data[input + 1] = 8u << 22; out[0] = bits(8); out[1] = bits(4);
      } else if (which == 14) {
        data[input + 1] = 2u << 22;
        if (bary) { out[2] = bits(-1); out[3] = bits(-1); }
      }
    } else if (which >= 3 && which <= 5) {
      data[input + 10] = which == 3 ? (3 * 8 + (compressed ? 3 : 2))
                           : which == 4 ? (3 * 8 + (compressed ? 4 : 5)) : (10 * 8 + 4);
      std::array<u32, 8> order {0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7};
      const auto compare = [&](u32 x, u32 y) {
        const bool xt = (children[x] & 7) < 2, yt = (children[y] & 7) < 2;
        if (triangles_first && xt != yt) return xt;
        if (heuristic == 1) return length[x] > length[y];
        if (heuristic == 2) return 2 * nearDist[x] + length[x] < 2 * nearDist[y] + length[y];
        return nearDist[x] < nearDist[y];
      };
      if (sorted) {
        if (wide_sort && which == 3) std::stable_sort(order.begin(), order.end(), compare);
        else {
          std::stable_sort(order.begin(), order.begin() + 4, compare);
          std::stable_sort(order.begin() + 4, order.end(), compare);
        }
      }
      for (u32 i = 0; i < (which == 3 ? 8u : 4u); ++i) out[i] = children[order[i]];
    } else if (which == 6 || which == 7 || which == 15) {
      data[input + 10] = 14;
      if (which == 15) { data[input] = 8; data[input + 10] = 6; }
      data[input + 4] = bits(1); data[input + 5] = bits(2); data[input + 6] = bits(3);
      if (which == 7) data[input + 3] = 2;
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) out[i] = 0xabc00000 + i;
      out[2] = 0x1000; out[3] = 9u << 22; out[6] = 0x123456; out[7] = which == 7 ? Invalid : 0x98;
    } else data[input + 10] = 7;
    if (edges) {
      switch (which) {
        case 0:
        case 1:
        case 2:
        case 5:
          if (which == 0) data[input] = 1; // Misaligned encoded base must not read across a block.
          if (which == 1) data[input + 4] = Infinity;
          if (which == 2) data[input + 2] = 0x7fc00000;
          if (which == 5) { data[input + 1] = 0x2000; data[input + 10] = 0; }
          miss(0, true); miss(1, true); out[8] = out[9] = Invalid;
          break;
        case 3:
          data[input + 10] = compressed ? 253 * 8 + 3 : 252 * 8 + 2;
          for (u32 i = 4; i < 8; ++i) out[i] = Invalid;
          break;
        case 4:
          if (compressed) {
            data[input + 10] = 11 * 8 + 4; data[input + 1] = 0x40u << 22;
            out[0] = out[2] = Invalid;
          } else {
            data[input + 2] = bits(1);
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) out[i] = Invalid;
          }
          break;
        case 6:
          data[input + 1] = 8u << 22; out[3] = 1u << 22;
          break;
        case 7:
          data[input + 1] = 2u << 22; out[3] = 10u << 22;
          break;
        case 9:
        case 10:
          data[input + 10] = 12 * 8;
          data[input + 4] = bits(100);
          out[8] = Shape; miss(0); miss(1);
          if (which == 9) { out[0] = bits(0); out[1] = bits(1); out[2] = bits(-1); out[3] = bits(1); }
          else data[input + 1] = 0x200u << 22;
          break;
        case 11:
          data[input + 1] = 0x10u << 22; miss(0); miss(1); out[8] = Shape;
          break;
        case 12:
        case 13:
          data[input + 1] = (which == 12 ? 0x14u : 0x10u) << 22;
          if (which == 13) data[input + 10] = 13 * 8;
          hit(0, 1, 1);
          break;
        case 14:
          // The compressed +X bound rounds outward beyond exactly one.
          if (compressed) {
            data[input + 1] = 0; data[input + 4] = bits(1.0f + 0x1p-17f);
            data[input + 10] = 3 * 8 + 4;
            out.fill(Invalid);
            for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) out[i] = children[i];
          }
          break;
      }
    }
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) out[10 + i] = data[input + 4 + i];
    if (which == 6 || which == 7 || which == 15) {
      out[10] = bits(3); out[11] = bits(4); out[12] = bits(15); out[15] = bits(4);
    }
    if (lane % 32 >= 16) {
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) out[i] = 0xabc00000 + i;
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) out[10 + i] = data[input + 4 + i];
    }
  }
  test.expected = data;
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < wave_size; ++lane)
    std::copy(expected[lane].begin(), expected[lane].end(), test.expected.begin() + OutputStart + lane * 16);
  auto& code = test.code;
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 8, GuestBase >> 8);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 9, (sorted ? 1u << 31 : 0) | (triangles_first ? 1u << 20 : 0) | (heuristic << 21));
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 10, edges ? 253 : 255);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 11, 0x80c00000 | (bary ? 1u << 24 : 0) |
      (compressed ? 1u << 20 : 0) | (wide_sort ? 1u << 21 : 0));
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 1, InlineU32(6), 0));
  for (u32 offset : {0u,4u,8u})
    code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMubuf0(offset == 8 ? 0x0f : 0x0e, offset * 4), EncodeMubuf1(4 + offset, 0, 1)});
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) AppendVMovLiteral(&code, 32 + i, 0xabc00000 + i);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 126, 0x0000ffff);
  if (wave_size == 64) AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 127, 0x0000ffff);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMimg0(0xe5, 15, 2, false, 0, true), EncodeMimg1(32, 4, 2),
      0x08070605, 0x00000e0b});
  code.push_back(EncodeSop1(0x04, 126, 193));
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 2, InlineU32(4), 0));
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 32 + i, 2, OutputStart + i);
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 8 + i, 2, OutputStart + 10 + i);
  AppendEnd(&code);
  test.bda_mappings = {{GuestBase, NodeStart * sizeof(u32)}};
  test.compute_info.wave_size = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[0] = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[1] = test.compute_info.threads_num[2] = 1;
  test.compute_info.thread_ids_num = 1;
  test.has_compute_info = true;
  test.decoded_counts = {{"IMAGE_BVH8_INTERSECT_RAY", 1}};
  test.required_spirv = {"trinity_bvh_intersect"};
  return test;
}

TestCase TrinityBvhAliases() {
  auto test = TrinityBvhIntersections(false, true, false, false);
  test.name = "TrinityBvhRegisterAliases";
  constexpr u32 OutputStart = 2048;
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < 32; ++lane) {
    auto* out = test.expected.data() + OutputStart + lane * 16;
    const auto* input = test.initial.data() + lane * 16;
    const bool active = lane < 16, instance = active && (lane == 6 || lane == 7 || lane == 15);
    if (!active) {
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) out[4 + i] = input[i];
    } else if (instance) {
      out[4] = input[0]; out[5] = input[1];
      out[8] = out[10]; out[9] = out[11];
    } else {
      // A non-instance writes its shape IDs into registers formerly holding ray XY.
      out[10] = out[8]; out[11] = out[9];
    }
  }
  auto& code = test.code;
  code.clear();
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 8, 0x100);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 9, 0);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 10, 255);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 11, 0x81c00000);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 50, InlineU32(6), 0));
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 51, InlineU32(4), 0));
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) AppendVMovLiteral(&code, i, 0xabc00000 + i);
  for (u32 offset : {0u, 4u, 8u})
    code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMubuf0(offset == 8 ? 0x0f : 0x0e, offset * 4),
        EncodeMubuf1(4 + offset, 0, 50)});
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 126, 0x0000ffff);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMimg0(0xe5, 15, 2, false, 0, true), EncodeMimg1(0, 4, 2),
      0x08070605, 0x00000e0b});
  code.push_back(EncodeSop1(0x04, 126, 193));
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, i, 51, OutputStart + i);
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 8 + i, 51, OutputStart + 10 + i);
  AppendEnd(&code);
  return test;
}

std::vector<TestCase> TrinityBvhCases() {
  return {TrinityBvhIntersections(false, true, false, false),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(false, true, true, true),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(true, true, false, false),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(true, true, true, false),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(false, false, true, true),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(false, true, true, true, 1),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(false, true, true, true, 2),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(true, true, true, true, 0, true),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(true, true, true, true, 0, false, 64),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(false, true, false, false, 0, false, 32, true),
          TrinityBvhIntersections(true, true, false, false, 0, false, 32, true),
          TrinityBvhAliases()};
}

TestCase TrinityStack(u32 wave_size, u32 capacity, bool storage = false) {
  TestCase test;
  static constexpr const char* names[2][3] = {
      {"TrinityStack32Capacity8", "TrinityStack32Capacity16", "TrinityStack32Capacity31"},
      {"TrinityStack64Capacity8", "TrinityStack64Capacity16", "TrinityStack64Capacity31"}};
  test.name = storage ? (wave_size == 32 ? "TrinityStackStorage32" : "TrinityStackStorage64")
                      : names[wave_size == 64][capacity == 8 ? 0 : capacity == 16 ? 1 : 2];
  constexpr u32 Invalid = 0xffffffffu, Terminal = 0xfffffffeu;
  constexpr u32 Parent = 1u << 29, Overflow = 1u << 30, Return = 1u << 31;
  const auto state = [](u32 count, u32 parent, u32 ring, u32 flags = 0) {
    return count | (parent << 5) | (ring << 10) | flags;
  };
  test.initial.resize(wave_size * 32);
  struct Output { u32 control, node; std::array<u32, 8> lds; };
  std::vector<Output> outputs(wave_size);
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < wave_size; ++lane) {
    const u32 which = lane % 16;
    const u32 base = which == 15 ? 0x3fff : (lane / 32) * capacity * 32 + lane % 32;
    auto* input = test.initial.data() + lane * 32;
    auto& out = outputs[lane];
    input[0] = base << 15;
    input[1] = Invalid;
    std::fill(input + 2, input + 10, Invalid);
    input[10] = base * 4;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 8; ++i) out.lds[i] = 100 + i * 8;
    if (capacity == 8) out.lds[7] = 88;
    out.node = Terminal;
    out.control = 0;
    const auto children = [&] {
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 8; ++i) input[2 + i] = (i + 1) * 8;
    };
    switch (which) {
      case 0: break;
      case 1: input[0] |= Overflow; out.control = Overflow; out.node = Invalid; break;
      case 2:
        children(); out.control = state(7, 7, 7); out.node = 8;
        out.lds = {64, 56, 48, 40, 32, 24, 16, 8}; break;
      case 3:
        input[2] = 8; input[4] = 24; input[7] = 48; input[9] = 64;
        out.control = state(3, 3, 3); out.node = 8;
        out.lds[0] = 64; out.lds[1] = 48; out.lds[2] = 24; out.lds[3] = 8; break;
      case 4:
      case 14:
        input[0] |= state(capacity, capacity, 0, which == 14 ? Parent : 0);
        input[2] = 8; out.control = state(capacity - 1, capacity - 1, 0, Overflow);
        out.node = out.lds[0] = 8; break;
      case 5:
        input[0] |= state(1, 1, 0); out.control = state(0, 0, capacity - 1); out.node = 88; break;
      case 6:
        input[0] |= state(1, 0, 1, Parent);
        out.control = state(0, 31, 0, Return); out.node = 100; break;
      case 7:
        input[2] = 14; out.control = Parent; out.node = out.lds[0] = 14; break;
      case 8:
        input[0] |= state(3, 1, 3, Parent);
        out.lds[2] = 14;
        out.control = state(0, 0, 2, Parent | Overflow); out.node = 14; break;
      case 9:
        children(); input[1] = 24; out.control = state(4, 4, 4); out.node = 32;
        out.lds[0] = 64; out.lds[1] = 56; out.lds[2] = 48; out.lds[3] = 40; out.lds[4] = 32; break;
      case 10:
        children(); input[1] = 96; input[0] |= state(1, 1, 1);
        out.node = 100; break;
      case 11:
        children(); input[9] = 0xfffffffbu; out.control = state(3, 3, 3); out.node = 8;
        out.lds[0] = 32; out.lds[1] = 24; out.lds[2] = 16; out.lds[3] = 8; break;
      case 12: children(); input[9] = 0xfffffff9u; break;
      case 13:
        children(); input[5] = 0xfffffffdu; out.control = state(3, 3, 3); out.node = 40;
        out.lds[0] = 64; out.lds[1] = 56; out.lds[2] = 48; out.lds[3] = 40; break;
      case 15:
        input[0] |= state(1, 1, 1); out.node = 0; out.lds.fill(0); break;
    }
    out.control |= base << 15;
    if ((lane % 32) >= 16) {
      out.control = input[0]; out.node = input[2];
      for (u32 i = 0; i < 8; ++i) out.lds[i] = 100 + i * 8;
      if (capacity == 8) out.lds[7] = 88;
      if (which == 8) out.lds[2] = 14;
      if (which == 15) out.lds.fill(0);
    }
  }
  test.expected = test.initial;
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < wave_size; ++lane) {
    test.expected[lane * 32 + 20] = outputs[lane].control;
    test.expected[lane * 32 + 21] = outputs[lane].node;
    std::copy(outputs[lane].lds.begin(), outputs[lane].lds.end(), test.expected.begin() + lane * 32 + 24);
  }
  auto& code = test.code;
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 1, InlineU32(7), 0));
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMubuf0(0x0d), EncodeMubuf1(8, 0, 1),
                           EncodeMubuf0(0x0e, 8), EncodeMubuf1(16, 0, 1),
                           EncodeMubuf0(0x0e, 24), EncodeMubuf1(20, 0, 1),
                           EncodeMubuf0(0x0c, 40), EncodeMubuf1(2, 0, 1)});
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    AppendVMovU32(&code, 3, 100 + i * 8);
    code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeDs0(0x0d, i * 128), EncodeDs1(0, 3, 2)});
  }
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 3, 88);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeDs0(0x0d, (capacity - 1) * 128), EncodeDs1(0, 3, 2)});
  // Lane eight starts with a nested instance on top of its stack.
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 126, 0x01000100u);
  if (wave_size == 64) AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 127, 0x01000100u);
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 3, 14);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeDs0(0x0d, 256), EncodeDs1(0, 3, 2)});
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 126, 0x0000ffffu);
  if (wave_size == 64) AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 127, 0x0000ffffu);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeDs0(0xe1, capacity), EncodeDs1Ex(16, 16, 9, 8)});
  code.push_back(EncodeSop1(0x04, 126, 193));
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 3, InlineU32(5), 0));
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 8, 3, 20);
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 16, 3, 21);
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeDs0(0x36, i * 128), EncodeDs1(24, 0, 2)});
    AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 24, 3, 24 + i);
  }
  AppendEnd(&code);
  test.compute_info.wave_size = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[0] = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[1] = test.compute_info.threads_num[2] = 1;
  test.compute_info.thread_ids_num = 1;
  test.compute_info.lds_size_dwords = wave_size * capacity;
  test.compute_info.lds_storage = storage;
  test.has_compute_info = true;
  test.decoded_counts = {{"DS_BVH_STACK_PUSH8_POP1_RTN_B32", 1}};
  test.forbidden_spirv = {"OpControlBarrier", "OpMemoryBarrier", "get_bda_pointer"};
  return test;
}

TestCase FlatStackApertures(u32 wave_size) {
  TestCase test;
  test.name = wave_size == 32 ? "FlatStackApertures32" : "FlatStackApertures64";
  auto &code = test.code;
  code = {EncodeSop1(0x04, 8, 237), // private base
          EncodeSop1(0x0b, 11, InlineU32(1)), // S_BREV_B32 shared aperture, as in the title.
          EncodeVop2(0x1a, 20, InlineU32(2), 0),
          EncodeVop2(0x1b, 22, InlineU32(1), 0),
          EncodeVop2(0x1a, 22, InlineU32(31), 22)};
  AppendVop3(&code, 0x159, 21, 9, 11, Vgpr(22)); // Clamp the stack address to the local apertures.
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 30, 100);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x25, 30, Vgpr(0), 30));
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 1), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20)});
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 30, 200);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x25, 30, Vgpr(0), 30));
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeDs0(0x0d), EncodeDs1(0, 30, 20)});
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 30, 300);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x25, 30, Vgpr(0), 30));
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 0), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20)});
  // FLAT writes must alias both explicit memory instructions, per invocation.
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 1), EncodeFlat1(24, 0x7d, 0, 20),
                           EncodeDs0(0x36), EncodeDs1(25, 0, 20),
                           EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 0), EncodeFlat1(26, 0x7d, 0, 20)});
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 24, 0, 0);
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 25, 0, wave_size);
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 26, 0, 2 * wave_size);
  // Inactive lanes must preserve both stores and destination VGPRs.
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 126, 0x55555555);
  if (wave_size == 64) AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 127, 0x55555555);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x25, 22, InlineU32(1), 22));
  AppendVop3(&code, 0x159, 21, 9, 11, Vgpr(22));
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 30, 400);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x25, 30, Vgpr(0), 30));
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 0), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20)});
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 0), EncodeFlat1(26, 0x7d, 0, 20)});
  code.push_back(EncodeSop1(0x04, 126, 193)); // -1 sign-extends across EXEC
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 26, 0, 3 * wave_size);
  // Noncanonical addresses outside either aperture, aperture overflow, and
  // offsets outside allocated local storage must not wrap into valid storage.
  AppendVMovLiteral(&code, 21, 0x78000000);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 0), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20),
                           EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 0), EncodeFlat1(26, 0x7d, 0, 20)});
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 26, 0, 4 * wave_size);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop1(0x01, 21, 11));
  AppendVMovLiteral(&code, 20, 0xfffffffc);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 0, 4), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20),
                           EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 0, 4), EncodeFlat1(26, 0x7d, 0, 20)});
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 26, 0, 5 * wave_size);
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 20, wave_size * 4);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 0), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20),
                           EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 0), EncodeFlat1(26, 0x7d, 0, 20)});
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 26, 0, 6 * wave_size);
  AppendVMovU32(&code, 20, 1);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x1c, 0), EncodeFlat1(0, 0x7d, 30, 20),
                           EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 0), EncodeFlat1(26, 0x7d, 0, 20)});
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 26, 0, 9 * wave_size);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 20, InlineU32(2), 0));
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeFlat0(0x0c, 1), EncodeFlat1(24, 0x7d, 0, 20),
                           EncodeDs0(0x36), EncodeDs1(25, 0, 20)});
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 24, 0, 7 * wave_size);
  AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 25, 0, 8 * wave_size);
  AppendEnd(&code);
  test.expected.resize(10 * wave_size);
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < wave_size; ++lane) {
    const bool shared = lane & 1;
    test.expected[lane] = (shared ? 100 : 300) + lane;
    test.expected[wave_size + lane] = (shared ? 300 : 200) + lane;
    test.expected[2 * wave_size + lane] = 300 + lane;
    test.expected[3 * wave_size + lane] = (shared ? 300 : 400) + lane;
    test.expected[7 * wave_size + lane] = (shared ? 100 : 400) + lane;
    test.expected[8 * wave_size + lane] = (shared ? 300 : 200) + lane;
  }
  test.compute_info.wave_size = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[0] = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[1] = test.compute_info.threads_num[2] = 1;
  test.compute_info.thread_ids_num = 1;
  test.compute_info.scratch_size_dwords = wave_size;
  test.compute_info.lds_size_dwords = wave_size;
  test.has_compute_info = true;
  test.decoded_counts = {{"S_BREV_B32", 1}};
  test.ir_counts = {{" = BitReverse32 ", 0}};
  test.forbidden_spirv = {"get_bda_pointer"};
  return test;
}

TestCase BvhIntersections(bool barycentrics, bool sorted, u32 grow = 0, bool wide = false) {
  TestCase test;
  test.name = barycentrics ? (sorted ? "BvhBarycentricSorted" : "BvhBarycentricUnsorted")
                          : (sorted ? "BvhTriangleIdSorted" : "BvhTriangleIdUnsorted");
  if (grow != 0) test.name = "BvhBoxExitGrowth";
  if (wide) test.name = "Bvh64HighNodePointers";
  constexpr u32 NodeStart = 1024, OutputStart = 512, LaneCount = 32;
  constexpr uint64_t GuestBase = 0x10000;
  const u32 node_base = wide ? 1u << 29 : 0;
  const auto bits = [](float value) { return std::bit_cast<u32>(value); };
  constexpr u32 Infinity = 0x7f800000, Invalid = UINT32_MAX, Flag = 0x04040404;
  test.initial.resize(NodeStart + 258 * 16);
  auto &data = test.initial;
  // Pack five float3 vertices and the triangle flag into a 64-byte node.
  const std::array<float, 15> vertices{-1, -1, 2, 1, -1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 0, 3, 2};
  for (u32 i = 0; i < vertices.size(); ++i) data[NodeStart + i] = bits(vertices[i]);
  data[NodeStart + 15] = Flag;
  constexpr std::array<u32, 4> children{0x88, 0x90, 0x98, 0xa0};
  constexpr std::array<float, 4> z{5, 1, 3, 7};
  constexpr std::array<u32, 4> half_z{0x4500, 0x3c00, 0x4200, 0x4700};
  constexpr std::array<u32, 4> half_far{0x4600, 0x4000, 0x4400, 0x4800};
  for (u32 child = 0; child < 4; ++child) {
    data[NodeStart + 16 + child] = data[NodeStart + 32 + child] = children[child];
    const auto fp16 = NodeStart + 20 + child * 3;
    data[fp16] = 0xbc00bc00; // min.xy = -1,-1
    data[fp16 + 1] = 0x3c000000 | half_z[child];
    data[fp16 + 2] = (half_far[child] << 16) | 0x3c00;
    const auto fp32 = NodeStart + 36 + child * 6;
    const std::array<float, 6> bounds{-1, -1, z[child], 1, 1, z[child] + 1};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) data[fp32 + i] = bits(bounds[i]);
  }
  // A grazing ray enters one ULP after exiting on another axis.
  for (u32 child = 0; child < 4; ++child) {
    data[NodeStart + 64 + child] = children[child];
    const std::array<float, 6> bounds = child == 0
        ? std::array<float, 6>{0, 0, std::nextafter(1.0f, 2.0f), 1, 2, 2}
        : child == 1 ? std::array<float, 6>{-1, 1, -1, -0.0f, 2, 2}
                     : std::array<float, 6>{1, 1, 1, -1, -1, -1};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i) data[NodeStart + 68 + child * 6 + i] = bits(bounds[i]);
  }
  // An FP32 node straddles two guest pages with a 64-byte gap in physical backing.
  std::copy_n(data.begin() + NodeStart + 32, 16, data.begin() + NodeStart + 255 * 16);
  std::copy_n(data.begin() + NodeStart + 48, 16, data.begin() + NodeStart + 257 * 16);
  const std::array<std::array<float, 2>, 4> origins{{{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {.5f, 1.5f}, {-.25f, 1}}};
  std::array<std::array<u32, 4>, LaneCount> expected{};
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < LaneCount; ++lane) {
    const auto kind = lane % 8;
    const auto input = lane * 16;
    data[input] = kind < 4 ? kind : kind == 4 ? 12 : kind == 5 ? 21 : kind == 6 ? 6 : 0x1000;
    data[input + 1] = bits(6);
    data[input + 2] = bits(kind < 4 ? origins[kind][0] : 0);
    data[input + 3] = bits(kind < 4 ? origins[kind][1] : 0);
    data[input + 7] = bits(1);
    data[input + 8] = data[input + 9] = Infinity;
    data[input + 10] = bits(1);
    if (kind < 4) {
      const float denominator = kind == 3 ? -2 : -4;
      const float i = kind == 0 || kind == 3 ? -1 : -2;
      const float j = kind == 3 ? -.5f : -1;
      expected[lane] = {bits(2 * denominator), bits(denominator),
                        barycentrics ? bits(i) : Flag + kind,
                        barycentrics ? bits(j) : 1};
    } else if (kind < 6) {
      expected[lane] = sorted ? std::array<u32, 4>{children[1], children[2], children[0], Invalid}
                              : std::array<u32, 4>{children[0], children[1], children[2], Invalid};
    } else {
      expected[lane] = kind == 6 ? std::array<u32, 4>{Invalid, Invalid, Invalid, Invalid}
                                 : std::array<u32, 4>{Infinity, bits(1), Invalid, 0};
    }
    if (lane >= 8 && lane < 12) {
      data[input + 2] = 0x7fc00000; // invalid ray origin
      expected[lane] = {Infinity, bits(1), Invalid, 0};
    } else if (lane == 12 || lane == 13) {
      data[input + 1] = bits(1); // nearest face equals the exclusive extent
      expected[lane] = {Invalid, Invalid, Invalid, Invalid};
    } else if (lane >= 16 && lane < 20) {
      const u32 axis = lane & 1;
      data[input + 2 + axis] = bits(origins[kind][axis] - 4);
      data[input + 5 + axis] = bits(2);
      data[input + 8 + axis] = bits(.5f);
      // Dominant X/Y projection scales all intersection numerators and the
      // denominator by four; the distance and barycentrics remain unchanged.
      for (u32 i = 0; i < (barycentrics ? 4u : 2u); ++i)
        expected[lane][i] = bits(std::bit_cast<float>(expected[lane][i]) * 4);
    } else if (lane == 22) {
      data[input] = 37; // node 4, FP32
      data[input + 1] = bits(10);
      for (u32 i = 5; i <= 10; ++i) data[input + i] = bits(1);
      expected[lane] = {grow ? children[0] : Invalid, Invalid, Invalid, Invalid};
    } else if (lane >= 24 && lane < 28) {
      data[input + 4] = bits(4);
      data[input + 7] = data[input + 10] = bits(-1);
      for (u32 i = 0; i < (barycentrics ? 4u : 2u); ++i)
        expected[lane][i] = bits(-std::bit_cast<float>(expected[lane][i]));
    } else if (lane == 28) {
      data[input] = 0;
      data[input + 3] = bits(-1); // horizontal triangle edge: top-left rule rejects
      expected[lane] = {Infinity, bits(1), barycentrics ? bits(-2) : Flag,
                        barycentrics ? bits(-2) : 0};
    } else if (lane == 29) {
      data[input] = (255 << 3) | 5;
    }
    if (wide) {
      // Keep the same small backing while placing nodes beyond the 32-bit pointer range.
      std::copy_backward(data.begin() + input + 1, data.begin() + input + 11,
                         data.begin() + input + 12);
      data[input + 1] = 1;
      if (lane == 14 || lane == 15) {
        data[input] = lane == 14 ? 0 : 5;
        // Neither an oversized index nor a shifted-address wrap may read node zero.
        data[input + 1] = lane == 14 ? 0x00001000 : 0x20000000;
        expected[lane] = lane == 14 ? std::array<u32, 4>{Infinity, bits(1), Invalid, 0}
                                    : std::array<u32, 4>{Invalid, Invalid, Invalid, Invalid};
      }
    }
  }
  test.expected = test.initial;
  for (u32 lane = 0; lane < LaneCount; ++lane) {
    std::copy(expected[lane].begin(), expected[lane].end(),
              test.expected.begin() + OutputStart + lane * 4);
    auto bounded = expected[lane];
    if (lane % 8 == 5) bounded = {Invalid, Invalid, Invalid, Invalid};
    if (lane >= 20) bounded = {0x12345678, 0x12345679, 0x1234567a, 0x1234567b};
    std::copy(bounded.begin(), bounded.end(),
              test.expected.begin() + OutputStart + LaneCount * 4 + lane * 4);
  }
  auto &code = test.code;
  // The resource is a GPU value, not a materialized host image descriptor.
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 8, GuestBase >> 8);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 9, (sorted ? 0x80000000 : 0) | (grow << 23));
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 10, node_base + 256);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 11, barycentrics ? 0x81000000 : 0x80000000);
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 1, InlineU32(6), 0));
  for (u32 offset : {0u, 4u, 8u}) {
    code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMubuf0(offset == 8 && !wide ? 0x0f : 0x0e, offset * 4),
                             EncodeMubuf1(4 + offset, 0, 1)});
  }
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMimg0(wide ? 0xe7 : 0xe6, 15, 0, false, 0, true),
                           EncodeMimg1(20, 4, 2)});
  code.push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 2, InlineU32(2), 0));
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 20 + i, 2, OutputStart + i);
  // NSA addressing, the FP32 second-block bound, and inactive destination lanes.
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 10, node_base + 2);
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i) AppendVMovLiteral(&code, 24 + i, 0x12345678 + i);
  AppendSMovLiteral(&code, 126, 0x000fffff);
  code.insert(code.end(), {EncodeMimg0(wide ? 0xe7 : 0xe6, 15, 3, false, 0, true),
                           EncodeMimg1(24, 4, 2), 0x08070605, 0x0c0b0a09,
                           wide ? 0x000f0e0du : 0x00000e0du});
  code.push_back(EncodeSop1(0x04, 126, 193));
  for (u32 i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(&code, 24 + i, 2, OutputStart + LaneCount * 4 + i);
  AppendEnd(&code);
  const auto nodes_address = GuestBase + (uint64_t{node_base} << 6);
  test.bda_mappings = {{nodes_address, NodeStart * sizeof(u32)},
                       {nodes_address + 0x4000, (NodeStart + 257 * 16) * sizeof(u32)}};
  test.compute_info.wave_size = LaneCount;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[0] = LaneCount;
  test.compute_info.threads_num[1] = test.compute_info.threads_num[2] = 1;
  test.compute_info.thread_ids_num = 1;
  test.has_compute_info = true;
  test.required_spirv = {"get_bda_pointer"};
  return test;
}
```

```inc
void TestTrinityStackInstruction() {
  namespace D = ShaderRecompiler::Decoder;
  const std::array code{0xdb840008u, 0x01010a09u,
                        0xdb840010u, 0x02010a09u, EncodeSopp(0x01)};
  D::Program decoded;
  D::DecodeProgram(code, decoded);
  const auto& first = decoded.instructions.front();
  Check(first.opcode == D::Opcode::DS_BVH_STACK_PUSH8_POP1_RTN_B32 &&
            first.src_count == 3 && first.offset == 8 && first.dst.reg == 1 &&
            first.src0.reg == 9 && first.src1.reg == 10 && first.src2.reg == 1,
        "Trinity stack operands or capacity were not decoded");
  ShaderComputeInputInfo compute{};
  compute.lds_size_dwords = 1024;
  auto options = MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Compute);
  options.input_info.compute = &compute;
  const auto result = RecompileForTest(code, options);
  Check(CountSourceOccurrences(result.ir_dump, " = BvhStack ") == 2 &&
            result.program.info.uses_lds && result.program.info.bvh_stack &&
            !result.program.info.shared_int64_atomics,
        "unused stack results discarded LDS writes or selected 64-bit atomics");
  Check(SpirvInstructionOpcodeCount(result.spirv, 54u) == 2 &&
            SpirvInstructionOpcodeCount(result.spirv, 246u) == 1,
        "Trinity stack calls duplicated the function or unrolled its eight pushes");
  CheckSpirvBinaryValidates(result.spirv);
  compute.lds_storage = true;
  CheckSpirvBinaryValidates(RecompileForTest(code, options).spirv);
  options = MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Pixel);
  CheckSpirvBinaryValidates(RecompileForTest(code, options).spirv);
  for (const auto words : {std::array{0xdb860008u, 0x01010a09u},
                           std::array{0xdb840007u, 0x01010a09u},
                           std::array{0xdb840020u, 0x01010a09u},
                           std::array{0xdb840008u, 0x01f90a09u},
                           std::array{0xdb840008u, 0x09010a09u}}) {
    const std::array invalid{words[0], words[1], EncodeSopp(0x01)};
    D::DecodeProgram(invalid, decoded);
    Check(decoded.instructions[0].opcode == D::Opcode::UNSUPPORTED,
          "unsupported stack encoding was silently accepted");
  }
}

void TestTrinityBvhInstruction() {
  namespace D = ShaderRecompiler::Decoder;
  const std::array code{0xf1949f05u, 0x00010000u, 0x0a030201u, 0x0000040du,
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 0, false), EncodeMubuf1(0, 0, 0),
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 16, false), EncodeMubuf1(4, 0, 0),
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1d, 32, false), EncodeMubuf1(8, 0, 0),
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 40, false), EncodeMubuf1(10, 0, 0),
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1d, 56, false), EncodeMubuf1(14, 0, 0), EncodeSopp(0x01)};
  D::Program decoded;
  D::DecodeProgram(code, decoded);
  const auto& inst = decoded.instructions.front();
  Check(inst.opcode == D::Opcode::IMAGE_BVH8_INTERSECT_RAY && inst.word_count == 4 &&
            inst.data_dwords == 10 && inst.image_address_components == 11 &&
            inst.image_nsa_addr[3] == 10 && inst.image_nsa_addr[5] == 12 &&
            inst.image_nsa_addr[6] == 13 && inst.image_nsa_addr[8] == 15 &&
            inst.image_nsa_addr[9] == 4 && inst.src1.reg == 4,
        "Trinity BVH8 grouped ray registers were not decoded");
  const auto result = RecompileForTest(code, MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Compute));
  Check(result.program.info.bvh8 && !result.program.info.bvh &&
            result.program.info.uses_dma && result.program.info.images.empty(),
        "Trinity BVH8 did not use its separate raw-memory helper");
  Check(CountSourceOccurrences(result.ir_dump, " = Bvh8Intersect ") == 1,
        "Trinity BVH8 result and ray writes duplicated the intersection");
  CheckSpirvBinaryValidates(result.spirv);
  Check(SpirvInstructionOpcodeCount(result.spirv, 54u) == 6 &&
            SpirvInstructionOpcodeCount(result.spirv, 246u) == 1,
        "Trinity BVH8 duplicated helpers or unrolled its four-child loop");
  CheckSpirvBinaryValidates(RecompileForTest(code, MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Pixel)).spirv);
  for (const auto words : {std::array{0xf1949f05u, 0x40010000u, 0x0a030201u, 0x0000040du},
                           std::array{0xf1949f05u, 0x0001f700u, 0x0a030201u, 0x0000040du},
                           std::array{0xf1949f05u, 0x00010000u, 0xfe030201u, 0x0000040du},
                           std::array{0xf1949f05u, 0x00010700u, 0x0a030201u, 0x0000040du},
                           std::array{0xf1949f05u, 0x00010000u, 0x0a030201u, 0x0000040bu}}) {
    const std::array invalid{words[0], words[1], words[2], words[3], EncodeSopp(0x01)};
    D::DecodeProgram(invalid, decoded);
    Check(decoded.instructions[0].opcode == D::Opcode::UNSUPPORTED,
          "Trinity BVH8 accepted truncated ray or destination registers");
  }
}

void TestRayTracingInstructions() {
  TestTrinityBvhInstruction();
  TestTrinityStackInstruction();
  namespace D = ShaderRecompiler::Decoder;
  const std::array code{
      0xf1989f01u, 0x00081014u,
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 0, false), EncodeMubuf1(16, 0, 0),
      0xf1989f07u, 0x00071001u, 0x3d3e3c15u, 0x38095851u, 0x00003a39u,
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 16, false), EncodeMubuf1(16, 0, 0),
      0xf19c9f01u, 0x00081014u,
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 32, false), EncodeMubuf1(16, 0, 0),
      // Captured 016c1ab44ee6a526: pointer v2:v7 and final inverse component v5.
      0xf19c9f07u, 0x00090202u, 0x28263607u, 0x221f1e29u, 0x00050403u,
      EncodeMubuf0(0x1e, 48, false), EncodeMubuf1(2, 0, 0),
      EncodeSopp(0x01)};
  D::Program decoded;
  D::DecodeProgram(code, decoded);
  Check(decoded.instructions.size() == 9 &&
            decoded.instructions.back().opcode == D::Opcode::S_ENDPGM,
        "decoder stopped before instructions following BVH intersections");
  for (const auto index : {0u, 2u}) {
    const auto &inst = decoded.instructions[index];
    Check(inst.opcode == D::Opcode::IMAGE_BVH_INTERSECT_RAY &&
              inst.image_address_components == 11 && inst.data_dwords == 4 && inst.image_r128,
          "BVH32 instruction lost its ray or descriptor width");
  }
  for (const auto index : {4u, 6u}) {
    const auto &inst = decoded.instructions[index];
    Check(inst.opcode == D::Opcode::IMAGE_BVH_INTERSECT_RAY && inst.opcode_id == 0xe7 &&
              inst.image_address_components == 12 && inst.data_dwords == 4 && inst.image_r128,
          "BVH64 instruction lost its full node pointer or ray width");
  }
  Check(decoded.instructions[6].word_count == 5 &&
            decoded.instructions[6].image_nsa_addr[0] == 7 &&
            decoded.instructions[6].image_nsa_addr[10] == 5,
        "captured BVH64 NSA pointer or final ray component was not decoded");
  Check(decoded.instructions[2].image_nsa_addr[9] == 58,
        "BVH NSA ray components were not decoded");
  const auto result = RecompileForTest(code, MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Compute));
  Check(CountSourceOccurrences(result.ir_dump, "BvhIntersect") == 4 &&
            result.program.info.uses_dma && result.program.info.images.empty() &&
            result.program.info.samplers.empty(),
        "BVH intersections did not use GPU descriptors and raw guest memory");
  CheckSpirvBinaryValidates(result.spirv);

  const std::array literal{EncodeSMovB32(0, 255), 0xf1989f01u, EncodeSopp(0x01)};
  D::DecodeProgram(literal, decoded);
  Check(decoded.instructions.size() == 2 && decoded.instructions[0].opcode == D::Opcode::S_MOV_B32,
        "BVH-shaped scalar literal was decoded as an instruction");
#if KYTY_PLATFORM != KYTY_PLATFORM_WINDOWS
  for (const auto words : {std::array{0xf19c9f01u, 0x40081014u}, // BVH64 A16
                           std::array{0xf1989f01u, 0x40081014u}, // BVH32 A16
                           std::array{0xf1981f01u, 0x00081014u}, // not R128
                           std::array{0xf1989f01u, 0x80081014u}}) { // D16
    const std::array unsupported{words[0], words[1], EncodeSopp(0x01)};
    ExpectFatal([&]() { (void)RecompileForTest(unsupported, MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Compute)); },
                "unsupported BVH encoding was silently accepted");
  }
  for (const auto encoding : {0xf1989f01u, 0xf19c9f01u}) {
    for (const auto nsa : {1u, 2u}) {
      std::array<uint32_t, 5> truncated{encoding | (nsa << 1), 0x00081014u};
      truncated[2 + nsa] = EncodeSopp(0x01);
      ExpectFatal([&]() {
        (void)RecompileForTest(std::span(truncated).first(3 + nsa), MakeCompileOptions(ShaderType::Compute));
      }, "BVH NSA instruction accepted an incomplete ray address");
    }
  }
#endif
}
```

`tests/ShaderRecompilerComputeTests.cpp`:

```cpp
#define SPV_ENABLE_UTILITY_CODE

#include "common/assert.h"
#include "common/debugCounters.h"
#include "common/emulatorConfig.h"
#include "common/file.h"
#include "common/hostException.h"
#include "common/logging/log.h"
#include "common/subsystems.h"
#include "common/threads.h"

template <typename Cache>
concept HasGetDownloadBuffer =
    requires(Cache &cache) { cache.GetDownloadBuffer(uint64_t{1}); };
static_assert(!HasGetDownloadBuffer<BufferCache>);
static_assert(std::same_as<decltype(&BufferCache::GetBuffer),
                           Buffer &(BufferCache::*)(BufferId)>);
static_assert(std::same_as<decltype(&TextureCache::GetImage),
                           Image &(TextureCache::*)(ImageId)>);

template <typename Cache>
concept HasSynchronizeImageToBuffer = requires(Cache &cache) {
  cache.SynchronizeImageToBuffer(uint64_t{1}, uint64_t{1});
};
template <typename Cache>
concept HasObtainBufferForImageCopy = requires(Cache &cache) {
  cache.ObtainBufferForImageCopy(uint64_t{1}, uint64_t{1});
};
template <typename Cache>
concept HasObtainBufferForImageWrite = requires(Cache &cache) {
  cache.ObtainBufferForImageWrite(uint64_t{1}, uint64_t{1});
};
template <typename Cache>
concept HasDiscardGpuDirtyBytes = requires(Cache &cache) {
  cache.DiscardGpuDirtyBytes(uint64_t{1}, uint64_t{1});
};
static_assert(!HasSynchronizeImageToBuffer<TextureCache>);
static_assert(!HasObtainBufferForImageCopy<BufferCache>);
static_assert(!HasObtainBufferForImageWrite<BufferCache>);
static_assert(!HasDiscardGpuDirtyBytes<BufferCache>);

template <typename Backing>
concept HasLegacyImageLayout = requires(Backing &backing) { backing.layout; };
static_assert(!HasLegacyImageLayout<VulkanImage>);

template <typename Manager>
concept HasPolicyDetileImage = requires { &Manager::DetileImage; };
template <typename Manager>
concept HasPolicyTileImageBacking = requires { &Manager::TileImageBacking; };
static_assert(!HasPolicyDetileImage<TileManager>);
static_assert(!HasPolicyTileImageBacking<TileManager>);
static_assert(BlitHelper::ColorToMsDepthLayout ==
              vk::ImageLayout::eDepthStencilAttachmentOptimal);

struct BufferCacheTestAccess {
  static_assert(std::same_as<decltype(BufferCache::m_slot_buffers),
                             Common::SlotVector<Buffer>>);

  static uint64_t GcTick(const BufferCache &cache) { return cache.m_gc_tick; }

  static void SetGarbageCollectionThresholds(BufferCache &cache,
                                             uint64_t trigger,
                                             uint64_t critical) {
    cache.m_trigger_gc_memory = trigger;
    cache.m_critical_gc_memory = critical;
  }

  static StreamBuffer &DownloadBuffer(BufferCache &cache) {
    return cache.m_download_buffer;
  }

  static void SetUnusedStagingBufferSize(BufferCache &cache, uint64_t size) {
    // Called immediately after cache construction, before any staging reservation.
    std::destroy_at(&cache.m_staging_buffer);
    std::construct_at(&cache.m_staging_buffer, cache.m_graphics, cache.m_scheduler,
                      MemoryUsage::Upload, size);
  }

  static bool SynchronizeBufferFromImage(BufferCache &cache, Buffer &buffer,
                                         uint64_t address, uint64_t size) {
    return cache.SynchronizeBufferFromImage(buffer, address, size);
  }

  static BufferId PageOwner(const BufferCache &cache, uint64_t address) {
    const auto *owner = cache.m_page_table.Find(
        address >> BufferCache::PageTable::kPageBits);
    return owner == nullptr ? BufferId{} : *owner;
  }

  static bool IsBufferAllocated(const BufferCache &cache, BufferId id) {
    return cache.m_slot_buffers.is_allocated(id);
  }
};

  static bool NormalizeReservation(bool coherent, uint64_t atom, uint64_t &size,
                                   uint64_t &alignment) {
    return StreamBuffer::NormalizeReservation(coherent, atom, size, alignment);
  }
};

  }

                                 uint64_t active, uint32_t remaining,
                                 uint64_t alignment, uint64_t max_range,
                                 uint32_t max_groups) {

struct ImageHeapTestAccess {
  static size_t ElementCount(const ImageHeap &heap) { return heap.m_elements.size(); }
  static size_t MemoryCount(const ImageHeap &heap) { return heap.m_memories.size(); }
  static const auto &Views(const ImageHeap &heap) { return heap.m_memories.at(0)->views; }
  static const auto &Element(const ImageHeap &heap, uint32_t entry) {
    return heap.m_elements[entry & ((1u << ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageHeapKindShift) - 1u)];
  }
  static const std::vector<uint32_t> &ListSlots(const ImageHeap &heap, const void *owner,
                                                uint32_t resource) {
    return heap.m_lists.at({owner, resource}).slots;
  }
  static ImageId ImageOf(const ImageHeap &heap, uint32_t entry) {
    return Element(heap, entry).binding.image_id;
  }
  // Whether the newest table no longer watches its last page.
  static bool TailPageDirty(const ImageHeap &heap) {
    return heap.m_memories.back()->dirty_pages.back() != 0u;
  }
};

struct TextureCacheTestAccess {
  static_assert(std::same_as<decltype(TextureCache::m_slot_images),
                             Common::SlotVector<Image>>);
  static_assert(TextureCache::ImagePageTable::kPageBits == 20);
  static_assert(TextureCache::ImagePageTable::kAddressSpaceBits == 44);
  static_assert(TextureCache::ImagePageTable::kFirstLevelBits == 14);

  static uint64_t GcTick(const TextureCache &cache) { return cache.m_gc_tick; }

  static std::unique_lock<TrackingSpinLock> Lock(TextureCache &cache) {
    return std::unique_lock(cache.m_lock);
  }

  static void ClearImage(TextureCache &cache, CommandBuffer &command, ImageId id,
                         const vk::ImageSubresourceRange &range,
                         const vk::ClearValue &clear) {
    auto lock = Lock(cache);
    cache.ClearImage(command, id, cache.GetImage(id).backing.format, range, clear);
  }

  static void ConfigureGarbageCollection(TextureCache &cache,
                                         std::span<const ImageId> oldest,
                                         uint64_t tick, uint64_t pressure) {
    cache.m_trigger_gc_memory = 0;
    cache.m_pressure_gc_memory = pressure;
    cache.m_critical_gc_memory = UINT64_MAX;
    cache.m_gc_tick = tick;
    std::vector<ImageId> live;
    cache.m_lru_cache = {};
    cache.m_slot_images.ForEach([&](ImageId id, Image &image) {
      if (image.registered) {
        image.tick_accessed_last = cache.m_scheduler.CurrentTick();
        live.push_back(id);
      }
    });
    for (const auto id : oldest) {
      const auto owner = cache.m_slot_images.try_get(id);
      if (owner != nullptr && owner->registered) {
        owner->tick_accessed_last = 0;
        owner->lru_id = cache.m_lru_cache.Insert(id, 0);
      }
    }
    for (const auto id : live) {
      if (std::ranges::find(oldest, id) == oldest.end()) {
        cache.m_slot_images[id].lru_id = cache.m_lru_cache.Insert(id, tick);
      }
    }
  }

  static bool Contains(const TextureCache &cache, ImageId id) {
    const auto owner = cache.m_slot_images.try_get(id);
    return owner != nullptr && owner->registered;
  }

  static std::vector<ImageId> FindImages(TextureCache &cache, uint64_t address,
                                         uint64_t size) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    const auto found = cache.FindImagesInRegion(address, size);
    std::vector<ImageId> result;
    result.reserve(found.size());
    for (const auto id : found) {
      result.push_back(id);
    }
    return result;
  }

  static size_t PageOwnerCount(TextureCache &cache, uint64_t address) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    const auto *owners = cache.m_image_page_table.Find(static_cast<size_t>(
        address >> TextureCache::ImagePageTable::kPageBits));
    return owners == nullptr ? 0 : owners->size();
  }

  static size_t OwnedPageCount(TextureCache &cache, uint64_t address,
                               uint64_t size, ImageId id) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    TextureCache::ImagePageTable::PageRange pages{};
    if (!TextureCache::ImagePageTable::TryGetPageRange(address, size, pages)) {
      return 0;
    }
    size_t count = 0;
    for (size_t page = pages.first; page < pages.last_exclusive; ++page) {
      const auto *owners = cache.m_image_page_table.Find(page);
      count += owners != nullptr &&
               std::find(owners->begin(), owners->end(), id) != owners->end();
    }
    return count;
  }

  static ImageId InsertImage(TextureCache &cache, const ImageInfo &info) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    return cache.InsertImage(info);
  }

  static void DeleteImage(TextureCache &cache, ImageId id) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    cache.DeleteImage(id);
  }

  static const Image *Owner(const TextureCache &cache, ImageId id) {
    return cache.m_slot_images.try_get(id);
  }

  static bool PendingDownload(const TextureCache &cache, ImageId id) {
    return cache.m_download_images.contains(id);
  }

  static void TrackDownload(TextureCache &cache, ImageId id) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    cache.TrackImageDownload(id, cache.m_slot_images[id]);
  }

  static void AssociateStencil(TextureCache &cache, ImageId depth,
                               GuestRange stencil) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    (void)cache.AssociateStencil(depth, stencil);
  }

  static void SetLinearReadback(TextureCache &cache, bool enabled) {
    cache.m_readback_linear_images = enabled;
  }

  static std::pair<uint8_t *, uint64_t>
  MapDownload(TextureCache &cache, uint64_t size, uint64_t alignment) {
    auto &download =
        cache.m_buffer_cache.GetUtilityBuffer(MemoryUsage::Download);
    auto mapping = download.Map(size, std::max<uint64_t>(alignment, 4));
    if (mapping.first != nullptr) {
      download.Commit();
    }
    return mapping;
  }

  static bool TryDownload(TextureCache &cache, ImageId id) {
    return cache.DownloadImageMemory(id);
  }

  static void RegisterHtileMeta(TextureCache &cache, uint64_t address) {
    std::lock_guard lock(cache.m_lock);
    auto &metadata = cache.m_surface_metas[address];
    metadata.clear_mask.reset();
  }

  static TileManager &Tiler(TextureCache &cache) { return cache.m_tiler; }
};

struct RenderExecutorTestAccess {
  static bool DrawIndex(RenderExecutor &executor, CommandBuffer &command,
                        const DrawIndexArgs &args) {
    return executor.DrawIndex(command, args);
  }

  static bool DrawAuto(RenderExecutor &executor, CommandBuffer &command,
                       const DrawAutoArgs &args) {
    return executor.DrawAuto(command, args);
  }

  static bool TryConsumeComputeFill(RenderExecutor &executor,
      const ShaderComputeInputInfo &input, CommandBuffer &command,
      uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t mode) {
    return executor.TryConsumeComputeFill(input, command, x, y, z, mode);
  }

  static bool TryConsumeComputeMetaClear(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                         const ShaderComputeInputInfo &input,
                                         const CommandBuffer &buffer) {
    return executor.TryConsumeComputeMetaClear(input, buffer);
  }

  static TextureBinding
  ResolveTexture(RenderExecutor &executor,
                 const ShaderRecompiler::IR::ImageResource &resource,
                 const ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue &value) {
    return executor.ResolveTexture(resource, value);
  }

  static auto PrepareGraphicsBindings(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                      const ShaderStageRuntime &vertex,
                                      const ShaderStageRuntime &pixel,
                                      bool pixel_active) {
    RenderExecutor::GraphicsBindings result;
    executor.PrepareBindings(vertex, result.vertex[0]);
    std::array<PreparedBindings *, 2> stages{&result.vertex[0], &result.pixel};
    if (pixel_active) {
      executor.PrepareBindings(pixel, result.pixel);
    }
    executor.PrepareGraphicsBindings(
        std::span{stages.data(), pixel_active ? 2u : 1u}, {});
    return result;
  }

  static void PrepareGraphicsBindings(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                      std::span<PreparedBindings *const> stages,
                                      std::span<RenderColorInfo> colors) {
    executor.PrepareGraphicsBindings(stages, colors);
  }

  static PipelineCache::Pipeline
  CreateDescriptorPipeline(RenderExecutor &executor,
                           std::span<PreparedBindings *const> stages) {
    std::vector<vk::DescriptorSetLayoutBinding> layout_bindings;
    bool compute = false;
    for (const auto *prepared : stages) {
      const auto &program = prepared->runtime->module->info;
      compute |= program.stage == ShaderType::Compute;
      const auto shader_stage = program.stage == ShaderType::Vertex
                                    ? vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eVertex
                                : program.stage == ShaderType::Pixel
                                    ? vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eFragment
                                    : vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute;
      for (auto mask = program.bindings.descriptor_mask; mask != 0; mask &= mask - 1) {
        const auto index = std::countr_zero(mask);
        const auto kind = static_cast<ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorBindingKind>(index);
        layout_bindings.push_back(
            {ShaderRecompiler::IR::NativeBinding(program.stage, kind),
             NativeDescriptorType(kind), program.bindings.descriptor_counts[index], shader_stage});
      }
    }
    vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo descriptor_info{};
    descriptor_info.sType = vk::StructureType::eDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo;
    descriptor_info.flags =
        vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateFlagBits::ePushDescriptorKHR;
    descriptor_info.bindingCount =
        static_cast<uint32_t>(layout_bindings.size());
    descriptor_info.pBindings = layout_bindings.data();
    PipelineCache::Pipeline pipeline{};
    auto &device = executor.m_context.GetGraphics().device;
    EXIT_IF(device.createDescriptorSetLayout(&descriptor_info, nullptr,
                                             &pipeline.descriptor_set_layout) !=
            vk::Result::eSuccess);

    vk::PipelineLayoutCreateInfo pipeline_info{};
    pipeline_info.sType = vk::StructureType::ePipelineLayoutCreateInfo;
    pipeline_info.setLayoutCount = 1;
    pipeline_info.pSetLayouts = &pipeline.descriptor_set_layout;
    pipeline.push_stages =
        compute ? vk::ShaderStageFlags {vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eCompute}
                : vk::ShaderStageFlags {vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eVertex |
                                       vk::ShaderStageFlagBits::eFragment};
    const vk::PushConstantRange push_range {pipeline.push_stages, 0,
                                            ShaderRecompiler::IR::NativePushConstantSize};
    pipeline_info.pushConstantRangeCount = 1;
    pipeline_info.pPushConstantRanges = &push_range;
    EXIT_IF(device.createPipelineLayout(&pipeline_info, nullptr,
                                        &pipeline.pipeline_layout) !=
            vk::Result::eSuccess);
    pipeline.uses_push_descriptors = true;
    return pipeline;
  }

  static PipelineCache::Pipeline CommitBindings(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                                CommandBuffer &buffer,
                                                PreparedBindings &bindings) {
    std::array<PreparedBindings *, 1> stages{&bindings};
    auto pipeline = CreateDescriptorPipeline(executor, stages);
    const auto bind_point = bindings.runtime->module->info.stage == ShaderType::Compute
                                ? vk::PipelineBindPoint::eCompute
                                : vk::PipelineBindPoint::eGraphics;
    executor.CommitBindings(buffer, bind_point, pipeline, stages);
    return pipeline;
  }

  static PipelineCache::Pipeline CommitBindings(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                                CommandBuffer &buffer,
                                                PreparedBindings &vertex,
                                                PreparedBindings &pixel) {
    std::array<PreparedBindings *, 2> stages{&vertex, &pixel};
    auto pipeline = CreateDescriptorPipeline(executor, stages);
    executor.CommitBindings(buffer, vk::PipelineBindPoint::eGraphics, pipeline,
                            stages);
    return pipeline;
  }

  static void CommitBindings(RenderExecutor &executor, CommandBuffer &buffer,
                             const PipelineCache::Pipeline &pipeline,
                             PreparedBindings &vertex, PreparedBindings &pixel) {
    std::array<PreparedBindings *, 2> stages{&vertex, &pixel};
    executor.CommitBindings(buffer, vk::PipelineBindPoint::eGraphics, pipeline,
                            stages);
  }

  static void DestroyDescriptorPipelines(
      RenderExecutor &executor,
      std::span<const PipelineCache::Pipeline> pipelines) {
    auto &device = executor.m_context.GetGraphics().device;
    for (const auto &pipeline : pipelines) {
      device.destroyPipelineLayout(pipeline.pipeline_layout, nullptr);
      device.destroyDescriptorSetLayout(pipeline.descriptor_set_layout,
                                        nullptr);
    }
  }

  static void ResolveRenderDepthTarget(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                       CommandBuffer &buffer,
                                       RenderDepthInfo &depth) {
    executor.ResolveRenderDepthTarget(buffer, depth);
  }

  static bool DepthStencilCopy(RenderExecutor &executor, CommandBuffer &buffer) {
    return executor.DepthStencilCopy(buffer);
  }

  static void ResolveRenderColorTarget(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                       CommandBuffer &buffer,
                                       RenderColorInfo &color, uint32_t slot) {
    executor.ResolveRenderColorTarget(buffer, color, slot);
  }

  static void BindRenderTarget(RenderExecutor &executor, ImageId id) {
    executor.BindRenderTarget(id);
  }

  static RenderState AcquireRenderTargets(RenderExecutor &executor,
                                          CommandBuffer &buffer,
                                          RenderColorInfo *colors,
                                          uint32_t color_count,
                                          RenderDepthInfo &depth,
                                          std::span<PreparedBindings *const> stages = {},
                                          vk::ImageAspectFlags *feedback_out = nullptr) {
    vk::ImageAspectFlags feedback;
    auto state = executor.AcquireRenderTargets(buffer, colors, color_count, depth,
                                               feedback, stages);
    if (feedback_out != nullptr) {
      *feedback_out = feedback;
    }
    return state;
  }

  static void ResetBindings(RenderExecutor &executor) {
    executor.ResetBindings();
  }

  static bool ResolveColorTargets(RenderExecutor &executor, CommandBuffer &buffer) {
    return executor.ResolveColorTargets(buffer);
  }

  static bool BoundImagesInOrder(const RenderExecutor &executor, ImageId first,
                                 ImageId second) {
    return executor.m_bound_images.size() == 2 &&
           executor.m_bound_images[0] == first &&
           executor.m_bound_images[1] == second;
  }
};

struct PipelineCacheTestAccess {
  // Replaces each graphics pipeline whose stage ids name compiled modules with one created
  // from only its key and those modules. The GPU must be idle. Returns how many it replaced.
  static uint32_t RecreateGraphicsPipelines(PipelineCache &cache) {
    const auto modules = cache.MapModules();
    auto &device = cache.m_graphics.device;
    uint32_t count = 0;
    for (auto &[key, pipeline] : cache.m_graphics_pipelines) {
      PipelineCache::Pipeline recreated;
      // Test-owned modules are not in the cache.
      if (!cache.CreateGraphicsPipeline(recreated, key, modules)) continue;
      device.destroyPipeline(pipeline.pipeline, nullptr);
      device.destroyPipelineLayout(pipeline.pipeline_layout, nullptr);
      device.destroyDescriptorSetLayout(pipeline.descriptor_set_layout, nullptr);
      pipeline = recreated;
      count++;
    }
    return count;
  }

  static auto Compiled(const PipelineCache &cache) { return cache.m_compiled; }

  static void StoreLayout(PipelineCache &cache, uint64_t key,
                          const ShaderTessellationInputInfo &layout) {
    cache.StoreLayout(key, layout);
  }

  // Holds the store thread until Save(), which destroying the cache also calls.
  static void HoldStoreUntilExit(PipelineCache &cache) {
    cache.m_store.Post([stop = cache.m_store.m_thread.get_stop_token()] {
      while (!stop.stop_requested()) std::this_thread::yield();
    });
  }

  static void Post(PipelineCache &cache, Common::UniqueFunction<void> &&job) {
    cache.m_store.Post(std::move(job));
  }

  // Gives the cache an empty driver cache saved to `path`.
  static void UseDriverCache(PipelineCache &cache, const std::filesystem::path &path) {
    const vk::PipelineCacheCreateInfo create{};
    EXIT_IF(cache.m_driver_cache != nullptr ||
            cache.m_graphics.device.createPipelineCache(&create, nullptr, &cache.m_driver_cache) !=
                vk::Result::eSuccess);
    cache.m_driver_cache_path = path;
  }

  // A due checkpoint has the store thread write the driver cache.
  static void CheckpointDriverCache(PipelineCache &cache, bool due) {
    if (due) cache.m_next_driver_cache_save = {};
    cache.CheckpointDriverCache();
  }

  static const auto &TessLayouts(const PipelineCache &cache) { return cache.m_tess_layouts; }

  static std::array<size_t, 2> Pipelines(const PipelineCache &cache) {
    return {cache.m_graphics_pipelines.size(), cache.m_compute_pipelines.size()};
  }
};

namespace {

using u32 = uint32_t;
using BindingType = TextureCache::BindingType;
using ImageDesc = TextureCache::ImageDesc;
using ShaderOpcode = ShaderRecompiler::Decoder::Opcode;

ImageInfo MakeTilingImage(Prospero::BufferFormat format, uint32_t width,
                          uint32_t height, uint32_t levels, uint32_t depth,
                          Prospero::TileMode tile, uint64_t guest_size,
                          bool volume) {
  ImageInfo info{};
  info.guest_format = format;
  info.type =
      volume ? Prospero::ImageType::kColor3D : Prospero::ImageType::kColor2D;
  info.extent = {width, height, volume ? depth : 1u};
  info.resources = {levels, volume ? 1u : depth};
  info.data.size = guest_size;
  info.tile_mode = tile;
  info.UpdateSize();
  return info;
}

constexpr u32 InlineU32(u32 value) { return 128u + value; }

constexpr u32 Vgpr(u32 reg) { return 256u + reg; }

constexpr u32 EncodeSMovB32(u32 dst, u32 src) {
  return 0x80000000u | (0x7du << 23u) | ((dst & 0x7fu) << 16u) | (0x03u << 8u) |
         (src & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSop1(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 src) {
  return 0x80000000u | (0x7du << 23u) | ((dst & 0x7fu) << 16u) |
         ((opcode & 0xffu) << 8u) | (src & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSop2(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 src0, u32 src1) {
  return 0x80000000u | ((opcode & 0x7fu) << 23u) | ((dst & 0x7fu) << 16u) |
         ((src1 & 0xffu) << 8u) | (src0 & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSopc(u32 opcode, u32 src0, u32 src1) {
  return 0x80000000u | (0x7eu << 23u) | ((opcode & 0x7fu) << 16u) |
         ((src1 & 0xffu) << 8u) | (src0 & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSopp(u32 opcode, u32 simm = 0) {
  return 0x80000000u | (0x7fu << 23u) | ((opcode & 0x7fu) << 16u) |
         (simm & 0xffffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSopk(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 imm) {
  return 0x80000000u | (((opcode + 0x60u) & 0x7fu) << 23u) |
         ((dst & 0x7fu) << 16u) | (imm & 0xffffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop1(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 src0) {
  return (0x3fu << 25u) | ((dst & 0xffu) << 17u) | ((opcode & 0xffu) << 9u) |
         (src0 & 0x1ffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop1Sdwa(u32 src0, u32 dst_sel = 6, u32 dst_u = 0,
                             u32 src0_sel = 6, u32 src0_sext = 0,
                             u32 src0_neg = 0, u32 src0_abs = 0, u32 s0 = 0,
                             u32 clamp = 0, u32 omod = 0) {
  return (src0 & 0xffu) | ((dst_sel & 0x7u) << 8u) | ((dst_u & 0x3u) << 11u) |
         ((clamp & 0x1u) << 13u) | ((omod & 0x3u) << 14u) |
         ((src0_sel & 0x7u) << 16u) | ((src0_sext & 0x1u) << 19u) |
         ((src0_neg & 0x1u) << 20u) | ((src0_abs & 0x1u) << 21u) |
         ((s0 & 0x1u) << 23u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop1Dpp(u32 src0, u32 dpp_ctrl = 0, u32 row_mask = 0xf,
                            u32 bank_mask = 0xf) {
  return (src0 & 0xffu) | ((dpp_ctrl & 0x1ffu) << 8u) |
         ((bank_mask & 0xfu) << 24u) | ((row_mask & 0xfu) << 28u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop2(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 src0, u32 src1) {
  return ((opcode & 0x3fu) << 25u) | ((dst & 0xffu) << 17u) |
         ((src1 & 0xffu) << 9u) | (src0 & 0x1ffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop2Sdwa(u32 src0, u32 dst_sel = 6, u32 dst_u = 0,
                             u32 src0_sel = 6, u32 src1_sel = 6,
                             u32 src0_sext = 0, u32 src1_sext = 0,
                             u32 src0_neg = 0, u32 src0_abs = 0,
                             u32 src1_neg = 0, u32 src1_abs = 0, u32 s0 = 0,
                             u32 s1 = 0, u32 clamp = 0, u32 omod = 0) {
  return (src0 & 0xffu) | ((dst_sel & 0x7u) << 8u) | ((dst_u & 0x3u) << 11u) |
         ((clamp & 0x1u) << 13u) | ((omod & 0x3u) << 14u) |
         ((src0_sel & 0x7u) << 16u) | ((src0_sext & 0x1u) << 19u) |
         ((src0_neg & 0x1u) << 20u) | ((src0_abs & 0x1u) << 21u) |
         ((s0 & 0x1u) << 23u) | ((src1_sel & 0x7u) << 24u) |
         ((src1_sext & 0x1u) << 27u) | ((src1_neg & 0x1u) << 28u) |
         ((src1_abs & 0x1u) << 29u) | ((s1 & 0x1u) << 31u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop2Dpp(u32 src0, u32 dpp_ctrl = 0, u32 row_mask = 0xf,
                            u32 bank_mask = 0xf, u32 src0_neg = 0,
                            u32 src0_abs = 0, u32 src1_neg = 0,
                            u32 src1_abs = 0) {
  return (src0 & 0xffu) | ((dpp_ctrl & 0x1ffu) << 8u) |
         ((src0_neg & 0x1u) << 20u) | ((src0_abs & 0x1u) << 21u) |
         ((src1_neg & 0x1u) << 22u) | ((src1_abs & 0x1u) << 23u) |
         ((bank_mask & 0xfu) << 24u) | ((row_mask & 0xfu) << 28u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop3Word0(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 abs = 0, u32 op_sel = 0,
                              bool clamp = false) {
  return (0x35u << 26u) | ((opcode & 0x3ffu) << 16u) | ((abs & 0x7u) << 8u) |
         ((op_sel & 0xfu) << 11u) | (clamp ? (1u << 15u) : 0u) | (dst & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop3BWord0(u32 opcode, u32 vdst, u32 sdst) {
  return (0x35u << 26u) | ((opcode & 0x3ffu) << 16u) | ((sdst & 0x7fu) << 8u) |
         (vdst & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop3Word1(u32 src0, u32 src1, u32 src2 = 0, u32 omod = 0,
                              u32 neg = 0) {
  return (src0 & 0x1ffu) | ((src1 & 0x1ffu) << 9u) | ((src2 & 0x1ffu) << 18u) |
         ((omod & 0x3u) << 27u) | ((neg & 0x7u) << 29u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop3pWord0(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 op_sel_hi = 0,
                               u32 op_sel = 0, u32 neg_hi = 0,
                               bool clamp = false) {
  return (0x33u << 26u) | ((opcode & 0x7fu) << 16u) | ((neg_hi & 0x7u) << 8u) |
         ((op_sel & 0x7u) << 11u) | (((op_sel_hi >> 2u) & 0x1u) << 14u) |
         (clamp ? (1u << 15u) : 0u) | (dst & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVop3pWord1(u32 src0, u32 src1, u32 src2 = 0,
                               u32 op_sel_hi = 0, u32 neg = 0) {
  return (src0 & 0x1ffu) | ((src1 & 0x1ffu) << 9u) | ((src2 & 0x1ffu) << 18u) |
         ((op_sel_hi & 0x3u) << 27u) | ((neg & 0x7u) << 29u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVopc(u32 opcode, u32 src0, u32 src1) {
  return (0x3eu << 25u) | ((opcode & 0xffu) << 17u) | ((src1 & 0xffu) << 9u) |
         (src0 & 0x1ffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVopcSdwa(u32 src0, u32 sdst = 0, u32 sd = 0,
                             u32 src0_sel = 6, u32 src1_sel = 6,
                             u32 src0_sext = 0, u32 src1_sext = 0,
                             u32 src0_neg = 0, u32 src0_abs = 0,
                             u32 src1_neg = 0, u32 src1_abs = 0, u32 s0 = 0,
                             u32 s1 = 0) {
  return (src0 & 0xffu) | ((sdst & 0x7fu) << 8u) | ((sd & 0x1u) << 15u) |
         ((src0_sel & 0x7u) << 16u) | ((src0_sext & 0x1u) << 19u) |
         ((src0_neg & 0x1u) << 20u) | ((src0_abs & 0x1u) << 21u) |
         ((s0 & 0x1u) << 23u) | ((src1_sel & 0x7u) << 24u) |
         ((src1_sext & 0x1u) << 27u) | ((src1_neg & 0x1u) << 28u) |
         ((src1_abs & 0x1u) << 29u) | ((s1 & 0x1u) << 31u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeMubuf0(u32 opcode, u32 offset = 0, bool idxen = false,
                           bool offen = true, bool glc = false) {
  return (0x38u << 26u) | ((opcode & 0xffu) << 18u) |
         (offen ? (1u << 12u) : 0u) | (idxen ? (1u << 13u) : 0u) |
         (glc ? (1u << 14u) : 0u) | (offset & 0xfffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeMubuf1(u32 vdata, u32 srsrc, u32 vaddr, u32 soffset = 128) {
  return ((soffset & 0xffu) << 24u) | ((srsrc & 0x1fu) << 16u) |
         ((vdata & 0xffu) << 8u) | (vaddr & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeMtbuf0(u32 opcode, u32 dfmt, u32 nfmt, u32 offset = 0,
                           bool idxen = false, bool offen = true) {
  return (0x3au << 26u) | (offset & 0xfffu) | (offen ? (1u << 12u) : 0u) |
         (idxen ? (1u << 13u) : 0u) | ((opcode & 0x7u) << 16u) |
         ((dfmt & 0xfu) << 19u) | ((nfmt & 0x7u) << 23u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeMtbuf1(u32 opcode, u32 vdata, u32 srsrc, u32 vaddr,
                           u32 soffset = 128) {
  return (((opcode >> 3u) & 1u) << 21u) | ((soffset & 0xffu) << 24u) |
         ((srsrc & 0x1fu) << 16u) | ((vdata & 0xffu) << 8u) | (vaddr & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSmem0(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 sbase = 0) {
  return (0x3du << 26u) | ((opcode & 0xffu) << 18u) | ((dst & 0x7fu) << 6u) |
         (sbase & 0x3fu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeSmem1(u32 offset, u32 soffset = 0) {
  return (offset & 0x1fffffu) | ((soffset & 0x7fu) << 25u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeMimg0(u32 opcode, u32 dmask, u32 nsa_dwords = 0,
                          bool glc = false, u32 dim = 1, bool r128 = false) {
  return (0x3cu << 26u) | ((opcode >> 7u) & 0x1u) |
         ((nsa_dwords & 0x3u) << 1u) | ((dim & 0x7u) << 3u) |
         ((dmask & 0xfu) << 8u) | (glc ? (1u << 13u) : 0u) |
         (r128 ? (1u << 15u) : 0u) | ((opcode & 0x7fu) << 18u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeMimg1(u32 vdata, u32 vaddr, u32 srsrc = 0, u32 ssamp = 0,
                          bool a16 = false, bool d16 = false) {
  return ((ssamp & 0x1fu) << 21u) | ((srsrc & 0x1fu) << 16u) |
         ((vdata & 0xffu) << 8u) | (vaddr & 0xffu) | (a16 ? (1u << 30u) : 0u) |
         (d16 ? (1u << 31u) : 0u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeVintrp(u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 attr, u32 chan, u32 src) {
  return (0x32u << 26u) | ((dst & 0xffu) << 18u) | ((opcode & 0x3u) << 16u) |
         ((attr & 0x3fu) << 10u) | ((chan & 0x3u) << 8u) | (src & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeExp0(u32 target, u32 en, bool done = true,
                         bool compr = false, bool vm = false) {
  return (0x3eu << 26u) | ((target & 0x3fu) << 4u) | (en & 0xfu) |
         (compr ? (1u << 10u) : 0u) | (done ? (1u << 11u) : 0u) |
         (vm ? (1u << 12u) : 0u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeExp1(u32 src0, u32 src1, u32 src2, u32 src3) {
  return (src0 & 0xffu) | ((src1 & 0xffu) << 8u) | ((src2 & 0xffu) << 16u) |
         ((src3 & 0xffu) << 24u);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeFlat0(u32 opcode, u32 segment, u32 offset = 0) {
  return (0x37u << 26u) | ((opcode & 0x7fu) << 18u) |
         ((segment & 0x3u) << 14u) | (offset & 0xfffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeFlat1(u32 vdst, u32 saddr, u32 data, u32 addr) {
  return ((vdst & 0xffu) << 24u) | ((saddr & 0x7fu) << 16u) |
         ((data & 0xffu) << 8u) | (addr & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeDs0(u32 opcode, u32 offset = 0, bool gds = false) {
  return (0x36u << 26u) | ((opcode & 0xffu) << 18u) | (gds ? (1u << 17u) : 0u) |
         (offset & 0xffffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeDs1Ex(u32 vdst, u32 data1, u32 data0, u32 addr) {
  return ((vdst & 0xffu) << 24u) | ((data1 & 0xffu) << 16u) |
         ((data0 & 0xffu) << 8u) | (addr & 0xffu);
}

constexpr u32 EncodeDs1(u32 vdst, u32 data0, u32 addr) {
  return EncodeDs1Ex(vdst, 0, data0, addr);
}

void AppendSMovLiteral(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 dst, u32 literal) {
  code->push_back(EncodeSMovB32(dst, 255u));
  code->push_back(literal);
}

void AppendVMovLiteral(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 dst, u32 literal) {
  code->push_back(EncodeVop1(0x01, dst, 255u));
  code->push_back(literal);
}

void AppendVMovU32(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 dst, u32 value) {
  if (value <= 64u) {
    code->push_back(EncodeVop1(0x01, dst, InlineU32(value)));
    return;
  }
  AppendVMovLiteral(code, dst, value);
}

void AppendVop3(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 src0, u32 src1,
                u32 src2 = 0, u32 abs = 0, u32 op_sel = 0, bool clamp = false,
                u32 omod = 0, u32 neg = 0) {
  code->push_back(EncodeVop3Word0(opcode, dst, abs, op_sel, clamp));
  code->push_back(EncodeVop3Word1(src0, src1, src2, omod, neg));
}

void AppendVop3B(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 vdst, u32 sdst,
                 u32 src0, u32 src1, u32 src2 = 0) {
  code->push_back(EncodeVop3BWord0(opcode, vdst, sdst));
  code->push_back(EncodeVop3Word1(src0, src1, src2));
}

void AppendVop3p(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 dst, u32 src0,
                 u32 src1, u32 src2 = 0, u32 op_sel_hi = 0, u32 op_sel = 0,
                 u32 neg_hi = 0, u32 neg = 0) {
  code->push_back(EncodeVop3pWord0(opcode, dst, op_sel_hi, op_sel, neg_hi));
  code->push_back(EncodeVop3pWord1(src0, src1, src2, op_sel_hi, neg));
}

void AppendBufferLoadDword(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 dst_vgpr,
                           u32 address_vgpr) {
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf0(0x0cu));
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf1(dst_vgpr, 0, address_vgpr));
}

void AppendBufferLoadOpcode(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 dst_vgpr,
                            u32 address_vgpr) {
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf0(opcode));
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf1(dst_vgpr, 0, address_vgpr));
}

void AppendBufferStoreDword(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 value_vgpr,
                            u32 address_vgpr) {
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf0(0x1cu));
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf1(value_vgpr, 12, address_vgpr));
}

void AppendBufferStoreOpcode(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 value_vgpr,
                             u32 address_vgpr, bool glc = false) {
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf0(opcode, 0, false, true, glc));
  code->push_back(EncodeMubuf1(value_vgpr, 12, address_vgpr));
}

void AppendTBufferLoadOpcode(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 dst_vgpr,
                             u32 address_vgpr) {
  code->push_back(EncodeMtbuf0(opcode, 14, 7));
  code->push_back(EncodeMtbuf1(opcode, dst_vgpr, 0, address_vgpr));
}

constexpr u32 BufferFormat(Prospero::BufferFormat format) {
  return static_cast<uint32_t>(format);
}

void AppendTBufferLoadFormatOpcode(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode,
                                   u32 dst_vgpr, u32 address_vgpr,
                                   Prospero::BufferFormat format) {
  const auto value = BufferFormat(format);
  code->push_back(EncodeMtbuf0(opcode, value & 0xfu, (value >> 4u) & 0x7u));
  code->push_back(EncodeMtbuf1(opcode, dst_vgpr, 0, address_vgpr));
}

void AppendTBufferStoreOpcode(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode,
                              u32 value_vgpr, u32 address_vgpr) {
  code->push_back(EncodeMtbuf0(opcode, 14, 7));
  code->push_back(EncodeMtbuf1(opcode, value_vgpr, 0, address_vgpr));
}

void AppendSmemLoadOpcode(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 opcode, u32 dst_sgpr,
                          u32 byte_offset) {
  code->push_back(EncodeSmem0(opcode, dst_sgpr));
  code->push_back(EncodeSmem1(byte_offset));
}

void AppendStoreVgpr(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 value_vgpr, u32 dword_index) {
  AppendVMovU32(code, 31, dword_index * 4u);
  AppendBufferStoreDword(code, value_vgpr, 31);
}

void AppendStoreVgprAtLaneDwordOffset(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 value_vgpr,
                                      u32 lane_vgpr, u32 dword_offset) {
  if (dword_offset == 0u) {
    code->push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 31, InlineU32(2), lane_vgpr));
  } else {
    AppendVMovU32(code, 31, dword_offset);
    code->push_back(EncodeVop2(0x25, 31, Vgpr(lane_vgpr), 31));
    code->push_back(EncodeVop2(0x1a, 31, InlineU32(2), 31));
  }
  AppendBufferStoreDword(code, value_vgpr, 31);
}

void AppendStoreSgpr(std::vector<u32> *code, u32 value_sgpr, u32 dword_index) {
```
