`tests/ShaderVertexMetadataTests.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "graphics/shader/shaderVertexMetadata.h"

#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

namespace {

using namespace Libs::Graphics;

void Check(bool value, const char* text) {
	if (!value) {
		std::fprintf(stderr, "ShaderVertexMetadataTests: failed: %s\n", text);
		std::abort();
	}
}

struct Fixture {
	std::array<uint16_t, static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::Last) + 1>    offsets {};
	ShaderUserData                                                             user_data {};
	ShaderSemantic                                                             semantic {};
	ShaderMappedData                                                           mapped {};

	Fixture() {
		offsets.fill(ILLEGAL_DIRECT_OFFSET);
		offsets[static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::PtrVertexBufferTable)]     = 2;
		offsets[static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::PtrVertexAttribDescTable)] = 4;
		user_data.direct_resource_offset = offsets.data();
		user_data.direct_resource_count  = static_cast<uint16_t>(offsets.size());
		mapped.user_data                 = &user_data;
		mapped.input_semantics           = &semantic;
		mapped.num_input_semantics       = 1;
	}
};

void CheckRejected(const ShaderMappedData& data, const char* text) {
	ShaderVertexMetadata output;
	std::array<ShaderSemantic, 7> prior_semantics {};
	output.vertex_buffer_reg = 37;
	output.vertex_attrib_reg = 41;
	output.input_semantics   = prior_semantics;
	Check(ShaderReadVertexMetadata(data, 64, output) != nullptr, text);
	Check(output.vertex_buffer_reg == 37 && output.vertex_attrib_reg == 41 &&
	          output.input_semantics.data() == prior_semantics.data() &&
	          output.input_semantics.size() == prior_semantics.size(),
	      "metadata rejection changed the prior output");
}

void TestValidAndInvalidMetadata() {
	Fixture              fixture;
	ShaderVertexMetadata output;
	Check(ShaderReadVertexMetadata(fixture.mapped, 64, output) == nullptr,
	      "valid vertex metadata was rejected");
	Check(output.vertex_buffer_reg == 2 && output.vertex_attrib_reg == 4 &&
	          output.input_semantics.size() == 1,
	      "valid vertex metadata was decoded incorrectly");

	Fixture buffer_only;
	buffer_only.offsets[static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::PtrVertexAttribDescTable)] =
	    ILLEGAL_DIRECT_OFFSET;
	buffer_only.mapped.input_semantics     = nullptr;
	buffer_only.mapped.num_input_semantics = 0;
	Check(ShaderReadVertexMetadata(buffer_only.mapped, 64, output) == nullptr,
	      "vertex-buffer-only metadata was rejected");
	Check(output.vertex_buffer_reg == 2 && output.vertex_attrib_reg == -1 &&
	          output.input_semantics.empty(),
	      "vertex-buffer-only metadata was decoded incorrectly");

	Fixture attrib_only;
	attrib_only.offsets[static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::PtrVertexBufferTable)] =
	    ILLEGAL_DIRECT_OFFSET;
	CheckRejected(attrib_only.mapped, "vertex-attribute-only metadata was accepted");

	auto missing_header      = fixture.mapped;
	missing_header.user_data = nullptr;
	CheckRejected(missing_header, "missing user-data header was accepted");

	Fixture missing_offsets;
	missing_offsets.user_data.direct_resource_offset = nullptr;
	CheckRejected(missing_offsets.mapped, "missing direct-resource offsets were accepted");

	Fixture excessive_resources;
	excessive_resources.user_data.direct_resource_count =
	    static_cast<uint16_t>(excessive_resources.offsets.size() + 1);
	CheckRejected(excessive_resources.mapped, "excessive direct-resource count was accepted");

	Fixture excessive_semantics;
	excessive_semantics.mapped.num_input_semantics = ShaderVertexInputInfo::RES_MAX + 1;
	CheckRejected(excessive_semantics.mapped, "excessive vertex semantic count was accepted");

	Fixture excessive_register;
	excessive_register.offsets[static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::PtrVertexBufferTable)] = 63;
	CheckRejected(excessive_register.mapped, "out-of-domain vertex table SGPR was accepted");

	Fixture excessive_attrib_register;
	excessive_attrib_register
	    .offsets[static_cast<size_t>(DirectResourceType::PtrVertexAttribDescTable)] = 63;
	CheckRejected(excessive_attrib_register.mapped,
	              "out-of-domain vertex attribute table SGPR was accepted");

	Fixture missing_semantics;
	missing_semantics.mapped.input_semantics = nullptr;
	CheckRejected(missing_semantics.mapped, "missing vertex semantic array was accepted");
}

} // namespace

int main() {
	TestValidAndInvalidMetadata();
	std::puts("ShaderVertexMetadataTests: all cases passed");
	return 0;
}
```

`tests/SlotVectorTests.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common/slotVector.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace {

void Check(bool value, const char *message) {
  if (!value) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "SlotVectorTests: failed: %s\n", message);
    std::abort();
  }
}

// Non-movable like the cached Image/Buffer; counts live objects.
struct Probe {
  Probe(int *live, uint32_t value) : live(live), value(value) { ++*live; }
  ~Probe() { --*live; }
  KYTY_CLASS_NO_COPY(Probe);

  int *live;
  uint32_t value;
};

static_assert(sizeof(Common::SlotId) == sizeof(uint32_t));

void TestInsertEraseReuse() {
  int live = 0;
  Common::SlotVector<Probe> slots;
  Check(!slots.is_allocated(Common::SlotId {}) && slots.try_get(Common::SlotId {}) == nullptr &&
            !slots.is_allocated(Common::SlotId {0}),
        "an empty vector reported an allocated slot");

  const auto a = slots.insert(&live, 0u);
  const auto b = slots.insert(&live, 1u);
  const auto c = slots.insert(&live, 2u);
  Check(a.index == 0 && b.index == 1 && c.index == 2 && live == 3,
        "fresh slots were not handed out in order");
  Check(slots.is_allocated(b) && slots.try_get(b) == &slots[b] && slots[b].value == 1,
        "an inserted slot did not expose its object");
  Check(!slots.is_allocated(Common::SlotId {3}), "an unused slot reported an object");

  slots.erase(b);
  slots.erase(a);
  Check(live == 1 && !slots.is_allocated(a) && !slots.is_allocated(b) &&
            slots.try_get(b) == nullptr && slots.is_allocated(c),
        "erase did not destroy and free exactly its slot");

  // Freed indices are reused most recently freed first, with the same plain id.
  const auto reused_a = slots.insert(&live, 0u);
  const auto reused_b = slots.insert(&live, 1u);
  const auto d = slots.insert(&live, 3u);
  Check(reused_a == a && reused_b == b && d.index == 3 && live == 4,
        "freed slots were not reused in LIFO order");
  Check(slots[reused_a].value == 0 && slots[reused_b].value == 1,
        "a reused slot did not expose its new object");
}

void TestForEachAndStability() {
  int live = 0;
  {
    Common::SlotVector<Probe> slots;
    const auto first = slots.insert(&live, 0u);
    Probe *const first_address = &slots[first];

    // Cross several chunks; earlier objects must keep their address.
    std::vector<Common::SlotId> ids {first};
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < 1000; ++i) {
      ids.push_back(slots.insert(&live, i));
    }
    Check(&slots[first] == first_address && live == 1000,
          "growing the vector moved a stored object");

    std::vector<uint32_t> expected;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) {
      if (i % 3 == 0) {
        slots.erase(ids[i]);
      } else {
        expected.push_back(i);
      }
    }
    std::vector<uint32_t> visited;
    std::as_const(slots).ForEach([&](Common::SlotId id, const Probe &probe) {
      Check(probe.value == id.index, "ForEach passed an id that does not match its object");
      visited.push_back(id.index);
    });
    Check(visited == expected && live == static_cast<int>(expected.size()),
          "ForEach did not visit exactly the live slots in index order");
  }
  Check(live == 0, "destroying the vector did not destroy every live object exactly once");
}

} // namespace

int main() {
  TestInsertEraseReuse();
  TestForEachAndStability();
  std::puts("SlotVectorTests: all cases passed");
  return 0;
}
```

`tests/SrtWalkerTestMemory.h`:

```h
#ifndef KYTY_TESTS_SRTWALKERTESTMEMORY_H_
#define KYTY_TESTS_SRTWALKERTESTMEMORY_H_

#include "graphics/shader/recompiler/ir/passes/SrtWalker.h"

#include <xbyak/xbyak.h>

#include <csignal>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iterator>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__linux__)
#include <ucontext.h>
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#elif defined(_WIN32)
#include <windows.h>
#endif

// Serves SRT walker loads from fake guest addresses: a walker load that faults completes with
// the test reader's DWORD, or with zero like the emulator when the reader fails or is null.
class FakeGuestMemory {
public:
  explicit FakeGuestMemory(Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtMemoryReader reader = nullptr,
                           void *userdata = nullptr) {
    Current() = {reader, userdata};
#if defined(__linux__) || defined(__APPLE__)
    struct sigaction action {};
    action.sa_sigaction = Handle;
    action.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < std::size(kSignals); ++index)
      sigaction(kSignals[index], &action, &m_previous[index]);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
    m_handler = AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, Handle);
#endif
  }
  ~FakeGuestMemory() {
#if defined(__linux__) || defined(__APPLE__)
    for (size_t index = 0; index < std::size(kSignals); ++index)
      sigaction(kSignals[index], &m_previous[index], nullptr);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
    RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(m_handler);
#endif
    Current() = {};
  }
  FakeGuestMemory(const FakeGuestMemory &) = delete;
  FakeGuestMemory &operator=(const FakeGuestMemory &) = delete;

private:
  using Reader = std::pair<Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtMemoryReader, void *>;
  static Reader &Current() {
    static thread_local Reader reader;
    return reader;
  }
  static uint32_t Read(uint64_t address) {
    uint32_t word = 0;
    const auto [reader, userdata] = Current();
    return reader != nullptr && reader(userdata, address, {&word, 1}) ? word : 0u;
  }
#if defined(__linux__) || defined(__APPLE__)
#if defined(__APPLE__)
  // macOS raises SIGBUS for some protection faults and SIGSEGV for others.
  static constexpr int kSignals[] = {SIGSEGV, SIGBUS};
#else
  static constexpr int kSignals[] = {SIGSEGV};
#endif
  static void Handle(int, siginfo_t *, void *context) {
    auto *native = static_cast<ucontext_t *>(context);
#if defined(__APPLE__)
    auto &rip = native->uc_mcontext->__ss.__rip;
    auto &rax = native->uc_mcontext->__ss.__rax;
    const auto r10 = native->uc_mcontext->__ss.__r10;
#else
    auto &rip = native->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP];
    auto &rax = native->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RAX];
    const auto r10 = native->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_R10];
#endif
    const auto length = Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtWalkerLoadLength(rip);
    if (length == 0) std::abort();
    rax = Read(r10);
    rip += length;
  }
  struct sigaction m_previous[std::size(kSignals)] {};
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  static LONG CALLBACK Handle(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *info) {
    auto &context = *info->ContextRecord;
    const auto length = Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtWalkerLoadLength(context.Rip);
    if (info->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION || length == 0)
      return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    context.Rax = Read(context.R10);
    context.Rip += length;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
  }
  void *m_handler = nullptr;
#endif
};

// Evaluates one value through a walker compiled for it, keeping the plan's resource walker.
inline bool EvaluateSrtValue(Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourcePlan &plan,
                             const Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtRuntime &runtime,
                             Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::Value value, uint32_t &result) {
  using namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR;
  const auto *inst = value.Resolve().TryInstruction();
  const auto output = inst != nullptr ? inst->WalkOutput() : UINT32_MAX;
  auto code = std::move(plan.srt_code);
  auto scratch = std::move(plan.srt_scratch);
  const auto user_data = plan.srt_user_data;
  const auto captures = plan.srt_captures;
  CompileSrtWalker(plan, {&value, 1});
  std::vector<uint32_t> flat;
  const bool known = WalkSrt(plan, runtime, flat, nullptr) && WalkedValue(plan, value, result);
  plan.srt_code = std::move(code);
  plan.srt_scratch = std::move(scratch);
  plan.srt_user_data = user_data;
  plan.srt_captures = captures;
  if (inst != nullptr) inst->SetWalkOutput(output);
  return known;
}

// Walks the plan's resources and reads back one descriptor.
inline bool EvaluateSrtDescriptor(const Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::ResourcePlan &plan,
                                  const Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::SrtRuntime &runtime,
                                  uint32_t source,
                                  Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR::DescriptorValue &result) {
  using namespace Libs::Graphics::ShaderRecompiler::IR;
  std::vector<uint32_t> flat;
  return WalkSrt(plan, runtime, flat, nullptr) && WalkedDescriptor(plan, source, result);
}

#endif // KYTY_TESTS_SRTWALKERTESTMEMORY_H_

```

`tests/SyncOnAddressTests.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "kernel/syncOnAddress.h"

#include "libs/errno.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace {

using Libs::LibKernel::SyncOnAddress::Wait32;
using Libs::LibKernel::SyncOnAddress::Wait64;
using Libs::LibKernel::SyncOnAddress::Wake;

std::atomic<int> g_signal_poll_count{0};

void Check(bool value, const char *text) {
  if (!value) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "SyncOnAddressTests: failed: %s\n", text);
    std::abort();
  }
}

template <typename T> void Store(T *address, T value) {
  std::atomic_ref<T>(*address).store(value, std::memory_order_release);
}

void CountSignalPoll() {
  g_signal_poll_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void TestInvalidAddress() {
  uint32_t timeout = 1;
  Check(Wait32(nullptr, 0, &timeout) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wait32 rejects a null address");
  Check(Wait64(nullptr, 0, &timeout) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wait64 rejects a null address");
  Check(Wake(nullptr, 1) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wake rejects a null address");

  alignas(uint64_t) uint8_t bytes[16] = {};
  auto *misaligned = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(bytes + 1);
  Check(Wait32(misaligned, 0, &timeout) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wait32 rejects a misaligned address");
  Check(Wait64(reinterpret_cast<uint64_t *>(bytes + 4), 0, &timeout) ==
            Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wait64 rejects a misaligned address");
  Check(Wake(misaligned, 1) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wake rejects a misaligned address");
  uint64_t aligned = 0;
  Check(Wake(&aligned, -1) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_EINVAL,
        "wake rejects a negative count");
}

void TestMismatchReturnsImmediately() {
  uint32_t word = 7;
  uint64_t word64 = UINT64_C(0x100000000);
  uint32_t timeout = 500000;
  const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  Check(Wait32(&word, 6, &timeout, CountSignalPoll) == OK,
        "mismatch succeeds without parking");
  Check(Wait64(&word64, 0, &timeout, CountSignalPoll) == OK,
        "wait64 compares all 64 bits");
  Check(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start <
            std::chrono::milliseconds(100),
        "mismatched value is a fast path");
  Check(g_signal_poll_count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) >= 2,
        "mismatch remains a guest signal safe-point");
}

void TestTimeout() {
  uint32_t word = 0;
  uint32_t timeout = 20000;
  const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  Check(Wait32(&word, 0, &timeout) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT,
        "matching value times out");
  const auto elapsed = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start;
  Check(elapsed >= std::chrono::milliseconds(10),
        "timeout does not return too early");
  Check(elapsed < std::chrono::milliseconds(500), "timeout remains bounded");

  timeout = 0;
  Check(Wait32(&word, 0, &timeout) == Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT,
        "zero timeout polls a matching value");
  word = 1;
  Check(Wait32(&word, 0, &timeout) == OK,
        "zero timeout succeeds for a mismatched value");
}

void TestValueChangeAndWake() {
  uint64_t word = 0;
  uint32_t timeout = 1000000;
  std::atomic<bool> ready{false};
  int result = Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT;

  std::thread waiter([&] {
    ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    result = Wait64(&word, 0, &timeout);
  });
  while (!ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  }
  Store(&word, UINT64_C(0x100000000));
  Check(Wake(&word, 1) == OK, "wake-one succeeds");
  waiter.join();
  Check(result == OK, "a value change plus wake releases the waiter");
}

void TestNanosecondTimeout() {
  uint64_t word = 0;
  const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  Check(Wait64(&word, 0, std::chrono::milliseconds(1)) ==
            Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT,
        "64-bit timespec wait expires");
  Check(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start >= std::chrono::milliseconds(1),
        "timespec wait preserves its deadline");
  Check(Wait64(&word, 0, std::chrono::nanoseconds(0)) ==
            Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT,
        "zero timespec polls a matching value");
  Check(Wait64(&word, 1, std::chrono::nanoseconds(0)) == OK,
        "zero timespec succeeds on mismatch");

  g_signal_poll_count.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  std::atomic<bool> returned{false};
  std::thread waker([&] {
    while (g_signal_poll_count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) < 2 &&
           !returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
      std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    Store(&word, UINT64_C(0x100000000));
    Check(Wake(&word, 1) == OK, "wake releases a long timespec wait");
  });
  const int result = Wait64(&word, 0, std::chrono::nanoseconds::max(), CountSignalPoll);
  returned.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  waker.join();
  Check(result == OK, "long timespec wait does not overflow its deadline");
  Check(g_signal_poll_count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) > 1,
        "timespec wait continues polling guest signals");
}

void TestWakeOneThenAll() {
  constexpr int WAITER_COUNT = 4;
  uint32_t word = 0;
  uint32_t timeout = 1000000;
  std::atomic<int> ready{0};
  std::atomic<int> returned{0};
  int results[WAITER_COUNT] = {};
  std::vector<std::thread> waiters;

  for (int i = 0; i < WAITER_COUNT; i++) {
    waiters.emplace_back([&, i] {
      ready.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
      results[i] = Wait32(&word, 0, &timeout);
      returned.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    });
  }
  while (ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != WAITER_COUNT) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  }
  std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
  Check(Wake(&word, 1) == OK, "wake-one succeeds with multiple waiters");
  const auto one_deadline =
      std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(500);
  while (returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0 &&
         std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < one_deadline) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  }
  Check(returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 1,
        "wake-one releases exactly one waiter");

  Check(Wake(&word, 2) == OK, "wake-two succeeds");
  const auto two_deadline =
      std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(500);
  while (returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) < 3 &&
         std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < two_deadline) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  }
  Check(returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 3,
        "wake-two releases exactly two more waiters");

  Check(Wake(&word, INT_MAX) == OK, "wake-all succeeds");
  for (auto &waiter : waiters) {
    waiter.join();
  }
  Check(returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == WAITER_COUNT,
        "wake-all releases the remaining waiters");
  for (int result : results) {
    Check(result == OK, "explicitly woken waiters return success");
  }
}

void TestAddressesAreIsolated() {
  uint32_t first = 0;
  uint32_t second = 0;
  uint32_t first_timeout = 1000000;
  uint32_t second_timeout = 1000000;
  std::atomic<int> ready{0};
  std::atomic<bool> first_returned{false};
  std::atomic<bool> second_returned{false};
  int first_result = 0;
  int second_result = 0;

  std::thread first_waiter([&] {
    ready.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    first_result = Wait32(&first, 0, &first_timeout);
    first_returned.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  });
  std::thread second_waiter([&] {
    ready.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    second_result = Wait32(&second, 0, &second_timeout);
    second_returned.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
  });
  while (ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 2) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  }
  std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
  Check(Wake(&first, 1) == OK, "first address wakes");
  std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
  Check(first_returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire),
        "first address waiter returned");
  Check(!second_returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire),
        "waking one address does not release another address");
  Check(Wake(&second, 1) == OK, "second address wakes");

  first_waiter.join();
  second_waiter.join();
  Check(first_result == OK && second_result == OK,
        "isolated waiters return success");
}

void TestCompareRegisterWakeRace() {
  for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    uint32_t word = 0;
    uint32_t timeout = 500000;
    std::atomic<bool> ready{false};
    int result = Libs::LibKernel::KERNEL_ERROR_ETIMEDOUT;
    std::thread waiter([&] {
      ready.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
      result = Wait32(&word, 0, &timeout);
    });
    while (!ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
      std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    Store(&word, uint32_t{1});
    (void)Wake(&word, 1);
    waiter.join();
    Check(result == OK, "compare/register/wake race never loses progress");
  }
}

void TestWakeZeroIsNoOp() {
  constexpr int WAITER_COUNT = 2;
  uint32_t word = 0;
  uint32_t timeout = 1000000;
  std::atomic<int> ready{0};
  std::atomic<int> returned{0};
  int results[WAITER_COUNT] = {};
  std::vector<std::thread> waiters;

  for (int i = 0; i < WAITER_COUNT; i++) {
    waiters.emplace_back([&, i] {
      ready.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
      results[i] = Wait32(&word, 0, &timeout);
      returned.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    });
  }
  while (ready.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != WAITER_COUNT) {
    std::this_thread::yield();
  }
  std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
  Check(Wake(&word, 0) == OK, "zero-count wake succeeds");
  std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
  Check(returned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0,
        "zero-count wake releases no waiters");
  Check(Wake(&word, INT_MAX) == OK, "wake-all succeeds after zero-count wake");
  for (auto &waiter : waiters) {
    waiter.join();
  }
  for (int result : results) {
    Check(result == OK, "wake-all releases waiters after zero-count no-op");
  }
}

} // namespace

int main() {
  TestInvalidAddress();
  TestMismatchReturnsImmediately();
  TestTimeout();
  TestValueChangeAndWake();
  TestNanosecondTimeout();
  TestWakeOneThenAll();
  TestAddressesAreIsolated();
  TestCompareRegisterWakeRace();
  TestWakeZeroIsNoOp();
  std::printf("SyncOnAddressTests: all passed\n");
  return 0;
}
```

```cpp
TEST(Trinity, ModeQueriesPacketsAndMemoryAgree) {
	static Common::Subsystems subsystems;
	Common::InitializeThreads();
	subsystems.Initialize<Config::Lifecycle>();
	Config::ConfigOptions options;
	options.printf_direction = Config::LogDirection::Silent;
	Config::Load(options);
	subsystems.Initialize<Log::Lifecycle>();
	Loader::SymbolDatabase symbols;
	Libs::InitLibKernel_1(&symbols);
	const auto* query = symbols.FindByNid("tU5e3f9gSiU", Loader::SymbolType::Func);
	const auto* operation = symbols.FindByNid("NH6xARDOVv8", Loader::SymbolType::Func);
	ASSERT_NE(query, nullptr);
	ASSERT_NE(operation, nullptr);
	const auto is_trinity = reinterpret_cast<int(KYTY_SYSV_ABI*)()>(query->vaddr);
	const auto operation_mode = reinterpret_cast<int(KYTY_SYSV_ABI*)(int*, int*)>(operation->vaddr);

	struct CommandBuffer {
		uint32_t* bottom;
		uint32_t* top;
		uint32_t* cursor_up;
		uint32_t* cursor_down;
		void* callback;
		void* user_data;
		uint32_t reserved_dw;
	};
	const auto path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() /
	                  ("kyty_trinity_" + std::to_string(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&symbols)) + ".json");
	struct Case { bool enabled; uint32_t attribute; bool expected; };
	for (const auto test: {Case {false, 0, false}, Case {false, 1u << 22, false}, Case {true, 0, false},
	                       Case {true, 1u << 21, false}, Case {true, 1u << 22, true}}) {
		options.pro_enabled = test.enabled;
		Config::Load(options);
		{
			std::ofstream file(path);
			file << "{\"attribute3\":" << test.attribute
			     << R"(,"kernel":{"flexibleMemorySize":3221225472,"cpuPageTableSize":134217728,"gpuPageTableSize":0},"amm":{"pagetableMemorySizeInMib":96}})";
			ASSERT_TRUE(file.good());
		}
		testing::internal::CaptureStdout();
		Loader::SystemContentLoadParamSfo(path);
		std::filesystem::remove(path);
		EXPECT_EQ(Loader::SystemContentIsTrinityMode(), test.expected);
		EXPECT_EQ(is_trinity(), test.expected ? 1 : 0);
		int mode = -1, submode = -1;
		EXPECT_EQ(operation_mode(&mode, &submode), 0);
		EXPECT_EQ(mode, test.expected ? 3 : 2);
		EXPECT_EQ(submode, 0);
		uint8_t graphics_mode = 0xff;
		Libs::Graphics::Gen5::AgcGetIsTrinityMode(&graphics_mode);
		EXPECT_EQ(graphics_mode, test.expected ? 1 : 0);
		std::array<uint32_t, 5> packet {};
		CommandBuffer buffer {packet.data(), packet.data() + packet.size(), packet.data(),
		                      packet.data() + packet.size(), nullptr, nullptr, 0};
		Libs::Graphics::Gen5::AgcDcbSetUcRegistersIndirect(
		    reinterpret_cast<Libs::Graphics::Gen5::CommandBuffer*>(&buffer), nullptr, 0);
		EXPECT_EQ(packet[0], KYTY_PM4(5, Pm4::IT_SET_UCONFIG_REG_INDIRECT,
		                              test.expected ? 1 : 0));
		const auto console = testing::internal::GetCapturedStdout();
		if (test.enabled) {
			EXPECT_EQ(console, test.expected ? "[PS5] title Trinity support=yes\n"
			                                 : "[PS5] title Trinity support=no\n");
		} else {
			EXPECT_TRUE(console.empty()) << console;
		}
	}

	using namespace Libs::LibKernel::Memory;
	subsystems.Initialize<Lifecycle>();
	constexpr uint64_t mib = 1024 * 1024;
	constexpr uint64_t backing = (12800 + 1216 - 64 - 96) * mib;
	constexpr uint64_t flexible = 3072 * mib;
	EXPECT_EQ(TestGuestBackingSize(), backing);
	EXPECT_EQ(KernelGetDirectMemorySize(), backing - flexible);
	size_t configured = 0;
	ASSERT_EQ(KernelConfiguredFlexibleMemorySize(&configured), 0);
	EXPECT_EQ(configured, flexible);
	int64_t available_start = -1;
	size_t available_size = 0;
	ASSERT_EQ(KernelAvailableDirectMemorySize(0, backing - flexible, 0x4000,
	                                         &available_start, &available_size), 0);
	EXPECT_EQ(available_start, 0);
	EXPECT_EQ(available_size, backing - flexible);
	int64_t physical = -1;
	ASSERT_EQ(KernelAllocateDirectMemory(backing - flexible - 0x4000, backing - flexible,
	                                     0x4000, 0x4000, 0, &physical), 0);
	void* mapped = nullptr;
	ASSERT_EQ(KernelMapDirectMemory(&mapped, 0x4000, 2, 0, physical, 0), 0);
	*static_cast<volatile uint64_t*>(mapped) = 0x123456789abcdef0ull;
	EXPECT_EQ(*static_cast<volatile uint64_t*>(mapped), 0x123456789abcdef0ull);
	EXPECT_EQ(KernelMunmap(reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(mapped), 0x4000), 0);
	EXPECT_EQ(KernelCheckedReleaseDirectMemory(physical, 0x4000), 0);
}
```

```cpp
  const auto japanese = Common::Localization::Get(0, key);

  for (const auto &translation : translations) {

          "invalid console language falls back to English");

            "missing.translation",

class TempDirectory {
public:
  TempDirectory() {
    const auto unique =
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count();
    m_path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() /
             ("kyty_trophy_test_" + std::to_string(unique));
    Check(std::filesystem::create_directories(m_path),
          "create temporary directory");
  }
  ~TempDirectory() {

    std::filesystem::remove_all(m_path, error);

void WriteBigEndian(std::vector<char> &bytes, size_t offset, uint64_t value,
                    size_t length) {
  Check(offset <= bytes.size() && length <= bytes.size() - offset,
        "write within package");
  for (size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
    bytes[offset + length - 1 - i] = static_cast<char>(value & 0xff);
    value >>= 8;
  }
}

void WritePackage(const std::filesystem::path &path,
                  const std::map<std::string, std::string> &files) {
  size_t offset = 0x40 + files.size() * 0x40;
  size_t size = offset;
  for (const auto &[name, contents] : files)
    size += contents.size();
  std::vector<char> bytes(size);
  WriteBigEndian(bytes, 0, 0xb228c60a, 4);
  WriteBigEndian(bytes, 4, 1, 4);
  WriteBigEndian(bytes, 8, bytes.size(), 8);
  WriteBigEndian(bytes, 0x10, files.size(), 4);
  WriteBigEndian(bytes, 0x14, 0x20, 4);
  size_t entry = 0x40;
  for (const auto &[name, contents] : files) {
    Check(name.size() < 0x20, "fixture file name fits");
    std::memcpy(bytes.data() + entry, name.data(), name.size());
    WriteBigEndian(bytes, entry + 0x20, offset, 8);
    WriteBigEndian(bytes, entry + 0x28, contents.size(), 8);
    std::memcpy(bytes.data() + offset, contents.data(), contents.size());
    offset += contents.size();
    entry += 0x40;
  }
  Common::File file;
  Check(file.Create(path), "create package fixture");
  uint32_t written = 0;
  file.Write(bytes.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes.size()), &written);
  Check(written == bytes.size(), "write package fixture");
}

		]})"},

std::vector<int>
EvaluateEvent(const Trophies::Package &package, std::string_view event,
              const std::map<std::string, Trophies::UdsInteger> &properties) {
  Trophies::UnlockData unlocks;
  return Trophies::ApplyUdsEvent(package, unlocks, event, properties).trophies;
}

void TestEventExtraction(const std::filesystem::path &directory) {
  auto package = MakePackage(directory);
  Check(package.trophies.size() == 5,
        "unsupported signed target does not discard trophy metadata");
  Check(package.trophies.at(1).uds_stat_id == 10 &&
            package.trophies.at(1).target == 10 &&
            !package.trophies.at(1).progressive,
        "non-progressive trophy retains its stat target");
  Check(!package.trophies.at(4).target,
        "negative target is not converted to unsigned");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "FIND_ALL_COINS", {{"counter", uint64_t{100}}})
            .empty(),
        "missing mapping never guesses from trophy text");
  const auto path = directory / "uds00.ucp";
  WritePackage(path, {{"stats_definition.json", R"({"statDefinitionArray":[
			{"statId":10,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"latest","minValue":"0"},
			{"statId":20,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"latest"},

			{"statId":40,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"sum"},
			{"statId":50,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"count"},
			{"statId":60,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"max"},
			{"statId":70,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"latest","maxValue":"3"}
		]})"},
                      {"stats_extraction.json", R"({"statsExtractionRuleArray":[
			{"condition":{"eventName":"COLLECT"},"action":{"input":"$.counter","output":{"statId":10}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"COLLECT"},"action":{"input":"$.counterBase","output":{"statId":20}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"MULTI"},"action":{"input":"$.first","output":{"statId":10}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"MULTI"},"action":{"input":"$.last","output":{"statId":10}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"TIME"},"action":{"input":"$.seconds","output":{"statId":30}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"FILTERED","property":{"path":"$.level","comparator":"==","value":1}},"action":{"input":"$.counter","output":{"statId":10}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"NESTED"},"action":{"input":"$.player.counter","output":{"statId":10}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"SUM"},"action":{"input":"$.counter","output":{"statId":40}}},
			{"condition":{"eventName":"COUNT"},"action":{"output":{"statId":50}}},

  package.event_rules = Trophies::LoadUdsRules(path);
  Check(package.event_rules.size() == 4,
        "skip unsupported extraction and aggregation");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "MULTI",
                      {{"first", uint64_t{10}}, {"last", uint64_t{0}}}) ==
            std::vector<int>{1},
        "each latest action can satisfy an unlock condition");
  Check(
      EvaluateEvent(package, "COLLECT",
                    {{"counter", uint64_t{9}}, {"counterBase", uint64_t{100}}})
          .empty(),
      "do not add independent counters or treat gt as ge");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "COLLECT",
                      {{"counter", uint64_t{10}},
                       {"counterBase", uint64_t{100}}}) == std::vector<int>{1},
        "each stat reads its configured property");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "COLLECT",
                      {{"counter", uint64_t{0}},
                       {"counterBase", uint64_t{101}}}) == std::vector<int>{2},
        "strict comparison requires greater value");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(
            package, "COLLECT",
            {{"counter", uint64_t{10}}, {"counterBase", uint64_t{101}}}) ==
            std::vector<int>({1, 2}),
        "one event can unlock multiple mapped trophies");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "TIME", {{"seconds", uint32_t{5}}}) ==
            std::vector<int>{3},
        "less-equal condition accepts its boundary");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "TIME", {{"seconds", uint32_t{6}}}).empty(),
        "less-equal condition rejects larger input");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "TIME", {{"counter", uint64_t{0}}}).empty(),
        "missing property is not zero");
  package.trophies.at(3).comparison = Trophies::Comparison::Less;
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "TIME", {{"seconds", uint32_t{5}}}).empty(),
        "strict less rejects its boundary");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "TIME", {{"seconds", uint32_t{4}}}) ==
            std::vector<int>{3},
        "strict less accepts lower input");
  package.trophies.at(3).comparison = Trophies::Comparison::GreaterEqual;
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "TIME", {{"seconds", uint64_t{UINT32_MAX} + 1}})
            .empty(),
        "uint64 input cannot update a uint32 stat");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "COLLECT", {{"counter", int32_t{100}}}).empty(),
        "signed inputs cannot update unsigned stats");
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "COLLECT", {{"counter", uint32_t{100}}}).empty(),
        "unsigned input width must match the stat");
  package.trophies.at(1).comparison = Trophies::Comparison::None;
  Check(EvaluateEvent(package, "COLLECT", {{"counter", uint64_t{100}}}).empty(),
        "unknown comparator cannot unlock");
  WritePackage(path, {{"stats_extraction.json", "{}"}});
  Check(Trophies::LoadUdsRules(path).empty(),
        "missing stat definitions cannot infer aggregation");
  Check(Trophies::LoadUdsRules(directory / "missing.ucp").empty(),
        "missing UDS package has no rules");
}

void TestProgress(const std::filesystem::path &directory) {
  const auto package = MakePackage(directory);
  Trophies::UnlockData unlocks;
  unlocks.unlocked = {0, 1, 999};
  const auto progress = Trophies::GetProgress(package, unlocks);
  Check(progress.total == 5 && progress.earned == 2,
        "ignore unlock IDs absent from package");
  Check(progress.earned_grade[1] == 1 && progress.earned_grade[2] == 1 &&
            progress.Percentage() == 60,
        "percentage uses 6:2:1 grade points and excludes platinum");
  const auto group = Trophies::GetProgress(package, unlocks, 1);
  Check(group.total == 1 && group.earned == 0 && group.Percentage() == 0,
        "group counts filter trophies");
  Check(Trophies::GetProgress({}, {}).Percentage() == 0,
        "empty package progress is zero");
}

Trophies::Package TestMaximumStats(const std::filesystem::path &directory) {
  auto package = MakePackage(directory);
  package.trophies.erase(3);
  package.trophies.erase(4);
  package.trophies.at(1).progressive = true;
  package.trophies.at(1).target = 5;
  package.trophies.at(1).platinum_id = 0;
  package.trophies.at(2).platinum_id = 0;
  const auto path = directory / "maximum.ucp";
  WritePackage(path, {{"stats_definition.json", R"({"statDefinitionArray":[
    {"statId":10,"dataType":"int64","aggregation":"max","minValue":"0","initialValue":"2"},
    {"statId":20,"dataType":"uint32","aggregation":"max"},
    {"statId":30,"dataType":"uint64","aggregation":"max"},
    {"statId":40,"dataType":"int64","aggregation":"max"},
    {"statId":50,"dataType":"int64","aggregation":"max","minValue":"-1"},
    {"statId":60,"dataType":"int64","aggregation":"max","minValue":"0","initialValue":"9223372036854775808"}
  ]})"},
                      {"stats_extraction.json", R"({"statsExtractionRuleArray":[
    {"condition":{"eventName":"MAX"},"action":{"input":"$.newValue","output":{"statId":10}}},
    {"condition":{"eventName":"MAX32"},"action":{"input":"$.newValue","output":{"statId":20}}},
    {"condition":{"eventName":"MAX64"},"action":{"input":"$.newValue","output":{"statId":30}}},
    {"condition":{"eventName":"BAD_MIN"},"action":{"input":"$.newValue","output":{"statId":40}}},
    {"condition":{"eventName":"NEGATIVE_MIN"},"action":{"input":"$.newValue","output":{"statId":50}}},
    {"condition":{"eventName":"BAD_INITIAL"},"action":{"input":"$.newValue","output":{"statId":60}}}
  ]})"}});
  package.event_rules = Trophies::LoadUdsRules(path);
  Check(package.event_rules.size() == 3,
        "only nonnegative representable maximum stats are supported");
  Trophies::UnlockData unlocks;
  const auto post = [&](std::string_view name, Trophies::UdsInteger value) {
    return Trophies::ApplyUdsEvent(package, unlocks, name,
                                   {{"newValue", value}});
  };
  for (const auto value :
       {Trophies::UdsInteger{INT64_MIN}, Trophies::UdsInteger{int32_t{5}},
        Trophies::UdsInteger{uint64_t{5}}}) {
    const auto result = post("MAX", value);
    Check(result.trophies.empty() && !result.stats_changed &&
              unlocks.max_stats.empty(),
          "invalid signed stat input never mutates progress");
  }
  Check(post("MAX", int64_t{1}).stats_changed && unlocks.max_stats.at(10) == 2,
        "maximum includes configured initial value");
  Check(post("MAX", int64_t{4}).trophies.empty() &&
            unlocks.max_stats.at(10) == 4,
        "subthreshold progress is retained");
  Check(!post("MAX", int64_t{2}).stats_changed &&
            !post("MAX", int64_t{4}).stats_changed &&
            unlocks.max_stats.at(10) == 4,
        "lower and repeated inputs do not change maximum");
  const auto saved = directory / "maximum.json";
  Check(Trophies::SaveUnlockData(saved, unlocks), "save subthreshold progress");
  unlocks = Trophies::LoadUnlockData(saved);
  Check(unlocks.max_stats.at(10) == 4 &&
            post("MAX", int64_t{5}).trophies == std::vector<int>{1},
        "reloaded progress reaches exact unlock threshold");
  unlocks.unlocked.insert(1);
  Check(post("MAX", int64_t{6}).trophies.empty(),
        "unlocked trophies are not reported again");
  Check(post("MAX", int64_t{INT64_MAX}).stats_changed &&
            unlocks.max_stats.at(10) == INT64_MAX,
        "retain full signed 64-bit precision");
  Check(post("MAX32", uint32_t{UINT32_MAX}).stats_changed &&
            post("MAX64", uint64_t{UINT64_MAX}).stats_changed &&
            unlocks.max_stats.at(20) == UINT32_MAX &&
            unlocks.max_stats.at(30) == UINT64_MAX,
        "retain unsigned maxima without signed overflow");
  Check(Trophies::SaveUnlockData(saved, unlocks) &&
            Trophies::LoadUnlockData(saved).max_stats == unlocks.max_stats,
        "persist full-width stat values");
  return package;
}

void TestMaximumEventHle(const std::filesystem::path &directory,
                         Trophies::Package package) {
  namespace Trophy = Libs::LibNpTrophy2;
  using namespace Libs::LibNpUniversalDataSystem;
  const auto previous = std::filesystem::current_path();
  std::filesystem::create_directory(directory / "hle");
  std::filesystem::current_path(directory / "hle");
  Config::Initialize();
  Trophy::g_packages.emplace(0, std::move(package));
  const int user = Config::GetUserId();
  int context = 0;
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemCreateContext(&context, user, 0, 0) == 0 &&
            NpUniversalDataSystemRegisterContext(context, 1, 0) == 0,
        "register UDS context");
  auto *state = Trophy::LoadTrophyState({user, 0});
  Trophy::NpTrophy2Data data{};
  const auto progress = [&] {
    Trophy::FillTrophyInfo(*state, state->package->trophies.at(1), nullptr,
                           &data);
    return data.progress.value;
  };
  Check(progress() == 2 && !data.unlocked,
        "report configured initial progress");
  const auto post = [&](int target_context, int64_t value) {
    NpUniversalDataSystemEventPropertyObject properties;
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemEventPropertyObjectSetInt64(
              &properties, "newValue", value) == 0,
          "set signed event value");
    NpUniversalDataSystemEvent *event = nullptr;
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemCreateEvent("MAX", &properties, &event,
                                           nullptr) == 0,
          "create progress event");
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemEventPropertyObjectSetString(
              &properties, "newValue", "replaced") == 0 &&
              properties.integers.empty(),
          "noninteger property replaces integer");
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemPostEvent(target_context, 1, event, 0) == 0,
          "post copied signed event");
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemDestroyEvent(event) == 0,
          "destroy progress event");
  };
  post(context, 4);
  Check(progress() == 4 && !data.unlocked && Libs::Graphics::notifications == 0,
        "signed event updates partial progress without unlocking");
  Trophy::g_states.clear();
  state = Trophy::LoadTrophyState({user, 0});
  post(context, 3);
  Check(progress() == 4 && !data.unlocked, "reloaded maximum cannot regress");
  NpUniversalDataSystemEvent direct{"_UnlockTrophy",
                                    {{{"_trophy_id", int32_t{2}}}}};
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemPostEvent(context, 1, &direct, 0) == 0 &&
            state->unlocks.unlocked == std::set<int>{2},
        "ordinary trophy direct unlock still works");
  post(context, 5);
  Check(progress() == 5 && data.unlocked &&
            state->unlocks.unlocked == std::set<int>({0, 1, 2}) &&
            Libs::Graphics::notifications == 3,
        "threshold awards trophy and linked platinum once");
  const auto timestamps = state->unlocks.timestamps;
  post(context, 6);
  Check(state->unlocks.timestamps == timestamps &&
            Libs::Graphics::notifications == 3 &&
            Trophies::LoadUnlockData(state->path).max_stats.at(10) == 6,
        "later progress persists without duplicate unlocks");
  int guest_context = 0;
  const auto guest = Config::GetPlayerUserId(1);
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemCreateContext(&guest_context, guest, 0, 0) == 0 &&
            NpUniversalDataSystemRegisterContext(guest_context, 1, 0) == 0,
        "register guest UDS context");
  post(guest_context, 5);
  const auto *guest_state = Trophy::LoadTrophyState({guest, 0});
  Check(guest_state->unlocks.max_stats.empty() &&
            guest_state->unlocks.unlocked.empty() &&
            guest_state->path.empty() && Libs::Graphics::notifications == 3,
        "guests do not earn or save progress");
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemDestroyContext(context) == 0 &&
            NpUniversalDataSystemDestroyContext(guest_context) == 0,
        "destroy UDS contexts");
  Trophy::g_states.clear();
  Trophy::g_packages.clear();
  Config::Shutdown();
  std::filesystem::current_path(previous);
}

void TestUnlockPersistence(const std::filesystem::path &directory) {
  const auto path = Trophies::UnlocksPath(directory, "PPSA00001", 1000, 0);
  Check(path == directory / "_Trophies/PPSA00001/trophies_1000_0.json",
        "store trophies outside save data");
  Check(Trophies::UnlocksPath(directory, "../bad", 1000, 0).empty(),
        "reject unsafe title IDs");
  Check(Trophies::LoadUnlockData(path).unlocked.empty(),
        "missing unlock file loads as empty");
  Trophies::UnlockData unlocks;
  unlocks.unlocked = {4, 42};
  const auto tick = Trophies::UnixEpochTick + 1791288000123456ULL;
  unlocks.timestamps.emplace(42, tick);
  Check(Trophies::SaveUnlockData(path, unlocks), "save timestamped unlocks");
  auto loaded = Trophies::LoadUnlockData(path);
  Check(loaded.unlocked == unlocks.unlocked &&
            loaded.timestamps == unlocks.timestamps,
        "persist full UTC microsecond timestamp");
  loaded.unlocked.insert(43);
  loaded.timestamps.emplace(43, tick + 1000000);
  Check(Trophies::SaveUnlockData(path, loaded), "replace existing unlock file");
  Check(Trophies::LoadUnlockData(path).timestamps.at(42) == tick,
        "retain original unlock time");

  const auto blocked = directory / "blocked.json";
  std::filesystem::create_directory(blocked);
  Common::File sentinel;
  Check(sentinel.Create(blocked / "keep"),
        "create replacement failure fixture");
  sentinel.Close();
  Check(!Trophies::SaveUnlockData(blocked, loaded) &&
            std::filesystem::exists(blocked / "keep"),
        "failed replacement leaves destination intact");
  Check(!std::filesystem::exists(directory / "blocked.json.tmp"),
        "failed replacement removes temporary file");
}

void TestReportedProgress(const std::filesystem::path &directory) {
  const auto trophy_path = directory / "trophy02.ucp";
  WritePackage(
      trophy_path,
      {{"tropconf.json", R"({"defaultLanguage":"en-US","trophies":[
			{"id":"0","grade":"P"},
			{"id":"9","grade":"B","unlockCondition":{"targetValue":"8","progressive":true}},
			{"id":"10","grade":"B"}
		]})"},
       {"tropmeta_en-US.json",
        R"({"metadata":{"titleMetadata":{"name":"Progress"},"trophyMetadata":[]}})"}});
  const auto package = Trophies::LoadPackage(trophy_path, 1);
  Check(package.trophies.size() == 3, "load progressive trophy without stat");

  Trophies::UnlockData unlocks;
  bool changed = false;
  const auto &trophy = package.trophies.at(9);
  Check(!Trophies::TrophyProgress(trophy, unlocks),
        "no progress before the first report");
  Check(!Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 9, 1, unlocks, changed) && changed &&
            Trophies::TrophyProgress(trophy, unlocks) == 1,
        "first report records progress");
  Check(!Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 9, 3, unlocks, changed) && changed &&
            Trophies::TrophyProgress(trophy, unlocks) == 3,
        "higher report raises progress");
  Check(!Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 9, 2, unlocks, changed) && !changed &&
            Trophies::TrophyProgress(trophy, unlocks) == 3,
        "lower report is ignored");
  Check(!Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 10, 5, unlocks, changed) &&
            !Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 0, 5, unlocks, changed) &&
            !Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 42, 5, unlocks, changed) && !changed &&
            unlocks.progress.size() == 1,
        "only progressive trophies take reported progress");

  const auto path = Trophies::UnlocksPath(directory, "PPSA09809", 1000, 0);
  Check(Trophies::SaveUnlockData(path, unlocks) &&
            Trophies::LoadUnlockData(path).progress == unlocks.progress,
        "persist reported progress");

  Check(Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 9, 9, unlocks, changed) &&
            Trophies::TrophyProgress(trophy, unlocks) == 8,
        "reaching the target unlocks and caps progress");
  unlocks.unlocked.insert(9);
  Check(!Trophies::UpdateTrophyProgress(package, 9, 10, unlocks, changed) && !changed,
        "unlocked trophies stop taking progress");
}

void TestReportedEventHle(const std::filesystem::path &directory) {
  namespace Trophy = Libs::LibNpTrophy2;
  using namespace Libs::LibNpUniversalDataSystem;
  auto package = MakePackage(directory);
  package.trophies.erase(3);
  package.trophies.erase(4);
  package.trophies.at(2).progressive = true;
  package.trophies.at(2).target = 8;
  package.trophies.at(2).uds_stat_id = std::nullopt;
  package.trophies.at(1).platinum_id = 0;
  package.trophies.at(2).platinum_id = 0;
  const auto previous = std::filesystem::current_path();
  std::filesystem::create_directory(directory / "progress_hle");
  std::filesystem::current_path(directory / "progress_hle");
  Config::Initialize();
  Trophy::g_packages.emplace(0, std::move(package));
  const int user = Config::GetUserId();
  int context = 0;
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemCreateContext(&context, user, 0, 0) == 0 &&
            NpUniversalDataSystemRegisterContext(context, 1, 0) == 0,
        "register UDS context for reported progress");
  auto *state = Trophy::LoadTrophyState({user, 0});
  Trophy::NpTrophy2Data data{};
  const auto progress = [&] {
    Trophy::FillTrophyInfo(*state, state->package->trophies.at(2), nullptr,
                           &data);
    return data.progress.value;
  };
  const int base = Libs::Graphics::notifications;
  Check(progress() == 0 && !data.unlocked, "reported progress starts empty");
  const auto post = [&](int target_context, int32_t trophy, int32_t value) {
    NpUniversalDataSystemEventPropertyObject properties;
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemEventPropertyObjectSetInt32(
              &properties, "_trophy_id", trophy) == 0,
          "set reported trophy id");
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemEventPropertyObjectSetInt32(
              &properties, "_trophy_progress", value) == 0,
          "set reported progress value");
    NpUniversalDataSystemEvent *event = nullptr;
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemCreateEvent("_UpdateTrophyProgress", &properties,
                                           &event, nullptr) == 0,
          "create reported progress event");
    const int result = NpUniversalDataSystemPostEvent(target_context, 1, event, 0);
    Check(NpUniversalDataSystemDestroyEvent(event) == 0,
          "destroy reported progress event");
    return result;
  };
  Check(post(context, 1, 4) == 0 && state->unlocks.progress.empty() &&
            Libs::Graphics::notifications == base,
        "non-progressive trophies ignore reported progress");
  Check(post(context, 2, 0) == 0 && state->unlocks.progress.at(2) == 0,
        "zero is valid reported progress");
  const std::optional<Trophies::UdsInteger> invalid[] = {
      std::nullopt, int32_t{-1}, uint32_t{2}, int64_t{2}, uint64_t{2},
      uint64_t{UINT64_MAX}};
  for (const auto *key : {"_trophy_id", "_trophy_progress"}) {
    for (const auto &value : invalid) {
      NpUniversalDataSystemEvent event{
          "_UpdateTrophyProgress",
          {{{"_trophy_id", int32_t{2}}, {"_trophy_progress", int32_t{8}}}}};
      event.properties.SetInteger(key, value);
      Check(NpUniversalDataSystemPostEvent(context, 1, &event, 0) ==
                NP_UNIVERSAL_DATA_SYSTEM_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT,
            "progress events require two nonnegative Int32 properties");
    }
  }
  const auto saved = Trophies::LoadUnlockData(state->path);
  Check(state->unlocks.progress == (std::map<int, uint64_t>{{2, 0}}) &&
            saved.progress == state->unlocks.progress &&
            state->unlocks.unlocked.empty() && saved.unlocked.empty() &&
            state->unlocks.timestamps.empty() && saved.timestamps.empty() &&
            Libs::Graphics::notifications == base,
        "invalid progress events leave memory, disk and notifications unchanged");
  Check(post(context, 2, 3) == 0 && progress() == 3 && !data.unlocked &&
            Trophies::LoadUnlockData(state->path).progress.at(2) == 3,
        "partial report is saved as trophy progress");
  Trophy::g_states.clear();
  state = Trophy::LoadTrophyState({user, 0});
  Check(post(context, 2, 1) == 0 && progress() == 3,
        "reloaded reported progress cannot regress");
  Check(post(context, 2, 8) == 0 && progress() == 8 && data.unlocked &&
            state->unlocks.unlocked == std::set<int>{2} &&
            Libs::Graphics::notifications == base + 1,
        "reaching the target awards the trophy");
  Check(Trophies::LoadUnlockData(state->path).unlocked == std::set<int>{2},
        "reaching the target persists the trophy award");
  NpUniversalDataSystemEvent direct{"_UnlockTrophy",
                                    {{{"_trophy_id", int32_t{1}}}}};
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemPostEvent(context, 1, &direct, 0) == 0 &&
            state->unlocks.unlocked == std::set<int>({0, 1, 2}) &&
            Libs::Graphics::notifications == base + 3,
        "remaining trophies award the linked platinum");
  int guest_context = 0;
  const auto guest = Config::GetPlayerUserId(1);
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemCreateContext(&guest_context, guest, 0, 0) == 0 &&
            NpUniversalDataSystemRegisterContext(guest_context, 1, 0) == 0,
        "register guest UDS context for reported progress");
  post(guest_context, 2, 5);
  const auto *guest_state = Trophy::LoadTrophyState({guest, 0});
  Check(guest_state->unlocks.progress.empty() &&
            guest_state->path.empty() && Libs::Graphics::notifications == base + 3,
        "guests do not save reported progress");
  Check(NpUniversalDataSystemDestroyContext(context) == 0 &&
            NpUniversalDataSystemDestroyContext(guest_context) == 0,
        "destroy UDS contexts of reported progress");
  Trophy::g_states.clear();
  Trophy::g_packages.clear();
  Config::Shutdown();
  std::filesystem::current_path(previous);
}
} // namespace

int main() {
  TestLocalization();
  TempDirectory directory;
  TestEventExtraction(directory.Path());
  TestProgress(directory.Path());
  TestUnlockPersistence(directory.Path());
  TestMaximumEventHle(directory.Path(), TestMaximumStats(directory.Path()));
  TestReportedProgress(directory.Path());
  TestReportedEventHle(directory.Path());
  std::printf("TrophySystemTests: all cases passed\n");
  return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// Six 16x16 YUV420 frames with Y=40,60,80,100,120,140, encoded by libx264

constexpr std::array<size_t, 7> PacketOffsets{0, 58, 79, 95, 112, 139, sizeof(Avc)};

// One independent, immediately displayable IDR (same pixels, QP18, no B frames).

	0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,0x09,0x10,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,0x67,0x64,0x10,0x0a,0xac,0xbb,
	0xd0,0x80,0x00,0x00,0x03,0x00,0x80,0x00,0x00,0x03,0x01,0x02,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,
	0x68,0xee,0x02,0x32,0xc8,0xb0,0x00,0x00,0x01,0x65,0x88,0x84,0x3a,0xfe,0xf5,0x27,
	0xf8,0x14,0xd0,0x8c,0x2d,
};

InputData Input(uint32_t packet) {
	return {sizeof(InputData), const_cast<uint8_t*>(Avc + PacketOffsets[packet]),
	        PacketOffsets[packet + 1] - PacketOffsets[packet],
	        PresentationOrder[packet] * 1000u, packet * 1000u,
	        0x12340000u + PresentationOrder[packet]};
}

struct GuardedMemory {
	uint8_t* allocation;
	uint8_t* data;
	size_t size;
	explicit GuardedMemory(size_t bytes): size(bytes) {
		allocation = static_cast<uint8_t*>(std::aligned_alloc(256, (bytes + 767u) & ~size_t{255}));
		CHECK(allocation != nullptr);
		data = allocation + 256;
		std::memset(allocation, 0xa7, bytes + 512);
	}
	~GuardedMemory() { Check(); std::free(allocation); }
	void Check() const {
		for (size_t i = 0; i < 256; ++i)
			CHECK(allocation[i] == 0xa7 && data[size + i] == 0xa7);
	}
};

ConfigInfo Config() {
	ConfigInfo config{};
	config.this_size = sizeof(config);
	config.resource_type = config.codec_type = 1;
	config.profile = 100;
	config.max_level = 10;
	config.max_width = config.max_height = 16;
	config.max_dpb_frames = 4;
	config.extra_dpb_frames = 1;
	config.input_queue_depth = 3;
	config.cpu_thread_priority = -1;
	config.optimize_progressive = true;
	return config;
}

struct Session {
	GuardedMemory queue_memory{sizeof(ComputeQueue)};
	GuardedMemory state_memory{sizeof(State)};
	ConfigInfo config = Config();
	MemoryInfo memory{sizeof(MemoryInfo)};
	ComputeQueue* queue = nullptr;
	State* decoder = nullptr;

	explicit Session(bool disable_sync = false) {
		ComputeMemoryInfo compute{sizeof(compute), 0, queue_memory.data};
		CHECK(QueryComputeMemoryInfo(&compute) == 0);
		CHECK(compute.cpu_gpu_memory_size == queue_memory.size);
		CHECK(compute.cpu_gpu_memory == queue_memory.data);
		ComputeConfigInfo queue_config{sizeof(queue_config), 3, 3, true, 0, 0};
		CHECK(AllocateComputeQueue(&queue_config, &compute, &queue) == 0);
		config.compute_queue = queue;
		config.disable_sync_input = disable_sync;
		CHECK(QueryDecoderMemoryInfo(&config, &memory) == 0);
		CHECK(memory.cpu_memory_size == state_memory.size);
		CHECK(memory.gpu_memory_size == 0 && memory.cpu_gpu_memory_size == 0);
		CHECK(memory.max_frame_buffer_size == 10240 && memory.frame_buffer_alignment == 256);
		memory.cpu_memory = state_memory.data;
		CHECK(CreateDecoder(&config, &memory, &decoder) == 0);
		CHECK(ReleaseComputeQueue(queue) == Fail(Error::ComputeQueue));
	}
	~Session() {
		CHECK(DeleteDecoder(decoder) == 0);
		CHECK(DeleteDecoder(decoder) == Fail(Error::DecoderInstance));
		CHECK(ReleaseComputeQueue(queue) == 0);
		CHECK(ReleaseComputeQueue(queue) == Fail(Error::ComputeQueue));
	}
	void Submit(uint32_t packet) {
		auto input = Input(packet);
		CHECK(SetDecodeInput(decoder, &input) == 0);
		InputResult result{sizeof(result)};
		CHECK(TrySyncDecodeInput(decoder, &result) == 0);
		CHECK(result.decoded_au == input.au_data && result.reserved0 == 0);
	}
};

void TestRegistrationAndErrors() {
	Loader::SymbolDatabase symbols;
	InitVdecsw_1(&symbols);
	g_print_name = false;
	constexpr std::array nids{"0moTubWCsTM", "hIgrg5h4V6s", "A+2M7EivuOU", "+L5ArV1tPGA",
	    "ecUtPX+dBYk", "fX-zOOefbbs", "aqMiF0AgUYI", "veb-YBrOqo0", "kMBw37oH8nI",
	    "rgtMCOpyBSc", "ihNT-uuEAr4", "5Y6nZqIZvBg", "l4sQYy5wPkc"};
	CHECK(registrations.size() == nids.size());
	for (size_t i = 0; i < nids.size(); ++i) {
		const auto& symbol = registrations[i];
		CHECK(symbol.name == nids[i] && symbol.library == "Vdecsw" && symbol.module == "Vdecsw");
		CHECK(symbol.library_version == 1 && symbol.module_version_major == 1 && symbol.module_version_minor == 1);
	}
	CHECK(uint32_t(Fail(Error::StructSize)) == 0x81510101u);
	CHECK(QueryComputeMemoryInfo(nullptr) == Fail(Error::ArgumentPointer));
	ComputeMemoryInfo compute{};
	CHECK(QueryComputeMemoryInfo(&compute) == Fail(Error::StructSize));
	auto config = Config();
	MemoryInfo memory{sizeof(memory)};
	config.max_width = 3840; config.max_height = 2160; config.max_level = 52;
	CHECK(QueryDecoderMemoryInfo(&config, &memory) == 0 && memory.max_frame_buffer_size == 12445696u);
	config.this_size = 72;
	CHECK(QueryDecoderMemoryInfo(&config, &memory) == Fail(Error::StructSize));
	Session session;
	GuardedMemory other_queue(sizeof(ComputeQueue));
	ComputeMemoryInfo compute_duplicate{sizeof(compute_duplicate), other_queue.size, other_queue.data};
	ComputeConfigInfo same_queue{sizeof(same_queue), 3, 3, false, 0, 0};
	ComputeQueue* duplicate = nullptr;
	CHECK(AllocateComputeQueue(&same_queue, &compute_duplicate, &duplicate) == Fail(Error::ComputeQueue));
	CHECK(duplicate == nullptr);
	compute_duplicate.cpu_gpu_memory = session.queue_memory.data;
	same_queue.queue_id = 2;
	CHECK(AllocateComputeQueue(&same_queue, &compute_duplicate, &duplicate) == Fail(Error::ComputeQueue));
	State* duplicate_decoder = nullptr;
	CHECK(CreateDecoder(&session.config, &session.memory, &duplicate_decoder) == Fail(Error::MemoryPointer));
	CHECK(duplicate_decoder == nullptr);
	CHECK(ResetDecoder(nullptr) == Fail(Error::DecoderInstance));
	InputResult completion{sizeof(completion)};
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeInput(session.decoder, &completion) == Fail(Error::InputQueueEmpty));
	OutputInfo output{sizeof(output)};
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &output) == Fail(Error::OutputBufferEmpty));
	GuardedMemory pixels(session.memory.max_frame_buffer_size);
	FrameBuffer frame{sizeof(frame), pixels.data + 1, pixels.size};
	CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &frame) == Fail(Error::FrameBufferAlignment));
	frame.data = pixels.data; frame.size--;
	CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &frame) == Fail(Error::FrameBufferSize));
	frame.size++;
	CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &frame) == 0);
	CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &frame) == Fail(Error::OutputBufferFull));
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &output) == Fail(Error::DecodePending));
	CHECK(ResetDecoder(session.decoder) == 0);
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &output) == Fail(Error::OutputBufferEmpty));
}

void CheckPicture(const OutputInfo& output, uint32_t frame, GuardedMemory& pixels) {
	CHECK(output.valid && output.picture_count == 1 && !output.error_frame && !output.discarded_frame);
	CHECK(output.width == 16 && output.height == 16 && output.pitch == 256 && output.pitch_in_bytes == 256);
	CHECK(output.frame_buffer == pixels.data && output.frame_buffer_size == pixels.size);
	for (uint32_t y = 0; y < 16; ++y)
		for (uint32_t x = 0; x < 16; ++x) CHECK(pixels.data[y * 256 + x] == 40 + frame * 20);
	Decoder::AvcPictureInfo picture{sizeof(picture)};
	CHECK(GetAvcPictureInfo(&output, &picture, nullptr) == 0);
	CHECK(picture.is_valid && picture.pts_data == frame * 1000u);
	CHECK(picture.attached_data == 0x12340000u + frame);
	CHECK(picture.profile_idc == 100 && picture.level_idc == 10);
	CHECK(picture.pic_width_in_mbs_minus1 == 0 && picture.pic_height_in_map_units_minus1 == 0);
	pixels.Check();
}

void TestBFramesAndFinalization() {
	Session session;
	GuardedMemory pixels(session.memory.max_frame_buffer_size);
	FrameBuffer buffer{sizeof(buffer), pixels.data, pixels.size};
	CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &buffer) == 0);
	uint32_t frames = 0;
	bool registered = true;
	OutputInfo output{sizeof(output)};
	const auto receive = [&] {
		if (!registered) { CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &buffer) == 0); registered = true; }
		const auto result = TrySyncDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &output);
		if (result == Fail(Error::DecodePending)) return false;
		CHECK(result == 0);
		CheckPicture(output, frames++, pixels);
		registered = false;
		return true;
	};
	CHECK(!receive()); // Output may be supplied before the first AU.
	for (uint32_t packet = 0; packet < 6; ++packet) {
		session.Submit(packet);
		while (receive()) CHECK(!output.last_frame);
	}
	CHECK(frames < 6); // B pictures remain in the decoder until end of sequence.
	CHECK(FinalizeDecodeSequence(session.decoder) == 0);
	while (frames < 6) { CHECK(receive()); CHECK(output.last_frame == (frames == 6)); }
	CHECK(FinalizeDecodeSequence(session.decoder) == 0);
	auto input = Input(0);
	CHECK(SetDecodeInput(session.decoder, &input) == Fail(Error::ApiFail));
	CHECK(ResetDecoder(session.decoder) == 0);
	Decoder::AvcPictureInfo picture{sizeof(picture)};
	CHECK(GetAvcPictureInfo(&output, &picture, nullptr) == Fail(Error::OutputInfo));
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &output) == Fail(Error::OutputBufferEmpty));
	InputResult completion{sizeof(completion)};
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeInput(session.decoder, &completion) == Fail(Error::InputQueueEmpty));
	session.Submit(0); // Reset accepts a new sequence.
}

void TestImmediateIntra() {
	Session session;
	InputData input{sizeof(input), const_cast<uint8_t*>(Intra), sizeof(Intra), 0, 0, 0x12340000};
	CHECK(SetDecodeInput(session.decoder, &input) == 0);
	InputResult completion{sizeof(completion)};
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeInput(session.decoder, &completion) == 0);
	CHECK(completion.output_frame_count == 1 && completion.decoded_au == Intra);
	GuardedMemory pixels(session.memory.max_frame_buffer_size);
	FrameBuffer buffer{sizeof(buffer), pixels.data, pixels.size};
	CHECK(SetDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &buffer) == 0);
	OutputInfo output{sizeof(output)};
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeOutput(session.decoder, &output) == 0);
	CheckPicture(output, 0, pixels);
	CHECK(!output.last_frame); // Output is available without another AU or finalization.
}

void TestCompletionOrderAndBackpressure() {
	Session session;
	for (uint32_t packet = 0; packet < 3; ++packet) {
		auto input = Input(packet);
		CHECK(SetDecodeInput(session.decoder, &input) == 0);
	}
	auto retry = Input(3);
	CHECK(SetDecodeInput(session.decoder, &retry) == Fail(Error::InputQueueFull));
	for (uint32_t packet = 0; packet < 3; ++packet) {
		InputResult output{sizeof(output)};
		CHECK(TrySyncDecodeInput(session.decoder, &output) == 0);
		CHECK(output.decoded_au == Input(packet).au_data);
	}
	session.Submit(3); // A rejected AU was not consumed.
	CHECK(ResetDecoder(session.decoder) == 0);
}

Decoder::Input BackendInput(uint32_t packet) {
	const auto input = Input(packet);
	return {input.au_data, input.au_size, input.pts, input.dts, input.attached_data};
}

void CheckBackendPicture(const Decoder::Output& output, uint32_t frame, GuardedMemory& pixels) {
	CHECK(output.valid && output.buffer == pixels.data && output.width == 16 && output.height == 16);
	for (uint32_t y = 0; y < 16; ++y)
		for (uint32_t x = 0; x < 16; ++x) CHECK(pixels.data[y * 256 + x] == 40 + frame * 20);
	Decoder::PictureInfo picture{};
	CHECK(Decoder::GetPictureInfo(pixels.data, &picture));
	CHECK(picture.pts == frame * 1000u && picture.attached_data == 0x12340000u + frame);
	pixels.Check();
}

void TestFailedCopyRetention() {
	auto* decoder = Decoder::Create({1, 16, 16, 8});
	CHECK(decoder != nullptr);
	for (uint32_t packet = 0; packet < 6; ++packet) {
		uint32_t produced = 0;
		CHECK(Decoder::Submit(decoder, BackendInput(packet), &produced) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
	}
	CHECK(Decoder::Finalize(decoder) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
	GuardedMemory pixels(10240);
	Decoder::Output output{};
	CHECK(Decoder::Receive(decoder, {pixels.data, 1}, &output) == Decoder::Result::FrameBufferSize);
	CHECK(!output.valid);
	for (uint32_t frame = 0; frame < 6; ++frame) {
		CHECK(Decoder::Receive(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
		CheckBackendPicture(output, frame, pixels);
		CHECK(output.last_frame == (frame == 5));
	}
	CHECK(Decoder::Receive(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::NoFrame);
	Decoder::PictureInfo picture{};
	Decoder::Destroy(decoder);
	CHECK(!Decoder::GetPictureInfo(pixels.data, &picture));
}

void TestBoundedQueueFinalization() {
	auto* decoder = Decoder::Create({1, 16, 16, 2});
	CHECK(decoder != nullptr);
	GuardedMemory pixels(10240);
	Decoder::Output output{};
	uint32_t frames = 0;
	uint32_t rejected = 0;
	for (uint32_t packet = 0; packet < 6;) {
		uint32_t produced = 0;
		const auto result = Decoder::Submit(decoder, BackendInput(packet), &produced);
		if (result == Decoder::Result::InputFull) {
			CHECK(produced == 0);
			++rejected;
			CHECK(Decoder::Receive(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
			CheckBackendPicture(output, frames++, pixels);
			CHECK(!output.last_frame);
		} else { CHECK(result == Decoder::Result::Ok); ++packet; }
	}
	CHECK(rejected > 0 && frames < 6);
	// The retained queue is full, and FFmpeg still holds delayed B pictures.
	CHECK(Decoder::Finalize(decoder) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
	while (frames < 6) {
		CHECK(Decoder::Receive(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
		CheckBackendPicture(output, frames++, pixels);
		CHECK(output.last_frame == (frames == 6));
	}
	CHECK(Decoder::Receive(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::NoFrame);
	Decoder::Destroy(decoder);
}

void TestCombinedDecode() {
	auto* decoder = Decoder::Create({1, 16, 16});
	CHECK(decoder != nullptr);
	GuardedMemory pixels(10240);
	Decoder::Output output{};
	uint32_t frames = 0;
	for (uint32_t packet = 0; packet < 6; ++packet) {
		CHECK(Decoder::Decode(decoder, BackendInput(packet), {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
		if (output.valid) CheckBackendPicture(output, frames++, pixels);
		CHECK(Decoder::Flush(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
		CHECK(!output.valid); // Legacy Flush is receive-only; the next AU remains acceptable.
	}
	CHECK(frames == 4);
	CHECK(Decoder::Finalize(decoder) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
	while (frames < 6) {
		CHECK(Decoder::Flush(decoder, {pixels.data, pixels.size}, &output) == Decoder::Result::Ok);
		CheckBackendPicture(output, frames++, pixels);
	}
	Decoder::Destroy(decoder);
}

void TestDisabledInputSync() {
	Session session(true);
	auto input = Input(0);
	CHECK(SetDecodeInput(session.decoder, &input) == 0);
	InputResult completion{sizeof(completion)};
	CHECK(TrySyncDecodeInput(session.decoder, &completion) == Fail(Error::ApiFail));
}
}

int main() {
	TestRegistrationAndErrors();
	TestBFramesAndFinalization();
	TestImmediateIntra();
	TestCompletionOrderAndBackpressure();
	TestFailedCopyRetention();
	TestBoundedQueueFinalization();
	TestCombinedDecode();
	TestDisabledInputSync();
	std::puts("Vdecsw tests passed");
}
```

```cpp
struct TestFailure {};

struct GpuRangeEvent {

	uint64_t address;
	size_t size;
	bool operator==(const GpuRangeEvent&) const = default;
};
```
